analyzed: na prayojana vaśāt ānanda śrutim utsṛjāmaḥ kim tu mukti śruti antara balāt eva tām anyathā nayāmaḥ na ca atyantam utsṛjāmaḥ iti adoṣaḥ nanu anānanda ātmake brahmaṇi apuruṣa artha tvāt pravṛttiḥ na syāt pravṛttau ca asya na nā icchā asti anicchoḥ pravṛtti anupapatteḥ sā eva ca rāgaḥ

original: ataḥ kathaṃ śāntatā tavāpītyāśaṅkya paraḥ svapakṣe pravṛttimadhikāriṇaṃ ca śāntaṃ darśayati— tasmāditi ; yasmādānandarāgātpravṛttāvevaṃ doṣastasmādityarthaḥ | P. 1-16.

original: sakalapādhyātmikādibhedabhinnaṃ duḥkhajātamatikrānte brahmattve tebhyaṃ eva duḥkhebhyaḥ udvignaḥ sukhebhyaśca hairaṇyagarbhebhyaḥ kṣayādidoṣaparibhāvanayā vigataspṛhaḥ pravartamāno mucyata ityarthaḥ | na hi duḥkhanivṛttīcchā rāgaḥ, kiṃ tu sukhecchā ; duḥkhanivṛttyarthamapi loke pravṛttirdṛṣṭā ;
analyzed: sakala pādhyātmika ādi bheda bhinnam duḥkha jātam atikrānte brahmattve tebhyaḥ eva duḥkhebhyaḥ udvignaḥ sukhebhyaḥ ca hairaṇyagarbhebhyaḥ kṣaya ādi doṣa paribhāvanayā vigata spṛhaḥ pravartamānaḥ mucyate iti arthaḥ na hi duḥkha nivṛtti icchā rāgaḥ kim tu sukha icchā duḥkha nivṛtti artham api loke pravṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā

original: ataḥ pravṛttiradhikārī cāsmatpakṣe ghaṭata iti bhāvaḥ | nanu yadi nānandātmakaṃ brahma kā tarhi “vijñānamānandam” ityādiśrutīnāṃ gatirityāśaṅkyāha—ānandeti | sakalasyādhyātmikādibhedabhinnasya trividhasyātikramamabhāvamāhuḥ gamayanti ; lakṣaṇayetyarthaḥ | sukhaṃ hi duḥkhābhāvāvinābhūtam ;
analyzed: atas pravṛttiḥ adhikārī ca asmad pakṣe ghaṭate iti bhāvaḥ nanu yadi na ānanda ātmakam brahma kā tarhi vijñānam ānandam ityādi śrutīnām gatiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha ānanda iti sakalasya ādhyātmika ādi bheda bhinnasya trividhasya atikramam abhāvam āhuḥ gamayanti lakṣaṇayā iti arthaḥ sukham hi duḥkha abhāva avinābhūtam

original: yatnāpi yugapat sukhaduḥkhe tatrāpi sukhadvārajaduḥkhābhāvenāvinābhūtam | anupapannaṃ ca brahmaṇi pūrvoktayuktyā | tasmādānandaśrutiṣu lakṣaṇaiva nyāyyā | ke cittu sukhe duḥkhābhāve ca sukhaśabdasya prayogādakṣādiśabdavadanekārthatvamicchanti ; tadayuktam, ekārthatvenaivetaratra lakṣaṇayā prayogopapatterabhidhānaśaktikalpanānupapatteḥ |

original: bhāvarūpe tu tasmin dharmādharmayoriva viruddhayorapyekatra yaugapadyamupapadyate | dharmādharmayoścaikatrātmani sthitāviva janmanyapi yaugapadyamastyeva ; yatraikasmāt vyāpārādekasya nigraho'nyasya cānugrahaḥ | saṃtāpavataśca śītahṛde nimamānimagnārdhakāgradvayadvāre sukhaduḥkhe yugapaddṛśyete | ato na duḥkhābhāvaḥ sukhamityarthaḥ |

original: iha tu kṛtsnadehamabhivyāpyāvasthitena tvagindriyāvayavinaikena toyenārdhasaṃyoginā sakramanaḥsaṃyogādhiṣṭhitena cittena sitāsitajñānavadekaṃ śītoṣṇagrāhi jñānamupajanyate; tena ca sukhaduḥkhe yugapajjanyate; te ca manaḥsaṃyogāviśeṣādyugapadekatva jñāne pratibhātaḥ| tasmāt sūktam—yugapat sukhaduḥkhayordarśanāditi | atrāśaṅkayati— atheti |
analyzed: iha tu kṛtsna deham abhivyāpya avasthitena tvak indriya avayavinā ekena toyena ardha saṃyoginā sakra manaḥ saṃyoga dhiṣṭhitena cittena sita asita jñāna vat ekam śīta uṣṇa grāhi jñānam upajanyate tena ca sukha duḥkhe yugapad janyate te ca manaḥ saṃyoga aviśeṣāt yugapad eka tva jñāne pratibhātaḥ tasmāt su uktam yugapad sukha duḥkhayoḥ darśanāt iti atra āśaṅkayati atha iti

original: atha satyapi śītahṛde'nimagnārdhakāyadvāre duḥkham, itarasya P. 1-20. nimamārdhakāyadvārasya duḥkhasyābhāvāt sukhitvamityucyata ityarthaḥ | evamāśaṅkaya dūṣayati—kumbhīti | kumbhīpāke narake pacyamānasya puṃso rauravādinarakvāntaraduḥkhasya bhuktasya pradhvaṃsābhāvādabhuktasya ca prāgabhāvāt sukhitvaprasaṅgaḥ syāt | na ca tadiṣṭam;
analyzed: atha sati api duḥkham itarasya duḥkhasya abhāvāt sukhitvam iti ucyate iti arthaḥ evam āśaṅkaya dūṣayati kumbhī iti kumbhīpāke narake pacyamānasya puṃsaḥ raurava ādi narakva antara duḥkhasya bhuktasya pradhvaṃsa abhāvāt abhuktasya ca prāgabhāvāt sukhitva prasaṅgaḥ syāt na ca tat iṣṭam

original: narake hi sukhāsaṃbhinnamaikāntikaduḥkham | tadidamalokamāgamamātrasujñeyamiti laukike viṣaye'tiprasaṅgadoṣamāha—eketi | ekendriyadvāraṃ duḥkhaṃ yasya puṃsaḥ sa tathoktaḥ | tasyendriyāntaradvāraduḥkhābhāvāt; sukhitvaprasaṅga ityanuṣajyate | hetvantaramāha—itaśceti | itaśca na duḥkhābhāvaḥ sukhamityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha—aduḥkhasyeti |
analyzed: narake hi sukha asaṃbhinnam aikāntika duḥkham tat idam alokam āgama mātra su jñeyam iti laukike viṣaya iti prasaṅga doṣam āha eka iti eka indriya dvāram duḥkham yasya puṃsaḥ sa tathā uktaḥ tasya indriya antara dvāra duḥkha abhāvāt sukhi tva prasaṅgaḥ iti anuṣajyate hetu antaram āha etas ca iti itas ca na duḥkha abhāvaḥ sukham iti arthaḥ kutas iti āha aduḥkhasya iti

original: nāsti duḥkhaṃ yasya puṃsaḥ so'duḥkhaḥ, tasya karpūrādiviṣayaviśeṣeṇa saṃyogāt saṃvedyasya hrādasya sukhasyotpatterityarthaḥ| saṃvedyagrahaṇamanubhavasiddhatvānnāsau ‘nāsti’ iti vaktuṃ śakyata iti darśayitum | nāduḥkhasya duḥkhapradhvaṃsaḥ sukham, asmato dhvaṃsāyogāt; na ca duḥkhaprāgabhāvaḥ, tasya viṣayairajanyatvāt; asya ca viṣayajanyatvāt;
analyzed: na asti duḥkham yasya puṃsaḥ saḥ duḥkhaḥ tasya karpūra ādi viṣaya viśeṣeṇa saṃyogāt saṃvedyasya hrādasya sukhasya utpatteḥ iti arthaḥ saṃvedya grahaṇam anubhava siddha tvāt na asau na asti iti vaktum śakyate iti darśayitum na aduḥkhasya duḥkha pradhvaṃsaḥ sukham asmataḥ dhvaṃsa ayogāt na ca duḥkha prāgabhāvaḥ tasya viṣayaiḥ ajanya tvāt asya ca viṣaya janya tvāt

original: tābhyāṃ sukhamanyadeva tatra saṃvedyata iti bhāvaḥ | yatra tarhi śudādiduḥkhamasti tatrānnapānādibhistatpradhvaṃsaḥ sukhaṃ kiṃ na syādityāśaṅkayāha—yatrāpīti | kuta ityata āha—anneti | surasāmbhaḥsuśītalānnapānopādānādityarthaḥ | nanvannapānaviśeṣopādānāt taduḥkhavigama eva bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkayāha—yaistairiti |
analyzed: tābhyām sukham anyat eva tatra saṃvedyate iti bhāvaḥ yatra tarhi śudh ādi duḥkham asti tatra anna pāna ādibhiḥ tad pradhvaṃsaḥ sukham kim na syāt iti āśaṅkayā āha yatra api iti kutas iti atas āha anna iti surasa ambhaḥ suśītala anna pāna upādānāt iti arthaḥ nanu anna pāna viśeṣa upādānāt tad duḥkha vigamaḥ eva bhaviṣyati iti āśaṅkayā āha yaiḥ taiḥ iti

original: yādṛśaistādṛśairasvādubhirapītyarthaḥ | nanu duḥkhavigamaviśeṣārthamevānnapānaviśeṣopādānaṃ bhaviṣyati; dṛṣṭo hi kāraṇaviśeṣāt kāryaviśeṣa ityāśaṅkayāha—na ceti | duḥkhābhāvasyāsiśayābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | bhāvarūpe tu sukhe tasyāsiśayavaccāt tadarthaṃ sukhasādhanaviśeṣāpekṣā yuktā | taduktam—sukhe tviti |
analyzed: yādṛśaiḥ tādṛśaiḥ asvādubhiḥ api iti arthaḥ nanu duḥkha vigama viśeṣa artham eva anna pāna viśeṣa upādānam bhaviṣyati dṛṣṭaḥ hi kāraṇa viśeṣāt kārya viśeṣaḥ iti āśaṅkayā āha na ca iti duḥkha abhāvasya asiśaya abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ bhāva rūpe tu sukhe tasya asiśaya vaccāt tad artham sukha sādhana viśeṣa apekṣā yuktā tat uktam sukhe tu iti
p 8

original: P. 2-8. aduḥkhasyeti yaduktaṃ tatrāśaṅkayati—yadapīti | viṣayaprāptiṃ vinā kāma eva duḥkham, atastannivṛttireva sukhaṃ bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ | taddūṣayati— tatreti; tasminnapi pakṣe | akāmasya avidyamānakāmasya puṃsaḥ pavanopanītācintitacampakagandhādiviṣayaviśeṣopabhoge sati sukhitā na syādityarthaḥ | mā bhavatviti cet tatrāha—bhavati ceti |
analyzed: aduḥkhasya iti yat uktam tatra āśaṅkayati yat api iti viṣaya prāptim vinā kāmaḥ eva duḥkham atas tad nivṛttiḥ eva sukham bhaviṣyati iti arthaḥ tat dūṣayati tatra iti tasmin api pakṣe akāmasya avidyamāna kāmasya puṃsaḥ pavana upanīta acintita campaka gandha ādi viṣaya viśeṣa upabhoge sati sukhitā na syāt iti arthaḥ mā bhavatu iti ced tatra āha bhavati ca iti

original: madhyastho rāgavairāgyayormadhye vartamāna ityarthaḥ | kāmanivṛtteḥ sukhatvavyabhicārārthamakāmasyāpītyuktam, tatra codayati—syādetaditi | sukhayatīti sukho viṣayaḥ, ṇyantāddhātoḥ pacādyac | svapakṣe sādhutvamāha—kāmanivṛttyā tviti | abhiruciriti kāmasya vivaraṇam |
analyzed: madhyasthaḥ rāga vairāgyayoḥ madhye vartamānaḥ iti arthaḥ kāma nivṛtteḥ sukhatva vyabhicāra artham akāmasya api iti uktam tatra codayati syāt etat iti sukhayati iti sukhaḥ viṣayaḥ sva pakṣe sādhutvam āha kāma nivṛttyā tu iti abhiruciḥ iti kāmasya vivaraṇam

original: yatrakāmasya viṣayaviśeṣayogāt sukhaṃ bhavati tatra tarhi kā gatirityāśaṅkyāha—tatreti | sahajo hi rāgaḥ sarvapuṃsāmasti, sa tu viṣayaviśeṣeṇāvirbhavatīti dhiyoktam—kāmābhivyaktāviti | siddhāntī pratyāha—tadapīti | nivarhaṇā hantāraḥ | bhavantītyadhyāhārtham | imamevārthamabhiyuktoktyā draḍhayati—uktaṃ hīti |
analyzed: yatra kāmasya viṣaya viśeṣa yogāt sukham bhavati tatra tarhi kā gatiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha tatra iti sahajaḥ hi rāgaḥ sarva puṃsām asti sa tu viṣaya viśeṣeṇa āvirbhavati iti dhiyā uktam kāma abhivyaktau iti siddhāntī pratyāha tat api iti nivarhaṇāḥ hantāraḥ bhavanti iti adhyāhā artham imam eva artham abhiyukta uktyā draḍhayati uktam hi iti

original: tathā pātañjalenāpi vacasāṃ draḍhayati—bhogeti | yathā bhogābhyāso vivardhate viśeṣeṇa vardhate tathā rāgo'pītyarthaḥ | doṣāntaramāha—viṣayadoṣeti | kāmanivṛtteravastutvenāviśeṣāditi bhāvaḥ | doṣāntaramāha—samāne ceti | ekasya prārthitārthalābhe prabhodo mahān bhavati, anyasya cārupa iti prabhodabhedo na syādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tathā pātañjalena api vacasām draḍhayati bhoga iti yathā bhoga abhyāsaḥ vivardhate viśeṣeṇa vardhate tathā rāgaḥ upi iti arthaḥ doṣa antaram āha viṣaya doṣa iti kāma nivṛtteḥ avastu tvena aviśeṣāt iti bhāvaḥ doṣa antaram āha samāne ca iti ekasya prārthita artha lābhe prabhodaḥ mahān bhavati anyasya cārupaḥ iti prabhoda bhedaḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ

original: kuta ityāha—kāmanivṛtteriti | para idānīṃ viśeṣamāha—syāditi | yasya kāmo'tirikto mahān sa tannivṛttau sukhamanatiriktamapyatiriktamabhimanyate, na taccato'tiriktam, kāmanivṛtteraviśeṣāt; itaratra tvanatirikte kāme anyathā anatiśayitamityarthaḥ | tatra doṣamāha—tacceti |
analyzed: kutas ityāha kāma nivṛtteḥ iti paraḥ idānīm viśeṣam āha syāt iti yasya kāma utiriktaḥ mahān sa tad nivṛttau sukham anatiriktam api atiriktam abhimanyate na tat catur atiriktam kāma nivṛtteḥ aviśeṣāt itaratra tu anatirikte kāme anyathā anatiśayitam iti arthaḥ tatra doṣam āha tat ca iti

original: satyapi kāmātireke kleśāvāse'rthe sukhātirekābhāvāt, asatyapi kāmātireke'kleśādupagate sukhātiśayadarśanānna kāmātirekanibandhanaḥ sukhātirekābhimāna ityarthaḥ | kāmātirekāddhetoḥ prayāsaṃ kleśaṃ kurvāṇaṃ naraṃ na tathā labdho'rthaḥ prīṇayati, yathā vinā prayāsādupanato'prārthitaḥ prīṇayatītyanvayaḥ |
analyzed: sati api kāma atireke sukha atireka abhāvāt asati api kāma atireke kleśāt upagate sukha atiśaya darśanāt na kāma atireka nibandhanaḥ sukha atireka abhimānaḥ iti arthaḥ kāma atirekāt hetoḥ prayāsam kleśam kurvāṇam naram na tathā labdha ūrthaḥ prīṇayati yathā vinā prayāsāt upanata uprārthitaḥ prīṇayati iti anvayaḥ

original: imamarthaṃ lokasiddhenānubhavena draḍhayati—tathā hīti | anāśaṃsitamaprārthitamityarthaḥ | kiṃ ca kiṃ kāmābhāvamātraṃ sukham, atha pradhvaṃsaḥ? tatrādye pakṣe doṣamāha—
analyzed: imam artham loka siddhena anubhavena draḍhayati tathā hi iti anāśaṃsitam aprārthitam iti arthaḥ kim ca kim kāma abhāva mātram sukham atha pradhvaṃsaḥ tatra ādye pakṣe doṣam āha
p 9

original: kāmābhāvamātre ceti | akāmitaviṣayopabhoge bhogāt prāk kāmasya P. 2-23. prāgabhāvaḥ ; bhogāvasthāyāṃ paratra ca viṣayaprāptyuddhuddhasya kāmasya pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ ; ataḥ kāmābhāvasyāviśeṣāt bhogāvasthātaḥ sakāśāt pūrvāpare avasthe na bhidyeyātām ; tasyāmiva tayorapi sukhī syāt ; na caivamastīti bhāvaḥ | dvitīye pakṣe doṣamāha—kāmadhvaṃsa iti |
analyzed: kāma abhāva mātre ca iti a kāmita viṣaya upabhoge bhogāt prāk kāmasya prāgabhāvaḥ bhoga avasthāyām paratra ca kāma abhāvasya aviśeṣāt bhoga avasthātaḥ sakāśāt pūrva apare avasthe na bhidyeyātām tasyām iva tayoḥ api sukhī syāt na ca evam asti iti bhāvaḥ dvitīye pakṣe doṣam āha kāma dhvaṃsaḥ iti

original: kāmadhvaṃse ca sukhe bhogāvasthātaḥ sakāśāt parāvasthā na bhidyeta ; ubhayatrāpi kāmadhvaṃsāviśeṣāt bhogāvasthāyāmiva taduttarakālamapi sukhī syādityarthaḥ | atha bhogāvasthāyāṃ sakāmaḥ pumān ; pūrvāparayoravasthayostvakāmaḥ ; tena kāmābhāvamātre sukhe bhogāvasthātaḥ pūrvāpare avasthe bhidyete ; kāmapradhvaṃse ca sukhe parāvasthābhidyete ;
analyzed: kāma dhvaṃse ca sukhe bhoga avasthātaḥ sakāśāt para avasthā na bhidyeta ubhayatra api kāma dhvaṃsa aviśeṣāt bhoga avasthāyām iva tad uttarakālam api sukhī syāt iti arthaḥ atha bhoga avasthāyām sa kāmaḥ pumān pūrva aparayoḥ avasthayoḥ tu akāmaḥ tena kāma abhāva mātre sukhe bhoga avasthātaḥ pūrva apare avasthe bhidyete kāma pradhvaṃse ca sukhe para avasthā bhidyete

original: ataḥ pakṣadvayoktadoṣāprasaṅga ityucyate | tadayuktam ; evaṃ hyādye pakṣe bhogāvasthātaḥ pūrvāparayoravasthayoḥ kāmābhāvamātrātmakamukhasadbhāvāt sukhī syāt ; dvitīye ca pakṣe kāmadhvaṃsātmakamukhasadbhāvāt paratra sukhī syāt ; bhogāvasthāyāṃ tu kāmātmakaduḥkhasadbhāvāt duḥkhī syāt ; etaccānubhavaviruddham |
analyzed: atas pakṣa dvaya ukta doṣa aprasaṅgaḥ iti ucyate tat ayuktam evam hi ādye pakṣe bhoga avasthātaḥ pūrva aparayoḥ avasthayoḥ kāma abhāva mātra ātmaka mukha sadbhāvāt sukhī syāt dvitīye ca pakṣe kāma dhvaṃsa ātmaka mukha sadbhāvāt paratra sukhī syāt bhoga avasthāyām tu kāma ātmaka duḥkha sadbhāvāt duḥkhī syāt etat ca anubhava viruddham

original: tadetatsarvaṃ sāśaṅkramāha—bhogāvasthāyāmiti | prabuddhaḥ adhvastaḥ kāmo yasyasa tathā iti vigrahaḥ | pūrvāparayorityupalakṣaṇam, paratreti ca draṣṭavyam | akāmasyāpi viṣayopabhogāt kāmābhivyaktau tanniruttiḥ sukhamityuktam, taḥ yuktam ; yato'prāptaḥ sukhahetutvena smaryamāṇo viṣayaḥ kāmamuddhoṣayati, prāptaśca taṃ nivartayati ;
analyzed: tat etat sarvam sāśaṅkram āha bhoga avasthāyām iti prabuddhaḥ adhvastaḥ kāmaḥ yasya asa tathā iti vigrahaḥ pūrva aparayoḥ iti upalakṣaṇam paratra iti ca draṣṭavyam akāmasya api viṣaya upabhogāt kāma abhivyaktau tad niruttiḥ sukham iti uktam taḥ yuktam yatas uprāptaḥ sukha hetu tvena smaryamāṇaḥ viṣayaḥ kāmam uddhoṣayati prāptaḥ ca tam nivartayati

original: prāptasyāpi viṣayasya kāmoddhoṣakatve tasyānivartakatvāt tato viṣayāt kāmasya nivṛttirna syāt ! ataḥ saiva nāsti ; kāsukhaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha—aprāptaśceti | aprāpto'bhujyamānaḥ, prāpto bhujyamānaityarthaḥ | kiṃ ca yadi kāmanivṛttiḥ sukhaṃ tadā yatra kāmastatrāvaśyaṃ sukhena bhāvyam, utpattimattvena kāmanivṛtteravaśyaṃbhāvitvāt ;
analyzed: prāptasya api viṣayasya kāma uddhoṣaka tve tasya anivartaka tvāt tatas viṣayāt kāmasya nivṛttiḥ na syāt atas sā eva na asti kā sukham bhaviṣyati iti āha aprāptaḥ ca iti aprāptaḥ bhujyamānaḥ prāptaḥ bhujyamānaḥ iti arthaḥ kim ca yadi kāma nivṛttiḥ sukham tadā yatra kāmaḥ tatra avaśyam sukhena bhāvyam utpattimat tvena kāma nivṛtteḥ avaśyaṃbhāvi tvāt

original: na caitadastītyāha— na ceti | kuta ityāha—manoratheti | manorathaśataprārthitasyāpi kasyacidviṣayasya kukalatrāderupabhogadaśāyāṃ duḥkhadarśanādityarthaḥ | kiṃ ca yatra
analyzed: na ca etat asti iti āha na ca iti kutas ityāha manoratha iti manoratha śata prārthitasya api kasyacid viṣayasya ku kalatra ādeḥ upabhoga daśāyām duḥkha darśanāt iti arthaḥ kim ca yatra

original: gavādijātiviśeṣabhājāṃ vatsādīnāṃ kāmaḥ kāmādvā stanapānādau pravṛttirna 2. 3-5. syādityāśaṅkyāha—yā pīti | prāgbhavaḥ pūrvajanma, tatra bhavo'nubhavaḥ prāgbhavīyaḥ, tannivantyanetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: gavā ādi jāti viśeṣa bhājām vatsa ādīnām kāmaḥ kāmāt vā stana pāna ādau pravṛttiḥ na syāt iti āśaṅkya āhayā pi iti prāk bhavaḥ pūrva janma tatra bhavaḥ anubhavaḥ prāk bhavīyaḥ

original: idamuktaṃ bhavati—anādau saṃsāre śataśo gavādidehānugṛhītātmanāṃ stanapānādisukhānubhavodbhūtastataḥ saṃskāraḥ, saṃskārācca gavādidehahetvadṛṣṭodvodhitā sukhasmṛtiḥ, tataḥ kāmapravṛttiḥ; atastatrāpi sukhānubhavapūrvaka eva kāmaḥ, kāmācca pravṛttiriti | taduktam—“taṃ vidyākarmaṇī” iti |
analyzed: idam uktam bhavati anādau saṃsāre śataśas gavādi deha anugṛhīta ātmanām stana pāna ādi sukha anubhava udbhūtaḥ tatas saṃskāraḥ saṃskārāt ca gavādi deha hetu adṛṣṭa udvodhitā sukha smṛtiḥ tatas kāma pravṛttiḥ atas tatra api sukha anubhava pūrvakaḥ eva kāmaḥ kāmāt ca pravṛttiḥ iti tat uktam tam vidyā karmaṇī iti

original: yatra kāmastatra sukham, anyathā ya ekasya sukhaḥ sa sarvasya syāditi avyavasthoktā; tatrāha—yathā ceti | kāmo'pi na sarvasya sarvatra bhavati; kiṃ tarhi? kiñcijātīyasya kiñcidvayasaḥ kiñcidavasthasya kacidbhavati; yathā—gordhāsagrāse, yūnastraiṇe, rogiṇo'pathye; sukhamapi tathaiva jātyādibhedāt vyavasthāpyata iti nāvyavastheti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yatra kāmaḥ tatra sukham anyathā yaḥ ekasya sukhaḥ sa sarvasya syāt iti avyavasthā uktā tatra āha yathā ca iti kāmaḥ api na sarvasya sarvatra bhavati kim tarhi kiñcid jātīyasya kiñcid vayasaḥ kiñcid avasthasya kacid bhavati yathā goḥ dhāsa grāse yūnaḥ traiṇe rogiṇā upathye sukham api tathā eva jāti ādi bhedāt vyavasthāpyate iti na avyavasthā iti bhāvaḥ

original: itaśca na kāmanivṛttiḥ sukham | api tu duḥkhaṃ yāvadityāha—api ca kecit pittāyupahatendriyā dūyante duḥkhena tapyante; kāmanivṛttau sukhe te'pi sukhinaḥ syuḥ; na caivamasti; ato na sā sukhamiti bhāvaḥ | kimiti dūyanta ityāha—tadabhāva iti; tadabhāve kāmābhāva ityarthaḥ | apara āha—na tarhīti | yadi dūyante na tarhi nivṛttakāmāḥ;
analyzed: itas ca na kāma nivṛttiḥ sukham api tu duḥkham yāvat iti āha api ca kecid pittāt upahata indriyāḥ dūyante duḥkhena tapyante kāma nivṛttau sukhe te api sukhinaḥ syuḥ na ca evam asti atas na sā sukham iti bhāvaḥ kim iti dūyante iti āha tad abhāve iti tad abhāve kāma abhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ aparaḥ āha na tarhi iti yadi dūyante na tarhi nivṛtta kāmāḥ

original: na hyaniṣṭhe kāmanivṛttyā kecit dūyanta iti bhāvaḥ | siddhāntavādyāha—nivṛtteti | pittadoṣāt tiktatayāvabhāsamānaṃ khaṇḍādiviṣayaṃ prati nivṛttakāmā nivṛttarucayaḥ; rucitaṃ kāmayanta eva ‘kathamatra no ruciḥ syāt’ iti viṣayagrahaṇam | hetumāha—tasyeti | tasya viṣayasya, kutaścit pittādidoṣāt anupabhogyatvāt sukhahetutvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: na hi aniṣṭhe kāma nivṛttyā kecid dūyante iti bhāvaḥ siddhāntavādī āha nivṛtta iti pitta doṣāt tikta tayā avabhāsamānam khaṇḍa ādi viṣayam prati nivṛtta kāmāḥ nivṛtta rucayaḥ rucitam kāmayante eva katham atra no ruciḥ syāt iti viṣaya grahaṇam hetum āhatasya iti tasya viṣayasya kutaścid pitta ādi doṣāt anupabhogya tvāt sukha hetu tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: viṣayaṃ prati cenniṣkāmāḥ kutastarhi hetostadabhogyatvena dūyante? na hyaniṣṭhaviṣayānupabhoge duḥkhaṃ dṛṣṭamityabhiprāyeṇa hetuṃ paraḥ pṛcchati—kimiti | siddhāntī hetumāha—anubhūteti | pittādidoṣātpūrvamanubhūtasya khaṇḍādiviṣayājātasya sukhasya pittādiduṣṭendriyairidānīmaprāptestadanusmṛtyā te dūyanta ityarthaḥ | atrodāharaṇamāha—yatheti |
analyzed: viṣayam prati ced niṣkāmāḥ kutas tarhi hetoḥ tad abhogya tvena dūyante na hi aniṣṭha viṣaya anupabhoge duḥkham dṛṣṭam iti abhiprāyeṇa hetum paraḥ pṛcchati kim iti siddhāntī hetum āha anubhūta iti pitta ādi doṣāt pūrvam anubhūtasya khaṇḍa ādi viṣaya ajātasya sukhasya pitta ādi duṣṭa indriyaiḥ idānīm aprāpteḥ tad anusmṛtyā te dūyante iti arthaḥ atra udāharaṇam āha yathā iti

original: upasaṃharati—tasmāditi | pratipuruṣavedyatvenānubhavasiddhatvādapratyākhyeyatvameva draḍhayati | yadi sukhaṃ vastubhūtamasti kimarthaṃ tarhi “anityāśuciduḥkhānātmasu nityaśucisukhātmakhyātiravidyā”
analyzed: upasaṃharati tasmāt iti prati puruṣa vedya tvena anubhava siddha tvāt apratyākhyeya tvam eva draḍhayati yadi sukham vastu bhūtam asti kimartham tarhi anitya aśuci duḥkha anātmasu nitya śuci sukha ātma khyātiḥ avidyā

original: “ duḥkhaṃ janma tamaḥśvabhraṃ varṣabuddhudasaṃnnimam | nāśaprāyaṃ sukhādhīnaṃ nāśottaramabhāvagam | ” ityādivacobhiḥ vyāsapatañjaliprabhṛtibhirācāryaiḥ saṃsāre sukhābhāva uktaḥ ? kimiti vā kaiścitpaṇḍitairduḥkhanivṛttiḥ sukhamuktam ? ityāśaṅkyāha—P. 3-14. sukhasaṃgīti |
analyzed: duḥkham janma tamaḥ śvabhram nāśa prāyam sukha adhīnam nāśa uttaram abhāva gam ityādi vacobhiḥ vyāsa patañjali prabhṛtibhiḥ ācāryaiḥ saṃsāre sukha abhāvaḥ uktaḥ kim iti vā kaiścid paṇḍitaiḥ duḥkha nivṛttiḥ sukham uktam iti āśaṅkya āha

original: viṣayasukhe'tyantamāsaktaṃ paramaśreyovimukhaṃ janamanukūlayituṃ tattvabhavadbhiḥ pūjyairācāryaiḥ sasvaṃ nāma vastu nāstīti varṇitamiti kalpayāma ityarthaḥ | prakṛtavicāraphalaṃ saṃkalpya kathayati—tadevamiti | siddhamityadhyāhāryam | idānīṃ yaduktamānandaśrutayo duḥkhābhāvaṃ lakṣaṇayāhuriti, taddūṣayati—sa ceti |
analyzed: viṣaya sukha ityantam āsaktam parama śreyaḥ vimukham janam anukūlayitum tattva bhavadbhiḥ pūjyaiḥ ācāryaiḥ sa svam nāma vastu na asti iti varṇitam iti kalpayāmaḥ iti arthaḥ prakṛta vicāra phalam saṃkalpya kathayati tat evam iti siddham iti adhyāhāryam idānīm yat uktam ānanda śrutayaḥ duḥkha abhāvam lakṣaṇayā āhuḥ iti tat dūṣayati sa ca iti

original: ataḥ sa eva grāhya iti vākyaśeṣaḥ | nanu gaṅgāghoṣādivākyavadamukhyo'rthaḥ kiṃ na gṛhyata ityāśaṅkya viśeṣamāha—śabdeti | tatra pramāṇāntaragocaratvāt tathāpi syāt; iha tu tannāsti, śabdaikagocaratvādātmasvarūpasya; ato'tra śabdaśaktyanusāreṇaivārthe pratītiryuktā, na mānāntarānusāreṇa yathā gaṅgāśabdāt tīra ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: atas saḥ eva grāhyaḥ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ nanu gaṅgā ghoṣa ādi vākya vat amukhyaḥ ṛthaḥ kim na gṛhyate iti āśaṅkya viśeṣam āha śabda iti tatra pramāṇa antara gocara tvāt tathā api syāt iha tu tat na asti śabda eka gocara tvāt ātma svarūpasya atas utra śabda śakti anusāreṇa eva arthe pratītiḥ yuktā na māna antara anusāreṇa yathā gaṅgā śabdāt tīre iti arthaḥ

original: nanvanupapattyā lakṣaṇā bhavati; sā cātrāpyastītyuktam ‘ānandarāgāt’ ityādinetyāśaṅkyāha—na ceti | kuta ityata āha—na hīti | na hi tapasvī tapāṃtīcchan rāgītyucyate loka iti bhāvaḥ | ko nāma sa ityāha—avidyeti | asatye satyamityanātmanyātmeti jñānamavidyā, tayākṣiptaṃ kṛtamaśānteṣu rūparasādiguṇeṣvabhiniveśaṃ rāgamācakṣate dhīrā ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu anupapattyā lakṣaṇā bhavati sā ca atra api asti iti uktam ānanda rāgāt ityādinā iti āśaṅkya āha na ca iti kutas iti atas āha na hi iti na hi tapasvī rāgī iti ucyate lokaḥ iti bhāvaḥ kaḥ nāma saḥ ityāha avidyā iti asatye satyam iti anātmani ātmā iti jñānam avidyā tayā ākṣiptam kṛtam aśānteṣu rūpa rasa ādi guṇeṣu abhiniveśam rāgam ācakṣate dhīrāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: avidyayā kṣetradharmādisukhādīnātmani manyamānasya taddhetuṣu rūparasādiṣvasatyeṣvavidyayā satyatayābhimateṣu yo'bhiniveśaḥ so'vidyākṣiptaḥ | vyatirekamāha—tacceti | tacce tu sacce tvānandātmakabrahmaṇi taddarśanasya vaimakhyāt saṃśayaviparyayamalavirahāt yā cittasya praśāntirabhīcchā sā na rāgapakṣe vyavasthāpyate dhīraiḥ |
analyzed: avidyayā kṣetra dharma ādi sukha ādīn ātmani manyamānasya tad hetuṣu rūpa rasa ādiṣu asatyeṣu avidyayā satyatayā abhimateṣu yaḥ abhiniveśaḥ saḥ vidyā ākṣiptaḥ vyatirekam āha tat ca iti tacce tu sacce tu ānanda ātmaka brahmaṇi tad darśanasya vaimakhyāt saṃśaya viparyaya mala virahāt yā cittasya praśāntiḥ abhīcchā sā na rāga pakṣe vyavasthāpyate dhīraiḥ

original: idamuktaṃ bhavati—na sarvavecchā rāgaḥ, kiṃ tvabhūtaviṣayeti | prasādo'bhirucirabhīccheti paryāyanirdeśaḥ, evaṃvidhaiḥ śabdailoke sā prasiddhā na rāgaśabdeneti dyotanārthaḥ | yathā tava noddegamātraṃ dveṣa ityāha—yatheti | tata iti, saṃsārādityarthaḥ | yoda punaruddhegamātraṃ dveṣaḥ syāt tatastavāpi muktirna syādityāha—anyatheti |
analyzed: idam uktam bhavati na rāgaḥ kim tu abhūta viṣayā iti prasādaḥ ubhiruciḥ abhīcchā iti paryāya nirdeśaḥ evaṃvidhaiḥ śabdaiḥ loke sā prasiddhā na rāga śabdena iti dyotana arthaḥ yathā tava na uddega mātram dveṣaḥ iti āha yathā iti tatas iti saṃsārāt iti arthaḥ punar uddhega mātram dveṣaḥ syāt tatas tava api muktiḥ na syāt iti āha anyathā iti

original: tato duḥkhāddūṣaḥ, tannivṛttiḥ, dhanetyarthaḥ | evaṃ tāva-
analyzed: tatas duḥkhāt dūṣaḥ tad nivṛttiḥ dhana ityarthaḥ evam tāvat

original: tattvabhūtanityaniratiśayānandecchā na rāgo bhavatītyuktam | adhunā bhavatu sā rāgaḥ, tathāpi na sā śāntatādiśrutyā niṣidhyate ; kiṃ tu tatparipanthitadarupakṣaviviṣayamutpannecchā ; yathā pramāṇāntaradṛṣṭe parame sārvabhaume rājyādyutkarṣe ye rāgiṇaḥ ; dṛṣṭaḥ parama utkarṣaḥ prakarṣo rāgitvena vā yeṣāṃ rāgiṇām ;
analyzed: tattva bhūta nitya niratiśaya ānanda icchā na rāgaḥ bhavati iti uktam adhunā bhavatu sā rāgaḥ tathā api na sā śānta tā ādi śrutyā niṣidhyate kim tu tad paripanthita daru pakṣa vi viṣayam utpanna icchā yathā pramāṇa antara dṛṣṭe parame sārvabhaume rājya ādi utkarṣe ye rāgiṇaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ paramaḥ utkarṣaḥ prakarṣaḥ rāgi tvena vā yeṣām rāgiṇām

original: yadvā parebhya utkarṣaḥ parotkarṣaḥ, dṛṣṭaśrāptau parotkarṣaśra, tatra ye rāgiṇaḥ ; teṣāmarthe kāmalobhādityāgātmaka indriyajayastatprāptyupāyatvenopadiśyate tathehāpi bhaviṣyatītyāha—api ceti |
analyzed: yat vā parebhyaḥ utkarṣaḥ para utkarṣaḥ dṛṣṭa śrāptau para utkarṣaḥ śra tatra ye rāgiṇaḥ teṣām arthe kāma lobha ādi tyāga ātmakaḥ indriya jayaḥ tad prāpti upāya tvena upadiśyate tathā iha api bhaviṣyati iti āha api ca iti

original: sarvarāgādiniṣedhe sārvabhaumarājyarāgasyāpi niṣedhāt tatrāpyapravṛtterupadeśvaryaiyarthyaṃ syāditi doṣāt yathā tatra samīhitāt sārvabhaumarājyāditarasmin tatparipanthini viṣaye abhiṣaṅga āsaktī rāgātiśayo niṣidhyate, tathehāpyuttamabrahmānandarāgāditarasmādanuttamaviṣayasukhāsaṅgādupanatādupasthitādapi śamavidhinā mumukṣornivṛttirupadiśyata
analyzed: sarva rāga ādi niṣedhe sārvabhauma rājya rāgasya api niṣedhāt tatra api apravṛtteḥ upadeśa varyaiyarthyam syāt iti doṣāt yathā tatra samīhitāt sārvabhauma rājyāt itarasmin tad paripanthini viṣaye abhiṣaṅgaḥ āsaktī rāga atiśayaḥ niṣidhyate tathā iha api uttama brahma ānanda rāgāt itarasmāt anuttama viṣaya sukha āsaṅgāt upanatāt upasthitāt api śama vidhinā mumukṣoḥ nivṛttiḥ upadiśyata

original: ityāha—tatheti | etaduktaṃ bhavati—brahmānandavarjamitaratra rāgaḥ śamavidhinā niṣidhyate ; tena brahmānandarāgādāpa mumukṣupravṛttau na śamavidhivirodha iti | tathā cānyairapi sūribhiridamuktamityāha—tathā coktamiti | atyantakāmātmatā na praśastā ; na ca mumukṣorapyatyantamakāmitāsti ; tasyāpi hi muktau kāmo'stītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: iti āha tathā iti etat uktam bhavati brahmānanda varjam itaratra rāgaḥ śama vidhinā niṣidhyate tena brahmānanda rāgāt āpa mumukṣu pravṛttau na śama vidhi virodhaḥ iti tathā ca anyaiḥ api sūribhiḥ idam uktam iti āha tathā ca uktam iti atyanta kāma ātmatā na praśastā na ca mumukṣoḥ api atyantam akāmi tā asti tasya api hi muktau kāmaḥ usti iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ śamavidhivirodhe parihṛte paraḥ punarapi brahmaṇyānandamākṣipati—syādetaditi | yadyānandaḥ saṃvedyaḥ tataḥ kartuḥ saṃvedituranyat karma saṃvedyamiti hetoḥ dvaitaprasaṅgaḥ ; ātmani kriyāvirodhāditi bhāvaḥ | itaśca dvaitaprasaṅga ityāha—kartriti | kriyāgarbhatvāt karmakartṛsaṃbandhasya kriyāyāśca karaṇamantareṇābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: evam śama vidhi virodhe parihṛte paraḥ punar api brahmaṇi ānandam ākṣipati syāt etat iti yadi ānandaḥ saṃvedyaḥ tatas kartuḥ saṃvedituḥ anyat karma saṃvedyam iti hetoḥ dvaita prasaṅgaḥ ātmani kriyā virodhāt iti bhāvaḥ itas ca dvaita prasaṅgaḥ iti āha kartṛ iti kriyā garbha tvāt karma kartṛ saṃbandhasya kriyāyāḥ ca karaṇam antareṇa abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: kartṛkarmabhāvena cānandabrahmaṇorbhede ghaṭapaṭhayoriva sāmānādhikaraṇyamapi na syādityāha—ānandamiti | atha ‘śuklaḥ paṭhaḥ’ itivadānandavadbrahmānandamityucyate, tato dvitīyena tadbrahmāvādadvitīyaṃ brahmeti na yujyate ; tataścādvaitaśrutivirodha ityabhiprāyeṇāha—tadvattayeti | athānando'saṃvedya ityucyate tatrāha—asaṃvedana iti |
analyzed: kartṛ karma bhāvena ca ānanda brahmaṇoḥ bhede ghaṭa paṭhayoḥ iva sāmānādhikaraṇyam api na syāt iti āha ānandam iti atha śuklaḥ paṭhaḥ iti vat ānanda vat brahma ānandam iti ucyate tatas dvitīyena tad brahma āvāt advitīyam brahma iti na yujyate tatas ca advaita śruti virodhaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha tadvat tayā iti atha ānandaḥ usaṃvedyaḥ iti ucyate tatra āha asaṃvedanaḥ iti

original: “vijñānamānandam” iti śrutāvityarthaḥ | kathaṃ vyarthamityāśaṅkyāha—puruṣārtheti | atra samādhānamāha—ucyata iti | phalaṃ pramāṇaphalamanubhavaḥ, kartā ca sannidhestasyaivānubhavinā ātmā, tadvadityarthaḥ |
analyzed: vijñānam ānandam iti śrutau iti arthaḥ katham vyartham iti āśaṅkya āha puruṣa artha iti atra samādhānam āha ucyate iti phalam pramāṇa phalam anubhavaḥ kartā ca sannidheḥ tasya eva anubhavinā ātmā tadvat iti arthaḥ

original: imamevārthaṃ phalasadbhāvapradarśanapuraḥsaraṃ prapañcayati—tathā hīti | paraśośchidivat P. 4-3. pramāṇādarthāntaraṃ vā phalamastu | “yadābhāsaṃ prameyaṃ tat pramāṇaṃ phalate punaḥ | bhāhakākārasaṃvittyotprayaṃ nātaḥ pṛthak kṛtam |” iti bauddhamatenānarthāntaraṃ vāstu, sarvaśca sarvaparīkṣakairamyupagamyate ; na tu tadviśeṣacintopayujyate ;
analyzed: imam eva artham phala sadbhāva pradarśana puraḥsaram prapañcayati tathā hi iti paraśoḥ chidi vat pramāṇāt artha antaram vā phalam astu yat ābhāsam prameyam tat pramāṇam phalate punar na atas pṛthak kṛtam iti bauddha matena anarthāntaram vā astu sarvaḥ ca sarva parīkṣakaiḥ amyupagamyate na tu tad viśeṣa cintā upayujyate

original: ato na dṛṣṭāntāsiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | pramāṇaśabdasya bhāvakaraṇavyutpattibhedābhiprāyeṇānarthāntaramityuktamityanye | tasyānavabhāsaṃ tāvanniṣedhati—na ceti | kuta ityāha—taditi | taccennāvabhāti, tataḥ śaśaśṛṅgavannāstyeva ; ato na tatkṛtaṃ saṃvedyatvaṃ bhāvānāṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ ; yadā pradīpakarapaṃ nendriyakarapam |
analyzed: atas na dṛṣṭānta asiddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ pramāṇa śabdasya bhāva karaṇa vyutpatti bheda abhiprāyeṇa anarthāntaram iti uktam iti anye tasya anavabhāsam tāvat niṣedhati na ca iti kutas ityāha tat iti tat ced na avabhāti tatas śaśa śṛṅga vat na asti eva atas na tat kṛtam saṃvedya tvam bhāvānām syāt iti bhāvaḥ yadā pradīpa karapam na indriya karapam

original: ataḥ satyapi tasminnanavabhāsamāne tatkṛtaṃ saṃvedyatvaṃ bhāvānāṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ | kasmāt punarajñātameva phalamindriyavadarthaṃ na saṃvedayati ? vaiṣamyāt ; indriyaṃ hi phalaṃ janayati ; janakaṃ cājñātamapi bhavati yathā bījamaṅkurasya ; phalaṃ tu phalāntaraṃ na janayati, anavasthānāt ; atastadeva ghaṭasyānubhavaḥ |
analyzed: atas sati api tasmin anavabhāsamāne tat kṛtam saṃvedya tvam bhāvānām na syāt iti bhāvaḥ kasmāt punar ajñātam eva phalam indriya vat artham na saṃvedayati vaiṣamyāt indriyam hi phalam janayati janakam ca ajñātam api bhavati yathā bījam aṅkurasya phalam tu phala antaram na janayati anavasthānāt atas tat eva ghaṭasya anubhavaḥ

original: sa cet tadanuviddhaghaṭapratibhāse bhātyeva | anyadeva ‘ghaṭo'yam’ iti jñānam, anyacca ‘ghaṭo'nubhūyate’ iti ; ato ‘ghaṭo'yam’ iti ghaṭa evāvabhāti, na ghaṭānubhava iti cet ; naivam ; evaṃ hi ghaṭe bhāti ‘ghaṭānubhavo mamāsti, na vā’ iti pṛthak jijñāsā syāt ; na ca tathāsti ; tasmādanubhavo ghaṭa evāvabhātīti |
analyzed: sa ced tad anuviddha ghaṭa pratibhāse bhāti eva anyat eva ghaṭaḥ yam iti jñānam anyat ca ghaṭaḥ anubhūyate iti atas ghaṭaḥ yam iti ghaṭaḥ eva avabhāti na ghaṭa anubhavaḥ iti ced na evam evam hi ghaṭe bhāti ghaṭa anubhavaḥ mama asti na vā iti pṛthak jijñāsā syāt na ca tathā asti tasmāt anubhavaḥ ghaṭaḥ eva avabhāti iti

original: kiṃ caivaṃ satyanubhavo'nubhavāntareṇa bhāvāt ; tathā sati cānavasthā syāt | kiṃ ca tadanubhavāntaram, yato'nubhavo bhāti ? ātmamanaḥsaṃyogajaṃ pratyakṣamiti cet ; na tāvadyugapatkālam, jñānānāmayaugapadyeṣṭeḥ ; nāpyanubhavāt pūrvottarakālam, pratyakṣasyātītānāgatānubhavaviṣayatvāyogāt ; anumeyatvamapi liṅgābhāvāt pratyākhyeyam ;
analyzed: kim ca evam sati anubhavaḥ anubhava antareṇa bhāvāt tathā sati ca anavasthā syāt kim ca tad anubhava antaram yatas anubhavaḥ bhāti ātma manaḥ saṃyoga jam pratyakṣam iti ced na tāvat yugapad kālam jñānānām ayaugapadya iṣṭeḥ na api anubhavāt pūrva uttara kālam pratyakṣasya atīta anāgata anubhava viṣaya tva ayogāt anumeya tvam api liṅga abhāvāt pratyākhyeyam

original: na tāvadarthaḥ sattāmātreṇa liṅgam, ajñātasyāliṅgatvāt ; jñātaśret, na ; saṃbandhānavasāyāt ; na hyajñāte'nubhave sambandhini tasya liṅgena saha saṃbandho jñātuṃ śakyaḥ | jñāte cet jñāyate, kena jñāte ? na tāvadanenaiva liṅgena, itaretarāśrayāt ; na liṅgāntareṇa, turudoṣatvāt liṅgāntaravaiyarthyācca |
analyzed: na tāvat arthaḥ sattā mātreṇa liṅgam ajñātasya aliṅga tvāt na saṃbandha anavasāyāt na hi ajñāta anubhave sambandhini tasya liṅgena saha saṃbandhaḥ jñātum śakyaḥ jñāte ced jñāyate kena jñāte na tāvat anena eva liṅgena itaretara āśrayāt na liṅga antareṇa turu doṣa tvāt liṅga antara vaiyarthyāt ca

original: tasmāt jñātena cedanubhavena saha liṅgasya saṃbandhajñānamiṣyate,
analyzed: tasmāt jñātena ced anubhavena saha liṅgasya saṃbandha jñānam iṣyate

original: tataḥ svataḥ saṃvediteneti balādāpatitam; ataḥ siddho naḥ pakṣaḥ; tadā cānumānamapyaphalam | yadapyuktaṃ—“jñānaṃ tajjñātatāvaśāt” iti, tadapyayuktam; jñātatā hi jñānasya jñeyena saṃbandhaḥ; taduktam—“kuttaddhitasamāsebhyaḥ saṃbandhābhidhānaṃ tvataśbhyām” iti | na ca jñāne saṃbandhinyajñāte jñātatā jñātuṃ śakyata ityaliṅgam |
analyzed: tatas svatas saṃveditena iti balāt āpatitam atas siddhaḥ naḥ pakṣaḥ tadā ca anumānam api aphalam yat api uktam jñānam tad jñāta tā vaśāt iti tat api ayuktam jñāta tā hi jñānasya jñeyena saṃbandhaḥ tat uktam kut taddhita samāsebhyaḥ saṃbandha abhidhānam tu a taśbhyām iti na ca jñāne saṃbandhini ajñāte jñāta tā jñātum śakyate iti aliṅgam

original: athārthasthaṃ prākaṭyaṃ jñātatā, tadapyajñātamaliṅgam; jñātaṃ cet, travāpyarthavat prākaṭyantarāpattāvanavasthā | svataḥ siddhaṃ cet, anubhava eva tathāstu, kiṃ tena? arthasthaṃ ca prākaṭyaṃ jñāne'tīte'pyanuvartata pāke'tīta iva pākajarūpādi; tadvadeva ca sarvapuruṣān pratyaviśiṣṭaṃ ca syāt, arthasthatvāt tasya |
analyzed: atha artha stham prākaṭyam jñātatā tat api ajñātam aliṅgam jñātam ced arthavat prākaṭī antara āpattau anavasthā svatas siddham ced anubhavaḥ eva tathā astu kim tena artha stham ca prākaṭyam jñāna itīte pi anuvartata pāka itīte iva pāka ja rūpa ādi tadvat eva ca sarva puruṣān prati aviśiṣṭam ca syāt artha stha tvāt tasya

original: etena jñātatānyathānupapattyāpi nānubhavo'nubhūyata iti siddham | kiṃ ca jñāna evārthānubaddhe prakāśamāne'rthaḥ prakāśata ityucyate; na tvarthasya pṛthak prakāśo'sti, jaḍaprakāśāyogāditi vakṣyāmaḥ | kiṃ ca jñānaṃ jñānāntarāprakāśyam, tatsajātitvāt; yat yatsajāti tat tasyāprakāśyam |
analyzed: etena jñātatā anyathā anupapattyā api na anubhavaḥ nubhūyate iti siddham kim ca jñāne eva artha anubaddhe prakāśamānā irthaḥ prakāśate iti ucyate na tu arthasya pṛthak prakāśaḥ usti jaḍa prakāśa ayogāt iti vakṣyāmaḥ kim ca jñānam jñāna antara aprakāśyam tad sajāti tvāt yat yat sajāti tat tasya aprakāśyam

original: tasmādanubhavaḥ svato bhāsamāna evārthaṃ bhāsayati, nendriyavadabhāsamāno'pi; dīpavat jñātaḥ svataśca | tadabhāne'rthasyābhānamiti sūktam—tadasaṃvedyatva iti | atha saṃvedyaṃ phalamiṣyate tatrāha—na ceti | na ca phalaṃ saṃvedyaṃ saṃvittikarma; tadā hi tatra saṃvittyantaropalabdhiḥ syāt, na ca sāstītyuktam |
analyzed: tasmāt anubhavaḥ svatas bhāsamānaḥ eva artham bhāsayati na indriya vat abhāsamānaḥ api dīpa vat jñātaḥ svatas ca tad abhānā ṛthasya abhānam iti su uktam tad asaṃvedya tve iti atha saṃvedyam phalam iṣyate tatra āha na ca iti na ca phalam saṃvedyam saṃvitti karma tadā hi tatra saṃvitti antara upalabdhiḥ syāt na ca sā asti iti uktam

original: tathā phale phalāntare tatrāpyevamityanavasthā ca syādityarthaḥ | upasaṃharati—tasmāditi | evaṃ phalavaditi yaduktaṃ tat prapañcaca idānīṃ kartṛvaditi yaduktaṃ tat prapañcayati—yathā ceti | kuto na syādityāha— na hati | na tadātmasaṃbandhitvenārtho bhāyādityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha— na hati |
analyzed: tathā phale phala antare tatra api evam iti anavasthā ca syāt iti arthaḥ upasaṃharati tasmāt iti evam phalavat iti yat uktam tat prapañca ca idānīm kartṛ vat iti yat uktam tat prapañcayati yathā ca iti kutas na syāt iti āha na ha iti na tad ātma saṃbandhi tvena arthaḥ bhāyāt iti arthaḥ kutas iti āha na ha iti

original: ‘idam’ iti viṣaye ‘viditam’ iti phale ca nātmānavabhāsamāno ‘mayā’ iti vettṛtvenānusaṃdhātuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ | tatra ca ko doṣaḥ syādityāha—ananusaṃdhāna iti | svaparavedyayoḥ ko'tiśayaḥ? na ko'pītyarthaḥ | astu tarhi saṃvedyaḥ; tadapi netyāha—na ceti | kuta ityāha— karmatva iti |
analyzed: idam iti viṣaye viditam iti phale ca na ātmā anavabhāsamānaḥ mayā iti vettṛ tvena anusaṃdhātum śakyate iti arthaḥ tatra ca kaḥ doṣaḥ syāt iti āha ananusaṃdhāne iti sva para vedyayoḥ na kaḥ api iti arthaḥ astu tarhi saṃvedyaḥ tat api na iti āha na ca iti kutas ityāha karma tve iti

original: ātmanaḥ saṃvittikarmatve svātmani kriyāvirodhāt saṃvettā tato vyātiriktaḥ syāt; ata ātmā tvanātmā syāt, saṃvedyatvāt, ghaṭavat; anavasthā ca syāditi bhāvaḥ | nanvātmā nedaṃtayārthavadavabhāti, kiṃ tu ‘aham’ ityātmānameva vettṛtayā vetti; ataḥ kuto vettṛvedyayorvyatireka- P. 4-6.
analyzed: ātmanaḥ saṃvitti karma tve sva ātmani kriyā virodhāt saṃvettā tatas syāt atas ātmā tu anātmā syāt saṃvedya tvāt ghaṭa vat anavasthā ca syāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu ātmā na idaṃtayā artha vat avabhāti kim tu aham iti ātmānam eva vettṛ tayā vetti atas kutas vettṛ vedyayoḥ vyatirekaḥ

original: prasaṅgaḥ ? pratītisiddhāttvaikasya viruddho'pi karmakartṛbhāvo bhāvapyati | syādevaṃ yadyahaṃ pratyaya evaṃ tadā syāt; sa eva tvātmani saṃvedye durlabhaḥ; tathā hi—ghaṭādivat ‘ayam’ iti pratyayaḥ syāt, na ‘aham’ iti; ato'haṃ pratyayaparyantaṃ evāyamākṣepaḥ; tataśca na tadbalāt vettavedyayoravyatirekaḥ, nāpyavirodhaḥ |
analyzed: prasaṅgaḥ pratīti siddhāt tvā ekasya viruddhaḥ api karma kartṛ bhāvaḥ syāt evam yadi aham pratyayaḥ evam tadā syāt saḥ eva tu ātmani saṃvedye durlabhaḥ tathā hi ghaṭa ādi vat ayam iti pratyayaḥ syāt na aham iti atas ham pratyaya paryantam eva ayam ākṣepaḥ tatas ca na tad balāt vetta vedyayoḥ avyatirekaḥ na api avirodhaḥ

original: nanvasti tāvat ‘aham’ ityucchekhaḥ; nāsāvanyathā karṣu śakyaḥ | yadi na śakyaḥ, śṛṇu tarhi tasya gatim—na khalu ‘aham’ iti pratyayaḥ, kiṃ tu ahaṃkāra eva svataḥ siddhānityacaitanyenāvadyotitastadupahite cātmani svato'vabhātyapi; tenaiva ‘ātmā pratīyate’ iti bālānāṃ tatra pratyayabhramaḥ | tataśca na svātmani kriyāvirodhaḥ;
analyzed: nanu asti tāvat aham iti ucchekhaḥ na asau anyathā karṣu śakyaḥ yadi na śakyaḥ śṛṇu tarhi tasya gatim na khalu aham iti pratyayaḥ kim tu ahaṃkāraḥ eva svatas siddha anitya caitanyena avadyotitaḥ tad upahite ca ātmani svatas vabhāti api tena eva ātmā pratīyate iti bālānām tatra pratyaya bhramaḥ tatas ca na svātmani kriyā virodhaḥ

original: na cāvirodhenopapattau virodhakalpanocitā | ahaṃkāraśca kevalakartṛśaktiḥ, na karma mātrayāpi sphurati | ataḥ kutastadavacchinnasya svasaṃvedyatā? ataḥ svasaṃvedyatvaṃ ghaṭavadātmano na syāt, api tu tato'nyasya tatsaṃvedyurghaṭeta | evamātmanaḥ saṃvedyatve'haṃ pratyayavedyatvaṃ balādāpatitam;
analyzed: na ca avirodhena upapattau virodha kalpanā ucitā ahaṃkāraḥ ca kevala kartṛ śaktiḥ na karma mātrayā api sphurati atas kutas tad avacchinnasya sva saṃvedya tā atas sva saṃvedya tvam ghaṭa vat ātmanaḥ na syāt api tu tatonyasya tat saṃvedyuḥ ghaṭeta evam ātmanaḥ saṃvedya tva iham pratyaya vedya tvam balāt āpatitam

original: tatra ca vedyurvedyayovyatireka iti sūktam—vyatirekaprasaṅgāditi | evaṃ saṃvittikarmatvāsaṃbhavamupajīvyātmanaḥ svābhimataṃ svaprakāśatvamāha—tasmāditi | svaprakāśatvaiva P. 4-11. tasyātmanaḥ saṃvedyatā, na saṃvittikarmatetyevakārārthaḥ | saṃvedyatetyavivakṣitakarmatvanirdeśaḥ | na cārthasaṃvittāvātmā bhāsate, atatkarmatvāt |
analyzed: tatra ca vedyuḥ vedyayoḥ vyatirekaḥ iti su uktam vyatireka prasaṅgāt iti evam saṃvitti karmatva asaṃbhavam upajīvya ātmanaḥ sva abhimatam sva prakāśa tvam āha tasmāt iti sva prakāśa tvā eva tasya ātmanaḥ saṃvedya tā na saṃvitti karma tā iti evakāra arthaḥ saṃvedya tā iti avivakṣita karmatva nirdeśaḥ na ca artha saṃvittau ātmā bhāsate atatkarmatvāt

original: yat yatra saṃvittāvakarma, tat tatra na bhāsate nīlamiva pītasaṃvidi | evaṃ phalavat kartṛvacceti dṛṣṭāntadvaye svaprakāśatvamupaprādya dārṣṭāntike yojayati— tatheti | na tāvadānando na pratibhāti; pratibhāne'pi na saṃvittikarmatayā pratibhāti, phalavat kartṛvat svaprakāśatvenopapatteḥ | ato nāpuruṣārthatvam;
analyzed: yat yatra saṃvittau akarma tat tatra na bhāsate nīlam iva pīta saṃvidi evam phalavat kartṛ vat ca iti dṛṣṭānta dvaye sva prakāśa tvam upaprādya dārṣṭāntike yojayati tathā iti na tāvat ānandaḥ na pratibhāti pratibhāne api na saṃvitti karmatayā pratibhāti phalavat kartṛ vat sva prakāśa tvena upapatteḥ atas na apuruṣa artha tvam

original: nāpi karturanyat karmeti dvaitaprasaṅgaḥ; na ca kriyākaraṇādyapekṣetibhāvaḥ | brahmaṇaśca svaprakāśatvam “ātmajyotiḥ samrāṭ” “na hi draṣṭṛṣṭerviparilopo vidyate” ityādiśrutisiddham | ‘svabhāvaḥ’ ityānandasya svaprakāśatve hetuḥ; svaprakāśabrahmasvabhāvatve tadavyatirekādānando'pi svaprakāśa eva yukta iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nā api kartuḥ anyat karma iti dvaita prasaṅgaḥ na ca kriyā karaṇa ādi apekṣā iti bhāvaḥ brahmaṇaḥ ca sva prakāśa tvam ātma jyotiḥ samrāj na hi draṣṭṛ ṣṭeḥ viparilopaḥ vidyate ityādi śruti siddham svabhāvaḥ iti ānandasya sva prakāśa tve hetuḥ sva prakāśa brahma svabhāva tve tad avyatirekāt ānandaḥ api sva prakāśaḥ eva yuktaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvānando brahmaṇo guṇaḥ, na svabhāvaḥ | naitat, “ānandaṃ brahma” iti sāmānādhikaraṇyāt | nanu guṇaguṇinorapi śuklapaṭādiṣu taddṛṣṭam; na, vaiṣamyāt; śuklādayo hi guṇavacanāḥ; te guṇamuktvā
analyzed: nanu ānandaḥ brahmaṇaḥ guṇaḥ na svabhāvaḥ na etat ānandam brahma iti sāmānādhikaraṇyāt nanu guṇa guṇinoḥ api śukla paṭa ādiṣu tat dṛṣṭam na vaiṣamyāt śukla ādayaḥ hi guṇa vacanāḥ te guṇam uktvā

original: guṇini vartantām; ānandādayastu niṣkṛṣṭaguṇasthāḥ, te na guṇini vṛttimarhanti; na hi bhavati 'candanaṃ gandhaḥ' iti; taduktam—“na kadācitrayogo'sti candanaṃ gandha ityayam” iti | na ca guṇinyavṛttasya guṇaśabdasya guṇisāmānādhikaraṇyamavakalpate | yathā cāsmatpakṣe tadbhavati tathā vakṣyām ityuparamyate |
analyzed: guṇini vartantām ānanda ādayaḥ tu niṣkṛṣṭa guṇa sthāḥ te na guṇini vṛttim arhanti na hi bhavati candanam gandhaḥ iti tat uktam na candanam gandhaḥ iti ayam iti na ca guṇini avṛttasya guṇa śabdasya guṇi sāmānādhikaraṇyam avakalpate yathā ca asmad pakṣe tat bhavati tathā vakṣyām iti uparamyate

original: nanu svaprakāśaśredātmā, suṣuptaḥ kiṃ na prakāśate ! kasya prakāśatām ? yadi svasya, tadiṣṭameva naḥ; svasya svayamātmā nityaṃ prakāśata eva; “na hi draṣṭurdṛṣṭirviparilopo vidyate” iti śrutiḥ | atha jīvānām, na;
analyzed: nanu sva prakāśaḥ średa ātmā suṣuptaḥ kim na prakāśate kasya prakāśatām yadi svasya tat iṣṭam eva naḥ svasya svayam ātmā nityam prakāśate eva na hi draṣṭuḥ dṛṣṭiḥ viparilopaḥ vidyate iti śrutiḥ atha jīvānām na kim na kaścitaḥ asti

original: te hyavidyākāryabuddhyādyapādhikalpitabhedāḥ svāpe saṃhatākhilakāryāyāṃ tattvamācchādya bījamātratayā sthitāyāmavidyāyāṃ saṃskāramātraśeṣāḥ kathamupalabhantām ! ato'yamadoṣaḥ | nanu svaprakāśatve nityapa. 4-18. dṛṣṭerbrahmaṇo darśanapratiṣedho nāvakalpa ityāśaṅkyāha—keneti | ‘kam’ iti dvāśikarmaṇo dṛśyajātasyāyamākṣepaḥ, na dṛśerevetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: te hi avidyā kārya buddhi ādi apādhi kalpita bhedāḥ svāpe saṃhata akhila kāryāyām tattvam ācchādya bīja mātra tayā sthitāyām avidyāyām saṃskāra mātra śeṣāḥ katham upalabhantām atas yam adoṣaḥ nanu sva prakāśa tve dṛṣṭeḥ brahmaṇaḥ darśana pratiṣedhaḥ na avakalpaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha kena iti kam iti dvāśi karmaṇaḥ dṛśya jātasya ayam ākṣepaḥ na dṛśeḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: etadeva śrutipaurvāparyeṇa draḍhayati—tathā hati | dṛśikarmaṇo dṛśyajātasya vilayanimittaka eva pratiṣedha ucyata ityarthaḥ | yadā asya viduṣaḥ sarvaṃ dṛśyajātamātmaivābhūta nātmavyatiriktamasti tadā kaṃ paśyet ? na kamapīti vākyārthaḥ; ‘nanu paśyet’ iti tena dṛśyadṛṣṭiratra niṣidhyate, nātmadṛṣṭirityarthaḥ |
analyzed: etat eva śruti paurvāparyeṇa draḍhayati tathā ha iti dṛśi karmaṇaḥ dṛśya jātasya vilaya nimittakaḥ eva pratiṣedhaḥ ucyate iti arthaḥ yadā asya viduṣaḥ sarvam dṛśya jātam ātmā eva abhūta na ātma vyatiriktam asti tadā kam paśyet na kam api iti vākya arthaḥ nanu paśyet iti tena dṛśya dṛṣṭiḥ atra niṣidhyate na ātma dṛṣṭiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tatra kecit ānandaśabdasya brahmaṇi duḥkhābhāvaparatvapratipādanāya sukhavācitvaṃ niṣektuṃ punaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhante—anya iti | dharmān vibhajati— bhāveti | tatrābhāvarūpāṇāmaduṣṭatvamāha—tatreti | tānudāharati—yatheti | hetumāha—na hati | nivṛttiravastutvāt na dvaitamāpādayati, ato nādvaitaṃ hantītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatra kecid ānanda śabdasya brahmaṇi duḥkha abhāva paratva pratipādanāya sukha vācitvam niṣektum punar pratyavatiṣṭhante anye iti dharmān vibhajati bhāva iti tatra abhāva rūpāṇām aduṣṭa tvam āha tatra iti tān udāharati yathā iti hetum āha na hati nivṛttiḥ avastu tvāt na dvaitam āpādayati atas na advaitam hanti iti arthaḥ

original: ‘ekam’ ityātmanāmanātmanāṃ cārthānāṃ bhedasya nānātvasya nivṛttiḥ, ‘ajam’ ityudayasya janmanaḥ, ‘amṛtam’ iti vyayasya vināśasyeti vivektavyam | ānandastu yadi bhāvarūpo'bhyupagamyate, tato'dvaitavidhātaḥ syādityāha—ānandaśreti ! nanu dharmadharmiṇorbhedādadvaitavidhātaḥ syāt; sa eva tatra nāsti, tayorbhede gavāśvavat dharmadharmitvāyogāt;
analyzed: ekam iti ātmanām anātmanām ca arthānām bhedasya nānātvasya nivṛttiḥ ajam iti udayasya janmanaḥ amṛtam iti vyayasya vināśasya iti vivektavyam ānandaḥ tu yadi syāt iti āha ānanda śrī iti nanu dharma dharmiṇoḥ bhedāt advaita vidhātaḥ syāt saḥ eva tatra na asti tayoḥ bhede gavāśva vat dharma dharmi tva ayogāt

original: ato nādvaitavidhātaḥ syāditi codayati—syādetaditi | tad dūṣayāt—taditi | dharmadharmiṇoratyantābhedo'pi dhārmiṇa iva svāpekṣayā dharmadharmitvānupapatterityarthaḥ | yasmādātyantikabhedābhedābhyāṃ vyāvṛtto dharmadharmibhāvaḥ, tasmāt kathaṃcidvighno

original: ātmaprakāśeti svaprakāśatvena vijñānarūpatām, prakṛṣṭeti ca mukhyāṃ paramatām, ānandasvabhāveti ca duḥkhābhāvasya bhāvatvānupapatterānandasya bhāvarūpatvamabhedaṃ ca sūcayatīti vivektavyam |

original: bhāvarūpānavacchinnānandasvabhāvatve ca brahmaṇo yat "etasyaivānandasyānyāni bhūtāni mātrāmupajīvanti" iti laukikaṃ sukhaṃ paramānandasya mātretyuktaṃ tadapi ghaṭata ityāha—evaṃ ceti | mātrā ekadeśaḥ, alpo bhāga iti yāvat | kuta ityāha—avacchedāditi |

original: bhāvo hyanavacchinno viṣayairavacchinnālpīkartuṃ śakyate yathā ākāśaṃ ghaṭādibhiḥ, nābhāvaḥ khapuṣpādyabhāvavat | taduktam—duḥkhanivṛttāviti | bhāvarūpānandasya svabhāvatve hetvantaramāha—itaśceti | paramapremaviṣayatvaṃ hetuṃ śrutyā sādhayati—śrūyata iti | na kevalaṃ śrūyate, anubhavāṃtteddhaṃ ca tadityāha—pratīyate ceti |
analyzed: bhāvaḥ hi anavacchinnaḥ viṣayaiḥ avacchinna alpīkartum śakyate yathā ākāśam ghaṭa ādibhiḥ na abhāvaḥ kha puṣpa ādi abhāva vat tat uktam duḥkha nivṛttau iti bhāva rūpa ānandasya svabhāva tve hetu antaram āha etas ca iti parama prema viṣaya tvam hetum śrutyā sādhayati śrūyate iti na kevalam śrūyate ca tat iti āha pratīyate ca iti

original: anubhavamāha—tathā hīti | ātmāśīriti ; ātmanyāśaṃsetyarthaḥ | tāmāha—meti | tataḥ kimityāha—sāpīti | na kevalaṃ śrutiḥ, api tu sāpyātmāśīḥ ityapiśabdārthaḥ | tathāpi kimityāha—premā ceti | duḥkhāt dveṣaḥ, sukhaduḥkhobhayarūparahite copekṣaṇamiti vivekaḥ | ātmanaḥ sukhātmakatvānubhave matāntaramāha—anye tviti |
analyzed: anubhavam āha tathā hi iti ātma āśīḥ iti ātmani āśaṃsā iti arthaḥ tām āhama eti tatas kim iti āha sā api iti na kevalam śrutiḥ api tu sā api ātma āśīḥ iti apiśabda arthaḥ tathā api kim iti āha premā ca iti duḥkhāt dveṣaḥ sukha duḥkha ubhaya rūpa rahite ca upekṣaṇam iti vivekaḥ ātmanaḥ sukha ātmaka tva anubhave mata antaram āha anye tu iti

original: suṣupte satyanantaraṃ pratibuddhasya parāmarśādityanvayaḥ | kathaṃ punarasmāt parāmarśādanubhavasiddhirityata āha - na hīti | anubhavapūrvakatvāt parāmarśasya tataḥ sa kalpyata ityarthaḥ | kiṃ ca sarvathānanubhave 'asvāptam' ityabhyupagamo'pi na syādityāha—suṣupteti | 'na syāt' ityanuvartate | nanve-
analyzed: suṣupte sati anantaram pratibuddhasya parāmarśāt iti anvayaḥ katham punar asmāt parāmarśāt anubhava siddhiḥ iti atas āha na hi iti anubhava pūrvaka tvāt parāmarśasya tatas sa kalpyate iti arthaḥ kim ca sarvathā ananubhave asvāptam iti abhyupagamaḥ api na syāt iti āha suṣupta iti na syāt iti anuvartate nanu evam iti

original: vamastvanubhavaḥ ; ‘sukhānubhavaḥ’ iti viśeṣaḥ kutaḥ ? duḥkhānubhava eva kiṃ na syādityata āha—na ceti | ‘syāt’ iti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | P. 6-1. sukhaparāmaśīghriśiṣṭānubhavasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | nanvastu sukhānubhavaḥ, tathāpi kathamātmanaḥ sukhasvabhāvatvam ? pṛthageva sukhamanubhūyata iti kiṃ na syāt ? ityata āha—na ceti |
analyzed: sukha anubhavaḥ iti viśeṣaḥ kutas duḥkha anubhavaḥ eva kim na syāt iti atas āha na ca iti syāt iti pūrveṇa anvayaḥ sukha parāma śīghri śiṣṭa anubhava siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu astu sukha anubhavaḥ tathā api katham ātmanaḥ sukha svabhāva tvam pṛthak eva sukham anubhūyate iti kim na syāt iti atas āha na ca iti

original: tatra supupte sarvakaraṇoparamādātmano'nyannānubhūyate ; ataḥ sa eva sukhasvabhāvaḥ svato bhāsata iti tasya sukhātmatvasiddhiriti | imamarthaṃ śrutyā draḍhayati—tathā ceti | “evamevemāḥ sarvāḥ prajā aharahargacchanti, ya etaṃ brahmalokaṃ na vindati” iti śrutiḥ | tadidamanye nānumanyante ; yataḥ parāmarśānyathānupapattyānubhavaḥ kalpyaḥ ;
analyzed: tatra supupte sarva karaṇa uparamāt ātmanaḥ nyat na anubhūyate atas saḥ eva sukha svabhāvaḥ svatas bhāsate iti tasya sukha ātmatva siddhiḥ iti imam artham śrutyā draḍhayati tathā ca iti evam eva imāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ aharahar gacchanti yaḥ etam brahma lokam na vindati iti śrutiḥ tat idam anye na anumanyante yatas parāmarśa anyathā anupapattyā anubhavaḥ kalpyaḥ

original: sa ca duḥkhābhāvanimitto'pyupapadyata iti ; tadāha—tatreti | tatra parāmarśaliṅgakasukhānubhavavādina evamāhuḥ—ātmanaḥ sukhātmatvādanyathātve asukhātmatve pramāṇāntarādavagate duḥkhābhāvanimittaḥ sukhaśabdo gauṇaḥ kalpyate, anyathā asukhātmatve tvanavagate mukhya eva yukta iti ; tadāha—tāniti | tadetaddūṣayati—tatreti |
analyzed: sa ca duḥkha abhāva nimittaḥ api upapadyate iti tat āha tatra iti tatra parāmarśa liṅgaka sukha anubhava vādinaḥ evam āhuḥ ātmanaḥ sukha ātma tvāt anyathātve asukha ātma tve pramāṇa antarāt avagate duḥkha abhāva nimittaḥ sukha śabdaḥ gauṇaḥ kalpyate anyathā asukha ātma tve tu anavagate mukhyaḥ eva yuktaḥ iti tat āha tān iti tat etat dūṣayati tatra iti

original: jīvasyaiva hi pratibuddhasya parāmarśādanubhavaḥ kalpyo nānyasya | na ca tasya tadānīmupasaṃhatākhilopādheḥ saṃskāramātraśeṣasyāvidyācchāditātmanaḥ suṣupta sukhopalambhaḥ saṃbhavati | tasmāt ‘sukham’ iti parāmarśamātramidam | tacca sukhe śruddhuḥkhādinivṛttau duḥkhoparame cobhayatrāpi dṛśyate ; upapadyate ca sukhāvinābhāvena duḥkhoparamo'pi |
analyzed: jīvasya eva hi pratibuddhasya parāmarśāt anubhavaḥ kalpyaḥ na anyasya na ca tasya tadānīm upasaṃhata akhila upādheḥ saṃskāra mātra śeṣasya avidyā ācchādita ātmanaḥ suṣupta sukha upalambhaḥ saṃbhavati tasmāt sukham iti parāmarśa mātram idam tat ca sukhe śruddhuḥkha ādi nivṛttau duḥkha uparame ca ubhayatra api dṛśyate upapadyate ca sukha avinābhāvena duḥkha uparamaḥ api

original: tataśca na tataḥ sukhānubhavarūpasyārthasya prasiddhiḥ | tadāha—tatreti | athavā ‘sukhamahamasvāptam, na mayā kiñciccetitam’ iti cobhayathā vyapadeśāt svāpe sarvathā ajñānam ; sukhaparāmarśastu duḥkhoparamanimitta ityevaṃ vyapadeśadvayasyopapatteśca na vyapadeśamātrāt sukhānubhavasiddhirityathaḥ | nanu duḥkhoparamo'pi svāpe na jñātaḥ ; satyam ;
analyzed: tatas ca na tatas sukha anubhava rūpasya arthasya prasiddhiḥ tat āha tatra iti athavā sukham aham asvāptam na mayā kiñcid cetitam iti ca ubhayathā vyapadeśāt svāpe sarvathā ajñānam sukha parāmarśaḥ tu duḥkha uparama nimittaḥ iti evam vyapadeśa dvayasya upapatteḥ ca na vyapadeśa mātrāt sukha anubhava siddhiḥ iti athaḥ nanu duḥkha uparamaḥ api svāpe na jñātaḥ satyam

original: pratibuddhastu sukhamanusaṃdhāya duḥkhoparamamavagacchati | nanu duḥkhānanubhavo'pi tadā na jñātaḥ kathamanusaṃdhīyate ? yadi duḥkhamanvabhavat, tato duḥkhamasmaripyat ; na caivam ; ato ‘na duḥkhamanvabhavam’ ityevaṃ duḥkhānubhavābhāvamanusaṃdhata ityadāpaḥ |
analyzed: pratibuddhaḥ tu sukham anusaṃdhāya duḥkha uparamam avagacchati nanu duḥkha ananubhavaḥ api tadā na jñātaḥ katham anusaṃdhīyate yadi duḥkham anvabhavat tatas duḥkham asmaripyat na ca evam atas na duḥkham anvabhavam iti evam duḥkha anubhava abhāvam anusaṃdhataḥ iti adāpaḥ

original: idānīmekapadaṃ vyākhyātuṃ tadyāvartyamātmanāmātmadṛśyayordṛśyānāṃ cānyonyabhedaṃ parābhimataṃ tāvadupanyasyati—atreti | kaścit sukhī kaścit
analyzed: idānīm eka padam vyākhyātum tad yāvartyam ātmanām ātma dṛśyayoḥ dṛśyānām ca anyonya bhedam para abhimatam tāvat upanyasyati atra iti kaścid sukhī kaścid

original: duḥkhīti bhogavyavasthā, kaścinmuktaḥ kaścit saṃsārīti ca vibhāga ātmanāṃ bhede ghaṭate ; anyathaikasmin sukhini mukte ca sarve sukhino muktāśca syurityātmanāṃ bhede yuktiḥ | dṛśyaṃ vinā cātmano dṛkchaktiraphalā syāt | P. 6-8. ātmānaṃ tayā drakṣyatīti cet, tatrāha—svātmanīti | svavyāpāravyāpyatayā svasya karmatvaṃ virudhyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: duḥkhī iti bhoga vyavasthā kaścid muktaḥ kaścid saṃsārī iti ca vibhāgaḥ ātmanām bhede ghaṭate anyathā ekasmin sukhini mukte ca sarve sukhinaḥ muktāḥ ca syuḥ iti ātmanām bhede yuktiḥ dṛśyam vinā ca ātmanaḥ syāt p 68 ātmānam tayā drakṣyati iti ced tatra āha sva ātmani iti sva vyāpāra vyāpya tayā svasya karma tvam virudhyate iti arthaḥ

original: kiṃ ca darśanavyāpyaṃ hi dṛśyam ; darśanaṃ ca kāryatvāt samavāyikāraṇaṃ draṣṭāramanumāpayatītyevaṃ dṛśyena draṣṭuranumānam ; ato'sti draṣṭuranyadṛśyamiti ātmadṛśyayorbhede yuktiḥ | dṛśyasyetyādi dṛśyānāṃ mitho bhede yuktiriti vivektavyam | sukhādibhedavacca ca śabdādeściguṇajatvāt ; evaṃ ca sukhādilakṣaṇo'pi dṛśyabhedaḥ kaṭākṣita iti draṣṭavyam |
analyzed: kim ca darśana vyāpyam hi dṛśyam darśanam ca kārya tvāt samavāyi kāraṇam draṣṭāram anumāpayati iti evam dṛśyena draṣṭuḥ anumānam atas asti draṣṭuḥ anya dṛśyam iti ātma dṛśyayoḥ bhede yuktiḥ dṛśyasya ityādi dṛśyānām mithas bhede yuktiḥ iti vivektavyam sukha ādi bheda vat ca ca śabda ādeḥ ci guṇa ja tvāt evam ca sukha ādi lakṣaṇaḥ api dṛśya bhedaḥ kaṭākṣitaḥ iti draṣṭavyam

original: yathā viruddhānāṃ sukhādīnāṃ bhedopalabdhiḥ, evaṃ viruddhānāmapi śabdādīnāmityarthaḥ | tadevaṃ bhede sati “eka evāyamadvitīyaḥ” ityātmaikatvaśrutimātmatvajāterabhedāddeśakālābhedācca, jagadekaśrutimapi sattārūpeṇaikatvato gauṇīm, “ātmaivedam” iti ca tādṛśyīt tacchabdaṃ ye manyante tān pratyucyate—ekamiti | atra śrutimāha—indra iti |
analyzed: yathā viruddhānām sukha ādīnām bheda upalabdhiḥ evam viruddhānām api śabda ādīnām iti arthaḥ tat evam bhede sati ekaḥ eva ayam advitīyaḥ iti ātma ekatva śrutim ātma tva jāteḥ abhedāt deśa kāla abhedāt ca jagat eka śrutim api sattā rūpeṇa ekatvataḥ gauṇīm ātmā eva idam iti ca tādṛśyīt tad śabdam ye manyante tān pratyucyate ekam iti atra śrutim āha aindraḥ iti

original: mīyate'nayeti māyā buddhiḥ ; ataścendriyabuddhyātmā dvipadādirūpaḥ pratīyata ityarthaḥ ; ataḥ kathaṃ nānātvasya mithyātvamiti cet ; na, yaugikatvāt ; yaugiko hi māyāśabdo buddhau, rūḍhaśca mithyābhāve ; rūḍhiśca yogādbalīyasīti nyāyaḥ ; tasmādbuddhireva grāhyā | yadyapi buddhināmasu kvacitpāṭho'sti, tathāpīha na sā grāhyā ;
analyzed: mīyate nayā iti māyā buddhiḥ atas ca indriya buddhi ātmā dvipada ādi rūpaḥ pratīyate iti arthaḥ atas katham nānātvasya mithyātvam iti ced na yaugika tvāt yaugikaḥ hi māyā śabdaḥ buddhau rūḍhaḥ ca mithyābhāve rūḍhiḥ ca yogāt balīyasī iti nyāyaḥ tasmāt buddhiḥ eva grāhyā yadi api buddhi nāmasu kvacid pāṭhaḥ asti tathā api iha na sā grāhyā

original: yaddhi pratīyate tad buddhyaiva ; ato māyeti viśeṣaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | na ca sarvatra vede buddhivācī māyāśabdaḥ, “māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ viddhi” iti vyabhicārāditi | tataḥ kimityāha—tatreti | nānātve satyekatvamupacaritam ; asarve tu tasmin śrutyoktamekatvameva satyamāpadyate, nopacaritamityarthaḥ | ekatvopacāre śrutyantaravirodhamāha—tatheti |
analyzed: yat hi pratīyate tat buddhyā eva atas māyā iti viśeṣaṇam vyartham syāt na ca sarvatra vede buddhi vācī māyā śabdaḥ māyām tu prakṛtim viddhi iti vyabhicārāt iti tatas kim iti āha tatra iti nānātve sati ekatvam upacaritam asarve tu tasmin śrutyā uktam ekatvam eva satyam āpadyate na upacaritam iti arthaḥ ekatva upacāre śruti antara virodham āha tathā iti

original: ‘nopacarita ekatve'vakalpata’ iti vakṣyamāṇena sarvatra saṃvandhaḥ | pūrvaṃ māyābhidhānenārthānāṃ nānātvaṃ niṣiddham, iha tu sākṣāditi vyaktatvābhidhānam | atrāhuḥ—ākṛteḥ padārthatvānāṃ śabdo nānātvamāha ; tataśca “asadevedam” ityataḥ prakṛte jagatkāraṇe nānātvaṃ niṣidhyate, na tu nānābhūtaṃ jagaditi |
analyzed: na upacaritaḥ eka tvā iva kalpate iti vakṣyamāṇena sarvatra saṃvandhaḥ pūrvam māyā abhidhānena arthānām nānātvam niṣiddham iha tu sākṣāt iti vyakta tva abhidhānam atra āhuḥ ākṛteḥ padārtha tvānām śabdaḥ nānātvam āha tatas ca asat eva idam iti atas prakṛte jagatkāraṇe nānātvam niṣidhyate na tu nānābhūtam jagat iti

original: atra brūmaḥ—nānātvavācyapi nānāśabdo ‘vaṭānānā paṭaḥ’ iti-
analyzed: atra brūmaḥ nānātva vācī api nānā śabdaḥ vaṭa anānā paṭaḥ iti

original: bat tadvati jagati vartate | tatra paṭhaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāt ‘śuklaḥ paṭaḥ’ iti vadvartate iti cet, atrāpi ‘kiñcana’ ityanirdhāritaviśeṣajagatsāmānādhikaraṇyamaviśiṣṭam | tasmānnānābhūtajagadeva niṣidhyate, na nānātvamiti siddham | na ca ‘ekasminnāyatane eka evādvitīyo bhoktā, na nānā’ ityayamasyārthaḥ kalpyaḥ, aśrutakalpanāprasaṅgāditi |
analyzed: tadvati jagati vartate tatra paṭha śabda sāmānādhikaraṇyāt śuklaḥ paṭaḥ iti vat vartate iti ced atra api kiñcana iti anirdhārita viśeṣa jagat sāmānādhikaraṇyam aviśiṣṭam tasmāt nānā bhūta jagat eva niṣidhyate na nānātvam iti siddham na ca ekasmin āyatane ekaḥ eva advitīyaḥ bhoktā na nānā iti ayam asya arthaḥ kalpyaḥ aśruta kalpanā prasaṅgāt iti

original: tatraiva śrutyantaravirodhamāha—nānātveti | ekatve upacarite nānātvaṃ paramārthaṃ syāt; na ca P. 6-14. tasya nindā yukteti bhāvaḥ | tatraiva punaḥ śrutyantaravirodhamāha—bhedeti | bhedadarśanādanyasmin tadābhāse iva śabdo ghaṭate, na tu tatraivetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatra eva śruti antara virodham āha nānātva iti ekatve upacarite nānātvam paramārtham syāt na ca tasya nindā yuktā iti bhāvaḥ tatra eva punar śruti antara virodham āha bheda iti bheda darśanāt anyasmin tad ābhāse iva śabdaḥ ghaṭate na tu tatra eva iti arthaḥ

original: na ca “bhedadṛṣṭiriva” iti “aṇvya ivemā dhānāḥ” iti vadavadhāraṇārthaṃ ivakāraḥ, nāsatvadyotanārthaṃ iti vācyam; bhramādityanupapatteḥ | ata eva ca bhedadṛṣṭe bhrāntitve sthite bhedasya mithyātvāt ‘nānā’ ityayamapīvakāro mithyātvadyotanārtho nāvadhāraṇārthaṃ iti siddham, anyathā tadviruddhārthaḥ syāt;
