original: dvitīyamapi hetumasiddhatvenaiva dūṣayati—dṛśyeti ; pramāṇasya pratyakṣāderdṛśyabhedaḥ grahaṇāsāmarthyādityarthaḥ | vakṣyata iti 'āhurvidhātṛ pratyakṣam' ityatretyarthaḥ | yo'pi bhinnadṛśyasadbhāvahetudṛcchakterthavacchaktaḥ, so'pi dṛśyābhāve'pi ghaṭana ityāha—dṛgiti ; ātmānameva tayā draṣṭā drakṣyatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: dvitīyam api hetum asiddha tvena eva dūṣayati dṛśya iti pramāṇasya pratyakṣa ādeḥ dṛśya bhedaḥ grahaṇa asāmarthyāt iti arthaḥ vakṣyate iti āhuḥ vidhātṛ pratyakṣam iti atra iti arthaḥ yaḥ api bhinna dṛśya sadbhāva hetu dṛcchakti īrtha vat śaktaḥ saḥ api dṛśya abhāve pi ghaṭane iti āha dṛś iti ātmānam eva tayā draṣṭā drakṣyati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu kartuḥ karmatvaṃ virudhyata ityuktamityāśaṅkyāha—na ceti | yathā pradīpaḥ pradīpāntaranirapekṣaḥ svata eva prakāśate tathātmāpi ; tataśca na virodha iti bhāvaḥ | yadi nāma pradīpaḥ pradīpāntaranirapekṣaḥ buddhivedyastu bhavatyeveti abuddhivedyakaṃ svataḥsiddhaṃ pramāṇaphalaṃ dṛṣṭāntayati—pramāṇeti |
analyzed: nanu kartuḥ karma tvam virudhyate iti uktam iti āśaṅkya āha na ca iti yathā pradīpaḥ pradīpa antara nirapekṣaḥ svatas eva prakāśate tathā ātmā api tatas ca na virodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ yadi nāma pradīpaḥ pradīpa antara nirapekṣaḥ buddhi vedyaḥ tu bhavati eva iti a buddhi vedyakam svatas siddham pramāṇa phalam dṛṣṭāntayati pramāṇa iti

original: 'na ca saṃvedyam' ityatroktamityarthaḥ idānīṃ tvapakṣe guṇamāha—api ceti ; draṣṭṛdṛśyayorekatva ityarthaḥ | kuta ityata āha—draṣṭuriti | tena tena dṛśyarūpeṇa vipariṇamāditi paramatam | vivartanāditi ; atadrūpasya bhrāntyā tadrūpādhyāsāditi tvamatam | krimatra
analyzed: na ca saṃvedyam iti atra uktam iti arthaḥ idānīm tva pakṣe guṇam āha api ca iti draṣṭṛ dṛśyayoḥ ekatve iti arthaḥ kutas iti atas āha draṣṭuḥ iti tena tena dṛśya rūpeṇa vipariṇamāt iti para matam vivartanāt iti a tad rūpasya bhrāntyā tad rūpa adhyāsāt iti tva matam krim atra

original: viśeṣanirūpaṇena ? matadvaye'pi dṛksarūpeṇa draṣṭṛsaṃbandhādarthānāṃ dṛśyatvaṃ ghaṭata iti bhāvaḥ | bhede tu tathostādātmyalakṣaṇasaṃbandharahitayorātmānātmanoranavayavatvādanyayogolakavacca parasparamasaṃsṛṣṭayorata evāsaṃbaddhayordraṣṭṛdṛśyabhāvo na syādityāha—nānātve tviti | kuto na syādityāha—na hīti | svato P. 7-24.
analyzed: viśeṣa nirūpaṇena mata dvaye pi dṛś sarūpeṇa draṣṭṛ saṃbandhāt arthānām dṛśya tvam ghaṭate iti bhāvaḥ bhede tu tathoḥ tādātmya lakṣaṇa saṃbandha rahitayoḥ ātma anātmanoḥ anavayava tvāt anyayoḥ golaka vat ca parasparam asaṃsṛṣṭayoḥ atas eva asaṃbaddhayoḥ draṣṭṛ dṛśya bhāvaḥ na syāt iti āha nānātve tu iti kutas na syāt ityāha na hi iti svatas

original: jaḍatvādarthānāmiti bhāvaḥ | nanu sphaṭikopame cetasi indriyapraṇālyā saṃkrāntānāmarthānāṃ tatraiva saṃkrāntenātmacaitanyena saṃbaddhānāṃ tadṛśyatvaṃ ghaṭiṣyata ityāśaṅkayati—eketi | tadṛṣayati—neti | ekāntaḥkaraṇasaṃkrāntāyā api cito nārthasaṃsargakāluṣyamasti, viśuddhatvāt |
analyzed: jaḍa tvāt arthānām iti bhāvaḥ nanu sphaṭika upame cetasi indriya praṇālyā saṃkrāntānām arthānām tatra eva saṃkrāntena ātma caitanyena saṃbaddhānām tad dṛśya tvam ghaṭiṣyate iti āśaṅkayati eka iti tat ṛṣayati na iti eka antaḥkaraṇa saṃkrāntāyāḥ api citaḥ na artha saṃsarga kāluṣyam asti viśuddha tvāt

original: na ca viśuddhāpi tatra saṃkrāntā arthākāreṇa pariṇamate, kauṭasthyenāpariṇāmāt | etacca saṃkrāntimapekṣyoktam ; taccatastu sāpi niṣkriyatvāccito nāsti, arthasya ca ; ataḥ kuto'rthasya tatsaṃbandhāccetyatvamiti bhāvaḥ | athocyate—na bāhyo'rtho dṛśyaḥ, kiṃtu buddhirevārthākāreṇa pariṇatā arthākāreṇa dṛśyā ;
analyzed: na ca viśuddhā api tatra saṃkrāntā artha ākāreṇa pariṇamate kauṭasthyena apariṇāmāt etat ca saṃkrāntim apekṣya uktam tat catas tu sā api niṣkriya tvāt citaḥ nā asti arthasya ca atas kutas ṛthasya tad saṃbandhāt cetya tvam iti bhāvaḥ atha ucyate na bāhyaḥ ṛthaḥ dṛśyaḥ kiṃtu buddhiḥ eva artha ākāreṇa pariṇatā artha ākāreṇa dṛśyā

original: sā cātmacitaḥ saṃnidheḥ citicchāyāṃ vahati ; ato'rtho dṛśyata ityucyate ; na tu citeraśuddhatvaṃ pariṇāgitvaṃ saṃkrāntirveti ; tadāha—dṛśyeti | tadṛṣayati—atheti | acitirūpāyā buddheścitirūpatā cettacchāyatā, mithyā tārhi ; na ca mithyābhūtena citisaṃbandhena paramārthato dṛśyaṃ dṛśyate ;
analyzed: sā ca ātma citaḥ saṃnidheḥ citi chāyām vahati atas ṛthaḥ dṛśyate iti ucyate na tu citeḥ aśuddha tvam pariṇāgi tvam saṃkrāntiḥ vā iti tat āha dṛśya iti tat ṛṣayati atha iti aciti rūpāyāḥ buddheḥ citi rūpa tā ced tad chāya tā mithyā tārhi na ca mithyā bhūtena citi saṃbandhena paramārthataḥ dṛśyam dṛśyate

original: na ca paramārthenādṛśyamānaṃ dṛśyaṃ draṣṭṛrvā atiriktamastīti śakyate bhaṇitum ; ato draṣṭṛdvaitasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | yo'pi bhīmāṃsako manyate—dṛśyatayaiva vācyavadṛśyasya vyavasthā, na saṃbandhena ; vācyavācakavadraṣṭṛdṛśyabhāva evānayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ, nānya iti yāvat ;
analyzed: na ca paramārthena adṛśyamānam dṛśyam atiriktam asti iti śakyate bhaṇitum atas draṣṭṛ dvaita siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ yaḥ api bhīmāṃsakaḥ manyate dṛśya tayā eva vācya va dṛśyasya vyavasthā na saṃbandhena vācya vācaka vat raṣṭṛ dṛśya bhāvaḥ eva anayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ na anyaḥ iti yāvat

original: darśanaṃ ca ‘nīlamidam’ iti vyatiriktaṃ nīlamupasthāpayati, na ‘ahaṃ nīlam’ ityavyatiriktam ; ato draṣṭṛvyatiriktaṃ dṛśyamiti ; sa vaktavyaḥ—satyaṃ darśanaṃ vyatiriktavastuviṣayam, kiṃ tvekasyaivātmanastena tena nīlādinā vyatiriktarūpeṇa bhrāntyādhyavasāyādavyatireke'pi tadyatirekadarśanamiti | tatsarvamāha— yo'pīti | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—darpaṇeti |
analyzed: darśanam ca nīlam idam iti vyatiriktam nīlam upasthāpayati na aham nīlam iti avyatiriktam atas draṣṭṛ vyatiriktam dṛśyam iti sa vaktavyaḥ satyam darśanam vyatirikta vastu viṣayam kim tu ekasya eva ātmanaḥ tena tena nīla ādinā vyatirikta rūpeṇa bhrāntyā adhyavasāyāt avyatireke pi tat sarvam āha yaḥ upi iti atra dṛṣṭāntam āha darpaṇa iti

original: ātmana iti ; ātmīyasya dehasyetyarthaḥ | tadeva prapañcayati—tathā hīti | yathā vimbāt prativimbamabhinnamapi bhinnaṃ pratyeti taddvityarthaḥ | nanu tatra vādhādastvevam, iha tu kiṃ nopapadyate, yenaivaṃ kalpyate ityata āha—citostviti | citerviviktamatadātmakatayā vā asaṃsṛṣṭaṃ tathā cetyata iti duravagamam ; ataścetyatvānupapadyaiva
analyzed: ātmanaḥ iti ātmīyasya dehasya iti arthaḥ tat eva prapañcayati tathā hi iti yathā vimbāt prativimbam abhinnam api bhinnam pratyeti tat du iti arthaḥ nanu tatra vādhāt astu evam iha tu kim na upapadyate yena evam kalpyate iti atas āha citoḥ tu iti citeḥ viviktam a tad ātmaka tayā vā asaṃsṛṣṭam tathā cetyataḥ iti duravagamam atas cetyatva anupapadyā eva

original: kalpyata iti bhāvaḥ | vācyavācakayorabhidhānakriyāgarbhaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, citestu na kācit kriyāstīti vaiṣamyam | ātmāvyatireke ca dṛśyasya śrutirapyastītyāha P. 8-11 — evaṃ ceti | ātmavyatiriktasya sarvasyābhāvādātmaiva sarvasya tattvam ; ata ātmani jñāte sarvaṃ jñātaṃ bhavatīti śruterarthaḥ |
analyzed: kalpyate iti bhāvaḥ vācya vācakayoḥ abhidhāna kriyā garbhaḥ saṃbandhaḥ citeḥ tu na kācid kriyā asti iti vaiṣamyam ātma avyatireke ca dṛśyasya śrutiḥ api asti iti āha evam ca iti ātma vyatiriktasya sarvasya abhāvāt ātmā eva sarvasya tattvam atas ātmani jñāte sarvam jñātam bhavati iti śruteḥ arthaḥ

original: na ca sadeva sarvamātmano bhinnābhinnam, tenābhedāṃśenātmani jñāte sarvaṃ jñātaṃ bhavatīti vācyam ; aśrutakalpanāprasaṅgāt, bhedāṃśena cājñānādaikāntikajñātatvānupapatteḥ, bhedābhedayośca nirākariṣyamāṇatvāditi | tasmācchobhanam 'ekam' ityuktamityupasaṃharati—tasmāditi |
analyzed: na ca sat eva sarvam ātmanaḥ bhinna abhinnam tena abheda aṃśena ātmani jñāte sarvam jñātam bhavati iti vācyam aśruta kalpanā prasaṅgāt bheda aṃśena ca ajñānāt aikāntika jñāta tva anupapatteḥ bheda abhedayoḥ ca nirākariṣyamāṇa tvāt iti tasmāt śobhanam ekam iti uktam iti upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: idānīm 'amṛtam, ajam' iti vyākhyātuṃ tadvyāvartya bauddhamatadvayamupanyasyan mādhyamikamataṃ tāvadāha—kṣaṇiketi | taduktam—“pradīpasyeva nirvāṇaṃ vimokṣastasya tāyinaḥ” iti | viṣayavāsanayā sahitasyāvidyādikleśasya samyagucchedanādityarthaḥ | viṣayavāsanocchedāt grāhyābhāvaḥ, tadabhāvācca grāhakābhāvaḥ ;
analyzed: idānīm amṛtam ajam iti vyākhyātum tat vyāvartya bauddha mata dvayam upanyasyan mādhyamika matam tāvat āha kṣaṇikā iti tat uktam pradīpasya iva nirvāṇam vimokṣaḥ tasya tāyinaḥ iti viṣaya vāsanayā sahitasya avidyā ādi kleśasya samyak ucchedanāt iti arthaḥ viṣaya vāsanā ucchedāt grāhya abhāvaḥ tad abhāvāt ca grāhaka abhāvaḥ

original: nāgrāhyaṃ grāhakaṃ saṃbhavatīti vijñānoparamahetuḥ | mādhyamikasya śūnyalakṣaṇaṃ brahma ; atastatprāptireva brahmaprāptiḥ | imamarthaṃ śrutyā draḍhayati—tathā ceti saṃsārāt pretya jñānaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ | yogācāramatamāha—anye tviti ; samyagucchinnā sakalā viṣayādivāsanā yasya sa tathoktaḥ, tattvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: na agrāhyam grāhakam saṃbhavati iti vijñāna uparama hetuḥ mādhyamikasya śūnya lakṣaṇam brahma atas tad prāptiḥ eva brahma prāptiḥ imam artham śrutyā draḍhayati tathā ca iti saṃsārāt pretya jñānam na asti iti arthaḥ yoga ācāra matam āha anye tu iti samyak ucchinnā sakalā viṣaya ādi vāsanā yasya sa tathā uktaḥ tattvāt iti arthaḥ

original: vidhūto vigato viṣayākāreṇopaṣṭhavaḥ saṃsargo yasya ; ata eva viśuddhasya vijñānasyotpādaḥ, tallakṣaṇāṃ brahmaprāptimāhuriti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | nityātmavādināṃ tu doṣamāha—anādīti | janmanāśarahitatve kauṭasthye ityarthaḥ | tataḥ kro doṣa ityata āha—itīti ; itirhetvarthaḥ | tadarthānīti ; apanayopanayaprayojanānītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: vidhūtaḥ vigataḥ viṣaya ākāreṇa upaṣṭhavaḥ saṃsargaḥ yasya atas eva viśuddhasya vijñānasya utpādaḥ tad lakṣaṇām brahmaprāptim āhuḥ iti pūrveṇa anvayaḥ nitya ātma vādinām tu doṣam āha anādi iti janma nāśa rahita tve kauṭasthye iti arthaḥ tatas kraḥ doṣaḥ iti atas āha eti iti itiḥ hetvarthaḥ tad arthāni iti apanaya upanaya prayojanāni iti arthaḥ

original: apaneyopaneyābhāvameva prapañcayati—tathā hīti | kuta ityāha—avidyāyā iti | na tāvadavidyā nivartyā, vidyātmani tasyā abhāvāt ; na ca vidyopaneyā, tasyāḥ svabhāvasiddhatvāt | na cāvidyāsvabhāvaṃ brahma ; tatrāvidyāpanīyate iti vācyam ; nityasya hi brahmaṇaḥ svabhāvanāśe'nityatvaprasaṅgāt ;
analyzed: apaneya upaneya abhāvam eva prapañcayati tathā hi iti kutas iti āha avidyāyāḥ iti na tāvat avidyā nivartyā vidyā ātmani tasyāḥ abhāvāt na ca vidyā upaneyā tasyāḥ svabhāva siddha tvāt na ca avidyā svabhāvam brahma tatra avidyā apanīyate iti vācyam nityasya hi brahmaṇaḥ svabhāva nāśe nitya tva prasaṅgāt

original: pūrvasyāvidyāsvabhāvasyātyāgāt, vidyāsvabhāvasya cānāveyātiśayatvenānāpateḥ vidyāvidyobhayasvabhāvatve ca vidyāyā avāptatvenānupaneyatvāt, avidyāyāśca tatsvabhāvatvenānapaneyatvādityarthaḥ | 'na kiṃcinnivartya'
analyzed: pūrvasya avidyā svabhāvasya atyāgāt vidyā svabhāvasya ca anāveya atiśaya tvena anāpateḥ vidyā avidyā ubhaya svabhāva tve ca vidyāyāḥ avāpta tvena anupaneya tvāt avidyāyāḥ ca tad svabhāva tvena anapaneya tvāt iti arthaḥ na kiṃcid nivartya

original: bhavāsavyaṃ vā' iti pakṣadvaye'pi parato'nuvartate | iti ye prāhuḥ tānpratyāha— P. 8-21. amṛtamajāmiti | tatra paroktaṃ tāvaddoṣadvayaṃ pariharati—na ceti | nanvanādiravidyā brahmavat tadanucchedyetyata āha—sarveti | sarvavādimiddhatvānnedaṃ vayamevopālabhyāḥ ; dṛśyata ca prāgabhāvasyānāderapyuccheda iti bhāvaḥ | para idānīmāha—neti |
analyzed: bhavāsavyam vā iti pakṣa dvaye pi paratas nuvartate iti ye prāhuḥ tān pratyāha amṛtam ajām iti tatra para uktam tāvat doṣa dvayam pariharati na ca iti nanu anādiḥ avidyā brahma vat tad anucchedyā iti atas āha sarva iti sarva vādi middha tvāt na idam vayam eva upālabhyāḥ dṛśyata ca prāgabhāvasya anādeḥ api ucchedaḥ iti bhāvaḥ paraḥ idānīm āha na iti

original: nityabrahmasvabhāvasyāvidyārūpasyānuccheda iti brūma iti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | sa evāśaṅkya dūṣayati—atheti | tataśca dvaitaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | athaitadbhyādarthāntaramapi sā neṣyate, tato na sā svabhāvaḥ, na cārthāntaramiti nāstyeva ; ataḥ kiṃ nivartyamityāha—na ceti | paraḥ punarāśaṅkyati—atheti |
analyzed: nitya brahma svabhāvasya avidyā rūpasya anucchedaḥ iti brūmaḥ iti pūrveṇa anvayaḥ saḥ eva āśaṅkya dūṣayati atha iti tatas ca dvaita prasaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ atha etad bhyāt artha antaram api sā na iṣyate tatas na sā svabhāvaḥ na ca artha antaram iti na asti eva atas kim nivartyam iti āha na ca iti paraḥ punar āśaṅkyati atha iti

original: nāvidyā brahmaṇaḥ svabhāvaḥ, tathāpi na dvaitaprasaṅgaḥ, grahaṇābhāvarūpāyā avastutvenānarthāntaratvāt ; na ca tata evānivartyā, sarvapramāṇānāṃ prameyāgrahaṇanidṛcyarthatvādityarthaḥ | tadanivartakatve satyapi pramāṇe prameyājñānamanuvartateti bhāvaḥ | evamāśaṅkya dūṣayati—tadapīti | kuta ityāha— tacceti |
analyzed: na avidyā brahmaṇaḥ svabhāvaḥ tathā api na dvaita prasaṅgaḥ grahaṇa abhāva rūpāyāḥ avastu tvena anartha antara tvāt na ca tatas eva anivartyā sarva pramāṇānām prameya agrahaṇa nidṛcī arthatvāt iti arthaḥ tad anivartaka tve sati api pramāṇe prameya ajñānam anuvartata iti bhāvaḥ evam āśaṅkya dūṣayati tat api iti kutas iti āha tat ca iti

original: yasmāttaccāgrahaṇātmikāvidyā tadviruddhā taccagrahaṇātmikayā vidyayā nivartyā nānyena ; sā ca brahmasvabhāvatvānnityā ; ato nityanidṛttaivāvidyeti na tannivṛttyarthatvena śāstrādīnāmarthavatteti bhāvaḥ | atha brahmaṇo nāvidyā, kiṃ tu jīvānāṃ brahmaviṣayā ; sā ca teṣāṃ śravaṇādiprayatnalabhyayā brahmaviṣayayāgantukayā vidyayā nivartyate ;
analyzed: yasmāt tat ca agrahaṇa ātmikā avidyā tad viruddhā tad ca grahaṇa ātmikayā vidyayā nivartyā na anyena sā ca brahma svabhāva tvāt nityā atas nitya nidṛttā eva avidyā iti na tad nivṛtti artha tvena śāstra ādīnām arthavat tā iti bhāvaḥ atha brahmaṇaḥ na avidyā kim tu jīvānām brahma viṣayā sā ca teṣām śravaṇa ādi prayatna labhyayā brahma viṣayayā āgantukayā vidyayā nivartyate

original: ato na nityamavidyānidṛttiprasaṅga ityucyate ; tadapi na, brahmavyatiriktajīvābhyupagame dvaitaprasaṅgāt ityabhiprāyeṇāha— na ceti | astu tarhi brahmaṇyevāvidyetyata āha—brahmaṇīti | dūṣaṇāntarābhidhitsayā punarupanyāsa iti draṣṭavyam | athaitaddoṣabhayādavirodhastayo riṣyeta tatrāha—avipratiṣedha iti |
analyzed: atas na nityam avidyā nidṛtti prasaṅgaḥ iti ucyate tat api na brahma vyatirikta jīva abhyupagame dvaita prasaṅgāt iti abhiprāyeṇa āha na ca iti astu tarhi brahmaṇi eva avidyā iti atas āha brahmaṇi iti dūṣaṇa antara abhidhitsayā punar upanyāsaḥ iti draṣṭavyam atha etad doṣa bhayāt avirodhaḥ tayoḥ riṣyeta tatra āha avipratiṣedhaḥ iti

original: viruddhā hi satī vidyā tāṃ nivartayet, nāviruddhā, rasa iva rūpamiti bhāvaḥ | evamagrahaṇātmikāmavidyāṃ dūṣayitvā viparyayagrahaṇātmikāmidānīṃ dūṣayati—yasya tviti | brahmāsvabhāvatve'rthāntaratvādadvaitavidhāta iti bhāvaḥ | doṣāntaramāha—kasya ceti ; nirāśrayaviparyayagrahaṇāsaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: viruddhā hi satī vidyā tām nivartayet na aviruddhā rasaḥ iva rūpam iti bhāvaḥ evam agrahaṇa ātmikām avidyām dūṣayitvā viparyaya grahaṇa ātmikām idānīm dūṣayati yasya tu iti brahma asvabhāva tva ṛtha antara tvāt advaita vidhātaḥ iti bhāvaḥ doṣa antara māhakasya ca iti nirāśraya viparyaya grahaṇa asaṃbhavāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: na tāvattadviparyayagrahaṇaṃ brahmaṇo'nyasya, tadabhāvān ; nāpi brahmaṇa eva, tasya vidyāsvarūpasya vipratiṣiddhāvidyāśrayatvāyogādityāha—brahmaṇa iti | athāvirodhastatrāha—avipratiṣedha iti |
analyzed: na tāvat tad viparyaya grahaṇam brahmaṇaḥ nyasya tad abhāvāt nā api brahmaṇaḥ eva tasya vidyā svarūpasya vipratiṣiddha avidyā āśraya tva ayogāt iti āha brahmaṇaḥ iti atha avirodhaḥ tatra āha avipratiṣedhaḥ iti

original: kena nivartyeta ? na kenāpītyarthaḥ | vidyāyā aviruddhatvenānivartakatvādanyasya ca tannivartakasyādṛṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ | P. 9-11. atra siddhāntamāha—atrocyata iti | ‘na svabhāvo nārthāntaram’ iti svabhāvāsvabhāvapakṣoktadoṣāvanabhyupagamenaiva pariharati | yadi brahmaṇo na svabhāvaḥ, nāpyarthāntaramavidyā, nāstyeva tarhītyatrāha—neti |
analyzed: kena nivartyeta na kena api iti arthaḥ vidyāyāḥ aviruddha tvena anivartaka tvāt anyasya ca tad nivartakasya adṛṣṭa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ atra siddhāntam āha atra ucyate iti na svabhāvaḥ na arthāntaram iti svabhāva asvabhāva pakṣa ukta doṣau anabhyupagamena eva pariharati yadi brahmaṇaḥ na svabhāvaḥ na api arthāntaram avidyā na asti eva tarhi iti atra āha na iti

original: yadi na brahmaṇo bhinnā, abhinnā vā, na satī, nāpyasatī, kīdṛśī nāma sā ? ityata āha— evamiti ; īdṛśyeva sā, anavasthitaikarūpetyarthaḥ | na ceyamalaukikītyāha— avidyeti ; loka iti vākyaśeṣaḥ | evamādibhiḥ śabdairasau rūḍhā, na sadasadādiśabdairiti darśayituṃ viśiṣṭaparyāyanirdeśaḥ | tatra saccābhāve tāvat pramāṇamāha—svabhāvaśrediti ;
analyzed: yadi na brahmaṇaḥ bhinnā abhinnā vā na satī na api asatī kīdṛśī nāma sā iti atas āha evam iti īdṛśī eva sā anavasthitā ekarūpā iti arthaḥ na ca iyam alaukikī iti āha avidyā iti lokaḥ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ evamādibhiḥ śabdaiḥ asau rūḍhā na sat asat ādi śabdaiḥ iti darśayitum viśiṣṭa paryāya nirdeśaḥ tatra sat ca abhāve tāvat pramāṇam āha svabhāva śret iti

original: tasyāḥ saccābhāve tāvadavidyātvānyathānupapattireva pramāṇamiti bhāvaḥ | tathā brahmasvabhāvatve satyatvāt brahmavadvādhānupapattirapi tatra pramāṇamūhyam | arthāntaratvābhāvastulyadoṣatvāt svabhāvānyatvapakṣatulyatvādvā na sa pṛthagukta iti | atyantāsaccābhāve tu vyavahārāṅgatvānupapattiḥ pramāṇam ;
analyzed: tasyāḥ sacca abhāve tāvat avidyā tva anyathā anupapattiḥ eva pramāṇam iti bhāvaḥ tathā brahma svabhāva tve satya tvāt brahma vat vādha anupapattiḥ api tatra pramāṇam ūhyam artha antara tva abhāvaḥ tulya doṣa tvāt svabhāva anya tva pakṣa tulya tvāt vā na sa pṛthak uktaḥ iti atyanta asat ca abhāve tu vyavahāra aṅga tva anupapattiḥ pramāṇam

original: na hyasato vyavahārāṅgatvaṃ dṛṣṭamityabhiprāyeṇāha— atyanteti | upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam ; upalabhbho'pyasataḥ svapuṣpavannopapadyeteti so'pi pramāṇam | nanu vyavahārāṅgaṃ cet tato'rthakriyākāritvāt saccasya kathaṃ na satī ? maivam, dehātmabhāvasyāśeṣavyavahārāṅgasyāpyasaccāt | tajjñānaṃ tatra sadeva vyavahārāṅgamiti cet, tadapi na ;
analyzed: na hi asataḥ vyavahāra aṅga tvam dṛṣṭam iti abhiprāyeṇa āha atyanta iti upalakṣaṇam ca idam sva puṣpa vat na upapadyeta iti saḥ upi pramāṇam nanu vyavahāra aṅgam ced tatas ṛthakriyā kāri tvāt saccasya katham na satī mā evam deha ātma bhāvasya aśeṣa vyavahāra aṅgasya api asaccāt tat jñānam tatra sat eva vyavahāra aṅgam iti ced tat api na asti

original: yato na jñānamātraṃ vyavahārāṅgam | nanvavidyā pramāṇena cet pratīyate, tato brahmavat satī ; no cet, svapuṣpavadasatī ; kathamanirvacanīyā ? maivam ; avabhāti hi sā ; na tu pramāṇena, śuktirūpyavat ; ata eva svapuṣpādviśiṣyate | na ca sadasatī, virodhāt ; ato balādāpannamanirvacanīyaṃ sadasaccābhyāṃ rāśyantaram | nanu na tadanyat kiñcidṛṣṭam |
analyzed: yatas na jñāna mātram vyavahāra aṅgam nanu avidyā pramāṇena ced pratīyate tatas brahma vat satī no ced sva puṣpa vat asatī katham anirvacanīyā mā evam avabhāti hi sā na tu pramāṇena śukti rūpya vat atas eva sva puṣpāt viśiṣyate na ca sat asatī virodhāt atas balāt āpannam anirvacanīyam sat asat ca ābhyām rāśi antaram nanu na tad anyat kiñcid dṛṣṭam

original: mā nāma dṛśyatām, tathāpyuktapramāṇabalāt siddhamanirvacanīyatvamavidyāyā nāpalapanīyam ; na hi bhuvo gandhavatvamanyatrādṛṣṭamiti tatra dṛṣṭamapyapalapyate | nanvanirvacanīyeti nirucyate, kathamanirvacanīyā ? maivam, sadasaccābhyāmiti viśeṣitatvāt | nanvavidyā cedupeyate, avaśyaṃ brahmaṇo bhinnā abhinnā vā syāt, rāśyantarāsaṃbhavāt |
analyzed: mā nāma dṛśyatām tathā api ukta pramāṇa balāt siddham anirvacanīya tvam avidyāyāḥ na apalapanīyam na hi bhuvaḥ gandhava tvam anyatra adṛṣṭam iti tatra dṛṣṭam api apalapyate nanu anirvacanīyā iti nirucyate katham anirvacanīyā mā evam sat asat cābhyām iti viśeṣita tvāt nanu avidyā ced upeyate avaśyam brahmaṇaḥ bhinnā abhinnā vā syāt rāśi antara asaṃbhavāt

original: maivam, śuktirūpya-
analyzed: mā evam śuktirūpya

original: vādetyuktottaratvāt ; śuktirūpyaṃ hi na śukterbhinnamabhinnaṃ bhinnābhinnaṃ vā ghaṭate ; tasmādasti prakārāntarasaṃbhava iti | sarvamūrīkṛtyopasaṃharati—tasmāditi | P. 9-14. iyaṃ cedṛśī sarvaireva vādibhirabhyupeyā ; tena na vayamevopālabhyā iti yuktivalena sarvānabhyupagamayati—sarveti | etadeva prapañcayati—tathā hīti |
analyzed: vāda iti ukta uttara tvāt śukti rūpyam hi na śukteḥ bhinnam abhinnam bhinna abhinnam vā ghaṭate tasmāt asti prakāra antara saṃbhavaḥ iti sarvam ūrīkṛtya upasaṃharati tasmāt iti iyam ca īdṛśī sarvaiḥ eva vādibhiḥ abhyupeyā tena na vayam eva upālabhyāḥ iti yukti valena sarvān abhyupagamayati sarva iti etat eva prapañcayati tathā hi iti

original: sarvaśūnyavādināṃ mādhyamikānāṃ yādṛśaṃ jagadṛśyate tādṛśaṃ cet sat, tataḥ paramārthatvānnāvidyā ; athātyantamasat, tataḥ khapuṣpavat vyavahārāṅgaṃ na syāt ; nāvabhāseta | tathā jñānamātravādino yogācārasya bāhyārthāvabhāsānapahvanāttathā satye nārthāpahvanaḥ syāt ; atyantāsatye khapuṣpavadvyavahārāṅgatvam |
analyzed: sarva śūnyavādinām mādhyamikānām yādṛśam jagat dṛśyate tādṛśam ced sat tatas paramārtha tvāt na avidyā atha atyantam asat tatas khapuṣpa vat vyavahāra aṅgam na syāt na avabhāseta tathā jñānamātra vādinaḥ yoga ācārasya bāhya artha avabhāsa anapahvanāt tathā satye na artha apahvanaḥ syāt atyanta asatye khapuṣpa vat vyavahāra aṅga tvam

original: bāhyārthavādino'pi patañjaleḥ “anityāśuciduḥkhānātmasu nityaśucisukhātmabuddhiravidyā” itīyaṃ nityādibuddhirmithyeṣṭā ; sā pratibhāsamānanityatvādyarthasya satyatve na mithyā syāt ; asatyatve na tannivandhano vyavahāraḥ syāt ; ataḥ sarvairanirvacanīyaivāvidyābhyupetavyetyarthaḥ | nanu śuktirajatādivibhrame rajatamasat, na tu tajjñānam ;
analyzed: bāhya artha vādinaḥ api patañjaleḥ anitya aśuci duḥkha anātmasu nitya śuci sukha ātma buddhiḥ avidyā iti iyam nitya ādi buddhiḥ mithyā iṣṭā sā pratibhāsamāna nitya tva ādi arthasya satya tve na mithyā syāt asatya tve na tad nibandhanaḥ vyavahāraḥ syāt atas sarvaiḥ anirvacanīyā eva avidyā abhyupetavyā iti arthaḥ nanu śukti rajata ādi vibhrame rajatam asat na tu tat jñānam

original: taccāvidyā ; ataḥ satyeva sā ; kathamanirvacanīyatā ? iti codayati—syādetaditi | siddhāntī tvāha—naitaditi | asatyavabhāsamāne'rthe, tadavabhāso'pi satyatvena durnirūpaḥ ; kiṃ tvavabhāsamātraṃ satyaṃ syāt ; tadavabhāsa ityapi bhrāntireva ; tasyaivābhāvāt ; na kevalamarthaḥ, api tvarthābhāso'pītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tat ca avidyā atas satī eva sā katham anirvacanīya tā iti codayati syāt etat iti siddhāntī tu āha na etat iti asati avabhāsamāna irthe tad avabhāsaḥ api satya tvena durnirūpaḥ kim tu avabhāsa mātram satyam syāt tad avabhāsaḥ iti api bhrāntiḥ eva tasya eva abhāvāt na kevalam arthaḥ api tu artha ābhāsaḥ api iti arthaḥ

original: etaduktaṃ syāt—arthānubandharahitamanubhavamātraṃ no nityaṃ sadeva ; tasya ca bhrāntenārthānubandhenāvidyātvam, na svataḥ ; asatyārthānubandharūpeṇa na satīti svataḥ satyapi ‘na satī’ ityucyata iti | evamanirvacanīyatvamākṣiptaṃ samādhāya punarupasaṃharati—tasmāditi | tadeva draṣṭayati—ata iti |
analyzed: etat uktam syāt artha anubandha rahitam anubhava mātram no nityam sat eva tasya ca bhrāntena artha anubandhena avidyā tvam na svatas asatya artha anubandha rūpeṇa na satī iti svatas satī api na satī iti ucyate iti evam anirvacanīya tvam ākṣiptam samādhāya punar upasaṃharati tasmāt iti tat eva draṣṭayati atas iti

original: kuta ityāha— svabhāvāhānāditi ! yadyavidyā satsvabhāvā syāt, na svabhāvaṃ jahyādagnirivīṣṇyam | na ca tathābhūtasyānyathābhāvaḥ ; anyathābhūtasya cānyathābhāve'navasthā syāt ; ato na bādhakajñānenānyathākriyeta | athāsatī, tataḥ svata eva niścatatvānna tena nivartyetetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: kutas iti āha svabhāva āhānāt iti yadi avidyā sat svabhāvā syāt na svabhāvam jahyāt agniḥ iva iṣṇyam na ca tathābhūtasya anyathābhāvaḥ anyathābhūtasya ca anyathābhāvena avasthā syāt atas na bādhaka jñānena anyathākriyeta atha asatī tatas svatas eva niścata tvāt na tena nivartyeta iti arthaḥ

original: evamanirvacanīyatvamavidyāyāḥ pratiṣṭhāpya ‘satye dvaitāpattiḥ, asatye brahmasvabhāvatve ca nivartanīyābhāvaḥ’ iti paroktaṃ doṣadvayaṃ pariharati—evamiti | idānīṃ kasyāvidyeti yaduktaṃ tadanubhāṣya tatrottaramāha—yatviti | atra paraśrodayati—nanviti | brahmaṇaśra nāvidyā, vidyāsvabhāvatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: evam anirvacanīya tvam avidyāyāḥ pratiṣṭhāpya satye dvaita āpattiḥ asatye brahma svabhāva tve ca nivartanīya abhāvaḥ iti para uktam doṣa dvayam pariharati evam iti idānīm kasya avidyā iti yat uktam tat anubhāṣya tatra uttaram āha yatu iti atra na avidyā vidyā svabhāva tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: P 10-4. kuta ityāha—evaṃ hīti| ‘jīvenātmanā’ ityātmaśabdena brahmavacinā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ śrūyate; na ca tayorbhede ghaṭapaṭayoriva tat syāditi bhāvaḥ | tathā “kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi” ityādivirodhaḥ, dvaitāpattiśca tayorbhede syādityūhanīyam | siddhāntavādī tvāha—satyamiti; na bhidyata ityanuvartate | kathaṃ nāma bhidyata ityāha—kalpanayeti;
analyzed: kutas iti āha evam hi iti jīvena ātmanā iti ātma śabdena brahma vacinā sāmānādhikaraṇyam śrūyate na ca tayoḥ bhede ghaṭa paṭayoḥ iva tat syāt iti bhāvaḥ tathā kṣetrajñam ca api mām viddhi ityādi virodhaḥ dvaita āpattiḥ ca tayoḥ bhede syāt iti ūhanīyam siddhānta vādī tu āha satyam iti na bhidyate iti anuvartate katham nāma bhidyate ityāha kalpanayā iti

original: ayathārthabuddherityarthaḥ | paramārthenābhinnā api brahmaṇo jīvāḥ kalpanayā mithyābuddhyo vimbaprativimbavaccandravacca tato bhidyante; evaṃ ca bhedamātramatra kālpanikam, na jīvavastvevetyuktaṃ bhavati | ata eva “taccamasi” iti bheda eva bādhyate, na tu ‘taccamasi’ iti jīva iti | punaśrodayati—kasyeti | kasya kalpanā jīvaparayorbhediketyarthaḥ |
analyzed: ayathārtha buddheḥ iti arthaḥ paramārthena abhinnāḥ api brahmaṇaḥ jīvāḥ kalpanayā mithyā buddhyaḥ vimba prativimba vat candra vat ca tatas bhidyante evam ca bheda mātram atra kālpanikam na jīva vastu eva iti uktam bhavati atas eva tat camasi iti bhedaḥ eva bādhyate na tu tat camasi iti jīvaḥ iti punar śrī udayati kasya iti kasya kalpanā jīva parayoḥ bhedikā iti arthaḥ

original: tatra matabhedena parihāradvayaṃ vivakṣurekaṃ tāvadāha— atreti | yadyavidyā nāma vastu syāt tato nāsiddhā jīvavastusiddhaye'lam, jīvaṃ ca vinā na tatsiddhiḥ itītaretarāśrayadoṣaḥ syāt; māyāmātraṃ tu sā; ato na doṣa ityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha—na hīti | kuta ityāha— anupapannārthaiva hīti | anupapannaviṣayaiva sā māyā;
analyzed: tatra mata bhedena parihāra dvayam vivakṣuḥ ekam tāvat āha atra iti yadi avidyā nāma vastu syāt tatas na asiddhā jīva vastu siddhayā ilam jīvam ca vinā na tad siddhiḥ iti itaretarāśraya doṣaḥ syāt māyā mātram tu sā atas na doṣaḥ iti arthaḥ kutas ityāha na hi iti kutas ityāha anupapanna arthā eva hi iti anupapanna viṣayā eva sā māyā

original: upapannārthatve tu tasyā yathārthatvāt svarūpahānireva syāt; ato'nupapannārthatvaṃ tasyā bhūṣaṇam, na tu dūṣaṇamityarthaḥ | parihārāntaramāha—anye tviti | ahaṃkārādikalpanādatastadavacchinnastadguṇasāro ghaṭākāśa iva jīvaḥ, tatastatkalpaneti bījāṅkuravadanāditvaṃ mantavyam | kāraṇavidyā tvanādiḥ |
analyzed: upapanna artha tve tu tasyāḥ yathārtha tvāt svarūpa hāniḥ eva syāt atas anupapanna artha tvam tasyāḥ bhūṣaṇam na tu dūṣaṇam iti arthaḥ parihāra antaram āha anye tu iti ahaṃkāra ādi kalpanāt atas tad avacchinnaḥ tad guṇa sāraḥ ghaṭa ākāśe iva jīvaḥ tatas tad kalpanā iti bīja aṅkura vat anādi tvam mantavyam kāraṇa vidyā tu anādiḥ

original: anāditvameva svayūthayoktyā draḍhayati—tathā ceti | avidyā upādānakāraṇaṃ yasya bhedaprapañcasya tadvādibhirityarthaḥ | tatrānāditvasya phalamāha—tutreti | tathā prasaṅgoktasyāprayojanatvasya phalamāha—aprayojanatvānneti; ‘bhidyamānasya prapañcasya sṛṣṭau kiṃ prayojanam?’ iti yaḥ paryanuyogaḥ tasyāvakāśo na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: anādi tvam eva sva yūthayā uktyā draḍhayati tathā ca iti avidyā upādāna kāraṇam yasya bheda prapañcasya tad vādibhiḥ iti arthaḥ tatra anādi tvasya phalam āha tutra iti tathā prasaṅga uktasya aprayojana tvasya phalam āha aprayojana tvāt na iti bhidyamānasya prapañcasya sṛṣṭau kim prayojanam iti yaḥ paryanuyogaḥ tasya avakāśaḥ na bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: tatra paryanuyogaṃ tāvadāha—yadeka iti | yadyapi sṛṣṭeḥ prāgapyanugrāhyāḥ sabījāvasthā jīvāḥ santi, anyathā punaḥ sṛṣṭyabhāvaprasaṅgāt; tathāpyupādhilaye brahmaṇi līnā iveti yathādṛṣṭapṛthagbhūtānugrāhyābhāvauktaḥ | itaśca na parānugrahaḥ prayājenamityāha—duḥkhottaratvācceti | anugrahāddhi mukhinameva sṛjet, na duḥkhinam;
analyzed: tatra paryanuyogam tāvat āha yat ekaḥ iti yadi api sṛṣṭeḥ prāk api anugrāhyāḥ sabīja avasthāḥ jīvāḥ santi anyathā punar sṛṣṭi abhāva prasaṅgāt tathā api upādhi laye brahmaṇi līnāḥ iva iti yathā dṛṣṭa pṛthak bhūta anugrāhya abhāva uktaḥ itas ca na para anugrahaḥ iti āha duḥkha uttara tvāt ca iti anugrahāt hi mukhinam eva sṛjet na duḥkhinam

original: duḥkhabahulā ca sṛṣṭirityarthaḥ ; taduktam—“sṛjecca śubhamevaikamanukampāprayojitaḥ” iti | na ca svopayogi kiñcitprayojanamastītyāha—neti | P. 10-18 āptakāmatvāditi ; “āptakāmaḥ ātmakāmaḥ” iti śruterāptāśeṣakāmyatvena kṛtārthatvādityarthaḥ | taduktam—“krīḍārthāyāṃ pravṛttau ca vihanyeta kṛtārthatā” iti | krīḍādirityādiśabdena kutūhalamucyate |
analyzed: duḥkha bahulā ca sṛṣṭiḥ iti arthaḥ tat uktam sṛjet ca śubham eva ekam anukampā prayojitaḥ iti na ca sva upayogi kiñcid prayojanam asti iti āha na iti āpta kāma tvāt iti āpta kāmaḥ ātma kāmaḥ iti śruteḥ āpta aśeṣa kāmya tvena kṛtārtha tvāt iti arthaḥ tat uktam krīḍā arthāyām pravṛttau ca vihanyeta kṛtārtha tā iti krīḍā ādiḥ iti ādi śabdena kutūhalam ucyate

original: evaṃ paryanuyogamuktvā tasyānavakāśatvamāha—tasyeti | kuta ityāha—na hīti | tadeva laukikadṛṣṭāntairdravyati—neti | prakṛtivikārapakṣokto'pi doṣo nāsmatpakṣamāskandatītyāha—tatheti ; vimalasyāpi vyomnastalamalinādibhramadarśanāditi bhāvaḥ | avidyākṛtā sṛṣṭiraprayojanetyuktam ;
analyzed: evam paryanuyogam uktvā tasya anavakāśa tvam āha tasya iti kutas ityāha na hi iti tat eva laukika dṛṣṭāntaiḥ dravyatinā iti prakṛti vikāra pakṣa uktaḥ api doṣaḥ na asmad pakṣam āskandati iti āha tathā iti vimalasya api vyomnaḥ tala malina ādi bhrama darśanāt iti bhāvaḥ avidyā kṛtā sṛṣṭiḥ aprayojanā iti uktam

original: idānīmabhyupagamyaiva krīḍārthā pravṛttiṃ pūrvoktadoṣābhāvamāha—api ceti | krīḍārthapravṛttiḥ ; krīḍā bhavatītyadhyāhāryam | ucchāsāditi ; protsāhādityarthaḥ | prārthaneti ; kāmaprārthanāvatā kṛtārthapravṛttireva krīḍocyate, na kāryārtheti bhāvaḥ | nanu sukhiduḥkhidṛṣṭe rāgadveṣahetutvena draṣṭṛtvādīśvarasya tadvatvena vaiṣamyaṃ syāt ;
analyzed: idānīm abhyupagamya eva krīḍā arthā pravṛttim pūrva ukta doṣa abhāvam āha api ca iti krīḍā artha pravṛttiḥ krīḍā bhavati iti adhyāhāryam ucchāsāt iti protsāhāt iti arthaḥ prārthanā iti kāma prārthanāvatā kṛtārtha pravṛttiḥ eva krīḍā ucyate na kārya arthā iti bhāvaḥ nanu sukhi duḥkhi dṛṣṭe rāga dveṣa hetu tvena draṣṭṛ tvāt īśvarasya tadvatvena vaiṣamyam syāt

original: tathā duḥkhinaḥ sṛjato nairvṛṇyaṃ ca syādityata āha—na ceti | kuta ityāha—na hīti | māyāṃ karotīti māyākaraḥ śāmbarikaḥ, tasya saṃpūrṇamasaṃpūrṇāṅgaṃ ca rudrādiprapañcaṃ darśayato yathā na rāgadveṣau tatheti svapakṣe dṛṣṭāntaḥ | satyaprapañcavādipakṣe'pi tamāha—citreti | pustaṃ lekhyam ; ‘kṛtām’ iti kṛtraḥ kiṃvantāt ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanam |
analyzed: tathā duḥkhinaḥ sṛjataḥ nairvṛṇyam ca syāt iti atas āha na ca iti kutas ityāha na hi iti māyām karoti iti māyākaraḥ śāmbarikaḥ tasya saṃpūrṇam asaṃpūrṇa aṅgam ca rudra ādi prapañcam darśayataḥ yathā na rāga dveṣau tathā iti sva pakṣe dṛṣṭāntaḥ satya prapañca vādi pakṣe api tam āha citra iti pustam lekhyam kṛtām iti kṛtraḥ kiṃvantāt ṣaṣṭhī bahuvacanam

original: vikalāvikalatvamasaṃpūrṇasaṃpūrṇāṅgatvam | citrāṇītyupalakṣaṇam, lekhyamāpaṃ draṣṭavyam | pratikṛtiḥ pratirūpakam | parihārāntaramāha—karmeti | parjanyasthānīyo hīśvaraḥ sādhāraṇaṃ kāraṇam | sukhiduḥkhibhedastu svakarmabhedāddhījabhedādivāṅkurabhedaḥ | tasmānna tasya vaiṣamyādidoṣa ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: vikala avikala tvam asaṃpūrṇa saṃpūrṇa aṅga tvam citrāṇi iti upalakṣaṇam lekhyam āpam draṣṭavyam pratikṛtiḥ pratirūpakam parihāra antaram āha karma iti parjanya sthānīyaḥ hi īśvaraḥ sādhāraṇam kāraṇam sukhi duḥkhi bhedaḥ tu sva karma bhedāt dhī ja bhedāt iva aṅkura bhedaḥ tasmāt na tasya vaiṣamya ādi doṣaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanveva karmāśayaṃpāratanvyāt svātantryalakṣaṇamaiśvaryaṃ na syādityata āha—na ceti | etaduktaṃ bhavati— nānyāpekṣitvamātreṇānīśvaratvaṃ syāt ; na hi loke sevāviśeṣāpekṣaḥ phalaṃ prayacchan prabhuraprabhuḥ ; āśraya tadapekṣo'pi yathā phalaṃ dātuṃ prabhavatīti sa prabhuḥ, netaraḥ ;
analyzed: nanu eva karma āśayam pāratanvyāt svātantrya lakṣaṇam aiśvaryam na syāt iti atas āha na ca iti etat uktam bhavati na anya apekṣi tva mātreṇa anīśvara tvam syāt na hi loke sevā viśeṣa apekṣaḥ phalam prayacchan prabhuḥ aprabhuḥ āśraya tad apekṣaḥ api yathā phalam dātum prabhavati iti sa prabhuḥ na itaraḥ

original: tathā karmāpekṣo'pi sa eva phalaṃ dātumīṣṭe netara iti tasyaiveśvaratvamiti | “puruṣasya ca śuddhasya nāśuddhā vikṛtiḥ” iti cādyaṃ 3
analyzed: tathā karma apekṣaḥ api saḥ eva phalam dātum īṣṭe na itaraḥ iti tasya eva īśvara tvam iti puruṣasya ca śuddhasya na aśuddhā vikṛtiḥ iti ca ādyam

original: māyikīṃ sṛṣṭimāśritya vikārapakṣānabhyupagamena pūrvaṃ parihatam; adhunā tadabhyupagame'pi naiṣa doṣaḥ, kimutāsmākaṃ māyāvādināmityabhiprāyeṇāha— P. 11-6. tatheti | prakṛtivikārayoratyantamavailakṣaṇye prakṛtimātravat prakṛtivikārabhāvabhedo na syāt; ato'sti tayorvailakṣaṇyam; evaṃ ca śuddhādapyaśuddhāvikṛtirbhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: māyikīm sṛṣṭim āśritya vikāra pakṣa anabhyupagamena pūrvam parihatam adhunā tad abhyupagame api na eṣa doṣaḥ kim uta asmākam māyā vādinām iti abhiprāyeṇa āha tathā iti prakṛti vikārayoḥ atyantam availakṣaṇye prakṛti mātra vat prakṛti vikāra bhāva bhedaḥ na syāt atas asti tayoḥ vailakṣaṇyam evam ca śuddhāt api aśuddha avikṛtiḥ bhaviṣyati iti arthaḥ

original: dṛṣṭaṃ cānyatrāpi prakṛtivikārayorvailakṣaṇyam, tadvadihāpi syādityabhiprāyeṇāha—dravāṇamiti | acetanacetanau cetanānadhiṣṭhitādhiṣṭhitau draṣṭavyau | idānīmadvaitimate punaśrodayati—nanviti | viśuddhasvabhāvāḥ; vimalavidyāsvabhāvā ityarthaḥ | siddhāntī tu śuddhādabhinnamapyaśuddhaṃ bhātyeveti darśayannāha—vārtamiti; asāramityarthaḥ;
analyzed: dṛṣṭam ca anyatra api prakṛti vikārayoḥ vailakṣaṇyam tadvat iha api syāt iti abhiprāyeṇa āha dravāṇam iti acetana cetanau cetana anadhiṣṭhita adhiṣṭhitau draṣṭavyau idānīm advaiti mate punar środayati nanu iti viśuddha svabhāvāḥ vimala vidyā svabhāvāḥ iti arthaḥ siddhāntī tu śuddhāt abhinnam api aśuddham bhāti eva iti darśayan āha vārtam iti asāram iti arthaḥ

original: vārtātaāgataṃ vārtam; niṣpramāṇakamityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha—na tāvaditi | kathaṃ punarvimbātpratibimbaṃ na bhinnam? sāvayavasyāvayavasaṃyogamantareṇānupapatteḥ | na na tasyāvayavā dṛśyante | na ca kalpyā, anyathāpi tatpratipatyupapatteḥ | sāvayavasya ca nirantare darpaṇe sthityanupapatteḥ; bimbarūpapratyabhijñānācca; sparśanena cānupalabdheḥ;
analyzed: vārtāta āgatam vārtam niṣpramāṇakam iti arthaḥ kutas ityāha na tāvat iti katham punar vimbāt pratibimbam na bhinnam sa avayavasya avayava saṃyogam antareṇa anupapatteḥ na na tasya avayavāḥ dṛśyante na ca kalpyāḥ anyathā api tad pratipati upapatteḥ sāvayavasya ca nirantare darpaṇe sthiti anupapatteḥ bimba rūpa pratyabhijñānāt ca sparśanena ca anupalabdheḥ

original: sāvayavasya avayavatatsaṃyoganāśamantareṇānāśāt; asya ca bimbasaṃnidhimātreṇābhāsāt; tasmādvimbameva bhrāntyā bhinnaṃ bhātīti sthitam | nanu śuddhādabhinnasyāśuddhistaccato na ghaṭate; pratibimbe tu bhrāntiḥ setyāśaṅkya ihāpi bhrāntirityāha—vibhrama iti | bhrāntitvameva draḍhayati—anyatheti |
analyzed: sāvayavasya avayava tad saṃyoga nāśam antareṇa anāśāt asya ca bimba saṃnidhi mātreṇa ābhāsāt tasmāt vimbam eva bhrāntyā bhinnam bhāti iti sthitam nanu śuddhāt abhinnasya aśuddhiḥ tat catas na ghaṭate pratibimbe tu bhrāntiḥ sā iti āśaṅkya iha api bhrāntiḥ iti āha vibhramaḥ iti bhrānti tvam eva draḍhayati anyathā iti

original: taccatastu jīvānāmaśuddhasvabhāvatve śuddhirna syāditi 'svabhāvāhānāt' ityatroktamityarthaḥ | atra punaśrodayati—syāditi | aikātmyavādinastaddhyatiriktaāgantuko heturnāstīti bhāvaḥ | siddhāntī tvāha—kimatrāgantukenānyena hetunā? āgantuke hi pratibimbādibhrame so'pekṣyeta; anādistvayaṃ jīvabhramaḥ;
analyzed: tat catas tu jīvānām aśuddha svabhāva tve śuddhiḥ na syāt iti svabhāva āhānāt iti atra uktam iti arthaḥ atra punar środayati syāt iti aikātmya vādinaḥ tat hi atirikta āgantukaḥ hetuḥ na asti iti bhāvaḥ siddhāntī tu āha kim atra āgantukena anyena hetunā āgantuke hi pratibimba ādi bhrame saḥ upekṣyeta anādiḥ tu ayam jīva bhramaḥ

original: ataścānādestaccāgrahaṇādevopapatterāgantukabāhyahetvanveṣaṇamayuktapityabhiprāyeṇāha—anādāviti | anāditvāccāvidyāpravṛttihetvabhāvacodyamapi parihatamityāha—tathā ceti | atra codayati—nanviti | hetucchedāddhi hetu maducchedo dṛṣṭaḥ; avidyā tvanāditvāt svābhāvikīti nirhetuḥ; ataḥ kathamucchidyetetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: atas ca anādeḥ tat ca agrahaṇāt eva upapatteḥ āgantuka bāhya hetu anveṣaṇam ayukta iti abhiprāyeṇa āha anādau iti anādi tvāt ca avidyā pravṛtti hetu abhāva codyam api parihatam iti āha tathā ca iti atra codayati nanu iti hetu chedāt hi hetu mad ucchedaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ avidyā tu anādi tvāt svābhāvikī iti nirhetuḥ atas katham ucchidyeta iti arthaḥ

original: siddhāntī tu svābhāvikyapyucchidyate tāvadavidyā; anyathā
analyzed: siddhāntī tu svābhāvikī api ucchidyate tāvat avidyā anyathā

original: tanniṣṭanyarthāni śāstrāṇi vyarthāni syurityamiprāyeṇāha—sarveti | dṛśyate ca P.11-17. svābhāvikasyāpyuccheda ityāha—api ceti | parastu śyāmatādivaiṣamyamāpādayan codayati—nanviti | pratyayaḥ ; heturityarthaḥ | na vidyate āgantuko dvitīyo'rtho yasya sa tathoktaḥ | tadbhāvāt ; vilakṣaṇapratyayopanipātābhāvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tad niṣṭanyarthāni śāstrāṇi vyarthāni syuḥ iti amiprāyeṇa āha sarva iti dṛśyate ca svābhāvikasya api ucchedaḥ iti āha api ca iti paraḥ tu śyāma tā ādi vaiṣamyam āpādayan codayati nanu iti pratyayaḥ hetuḥ iti arthaḥ na vidyate āgantukaḥ dvitīyaḥ ṛthaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ tad bhāvāt vilakṣaṇa pratyaya upanipāta abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: kuto niṣṭhattiḥ ? avidyāyā ityadhyāhāryam | nanu mā mṛdāgantuko hetuḥ ; ātmano vidyātmakatvāt tatsamāvabhūtaiva vidyā avidyāṃ nivartayiṣyatītyata āha—na khalviti | vidyāvidye cedakatrātmanīcchāsi, tatastayoḥ svabhāvāvasthānādavirodhe na nivartyanivartakabhāvaḥ ;
analyzed: kutas niṣṭhattiḥ avidyāyāḥ iti adhyāhāryam nanu mā mṛd āgantukaḥ hetuḥ ātmanaḥ vidyā ātmaka tvāt tad samāva bhūtā eva vidyā avidyām nivartayiṣyati iti atas āha na khalu iti vidyā avidye ced akatra ātmani icchā asi tatas tayoḥ svabhāva avasthānāt avirodhe na nivartya nivartaka bhāvaḥ

original: virodhe vā vidyayātmanyavidyā nityanirasteti tannibandhanatvābhāvānnityamuktaṃ jagat syādityarthaḥ | avidyāyā iti kākākṣivadubhayatra saṃbadhyate | tayeti ; vidyayetyarthaḥ | śravaṇādijanyamāgantukaṃ vidyāntaramavidyāṃ nivartayiṣyatīti cedata āha na ceti | āgantukasyāpi vidyāntarasya brahmasvabhāvatvāt naikātmyahāniriti cedata āha—āgantuketi |
analyzed: virodhe vā vidyayā ātmani avidyā nitya nirastā iti tad nibandhana tva abhāvāt nityam uktam jagat syāt iti arthaḥ avidyāyāḥ iti kāka akṣi vat ubhayatra saṃbadhyate tayā iti vidyayā iti arthaḥ śravaṇa ādi janyam āgantukam vidyā antaram avidyām nivartayiṣyati iti ced atas āha na ca iti āgantukasya api vidyā antarasya brahma svabhāva tvāt na aikātmya hāniḥ iti ced atas āha āgantuka iti

original: nānityasya nityasvabhāvatvaṃ ghaṭata ityarthaḥ | atraivārthaṃ paroktaṃ paṭhati—taduktamiti | atra siddhāntamāha—atreti | pratibimbadṛṣṭāntenoktamityarthaḥ | kasmānna brahmaṇa ityāha—tadbhīti | avidyānivartaka āgantuko'rtho'sya nāstītyarthaḥ | yadvā anāgantukārthamanādheyātiśayamityarthaḥ | tatra nityaprakāśatvena svābhāvikyavidyā nāstītyuktam ;
analyzed: na anityasya nitya svabhāva tvam ghaṭate iti arthaḥ atra eva artham para uktam paṭhati tat uktam iti atra siddhāntam āha atra iti pratibimba dṛṣṭāntena uktam iti arthaḥ kasmāt na brahmaṇaḥ iti āha tad bhī iti avidyā nivartakaḥ āgantukaḥ ūrthaḥ asya na asti iti arthaḥ yat vā anāgantuka artham anādheya atiśayam iti arthaḥ tatra nitya prakāśa tvena svābhāvikī avidyā na asti iti uktam

original: atrānāgantukārthatvena cāgantukyapi sā nāstītyuktamiti vivekaḥ | vidyāsvabhāve brahmaṇyavidyākalluṣitatvaṃ nāstītyuktam ; yadi ca syāttato mahān doṣaḥ syādityāha—anyatheti | brahmabhūyaṃ gatasyeti ; brahmabhāvaṃ prāptasyetyarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityata āha—tatreti | brahmaiva saṃsarati mucyate ca, na jīvā iti ca teṣāṃ matam ;
analyzed: atra anāgantuka artha tvena ca āgantukī api sā na asti iti uktam iti vivekaḥ vidyā svabhāve brahmaṇi avidyā kalluṣita tvam na asti iti uktam yadi ca syāt tatas mahān doṣaḥ syāt iti āha anyathā iti brahma bhūyam gatasya iti brahma bhāvam prāptasya iti arthaḥ tatas kim iti atas āha tatra iti brahma eva saṃsarati mucyate ca na jīvāḥ iti ca teṣām matam

original: tadanubhāṣya dūṣayati—arthāt | brahmaiva ; na jīvā ityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha—yata iti | abhedadarśanādbrahmaṇi mukte, anyasya bhedadraṣṭurbaddhasyābhāvātsarvabhedapratyastamaye yugapat sarvamokṣaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | svapakṣamupasaṃharati—tasmāditi | nanvastu jīvānāmavidyā ;
analyzed: tat anubhāṣya dūṣayati arthāt brahma eva na jīvāḥ iti arthaḥ kutas iti āha yatas iti abheda darśanāt brahmaṇi mukte anyasya bheda draṣṭuḥ baddhasya abhāvāt sarva bheda prati astamaye yugapad sarva mokṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti arthaḥ sva pakṣam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti nanu astu jīvānām avidyā

original: tathāpyaikātmye vilakṣaṇahetvabhāvāt kathamavidyānivṛttiriti pūrvoktamāśaṅkya pariharati—teṣāmiti | vilakṣaṇasatyahetvabhāve'pi jīvānā 35
analyzed: tathā api aikātmye vilakṣaṇa hetu abhāvāt katham avidyā nivṛttiḥ iti pūrva uktam āśaṅkya pariharati teṣām iti vilakṣaṇa satya hetu abhāve pi jīvānām

original: mavidyākaluṣāṇāmavidyākalpitaśravaṇādilakṣaṇahetukavidyodayādavidyānivṛttirdhaṭata ityarthaḥ | vilakṣaṇaḥ pratyayaḥ kāraṇaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ, vilakṣaṇapratyayaśrāsau vidyodayaśreti karmadhārayaḥ; vilakṣaṇaśrāsau pratyayavidyodayaśreti vā | P. 12-8.
analyzed: mavidyā kaluṣāṇām avidyā kalpita śravaṇa ādi lakṣaṇa hetuka vidyā udayāt avidyā nivṛttiḥ dhaṭate iti arthaḥ vilakṣaṇaḥ pratyayaḥ kāraṇam yasya sa tathā uktaḥ vilakṣaṇa pratyaya śrāsau vidyā udaya śrā iti karmadhārayaḥ vilakṣaṇa śrāsau pratyaya vidyā udaya śrā iti vā

original: nanu jīvānāmapi vidyā naitīrgaveyasti, ataḥ saivāvidyānivartikā, nāgantukī vilakṣaṇetyata āha—na hīti | avidyāmaya eva jīva ityucyata ityarthaḥ | nanu vidyātsabhāvād brahmaṇo jīvānāmabhedāt katha mavidyāmayatvamityata āha—avyatireke'pīti |
analyzed: nanu jīvānām api vidyā atas sā eva avidyā nivartikā nāgantukī vilakṣaṇā iti atas āha na hi iti avidyā mayaḥ eva jīvaḥ iti ucyate iti arthaḥ nanu vidyāt sabhāvāt brahmaṇaḥ jīvānām abhedāt katham avidyā maya tvam iti atas āha avyatireke pi iti

original: yathā bimbaṃ mukhādyavadātaṃ tatpratibimbaṃ ca kṛpāṇādāvanavadātamevaṃ brahmaṇo vidyātmatve'pi jīvānāmavidyeti vyavasthetyarthaḥ | nanu na tāvadbrahmavidyānivartakam, nityanivṛttiprasaṅgāt; na cāvidyāntaram, avidyātvāviśeṣeṇāpratiyogitvāt; nivartakānivṛttiprasaṅgācca, nivartakāntarakalpanāyāṃ cānavatthānāt;
analyzed: yathā bimbam mukha ādi avadātam tad pratibimbam ca kṛpāṇa ādau anavadātam evam brahmaṇaḥ vidyā ātma tve pi jīvānām avidyā iti vyavasthā iti arthaḥ nanu na tāvat brahma vidyā nivartakam nitya nivṛtti prasaṅgāt na ca avidyā antaram avidyā tva aviśeṣeṇa apratiyogi tvāt nivartaka anivṛtti prasaṅgāt ca nivartaka antara kalpanāyām ca anavatthānāt

original: na ca brahmāvidyābhyāmanyannivartakaṃ travāstītyabhiprāyeṇa pṛcchati—keneti | siddhāntī tu rajastvāviśeṣe'pi yathā katakarajo rajo'ntarapratiyogi tannivartakaṃ ca bhavati tathā avidyātvāviśeṣe'pi śravaṇādyavidyā prapañcāvidyāyāḥ pratiyoginī niva rtikā ca bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyeṇāha—śravaṇeti |
analyzed: na ca brahma avidyābhyām anyat nivartakam ca asti iti abhiprāyeṇa pṛcchati kena iti siddhāntī tu rajaḥ tva aviśeṣe pi yathā kataka rajaḥ rajaḥ ntara pratiyogi tat nivartakam ca bhavati tathā avidyā tva aviśeṣe pi śravaṇa ādi avidyā prapañca avidyāyāḥ pratiyoginī nivartikā ca bhaviṣyati iti abhiprāyeṇa āha śravaṇa iti

original: tatra śravaṇamananayoḥ śābdavidyātpattikrameṇa, brahmacaryādeśca kalpamakṣayakrameṇa, dhyānādeścādvyātmaprakāśābhivyaktikrameṇāvidyānivṛttyupāyatvamiti vivekaḥ | śravaṇaṃ vedāntasya, mananaṃ tarkeṇa tadarthānusandhānam, dhyānābhyāsastadarthānucintanāvṛttiḥ |
analyzed: tatra śravaṇa mananayoḥ śābdavidya utpatti krameṇa brahmacarya ādeḥ ca kalpam akṣaya krameṇa dhyāna ādeḥ ca advi ātma prakāśa abhivyakti krameṇa avidyā nivṛtti upāya tvam iti vivekaḥ śravaṇam vedāntasya mananam tarkeṇa tad artha anusandhānam dhyāna abhyāsaḥ tad artha anucintana āvṛttiḥ

original: paraśca tulyajātīyasya śravaṇādeḥ pratiyogitvāsaṃbhavābhiprāyeṇa punaḥ pṛcchani— kathamiti | siddhāntī tu kimatra vaktavyam? avidyātvāviśeṣe'pi śravaṇamananapūrvako na karṇamūlopadeśapūrvako yo'yaṃ “sa eṣa neti neti” iti vīpsayā pratiṣiddhākhilabhidyamānaprapañce dhyānābhyāsaḥ so'ta eva prapañcadarśana pratiyogī;
analyzed: paraḥ ca tulya jātīyasya śravaṇa ādeḥ pratiyogitva asaṃbhava abhiprāyeṇa punar katham iti siddhāntī tu kim atra vaktavyam avidyā tva aviśeṣe pi śravaṇa manana pūrvakaḥ na karṇa mūla upadeśa pūrvakaḥ yaḥ yam saḥ eṣa na iti na iti iti vīpsayā pratiṣiddha akhila bhidyamāna prapañce dhyāna abhyāsaḥ saḥ utaḥ eva prapañca darśana pratiyogī

original: atastannivartayatītyāha—yo'yamiti | pratiṣiddho'khilabhedaprapañco yasmin sa tathoktaḥ | dehādīnāmātmatvapratiṣedho'yam, nākhilaprapañcapratiṣedha iti cet, na; dehāderaśrutatvādaśrutakalpanāpramāṇābhāvācca | tasmātpratiṣedhyāpekṣāyāmagṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvādakhilaprapañcapratiṣedha evāyamiti sūktam—pratiṣiddhākhilabhedaprapañca iti |
analyzed: atas tat nivartayati iti āha yaḥ yam iti pratiṣiddha ukhila bheda prapañcaḥ yasmin sa tathā uktaḥ deha ādīnām ātmatva pratiṣedhaḥ yam na akhila prapañca pratiṣedhaḥ iti ced na deha ādeḥ aśruta tvāt aśruta kalpanā pramāṇa abhāvāt ca tasmāt pratiṣedhya apekṣāyām agṛhyamāṇa viśeṣa tvāt akhila prapañca pratiṣedhaḥ eva ayam iti sūktam pratiṣiddha akhila bheda prapañcaḥ iti

analyzed: nanu evam api śravaṇa ādeḥ bheda darśana nivartakasya nivartakā

original: ntarānupapatteranivṛttāvanirmokṣaprasaṅga iti parābhiprāyamāśaṅkya pariharāti—sa 1.12-14 ceti | sāmānyeneti ; aviśeṣeṇetyarthaḥ | ‘maḥ’ iti śravaṇādipūrvo dhyānābhyāsaḥ parāmṛśyate | etadevānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ prapañcayati—na hīti | yadi śrotṛśravaṇādibhedaṃ vihāya bhedāntarapravilāpakāḥ śravaṇādayaḥ syuḥ, tataḥ syādeṣa doṣaḥ ;
analyzed: ntara anupapatteḥ anivṛttau anirmokṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti para abhiprāyam āśaṅkya pariharāti sa ca iti sāmānyena iti aviśeṣeṇa iti arthaḥ maḥ iti śravaṇa ādi pūrvaḥ dhyāna abhyāsaḥ parāmṛśyate etat eva anvaya vyatirekābhyām prapañcayati na hi iti yadi śrotṛ śravaṇa ādi bhedam vihāya bheda antara pravilāpakāḥ śravaṇa ādayaḥ syuḥ tatas syāt eṣa doṣaḥ

original: te viśeṣeṇa sarvabhedān pravilāpayantastadantargatatvādātmānamapi pravilāpayanti ; tataśca na teṣāmanivṛttiḥ ; nāpi nivartakāntarāpekṣeti bhāvaḥ ; tataśca nānirmokṣadoṣa ityāha—tathā ceti | svaccha iti svabhāvanirmalatvamāha | pariśuddha iti ; apagatāgantukāvidyākāluṣya ityarthaḥ | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—yatheti ;
analyzed: te viśeṣeṇa sarva bhedān pravilāpayantaḥ tad antargata tvāt ātmānam api pravilāpayanti tatas ca na teṣām anivṛttiḥ na api nivartaka antara apekṣā iti bhāvaḥ tatas ca na anirmokṣa doṣaḥ iti āha tathā ca iti svacchaḥ iti svabhāva nirmala tvam āha pariśuddhaḥ iti apagata āgantuka avidyā kāluṣyaḥ iti arthaḥ atra dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā iti

original: yathā dravyaviśeṣasya katakādeścūrṇarūpaṃ rajaḥ kartṛ trākṣiptaṃ sat rajo'ntarāṇi saṃharat svayaṃ ca saṃhiyamāṇaṃ rajaḥ saṃparkakaluṣamudakaṃ karmamūtaṃ svarūpāvasthāṃ nayatītyarthaḥ | dṛṣṭāntamuktvā dārṣṭāntike'pi yojayati—evamiti |
analyzed: yathā dravya viśeṣasya kataka ādeḥ cūrṇa rūpam rajaḥ kartṛ ākṣiptam sat rajaḥ antarāṇi saṃharat svayam ca saṃhiyamāṇam rajaḥ saṃparka kaluṣam udakam svarūpa avasthām nayati iti arthaḥ dṛṣṭāntam uktvā dārṣṭāntike api yojayati evam iti

original: bhedadarśanatvena viśeṣābhāvāt tadvat śravaṇādigate ca bhede pravilīyamāne jīvaḥ svacche svarūpe'vatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ | nanu brahmaṇo vibhakto jīvo'vidyāvilaye svarūpastho'pi tathaivāvatiṣṭhate ; ato na brahmībhāvo'sya syāt ; śrūyate cāsau—“brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati” ityāśaṅkyāha —avidyayeti |
analyzed: bheda darśana tvena viśeṣa abhāvāt tadvat śravaṇa ādi gate ca bhede pravilīyamāne jīvaḥ svacche sva rūpa iva tiṣṭhate iti arthaḥ nanu brahmaṇaḥ vibhaktaḥ jīvaḥ vidyā vilaye sva rūpa sthaḥ api tathā eva avatiṣṭhate atas na brahmībhāvaḥ syāt śrūyate ca asau brahma veda brahmā eva bhavati iti āśaṅkya āha avidyayā iti

original: yadi brahmaṇo jīvastaccato bhinnaḥ syāt tataḥ syādevam ; kiṃ tvavidyayā ; ato vidyayāvidyānivṛttau yathābrahmarūpameva bhavatītyarthaḥ | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—yatheti | bhede ; vidāraṇa ityarthaḥ | tadākāśa iti ; ghaṭākāśa ityarthaḥ | para idānīṃ vijātīyatvaprayuktamuṣṇaśītādiṣu nivartakatvaṃ dṛṣṭamityabhimānena punaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate—syāditi |
analyzed: yadi brahmaṇaḥ jīvaḥ tat catas bhinnaḥ syāt tatas syāḥ evam kim tu avidyayā atas vidyayā avidyā nivṛttau yathā brahma rūpam eva bhavati iti arthaḥ atra dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā iti bhede vidāraṇe iti arthaḥ tad ākāśe iti ghaṭa ākāśe iti arthaḥ paraḥ idānīm vijātīya tva prayuktam uṣṇa śīta ādiṣu nivartaka tvam dṛṣṭam iti abhimānena punar pratyavatiṣṭhate syāt iti

original: śravaṇādibhedena prapañcaḥ kathaṃ nivartate ? avidyātvāviśeṣāditi bhāvaḥ | siddhāntau tu sajātīyasyāpi rajasaḥ pratiyogino rajontaranivartakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam ; vijānīyasyāpi rūparasāderapratiyogino na dṛṣṭam ; ataḥ śītoṣṇādāvapi pratiyogitvaprayuktameva nivartakatvam ; tacca śravaṇādibhedasyāvidyākṛtatve'pi vyaktamastītyāha—bhedeti |
analyzed: śravaṇa ādi bhedena prapañcaḥ katham nivartate avidyā tva aviśeṣāt iti bhāvaḥ siddhāntau tu sajātīyasya api rajasaḥ pratiyoginaḥ rajaḥ ntara nivartaka tvam dṛṣṭam vijānīyasya api rūpa rasa ādeḥ apratiyoginaḥ na dṛṣṭam atas śīta uṣṇa ādau api pratiyogi tva prayuktam eva nivartaka tvam tat ca śravaṇa ādi bhedasya avidyā kṛta tve pi vyaktam asti iti āha bheda iti

original: pratipakṣatvamāha—vyaktamiti | śravaṇādeḥ svayaṃ nivṛttau sajātīyasya ca nivartakatve dṛṣṭāntadvayamaparamāha—yathā ceti | yadyapi payo jāṭhareṇāgninā jīryati, tathāpi payontaramanapekṣya jīryatītyetāvatā sāmyena svayamityuktam ;
analyzed: pratipakṣatvam āha vyaktam iti śravaṇa ādeḥ svayam nivṛttau sajātīyasya ca nivartaka tve dṛṣṭānta dvayam aparam āha yathā ca iti yadi api payaḥ jāṭhareṇa agninā jīryati tathā api payaḥ ntaram an apekṣya jīryati iti etāvatā sāmyena svayam iti uktam

original: na hi dṛṣṭāntena sarvathā sāmyaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | śravaṇādyavidyaivāvidyāṃ P. 13-2. nivartayatītīmaṃ śrutyā draḍhayati—yathoktamiti | mantrārthaṃ spaṣṭayati— etaditi | vidyā-viśuddhavijñānaṃ nityam; avidyā śravaṇādi; te hyupāyopeyabhāvena sahite saṃbaddhe iti yathākramamabhisaṃbandha iti | nanūpeyā cedvidyā, sādhyā terhi ;
analyzed: na hi dṛṣṭāntena sarvathā sāmyam bhavati iti bhāvaḥ śravaṇa ādi avidyā eva avidyām nivartayati iti imam śrutyā draḍhayati yathā uktam iti mantra artham spaṣṭayati etat iti vidyā viśuddha vijñānam nityam avidyā śravaṇa ādi te hi upāya upeya bhāvena sahite saṃbaddhe iti yathākramam abhisaṃbandhaḥ iti nanu upeyā ced vidyā sādhyā teḥ hi

original: na hyasādhyasyopeyatvaṃ ghaṭate; ataścānityatvamityāśaṅkya mantrasyottarārthaṃ yojayati—sādhyeti | tadyācaṣṭe—eṣa iti | nāvidyā vidyāṃ janayati, kiṃ tvavidyāniṣṭhastim; vidyāṃ tu vyanakti, tena vyaṅgyatathāpeyatvaṃ vidyāyāḥ, na janyatayā; ato nānityatvamityarthaḥ | etaccātmasvabhāvabhūtanityavidyābhiprāyeṇoktam |
analyzed: na hi asādhyasya upeya tvam ghaṭate atas ca anitya tvam iti āśaṅkya mantrasya uttara artham yojayati sādhyā iti tat yācaṣṭe eṣaḥ iti na avidyā vidyām janayati kim tu avidyā niṣṭhastim vidyām tu vyanakti tena vyaṅgya tathā apeya tvam vidyāyāḥ na janya tayā atas na anitya tvam iti arthaḥ etat ca ātma svabhāva bhūta nityavidyā abhiprāyeṇa uktam

original: nanu “mṛtyuṃ tītvā” iti mṛtyuniṣṭhattiḥ śrūyate, nāvidyāniṣṭhattiḥ; kathamavidyā nivartyata ityucyeta ? ityāśaṅkyāha— mṛtyuriti | caturthaṃ mantrapādaṃ yojayati—tasyāmiti | ‘vidyayā’ iti ityaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā | svarūpāvasthānāmityamṛtāvivaraṇam | nanvavidyā cedavidyāṃ nivartayati na tataḥ svarūpalabhāya prayatitavyamityāśaṅkyāha—sphaṭiketi;
analyzed: nanu mṛtyum tītvā iti mṛtyu niṣṭhattiḥ śrūyate na avidyā niṣṭhattiḥ katham avidyā nivartyate iti ucyeta iti āśaṅkya āha mṛtyuḥ iti caturtham mantra pādam yojayati tasyām iti vidyayā iti svarūpa avasthānām iti amṛtā vivaraṇam nanu avidyā ced avidyām nivartayati na tatas svarūpa labhāya prayatitavyam iti āśaṅkya āha sphaṭika iti

original: yathā sphaṭikamaṇerjapādyupādhyapanayāya prayatnādeva tannibandhanarāgatyāgāt prayatnāntaramantareṇa svarūpe'vasthānaṃ tadvadihāpītyarthaḥ | atra kecidāhuḥ—“kurvanneveha karmāṇi” ityato mantrāt karma prakṛtamavidyāśabdena vidyāparyudāsenocyate; tasmāt jñānakarmasamuccayaparo'yaṃ mantra iti | tadasat;
analyzed: yathā sphaṭika maṇeḥ japa ādi upādhi apanayāya prayatnāt eva tad nibandhana rāga tyāgāt prayatna antaram antareṇa svarūpa iva sthānam tadvat iha api iti arthaḥ atra kecid āhuḥ kurvan eva iha karmāṇi iti atas mantrāt karma prakṛtam avidyā śabdena vidyā paryudāsena ucyate tasmāt jñāna karma samuccaya paraḥ yam mantraḥ iti tat asat

original: ‘avidyā’ iti hi nanśrutiraparyantaṃ svaśaktyā vidyāviruddhamasamyagjñānamajñānaṃ cāha, nānyamātram | atra śrutiśca prakaraṇādbalīyatī | tasmānna jñānakarmasamuccayaparo'yaṃ mantra iti | mantrasyārthāntaramāha—anya iti | avidyā prapañcadarśanaṃ na vidyayā kūṭasthātmaprakāśena rahitamastītyarthaḥ | etadeva darśayati—tathā hīti |
analyzed: avidyā iti hi nanu śrutiḥ aparyantam sva śaktyā vidyā viruddham asamyak jñānam ajñānam ca āha na anya mātram atra śrutiḥ ca prakaraṇāt balīyatī tasmāt na jñāna karma samuccaya paraḥ yam mantraḥ iti mantrasya artha antaram āha anyaḥ iti avidyā prapañca darśanam na vidyayā kūṭastha ātma prakāśena rahitam asti iti arthaḥ etat eva darśayati tathā hi iti

original: na jaḍasya svataḥ prakāśaḥ saṃbhavati; na ca parataḥ, svabhāvāhānāt; na cātmasthena prakāśāntareṇa svaprakāśena, avikāritvādātmanaḥ | na ca prakāśenāsaṃbaddhasya prakāśa iti bhāvaḥ | upasaṃharati—tasmāditi | tathā tatheti; tena tena prapañcarūpeṇetyarthaḥ | etadeva śrutyā draḍhayati—yatheti | atra kaścidāha—
analyzed: na jaḍasya svatas prakāśaḥ saṃbhavati na ca paratas svabhāva ahānāt na ca ātma sthena prakāśa antareṇa sva prakāśena avikāri tvāt ātmanaḥ na ca prakāśena asaṃbaddhasya prakāśaḥ iti bhāvaḥ upasaṃharati tasmāt iti tathā tathā iti tena tena prapañca rūpeṇa iti arthaḥ etat eva śrutyā draḍhayati yathā iti atra kaścid āha

original: sarvaśabdo'yaṃ prakṛtaviṣayaḥ ; prakṛtaṃ cātra “ na tatra sūryo bhāti na candratārakam ” ityataḥ sūryādi ; tenāyamarthaḥ—tasya brahmaṇo bhāsā prabhāveṇa sarvabhidaṃ sūryādi bhāti vidyotata iti, na tu tatprakāśena sarvaṃ jagatprakāśata iti | tadayuktam ; bhāḥśabdo hi prakāśavacanaḥ ; prabhāvaśaktyādivācitve satyalaukiko'rthaḥ kalpitaḥ syāt ;
analyzed: sarva śabdaḥ ayam prakṛta viṣayaḥ prakṛtam ca atra na tatra sūryaḥ bhāti na candra tārakam iti atas sūrya ādi tena ayam arthaḥ tasya brahmaṇaḥ bhāsā prabhāveṇa sarva bhidam sūrya ādi bhāti vidyotate iti na tu tad prakāśena sarvam jagat prakāśate iti tat ayuktam bhās śabdaḥ hi prakāśa vacanaḥ prabhāva śakti ādi vāci tve satya laukikaḥ ūrthaḥ kalpitaḥ syāt

original: tasmāt tasya bhāsā prakāśena sarvaṃ prakāśata ityayamevārthaḥ | nanvevaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prakāśātmakatvāt ‘tasya’ iti vyatireko na ghaṭate | ‘rāhoḥ śiraḥ’ itivadupacārādupapatteḥ | nanvevamapi prakṛtatvātsūryādireva brahmaprakāśyatvamuktaṃ syāt, na sarvasya jagataḥ | na ; tatsāmānyāditareṣu tathātvāt, brahmakṣatrādivadupalakṣaṇopapatteśca |
analyzed: tasmāt tasya bhāsā prakāśena sarvam prakāśate iti ayam eva arthaḥ nanu evam brahmaṇaḥ prakāśa ātmaka tvāt tasya iti vyatirekaḥ na ghaṭate rāhoḥ śiraḥ iti vat upacārāt upapatteḥ nanu evam api prakṛta tvāt sūrya ādiḥ eva brahma prakāśya tvam uktam syāt na sarvasya jagataḥ na tad sāmānyāt itareṣu tathātvāt brahma kṣatra ādi vat upalakṣaṇa upapatteḥ ca

original: sarvaśabdaśca svarasenāśeṣavacanaḥ ; sa svārthānupapattyā saṃkocyamānaḥ prakaraṇādibhirniyantyata ; yathā—‘sarvamannaṃ muktam’ iti | na tviha tatheti śrutasaṃkoco na yuktaḥ | uktaḥ para eva prakāśastathā tathā prakāśata iti sa kiṃ svabhāvātpariṇāmādvā ? netyāha—kiṃ tviti | atrārthe'bhiyuktavākyamāha—yatheti | P. 13-14.
analyzed: sarva śabdaḥ ca svarasena aśeṣa vacanaḥ sa svārtha anupapattyā saṃkocyamānaḥ prakaraṇa ādibhiḥ yathā sarvam annam muktam iti na tu iha tathā iti śruta saṃkocaḥ na yuktaḥ uktaḥ paraḥ eva prakāśaḥ tathā tathā prakāśate iti sa kim svabhāvāt pariṇāmāt vā na iti āha kim tu iti atra artha ibhiyukta vākyam āha yathā iti

original: sarvaṃ darśanaṃ sarvaṃ jñānam ; anyūnaṃ saṃpūrṇam, paraprakāśasvarūpamiti yāvat | avikalpaṃ vidyadādivikalparāhitaṃ vidyadādirūpeṇa vikalpyamānamiva tu ayamāntaraḥ dehāntargato jīvo manyata ityarthaḥ yadvā vikalpo'sadarthajñānam, tanna bhavatītyavikalpam, asantaṃ vikalpamivāsadarthaṃ jñānamiva manyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: sarvam darśanam sarvam jñānam anyūnam saṃpūrṇam para prakāśa svarūpam iti yāvat avikalpam vidyat ādi vikalpa rāhitam vidyat ādi rūpeṇa vikalpyamānam iva tu ayam āntaraḥ deha antargataḥ jīvaḥ manyate iti arthaḥ yat vā vikalpa usat artha jñānam tat na bhavati iti avikalpam asantam vikalpam iva asat artham jñānam iva manyate iti arthaḥ

original: pūrvaṃ vidyāvidyayorupāyopeyabhāvena sahabhāva uktaḥ, iha tvavidyāyāḥ prapañcadarśanasya vidyānubaddhatveneti vivekaḥ | nanu jīvānāmavidyā, na brahmaṇa iti pūrvamuktam ; kathamidānīṃ tasyaivāvidyānubaddhatvamucyate ? pūrvaṃ brahmasvarūpājñātṛtvena jīvānāmavidyetyuktam ;
analyzed: pūrvam vidyā avidyayoḥ upāya upeya bhāvena sahabhāvaḥ uktaḥ iha tu avidyāyāḥ prapañca darśanasya vidyā anubaddha tvena iti vivekaḥ nanu jīvānām avidyā na brahmaṇaḥ iti pūrvam uktam katham idānīm tasya eva avidyā anubaddha tvam ucyate pūrvam brahma svarūpa ajñātṛ tvena jīvānām avidyā iti uktam

analyzed: adhunā tu niradhiṣṭhāna vibhrama anupapatteḥ ajñā tvena śukti vat brahmaṇaḥ kārya avidyā anubaddha tvam ucyate iti avirodhaḥ evam prapañca avidyāyāḥ nityavidyāyā sahabhāvam uktvā śravaṇa ādi vidyāyāḥ avidyayā sahabhāvam āha tathā iti vidyā avidyayoḥ anyonya sahabhāvaḥ iti uktam bhavati atas eva uktam ubhayam sahaḥ iti kutas ityāha śrotṛ iti

original: tulye ko viśeṣaḥ, ye^na^ sā jagato bhedadarśanamavidyāṃ bhāṣetatyāśaṅkya viśeṣa pa. 13-17. uktaḥ—vidyāpratyāsannayeti | aikātmyaśravaṇādividyāyāṃ tatsahabhāvena nityaprakāśarūpāyāṃ cābhivyañjakatvena śrotṛśravaṇādibhedāvidyā pratyāsanneti viśeṣaḥ | vidyālakṣaṇa iti ; nityaprakāśalakṣaṇa ityarthaḥ | tannivṛttāviti ; kāluṣyanivṛttāvityarthaḥ |

original: atredānīmaikātmye bhedasyāsatyatvāt śrotrādibhedāśrayāḥ śravaṇādayo'pyasatyāḥ ; tataśca kathamavidyānivṛttikāryaṃ kuryuḥ ? iti paraśvodayati — syāditi | marumarīcikājalādau snānādikāryādarśanāditi bhāvaḥ | śravaṇāderasatyācca brahmapratipattirasatyā syādityāha—asatyācceti | vahnerityadhyāhatya pratipattipadenānuṣañjanīyam |

original: siddhāntī tvasatyādapi satyaṃ kāryaṃ satyārthapratipattiśca dṛṣṭetyāha—ucyata iti | śāmbarikadarśitā ruyādimāyā prīteḥ, vyāghrādimāyā ca bhayasya nimittamiti vivekaḥ | satyapratipatterityatra nimittamityanuṣañjanīyam ; idamudāhṛtam | rekhā gavayādirūpeṇāsatyāpi rekhāsvarūpeṇa tāvat satyā ;

analyzed: śravaṇa ādi upāyāḥ tu sva rūpeṇa api asatyāḥ iti viśeṣam darśayan paraḥ punar pratyavatiṣṭhate syāt etat iti siddhāntī tu rekhā sva rūpeṇa satyāḥ api rekhā gavaya ādayaḥ yena go ādi rūpeṇa satya gavaya ādi pratipādakāḥ asatyam eva rekhā rūpa satya tvam tu satya gavaya ādi pratipatti kārya anupayogi akiñcitkaram eva iti aviśeṣam āha ucyate iti
