analyzed: atas ca na tad lakṣaṇaḥ mokṣaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha sati iti paraḥ punar viśeṣam āha na iti tatas kim ityāha na ca iti yogi jñāna saṃtatau caramaḥ iti arthaḥ yadi na upādānam kim tarhi saḥ iti āha ālambana iti pratyayaḥ kāraṇam viṣaya rūpam kāraṇam iti arthaḥ upādānam tu samanantara pūrva bhāvi kāraṇam ucyate iti āha samanantara iti

original: tatra sarvajñajñāne'nya eva svasaṃtānavartī pūrvakṣaṇaḥ, caramastu sarvajñajñānagrāhyatvāt viṣayarūpaṃ kāraṇamityāha— sveti | siddhāntī tu na tāvadyadātmakaṃ kāryaṃ tadupādānameva, nāpi yadāśrayaḥ; kṣaṇānāṃ parasparamanātmatvādanāśrayatvācca; yadi tulyajātīyamupādānam, prāptaṃ tarhi yogijñānaṃ sarvajñajñānasya jñānamātrarūpatayā tulyatvenopādānam;
analyzed: tatra sarvajña jñānenyaḥ eva sva saṃtāna vartī pūrva kṣaṇaḥ caramaḥ tu sarvajña jñāna grāhya tvāt viṣaya rūpam kāraṇam iti āha sva iti siddhāntī tu na tāvat yad ātmakam kāryam tat upādānam eva nā api yad āśrayaḥ kṣaṇānām parasparam anātma tvāt anāśraya tvāt ca yadi tulya jātīyam upādānam prāptam tarhi yogi jñānam sarvajña jñānasya jñāna mātra rūpatayā tulya tvena upādānam

original: ato na saṃtānāntaratvamityabhiprāyeṇāha—yadīti | yadi tu yogisarvajñajñānayorasarvasarvaviṣayatvena viṣayabhedādanuvṛttajātīyatvam, ato na yogijñānamupādānam, ato vilakṣaṇasarvajñajñānotpattau yogijñānasaṃtānoccheda ityucyate; ato rūpajñānapravāhe sati yadā rasajñānaṃ bhavati tadāpi pūrvasaṃtānocchedādapavargaprasaṅgaḥ syādityāha—yo'pīti |
analyzed: atas na saṃtāna antara tvam iti abhiprāyeṇa āha yadi iti yadi tu yogi sarvajña jñānayoḥ asarva sarva viṣaya tvena viṣaya bhedāt anuvṛtta jātīya tvam atas na yogi jñānam upādānam atas vilakṣaṇa sarvajña jñāna utpattau yogi jñāna saṃtāna ucchedaḥ iti ucyate atas rūpa jñāna pravāhe sati yadā rasa jñānam bhavati tadā api pūrva saṃtāna ucchedāt apavarga prasaṅgaḥ syāt iti āha yaḥ upi iti

original: atha tatra kathaṃci-
analyzed: atha tatra kathaṃcid

original: dvoṣarūpatayā tulyatvamucyate, tadaviśiṣṭaṃ yogisarvajñānayorapi ; tataśropādānopādeyabhāvādekasaṃtānatvaṃ pūrvasaṃtānānucchedātpunarapyanirvāṇaṃ syādityāha — kathaṃciditi || P.15-16. idānīṃ kramaprāptaṃ vijñānapadaṃ vyākhyātuṃ tadvacāvatyaṃ paramatamupanyasyati— keciditi | ātmamanaḥsaṃyogajaṃ vijñānaṃ guṇo yasyeti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: tulya tvam ucyate tat aviśiṣṭam yogi sarva jñānayoḥ api tatas rā upādāna upādeya bhāvāt eka saṃtāna tvam pūrva saṃtāna anucchedāt punar api anirvāṇam syāt iti āha kathaṃcid iti idānīm krama prāptam vijñāna padam vyākhyātum tad vacāvatyam para matam upanyasyati kecid iti ātma manaḥ saṃyoga jam vijñānam guṇaḥ yasya iti vigrahaḥ

original: avijñānasvabhāvamiti ; svato jaḍamityarthaḥ | samyagutvātā unmūlitāḥ sakalā buddhisukhaduḥkhecchādveṣaprayatnadharmādharmasaṃskārākhyā viśeṣaguṇā yasminniti vigrahaḥ | tasyeti ; ātmatattvasyetyarthaḥ | jñānasvabhāvo'pi cenmanaḥsaṃyogasāpekṣo jānāti tata eva tarhi jñānamutpattyate, tena dṛthā tatsvabhāvatvakalpaneti kaṇabhujo matam |
analyzed: avijñāna svabhāvam iti svatas jaḍam iti arthaḥ unmūlitāḥ sakalāḥ buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma saṃskāra ākhyāḥ viśeṣa guṇāḥ yasmin iti vigrahaḥ tasya iti ātma tattvasya iti arthaḥ jñāna svabhāvaḥ api ced manaḥ saṃyoga sāpekṣaḥ jānāti tatas eva tarhi jñānam utpattyate tena dṛthā tad svabhāva tva kalpanā iti kaṇabhujaḥ matam

original: kathaṃ svarūpāvasthā brahmaśabdenocyata ityāśaṅkya tasya pravṛttinimittamāha—sā hīti | dehādibhiranavacchinnatvaṃ bṛhattve hetuḥ ; bṛhattvācca brahmeti gīyate ; 'bṛha bṛhi vṛddhau' ityasmāt brahmaśabdavyutpatteriti bhāvaḥ | etacca śrautatvaleśādyotanārthamuktamiti mantavyam | jñānasvabhāvātmapakṣe tu doṣamāha—jñānasvabhāvatveti |
analyzed: katham svarūpa avasthā brahma śabdena ucyate iti āśaṅkya tasya pravṛtti nimittam āha sā hi iti deha ādibhiḥ anavacchinna tvam bṛhat tve hetuḥ bṛhat tvāt ca brahma iti gīyate vṛddhau iti asmāt brahma śabda vyutpatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ etat ca śrauta tva leśa ādyotana artham uktam iti mantavyam jñāna svabhāva ātma pakṣe tu doṣam āha jñāna svabhāva tva iti

original: caśabdastuśabdārthe | na tāvadasaṃnidhānāt sarvaṃ na budhyate, sarvagatasya sarvatra saṃnidhānāt | na ca sarvagato'pyasarvagatadehendriyādisāpekṣaḥ sarvaṃ na budhyate, nityatvājjñānarūpasya ; jñānotpattyarthaṃ hi dehādyapekṣyate ; nityatvādātmano jñānarūpaṃ nityam | ataśca saṃnihitavividhajñeyaviśeṣatvāt sarvamānmā budhyeta ;
analyzed: caśabdaḥ tuśabda arthe na tāvat asaṃnidhānāt sarvam na budhyate sarva gatasya sarvatra saṃnidhānāt na ca sarva gataḥ api a sarva gata deha indriya ādi sāpekṣaḥ sarvam na budhyate nitya tvāt jñāna rūpasya jñāna utpatti artham hi deha ādi apekṣyate nitya tvāt ātmanaḥ jñāna rūpam nityam atas ca saṃnihita vividha jñeya viśeṣa tvāt budhyeta

original: tataśca baddhasya muktasya ca yathādṛṣṭaniyatārthagocarāt saṃsārāt sarvadarśitvena bṛhattaraḥ saṃsāraḥ syādityarthaḥ | athaitaddoṣabhayāt na kiñcijjānātītyucyate, prāptaṃ tarhi jaḍatvam ; gateriva gamyamantareṇa jānātyarthasya jñeyaṃ vinānutpatteḥ | na cātmaiva jñeyaḥ, kartṛkarmatvavirodhāt | tadetat sāśaṅkramāha—athaiti |
analyzed: tatas ca baddhasya muktasya ca yathā dṛṣṭa niyata artha gocarāt saṃsārāt sarva darśi tvena bṛhattaraḥ saṃsāraḥ syāt iti arthaḥ atha etad doṣa bhayāt na kiñcid jānāti iti ucyate prāptam tarhi jaḍa tvam gateḥ iva gamyam antareṇa jānāti arthasya jñeyam vinā anutpatteḥ na ca ātmā eva jñeyaḥ kartṛ karmatva virodhāt tat etat sāśaṅkram āha atha eti

original: tadeva paramatamupanyasya tannivṛttaye vijñānapadaṃ yojayati—tāniti | paraḥ pūrvoktadoṣadṛṣṭiḥ pṛcchati—kuta iti | siddhāntī tu na vayaṃ prayojanabalāt citsvabhāvatvaṃ brūmaḥ, kiṃ tu śrutibalāditi manyamāna āha—śrūyata iti | nanu prāguktadoṣabalācchūterarthāntaratvaṃ kalpayiṣyāma ityata āha—na ceti |
analyzed: tat eva para matam upanyasya tad nivṛttaye vijñāna padam yojayati tān iti paraḥ pūrva ukta doṣa dṛṣṭiḥ pṛcchati kutas iti siddhāntī tu na vayam prayojana balāt cit svabhāva tvam brūmaḥ kim tu śruti balāt iti manyamānaḥ āha śrūyate iti nanu prāc ukta doṣa balāt śūteḥ artha antara tvam kalpayiṣyāmaḥ iti atas āha na ca iti

original: syādarthāntarakalpanā śruteḥ, yadyukto doṣaḥ syāt ; sa tu nāstītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: syāt artha antara kalpanā śruteḥ yadi uktaḥ doṣaḥ syāt sa tu na asti iti arthaḥ

original: P.15-25. kuta ityāha—yatheti | yathā dāhako'pyagnirna sarvaṃ dahati, yathā ca darpaṇādiryadupanīyate tacchāyāmāpadya tadeva darśayati, upanāyakābhāve śuddhamavatiṣṭhate; tathā ātmāpīndriyādyupanītaṃ budhyate, na sarvam; muktaścopanāyakābhāvānna bāhyaṃ budhyata iti | adāhyamiti; ayogyamityarthaḥ | bhogāyatanaśarīrastha iti;
analyzed: kutas iti āha yathā iti yathā dāhakaḥ api agniḥ na sarvam dahati yathā ca darpaṇa ādiḥ yat upanīyate tad chāyām āpadya tat eva darśayati upanāyaka abhāve śuddham avatiṣṭhate tathā ātmā api indriya ādi upanītam budhyate na sarvam muktaḥ ca upanāyaka abhāvāt na bāhyam budhyate iti adāhyam iti ayogyam iti arthaḥ bhoga āyatana śarīra sthaḥ iti

original: anyatra sato'pi bhoganivṛttyarthaṃ viśeṣaṇam; muktau ca bhogābhāve upanāyakābhāvo heturiti mantavyam | nanu vahnyāderasarvagatasyāsaṃnihitadāhyādupanayanāpekṣā yuktā, na tu sarvagatasyātmano nityasaṃnihitasarvaviṣayasya; ataḥ sarvadarśitvaṃ muktasya ca bāhyaviṣayopalabdhiḥ syāditi codayati— syāditi | siddhāntī tu tavāpyeṣa doṣo'sti;
analyzed: anyatra sataḥ api bhoga nivṛtti artham viśeṣaṇam muktau ca bhoga abhāve upanāyaka abhāvaḥ hetuḥ iti mantavyam nanu vahni ādeḥ asarva gatasya asaṃnihita dāhyāt upanayana apekṣā yuktā na tu sarva gatasya ātmanaḥ nitya saṃnihita sarva viṣayasya atas sarva darśi tvam muktasya ca bāhya viṣaya upalabdhiḥ syāt iti codayati syāt iti siddhāntī tu tava api eṣa doṣaḥ asti

original: ato yaste parihāraḥ sa no'pi bhāvapyatītyabhiprāyeṇa parasyāpi taddoṣamāsañjayati—ucyata iti | ātmamanaḥsaṃyogenātmanā ca jñānamupajanyate; sa cātmamanaḥsaṃyogaḥ sarvamanobhiḥ sarvātmanāṃ sarvagatatvenāviśiṣṭa iti sarvopalambhaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: atas yaḥ te parihāraḥ sa na upi bhau apyati iti abhiprāyeṇa parasya api tad doṣam āsañjayati ucyate iti ātma manaḥ saṃyogena ātmanā ca jñānam upajanyate sa ca ātma manaḥ saṃyogaḥ sarva manobhiḥ sarva ātmanām sarvagata tvena aviśiṣṭaḥ iti sarva upalambha prasaṅgaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sarvātmanāṃ sarvamanobhiḥ saṃyogāviśeṣe'pi yo viṣayo yasya viṣayatve vartate sa eva tabhevāvabudhyata iti nāvyavasthā syādityāśaṅkyāha— mana iti | na hi viṣayāṇāmātmanaḥ prati svato viṣayatvam, api tu manaḥsaṃyogamuratena; ataḥ sarvasaṃyuktaiḥ sarvamanobhiḥ saṃyogāviśeṣāt sarve viṣayā viṣayatve'sya vartanta ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu sarva ātmanām sarva manobhiḥ saṃyoga aviśeṣe pi yaḥ viṣayaḥ yasya viṣaya tve vartate saḥ eva iti na avyavasthā syāt iti āśaṅkya āha manaḥ iti na hi viṣayāṇām ātmanaḥ prati svatas viṣaya tvam api tu manaḥ saṃyoga muratena atas sarva saṃyuktaiḥ sarva manobhiḥ saṃyoga aviśeṣāt sarve viṣayāḥ vartante iti arthaḥ

original: atha sarvamanobhiḥ saṃyogāviśeṣe'pi svakarmanimittatvādupabhogasya svakarmopanītameva bhogyamupalabhata iti vyavasthocyate, tato'smākamapi jñānarūpo'pyātmā karmapāśavaśīkṛto'svatantrastadupanītamevārthaṃ budhyate, na sarvamiti vyavasthā setsyatītyāha—atheti | nanu janyajñānavādinaḥ karmavaśāt kacijjñānaṃ janyate kacinneti yuktā vyavasthā;
analyzed: atha sarva manobhiḥ saṃyoga aviśeṣe api sva karma nimitta tvāt upabhogasya sva karma upanītam eva bhogyam upalabhate iti vyavasthā ucyate tatas usmākam api jñāna rūpaḥ api ātmā karma pāśa vaśīkṛtaḥ asvatantraḥ tad upanītam eva artham budhyate na sarvam iti vyavasthā setsyati iti āha atha iti nanu janya jñāna vādinaḥ karma vaśāt kacit jñānam janyate kacit na iti yuktā vyavasthā

original: nityajñānasvabhāvātmavādinastu kathaṃ karmanimittā vyavastheti vācyam; na hi tasya karmabhirniyatārthaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ janyate, nityatvāt; tajjanmani ca tatsvabhāvātmajanmaprasaṅgāt | na ca viṣayāntaraṃ pratibhāsyate, anityatvādātmanāśāpatteśca | tadā ca sarvānupalabdhiḥ prasajyate, na tu vyavasthā; na hyekasya viṣayabhedena nāśānāśau saṃbhavataḥ |
analyzed: nitya jñāna svabhāva ātma vādinaḥ tu katham karma nimittā vyavasthā iti vācyam na hi tasya karmabhiḥ niyata artha viṣayam jñānam janyate nitya tvāt tad janmani ca tad svabhāva ātma janma prasaṅgāt na ca viṣaya antaram pratibhāsyate anitya tvāt ātma nāśa āpatteḥ ca tadā ca sarva anupalabdhiḥ prasajyate na tu vyavasthā na hi ekasya viṣaya bhedena nāśa anāśau saṃbhavataḥ

original: ata eva na tiroṣīyate'pi | na cārthaṃ eva kaścidātmanaḥ sarvagatādapasāryate, paṭhādibhirivātriyate vā karmabhiḥ; yato'vyavasthā syāt | āpe ca karmanimittā cedvyavasthā, tato
analyzed: atas eva na tiroṣīyate api na ca artham eva kaścid ātmanaḥ sarvagatāt apasāryate paṭha ādibhiḥ iva ātriyate vā karmabhiḥ yatas vyavasthā syāt ca karma nimittā ced vyavasthā tatas

original: muktaya kṣīṇāśeṣakarmaṇaḥ sarvadarśitvaṃ durnivāram | ucyate—jñānamātmā, na jñātā; jñātṛtā ca tasya kartṛśaktyahaṃkāroparāgatibandhanā; ahaṃkāraśca bhogāyatanasthastatraiva jñātṛtāmavabhāsayati; tena vibhorapyātmano jñātṛtvaṃ prādeśikameva, na sārvatrikam; ato bhogāyatanastha evātmā jñātā, nānyatra sannapi;
analyzed: muktaye kṣīṇa aśeṣa karmaṇaḥ sarva darśi tvam durnivāram ucyate jñānam ātmā na jñātā jñātṛtā ca tasya kartṛ śakti ahaṃkāra uparā gati bandhanā ahaṃkāraḥ ca bhogāyatana sthaḥ tatra eva jñātṛtām avabhāsayati tena vibhoḥ api ātmanaḥ jñātṛtvam prādeśikam eva na sārvatrikam atas bhogāyatana sthaḥ eva ātmā jñātā na anyatra san api

original: tataśca yadeva bhogasādhanaiḥ karmabhirbhogāyatanaṃ pratyupanītaṃ tadeva jñātuḥ saṃnihitamiti tadeva vetti, netaraditi vyavasthātiddhiḥ | nanu jñānarūpasyātmano vibhutvāt sarvajñeyasaṃbandho'sti | bāḍham | kimiti tarhi ‘sarvamidaṃ jāne’ iti na parāmṛśati? ajñātṛtvāt, jñāturbdhaye parāmarśo ‘jāne’ iti;
analyzed: tatas ca yat eva bhoga sādhanaiḥ karmabhiḥ bhoga āyatanam pratyupanītam tat eva jñātuḥ saṃnihitam iti tat eva vetti na itarat iti vyavasthā atiddhiḥ nanu jñāna rūpasya ātmanaḥ vibhu tvāt sarva jñeya saṃbandhaḥ usti bāḍham kim iti tarhi sarvam idam jāne iti na parāmṛśati ajñātṛ tvāt jñātuḥ ūrdhaye parāmarśaḥ jāne iti

original: jñātṛtvaṃ ca bhogāyatanastham, na sārvatrikamityuktam | ata eva muktasyāpi na bāhyaviṣayajñātṛtā; sā hi śarīrasthetyuktam | ato nāśarīrasya bhavitumarhati | tataśca muktau jñānamātratayāvatiṣṭhate, na jñātṛtayā; atastena saṃbaddhamapi jagattacca na jñeyatayā saṃbaddham; karturhi karmaṇā saṃbandhaḥ | nanu na jñānamapi jñeyaṃ vināsti;
analyzed: jñātṛ tvam ca bhogāyatana stham na sārvatrikam iti uktam atas eva muktasya api na bāhya viṣaya jñātṛ tā sā hi śarīra sthā iti uktam atas na aśarīrasya bhavitum arhati tatas ca muktau jñāna mātra tayā avatiṣṭhate na jñātṛ tayā atas tena saṃbaddham api jagat tat ca na jñeya tayā saṃbaddham kartuḥ hi karmaṇā saṃbandhaḥ nanu na jñānam api jñeyam vinā asti

original: sakarmako hi jñānārtha ityuktam; ataḥ kathaṃ jñeyaṃ vinā muktajñānamavatiṣṭhate—iti cet, na; ādityaprakāśavadupapatteḥ; yathā svalvādityaprakāśaḥ prakāśyānapekṣatiddhiḥ, evaṃ jñānamapi jñeyānapekṣatiddhiḥ | nanu sakarmako jānātyarthaḥ | satyam; buddhivṛttaṃ tu tat; taddhi sakarmikā kriyā, sā karmapekṣati yuktam; nityaṃ ca jñānam, na kriyā;
analyzed: sa karmakaḥ hi jñāna arthaḥ iti uktam atas katham jñeyam vinā mukta jñānam avatiṣṭhate iti ced na āditya prakāśa vat upapatteḥ yathā svalva āditya prakāśaḥ prakāśya anapekṣa tiddhiḥ evam jñānam api jñeya anapekṣa tiddhiḥ nanu sa karmakaḥ jānāti arthaḥ satyam buddhi vṛttam tu tat tat hi sa karmikā kriyā sā karma apekṣati yuktam nityam ca jñānam na kriyā

original: kṣaṇikā hi sā | kathaṃ tarhi tasyādhyastajñātṛbhāvasyāpi jñeyena saṃbandhaḥ? na; kriyāgarbho hi saḥ | sā ca buddherityuktam | na cānyakriyāgarbho'nyayoḥ karmakartṛbhāvo bhavati | satyam, anyatvāvagatau; aviveke tu tayoranyakriyāyā api tatkarmaṇyasya kartṛtā syādeva; yathā dehagatayā gatyā tadviviktasyāsmadarthasyātmano ‘grāmamahaṃ gacchāmi’ iti |
analyzed: kṣaṇikā hi sā katham tarhi tasya adhyasta jñātṛ bhāvasya api jñeyena saṃbandhaḥ na kriyā garbhaḥ hi saḥ sā ca buddheḥ iti uktam na ca anya kriyā garbhaḥ nyayoḥ karma kartṛ bhāvaḥ bhavati satyam anya tva avagatau aviveke tu tayoḥ anya kriyāyāḥ api tad karmaṇi asya kartṛ tā syāt eva yathā deha gatayā gatyā tad viviktasya asmad arthasya ātmanaḥ grāmam aham gacchāmi iti

original: tatkimidānīṃ dve jñāne? cideva svaprakāśā jñānam; tadavivekāsu loko buddhivṛttau jñānapadaṃ prayuṅkte | nanu lokaprayogagamyaḥ śabdārthaḥ; atastatra prayogāttadeva jñānapadārthaḥ syāt; na tu citsvaprakāśā | na, svayaṃprakāśajñānādhyāsenaiva buddhivṛttau prayogāt;
analyzed: tat kim idānīm dve jñāne cit eva sva prakāśā jñānam tad avivekāsu lokaḥ buddhi vṛttau jñāna padam prayuṅkte nanu loka prayoga gamyaḥ śabda arthaḥ atas tatra prayogāt tat eva jñāna padārthaḥ syāt na tu cit sva prakāśā na svayam prakāśa jñāna adhyāsena eva buddhi vṛttau prayogāt

original: yadadhyāsena yaḥ śabdo yatra prayujyate sa eva tasya mukhyo'rthaḥ, śuktāviva rajataśabdasya rajatam | kathaṃ punaravagamyate—adhyastasvaprakāśajñāne buddhivṛttau loke jñānapadaprayoga iti?
analyzed: yad adhyāsena yaḥ śabdaḥ yatra prayujyate saḥ eva tasya mukhyaḥ ṛthaḥ śuktau iva rajata śabdasya rajatam katham punar avagamyate adhyasta sva prakāśa jñāne buddhi vṛttau loke jñāna pada prayogaḥ iti

original: ‘ghaṭamahaṃ jāne’ iti jñānāvabhāsāt | na ca tadavabhāso'nyato'vakalpata ityuktam | na ca buddhivṛttameva svato'vabhāti, jaḍatvāt | na ca buddhivṛttasya svato jaḍasya ghaṭādivadarthaprakāśatvam | indriyaṃ tu prakāśakam, na prakāśa iti viśeṣaḥ | asti ca nityajñāne jñānaśabdo vede; yathā— “satyaṃ jñānamanantam” iti |
analyzed: ghaṭam aham jāne iti jñāna avabhāsāt na ca tad avabhāsaḥ nyatas vakalpate iti uktam na ca buddhi vṛttam eva svatas vabhāti jaḍa tvāt na ca buddhi vṛttasya svatas jaḍasya ghaṭa ādi vat artha prakāśa tvam indriyam tu prakāśakam na prakāśe iti viśeṣaḥ asti ca nitya jñāne jñāna śabdaḥ vede yathā satyam jñānam anantam iti

original: na hi buddhivṛttasya kṣaṇikasyānantyamavakalpate; yogyatālakṣaṇo vā dṛśo dṛśyena saṃbandho nānyaḥ; “asaṅgo hyayaṃ puruṣaḥ” iti śruteḥ | darśanayogyatā cārthasya buddhyapārūḍhasyaiveti nānyatropalabdhiprasaṅgaḥ | tasmāt svaprakāśameva jñānaṃ mukhyam; nānyat | buddhivṛttaṃ tu āntamamukhyamiti siddham |
analyzed: na hi buddhi vṛttasya kṣaṇikasya ānantyam avakalpate yogyatā lakṣaṇaḥ vā dṛśaḥ dṛśyena saṃbandhaḥ na anyaḥ asaṅgaḥ hi ayam puruṣaḥ iti śruteḥ darśana yogyatā ca arthasya buddhi apārūḍhasya eva iti na anyatra upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt sva prakāśam eva jñānam mukhyam na anyat buddhi vṛttam tu āntam amukhyam iti siddham

original: tadetat svamate'pyupayujyata iti sāṃkhyamataprastāvenoktamityupasthite | P. 16-9. evaṃ paramatena vyavasthāmuktvā adhunā svamatenāha—api ceti | bhedadarśanamavidyā; tasyām ‘asmaivedaṃ sarvam’ ityabhedadarśanena vidyayā nirvartitāyāmātmamātrāvaśeṣe jagati dṛśyameva nāsti, kuto muktasya sarvadarśitvamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tat etat sva mate api upayujyate iti sāṃkhya mata prastāvena uktam iti upasthite evam para matena vyavasthām uktvā adhunā sva matena āha api ca iti bheda darśanam avidyā tasyām asmai eva idam sarvam iti abheda darśanena vidyayā nirvartitāyām ātma mātra avaśeṣe jagati dṛśyam eva na asti kutas muktasya sarva darśi tvam iti arthaḥ

original: baddhasya tu “eṣo'ṇurātmā cetastā veditavyaḥ” ityādiśruteraṇabuddhyavacchinnatvenāṇutvānniyatārthopanelavidyopanītārthamātradraṣṭṛtvācca sarvagatapakṣoktasarvadarśitvadoṣo dūrata eveti bhāvaḥ | atraiva dṛṣṭāntadvayamāha—draṣṭuriveti | tamevārthaṃ śrutidvayena draḍhayati—taduktamiti | draṣṭurātmano dṛśyatāyā iti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau |
analyzed: baddhasya tu eṣa uṇuḥ ātmā cetastā veditavyaḥ ityādi śrutyāḥ aṇa buddhi avacchinna tvena aṇu tvāt sarvagata pakṣa ukta sarva darśi tva doṣaḥ dūratas eva iti bhāvaḥ atra eva dṛṣṭānta dvayam āha draṣṭuḥ iva iti tam eva artham śruti dvayena draḍhayati tat uktam iti draṣṭuḥ ātmanaḥ dṛśya tāyāḥ iti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau

original: evaṃ svapakṣamupapādya parapakṣe doṣamāha— vijñāna iti | kuta ityāha—na hoti; buddhyādiguṇarahitasya nityamanavabuddhyamānasya na sattvamasattvādviśiṣyata ityarthaḥ | na cātmābhāva eva puruṣārthaḥ, puruṣairanadhyamānatvādityāha—kaśceti || matāntaramāśaṅkya dūṣayati—syāditi | udvahanta ityatra svocchedāya yatamānā dṛśyanta iti pūrveṇānvayaḥ |
analyzed: evam sva pakṣam upapādya para pakṣe doṣam āha vijñāne iti kutas ityāha na ha iti buddhi ādi guṇa rahitasya nityam anavabuddhyamānasya na sattvam asattvāt viśiṣyate iti arthaḥ na ca ātma abhāvaḥ eva puruṣa arthaḥ puruṣaiḥ anadhyamāna tvāt iti āha kaḥ ca iti mata antaram āśaṅkya dūṣayati syāt iti udvahantaḥ iti atra sva ucchedāya yatamānāḥ dṛśyante iti pūrveṇa anvayaḥ

original: saṃsāriṇastu naivaṃvidhāḥ, yena svocchedāya yaterannityāha - na tviti | anevaṃvidhatvadyotanārthaṃ vividhetyādiviśe ṣaṇam | tataḥ kimityāha—tatreti | svapakṣe tu mokṣasyāniṣṭhanivṛttīṣṭaprāptibhyāgaikāntikaṃ puruṣārthatvamāha—yasya tviti |
analyzed: saṃsāriṇaḥ tu na evaṃvidhāḥ yena sva ucchedāya yateran iti āha na tu iti anevaṃvidha tva dyotana artham vividha ityādi viśe ṣaṇam tatas kim iti āha tatra iti sva pakṣe tu mokṣasya aniṣṭha nivṛtti iṣṭa prāpti bhyāk aikāntikam puruṣa artha tvam āha yasya tu iti

original: idānīṃ kramāgatamakṣarapadaṃ vyācaṣṭe—akṣaramiti | śabdātmatāmiti | P.16-23 yadāgamaikasamadhigamyaṃ yenākārādivarṇaviśeṣākhilaśabdārthaviśeṣānusyūtamokārasya śabdatanmātrarūpaṃ tadātmatāmāgamaikagamyātmana āhetyarthaḥ | nanvakṣaraśabdo'kārādivarṇopetaṃ viśeṣarūpamokāramāha ;
analyzed: idānīm krama āgatam akṣara padam vyācaṣṭe akṣaram iti śabda ātmatām iti yat āgama eka samadhigamyam yena ākāra ādi varṇa viśeṣa akhila śabdārtha viśeṣa anusyūtam okārasya śabda tanmātra rūpam tad ātmatām āgama eka gamya ātmanaḥ āha iti arthaḥ nanu akṣara śabda okāra ādi varṇa upetam viśeṣa rūpam okāram āha

original: tatkathamapetavarṇavibhāgamakhilaśabdārthānusyūtatvena sāmānyarūpamokāramāhetyata āha—viśeṣeṇeti | akṣaraśabdavācyenākārādiviśeṣarūpeṇa śrautreṇa sarvātmatve śrutivirodhāt atīndriyamokārasya pūrvoktaṃ sāmānyarūpaṃ lakṣyata ityarthaḥ | yadvā—akṣaraśabdo varṇātmakaṃ śabdaviśeṣamāha ;
analyzed: tat katham apeta varṇa vibhāgam akhila śabdārtha anusyūta tvena sāmānya rūpam okāram āha iti atas āha viśeṣeṇa iti akṣara śabda vācyena ākāra ādi viśeṣa rūpeṇa śrautreṇa sarva ātma tve śruti virodhāt atīndriyam okārasya pūrva uktam sāmānya rūpam lakṣyate iti arthaḥ yat vā akṣara śabdaḥ varṇa ātmakam śabda viśeṣam āha

original: tatkathamapetaviśeṣaśabdamātrarūpatocyata ityāśaṅkyāha—viśeṣeṇeti | vyākhyāntaramāha—apariṇāmitvaṃ veti ; akṣaramityāhetyanuvartate | kathamakṣaraśabdena taducyata ityāha—pīraṇāma iti | pariṇāme pūrvadharmanivṛttirūpasya kṣaraṇasya bhāvāt, nāsti kṣaraṇaṃ cyavanamasya pūrvadharmāditi kṣaraṇavyudāsenāpariṇāmyucyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tat katham apeta viśeṣa śabda mātra rūpatā ucyate iti āśaṅkya āha viśeṣeṇa iti vyākhyā antaram āha apariṇāmi tvam vā iti akṣaram iti āha iti anuvartate katham akṣara śabdena tat ucyate iti āha iti pariṇāme pūrva dharma nivṛtti rūpasya kṣaraṇasya bhāvāt na asti kṣaraṇam cyavanam asya pūrva dharmāt iti kṣaraṇa vyudāsena apariṇāmi ucyate iti arthaḥ

original: tatra brahmaṇaḥ śabdātmatve pratyakṣāderaṃbhāvaṃ bakṣyamāṇaśrutīnāṃ pratīkopāsanāparatvaṃ ca manvānaḥ pṛcchati—kathamiti | siddhāntī tu nemāḥ pratīkopāsanaparāḥ śrutayaḥ, api tu brahmasvarūpaparā iti manvānaḥ śrutimeva pramāṇatvenodāharati—paraṃ cāparamiti | nanvokārābhidheyaṃ brahma ; taduktama—“tasya vācakaḥ praṇavaḥ” iti |
analyzed: tatra brahmaṇaḥ śabda ātmatve pratyakṣa ādeḥ aṃbhāvam bakṣyamāṇa śrutīnām pratīka upāsana paratvam ca manvānaḥ pṛcchati katham iti siddhāntī tu na imāḥ pratīka upāsana parāḥ śrutayaḥ api tu brahma svarūpa parāḥ iti manvānaḥ śrutim eva pramāṇa tvena udāharati param ca aparam iti nanu okāra abhidheyam brahma tat uktam atasya vācakaḥ praṇavaḥ iti

original: tena tadabhidheyasya brahmaṇaḥ parāpararūpatātrocyate, nokārasyetyāśaṅkyāha— na ceti | nanu “varṇāt kāraḥ” iti vivakṣitaikasaṃkhyāt kathaṃ varṇasamudāyāt ‘om’ iti nāmnaḥ kārapratyaya ityata āha—avarṇāditi ; ekavarṇādanyasmādapītyarthaḥ ; tasmāt ‘varṇāt’ ityekatvamavivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ | atra codayati—nanviti |
analyzed: tena tad abhidheyasya brahmaṇaḥ parāpara rūpa tā atra ucyate nokārasya iti āśaṅkya āha na ca iti nanu varṇāt kāraḥ iti vivakṣita eka saṃkhyāt katham varṇa samudāyāt om iti nāmnaḥ kāra pratyayaḥ iti atas āha avarṇāt iti eka varṇāt anyasmāt api iti arthaḥ tasmāt varṇāt iti eka tvam avivakṣitam iti bhāvaḥ atra codayati nanu iti

original: pratīkamālambanaṃ viṣaya upāsanābuddheḥ ; okāraviṣaye brahmabuddhiḥ kāryatyarthaḥ | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—yatheti | devatāyā avyaktatvena sākṣāt pūjāyā asaṃbhavāt tallāñchane tasyā devatāyā lāñchanāni cihnāni śaṅkhacakrādīni yasmin dāruṇi śilāyāṃ vā tatra devatābuddhyā pūjāvidhānam, tathā sā pūjitā prasīdatīti kṛtvā yathā tathetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: pratīkam ālambanam viṣayaḥ upāsanā buddheḥ okāra viṣaye brahma buddhiḥ kārī ati arthaḥ atra dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā iti devatāyāḥ avyakta tvena sākṣāt pūjāyāḥ asaṃbhavāt tad lāñchane tasyāḥ devatāyāḥ lāñchanāni cihnāni śaṅkha cakra ādīni yasmin dāruṇi śilāyām vā tatra devatā buddhyā pūjā vidhānam tathā sā pūjitā prasīdati iti kṛtvā yathā tathā iti arthaḥ

original: yadvā omiti varṇabhedena nāmnā brahmaiva dhyeyam ; tathā tatprasīdatītyāha— anena ceti | evaṃ matadvayamupanyasya dūṣayati—ucyata iti | yatra
analyzed: yat vā om iti varṇa bhedena nāmnā brahma eva dhyeyam tathā tat prasīdati iti āha anena ca iti evam mata dvayam upanyasya dūṣayati ucyate iti yatra

original: dhyānāṅgatokārasya śrūyate, tatra bhavatu pratīkādyupāsanopadeśaḥ; yatra tu 'yajjīta' ityāderaśravaṇādaśrutakalpanāpramāṇābhāvācca brahmaṇaḥ sarvasya cokārātmatve vākyaṃ paryavasyati tatra na pratīkādyupadeśa ityarthaḥ | tadudāharati— P.17-11. yatheti | "tadyathā śaṅkunaikena sarvāṇi parṇāni saṃtṛṇṇāni, evamokāreṇa sarvā vāk saṃtṛṇṇā";
analyzed: dhyāna aṅga tā ukārasya śrūyate tatra bhavatu pratīka ādi upāsana upadeśaḥ yatra tu yat jītaḥ ityādeḥ aśravaṇāt aśruta kalpanā pramāṇa abhāvāt ca brahmaṇaḥ sarvasya ca ukāra ātma tve vākyam paryavasyati tatra na pratīka ādi upadeśaḥ iti arthaḥ tat udāharati yathā iti tat yathā śaṅkunā ekena sarvāṇi parṇāni saṃtṛṇṇāni evam okāreṇa sarvā vāc saṃtṛṇṇā

original: "oṃkāra evedaṃ sarvam" iti sopakramopasaṃhāraṃ vākyaṃ paṭhitam; yathā śaṅkunā patramadhyavartinā vaṃśakenaikena sarvataḥ prasṛtābhiḥ sirābhiḥ pratyekaṃ sarvapatrāṇi saṃtṛṇṇāni vyāptāni tathetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: oṃkāraḥ eva idam sarvam iti sa upakrama upasaṃhāram vākyam paṭhitam yathā śaṅkunā patra madhya vartinā vaṃśakena ekena sarvatas prasṛtābhiḥ sirābhiḥ pratyekam sarva patrāṇi saṃtṛṇṇāni vyāptāni tathā iti arthaḥ

original: nanu yadyapyokāreṇa sarvā vāco'nugatāḥ, tathāpi kathaṃ tāsāṃ tadātmatvam, tādātmye 'pi ca tāsāmarthamāgasyātādātmyāt kathamokārasya sarvātmatvam—ityāśaṅkya dvayaṃ saṃpādayati—atra hīti; sarvavāco'nugamenokārasya sarvavācāṃ tadrūpā tyāgādavyabhicāritvam; avyabhicāri vastunastaccam, na vyabhicāri śukteriva rūpyam;
analyzed: nanu yadi api okāreṇa sarvāḥ vācaḥ anugatāḥ tathā api katham tāsām tad ātmatvam tādātmye ca tāsām artha māgasya a tādātmyāt katham okārasya sarva ātmatvam iti āśaṅkya dvayam saṃpādayati atra hi iti sarva vācaḥ anugamena ukārasya sarva vācām tyāgāt avyabhicāri tvam avyabhicāri vastunaḥ na vyabhicāri śukteḥ iva rūpyam

original: anyonyavyabhicāriṇaśca vācāṃ viśeṣāḥ, na tvokāra ityokāro vācastatvaṃ satyarūpam, na tadviśeṣā iti "sarvā vācaḥ saṃtṛṇṇāḥ" ityantena darśitatvāt sarvārthānāṃ ca savikalpakajñānairvāganuviddhānāmupalabdheḥ pūrvavadvāgrūpatvaṃ satyam; tataścārthānāṃ vāk taccam, vācaścokāra ityabhipretya "oṃkāra evedaṃ sarvam" ityupasaṃharati | sarvaṃ ca brahma;
analyzed: anyonya vyabhicāriṇaḥ ca vācām viśeṣāḥ na tu okāraḥ iti okāraḥ vācaḥ tatvam satya rūpam na tad viśeṣāḥ iti sarvāḥ vācaḥ saṃtṛṇṇāḥ ityantena darśita tvāt sarva arthānām ca savikalpaka jñānaiḥ vāc anuviddhānām upalabdheḥ pūrvavat vāc rūpa tvam satyam tatas ca arthānām vāc taccam vācaḥ ca ukāraḥ iti abhipretya oṃkāraḥ eva idam sarvam iti upasaṃharati sarvam ca brahma

original: ata oṃkāro brahmeti bhāvaḥ | evamokārasarvātmatvamavivekavākyagamyamuktvā idānīṃ saviveke'pi tadgamyata ityāha—yatnāpīti | etena pūrvoktasarvātmatvenokāreṇetyarthaḥ | nanvarthavādatvāt stutyartho'yamupacāra ityāśaṅkyāha—na ceti | kuta ityāha—mukhyārthatva iti |
analyzed: atas oṃkāraḥ brahma iti bhāvaḥ evam okāra sarva ātma tvam aviveka vākya gamyam uktvā idānīm saviveke api tat gamyate iti āha yatnā api iti etena pūrva ukta sarva ātma tvena ukāreṇa iti arthaḥ nanu arthavāda tvāt stuti arthaḥ yam upacāraḥ iti āśaṅkya āha na ca iti kutas ityāha mukhya artha tve iti

original: arthavādā api guṇābhidhānalakṣaṇatvāt stuteḥ kecidarthamabhivadantaḥ stuvanti, evameva stutyavagamāt; tasya ca stute raveriva "naktaṃ dadṛśe" itivat pramāṇāntaravirodho nimittam; sa cennāsti tataḥ pratīyamānasyārthasyābādhitasyāpekṣitasya mukhyasya ca tyāgena nāśrutagauṇārthakalpanā yukteti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: arthavādāḥ api guṇa abhidhāna lakṣaṇa tvāt stuteḥ kecid artham abhivadantaḥ stuvanti evam eva stuti avagamāt tasya ca stuteḥ raveḥ iva naktam dadṛśe iti vat pramāṇa antara virodhaḥ nimittam sa ced nā asti tatas pratīyamānasya arthasya abādhitasya apekṣitasya mukhyasya ca tyāgena na aśruta gauṇa artha kalpanā yuktā iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu sarvasya cedokārātmatvam, tataḥ pratyakṣādinā gṛhyeta; na caidam; ataḥ pratyakṣādyanupalabdhiviruddhatvāt kathamavirodha ityāśaṅkyāha—sarvasya hīti | na hi
analyzed: nanu sarvasya ced okāra ātma tvam tatas pratyakṣa ādinā gṛhyeta na ca edam atas pratyakṣa ādi anupalabdhi viruddha tvāt katham avirodhaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha sarvasya hi iti na hi

original: varṇātmanā śrautreṇa sarvasyokārātmatvam, kiṃ tu pratyakṣādyanavaseyenāgamagamyenātmanā; ato na pratyakṣādyanupalabdhivirodha ityarthaḥ | nanu śāstraikagamye'pi pratyakṣādyanupalabdhivirodho'styeva, kathamavirodha ityāśaṅkyāha—na hīti | P.17-17.
analyzed: varṇa ātmanā śrautreṇa sarvasya ukāra ātmatvam kim tu pratyakṣa ādi anavaseyena āgama gamyena ātmanā atas na pratyakṣa ādi anupalabdhi virodhaḥ iti arthaḥ nanu śāstra eka gamye api pratyakṣa ādi anupalabdhi virodhaḥ usti eva katham avirodhaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha na hi iti

original: pramāṇāntareṇa pratyakṣādinā, anavagamaḥ anupalabdhiḥ, pramāṇāntarasya śāstrasya, viṣayaṃ sarvasya okārātmatvaṃ dharmādikamiva nāpaharati na bādhate | na hi śāstragamyaṃ dharmādi pratyakṣādyanupalabdhito'sat bhavatītyarthaḥ | itaścārthavādoktamapi sarvātmatvamokārasya vivakṣitamityāha—tasmāditi |
analyzed: pramāṇa antareṇa pratyakṣa ādinā anavagamaḥ anupalabdhiḥ pramāṇa antarasya śāstrasya viṣayam sarvasya okāra ātmatvam dharma ādikam iva na apaharati na bādhate na hi śāstra gamyam dharma ādi bhavati iti arthaḥ itas ca arthavāda uktam api sarva ātmatvam okārasya vivakṣitam iti āha tasmāt iti

original: “tasmādvidvānetena paraṃ puruṣam” iti jñānino'dhikāraḥ śrutaḥ; jñānī ca pratyāsaceroṃkārasarvātmatvajñānī; taccāsya nānyataḥ pramāṇāt, anupalabdheḥ; ataḥ pratyāsacerarthavādājjātaṃ grāhyam; tasmādanantaramevārthavādavākyamokārasarvātmatve paryavasitam; na tadatikrameṇa gauṇaparyavasānam; tat punardharmānavidhyekavākyatāṃ nayati |

original: śabdasaṃsparśe sati vivekavato'rthavodhasya vyavahāropayuktavivekavattvayotkarṣadarśanāt, tatpratisaṃhāre śabdābhāve saṃcetitānāmapyasaṃcetitakalpatvāt ; kutaḥ ? pathi gacchataḥ puṃsaḥ padmyāṃ spṛśyamānānāmapi gucchatṛṇādīnāmapakarṣāt ; ato'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vāprapādhīnameva citeśrititvamiti balādāpadyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: śabda saṃsparśe sati vivekavataḥ ṛtha vodhasya vyavahāra upayukta vivekavat tvayā utkarṣa darśanāt tad pratisaṃhāre śabda abhāve saṃcetitānām api a saṃcetita kalpa tvāt kutas pathi gacchataḥ puṃsaḥ padmyām spṛśyamānānām api guccha tṛṇa ādīnām apakarṣāt atas nvaya vyatirekābhyām vāprapā adhīnam eva citeḥ śriti tvam iti balāt āpadyate iti arthaḥ

original: arthaprakāśātmakatvaṃ hi citeśrititvam, na vastumātratvam ; tacca śabdasaṃsparśe satyutkṛṣyate, tadabhāve cāpakṛṣyate ; tasmādvāprapādhīnaṃ citeśrititvaṃ nāma rūpam | matāntaramāha—vākśaktiriti ; vāco'rthaprakāśaśaktirvākśaktiḥ | vākśaktiścecitiḥ, kathaṃ tarhi vāgupasaṃhāre'rthaścetyata ityata āha—tatpratīti |
analyzed: artha prakāśa ātmaka tvam hi citeḥ śriti tvam na vastu mātra tvam tat ca śabda saṃsparśe sati utkṛṣyate tad abhāve ca apakṛṣyate tasmāt vāprapā adhīnam citeḥ śriti tvam nāma rūpam mata antaram āha vāc śaktiḥ iti vācaḥ ūrtha prakāśa śaktiḥ vāc śaktiḥ vāc śaktiḥ ca icitiḥ katham tarhi vāc upasaṃhāra īrthaḥ ca iti atas iti atas āha tat prati iti

original: tatrāpi citeścedasti, asti sūkṣmā vāk, citervākśaktitvāt | tataḥ kimityata āha—sarvatheti ; sarvathā vāgrapādhīnatve vākśaktitve cetyarthaḥ | hetau ‘iti’śabdaḥ | ‘mṛdaḥ’ iti vikāre, ‘candramasaḥ’ iti vivarte dṛṣṭāntaḥ | ataśca vāgātmakaṃ sarvam ; vākca “yathā śaṅkunā” iti śruterokārātmikā ; tenokāraḥ sarvaḥ ; sarvaṃ ca brahma ;
analyzed: tatra api citeḥ ced asti asti sūkṣmā vāc citeḥ vāc śakti tvāt tatas kim iti atas āha sarvathā iti sarvathā vāc rapa adhīna tve vāc śakti tve ca iti arthaḥ hetau iti śabdaḥ mṛdaḥ iti vikāre candramasaḥ iti vivarte dṛṣṭāntaḥ atas ca vāc ātmakam sarvam vāc ca yathā śaṅkunā iti śruteḥ okāra ātmikā tena ukāraḥ sarvaḥ sarvam ca brahma

original: ata oṃkāro brahmeti siddham |
analyzed: atas oṃkāraḥ brahma iti siddham

original: idānīmakṣarapadasyārthāntaraṃ vaktuṃ tadyāvatyaṃ paramataṃ vaktumupakramate—anya P. 19-13 iti | 'mṛdādidṛṣṭāntadarśanāt' ityekadeśena kṛtsno'numānaprayogaḥ sūcitaḥ ; so'yaṃ prayogaḥ—brahma kāryarūpeṇa pariṇamate, prakṛtitvāt mṛdādīva ghaṭādirūpeṇeti; prakṛtitva ca "yato vā imāni bhūtāni" ityādiśrutisiddham ;
analyzed: idānīm akṣara padasya artha antaram vaktum tat yāvatyam paramatam vaktum upakramate iti mṛd ādi dṛṣṭānta darśanāt iti eka deśena kṛtsnaḥ unumāna prayogaḥ sūcitaḥ saḥ ayam prayogaḥ brahma kārya rūpeṇa pariṇamate prakṛti tvāt mṛd ādi iva ghaṭa ādi rūpeṇa iti ca yatas vā imāni bhūtāni ityādi śruti siddham

original: śrutau vā mṛdādidṛṣṭāntadarśanādityarthaḥ | evaṃ paramatamupanyasya tannirākaraṇārthatvenākṣarapadaṃ yojayati—taditi; tat brahmaṇaḥ pariṇāmitvam, apākīryate nirasyate; akṣaramityanenetyarthaḥ | parastu pūrvoktānumānabalena pṛcchati—kuta iti | siddhāntī tu śrutiviruddhamanumānamapramāṇaṃ manyamānaḥ śrutimāha— bhruva iti |
analyzed: śrutau vā mṛd ādi dṛṣṭānta darśanāt iti arthaḥ evam para matam upanyasya tad nirākaraṇa arthatvena akṣara padam yojayati tat iti tat brahmaṇaḥ pariṇāmi tvam apākīryate nirasyate akṣaram iti anena iti arthaḥ paraḥ tu pūrvokta anumāna balena pṛcchati kutas iti siddhāntī tu śruti viruddham anumānam apramāṇam manyamānaḥ śrutim āha bhruvaḥ iti

original: atra paramatamāśaṅkayati—atheti | pariṇāmitve'pyātmano nityatā na vyāhanyate mṛda iva ghaṭādau, tattvāvighātāt tatsarūpatvāvināśāt ; ato nityatā tu tiḥ pariṇāmitve'pyupapannatvān pariṇāmitvānumānaṃ bādhata iti bhāvaḥ | etadevābhiyuktavacanena draḍhayati—yathoktamiti |
analyzed: atra para matam āśaṅkayati atha iti pariṇāmi tve ipi ātmanaḥ nitya tā na vyāhanyate mṛdaḥ iva ghaṭa ādau tattva avighātāt tad sarūpa tva avināśāt atas nitya tā tu tiḥ pariṇāmi tve ipi upapanna tvān pariṇāmi tva anumānam bādhate iti bhāvaḥ etat eva abhiyukta vacanena draḍhayati yathā uktam iti

original: yasmin kāryātmanā pariṇate'pi tattvaṃ kāryeṣu prathamijñānāt kāryarūpeṇa na vyāvartyate tadapi nityam; na kevalaṃ kūṭasthamevetyarthaḥ | evamāśaṅkya dūṣayati— satyamiti | satyaṃ pariṇāmini nityatvamapyasti, kiṃ tvātmani tanna saṃbhavati; sa hi sarvātmanā pariṇamet, ekadeśena vā;
analyzed: yasmin kārya ātmanā pariṇate api tattvam kāryeṣu prathami jñānāt kārya rūpeṇa na vyāvartyate tat api nityam na kevalam kūṭastham eva iti arthaḥ evam āśaṅkya dūṣayati satyam iti satyam pariṇāmini nitya tvam api asti kim tu ātmani tat na saṃbhavati sa hi sarva ātmanā pariṇamet eka deśena vā

original: tatra sarvātmanā pariṇatāvātmasvarūpasya vināśādanityatvaṃ syāt, ekadeśapariṇatau ca sāvayavatvānnityatvasya vyāghātaḥ syāt; yaddhi sāvayavam, tadavayavasaṃyogajatvāt kāryaṃ dṛṣṭam; yacca kāryam, tadanityaṃ dṛṣṭam; tathā cātmanaḥ sāvayavatve avayavānāṃ mitho'vayavinaśca bhedādekatvamadvayatvaṃ vyāhanyetetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatra sarva ātmanā pariṇatau ātma svarūpasya vināśāt anitya tvam syāt eka deśa pariṇatau ca sa avayava tvāt nitya tvasya vyāghātaḥ syāt yat hi sa avayavam tat avayava saṃyoga ja tvāt kāryam dṛṣṭam yat ca kāryam tat anityam dṛṣṭam tathā ca ātmanaḥ sa avayava tve avayavānām mithas vayavinaḥ ca bhedāt ekatvam advaya tvam vyāhanyeta iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ pariṇāmapakṣo'nupapattimuktvā vivartapakṣe upapattimāha—tadetaditi | tadetatsarūpeṇa viśuddhatvaṃ prapañcātmanā cāviśuddhatvam, tathā prapañcanāśe'pi svato nityatvam, prapañcabhede'pyekatvaṃ cākāśakalpe viśuddhatvānavayavatvādibhirākāśopame avidyākalpitena prapañcena kalpitāvacchede brahmaṇi ghaṭate; nānyathetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: evam pariṇāma pakṣaḥ ūnupapattim uktvā vivarta pakṣe upapattim āha tat etat iti tat etat sarūpeṇa viśuddha tvam prapañca ātmanā ca aviśuddha tvam tathā prapañca nāśe api svatas nitya tvam prapañca bhede pi ekatvam ca ākāśa kalpe viśuddha tva anavayava tva ādibhiḥ ākāśa upame avidyā kalpitena prapañcena kalpita avacchede brahmaṇi ghaṭate na anyathā iti arthaḥ

original: kathaṃ ghaṭate ? ityāha—kalpiteti | yathā kalpitāvacchedamapyākāśaṃ vastuvṛttenānavacchinnamastyeva, avacchedanāśādanityamapi kalpanayā tattvato nityam, avacchedabhedātkalpitabhedamapi vastuvṛttenaikam, tadaviśuddhyā
analyzed: katham ghaṭate iti āha kalpita iti yathā kalpita avacchedam api ākāśam vastu vṛttena anavacchinnam asti eva avaccheda nāśāt anityam api kalpanayā tattvataḥ nityam avaccheda bhedāt kalpita bhedam api vastu vṛttena ekam tad aviśuddhyā

original: vāśuddhamapi taccataḥ śuddham; tathā brahmāpi; na hi kalpanā vastu anyathābhāvaṃ nayatīti bhāvaḥ | athocyate—yadi kalpitāvacchedaṃ brahma, tataḥ kalpitānāmevaikadeśānāṃ pariṇāmo'stu; tathā sati ca nityatvamekatvaṃ ca na P.19-21. vyāhaniṣyate; pariṇāmastu setsyatītyāśaṅkya dūṣayati—atheti |
analyzed: vā aśuddham api śuddham tathā brahma api na hi kalpanā vastu anyathābhāvam nayati iti bhāvaḥ atha ucyate yadi kalpita avacchedam brahma tatas kalpitānām eva eka deśānām pariṇāmaḥ ustu tathā sati ca nitya tvam ekatvam ca na vyāhaniṣyate pariṇāmaḥ tu setsyati iti āśaṅkya dūṣayati atha iti

original: kalpitasya asamyagucchādhyavasitasya ekadeśasya yaḥ pariṇāmaḥ, sa kalpanayaiva asamyagucchaiva syāt; na cāsamyagucchādhyavasitasya satyatvam; ato'pariṇāmitvameva brahmaṇa iti siddho naḥ pakṣa iti sūktam 'akṣaram' iti | idaṃ cākṣarapadasya vyākhyāntaraṃ na pūrvatrāparitoṣeṇa, pūrvatra dūṣaṇānabhidhānāt;
analyzed: kalpitasya asamyak ucchā adhyavasitasya eka deśasya yaḥ pariṇāmaḥ sa kalpanayā eva asamyak ucchā eva syāt na ca asamyak ucchā adhyavasitasya satya tvam brahmaṇaḥ iti siddhaḥ naḥ pakṣaḥ iti sūktam akṣaram iti idam ca akṣara padasya vyākhyā antaram na pūrvatra aparitoṣeṇa pūrvatra dūṣaṇa anabhidhānāt

original: tasmādāvṛtyā vṛttyantareṇa vā viṣayavyāptyarthamiti mantavyam | idānīmasarvapadaṃ vyākhyātuṃ tadvyāvartya satyaprapañcavādimataṃ tāvadupanyasyati— ke ciditi | ke cit “sarvagandhaḥ sarvarasaḥ sarvakāmaḥ sarvakarmā” ityādiśruteḥ satprapañcātmatāṃ brahmaṇo'bhyupagatavanta ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt āvṛtyā vṛtti antareṇa vā viṣaya vyāpti artham iti mantavyam idānīm asarva padam vyākhyātum tat vyāvartya satya prapañca vādi matam tāvat upanyasyati ke cid iti ke cid sarva gandhaḥ sarva rasaḥ sarva kāmaḥ sarva karmā ityādi śruteḥ sat prapañca ātmatām brahmaṇā abhyupagatavantaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: na kevalaṃ śrutitaḥ, arthāpattito'pyayamartho labhyata ityāha—evamiti | sarvātmatve sati ca viṣayāṇāmupabhogaḥ prakāśo ghaṭata ityarthaḥ | kathamityāha—prakāśeti | sarvātmake brahmaṇi prakāśasvabhāvasya brahmātmanaḥ svabhāvabhūtā viṣayāḥ prakāśātmakatvāt yuktaṃ prakāśaratnityarthaḥ |
analyzed: na kevalam śrutitaḥ arthāpattitaḥ api ayam arthaḥ labhyate iti āha evam iti sarva ātma tve sati ca viṣayāṇām upabhogaḥ prakāśaḥ ghaṭate iti arthaḥ katham iti āha prakāśa iti sarva ātmake brahmaṇi prakāśa svabhāvasya brahma ātmanaḥ svabhāva bhūtāḥ viṣayāḥ prakāśa ātmaka tvāt yuktam prakāśa ratni iti arthaḥ

original: brahmaṇo'nyatve tu prakāśasaṃsṛṣṭasya svato jaḍasya ca viṣayasya prakāśo nādhakalpeta | tadevaṃ viṣayaprakāśo'sarvātmatve brahmaṇo'nupapadyamāno brahmaṇaḥ sarvātmatvaṃ gamayatītyabhiprāyeṇāha—anyatva iti |
analyzed: brahmaṇaḥ anyatve tu prakāśa saṃsṛṣṭasya svatas jaḍasya ca viṣayasya prakāśaḥ tat evam viṣaya prakāśaḥ sarva ātma tve brahmaṇaḥ unupapadyamānaḥ brahmaṇaḥ sarva ātma tvam gamayati iti abhiprāyeṇa āha anya tve iti

original: niṣprapañcabrahmaśrutayaśca “asthūlam” ityādyāḥ niṣprapañcamiti saprapañcaṃ brahmopāsyam—ityevaṃparāḥ, na tu prapañcātmatvapratyākhyānaparā iti bhāvaḥ | atra siddhāntamāha—tāniti | na sarvātmakaṃ brahma, kiṃ tu niṣkevalamadvayamiti yāvat | parastu tenaiva śrutyarthāpacyavaṣṭambhena pṛcchati—kuta iti | uttaramāha—asthūlamiti | uparāgastādātmyam |
analyzed: niṣprapañca brahma śrutayaḥ ca a sthūlam ityādyāḥ niṣprapañcam iti sa prapañcam brahma upāsyam iti evaṃparāḥ na tu prapañca ātmatva pratyākhyāna parāḥ iti bhāvaḥ atra siddhāntam āha tān iti na sarva ātmakam brahma kim tu niṣkevalam advayam iti yāvat paraḥ tu tena eva śruti arthāpacī avaṣṭambhena pṛcchati kutas iti uttaram āha asthūlam iti uparāgaḥ tādātmyam

original: neyamupāsanāparā śrutiḥ, upāsteraśrutatvāt; aprakṛtatvādadhyāhārapramāṇābhāvāt; upaniṣadāṃ tu siddhe'rthe prāmāṇyāt; ato'sthūlādiśruterna sarvātmakaṃ brahma | nanu sarvagandhādiśrutirapyasti; tasyāstarhi kā gatiḥ? ucyate—sarvagandhādivikalpāspadasvāt ‘sarvagandhaḥ’ ityādyuktamityavirodhaḥ | viṣayopabhogopapattiśca
analyzed: na iyam upāsanā parā śrutiḥ upāsteḥ aśruta tvāt aprakṛta tvāt adhyāhāra pramāṇa abhāvāt upaniṣadām tu siddhi ṛthe prāmāṇyāt atas sthūla ādi śruteḥ na sarva ātmakam brahma nanu sarva gandha ādi śrutiḥ api asti tasyāḥ tarhi kā gatiḥ ucyate sarva gandha ādi vikalpa āspada svāt sarva gandhaḥ ityādi uktam iti avirodhaḥ viṣaya upabhoga upapattiḥ ca

original: vivartapakṣe'pyukteti na punaruktā | evaṃ pramāṇābhāvena viparyayapramāṇena ca prapañcasabhāvatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pratiṣidhya, idānīṃ tadabhyupagame doṣamāha—sarveti | P. 20-2. sarvagandhādiviśeṣairaviyogādātmana, ityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha—na hīti | nanu sabhāvādāpi kiñcidviyojyate ; kathamiva ? ghaṭa iva pākenetyāśaṅkyāha —athāpīti |
analyzed: vivarta pakṣe api uktā iti na punar uktā evam pramāṇa abhāvena viparyaya pramāṇena ca prapañca sabhāva tvam brahmaṇaḥ pratiṣidhya idānīm tad abhyupagame doṣam āha sarva iti sarva gandha ādi viśeṣaiḥ aviyogāt ātmanaḥ iti arthaḥ kutas ityāha na hi iti nanu sabhāvāt api kiñcid viyojyate katham iva ghaṭaḥ iva pākena iti āśaṅkya āha atha api iti

original: viyogo'pi bhavan katipayaireva prapañcaiḥ syāt, na sarvaiścailokyavartibhiḥ ; prapañcaprabandhasya kṛtsnasya prapañcasyānucchedāt ; ataśca nityasaṃsāritā syādityarthaḥ | nanu pralaye sarvocchedo dṛṣṭaḥ ; naivam, ātmantikalayābhiprāyatvādasya ; sa hi muktyupayogī ; netaraḥ, punaḥ sṛṣṭeḥ | prapañcaprābalyasyānucchedaṃ prakaṭayati—sarvayeti |
analyzed: viyogaḥ upi bhavan katipayaiḥ eva prapañcaiḥ syāt na sarvaiḥ cailokya vartibhiḥ prapañca prabandhasya kṛtsnasya prapañcasya anucchedāt atas ca nitya saṃsāri tā syāt iti arthaḥ nanu pralaye sarva ucchedaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na evam ātmantika layā abhiprāya tvāt asya sa hi mukti upayogī na itaraḥ punar sṛṣṭeḥ prapañca prābalyasya anucchedam prakaṭayati sarvayā iti

original: sabhāvasyāviyoge viyoge ca, bubhukṣādiprapañco'syātmana ātmā sabhāvastvatpakṣe ; na ca bubhukṣādiprabandhasya sarvajantugatasya bubhukṣāderucchedaḥ kenacidiṣyate, ekamuktau sarvamuktiprasaṅgādityarthaḥ | bubhukṣāderādhyātmikasya puruṣaviṣṇavakasya pratyāsannamatiśayitaṃ bandhahetutvamiti viśeṣataḥ parigrahaḥ |
analyzed: sa bhāvasya aviyoge viyoge ca bubhukṣā ādi prapañcaḥ asya ātmanaḥ ātmā sa bhāvaḥ tvad pakṣe na ca bubhukṣā ādi prabandhasya sarva jantu gatasya bubhukṣā ādeḥ ucchedaḥ kenacid iṣyate eka muktau sarva mukti prasaṅgāt iti arthaḥ bubhukṣā ādeḥ ādhyātmikasya puruṣa viṣṇavakasya pratyāsannam atiśayitam bandha hetu tvam iti viśeṣataḥ parigrahaḥ

original: tatra sarvātmakaikātmavādinastava mokṣo na syādityāha—tatreti | etena kalpitabhedasya jīvasyāpi brahma prāptasya muktiḥ pratyuktā | kasya nāma nirmokṣaḥ syādityata āha—ātmeti | ātmabhedavādinastu kasyacidātmano bubhukṣādiprapañcocchedānmuktasaṃsārasya vibhāgaḥ syāt ; na tvasya sarvātmatvamiṣṭamityarthaḥ | prakṛtamupasaṃharati— tasmāditi |
analyzed: tatra sarva ātmaka eka ātma vādinaḥ tava mokṣaḥ na syāt iti āha tatra iti etena kalpita bhedasya jīvasya api brahma prāptasya muktiḥ pratyuktā kasya nāma nirmokṣaḥ syāt iti atas āha ātma iti ātma bheda vādinaḥ tu kasyacid ātmanaḥ bubhukṣā ādi prapañca ucchedāt mukta saṃsārasya vibhāgaḥ syāt na tu asya sarva ātma tvam iṣṭam iti arthaḥ prakṛtam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: yadi na brahmasabhāvabhūtaḥ prapañcaḥ, kīdṛśastarhītyata āha— avidyeti | ayamāśayaḥ—taccataḥ prapañcātmatve brahmaṇaḥ prapañcasya bahudoṣaduṣṭatvāt taddoṣakalpitatvādamedhyādīnāṃ durgandhādiprapañcena nityaduḥkhitvaṃ durnivāraṃ syāt ; akalpamānandaikarasaṃ ca tacchrūyate, tadvyāhanyeta |
analyzed: yadi na brahma sabhāva bhūtaḥ prapañcaḥ kīdṛśaḥ tarhi iti atas āha avidyā iti ayam āśayaḥ taccataḥ prapañca ātmatve brahmaṇaḥ prapañcasya bahu doṣa duṣṭatvāt tad doṣa kalpita tvāt amedhya ādīnām durgandha ādi prapañcena nitya duḥkhitvam durnivāram syāt akalpam ānanda eka rasam ca tat śrūyate tat vyāhanyeta

original: vikāradoṣāste na prakṛtiṃ spṛśantīti cet, tatkimamedhyādiduṣṭe ghaṭe mṛdamaduṣṭāṃ manyase ? yenaivam | atha bhinnābhinnatvāt prapañcasya bhedābhedena na taddoṣalepa iti cet, na ; bhedābhedena tadāpatterduṣṭamaduṣṭaṃ ca brahma syāt ; atyantaviśuddhaṃ ca tacchrūyatam | avidyākrīḍite tu prapañce taiṣa doṣaḥ ;
analyzed: vikāra doṣāḥ te na prakṛtim spṛśanti iti ced tat kim amedhya ādi duṣṭe ghaṭe mṛdam aduṣṭām manyase yena evam atha bhinna abhinna tvāt prapañcasya bheda abhedena na tad doṣa lepaḥ iti ced na bheda abhedena tad āpatteḥ duṣṭam aduṣṭam ca brahma syāt atyanta viśuddham ca avidyā krīḍite tu prapañce doṣaḥ

original: na khalvavidyākrīḍitena doṣeṇa tattvamupalipyate gaganamiva malinatādinā | tasmādatyantaviśuddhaṃ brahmacchatā avidyāpakṣa evopāsya iti |

original: teṣāmaniyatavipākakālatvāt; aniyatavipākasya phaladānasya kālo yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ; tataśca bahutarakālātikrame'pi svasahakāriṇaṃ kālaṃ prāpya kadācinmuktamapi badhnīyuḥ; tataśca pralayāvasthāta iva muktyavasthāto'pi punarāvṛttiḥ syāt; tadetadāha— avidyeti | avidyānibandhane'pi bandhe punarāvṛttibhayamāha—avidyeti |

original: na tāvanmuktasya hetvabhāvāt prayojanābhāvādvā nāvidyā pravartate, yato nirhetukā niṣprayojanā ca sā; na tasyā hetuprayojanāpekṣāsti; tataśca kadācinmuktamapi punarbadhnīyādityarthaḥ | na cedamasaṃbhāvanīyam, suṣupte brahma prāptasya tataḥ punarāvṛttidarśanādityāha—tathā ceti | atrāvidyāstīti cet, muktāvapi tayā bhāvyamityuktam; ataḥ sāmyam |

original: brahmaprāptiśca suṣuptasya “sati saṃpadya na viduḥ” “sati saṃtpasyāmahe” ityādiśrutyokteti draṣṭavyam | tathā svatantre'pi brahmaṇi svato bhinnānāmabhinnānāṃ vā jīvānāṃ vibhajya bhogakrīḍāvibhūtirupāpanasvabhāvāruthairhetubhirdehendriyabhogānāṃ hetāvabhyupagamyamāne punardehādisaṃbandhabhayamastītyāha—svatantre tviti | kṛta ityāha—

original: na ca prāyaścittaṃ naimittikamātram, etadapi bhogenaiva kṣīyata iti vācyam; “dvādaśābdena godhatī tasmātpāpātpramucyate” iti smṛtivirodhāt | nanvāgamatiddhatvādastu prāyaścittasya pāpakṣayahetutvam, vidyāyāstu kathamanantakarmakṣayahetutvamityāśaṅkyātrāpyāgamamāha—uktaṃ hīti |

original: evamadṛṣṭaśaktyā prāyaścittavadvidyāyāḥ sarvakarmakṣayahetutvaṃ paramatenoktvā adhunā svamatena dṛṣṭaśaktyā tadāha—atha veti | avidyāhetukaḥ kartṛkarmādivibhāgaḥ, tasya vidyayā nivṛttau kutastasya punarāvṛttibhayaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | avidyānibandhane'pi bandhe muktasya punaḥ saṃsārabhayaṃ nāstītyāha—nāpīti; punaḥ saṃsāra iti pūrveṇānvayaḥ |
analyzed: evam adṛṣṭa śaktyā prāyaścitta vat vidyāyāḥ sarva karma kṣaya hetu tvam para matena uktvā adhunā sva matena dṛṣṭa śaktyā tat āha atha vā iti avidyā hetukaḥ kartṛ karma ādi vibhāgaḥ tasya vidyayā nivṛttau kutas tasya punarāvṛtti bhayam syāt iti bhāvaḥ avidyā nibandhane api bandhe muktasya punar saṃsāra bhayam na asti iti āhana api iti punar saṃsāre iti pūrveṇa anvayaḥ

original: kuta ityāha—taditi; ‘tat’ ityavidyāṃ parāmṛśati | kimiti tatpravṛttiheturnāstītyāha—anādiriti | kasmātpunaranādihetuṃ nāpekṣata ityāha— prāgiti | yadi nāmāvidyānāditvādahetukā, tataḥ kimityāha—vidyayeti | parvā tāvadanādiravidyā muktasya vidyayā hatā; itarā ca nirhetukatvānna hetumantareṇotpattimarhatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: kutas ityāha tat iti tat iti avidyām parāmṛśati kim iti tad pravṛtti hetuḥ na asti iti āha anādiḥ iti kasmāt punar anādi hetum na apekṣate iti āha prāk iti yadi nāma avidyā anādi tvāt ahetukā tatas kim iti āha vidyayā iti parvā tāvat anādiḥ avidyā muktasya vidyayā hatā itarā ca nirhetuka tvāt na hetum antareṇa utpattim arhati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu suṣuptavaducchinnāpi punarutpattyata ityata āha—suṣupte tviti | suṣupte prapañcātmanā vistāramātramavidyāyā nivṛttam; svayaṃ tu sā ātmatattvāgrahaṇātmanā vikṣepasaṃskārātmanā cāvasthitaiva; ataḥ prabodhe punaḥ prapañcamādarśayati; muktasya tu sarvathocchinneti viśeṣaḥ |

original: yadi tu suṣupte'pi sarvathocchinnā syāt, na mokṣāt suṣuptaṃ vibhajyetetyarthaḥ | suṣupte cedavidyā nocchinnā, kathaṃ tarhi “tatrāharaharimāḥ prajā brahmalokam” ityādau brahmaprāptyabhidhānamityata āha—vikṣepa iti | yadyapi tatra kāraṇāvidyāsti, tathāpi kāryāvidyānivṛttisāmānyād gauṇaṃ brahmaprāptyabhidhānamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yadi tu suṣupte api sarvathā ucchinnā syāt na mokṣāt suṣuptam vibhajyeta iti arthaḥ suṣupte ced avidyā na ucchinnā katham tarhi tatra aharahar imāḥ prajāḥ brahma lokam ityādau brahma prāpti abhidhānam iti atas āha vikṣepaḥ iti yadi api tatra kāraṇa avidyā asti tathā api kārya avidyā nivṛtti sāmānyāt gauṇam brahma prāpti abhidhānam iti bhāvaḥ

original: svātantryayogyatāpakṣayostu punarāvṛttyāśaṅkā tayoranabhyupagamenaiva pratyuktena punarna pratyuktā | prakṛtamupasaṃharati—tasmāditi |
analyzed: svātantrya yogyatā pakṣayoḥ tu punarāvṛtti āśaṅkā tayoḥ anabhyupagamena eva pratyuktena punar na pratyuktā prakṛtam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: kena punaḥ pramāṇenāsya prathamaślokoktasyādvayātmatattvarūpasyārthasyāvagamaḥ ? original: anumānopamāne bhedasāpekṣe, na tu bhedaṃ sākṣāt gṛhītaḥ; pratyakṣaṃ tu gṛhadāpi vastūpasarjanaṃ gṛhṇāti, na tu tameva sākṣāt | arthāpattiḥ punarabhedaviṣaye bheda eva sākṣāt pramāṇaṃ sutarāṃ pratipakṣabhūtā; yato na bhedamantareṇa pramātṛprameyādibhedavyavahāraḥ kvacidupapadyate; apekṣitaśrāsau; anyathā taṃ vinā nirbhedabrahmāvagamo'pi na syāt |

original: abhāvo'pi na bhāvarūpe brahmaṇi tāvat pramāṇam | na ca prapañcābhāve, tasya pramāṇapañcakābhāvarūpasya pratyakṣādiṣu satstasaṃbhavāt | āgamasya bahuvaktavyatvāt pūrvamupamānādyabhāva ukta iti draṣṭavyam | evamāgamasyāpi; yasya tāvadāptaḥ praṇetā, sa pramāṇāntarādhigatavastuviṣayatvāt tadagocare brahmaṇi na pramāṇam |

original: nāpi vedaḥ, tasya vidhiniṣedhātmakatvāt; vidhiniṣedhayośca siddhe brahmatattve'saṃbhavāt | na ca vidhiniṣedhāvanapekṣya siddhe vastuni śabdasya prāmāṇyaṃ yuktam; tathā hi—ghaṭo'yamitivat siddhānuvādatve pramāṇāntarāpekṣā syāt; na ca tadalaukike brahmaṇi saṃbhavatītyaprāmāṇyameva syāt | itaśca siddhe'rthe na vedasya prāmāṇyam;

original: yato loke śabdasya vācakasāmarthyāvagamaḥ, tatra ca kāryaparatayaiva kāryānvayitvārthe padāni prayujyante, tathā prayojanavaccāt; anyathā niṣprayojanāni syuḥ | kiṃ ca na siddhānuvādāt śabdasya vācyavācakasaṃbandhāvagamaḥ, kiṃ tu pravartakādvākyāt;
analyzed: yatas loke śabdasya vācaka sāmarthya avagamaḥ tatra ca kārya para tayā eva kārya anvayi tva arthe padāni prayujyante tathā anyathā niṣprayojanāni syuḥ kim ca na siddha anuvādāt śabdasya vācya vācaka saṃbandha avagamaḥ kim tu pravartakāt vākyāt

original: yataḥ 'pikamānaya' ityukte preṣyasya pravṛttyārthapratyayaṃ vinānupapadyamānayā tasyārthapratyayamanumāya śabdānantaryāt tannimittāntarādarśanācca 'śabdenāyaṃ kṛtaḥ' iti tasya tatra sāmarthyamavagamyate; tataśca pravṛttisaṃbandhena vyutpannaśaktayaḥ śabdā na siddhaṃ brahmāvagamayitumalamiti na tatra pramāṇam |
analyzed: yatas pikam ānaya iti ukte preṣyasya pravṛttyā artha pratyayam vinā anupapadyamānayā tasya artha pratyayam anumāya śabda ānantaryāt tad nimitta antara adarśanāt ca śabdena ayam kṛtaḥ iti tasya tatra sāmarthyam avagamyate tatas ca pravṛtti saṃbandhena vyutpanna śaktayaḥ śabdāḥ na siddham brahma avagamayitum alam iti na tatra pramāṇam

original: kiṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ pramāṇāntareṇa siddhatve śabdasyānuvādakatvādaprāmāṇyam, asiddhatve natarām; ajñātasya hi brahmaṇaḥ padena saṃbandhājñānādapadārthatve vākyārthatvāyogāt | katham ? padārtha eva padārthāntaraviśiṣṭo vākyārtho bhavati; brahmapadārthastvanyena pramā-
analyzed: kim ca brahmaṇaḥ pramāṇa antareṇa siddha tve śabdasya anuvādaka tvāt aprāmāṇyam asiddha tve natarām ajñātasya hi brahmaṇaḥ padena saṃbandha ajñānāt apadārtha tve vākya artha tva ayogāt katham padārthaḥ eva padārtha antara viśiṣṭaḥ vākya arthaḥ bhavati brahma padārthaḥ tu anyena pramā

original: ṇenātyantamadṛṣṭo'navagatasaṃbandhatayā padādanavagamyamānaḥ padārthasaṃsargātmake vākyārthe guṇatvena pradhānatvena vā nānupraveśamarhati | tasmānna śabdapramāṇakaṃ brahma | api ca nirastasamastaviśeṣaṇaṃ brahmatattvaṃ pratītigocara eva na bhavati |

original: katham ? sarvā hi pratītiḥ 'evaṃprakāramidam, nānyaprakāram' ityevaṃ vastu vyavacchindatī pravartate, anyathā pratītireva na syāt; nirastasamastaprakāre tu brahmaṇi kathaṃ pratītiḥ syādityevaṃ pramāṇābhāvenādvayaṃ brahmākṣipya tatra P.23-18. pramāṇamāha—āmnāyata iti | 'nirūpaṇam' ityatra pracakṣata ityanuvartate |

original: yattāvaduktam—siddhānuvāditve vedasya pramāṇāntaratāpekṣatvaṃ syāditi, tattāvannāstīti niyogakāṇḍe vakṣyāmaḥ | yaccoktam—kāryaniṣṭhānyeva laukikavākyānīti, tadapi naikāntikam; akāryaniṣṭhānyapi hi priyākhyānāni priyamākhyāyate yaistāni 'putraste jātaḥ' ityādīni vākyāni pravṛttinivṛttiprayojanaśūnyāni loke santi;

original: na ca tāvatā niṣprayojanānyeva, pitṛsukhotpādaprayojanatvāt | na ca tatra 'sukhī bhava' iti pravṛttyupadeśaḥ kalpyaḥ, jñātaputrajanmavastusāmarthyādeva sukhitvasiddherupadeśānapekṣatvāt | atha matam— asti tāvattatra pituḥ sukhe pravṛttiḥ; tatraiva vacatastātparyam; atastadapi pravṛttiniṣṭhameva | satyam;

analyzed: na ca pitṛ sukha utpāda prayojana vacce sati siddhārtha paryavasitasya eva śabdasya pūṣā prapiṣṭha bhāgaḥ iti vat pravṛtti paryantaḥ vyāpāraḥ śakyaḥ kalpayitum tena siddhārtha niṣṭham eva tat vākyam na pravṛtti niṣṭham api ca pravṛtti niṣṭha tve pi na tāvat putra janmani sukha upāye puruṣa apravṛttaḥ pravartyaḥ tasya siddha tvāt

original: yasmādetaddoṣadvayamasmin pakṣe bhavati tasmādetaddoṣadvayaparihārāyānyonyākāṅkṣitayogyasannihitena kāryeṇākāryeṇa vārthamātreṇa vyatiṣaṅgaḥ anyonyasaṃsargaḥ kalpanīyaḥ ; tāvatā cānyārthamātravyatiṣaṅgeṇa padaprayogavākyārthapratyayayorupapattau satyāṃ prayoktṛpratipatternirākāṅkṣānna kāryarūpapadārthaviśeṣavyatiṣaṅge pramāṇamasti ;
analyzed: yasmāt etat doṣa dvayam asmin pakṣe bhavati tasmāt etad doṣa dvaya parihārāya anyonya ākāṅkṣita yogya sannihitena kāryeṇa akāryeṇa vā artha mātreṇa vyatiṣaṅgaḥ anyonya saṃsargaḥ kalpanīyaḥ tāvatā ca anya artha mātra vyatiṣaṅgeṇa pada prayoga vākya artha pratyayayoḥ upapattau satyām prayoktṛ pratipatteḥ nirākāṅkṣāt na kārya rūpa padārtha viśeṣa vyatiṣaṅge pramāṇam asti

original: svārthamātraparyavasāne hi padānāṃ prayogapratyayāvanupapadyamānau tadatikramya padārthamātrasaṃsargaparyantatātparyaśaktiṃ gamayataḥ ; tau ca tāvataivopapattau na kāryātmakārthāntarasaṃsargaparyantatāṃ gamayitumalamiti bhāvaḥ | itaśca—yo hi kāryātmakārthāntaravyatiṣaṅgaṃ kalpayati, kāryasyāpyarthāntaratvāt kalpayatyasāvarthāntaravyatiṣaṅgam ;
analyzed: svārtha mātra paryavasāne hi padānām prayoga pratyayau anupapadyamānau tat atikramya padārtha mātra saṃsarga paryanta tātparya śaktim gamayataḥ tau ca tāvatā eva upapattau na kārya ātmaka artha antara saṃsarga paryanta tām gamayitum alam iti bhāvaḥ itas cayaḥ hi kārya ātmaka artha antara vyatiṣaṅgam kalpayati kāryasya api artha antara tvāt kalpayati asau artha antara vyatiṣaṅgam

original: tenobhayavādisiddhatvādarthāntaramātravyatiṣaṅga evāśrayi tavyaḥ, na kāryavyatiṣaṅgaḥ ; vimatyadhikṛtvāditi bhāvaḥ | kiṃ ca kāryasaṃsargo vyabhicarati, kāryasyākāryeṇa saṃsargat ; arthāntaramātrasaṃsargastvavyati . 5
analyzed: tena ubhaya vādi siddha tvāt artha antara mātra vyatiṣaṅgaḥ eva āśrayi tavyaḥ na kārya vyatiṣaṅgaḥ vimati adhikṛtvāt iti bhāvaḥ kim ca kārya saṃsargaḥ vyabhicarati kāryasya akāryeṇa saṃsargat artha antara mātra saṃsargaḥ tu avyati

original: cārī ; tasmāt sa evāśrayitavyaḥ | evaṃ cetkāryākāryātmakārthāntaramātrasaṃsarge padānāṃ tātparyaśāktiravadhṛtā, tathā sati yatra loke vyavahārāya padaṃ prayujyate vede ca, tatra tena saṃsargaḥ ;
analyzed: cārī tasmāt saḥ eva āśrayitavyaḥ evam ced kārya akārya ātmaka artha antara mātra saṃsarge padānām tātparya śāktiḥ avadhṛtā tathā sati yatra loke vyavahārāya padam prayujyate vede ca tatra tena saṃsargaḥ

original: yatra tu vedānte kāryaṃ na śrūyate, tatra vināpi tena padārthānāṃ parasparasaṃsargādanyonyaviśiṣṭasiddhārthapratyayasiddhiriti siddhaṃ siddhe'pyarthe śabdasya prāmāṇyam | ataśca loke vyutpattivākye dṛṣṭo'pi kāryavyatiṣaṅgo na kāryamātrānvaye śabdatātparyaśaktiniyāmakatvenāśrayitavyaḥ |
analyzed: yatra tu vedānte kāryam na śrūyate tatra vinā api tena padārthānām paraspara saṃsargāt anyonya viśiṣṭa siddhārtha pratyaya siddhiḥ iti siddham siddhe api arthe śabdasya prāmāṇyam atas ca loke vyutpatti vākye dṛṣṭaḥ api kārya vyatiṣaṅgaḥ na kārya mātra anvaye śabda tātparya śakti niyāmaka tvena āśrayitavyaḥ

original: etaccāvaśyaṃ tvayāpyaṅgīkartavyam, anyathā yadyokte dṛṣṭaṃ tacca sarvaṃ padaśaktiniyāmakatvenāśrayite, tato loke vyutpattivākye vaktṛvivakṣāparatvaṃ padārthānvayasya dṛṣṭamiti vede vakturabhāvena vivakṣābhāvāt vidhāyakebhyo'rthapratītirna syāt ; asti ca sā |
analyzed: etat ca avaśyam tvayā api aṅgīkartavyam anyathā yadi ukte dṛṣṭam tat ca sarvam pada śakti niyāmaka tvena āśrayite tatas loke vyutpatti vākye vaktṛ vivakṣā para tvam padārtha anvayasya dṛṣṭam iti vede vaktuḥ abhāvena vivakṣā abhāvāt vidhāyakebhyaḥ ṛtha pratītiḥ na syāt asti ca sā

original: tasmāt kāryavyatiṣaṅgo vyutpattāvatantramityakāryeṇāpi padārthānāṃ saṃsargāt siddhaṃ siddhe'pyarthe śabdasya prāmāṇyam | api ca sarveṣāṃ padānāṃ padārthānāṃ kāryeṇaiva saṃsarge'ṅgīkriyamāṇe'ruṇādīnāṃ parasparaṃ krīṇātinā ca kriyākārakalakṣaṇaḥ saṃsargo na syāt ;
analyzed: tasmāt kārya vyatiṣaṅgaḥ vyutpattau atantram iti akāryeṇa api padārthānām saṃsargāt siddham siddhe api arthe śabdasya prāmāṇyam api ca sarveṣām padānām padārthānām kāryeṇa eva parasparam krīṇātinā ca kriyā kāraka lakṣaṇaḥ saṃsargaḥ na syāt

original: tatrāruṇādikārakaviśiṣṭakrayaviṣayo niyogo na pratīyeta, kiṃ tu krayamātraikapadārthasādhya eva sa syāt | atha matam—kārakaviśiṣṭadhātvarthaviṣayo hi niyogaḥ pratīyate, na dhātvarthamātraviṣayaḥ ; na ca kārakasaṃsargamantareṇa dhātvartho viśiṣṭo bhavati ; tena viniyogaṃ prati na pratyarthī, api tvarthī niyogaḥ ;
analyzed: tatra aruṇa ādi kāraka viśiṣṭa kraya viṣayaḥ niyogaḥ na pratīyeta kim tu kraya mātra eka padārtha sādhyaḥ eva sa syāt atha matam kāraka viśiṣṭa dhātvartha viṣayaḥ hi niyogaḥ pratīyate na dhātvartha mātra viṣayaḥ na ca kāraka saṃsargam antareṇa dhātvarthaḥ viśiṣṭaḥ bhavati tena viniyogam prati na pratyarthī api tu arthī niyogaḥ

original: tataśca niyogānvaye'pi padārthānāṃ na parasparānvayavyāghātaḥ | tatrocyate— niyogācca yāvatpūrvabhāvī tarhi viniyogaḥ | parastu bhavatu pūrvabhāvī viniyogaḥ, tathāpyasti tāvanniyogānvaya iti pṛcchati—kimato yadyevamiti | pa. 26-8. siddhāntī tu svābhiprāyaṃ prakaṭayati—evaṃ sati asti niyogātiriktapadārthānvaye'pi padasya tātparyasāmarthyam ;
analyzed: tatas ca niyoga anvaye api padārthānām na paraspara anvaya vyāghātaḥ tatra ucyate niyogāt ca yāvat pūrva bhāvī tarhi viniyogaḥ paraḥ tu bhavatu pūrva bhāvī viniyogaḥ tathā api asti tāvat niyoga anvayaḥ iti pṛcchati kim atas yadi evam iti pa 268 siddhāntī tu sva abhiprāyam prakaṭayati evam sati asti niyoga atirikta padārtha anvaye pi padasya tātparya sāmarthyam

original: ataḥ siddho naḥ pakṣaḥ | nanu niyogānvayānāmanyonyamanvayaḥ, na tu tannirapekṣāṇām ; ato niyoganibandhana evāsāviti na tena vinopaniṣatsu padānāmanvayaśaktiriti ; tatrāha— niyoganirapekṣameva padānāmanyonyānvayasāmarthyam | kutaḥ ? pūrvaṃ parasparānvitānāṃ satāṃ padānāṃ paścānniyogenānvayāt |
analyzed: atas siddhaḥ naḥ pakṣaḥ nanu niyoga anvayānām anyonyam anvayaḥ na tu tad nirapekṣāṇām atas niyoga nibandhanaḥ eva asau iti na tena vinā upaniṣatsu padānām anvaya śaktiḥ iti tatra āha niyoga nirapekṣam eva padānām anyonya anvaya sāmarthyam kutas pūrvam paraspara anvitānām satām padānām paścāt niyogena anvayāt

original: ayamāśayaḥ—viśiṣṭena hi viṣayeṇa niyogasyānvayastvayeṣṭaḥ ; na cāsau kārakairananvito viśiṣṭo bhavati ; na cāviśiṣṭo niyogenānvayite ; aviśiṣṭasyāviṣayatvāt, aviṣayasya ca
analyzed: ayam āśayaḥ viśiṣṭena hi viṣayeṇa niyogasya anvayaḥ tvayā iṣṭaḥ na ca asau kārakaiḥ ananvitaḥ viśiṣṭaḥ bhavati na ca aviśiṣṭaḥ niyogena anvayite aviśiṣṭasya aviṣaya tvāt aviṣayasya ca

original: niyogenānapekṣaṇām, apekṣānibandhanatvāccāsya ; tasmānniyogānvayātpūrvaḥ padānāmanvaya iti | niyogānvayanirapekṣa eva cet, vināpi tenopaniṣatsu siddhe'pyarthe'nvayaḥ siddha iti | nanu yadi nāma niyogānvayapūrvaḥ padārthānvayo na bhavati, tathāpi niyogākāṅkṣānibandhano'sau ; sa hi viśiṣṭaviṣayasiddhaye padārthānāmanyonyānvayamākāṅkṣate ;
analyzed: niyogena anapekṣaṇām apekṣā nibandhana tvāt ca asya tasmāt niyoga anvayāt pūrvaḥ padānām anvayaḥ iti niyoga anvaya nirapekṣaḥ eva ced vinā api tena upaniṣatsu siddhe pi arthe nvayaḥ siddhaḥ iti nanu yadi nāma niyoga anvaya pūrvaḥ padārtha anvayaḥ na bhavati tathā api niyoga ākāṅkṣā nibandhanā usau sa hi viśiṣṭa viṣaya siddhaye padārthānām anyonya anvayam ākāṅkṣate

original: anyathā kāryānvayaśūnyaḥ padārthānvayo'pi vyarthaḥ syāt, ekavākyatā ca na syāt | evaṃ cedupaniṣatsu na niyogena vinānvayasiddhirityāha—na ca niyogākāṅkṣānibandhanaḥ padārthānāṃ parasparasaṃsarga P. 26-10 itīmamarthaṃ vakṣyati niyogakāṇḍe |
analyzed: anyathā kārya anvaya śūnyaḥ padārtha anvayaḥ api vyarthaḥ syāt ekavākyatā ca na syāt evam ced upaniṣatsu na niyogena vinā anvaya siddhiḥ iti āha na ca niyoga ākāṅkṣā nibandhanaḥ padārthānām paraspara saṃsargaḥ iti imam artham vakṣyati niyoga kāṇḍe

original: yaccoktam—brahmaṇaḥ pramāṇāntarāsiddhatve saṃbandhāgrahādapadārthatve satyavākyatvamiti, tatrocyate—pramāṇāntareṇānadhigatamapi brahma tata eva brahmāntaryāmyādisvaśabdenānadhigatavācyatvasaṃbandhamapi śakyam “asthūlamanaṇvahasvam” ityādiśabdena nirūpayitum |
analyzed: yat ca uktam brahmaṇaḥ pramāṇa antara asiddha tve saṃbandha agrahāt apadārtha tve satya vākyatvam iti tatra ucyate pramāṇa antareṇa anadhigatam api brahma tatas eva brahma antaryāmi ādi sva śabdena anadhigata vācyatva saṃbandham api śakyam asthūlam anaṇu ahasvam iti ādi śabdena nirūpayitum

original: katham? ucyate— ‘sthūlo'ham’ ‘aṇuraham’ ‘hasvo'ham’ ityavidyādhyastasthūlādiviśeṣapratiṣeṣadvāreṇa | na ca yena śabdena tathā pratipādyate tasyāpyasaṃgatidoṣastulya iti vācyam, sthūlādiviśeṣaśabdānāṃ nañaśca sena senārthena viditasaṃbandhatvāt | na ca brahmāntaryāmyādiśabdavadasaṃgatidoṣo'sti |
analyzed: katham ucyate sthūlaḥ ham aṇuḥ aham hasvaḥ ham iti avidyā adhyasta sthūla ādi viśeṣa pratiṣeṣa dvāreṇa na ca yena śabdena tathā pratipādyate tasya api asaṃgati doṣaḥ tulyaḥ iti vācyam sthūla ādi viśeṣa śabdānām nañaḥ ca vidita saṃbandha tvāt na ca brahma antaryāmi ādi śabda vat asaṃgati doṣaḥ asti

original: tena svasiddhasya jīvasya sthūlādiviśeṣaniṣedhamukhenāsthūlādiśabdānāmasti vigataniḥśeṣadoṣatattvābhiṣānaśaktiriti bhāvaḥ | tathā ca śrutyāpi ‘asthūlamanaṇvahasvamadīrghamalohitam’ ityādyayā itthameva sthūlādiviśeṣaniṣedhamukhenaiva tadbrahma sarvaviśeṣātigaṃ sarvān sthūlatvādiviśeṣānatikrāntamupadiśyate ; nāsmābhiḥ svotprekṣyedamuktamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tena sva siddhasya jīvasya sthūla ādi viśeṣa niṣedha mukhena asthūla ādi śabdānām asti vigata niḥśeṣa doṣa tattva abhiṣāna śaktiḥ iti bhāvaḥ tathā ca śrutyā api asthūlam anaṇu ahasvam adīrgham alohitam ityādyayā ittham eva sthūla ādi viśeṣa niṣedha mukhena eva tat brahma sarva viśeṣa atigam sarvān sthūla tva ādi viśeṣa an atikrāntam upadiśyate na asmābhiḥ sva utprekṣya idam uktam iti bhāvaḥ

original: ukte'rthe ślokārthaṃ yojayati—etatkathayatīti | etacca caturthe kāṇḍe vakṣyata itīha na prapañcitam | itīti samāptau | asyaiva ślokasyānyo'rtha ucyate—yadapyuktaṃ pūrvapakṣe pratyastamitasakalaviśeṣaṃ brahma pratipatterevāviṣaya iti, tatrocyate—viśeṣanivṛttyaiva tannirviśeṣaṃ vastu śabdena pratipādyate |
analyzed: ukta īrthe śloka artham yojayati etat kathayati iti etat ca caturthe kāṇḍe vakṣyate iti iha na prapañcitam iti iti samāptau asya eva ślokasya anyaḥ arthaḥ ucyate yat api uktam pūrvapakṣe pratyasta mita sakala viśeṣam brahma pratipatteḥ eva aviṣayaḥ iti tatra ucyate viśeṣa nivṛttyā eva tat nirviśeṣam vastu śabdena pratipādyate

original: idamuktaṃ syāt—dvividhaṃ hi pratipādanaṃ dṛṣṭam; ekaṃ viśeṣamukhena, yathā ‘ayaṃ kuṇḍalī, sa kaṭhakī’ iti; ekaṃ ca viśeṣaniṣedhamukhena, yathā ‘nāṅgadī na makuṭī, sa na kaṭhakī’ iti |
analyzed: idam uktam syāt dvividham hi pratipādanam dṛṣṭam ekam viśeṣa mukhena yathā ayam kuṇḍalī sa kaṭhakī iti ekam ca viśeṣa niṣedha mukhena yathā na aṅgadī na makuṭī sa na kaṭhakī iti

original: tataśca yadi nāma virviśeṣaṃ tattvam ‘itthaṃbhūtam’ iti viśeṣamukhena vaktuṃ na śakyate, tathāpyavidyādhyastaviśeṣaniṣedhamukhena pratipādayiṣyate pratipattyate ceti | atra 6A
analyzed: tatas ca yadi nāma tattvam itthaṃbhūtam iti viśeṣa mukhena vaktum na śakyate tathā api avidyā adhyasta viśeṣa niṣedha mukhena pratipādayiṣyate ca iti atra

original: P. 26-16. dṛṣṭāntamāha—suvarṇaṃ tattvavaditi | tatprapañcayati—na hīti | suvarṇatattvaṃ piṇḍarucakādisaṃsthānaviśeṣairya upalabdhaḥ—uparāgaḥ, saṃmiśratvam, apṛthagbhāvaḥ—tena rahitaṃ rucakādivilakṣaṇaviśeṣaśāli, tebhyaḥ pṛthak na dṛśyate iti | na ca rucakādaya eva suvarṇatattvamiti vācyam, rucakatyāgena saṃsthānāntare svastike'pi bhāvāt;
analyzed: dṛṣṭāntam āha suvarṇam tattva vat iti tat prapañcayati na hi iti suvarṇa tattvam piṇḍa rucaka ādi saṃsthāna viśeṣaiḥ yaḥ upalabdhaḥ uparāgaḥ sammiśra tvam apṛthagbhāvaḥ tena rahitam rucaka ādi vilakṣaṇa viśeṣa śāli tebhyaḥ pṛthak na dṛśyate iti na ca rucaka ādayaḥ eva suvarṇa tattvam iti vācyam rucaka tyāgena saṃsthāna antare svastike api bhāvāt

original: suvarṇatattvasya hi rucakābhede ca rucakavat tadapi svastike na bhavet; asti ca; tasmāt tataḥ pṛthak | evaṃ svastike'pi draṣṭavyam | evaṃ suvarṇatattvaṃ rucakādibhyo'nyadapi pṛthak na dṛśyate; atha ca tādṛśamapi tanna svastikaḥ, rucake bhāvāt; na rucakaḥ; svastike bhāvāt;
analyzed: suvarṇa tattvasya hi rucaka abhede ca rucaka vat tat api svastike na bhavet asti ca tasmāt tatas pṛthak evam svastike pi draṣṭavyam evam suvarṇa tattvam rucaka ādibhyaḥ nyat api pṛthak na dṛśyate atha ca tādṛśam api tat na svastikaḥ rucake bhāvāt na rucakaḥ svastike bhāvāt

original: ato'nyaditi vivekabuddhyā ‘na tadbuddhako na svastikaḥ’ iti rucakādibhedāpohadvāreṇa rucakādiviśeṣaniṣedhe tebhyaḥ sarvāntaraṃ suvarṇatattvaṃ svayaṃ pratīyate parasmai ca pratipādyate, tathā brahmāpītyarthaḥ | na dṛṣṭaḥ saṃsthānabhedopalabdhāt viveko yasyeti vigrahaḥ | etacca gotvādāvapi tulyam; udāharaṇamātraṃ suvarṇam |
analyzed: atonyat iti viveka buddhyā na tad buddhakaḥ na svastikaḥ iti rucaka ādi bheda apoha dvāreṇa rucaka ādi viśeṣa niṣedhe tebhyaḥ sarva antaram suvarṇa tattvam svayam pratīyate parasmai ca pratipādyate tathā brahmā api iti arthaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ saṃsthāna bheda upalabdhāt vivekaḥ yasya iti vigrahaḥ etat ca go tva ādau api tulyam udāharaṇa mātram suvarṇam

original: imamarthaṃ śrutyā draḍhayati—sa eṣa iti | asminnevārthe'bhiyuktavākyadvayaṃ paṭhati—tatheti | uktamiti vākyaśeṣaḥ | sthūlādyākārāṇāṃ viśeṣāṇāmupasaṃhāre vilaye ante avasāne yat vyavatiṣṭhate tatsatyamityarthaḥ | tathā parairapyuktam—paramārthato niṣprapañcameva brahma;
analyzed: imam artham śrutyā draḍhayati saḥ eṣaḥ iti asmin eva artha ibhiyukta vākya dvayam paṭhati tathā iti uktam iti vākyaśeṣaḥ sthūla ādi ākārāṇām viśeṣāṇām upasaṃhāre vilaye ante avasāne yat vyavatiṣṭhate tat satyam iti arthaḥ tathā paraiḥ api uktam paramārthataḥ niṣprapañcam eva brahma

original: tadavidyayā prapañcasyādhyāropeṇa tadapavādana tanniṣedhena ca prapañcyate vyākhyāyata ityarthaḥ | evaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prapañcavilayadvāreṇāmnāyagamyatvamuktvā āmnāyaviśeṣanirdhāraṇāya idamidānīṃ vicāryate—kiṃ kṛtsna eva svarūpakāryaniṣṭha āmnāyo bhedaniṣedhadvāreṇādvayaṃ brahma gamayati, uta kaścidasyāmnāyasya vedāntākhya ekadeśa iti |
analyzed: tat avidyayā prapañcasya adhyāropeṇa tad apavādana tad niṣedhena ca prapañcyate vyākhyāyate iti arthaḥ evam brahmaṇaḥ prapañca vilaya dvāreṇa āmnāya gamya tvam uktvā āmnāya viśeṣa nirdhāraṇāya idam idānīm vicāryate kim kṛtsnaḥ eva svarūpa kārya niṣṭhaḥ āmnāyaḥ bheda niṣedha dvāreṇa advayam brahma gamayati uta kaścid asya āmnāyasya vedānta ākhyaḥ eka deśaḥ iti

original: tatra tasmin saṃdehe kecidāhuḥ—sarvatrāmnāye kacit kasyacidvedasya pravilayo gamyate | tena tadadvāreṇa kṛtsna evāmnāyo brahma gamayatīti bhāvaḥ | tad darśayati—yathā “sargakāmo yajet” ityāmnāyāt śarīrasyātmatvapravilayo gamyata iti pūrveṇānvayaḥ |
analyzed: tatra tasmin saṃdehe kecid āhuḥ sarvatra āmnāye kacid kasyacid vedasya pravilayaḥ gamyate tena tad advāreṇa kṛtsnaḥ eva āmnāyaḥ brahma gamayati iti bhāvaḥ tat darśayati yathā sarga kāmaḥ yajet iti āmnāyāt śarīrasya ātma tva pravilayaḥ gamyate iti pūrveṇa anvayaḥ

original: katham? ucyate—atra hi vākye dehasya lokāntaramananuvartamānasya jaḍasya ca janmāntarīyasvargopabhogasāmarthyābhāvāt tadyatirikto janmāntarānuvartī cetanaśca svargopabhogasamarthyo'dhikārī gamyate; sa eva catvāmeti dehātmavilayo gamyata iti
analyzed: katham ucyate atra hi vākye dehasya loka antaram ananuvartamānasya jaḍasya ca janma antarīya svarga upabhoga sāmarthya abhāvāt janma antara anuvartī cetanaḥ ca svarga upabhoga samarthya udhikārī gamyate saḥ eva deha ātma vilayaḥ gamyate iti

original: pūrveṇaivānvayaḥ | tathā “godohanena paśukāmasya” ityatra godohanasyākriyātmano'nanyotpādanasvabhāvasya sākṣātpaśusādhanatvāsaṃbhavāt kriyāṃ svāśrayamapekṣamāṇasya prakaraṇāt dārśapaurṇamāsikīṃ praṇayanakriyāmāśritya paśusādhanatvamityarthāt darśapūrṇamāsādhikṛtasyaivādhikārādadhikārī bhinno niṣedhyate | P. 27-4.
analyzed: pūrveṇa eva anvayaḥ tathā godohanena paśu kāmasya iti atra godohanasya akriyā ātmanaḥ na anya utpādana svabhāvasya sākṣāt paśu sādhanatva asaṃbhavāt kriyām sva āśrayam apekṣamāṇasya prakaraṇāt dārśapaurṇamāsikīm praṇayana kriyām āśritya paśu sādhanatvam iti arthāt darśa pūrṇamāsa adhikṛtasya eva adhikārāt adhikārī bhinnaḥ niṣedhyate

original: nanvevamādiṣu bhavatu bhedavilayaḥ, vidhiniṣedhacodanāsu tu pravṛttinivṛttimātraphalāsu tadasaṃbhavānna kṛtsnānnāyo bhedapravilayapara ityāśaṅkya tatrāpi bhedapravilayamāha—tatheti | tathā vidhiniṣedhacodanāsvapi svābhāvikīnāṃ rāgadveṣanibandhanānāṃ bāhyapravṛttīnāṃ niṣedho gamyata ityanvayaḥ |
analyzed: nanu evamādiṣu bhavatu bheda vilayaḥ vidhi niṣedha codanāsu tu pravṛtti nivṛtti mātra phalāsu tad asaṃbhavān na bheda pravilaya paraḥ iti āśaṅkya tatra api bheda pravilayam āha tathā iti tathā vidhi niṣedha codanāsu api svābhāvikīnām rāga dveṣa nibandhanānām bāhya pravṛttīnām niṣedhaḥ gamyate iti anvayaḥ

original: tatra niṣedheṣu sākṣādeva ‘nedaṃ kuru’ iti pravṛttyantaraniṣedho'vagamyata ityāha— niṣedheṣviti | nanvevamastu niṣedheṣu ; vidhiṣu tu pravṛttimātraphaleṣu kathamityata āha—vidhiṣviti | vidhiṣu tu “sandhyāmupāsīta” iti pravṛttyantaraniyogena tatkālabāhyapravṛttiniṣedho'vagamyate | etaduktaṃ bhavati—ubhayatrāpi bāhyapravṛttivilayo na viśiṣyate;
analyzed: tatra niṣedheṣu sākṣāt eva na idam kuru iti pravṛtti antara niṣedhaḥ uvagamyate iti āha niṣedheṣu iti nanu evam astu niṣedheṣu vidhiṣu tu pravṛtti mātra phaleṣu katham iti atas āha vidhiṣu iti vidhiṣu tu sandhyām upāsīta iti pravṛtti antara niyogena tad kāla bāhya pravṛtti niṣedhaḥ uvagamyate etat uktam bhavati ubhayatra api bāhya pravṛtti vilayaḥ na viśiṣyate

original: ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ—yanniṣedheṣu sākṣāt, vidhiṣu punararthāditi | lokadṛṣṭe cedaṃ prakāradvayamityāha—loka iti | loke'pyanabhipretāt pathaḥ sakāśāt ‘anenādhvanā mā gaccha’ iti sākṣādvā nivāraṇaṃ dṛśyate, mārgāntaropadeśena vā vivakṣitānabhimatamārganiṣedhenārthāt | tadevaṃ vidhiniṣedhacodanāsvapi rāgādinibandhanapravṛttivilayo gamyata iti sthitam |
analyzed: ayam tu viśeṣaḥ yat niṣedheṣu sākṣāt vidhiṣu punar arthāt iti loka dṛṣṭe ca idam prakāra dvayam iti āha loke iti loke api anabhipretāt pathaḥ sakāśāt anena adhvanā mā gaccha iti sākṣāt vā nivāraṇam dṛśyate mārga antara upadeśena vā vivakṣita anabhimata mārga niṣedhena arthāt tat evam vidhi niṣedha codanāsu api rāga ādi nibandhana pravṛtti vilayaḥ gamyate iti sthitam

original: evaṃ caiṣa guṇo bhavati—rāgādinibandhanaisargikapravṛttirūpabhedavilayadvāreṇa mukṣukṣoḥ śāntatādadhikāriviśeṣaṇamupapādayanto dṛṣṭenaivopakāreṇāvadhātādivat sannipatyopakāritayā karmavidhayaḥ “ātmā jñātavyaḥ” ityātmajñānādhikāropayoginaḥ syutthidṛṣṭakalpanāgauravaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: evam ca eṣa guṇaḥ bhavati rāga ādi nibandha naisargika pravṛtti rūpa bheda vilaya dvāreṇa mukṣukṣoḥ śānta tāt adhikāri viśeṣaṇam upapādayantaḥ dṛṣṭena eva upakāreṇa avadhāta ādi vat sannipatya upakāri tayā karma vidhayaḥ ātmā jñātavyaḥ iti ātma jñāna adhikāra upayoginaḥ na bhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: śrutyāpi rāgādinibandhanāśeṣabāhyapravṛttinivṛttiradhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ darśitamityāha—tathā hīti | śāntasya samāhitasya cātmani viṣaye darśanamupadiśyate—“tasmācchānto dānta uparatastitikṣuḥ samāhito bhūtvā ātmanyevātmānaṃ paśyet” ityādiśrutyā | tatra śānta ityantaḥkaraṇapūrvakarāgādijapravṛttinivṛttiradhikāriviśeṣaṇamuktam;
analyzed: śrutyā api rāga ādi nibandhana aśeṣa bāhya pravṛtti nivṛttiḥ adhikāri viśeṣaṇam darśitam iti āha tathā hi iti śāntasya samāhitasya ca ātmani viṣaye darśanam upadiśyate tasmāt śāntaḥ dāntaḥ uparataḥ titikṣuḥ samāhitaḥ bhūtvā ātmani eva ātmānam paśyet ityādi śrutyā tatra śāntaḥ iti antaḥkaraṇa pūrvaka rāga ādi ja pravṛtti nivṛttiḥ adhikāri viśeṣaṇam uktam

original: dānta iti vahiḥkaraṇapūrvakarāgādijapravṛttinivṛttiḥ | anye tu viparyayamāhuḥ—avaśyaṃ caitadadhikāriviśeṣaṇamāsyeyam, yataḥ samartho'dhikārī bhavati; taccātmajñānaṃ śāntadāntasamāhitasyaiva śakyam,
analyzed: dāntaḥ iti vahiḥkaraṇa pūrvaka rāga ādi ja pravṛtti nivṛttiḥ anye tu viparyayam āhuḥ avaśyam ca etat adhikāri viśeṣaṇam āsyeyam yatas samarthaḥ udhikārī bhavati tat ca ātma jñānam śānta dānta samāhitasya eva śakyam

original: netarasya ; tena sa evādhikārī, natara iti bhāvaḥ | kutaḥ P. 27-10. punaritarasyātmajñānamaśakyamityata āha — na hīti |
analyzed: na itarasya tena saḥ eva adhikārī nataraḥ iti bhāvaḥ kutas punar itarasya ātma jñānam aśakyam iti atas āha na hi iti

original: viṣaye ramaṇīyatayābhimukhamākṛṣyamāṇo viṣayasyopāye yā pravṛttiḥ tatra kṛtaṃ ceto yena tatprasaktamanā yaḥ, sa yasmānna śaknotyātmani viṣaye samādhānaṃ kartum, na vāstamāhitaḥ śaknotyātmānaṃ vettum, ato'samarthatvānnāsāvadhikārīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: viṣaye ramaṇīya tayā abhimukham ākṛṣyamāṇaḥ viṣayasya upāye yā pravṛttiḥ tatra kṛtam cetaḥ yena tad prasakta manāḥ yaḥ sa yasmāt na śaknoti ātmani viṣaye samādhānam kartum na śaknoti ātmānam vettum atas samartha tvāt na asau adhikārī iti bhāvaḥ
