original: yaḥ punā rāganibandhanābhyo naisargikībhyaḥ pravṛttibhya uparataḥ śānto dānto'ta eva niyatamānaso nirastavāhvāntaravikṣepaḥ sa śaknotyātmani samādhātumityātmajñānasamarthatvādātmadarśane'dhikriyate | tasmānnaisargikapravṛttiniṣedhaparatve karmavidhayo dṛṣṭenaiva jñānādhikāropayogino bhavantīti tatparā eva te yuktā iti kecit manyante |
analyzed: yaḥ punar rāga nibandhanābhyaḥ naisargikībhyaḥ pravṛttibhyaḥ uparataḥ śāntaḥ dānta ūtaḥ eva niyata mānasaḥ sa śaknoti ātmani samādhātum iti ātma jñāna samartha tvāt ātma darśanā idhikriyate tasmāt naisargika pravṛtti niṣedha para tve karma vidhayaḥ dṛṣṭena eva jñāna adhikāra upayoginaḥ bhavanti iti tad parāḥ eva te yuktāḥ iti kecid manyante

original: anye tvanyathā ātmajñānādhikāropayogitāṃ karmavidhīnāṃ manyante ; kathaṃ tat ? ucyate — anavāptakāmaḥ, kāmyanta iti kāmāḥ svargādayaḥ, anavāptāḥ kāmā yena so'navāptakāmaḥ ; kāmopahatamanāḥ, kāmanā kāmaḥ viṣayasukhābhilāṣaḥ, tenopahatamasvasthīkṛtaṃ mano yasya sa paramādvaitadarśanayogyo na bhavatīti na tatrādhikriyate ;
analyzed: anye tu anyathā ātma jñāna adhikāra upayogi tām karma vidhīnām manyante katham tat ucyate anavāpta kāmaḥ kāmyante iti kāmāḥ svarga ādayaḥ an avāptāḥ kāmāḥ yena saḥ na avāpta kāmaḥ kāma upahata manāḥ kāmanā kāmaḥ viṣaya sukha abhilāṣaḥ tena upahatam asvasthīkṛtam manaḥ yasya sa parama advaita darśana yogyaḥ na bhavati iti na tatra adhikriyate

original: na khalvayogyo'dhikāraṃ pratipadyate | yaḥ punarāśrānādārabhya sahasrasaṃvatsarākhyasatraparyantaiḥ karmabhirupanītāśeṣakāmyairavāptāśeṣakāmyatayā kṛtakāmanibarhaṇaḥ, kṛtaḥ kāmasya viṣayasukhābhilāṣasya nibarhaṇaṃ vināśo yasya sa prājāpatyāt prajāpateridaṃ prājāpatyaṃ padaṃ tataḥ paramavāptāśeṣakāmyatayā anupahatamanāḥ sannadvaitamātmānaṃ
analyzed: na khalu ayogya adhikāram pratipadyate yaḥ punar āśrānāt ārabhya sahasra saṃvatsara ākhya satra paryantaiḥ karmabhiḥ upanīta aśeṣa kāmyaiḥ avāpta aśeṣa kāmyatayā kṛta kāma nibarhaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ kāmasya viṣaya sukha abhilāṣasya nibarhaṇam vināśaḥ yasya sa prājāpatyāt prajāpateḥ idam prājāpatyam padam tatas param avāpta aśeṣa kāmyatayā anupahata manāḥ san advaitam ātmānam

original: pratipadyate | evaṃ kāmanibarhaṇadvāreṇa karmavidhīnāmātmajñānādhikāropayoga ityanye manyante | evaṃ caiṣa sarvatrānnāye vākyārtho jñātaḥ — sahasrasaṃvatsarāntaṃ karmajātamātmani jijñāsunā kāryamiti |
analyzed: pratipadyate evam kāma nibarhaṇa dvāreṇa karma vidhīnām ātma jñāna adhikāra upayogaḥ iti anye manyante evam ca eṣa sarvatra annāye vākya arthaḥ jñātaḥ sahasra saṃvatsara antam karma jātam ātmani jijñāsunā kāryam iti

original: ubhayorapi cānantarayoḥ karmavidhīnāmātmajñānādhikāropayogitvapakṣayoḥ kṛtsna āmrāya ātmajñānaikakāryaparyavasāyī, ātmajñāne ekasmin kārye paryavasyati samāpyate ; tatpara iti yāvat | na bhāvāntarakāryaparyavasāyītyekaprahaṇam |
analyzed: ubhayoḥ api ca anantarayoḥ karma vidhīnām ātma jñāna adhikāra upayogi tva pakṣayoḥ kṛtsnaḥ āmrāyaḥ ātma jñāna eka kārya paryavasāyī ātma jñāne ekasmin kārye paryavasyati samāpyate tad paraḥ iti yāvat na bhāva antara kārya paryavasāyī iti eka prahaṇam

original: tatrādye pakṣe vivakṣitāvāntaraniyogaphalānāṃ karmaniyogānāmātmajñānaparamaniyogānvayaḥ, dvitīye tvavāntarakarmaniyogaphaladvāreṇeti vivekaḥ |
analyzed: tatra ādye pakṣe vivakṣita avāntara niyoga phalānām karma niyogānām ātma jñāna parama niyoga anvayaḥ dvitīye tu avāntara karma niyoga phala dvāreṇa iti vivekaḥ

original: matāntaramāha—anyeṣāṃ darśanamiti | pṛthakkāryā eva, mokṣaphalāt P. 27-17 jñānāt pṛthakkāryāḥ pṛthakkalāḥ ; pṛthakkaraṇā vā, karaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ ; svapradhānā iti yāvat ; te pṛthakkāryā eva santo mumukṣuṃ puruṣamātmajñānādhikāramavatārayanti ; adhikārayogyaṃ kurvantīti yāvat | dvikarmako'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ ‘ajāṃ grāmaṃ nayati’ iti yadvat |
analyzed: mata antaram āha anyeṣām darśanam iti pṛthakkāryāḥ eva mokṣa phalāt jñānāt pṛthakkāryāḥ pṛthak kalāḥ pṛthak karaṇāḥ vā karaṇam kāryam yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ svapradhānāḥ iti yāvat te pṛthakkāryāḥ eva santaḥ mumukṣum puruṣam ātma jñāna adhikāram avatārayanti adhikāra yogyam kurvanti iti yāvat dvi karmakaḥ ayam nirdeśaḥ ajām grāmam nayati iti yadvat

original: kutaḥ ? anapākṛtaṛṇatrayasya, anapākṛtamṛṇatrayaṃ yena, tasya tatrātmajñāne'nadhikārāt | kutastasyānadhikāraḥ ? “ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mano mokṣe niveśayet” iti manuvacanāt | ṛṇatrayaṃ ca śrutyaivoktam—“jātastribhi ṛṇai ṛṇavān jāyate brahmacaryeṇarṣibhyo yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ” iti |
analyzed: kutas anapākṛta ṛṇa trayasya anapākṛtam ṛṇa trayam yena tasya tatra ātma jñānena adhikārāt kutas tasya anadhikāraḥ ṛṇāni trīṇi apākṛtya manaḥ mokṣe niveśayet iti manu vacanāt ṛṇa trayam ca śrutyā eva uktam jātaḥ tribhiḥ ṛṇaiḥ ṛṇavān jāyate brahmacaryeṇa ṛṣibhyaḥ yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ iti

original: nanu kāmanivarhaṇapakṣe'pi pṛthakkāryatvaṃ karmavidhīnāmastyeva ; ataḥ ko'sya pakṣasya viśeṣaḥ ? ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ—tatra hi na phalaṃ phalāyoktam, kiṃ tu kāmāvāptyā tatkāmanivṛttāvakāmasyātmajñānādhikāralabhāya ; tena tatrāvāntarakāryamavivakṣitam ;
analyzed: nanu kāma nivarhaṇa pakṣe api pṛthak kārya tvam karma vidhīnām asti eva atas kaḥ asya pakṣasya viśeṣaḥ ayam viśeṣaḥ tatra hi na phalam phalāya uktam kim tu kāma avāptyā tad kāma nivṛttau akāmasya ātma jñāna adhikāra labhāya tena tatra avāntara kāryam avivakṣitam

original: iha tu vivakṣitāvāntararūpāpākaraṇakāryā eva karmavidhaya- “bṛhaspatisaveneṣṭvā vājapeyena yajeta” iti vadātmajñānādhikāropayogina iti na doṣaḥ | matāntaraṃ cāha—anye tviti |
analyzed: iha tu vivakṣita avāntara rūpa apākaraṇa kāryāḥ eva karma vidhayaḥ bṛhaspatisavena iṣṭvā vājapeyena yajeta iti vat ātma jñāna adhikāra upayoginaḥ iti na doṣaḥ mata antaram ca āha anye tu iti

original: śrutasargādiphalasaṃprayuktānāmata eva prayojanāntaranirapekṣāṇāmapi “tametaṃ yajñena dānena tapasānāśakana vividiṣanti” iti vidinā saṃyogapṛthaktvena jñānenāpi pṛthak sambandhāntaraśruteḥ “ekasya tūbhayatve saṃyogapṛthaktvam” iti nyāyena “svādiro yūṣo bhavati” “yūṣe paśuṃ badhnāti” “svādiraṃ vīryakāmasya” itivat nityanaimittikakāmyānāṃ
analyzed: śruta sarga ādi phala saṃprayuktānām atas eva prayojana antara nirapekṣāṇām api tam etam yajñena dānena tapasā anāśakana vividiṣanti iti vidinā saṃyoga pṛthaktvena jñānena api pṛthak sambandha antara śruteḥ ekasya tu ubhaya tve saṃyoga pṛthaktvam iti nyāyena svādiraḥ yūṣaḥ bhavati yūṣe paśum badhnāti svādiram vīrya kāmasya itivat nitya naimittika kāmyānām

original: sarvakarmaṇāmevātmajñānādhikārānupraveśaṃ viniyogādevānye tvāhuriti sambandhaḥ | tuśabdo viśeṣārthaḥ | viśeṣaśrātra pakṣe jñāne karmānvayasya viniyogitvam | tathā manovikṣepanivṛttidvāreṇa karmaṇāmātmajñānādhikārānupraveśitvaparaṃ śrutyantaramāha—yena keneti | matāntaramāha—anye tviti | saṃskṛto hi puruṣa ātmajñānādhikārayogyo bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sarva karmaṇām eva ātma jñāna adhikāra anupraveśam viniyogāt eva anye tu āhuḥ iti sambandhaḥ tuśabdaḥ viśeṣa arthaḥ viśeṣaḥ atra pakṣe jñāne karma anvayasya viniyogi tvam tathā manaḥ vikṣepa nivṛtti dvāreṇa karmaṇām ātma jñāna adhikāra anupraveśi tva param śruti antaram āha yena kena iti mata antaram āha anye tu iti saṃskṛtaḥ hi puruṣaḥ ātma jñāna adhikāra yogyaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: atrārthaṃ smṛtidvayamāha—mahāyajñairiti | mahāyajñaiḥ brahmadevapitṛmanupyabhūtavajñaiḥ itarayajñairiyaṃ tanuḥ brāhmī brahmaṇyadhikṛtā, ye yā
analyzed: atra artham smṛti dvayam āha mahāyajñaiḥ iti mahāyajñaiḥ itara yajñaiḥ iyam tanuḥ brāhmī brahmaṇi adhikṛtāḥ ye yā

original: brahmavidyāyām “tadadhīte tadveda” ityaṇo vidhānāt, kriyata ityarthaḥ | tanuriti tātsthye upacārādātmocyate | sa hi brahmajñāne'dhikārī brahmavicca na tanuḥ, jaḍatvāt |
analyzed: brahma vidyāyām tat adhīte tat vedaḥ iti aṇoḥ vidhānāt kriyate iti arthaḥ tanuḥ iti tātsthye upacārāt ātmā ucyate sa hi brahma jñāna adhikārī brahma vid ca na tanuḥ jaḍa tvāt

analyzed: tatra naiyogika pravṛttīnām rāga ākṣipta pravṛtti nirodhaka tve dhana arjanam api nirudhyeta atas ca asādhanasya naiyogika pravṛtti asaṃbhavāt tāḥ api virudhyeran iti bhāvaḥ dūṣaṇa antarāya upakramate api ca iti dṛṣṭa arthāyāḥ strī saṃbhoga ādi pravṛtteḥ adṛṣṭa arthāyāḥ ca jyotiṣṭoma ādi pravṛtteḥ tulye sukha upāya tve rāga prayukta tve na kaścid viśeṣaḥ

original: jabhe api sukharāgaprayukte ityarthaḥ | tulyatvameva darśayati— tathā hīti | itiśabdaḥ svarūpanirdeśārthaḥ | sargakāmaśabdena “tasya lipsārthalakṣaṇā” iti nyāyena svarge rāgataḥ prāptāṃ pravṛttimanūya tatra jyotiṣṭomādisādhanaviśeṣo vidhīyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: api sukha rāga prayukte iti arthaḥ tulya tvam eva darśayati tathā hi iti iti śabdaḥ svarūpa nirdeśa arthaḥ sarga kāma śabdena tasya lipsā artha lakṣaṇā iti nyāyena svarge rāgataḥ prāptām pravṛttim anūya tatra jyotiṣṭoma ādi sādhana viśeṣaḥ vidhīyate iti arthaḥ

original: yadi nāma dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthapravṛttīnāṃ rāgaprayuktatvaṃ tulyam, tathāpi kimityata āha—tathā ceti | tathā tulye rāgaprayuktatve sati ca rāgākṣiptasukhasādhanādiprapaścābhiniveśe tulye ko viśeṣaḥ, yena naiyogikī ātmajñānaṃ pratyanuguṇā bhavati, aparā
analyzed: yadi nāma dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa artha pravṛttīnām rāga prayukta tvam tulyam tathā api kim iti atas āha tathā ca iti tathā tulye rāga prayukta tve sati ca rāga ākṣipta sukha sādhana ādi prapaśca abhiniveśe tulye kaḥ viśeṣaḥ yena naiyogikī ātma jñānam pratyanuguṇā bhavati aparā

original: tu dṛṣṭārthā ātmajñānavirodhinītiḥ na ko'pyastītyarthaḥ | aviśeṣe hetumāha—kāmeti | kāmaḥ sukhābhilāṣo rāgaḥ, tenākarṣaṇaṃ manaso P. 22-24. dṛṣṭārthāyāmadṛṣṭārthāyāṃ ca pravṛttāvaviśiṣṭam; dṛṣṭārthapravṛttivadadṛṣṭārthāyāmapi svargādisukhakāmākṛṣṭaṃ mano'samāhitaṃ nātmajñānakṣamam; ataḥ sāpi tadvirodhinīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tu dṛṣṭa arthā ātma jñāna virodhi nītiḥ na kaḥ api asti iti arthaḥ aviśeṣe hetum āha kāma iti kāmaḥ sukha abhilāṣaḥ rāgaḥ tena ākarṣaṇam manasaḥ dṛṣṭa arthāyām adṛṣṭa arthāyām ca pravṛttau aviśiṣṭam dṛṣṭa artha pravṛtti vat adṛṣṭa arthāyām api svarga ādi sukha kāma ākṛṣṭam manaḥ samāhitam na ātma jñāna kṣamam atas sā api tad virodhinī iti bhāvaḥ

original: atha svargasya guṇatvenānvayānna jyotiṣṭomādeḥ kāmyasvargopāyatvam; ato na tatra kāmākṣepo manasa ityasti viśeṣa ityāśaṅkayati—atheti | tatra dūṣaṇamāha—varṇitamiti | jyotiṣṭomāderakāmopāyatve jantūnāmabhyudayavinipātā ākasmikāḥ syuriti varṇitamityarthaḥ | doṣāntaramāha—uktaśceti |
analyzed: atha svargasya guṇa tvena anvayāt na jyotiṣṭoma ādeḥ kāmya svarga upāyatvam atas na tatra kāma ākṣepaḥ manasaḥ iti asti viśeṣaḥ iti āśaṅkayati atha iti tatra dūṣaṇam āha varṇitam iti jyotiṣṭoma ādeḥ akāma upāya tve jantūnām abhyudaya vinipātāḥ ākasmikāḥ syuḥ iti varṇitam iti arthaḥ doṣa antaram āha uktaḥ ca iti

original: svargasya sādhyatvenānvaya iti ṣaṣṭhāye jaimininoktaśca nyāyaḥ pratyuddhiyeta; ucchabda uddhārārthaḥ; pratiśabdaśca tatpratipakṣārthaḥ; adhaḥ kriyetetyarthaḥ | pūrvāparaviruddhaścāyaṃ pakṣa ityāha—tulyeti |
analyzed: svargasya sādhya tvena anvayaḥ iti ṣaṣṭha āye jaimininā uktaḥ ca nyāyaḥ pratyuddhiyeta ucchabdaḥ uddhāra arthaḥ pratiśabdaḥ ca tad pratipakṣa arthaḥ adhas kriyeta iti arthaḥ pūrva apara viruddhaḥ ca ayam pakṣaḥ iti āha tulya iti

original: dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthapravṛttyostulyakāryatvena virodhāt yā pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthapravṛttyornirodhāśaṅkā kṛtā, sāpi jyotiṣṭomāderakāmopāyatve tulyakāryatvābhāvāt dūre nirastāvakāśā syādityarthaḥ; dūranirasto'vakāśo yasyā iti vigrahaḥ | prakārāntareṇa karmavidhīnāmātmajñānānuguṇyaṃ dṛṣṭenāśaṅkayati—atheti |
analyzed: dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa artha pravṛttyoḥ tulya kāryatvena virodhāt yā pūrvam dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa artha pravṛttyoḥ nirodha āśaṅkā kṛtā sā api jyotiṣṭoma ādeḥ akāma upāya tve tulya kāryatva abhāvāt dūre nirasta avakāśā syāt iti arthaḥ dūra nirasta uvakāśaḥ yasyāḥ iti vigrahaḥ prakāra antareṇa karma vidhīnām ātma jñāna ānuguṇyam dṛṣṭena āśaṅkayati atha iti

original: kāmasyāprāptau kāmānukūlaḥ puruṣo'samāhitatvānnātmajñānakṣamaḥ; karmavidhibhiḥ kāmyeṣu prāpiteṣu kāmanāḥ pravilīyante; tena kāmyaprāptidvāreṇa karmavidhayaḥ kāmān kāmanāḥ pravilāpayanta ātmajñānādhikārānuguṇyaṃ bhajanta ityarthaḥ | pravilīnakāmasya jñānotpattidvāreṇa muktirityatraiva śrutimāha—yathoktamiti | tad dūṣayati—tadapyasaditi |
analyzed: kāmasya aprāptau kāma anukūlaḥ puruṣaḥ samāhita tvāt na ātma jñāna kṣamaḥ karma vidhibhiḥ kāmyeṣu prāpiteṣu kāmanāḥ pravilīyante tena kāmya prāpti dvāreṇa karma vidhayaḥ kāmān kāmanāḥ pravilāpayantaḥ ātma jñāna adhikāra ānuguṇyam bhajante iti arthaḥ pravilīna kāmasya jñāna utpatti dvāreṇa muktiḥ iti atra eva śrutim āha yathā uktam iti tat dūṣayati tat api asat iti

original: kuta ityāha—yata iti | sādhu brūte bhavān, yadi kāmaprāptyā tatkāmanāḥ pravilīyante; na tu tatprāptyā tāḥ pravilīyanta ityarthaḥ | kena tarhi tat pravilīyanta ityata āha—api tviti | viṣayāṇāmanityatādidoṣaparibhāvanā anucintanam, tato bhavatīti dāṣaparibhāvanodbhūtena prasaṃkhyānena vivekena vilaya ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: kutas iti āha yatas iti sādhu brūte bhavān yadi kāma prāptyā tad kāmanāḥ pravilīyante na tu tad prāptyā tāḥ pravilīyante iti arthaḥ kena tarhi tat pravilīyante iti atas āha api tu iti viṣayāṇām anitya tā ādi doṣa paribhāvanā anucintanam tatas bhavati iti prasaṃkhyānena vivekena vilayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kāmyasaṃsparśastu manaso viparyayakārītyāha—kalayeti | mātrayāpi cetkāmyairmanaḥ saṃspṛśyate tato hyiyata eva tadatyantamākṛṣyata eva tairhāribhiḥ manoharaṇaśallaiḥ; na tu tebhyo niruttakāmaṃ mano bhavatītyarthaḥ | tadevābhiyuktavākyābhyāṃ draḍhayati—
analyzed: kāmya saṃsparśaḥ tu manasaḥ viparyaya kārī iti āha kalayā iti mātrayā api ced kāmyaiḥ manaḥ saṃspṛśyate tatas hi iyatas eva tat atyantam ākṛṣyate eva taiḥ hāribhiḥ manoharaṇa śallaiḥ na tu tebhyaḥ nirutta kāmam manaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ tat eva abhiyukta vākyābhyām draḍhayati

original: P. 30-6. uktamiti | na kevalaṃ dharmavidhayaḥ kāmyavilayahetavo na bhavanti, pratyuta viparyayakāriṇa ityāha—anupāyatvāditi | karmavidhiṣvasatsu kāmopāyabhūtayāgādyajñānādanupāyatvādapi tāvadayaṃ pumān kāmebhyo nivarteta; upaśāmyatyanenetyupaśamaḥ, nikhilasyāvidyādeḥ cheśasyopaśamaḥ, tadrūpaṃ cātmajñānamāśrayet;
analyzed: uktam iti na kevalam dharma vidhayaḥ kāmya vilaya hetavaḥ na bhavanti pratyuta viparyaya kāriṇaḥ iti āha anupāya tvāt iti karma vidhiṣu asatsu kāma upāya bhūta yāga ādi ajñānāt anupāya tvāt api tāvat ayam pumān kāmebhyaḥ nivarteta upaśāmyati anena iti upaśamaḥ nikhilasya avidyā ādeḥ upaśamaḥ tad rūpam ca ātma jñānam āśrayet

original: karmavidhiṣu tu satsu tairdarśito vividho yāgadānādirūpāyo yasya satathāvidhaḥ pumān tāneva kāmyān prakṛtihāriṇaḥ prakṛtyā svabhāvena mano hartuṃ śīlān, prakṛtiṃ ca svabhāvaṃ puṃso hartuṃ śīlān, api tu taṃ vikṛtaṃ kartuṃ śīlānabhiniviśeta teṣveva sutarāṃ baddhagraho bhavet;
analyzed: karma vidhiṣu tu satsu taiḥ darśitaḥ vividhaḥ yāga dāna ādi rūpāyaḥ yasya sa tathāvidhaḥ pumān tān eva kāmyān prakṛti hāriṇaḥ prakṛtyā svabhāvena manaḥ hartum śīlān prakṛtim ca svabhāvam puṃsaḥ hartum śīlān api tu tam vikṛtam kartum śīlān abhiniviśeta teṣu eva sutarām baddha grahaḥ bhavet

original: teṣāṃ kāmānāṃ ca pravilayaḥ, pravilīyate'neneti pravilayaḥ, tadrūpāccātmajñānādiṣṭavidhātakatvenodvijetetyarthaḥ | nanu viṣayasukhamanityamalpaṃ duḥkhānuṣaṅgi ca; jñānaphalaṃ ca paramānandastadviparītaḥ, “paramo hyeṣa ānandaḥ” iti śruteḥ; tena tatraivābhilāṣaḥ prāptaḥ; sa ca viṣayānandābhilāṣamucchetsyati;
analyzed: teṣām kāmānām ca pravilayaḥ pravilīyate enā iti pravilayaḥ tad rūpāt ca ātma jñānāt iṣṭavidhātaka tvena udvijeta iti arthaḥ nanu viṣaya sukham anityam alpam duḥkha anuṣaṅgi ca jñāna phalam ca parama ānandaḥ tad viparītaḥ paramaḥ hi eṣaḥ ānandaḥ iti śruteḥ tena tatra eva abhilāṣaḥ prāptaḥ sa ca viṣaya ānanda abhilāṣam ucchetsyati

original: tena satsvapi karmavidhiṣu tatphalakāmebhyo nivarteta, na teṣvabhiniviśeta; na cātmajñānādudvijetetyāśaṅkyāha—śruto'pīti | viṣayānando hyasakṛdanubhūtaḥ; yaścānubhūtaḥ sa eva cittamākarṣati; na tu śrutimātragamyaḥ, ananubhūtatvāditi bhāvaḥ | prāgeveti; kimutetyarthaḥ | upasaṃharati—tasmāditi |
analyzed: tena satsu api karma vidhiṣu tad phala kāmebhyaḥ nivarteta na teṣu abhiniviśeta na ca ātma jñānāt udvijeta iti āśaṅkya āha śrutaḥ upi iti viṣaya ānandaḥ hi asakṛt anubhūtaḥ yaḥ ca anubhūtaḥ saḥ eva cittam ākarṣati na tu śruti mātra gamyaḥ ananubhūta tvāt iti bhāvaḥ prāk eva iti kim uta iti arthaḥ upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: ato na kāmapravilayadvāreṇa dṛṣṭenaiva karmavidhīnāṃ jñānavidhyadhikārānupraveśaṃ iti siddham | yadyapi kāmapravilayapakṣo dvitīyaḥ, tathāpi karmāvadhīnāṃ dṛṣṭenaivopayoga ityetatpakṣadūṣaṇaprasaṅgenehokta ityadoṣaḥ | yadapyuktaṃ sarvatra vede kacit kasyacidvedasya vilayo gamyata iti, tadapyanubhāṣya dūṣayati—yadapīti | 'uktam' iti vākyaśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: atas na kāma pravilaya dvāreṇa dṛṣṭena eva karma vidhīnām jñāna vidhi adhikāra anupraveśam iti siddham yadi api kāma pravilaya pakṣaḥ dvitīyaḥ tathā api karma avadhīnām dṛṣṭena eva upayogaḥ iti etad pakṣa dūṣaṇa prasaṅgena iha uktaḥ iti adoṣaḥ yat api uktam sarvatra vede kacid kasyacid vedasya vilayaḥ gamyate iti tat api anubhāṣya dūṣayati yat api iti uktam iti vākyaśeṣaḥ

original: kathamasadityāha—anidamiti; "sargakāmo yajeta" iti vākyasyeti śeṣaḥ | tadeva vivṛṇoti—na hīti | yatparaḥ śabdaḥ sa śabdārthaḥ; idaṃ tu sargakāmavākyaṃ na dehātiriktātmataccāvabodhaparam, śrutahānyaśrutakalpanāprasaṅgāt; api tu yāganiyogaparam; ato'traiva tat pramāṇam; na pūrvatriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: katham asat iti āha anidam iti sarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti vākyasya iti śeṣaḥ tat eva vivṛṇoti na hi iti yad paraḥ śabdaḥ sa śabda arthaḥ idam tu sarga kāma vākyam na deha atirikta ātma tad ca avabodha param śruta hāni aśruta kalpanā prasaṅgāt api tu yāga niyoga param tat pramāṇam na pūrvatri ti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu yadyapi dehātiriktamātmataccaṃ na śrutam, tathāpi dehasyānityasya
analyzed: nanu yadi api deha atiriktam ātma taccam na śrutam tathā api dehasya anityasya

original: jaḍasya ca janmāntarīyasvargopabhogāśakterarthādidaṃ dehātiriktamātmatattvamavagamyate; bhavati cānyaparādarthagamyo'pi vedārthaḥ; yathā “upari hi devebhyo dhārayati” iti hetuparāduparidhāraṇavidhiḥ; tataśca dehātmavilayo jyotiṣṭomādividherartha ityabhiprāyeṇāśaṅkayati—atheti | dūṣayati—tadapīti | P. 30-16.
analyzed: jaḍasya ca janma antarīya svarga upabhoga aśakteḥ arthāt idam deha atiriktam ātma tattvam avagamyate bhavati ca anya parāt artha gamyaḥ api veda arthaḥ yathā upari hi devebhyaḥ dhārayati iti hetu parāt upari dhāraṇa vidhiḥ tatas ca deha ātma vilayaḥ jyotiṣṭoma ādi vidheḥ arthaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āśaṅkayati atha iti dūṣayati tat api iti

original: tadapi hastini pratyakṣeṇa dṛṣṭe hastipadena hastino'numānaṃ yathā vyarthatvādanapekṣitam, tādṛśamityarthaḥ | nanu tatra pratyakṣasiddho hastī, na tviha tathā dehātmavilaya ityāśaṅkyāha—sākṣāditi | satyamātmajñānavidhirdehātmavilayamapekṣate, sa tu pratyakṣaśrutilabdha iti na tamarthalabdhamapekṣate;
analyzed: tat api hastini pratyakṣeṇa dṛṣṭe hasti padena hastinaḥ unumānam yathā vyartha tvāt anapekṣitam tādṛśam iti arthaḥ nanu tatra pratyakṣa siddhaḥ hastī na tu iha tathā deha ātma vilayaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha sākṣāt iti satyam ātma jñāna vidhiḥ deha ātma vilayam apekṣate sa tu pratyakṣa śruti labdhaḥ iti na tam artha labdham apekṣate

original: “yaścārthādartho na sa śabdārthaḥ” iti ca nyāyaḥ; tataścārthagamyo dehātmavilayo na jyotiṣṭomādividhiṣu vedārthaḥ; dhāraṇe punaraprāptasyānuvādāsaṃbhavāt tadvidhiriti vaiṣamyamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ ca arthāt arthaḥ na sa śabda arthaḥ iti ca nyāyaḥ tatas ca artha gamyaḥ deha ātma vilayaḥ na jyotiṣṭoma ādi vidhiṣu veda arthaḥ dhāraṇe punar aprāptasya anuvāda asaṃbhavāt tad vidhiḥ iti vaiṣamyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: kiṃ ca arthasiddhamapi cedvedārthaḥ syāt, tato dehātmatve dehasyānityasya janmāntarīyaphalabhoktṛtvāsaṃbhavaṃ manvānasya tatkāmanayā bhoktṛtvābhimānena ca yo manaso granthiḥ sa śithilībhavedapi;
analyzed: kim ca artha siddham api ced veda arthaḥ syāt tatas deha ātmatve dehasya anityasya janma antarīya phala bhoktṛtva asaṃbhavam manvānasya tad kāmanayā bhoktṛtva abhimānena ca yaḥ manasaḥ granthiḥ sa śithilībhavet api

original: dehātirikte'pyātmani vedārthe yathā so'rthagamyo vedārthastathā tasya nityasya janmāntarīyaphalabhogaṃ manvānasya puṃsaḥ tatkāmādigrantheḥ kāṭhinyaṃ dṛḍhatvaṃ yadarthāt sidhyati tadapi vaidikaṃ syāt; tataśca jyotiṣṭomādividhayo viraktātmajñānavidhipratikūlatvānna tadekavākyatāṃ yāyurityabhiprāyeṇāha—arthācceti |
analyzed: deha atirikte api ātmani veda arthe yathā saḥ ṛtha gamyaḥ veda arthaḥ tathā tasya nityasya janma antarīya phala bhogam manvānasya puṃsaḥ tad kāma ādi grantheḥ kāṭhinyam dṛḍha tvam yad arthāt sidhyati tat api vaidikam syāt tatas ca jyotiṣṭoma ādi vidhayaḥ virakta ātma jñāna vidhi pratikūla tvāt na tad ekavākya tām yāyuḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha arthāt ca iti

original: vedadarśitavividhopāyatvena vā yat kāmādigrantheḥ kāṭhinyaṃ tadvaidikaṃ syādityarthaḥ | cakāro dūṣaṇasamuccaye | evamādyapakṣaṃ dūṣayitvā kāmanibarhaṇadvāreṇa karmavidhīnāmātmajñānānupraveśapakṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati—dvitīyo'pīti |
analyzed: veda darśita vividha upāya tvena vā yat kāma ādi grantheḥ kāṭhinyam tat vaidikam syāt iti arthaḥ cakāraḥ dūṣaṇa samuccaye evam ādya pakṣam dūṣayitvā kāma nibarhaṇa dvāreṇa karma vidhīnām ātma jñāna anupraveśa pakṣam dvitīyam dūṣayati dvitīyaḥ upi iti

original: “na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānāma” ityādinā varṇitādeva kāmyānāṃ kāmanāvicchedasāmarthyabhāvāt svavākyopāttasvargādikāryanirākāṅkṣāṇāṃ karmavidhīnāmātmajñānavidhyanupraveśe varṇitādeva pramāṇābhāvāt dvitīyo'pi pakṣo'samañjasa iti vyavahitenānvayaḥ |
analyzed: na jātu kāmaḥ kāmān āmaḥ ityādinā varṇitāt eva kāmyānām kāmanā viccheda sāmarthya bhāvāt sva vākya upātta svarga ādi kārya nirākāṅkṣāṇām karma vidhīnām ātma jñāna vidhi anupraveśe varṇitāt eva pramāṇa abhāvāt dvitīyaḥ api pakṣaḥ usamañjasaḥ iti vyavahitena anvayaḥ

original: kiṃ ca karmavidhīnāṃ sahasrasaṃvatsarāntānāṃ jñānavidhiśeṣatve aṅgapradhānayorekādhikāratve sati jñānādhikṛtenaikenaiva mumukṣuṇā kṛtsnakarmopasaṃhāraḥ kartavyaḥ; tataśca sarvakarmaṇāṃ jñānena samuccayaḥ, ekena ca kartropasaṃhāraḥ syāt; sa cāśakya ityāha—ekādhikāratva iti | ekasyādhikāro yeṣviti vigrahaḥ | itiḥ samāptau | 6
analyzed: kim ca karma vidhīnām sahasrasaṃvatsara antānām jñāna vidhi śeṣa tve aṅga pradhānayoḥ eka adhikāra tve sati jñāna adhikṛtena ekena eva mumukṣuṇā kṛtsna karma upasaṃhāraḥ kartavyaḥ tatas ca sarva karmaṇām jñānena samuccayaḥ ekena ca kartrā upasaṃhāraḥ syāt sa ca aśakyaḥ iti āha eka adhikāra tve iti ekasya adhikāraḥ yeṣu iti vigrahaḥ itiḥ samāptau

original: idānīmuddeśakramaprāptānanantarapakṣānanādṛtya bahuvaktavyatvādātmajñānasya P. 81-1. kartṛsaṃskāratayā karmāṅgatvapakṣaṃ dūṣayitumanubhāṣayati—ye'pīti | pūrvaṃ karma jñānāṅgamityuktam, adhunā tu jñānaṃ karmāṅgamiti viparyayārthaḥ | taddūṣayati— tairiti |
analyzed: idānīm uddeśa krama prāptān anantarapakṣān an ādṛtya bahu vaktavya tvāt ātma jñānasya kartṛ saṃskāra tayā karma aṅga tva pakṣam dūṣayitum anubhāṣayati ye pi iti pūrvam karma jñāna aṅgam iti uktam adhunā tu jñānam karma aṅgam iti viparyaya arthaḥ tat dūṣayati taiḥ iti

original: tairapi jñānasya karmabhiḥ saṃbandhe śrutyādīnāmanyatamaṃ pramāṇaṃ vācyam, tacca durvacamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu brīhiprokṣaṇādisaṃskāravat kartṛsaṃskāratvātmajñānaṃ karmabhiḥ saṃbadhyata ityāśaṅkya taddaiṣamyamāha—na tāvaditi | yathā tatra karmabhiḥ saṃbandhe pramāṇamasti na tathāleti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: taiḥ api jñānasya karmabhiḥ saṃbandhe śruti ādīnām anyatamam pramāṇam vācyam tat ca durvacam iti bhāvaḥ nanu brīhi prokṣaṇa ādi saṃskāra vat kartṛ saṃskāra tva ātma jñānam karmabhiḥ saṃbadhyate iti āśaṅkya tad daiṣamyam āha na tāvat iti yathā tatra karmabhiḥ saṃbandhe pramāṇam asti na śeṣaḥ

original: tatra prokṣaṇādau tāvat karmasaṃbandhe pramāṇamāha—tatra hīti | tatra hi brīhisvarūpasya karmaṇyanupayokṣyamāṇasyāsādhanībhūtasya prokṣaṇena na kaścidartha iti brīhisvarūpaprokṣaṇasyānarthakyādanyatra sādhanībhūtaṃ brīhiśabdo lakṣayati;
analyzed: tatra prokṣaṇa ādau tāvat karma saṃbandhe pramāṇam āha tatra hi iti tatra hi brīhi svarūpasya karmaṇi anupayokṣyamāṇasya asādhanībhūtasya prokṣaṇena na kaścid arthaḥ iti brīhi svarūpa prokṣaṇasya ānarthakyāt anyatra sādhanībhūtam brīhi śabdaḥ lakṣayati

original: tatrāpi prakaraṇagṛhītasya prokṣaṇasyāprakṛtakarmāpūrvasādhanasaṃbandhe prakaraṇabādhaḥ syāditi prakaraṇāt prakṛtakarmāpūrvasādhanamiti gamyate; tadevaṃ prakṛtakarmāpūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇadvāreṇa brīhiśabdaḥ prokṣaṇasya prakṛtakarmāpūrvasaṃbandhaṃ bodhayatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatra api prakaraṇa gṛhītasya prokṣaṇasya aprakṛta karma apūrva sādhana saṃbandhe prakaraṇa bādhaḥ syāt iti prakaraṇāt prakṛta karma apūrva sādhanam iti gamyate tat evam prakṛta karma apūrva sādhana tva lakṣaṇa dvāreṇa brīhi śabdaḥ prokṣaṇasya prakṛta karma apūrva saṃbandham bodhayati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu parṇamayītvavadātmajñānamasatyapi prakaraṇe karmaṇā kimiti na saṃbadhyata ityāha— nāpīti | yathā “yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati” ityatra karmasaṃbandhaḥ, tathātreti vākyaśeṣaḥ | kuta ityāha—tatrāpīti | tatrāpi juhvādidravyamavyabhicaritakarmasaṃbandhaṃ na vyabhicaritaḥ karmasaṃbandho yasya tat tathoktam;
analyzed: nanu parṇa mayī tva vat ātma jñānam asati api prakaraṇe karmaṇā kim iti na saṃbadhyate iti āha na api iti yathā yasya parṇa mayī juhūḥ bhavati iti atra karma saṃbandhaḥ tathā atra iti vākyaśeṣaḥ kutas iti āha tatra api iti tatra api juhū ādi dravyam avyabhicarita karma saṃbandham na vyabhicaritaḥ karma saṃbandhaḥ yasya tat tathā uktam

original: karmasamavetameva hi juhvādidravyam, nānyatra tat; ata evāsatyapi prakaraṇe karmopasthāpayatītyarthaḥ | nanu yadi nāmaivaṃ tathāpi parṇamayītvasya kena pramāṇena karmasaṃbandha ityata āha—tatreti | tatra tasmin sati, tatra vā parṇamayīvākye vākyenaiva karmasaṃbandhaḥ; parṇamayītvasyeti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: karma samavetam eva hi juhū ādi dravyam na anyatra tat atas eva asati api prakaraṇe karma upasthāpayati iti arthaḥ nanu yadi nāma evam tathā api parṇa mayī tvasya kena pramāṇena karma saṃbandhaḥ iti atas āha tatra iti tatra tasmin sati tatra vā parṇa mayī vākye vākyena eva karma saṃbandhaḥ parṇa mayī tvasya iti śeṣaḥ

original: taddhiḥ vākyaṃ kratvavyabhicaritasaṃbandhajuhvanuvādena parṇamayītvaṃ vidadhat kratumanupraveśayatīti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ dṛṣṭāntadvaye karmasaṃbandhahetumuktvā dārṣṭāntike tadasaṃbhavamāha— ātmajñānaṃ tviti | nātmajñānaṃ prakaraṇe śrutam, karmakāṇḍabahirbhāvājjñānakāṇḍasya;
analyzed: tat hiḥ vākyam kratu avyabhicarita saṃbandha juhū anuvādena parṇa mayī tvam vidadhat kratum anupraveśayati iti bhāvaḥ evam dṛṣṭānta dvaye karma saṃbandha hetum uktvā dārṣṭāntike tad asaṃbhavam āha ātma jñānam tu iti na ātma jñānam prakaraṇe śrutam karmakāṇḍa bahirbhāvāt jñānakāṇḍasya

original: nāpyavyabhicaritakratusaṃbandham, laukike'pi karmaṇyātmanaḥ kartṛtvasyeṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ | tena pramāṇābhāvādātmajñānasya kartṛsaṃskāratayā karmasaṃbandho vaktuṃ na śakyata ityāha—teneti | ātmajñānasya karmasaṃbandhābhāve
analyzed: na api avyabhicarita kratu saṃbandham laukike api karmaṇi ātmanaḥ kartṛ tvasya iṣṭatvāt iti bhāvaḥ tena pramāṇa abhāvāt ātma jñānasya kartṛ saṃskāra tayā karma saṃbandhaḥ vaktum na śakyate iti āha tena iti ātma jñānasya karma saṃbandha abhāve

original: yadabhimataṃ siddhaṃ bhavati, tadāha—tathā ceti | ātmajñānasya P. 31-7. karmasaṃbandhābhāve sati ajñāte pārārthye “dravyasaṃskārakarmasu phalaśrutirarthavādaḥ syāt” iti nyāyena “na ca punarāvartate” ityādiphalaśrutirarthavādinī na bhavatītyataḥ pṛthakphalatvāt pṛthagadhikāratvamiti ‘jñānakarmaṇorviparyayeṇaikādhikāratvam’ iti yaduktaṃ tannirastaṃ
analyzed: yat abhimatam siddham bhavati tat āha tathā ca iti ātma jñānasya karma saṃbandha abhāve sati ajñāte pārārthye dravya saṃskāra karmasu phala śrutiḥ artha vādaḥ syāt iti nyāyena na ca punar āvartate ityādi phala śrutiḥ artha vādinī na bhavati iti atas pṛthak phala tvāt pṛthak adhikāra tvam iti jñāna karmaṇoḥ viparyayeṇa eka adhikāra tvam iti yat uktam tat nirastam

original: bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | nanu syādevaṃ yadīyaṃ phalaśrutiḥ syāt; iyaṃ tu “ghṛtakulyāḥ kṣaranti” itivat vartamānāpadeśatvāt svargakāmādivaktāmopabandhābhāvācca svarasataḥ phalaśrutirna bhavati; tataśca yathā rātrisatre “pratitiṣṭhante” iti ‘pratitiṣṭheran’ iti vipariṇamayya phalaṃ kalpitam, tathā kalpanīyam;
analyzed: bhavati iti bhāvaḥ nanu syāt evam yadi iyam phala śrutiḥ syāt iyam tu ghṛtakulyāḥ kṣaranti iti vat vartamāna apadeśa tvāt svarasataḥ phala śrutiḥ na bhavati tatas ca yathā rātri satre pratitiṣṭhante iti pratitiṣṭheran iti vipariṇamayya phalam kalpitam tathā kalpanīyam

original: tacca phalākāṅkṣāyāṃ satyāṃ rātrisatravat kalpanīyaḥ; na ca dṛṣṭe phale sati phalākāṅkṣā bhavati; asti cātmajñānasya dehāntarabhogyaphaleṣu karmasu pravṛttirdṛṣṭaprayojanam; na hi nityātmajñānaṃ vinā sā syāt; ato na vipariṇamayya phalaṃ kalpyamityabhiprāyeṇāśaṅkayati—atheti |
analyzed: tat ca phala ākāṅkṣāyām satyām rātri satra vat kalpanīyaḥ na ca dṛṣṭe phale sati phala ākāṅkṣā bhavati asti ca ātma jñānasya deha antara bhogya phaleṣu karmasu pravṛttiḥ dṛṣṭa prayojanam na hi nitya ātma jñānam vinā sā syāt atas na vipariṇamayya phalam kalpyam iti abhiprāyeṇa āśaṅkayati atha iti

original: tasmāt yathādhyayanavidhidṛṣṭārtho nārthavādādikaṃ phalaṃ prārthayate, tathātmajñānavidhirapītyāha—tasmāditi | ataḥ pṛthakphalābhāvācca karmādhikārādātmajñānavidhāvadhikārāntaramiti siddhamekādhikāratvaṃ jñānakarmaṇorityāha—tatheti | itirhetvarthaḥ | tadetaddūṣayati—tadapyasaditi | kathamasadityāha—yata iti |
analyzed: tasmāt yathā adhyayana vidhi dṛṣṭārthaḥ na arthavāda ādikam phalam prārthayate tathā ātma jñāna vidhiḥ api iti āha tasmāt iti atas pṛthak phala abhāvāt ca karma adhikārāt ātma jñāna vidhau adhikāra antaram iti siddham eka adhikāra tvam jñāna karmaṇoḥ iti āha tathā iti itiḥ hetvarthaḥ tat etat dūṣayati tat api asat iti katham asat ityāha yatas iti

original: yasmāt karmavidhyapekṣitāt kartuḥ bhoktṛśrātmano'nya evākartṛbhoktṛrūpa aupaniṣada upaniṣadekagamyaḥ puruṣo vedānteṣu jijñāsyate | na ca tasya jñānaṃ karmaṇi pravṛttirheturityarthaḥ | kutastaddheturna bhavatītyāha—na hīti | kartā bhoktā ca karmasu pravartate; tena tajjñānaṃ karmapravṛttirhetuḥ, na punaropaniṣadātmajñānam;
analyzed: yasmāt karma vidhi apekṣitāt kartuḥ eva akartṛ bhoktṛ rūpaḥ aupaniṣadaḥ upaniṣad eka gamyaḥ puruṣaḥ vedānteṣu jijñāsyate na ca tasya jñānam karmaṇi pravṛttiḥ hetuḥ iti arthaḥ kutas tad hetuḥ na bhavati iti āha na hi iti kartā bhoktā ca karmasu pravartate tena tat jñānam karma pravṛttiḥ hetuḥ na punar upaniṣad ātma jñānam

original: na hi tasyopaniṣadātmanaḥ kartṛtvabhoktṛtve sta ityarthaḥ | kutaḥ punastasya kartṛtvabhoktṛtve na sta ityata āha—evamiti | ‘nāśrāti’ na bhuṅkte, ‘anaśnan’ abhuñjāna iti ca bhoktṛtvaniṣedhaḥ | upalakṣaṇamidam; “niṣkalaṃ niṣkriyam” iti “nāyaṃ hanti na hanyate” iti ca kartṛtvaniṣedho draṣṭavyaḥ |
analyzed: na hi tasya upaniṣad ātmanaḥ kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tve staḥ iti arthaḥ kutas punar tasya kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tve na staḥ iti atas āha evam iti na aśrāti na bhuṅkte an aśnan a bhuñjānaḥ iti ca bhoktṛ tva niṣedhaḥ upalakṣaṇam idam niṣkalam niṣkriyam iti na ayam hanti na hanyate iti ca kartṛ tva niṣedhaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: evaṃ vedāntavedyasyātmanaḥ karmaṇyapravṛttimuktvā yastu karmaṇi pravartate kartā bhoktā ca, na sa vedāntavedya ityāha—yastviti | 6A
analyzed: evam vedānta vedyasya ātmanaḥ karmaṇi apravṛttim uktvā yaḥ tu karmaṇi pravartate kartā bhoktā ca na sa vedānta vedyaḥ iti āha yaḥ tu iti

original: evaśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ | yastu kartā bhoktā jīvaḥ, sa eva pratyakṣasiddhaḥ 'aham' ityaparokṣatayā vyavahāre svataḥ siddhaḥ, na paramātmā; tena so'dhigatatvāt na vedāntaśabdagamya ityarthaḥ | atra codayati—nanviti | jīvaparamātmanorabhede paramātmani śabdagamye jīvo'pi śābda eva; ataḥ kathaṃ na śabdagamya ityuktamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: evaśabdaḥ avadhāraṇa arthaḥ yaḥ tu kartā bhoktā jīvaḥ saḥ eva pratyakṣa siddhaḥ aham iti aparokṣa tayā vyavahāre svatas siddhaḥ na paramātmā tena saḥ adhigata tvāt na vedānta śabda gamyaḥ iti arthaḥ atra codayati nanu iti jīva paramātmanoḥ abhede paramātmani śabda gamye jīvaḥ api śābdaḥ eva atas katham na śabda gamyaḥ iti uktam iti bhāvaḥ

original: ekatvameva śrutyā draḍhayati— P.31-18. evamiti | "anena jīvenātmanānupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" iti śrutiḥ 'jīvenātmanā' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyāt 'vyākaravāṇi' iti cottamapuruṣaprayogājīvātmanorabhedamāha; tatkathamanayorbheda ityarthaḥ | siddhāntī tayostāttvikamabhedamabhyupagamya śabdagamyāgamyatve vyavasthāmāha—satyamiti |
analyzed: ekatvam eva śrutyā draḍhayati evam iti anena jīvena ātmanā anupraviśya nāma rūpe vyākaravāṇi iti śrutiḥ jīvena ātmanā iti sāmānādhikaraṇyāt vyākaravāṇi iti ca uttama puruṣa prayoga ajīva ātmanoḥ abhedam āha tat katham anayoḥ bhedaḥ iti arthaḥ siddhāntī tayoḥ tāttvikam abhedam abhyupagamya śabda gamya agamya tve vyavasthām āha satyam iti

original: tasyaiva tu jīvasyaikatvenābhinnasya bimbapratibimbādivat kalpitabhedasya kartṛ-śaktyahaṅkārāvidyānuviddhaṃ bimbasyeva darpaṇādyanuviddhaṃ śyāmādirūpaṃ jīvākhya-mekarūpamasti; tacca kartṛtvāt karmaṇāṃ pravṛttihetuḥ, pratyakṣasiddhatvānna vedāntamapekṣate; tena tacchabdagamyaṃ na bhavati |
analyzed: tasya eva tu jīvasya ekatvena abhinnasya bimba pratibimba ādi vat kalpita bhedasya kartṛ śakti ahaṅkāra avidyā anuviddham bimbasya iva darpaṇa ādi anuviddham śyāma ādi rūpam jīva ākhyam eka rūpam asti tat ca kartṛ tvāt karmaṇām pravṛtti hetuḥ pratyakṣa siddha tvāt na vedāntam apekṣate tena tat śabda gamyam na bhavati

original: yattu tasyaivāvidyānubaddhaṃ rūpaṃ svayaṃprakāśaṃ sarvakartṛtvādivibhāgaśūnyam, tat tādṛśaṃ lokavyavahāreṣva-siddhatvācchabdājjñātumiṣyate; tataśca siddhaṃ jīvaparayorabhede'pi paraḥ śabda-prameyaḥ, na jīva ityarthaḥ | na ca parajñānasyaiva vedāntajasya karmasu pravṛttidṛṣṭaṃ prayojanamityāha—tacceti |
analyzed: yat tu tasya eva avidyā anubaddham rūpam svayam prakāśam sarva kartṛ tva ādi vibhāga śūnyam tat tādṛśam loka vyavahāreṣu asiddha tvāt śabdāt jñātum iṣyate tatas ca siddham jīva parayoḥ abhede pi paraḥ śabda prameyaḥ na jīvaḥ iti arthaḥ na ca para jñānasya eva vedānta jasya karmasu pravṛtti dṛṣṭam prayojanam iti āha tat ca iti

original: tacca vedāntavedyaṃ rūpaṃ karmapravṛttervirodhi; kathaṃ tajjñānasya karmapravṛttidṛṣṭaṃ prayojanaṃ syādityarthaḥ | virodhitvaṃ prakaṭayati—tathā hīti | brahmānandādi-rūpamātmānaṃ jānataḥ puṃsaḥ pravṛttau prayojanaṃ sāmarthyaṃ ca nāstī-tyarthaḥ | vāśabdaśrārthe | kutaḥ punarbrahmātmavidaḥ prayojanasāmarthyaṃ na sta ityata āha—āptakāmatvāditi |
analyzed: tat ca vedānta vedyam rūpam karma pravṛtteḥ virodhi katham tat jñānasya karma pravṛtti dṛṣṭam prayojanam syāt iti arthaḥ virodhi tvam prakaṭayati tathā hi iti brahma ānanda ādi rūpam ātmānam jānataḥ puṃsaḥ pravṛttau prayojanam sāmarthyam ca na asti iti arthaḥ vā śabdaḥ śra arthe kutas punar brahma ātma vidaḥ prayojana sāmarthyam na staḥ iti atas āha āpta kāma tvāt iti

original: tatrāptakāmatvaṃ niṣprayojanatve hetuḥ | sādhanādyupāyābhāvaśca pravṛttāvasāmarthyaṃ hetuḥ | āptakāmatve ca pūrvoktaṃ paramānandarūpatvaṃ hetuḥ, sarvānandānāṃ tatrāntarbhāvāt | advayatvaṃ ca karma-sādhanetikartṛvyatādyupāyābhāve heturiti vivekaḥ | evamavidyānubaddhaṃ rūpaṃ karma-pravṛttihetuḥ, na tvaupaniṣadam;
analyzed: tatra āpta kāma tvam niṣprayojana tve hetuḥ sādhana ādi upāya abhāvaḥ ca pravṛttau asāmarthyam hetuḥ āpta kāma tve ca pūrva uktam parama ānanda rūpatvam hetuḥ sarva ānandānām tatra antarbhāvāt advaya tvam ca karma sādhana itikartṛvya tā ādi upāya abhāve hetuḥ iti vivekaḥ evam avidyā anubaddham rūpam karma pravṛtti hetuḥ na tu aupaniṣadam

original: ato na tajjñānaṃ karmāṅgamiti sthitam | nanvaupaniṣadātmajñānameva karmāṅgatvena śrutyā coditam, tatkathamucyate na
analyzed: atas na tat jñānam karma aṅgam iti sthitam nanu aupaniṣada ātma jñānam eva karma aṅga tvena śrutyā coditam tat katham ucyate na

original: tatkarmāṅgamitīti paraśrodayati—syādetaditi | yadi nāmaupaniṣadātmajñānaṃ P. 31-24. dṛṣṭena na karmāṅgam, tathāpi prayojanādivadadṛṣṭena bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ | nanu pravṛttau satyāṃ prayojanādivadadṛṣṭārthatvaṃ syāt ; aupaniṣadātmavidastu niṣpayojanatvāvirupāyatvācca karmaṇi pravṛttireva nāstītyuktam ;
analyzed: tat karma aṅgam iti iti

original: ataḥ kutraupaniṣadātmajñānamadṛṣṭenāṅgaṃ bhaviṣyatītyucyate ? etābhya eva vakṣyamāṇaśrutibhyaḥ paramānandādvayaśrutirupacaritārthe kalpyeteti paro manyate ; tāḥ śrutīrudāharati—yadeveti | ‘vidyayā’ ityātmavidyokteti parābhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: atas kutra aupaniṣada ātma jñānam adṛṣṭena aṅgam bhaviṣyati iti ucyate etābhyaḥ eva vakṣyamāṇa śrutibhyaḥ paramānanda advaya śrutiḥ upacarita arthe kalpyeta iti paraḥ manyate tāḥ śrutīḥ udāharati yat eva iti vidyayā iti ātma vidyā uktā iti para abhiprāyaḥ

original: tathā “yo vā etadakṣaramaviditvā gārgyasmin loke juhāṃti dadāti tapastapyati bahūni varṣasahasrāṇyantavānevāsya sa loko bhavati” itiśrutyā brahmavidyārahitatayā yāgādikarmaphalāntavaccapradarśanadvāreṇa kevalakarmanindayā “na hi nindā nindyaṃ nindatum, api tu ninditāditarat praśaṃsitum” iti vidyāsahitakarmapraśaṃsā kṛtā |
analyzed: tathā yaḥ vai etat akṣaram a viditvā gārgi asmin loke juhāṃti dadāti tapaḥ tapyati bahūni varṣa sahasrāṇi antavān eva asya sa lokaḥ bhavati iti śrutyā brahma vidyā rahita tayā yāga ādi karma phala antavat ca pradarśana dvāreṇa kevala karma nindayā na hi nindā nindyam nindatum api tu ninditāt itarat praśaṃsitum iti vidyā sahita karma praśaṃsā kṛtā

original: praśaṃsā ca vidhānāyeti brahmavidyāyā yāgāṅgatvaṃ darśitam | tathā “taṃ vidyākarmaṇī samanvārabhete” iti saṃśabdasya sahārthatvāt brahmavidyākarmaṇoḥ samārambhe sahabhāvo darśitaḥ | ekaprayoge ca kāryārambhe sahabhāvo bhavati | na cāsau darśapūrṇamāsavat, samapradhānayoḥ samudāye phalāśravaṇāt, yāgādibhyaśca phalaśruteḥ ;
analyzed: praśaṃsā ca vidhānāya iti brahma vidyāyāḥ yāga aṅga tvam darśitam tathā tam vidyā karmaṇī samanvārabhete iti saṃśabdasya saha artha tvāt brahma vidyā karmaṇoḥ samārambhe sahabhāvaḥ darśitaḥ eka prayoge ca kārya ārambhe sahabhāvaḥ bhavati na ca asau darśa pūrṇamāsa vat sama pradhānayoḥ samudāye phala aśravaṇāt yāga ādibhyaḥ ca phala śruteḥ

original: yāgādayaḥ pradhānam, sāmarthyāt ; vidyā aṅgam, “phalavatsannidhāvaphalaṃ tadaṅgam” iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ | siddhāntī tvāha—pūrvamiti | pūrvaṃ yatprathamamupanyastaṃ “yadeva vidyayā karoti” iti vacanam, tattāvat prakṛtā yā udgīthavidyā udgīthe sāmabhaktāvakṣaropāsanalakṣaṇā tadviṣayam, na brahmavidyāviṣayam ;
analyzed: yāga ādayaḥ pradhānam sāmarthyāt vidyā aṅgam phalavat sannidhau aphalam tat aṅgam iti nyāyāt iti bhāvaḥ siddhāntī tu āha pūrvam iti pūrvam yat prathamam upanyastam yat eva vidyayā karoti iti vacanam tat tāvat prakṛtā yā udgītha vidyā udgīthe sāma bhaktau akṣara upāsana lakṣaṇā tad viṣayam na brahma vidyā viṣayam

original: ato na tasyāḥ karmāṅgatvaṃ bodhayatītyarthaḥ | ‘vidyā’ iti sāmānyaśabdo'pi prakramaviśeṣāt viśeṣe vartate iti vadituṃ prakṛtaprahaṇam | tāvacchabdaḥ kramārthaḥ | kathamudgīthavidyā prakṛtetyata āha—omiti |
analyzed: atas na tasyāḥ karma aṅga tvam bodhayati iti arthaḥ vidyā iti sāmānya śabdaḥ api prakrama viśeṣāt viśeṣe vartate iti vaditum prakṛta prahaṇam tāvat śabdaḥ krama arthaḥ katham udgītha vidyā prakṛtā iti atas āha om iti

original: tathā “yadeva vidyayā” ityataḥ pareṇāpi “yo vā etadakṣaramaviditvā” ityanena kṣayiphalatvena karmanindayā akṣarajñānastutiḥ kriyate, na tu brahmavidyāyāḥ karmāṅgatvajñāpanam | nanu kevalakarmanindayā vidyāsāhityaṃ vidhitstimiti gamyate | maivam ; evaṃ hi parastāt vidyāsahitaṃ karma saṃstuyāt ;
analyzed: tathā yat eva vidyayā iti atas pareṇa api yaḥ vai etat akṣaram a viditvā iti anena kṣayi phala tvena karma nindayā akṣara jñāna stutiḥ kriyate na tu brahma vidyāyāḥ karma aṅga tva jñāpanam nanu kevala karma nindayā vidyā sāhityam vidhitstim iti gamyate mā evam evam hi parastāt vidyā sahitam karma saṃstuyāt

original: iha tu “yadetadakṣaraṃ gārgyaṃ viditvāsmācchoktāt preti sa brahmaṇaḥ” ityādinā kevalākṣarajñānaṃ stūyate ; tasmā-
analyzed: iha tu yat etat akṣaram gārgyam viditvā asmāt śoktāt pra iti sa brahmaṇaḥ ityādinā kevala akṣara jñānam stūyate tasmai

original: dakṣarajñānastutāvevāsya tātparyam, na vidyākarmaṇoḥ sāhityavidhāvityadoṣaḥ | P 32.5. tathā vidyākarmaṇoranvārambhe'pi sāhityaṃ nāstītyāha—vidyeti | bhedeneti vibhāgenetyarthaḥ | vibhāgamevāha—vidyāvantamiti | nanu saṃśabde sahārthaṃ jīvati kathamevaṃ vyākhyāyate ? vidyākarmaṇorekatvasāhityāsaṃbhavāditi brūmaḥ |
analyzed: dakṣara jñāna stutau eva asya tātparyam na vidyā karmaṇoḥ sāhitya vidhau iti adoṣaḥ tathā vidyā karmaṇoḥ anvārambhe pi sāhityam na asti iti āha vidyā iti bhedena iti vibhāgena iti arthaḥ vibhāgam eva āha vidyāvantam iti nanu saṃśabde saha artham jīvati katham evam vyākhyāyate vidyā karmaṇoḥ ekatva sāhitya asaṃbhavāt iti brūmaḥ

original: kathamasaṃbhavaḥ ? ucyate—na tāvadaparavidyākarmaṇoranvārambhe sāhityam, anyonyanirapekṣatvāt | anyonyanirapekṣatvaṃ tu pṛthak phalaśruteḥ, jyotiṣṭomāmihotrādivat ; ekaphalatve hi kāryārambhe sāhityaṃ syāt yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ | paravidyā tu karmaparipanthinī kathaṃ karmaṇā samuccayeta ? na ca sā janmāntarārambhikā, apavargaphalatvāt |
analyzed: katham asaṃbhavaḥ ucyate na tāvat aparavidyā karmaṇoḥ anvārambhe sāhityam anyonya nirapekṣa tvāt anyonya nirapekṣa tvam tu pṛthak phala śruteḥ jyotiṣṭoma amihotra ādi vat eka phala tve hi kārya ārambhe sāhityam syāt yathā darśa pūrṇamāsayoḥ paravidyā tu karma paripanthinī katham karmaṇā samuccayeta na ca sā janma antara ārambhikā apavarga phalatvāt

original: tasmādvibhajyaivāparavidyākarmaṇoranvārambhakatvam | taduktam—“vibhāgaḥ śatavat” iti | saṃśabdaścāvivakṣitasahārthaḥ samyagarthānuvādaḥ | ataḥ sūktam—bhedeneti | prakaraṇārthamupasaṃharati—tasmāditi | evamapīti ; viparyayeṇāpītyarthaḥ | yadvā na kevalamātmajñānasya dṛṣṭārthatvena, api tvevamapi śruticoditasya tasyādṛṣṭārthatayāpītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt vibhajya eva aparavidyā karmaṇoḥ anvārambhaka tvam tat uktam vibhāgaḥ śata vat iti saṃśabdaḥ ca avivakṣita saha arthaḥ samyak artha anuvādaḥ atas sūktam bhedena iti prakaraṇa artham upasaṃharati tasmāt iti evam api iti viparyayeṇa api iti arthaḥ yat vā na kevalam ātma jñānasya dṛṣṭārtha tvena api tu evam api śruti coditasya tasya adṛṣṭa artha tayā api iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ jñānaṃ karmāṅgamiti viparyayapakṣaṃ nirasya pakṣāntaraṃ dūṣayitumanubhāṣate—ye'pīti | asaṃbandhameva manyanta ityanantareṇa saṃbandhaḥ | kathaṃ tayorvirodha ityata āha—dvaiteti | sādhanādidvaitaviṣayaṃ karma, dvaitarahitātmaviṣayaṃ tvātmajñānamiti hetorvirodhādananvayaḥ | itiśabdo hetyarthaḥ | dūṣaṇamāha—teṣāmiti | kuta ityāha—pramāṇādīti |
analyzed: evam jñānam karma aṅgam iti viparyaya pakṣam nirasya pakṣa antaram dūṣayitum anubhāṣate ye pi iti asaṃbandham eva manyante iti anantareṇa saṃbandhaḥ katham tayoḥ virodhaḥ iti atas āha dvaita iti sādhana ādi dvaita viṣayam karma dvaita rahita ātma viṣayam tu ātma jñānam iti hetoḥ virodhāt ananvayaḥ iti śabdaḥ ha iti arthaḥ dūṣaṇam āha teṣām iti kutas ityāha pramāṇa ādi iti

original: yadi dvaitaviṣayaṃ karmeti virodhādadvaitajñānena saha na saṃbadhyate, tataḥ pramāṇaprameyapramātrādidvaitamapi na tena saṃbadhyeta ; na ca pramāṇādyupāyasaṃbandhamantareṇa jñānamutpadyate ; tataścādvaitajñānasyānutpāda eva syādityarthaḥ | athocyate—pramāṇādivibhāga upāyaḥ, upeyaṃ cādvaitajñānam, tayośca paurvāparyādayogapadyam ;
analyzed: yadi dvaita viṣayam karma iti virodhāt advaita jñānena saha na saṃbadhyate tatas pramāṇa prameya pramātṛ ādi dvaitam api na tena saṃbadhyeta na ca pramāṇa ādi upāya saṃbandham antareṇa jñānam utpadyate tatas ca advaita jñānasya anutpādaḥ eva syāt iti arthaḥ atha ucyate pramāṇa ādi vibhāgaḥ upāyaḥ upeyam ca advaita jñānam tayoḥ ca paurvāparyāt ayogapadyam

original: anyathā savyadakṣiṇaśṛṅgavadupāyopeyabhāva eva na syāt ; ataḥ kālamedena tayoravirodhādanyonyasaṃbandhe nādvaitajñānasyānutpādadoṣa iti ; tadāha—atheti | yadi pramāṇādivibhāgādvaitapratipattyoravirodhaḥ, tato jātāyāmapi tasyāṃ pramāṇādivibhāgena tathaivānuvartitavyam ; ato nādvaitaprāptiḥ ; ataścānirmokṣaprasaṅga
analyzed: anyathā savya dakṣiṇa śṛṅga vat upāya upeya bhāvaḥ eva na syāt atas kāla medena tayoḥ avirodhāt anyonya saṃbandhe na advaita jñānasya anutpāda doṣaḥ iti tat āha atha iti yadi pramāṇa ādi vibhāga advaita pratipattyoḥ avirodhaḥ tatas jātāyām api tasyām pramāṇa ādi vibhāgena tathā eva anuvartitavyam atas na advaita prāptiḥ atas ca anirmokṣa prasaṅgaḥ

original: ityāśaṅkyāha—pravilīyata eveti | advaitapratipattau satyāṃ pravilīyata eva P. 32-10. sarvapramāṇādivibhāgaḥ, ato nānirmokṣaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | yadyadvaitajñāne sati pramāṇādidvaitaṃ pravilīyate, prāptaṃ tarhi tayośchāyātpādivadvirodhaḥ anupāyatvaṃ ca pramāṇādivibhāgasya ; na hi pravilīyamānasya kvacidupāyatvaṃ dṛṣṭam ;
analyzed: iti āśaṅkya āha pravilīyate eva iti advaita pratipattau satyām pravilīyate eva sarva pramāṇa ādi vibhāgaḥ atas na anirmokṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ yadi advaita jñāne sati pramāṇa ādi dvaitam pravilīyate prāptam tarhi tayoḥ chāyā ātpādi vat virodhaḥ anupāya tvam ca pramāṇa ādi vibhāgasya na hi pravilīyamānasya kvacid upāya tvam dṛṣṭam

original: ato nāvirodhaḥ, nāpyupāyatvaṃ pramāṇādivibhāgasyetyāśaṅkyāha— na ceti | tatrāvirodhe tāvaddhetumāha—upāyasyeti | na pravilāpyapravilāpakatvamātreṇa virodhaḥ, kiṃtu kālabhedena ca, tādṛśayorapi chāyātapayorbhinnakālayoravirodhāt | iha ca tayoḥ kālabhedaḥ ; tasmādavirodha iti bhāvaḥ | upāyatve hetumāha—vadā ceti |
analyzed: atas na avirodhaḥ na api upāyatvam pramāṇa ādi vibhāgasya iti āśaṅkya āha na ca iti tatra avirodhe tāvat hetum āha aupāyasya iti na pravilāpya pravilāpaka tva mātreṇa virodhaḥ kiṃtu kāla bhedena ca tādṛśayoḥ api chāyā ātapayoḥ bhinna kālayoḥ avirodhāt iha ca tayoḥ kāla bhedaḥ tasmāt avirodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ upāya tve hetum āha ca iti

original: jāte brahmaitajñāne pramāṇādidvaitaṃ pravilīyate, na pūrvameva ; pūrvaṃ ca tasyopāyatvam, tadā ca tadapravilīnamevetyarthaḥ | itaśca nānupāyatvamityāha—bheda iti | advaitajñānasya tāvat kāryatvādavaśyaṃ kāraṇena bhāvyam ; na cādvaitameva brahma tasya kāraṇam, tasyākārakatvāt, nityaṃ ca kāryātpattiprasaṅgāt ;
analyzed: jāte brahmaita jñāne pramāṇa ādi dvaitam pravilīyate na pūrvam eva pūrvam ca tasya upāya tvam tadā ca tat apravilīnam eva iti arthaḥ itas ca na anupāya tvam iti āha bhedaḥ iti advaita jñānasya tāvat kārya tvāt avaśyam kāraṇena bhāvyam na ca advaitam eva brahma tasya kāraṇam tasya akāraka tvāt nityam ca kārya ātpatti prasaṅgāt

original: ataḥ pāriśeṣyāt pramāṇādidvaitena bhāvyamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā bheda evānyo'pīti sāmānyādyabhedapratipattāvupāyo dṛṣṭaḥ, tadvat pramāṇādibhedo'pi bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ paramatamāśaṅkya tadevopajīvya karmajñānayorasaṃbandhahetuṃ paroktaṃ virodhaṃ pariharati—neti |
analyzed: atas pāriśeṣyāt pramāṇa ādi dvaitena bhāvyam iti bhāvaḥ yat vā bhedaḥ eva anyaḥ api iti sāmānya ādi abheda pratipattau upāyaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tadvat pramāṇa ādi bhedaḥ api bhaviṣyati iti bhāvaḥ evam para matam āśaṅkya tat eva upajīvya karma jñānayoḥ asaṃbandha hetum para uktam virodham pariharati na iti

original: yadi pramāṇādidvaitaṃ tūpāyatvādvinnakālamiti na tenādvaitajñānasya virodhaḥ, evaṃ tarhi karmabhirapyupāyatvādeva bhinnakālairma tasya virodhaḥ ; tataśca na tasya tairasaṃbandha iti bhāvaḥ | para idānīṃ karmaṇāmanupayogenopāyatvamevākṣipan saṃbandhamākṣipati—syāditi | bhavedetakarmaṇāmupāyatvaṃ tena ca saṃbandhaḥ, yadi teṣāmupayogaḥ syāt ;
analyzed: yadi pramāṇa ādi dvaitam tu upāya tvāt vinna kālam iti na tena advaita jñānasya virodhaḥ evam tarhi karmabhiḥ api upāya tvāt eva tasya virodhaḥ tatas ca na tasya taiḥ asaṃbandhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ paraḥ idānīm karmaṇām anupayogena upāya tvam eva ākṣipan saṃbandham ākṣipati syāt iti bhavet eta karmaṇām upāya tvam tena ca saṃbandhaḥ yadi teṣām upayogaḥ syāt

original: sa eva tu brahmaṇo nityatvenāsādhyatvānna vidyate | na ca kāryasiddhāvanupayuktasyopāyatvamasti ; na cānupāye'pekṣā ; na cānapekṣitasya saṃbandha iti bhāvaḥ | karmaṇāmanupayoge śrutimudāharati—śrūyata iti | asyārthaḥ—akṛto'kāryo mokṣo brahmasvarūpaṃ kṛtena karmaṇā nāsti na bhavati na sidhyatīti |
analyzed: saḥ eva tu brahmaṇaḥ nitya tvena asādhya tvāt na vidyate na ca kārya siddhau anupayuktasya upāya tvam asti na ca anupāya ipekṣā na ca anapekṣitasya saṃbandhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ karmaṇām anupayoge śrutim udāharati śrūyate iti asya arthaḥ akṛtaḥ ukāryaḥ mokṣaḥ brahma svarūpam kṛtena karmaṇā nā asti na bhavati na sidhyati iti

original: nanu mā bhavatu brahmaṇyasādhye karmaṇāmupayogaḥ, tajjñānotpattau tu pramāṇādivibhāgasyeva kena vāryata ityāśaṅkyāha—na ceti | hetumāha—jñānasyeti | jñānaṃ nāma pramāṇādhīnam, na karmādhīnam ; anyathā
analyzed: nanu mā bhavatu brahmaṇi asādhye karmaṇām upayogaḥ tad jñāna utpattau tu pramāṇa ādi vibhāgasya iva kena vāryate iti āśaṅkya āha na ca iti hetum āha jñānasya iti jñānam nāma pramāṇa adhīnam na karma adhīnam anyathā

original: karmāpi saptamaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt ; ataḥ pramāṇasyaiva jñānotpattāvupayogaḥ, na karmaṇāmityarthaḥ | nanu yadi nāma karmaṇāṃ jñānotpattāvupayogo nāsti, P. 32-16. jñānakāryotpattau tu sahakāritvenopayogo bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkyāha—na ceti | kuta ityāha—jñānasyeti | kāryaṃ hi saṃbhūya kurvataḥ sahakāritvam, yathā kṣityāderaṅkuram ;
analyzed: karma api saptamam pramāṇam syāt atas pramāṇasya eva jñāna utpattau upayogaḥ na karmaṇām iti arthaḥ nanu yadi nāma karmaṇām jñāna utpattau upayogaḥ na asti jñāna kārya utpattau tu sahakāri tvena upayogaḥ bhaviṣyati iti āśaṅkya āha na ca iti kutas iti āha jñānasya iti kāryam hi saṃbhūya kurvataḥ sahakāri tvam yathā kṣiti ādeḥ aṅkuram

original: na cātmajñānasya svaviṣayaparicchedādanyat kāryamastītyarthaḥ | nanvastyeva jñānasya kāryāntaraṃ mokṣaḥ ; tathā ca jñānānmokṣaḥ śrūyata ityāśaṅkyāha—na tasyeti | mokṣo nāma brahmasvarūpam, tacca nityamiṣṭam ; taccetkāryaṃ syāt, tato'nityaṃ syāt | athavā mokṣaśret kāryaḥ syāt, tatastasyānityatvānmuktasya punarāvṛttiḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na ca ātma jñānasya sva viṣaya paricchedāt anyat kāryam asti iti arthaḥ nanu asti eva jñānasya kārya antaram mokṣaḥ tathā ca jñānāt mokṣaḥ śrūyate iti āśaṅkya āha na tasya iti mokṣaḥ nāma brahma svarūpam tat ca nityam iṣṭam tat ced kāryam syāt tatas nityam syāt athavā kāryaḥ syāt tatas tasya anitya tvāt muktasya punarāvṛttiḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu yadi nāma mokṣaḥ sākṣātsādhyo na bhavati, tathāpi bandhahetupradhvaṃso jñānasya sādhyo bhaviṣyati ; atastatra karmaṇāṃ sahakāritvenopayoga upapatsyate ; pradhvaṃsasya ca kāryasyāpi nityatvādanityatvadoṣo'pi na saṃpatsyata ityabhiprāyeṇa para āha—bandhahetviti | nanu mokṣaḥ puruṣārthaḥ, na bandhahetuvicchedaḥ ;
analyzed: nanu yadi nāma mokṣaḥ sākṣāt sādhyaḥ na bhavati tathā api bandha hetu pradhvaṃsaḥ jñānasya sādhyaḥ bhaviṣyati atas tatra karmaṇām sahakāri tvena upayogaḥ upapatsyate pradhvaṃsasya ca kāryasya api nitya tvāt anitya tva doṣaḥ api na saṃpatsyate iti abhiprāyeṇa paraḥ āha bandha hetu iti nanu mokṣaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ na bandha hetu vicchedaḥ

original: sa cet jñānasādhyaḥ syāt, tato jñānamapuruṣārthaphalamanupādeyaṃ syāt ; kutaśca tadā mokṣaḥ syāt ? na hi tasya jñānādupāyāntaraṃ śrūyata ityāśaṅkya sa evāha— itīti | itiśabdo hetau ; yasmāt bandhahetuvicchedo jñānasya sādhyaḥ, tasmāt tasmin bandhahetau jñānādvicchinne tasya bandhahetorabhāvānmucyate ;
analyzed: sa ced jñāna sādhyaḥ syāt tatas jñānam apuruṣa artha phalam anupādeyam syāt kutas ca tadā mokṣaḥ syāt na hi tasya jñānāt upāya antaram śrūyate iti āśaṅkya saḥ eva āha iti iti iti śabdaḥ hetau yasmāt bandha hetu vicchedaḥ jñānasya sādhyaḥ tasmāt tasmin bandha hetau jñānāt vicchinne tasya bandha hetoḥ abhāvāt mucyate

original: tataśca jñānasya mokṣaphalatvānnāpuruṣārthaphalatvam, na ca nirupāyatvānmokṣāsaṃbhava ityabhiprāyaḥ | tadetad dūṣayituṃ pṛcchati—ka iti | itara āha—avidyeti | taddūṣayati—na tarhiti | vidyāyāḥ pṛthak vyatirikto nāvidyāvicchedo vidyāsādhyo'sti, yatra karmaṇāṃ sahakāritvamiti bhāvaḥ | kimiti nāstītyāha—yata iti |
analyzed: tatas ca jñānasya mokṣa phalatvāt na a puruṣārtha phalatvam na ca nirupāya tvāt mokṣa asaṃbhavaḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ tat etat dūṣayitum pṛcchati kaḥ iti itaraḥ āha avidyā iti tat dūṣayati na tarhi iti vidyāyāḥ pṛthak vyatiriktaḥ na avidyā vicchedaḥ vidyā sādhyaḥ asti yatra karmaṇām sahakāri tvam iti bhāvaḥ kim iti na asti iti āha yatas iti

original: agrahaṇamavidyā, tacca grahaṇaprāgabhāvaḥ, tasya ca nivṛttigrahaṇātmakavidyotpāda eva, saprāgabhāvavimardātmakatvāt bhāvotpādasya ; ato nāvidyānivṛttirvidyayā pṛthak sādhyā, yatra karmaṇāṃ sahakāritvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | atra codayati—syāditi |
analyzed: agrahaṇam avidyā tat ca grahaṇa prāgabhāvaḥ tasya ca nivṛtti grahaṇa ātmaka vidyā utpādaḥ eva sa prāgabhāva vimarda ātmaka tvāt bhāva utpādasya atas na avidyā nivṛttiḥ vidyayā pṛthak sādhyā yatra karmaṇām sahakāri tvam syāt iti bhāvaḥ atra codayati syāt iti

analyzed: vidyā utpādaḥ eva viparyaya niṣṭhattiḥ atas tad niṣṭhattiḥ vidyāyāḥ pṛthak sādhyā atas ca tatra karmaṇām sahakāri tvena upayogaḥ usti iti bhāvaḥ kim iti punar agrahaṇa niṣṭhatti vat viparyaya jñāna niṣṭhattiḥ api vidyā utpādaḥ eva na syāt iti āśaṅkya vaiṣamyam āha na khalu iti agrahaṇam hi prāgabhāvaḥ tasya bhāva utpādaḥ eva nivṛttiḥ yujyate

original: viparyayajñānaṃ tu vidyāto bhāvāntaram ; na ca bhāvāntaraṃ vidyā viparyayajñānasya bhāvāntarasya nivṛttirityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha—na hīti | yadi parasparābhāvā bhāvā bhaveyuḥ, tato bhāvāntaraṃ bhāvāntarasyābhāvaḥ syāt ; na tvevamasti ; tataśca bhāvādbhāvāntarābhāvaḥ pṛthak sādhyo'sti ; tatra ca karmaṇāmanupraveśo ghaṭata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: viparyaya jñānam tu vidyātaḥ bhāva antaram na ca bhāva antaram vidyā viparyaya jñānasya bhāva antarasya nivṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ kutas ityāha na hi iti yadi paraspara abhāvāḥ bhāvāḥ bhaveyuḥ tatas bhāva antaram bhāva antarasya abhāvaḥ syāt na tu evam asti tatas ca bhāvāt bhāva antara abhāvaḥ pṛthak sādhyaḥ asti tatra ca karmaṇām anupraveśaḥ ghaṭate iti bhāvaḥ

original: kuta ityāha—abhāvatveti | abhāvasvabhāvatve hi bhāvānāṃ bhāvasvabhāvatvābhāvādabhāvyaḥ syāt ; tataśca sarvaśūnyatā syāditi bhāvaḥ | bhodaka evāśaṅkyati—yadīti | na khalva tattvaṃ gṛhṇato viparyayajñānaṃ bhavati ; tena tattvāgrahaṇaṃ viparyayajñānasya nimittam ;
analyzed: kutas iti āha abhāva tva iti abhāva svabhāva tve hi bhāvānām bhāva svabhāva tva abhāvāt abhāvyaḥ syāt tatas ca sarva śūnyatā syāt iti bhāvaḥ bhodakaḥ eva āśaṅkyati yadi iti na khalu tattvam gṛhṇataḥ viparyaya jñānam bhavati tena tattva agrahaṇam viparyaya jñānasya nimittam

original: atastattvajñānātmikayā vidyayā nivṛtte nimittanivṛttyaiva viparyayajñānaṃ svayameva nivartiṣyate | ato bhāvāntaratve'pi na tannivṛttirvidyayā pṛthak sādhyā, yatra karmaṇāmanupraveśaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | evamāśaṅkya dūṣayati— tacceti | syādevam, yadyagrahaṇaṃ kasya cinnimittaṃ syāt ; na tvetadasti ; abhāvo hyagrahaḥ, tanna kasya cinnimittam ;
analyzed: atas tattva jñāna ātmikayā vidyayā nivṛtte nimitta nivṛttyā eva viparyaya jñānam svayam eva nivartiṣyate atas bhāva antara tve pi na tad nivṛttiḥ vidyayā pṛthak sādhyā yatra karmaṇām anupraveśaḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ evam āśaṅkya dūṣayati tat ca iti syāt evam yadi agrahaṇam kasya cit nimittam syāt na tu etat asti abhāvaḥ hi agrahaḥ tat na kasya cit nimittam

original: ato na viparyayasyāpītyarthaḥ | kuta ityāha—mūrcchādīti | yadyagrahaṇaṃ viparyayanimittaṃ syāt, tato mūrcchādiṣu tadastīti viparyayajñānaṃ prasajyeta ; na caivamastītyarthaḥ | yadyagrahaṇamanimittaṃ viparyayasya, kiṃ tarhi tasya nimittamiti pṛcchati—kiṃ tarhīti | uttaramāha—anādīti |
analyzed: atas na viparyayasya api iti arthaḥ kutas iti āha mūrcchā ādi iti yadi agrahaṇam viparyaya nimittam syāt tatas mūrcchā ādiṣu tat asti iti viparyaya jñānam prasajyeta na ca evam asti iti arthaḥ yadi agrahaṇam animittam viparyayasya kim tarhi tasya nimittam iti pṛcchati kim tarhi iti uttaram āha anādi iti

original: anādiraprayojanā yā anirvacanīyāvidyā, sā viparyayāvidyāyā nimittamityuktam ‘amṛtamajam’ ityetadvyākhyānāvasara ityarthaḥ | na ca tasyāmapi ko heturiti vaktavyam, anāditvādityāha—tatra ceti | yadvā tatra ca tasyāmanādyavidyāyāṃ satyāṃ viparyayasya ko heturiti yaḥ paryanuyogaḥ sa niravakāśa ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: anādiḥ aprayojanā yā anirvacanīya avidyā sā viparyaya avidyāyāḥ nimittam iti uktam amṛtam ajam iti etad vyākhyāna avasaraḥ iti arthaḥ na ca tasyām api kaḥ hetuḥ iti vaktavyam anādi tvāt iti āha tatra ca iti yat vā tatra ca tasyām anādya vidyāyām satyām viparyayasya kaḥ hetuḥ iti yaḥ paryanuyogaḥ sa niravakāśaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: yadi tvanādyavidyātiriktaṃ viparyayasya nimittamicchasi, tadapi śakyaṃ darśayitumityāha—viparyāseti | prapañcagrāhiṇo viparyayajñānasya prapañcasaṃskāro nimittam | tasya tarhi kiṃ nimitta-
analyzed: yadi tu anādyavidyā atiriktam viparyayasya nimittam icchasi tat api śakyam darśayitum iti āha viparyāsa iti prapañca grāhiṇaḥ viparyaya jñānasya prapañca saṃskāraḥ nimittam tasya tarhi kim

original: mityucyate ! tasyāpi viparyayajñānameva nimittam | evamubhayoranāditvena bījāṅkurādivat kāryakāraṇabhāvena vyavasthānānna nirnimittatvādidoṣa ityarthaḥ | tadevaṃ nāgrahaṇanivṛttyā viparyayasya svayaṃ nivṛttiḥ ; ato vidyayā socyate ; tena tatra sādhyasya samyagjñānasya sahakāryapekṣā syāt ;
analyzed: m iti ucyate tasya api viparyaya jñānam eva nimittam evam ubhayoḥ anādi tvena bīja aṅkura ādi vat kārya kāraṇa bhāvena vyavasthānāt na nirnimitta tva ādi doṣaḥ iti arthaḥ tat evam na agrahaṇa nivṛttyā viparyayasya svayam nivṛttiḥ atas vidyayā sā ucyate tena tatra sādhyasya samyak jñānasya sahakāri apekṣā syāt

original: satyāṃ ca tasyāṃ karmaṇāmabhisaṃbandha iti phalamupasaṃharati | tadetadasaṃbandhavādī dūṣayati— P. 38-4. etacceti ; tadapyasāramityarthaḥ | kathamasāramityāha—na svalpiti | svalpaśabdaḥ prasiddhidyotanārthaḥ | prasiddhamidaṃ loke, yat śuktikādau mithyājñānapūrvakasamyagjñāne jāte mithyājñānanivṛttaye samyagjñānotpādāt pṛthak yatnaṃ na kurvanti ;
analyzed: satyām ca tasyām karmaṇām abhisaṃbandhaḥ iti phalam upasaṃharati tat etat asaṃbandha vādī dūṣayati etat ca iti tat api asāram iti arthaḥ katham asāram iti āha na su alpa iti su alpa śabdaḥ prasiddhi dyotana arthaḥ prasiddham idam loke yat śuktikā ādau mithyājñāna pūrvaka samyagjñāne jāte mithyājñāna nivṛttaye samyagjñāna utpādāt pṛthak yatnam na kurvanti

original: na ca sahakāri vā samyagjñānādanyat kiñcit karmādhipekṣante, yena karmaṇāṃ sahakāritvenānupraveśaḥ syādityarthaḥ | nanu dātreṇeva lavanāya samyagjñānena viparyayanivṛttaye kimiti na prayatante, kimiti vā taddeva sahakāri nāpekṣante ityāśaṅkyāha |
analyzed: na ca sahakāri vā samyak jñānāt anyat kiñcid karma adhipekṣante yena karmaṇām sahakāri tvena anupraveśaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ nanu dātreṇa iva lavanāya samyak jñānena viparyaya nivṛttaye kim iti na prayatante kim iti vā tat deva sahakāri na apekṣante iti āśaṅkya āha

original: yadi hi dātrādiva lavanaṃ samyagjñānāt viparyayajñānanivṛttiḥ pṛthak kāryā syāt tato dātreṇeva lavanāya samyagjñānena viparyayanivṛttaye pṛthak prayateran, sahakāri vānyadapekṣeran ; na tvetadasti ; na hi dātramiva samyagjñānamutpādya paścānmithyājñānanivṛttaye vyāpāryate | kiṃ tarhi ? tadutpāda eva mithyājñānanivṛttiḥ ;
analyzed: yadi hi dātrāt iva lavanam samyagjñānāt viparyaya jñāna nivṛttiḥ pṛthak kāryā syāt tatas dātreṇa iva lavanāya samyagjñānena viparyaya nivṛttaye pṛthak prayateran sahakāri vā anyat apekṣeran na tu etat asti na hi dātram iva samyagjñānam utpādya paścāt mithyājñāna nivṛttaye vyāpāryate kim tarhi tad utpādaḥ eva mithyājñāna nivṛttiḥ

original: yato'vidyāvirodhino bhāvāntarasyotpāda eva pūrvapradhvaṃsaḥ, ataḥ kiṃ pṛthak prayatnenetyarthaḥ | bhāvāntaramātrasya pūrvapradhvaṃsatve ghaṭabhāve mṛdaḥ pradhvaṃsaḥ syāditi virodhigrahaṇam | bhāvo hyanyābhāvaḥ, anyābhāvo na bhāva iti pūrvoktaḥ sarvābhāvaprasaṅgadoṣo'pi nāstīti bhāvaḥ |

analyzed: jarayati iti tasmāt yat yasya nivartakam tat tasya virodhi nivartikā ca vidyā mithyājñānasya tasmāt virodhinī iti tatas kim iti āha tat iti yadā virodhi bhāva utpattiḥ eva pūrva pradhvaṃsaḥ vidyā ca virodhinī tadā vidyā utpattiḥ eva mithyājñāna pradhvaṃsaḥ iti vidyā utpattau mithyājñānam naṣṭam eva bhavati

original: ato dātreṇaiva lavanāya vidyayā mithyājñānanivṛttaye na pṛthak prayatante, na sahakāri cāpekṣanta iti na viparyayajñānanivṛttyarthaṃ jñānasya karmasaṃbandha iti bhāvaḥ | athocyate—syādetat, yadyavidyā bandhahetuḥ syāt ; kiṃ tu karmāṇi bandhahetavaḥ | na ca tadvirodhinī vidyā, kiṃ tvavidyāvirodhinī ;
analyzed: atas dātreṇa eva lavanāya vidyayā mithyājñāna nivṛttaye na pṛthak prayatante na sahakāri ca apekṣante iti na viparyaya jñāna nivṛtti artham jñānasya karma saṃbandhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ atha ucyate syāt etat yadī avidyā bandha hetuḥ syāt kim tu karmāṇi bandha hetavaḥ na ca tad virodhinī vidyā kim tu avidyā virodhinī

original: ato na vidyotpattireva karmadhvaṃsa iti pṛthagvidyāsādhyaḥ ; atastatra sahakāritvena karmāpekṣayā karmānupraveśa ityabhiprāyeṇāśaṅkayati—athocyeteti | tadūṣayati—tacceti | etaduktaṃ bhavati—karmāṇyavidyāvilasitānyavidyāyā nivṛttau nimittanivṛttyā svayameva nivartante, na tu tannivṛttiḥ pṛthak sādhyā, yatra karmāṇi sahakāritvāpekṣyet |
analyzed: atas na vidyā utpattiḥ eva karma dhvaṃsaḥ iti pṛthak vidyā sādhyaḥ atas tatra sahakāri tvena karma apekṣayā karma anupraveśaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āśaṅkayati atha ucyeta iti tat ūṣayati tat ca iti etat uktam bhavati karmāṇi avidyā vilasitāni avidyāyāḥ nivṛttau nimitta nivṛttyā svayam eva nivartante na tu tad nivṛttiḥ pṛthak sādhyā yatra karmāṇi sahakāri tva apekṣyet

original: avidyāyā mūlatvādyāvadavidyā tāvat ‘karmedam, idaṃ ca phalam’ iti vibhāgavyavahāramātram ; tasya vyavahārasya pramṛṣṭāḥ nirastāḥ aśeṣāḥ prapañcabhedā yasminstat tathoktam ; ata eva viśuddhaṃ ca tat vijñānaṃ ca tasyodaye kutaḥ saṃbhava ityarthaḥ | mātragrahaṇamaparamārthatvadyotanārtham | imamarthaṃ śrutyā draḍhayati—tathā ceti |
analyzed: avidyāyāḥ mūla tvāt yāvat avidyā tāvat karma idam idam ca phalam iti vibhāga vyavahāra mātram tasya vyavahārasya pramṛṣṭāḥ nirastāḥ aśeṣāḥ prapañca bhedāḥ yasmin tat tathā uktam atas eva viśuddham ca tat vijñānam ca tasya udaye kutas saṃbhavaḥ iti arthaḥ mātra grahaṇam aparama artha tva dyotana artham imam artham śrutyā draḍhayati tathā ca iti

analyzed: viparyaya saṃśayābhyām karma anapekṣa samyagjñāna nivartyābhyām saha karmaṇaḥ samyagjñāna nivartya tvena tulya vat pāṭhāt karma anapekṣa samyagjñāna nivartya tvam avasīyate iti arthaḥ hṛdayagranthiḥ viparyāsaḥ mataḥ prakāra antareṇa jñāne karmaṇām anvayam āśaṅkya dūṣayati atha iti jñāne hi saṃśaya viparyāsau eva male na anyat

analyzed: śabda janitāt brahma jñānāt anyat api vigalita upaścaṣṭaḥ vibhāga udvāhaḥ prapañca bheda avabhāsaḥ yasmin tat atas eva sarva vikalpa atītam viyat ādi jagat vikalpa rahitam taccam brahma taccam yasmin tat tādṛśam pratyakṣam jñānam mithyate tasya eva ca brahma gocaraḥ

analyzed: viṣayaḥ na vedānta śabda janitasya vibhaktānām nānā bhūtānām padārthānām anyonya saṃsargaḥ tam udgrahītum śīlam yasya tasya iti arthaḥ etat uktam bhavati advaitam brahma tu vigalita dvaita vikalpena eva pratyakṣa jñānena jñātum śakyate na tu śābda jñānena tat hi nānā padārtha saṃsarga rūpa vākya artha viṣaya tvena dvaita viṣaya tvāt na advaitam brahma gamayati iti

original: 33-17. tataḥ kimityāha—tadutpattāviti ; nimittasaptamī “carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti” itivat | karmānvayaprastāve tulyanyāyatvena prasaṅgādupāsanādyanvayo'pi darśitaiti draṣṭavyam | upāsanamanudinamanucintanam | ādiśabdena brahmacaryādigrahaṇam | evamāśaṅkya dūṣayati—ka iti |

original: asya pratyakṣajñānasya śābdajñānāt ko viśeṣaḥ, yena hetunā jāte'pi śābdajñāne tat pratyakṣajñānaṃ prārthayate tadarthaṃ ca karmāṇyapekṣyate ; “sa eṣa neti netyātmā” “eka evāyamādvitīyaḥ” ityādiśābdajñānasyāpyadvaitaviṣayatvāviśeṣānna ko'pi viśeṣastasyāstīti bhāvaḥ | itaraḥ śābdajñānāt pratyakṣasya viśeṣamāha—spaṣṭābhatvamiti | tat dūṣayati—neti |
analyzed: asya pratyakṣa jñānasya śābdajñānāt kaḥ viśeṣaḥ yena hetunā jāte api śābdajñāne tat pratyakṣa jñānam prārthayate tad artham ca karmāṇi apekṣyate saḥ eṣa na iti na iti ātmā ekaḥ eva ayam ādvitīyaḥ ityādi śābdajñānasya api advaita viṣaya tva aviśeṣāt na kaḥ api viśeṣaḥ tasya asti iti bhāvaḥ itaraḥ śābdajñānāt pratyakṣasya viśeṣam āha spaṣṭa ābha tvam iti tat dūṣayati na iti

original: astu pratyakṣasya spaṣṭābhatvam ; tathāpi na tadarthanīyam | spaṣṭābhatvasyaivānupayogādityarthaḥ | anupayogamāha—jñānaṃ hīti | jñeyaprāptaye jñānamapekṣyate, na ca sā śābdajñānānna bhavatītyataḥ kiṃ spaṣṭābhatvena ? ato na tadarthaṃ pratyakṣaṃ prārthanīyamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: astu pratyakṣasya spaṣṭa ābha tvam tathā api na tat arthanīyam spaṣṭa ābha tvasya eva anupayogāt iti arthaḥ anupayogam āha jñānam hi iti jñeya prāptaye jñānam apekṣyate na ca sā śābda jñānāt na bhavati iti atas kim spaṣṭa ābha tvena atas na tad artham pratyakṣam prārthanīyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvevaṃ tarhi sarvasyāḥ pramāṇāntarajāyāḥ pramiteḥ pratyakṣaparatvena pratyakṣamarthyatām ; tadetadāśaṅkyati—pramiteriti | pratyakṣaṃ paraṃ pradhānaṃ yasyā iti vigrahaḥ ; pratyakṣaparyavasāyitvādityarthaḥ ; tadarthyata iti vakṣyamāṇenānvayaḥ | kutaḥ pramiteḥ pratyakṣaparatvamityata āha—tatreti |
analyzed: nanu evam tarhi sarvasyāḥ pramāṇa antara jāyāḥ pramiteḥ pratyakṣa paratvena pratyakṣam arthyatām tat etat āśaṅkyati pramiteḥ iti pratyakṣam param pradhānam yasyāḥ iti vigrahaḥ pratyakṣa paryavasāyi tvāt iti arthaḥ tad arthyataḥ iti vakṣyamāṇena anvayaḥ kutas pramiteḥ pratyakṣa paratvam iti atas āha tatra iti

original: tatra tasmin pratyakṣe sati pramātuḥ nairutsukyādityarthaḥ | tathā hi—dhūmādinā agnyādi dūre pramitamapi pramātā punaḥ pratyakṣeṇa pramitsati ; evamāśaṅkya dūṣayati—naitaditi | na hi sarvā pramitiḥ pratyakṣaparā, vaidikyā dharmādipramityā vyabhicārāt ; agnyādāvapi vyavahārāya saṃnidhānaṃ pramātāpekṣate, na tu pratyakṣapramitim ;
analyzed: tatra tasmin pratyakṣe sati pramātuḥ nairutsukyāt iti arthaḥ tathā hi dhūma ādinā agni ādi dūre pramitam api pramātā punar pratyakṣeṇa pramitsati evam āśaṅkya dūṣayati na etat iti na hi sarvā pramitiḥ pratyakṣa parā vaidikyā dharma ādi pramityā vyabhicārāt agni ādau api vyavahārāya saṃnidhānam pramātā apekṣate na tu pratyakṣa pramitim

original: daivāt tatsamīhitasya sā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | tathā brahmasaṃnihite sūryagatyādau na sā bhavati, bhavati ca pramāturnairutsukyam ; ato na pratyakṣaparā pramitiḥ, kiṃ tu prameyādhigamamātraparā | tatrādhigate prameye kimaparamākāṅkṣyate ? na kiṃcidityarthaḥ | nanvadhigate'pi prameye pramāṇāntaramākāṅkṣipyata ityāśaṅkya dūṣayati—pramāṇāntaramiti |
analyzed: daivāt tad samīhitasya sā bhavati iti bhāvaḥ tathā brahma saṃnihite sūrya gati ādau na sā bhavati bhavati ca pramātuḥ nairutsukyam atas na pratyakṣa parā pramitiḥ kim tu prameya adhigama mātra parā tatra adhigate prameye kim aparam ākāṅkṣyate na kiṃcid iti arthaḥ nanu adhigate api prameye pramāṇa antaram ākāṅkṣipyate iti āśaṅkya dūṣayati pramāṇa antaram iti

original: pramāṇāntaraṃ hi
analyzed: pramāṇa antaram hi

original: prameyasiddhyarthamākāṅkṣyate, nāṭyāya ; prameyaṃ ca pūrvapramāṇādeva siddhamiti pramāṇāntarākāṅkṣā vyarthaivetyarthaḥ | na vyarthā, siddhasyāpi hi prameyasya punaḥ siddhyarthamapekṣā bhaviṣyatīti cet ; maivam ; siddhasyāpi punaḥ siddhyā cetprayojanam, tadā pūrvapramāṇādeva sā setsyati ; tathāpi pramāṇāntarākāṅkṣā vyarthaiveti |
analyzed: prameya siddhi artham ākāṅkṣyate nāṭyāya prameyam ca pūrva pramāṇāt eva siddham iti pramāṇa antara ākāṅkṣā vyarthā eva iti arthaḥ na vyarthā siddhasya api hi prameyasya punar siddhi artham apekṣā bhaviṣyati iti ced mā evam siddhasya api punar siddhyā ced prayojanam tadā pūrva pramāṇāt eva sā setsyati tathā api pramāṇa antara ākāṅkṣā vyarthā eva iti

original: tadetatsāśaṅkyāha—punariti | etacca punaḥ siddhyākā P. 33-22. ikṣāmabhyupagamyoktam ; paramārthatastu sakṛtsiddhyaiva pramāturnairākāṅkṣyāt punaḥ siddhyākāṅkṣāyāṃ na kaściddheturastītyāha—siddhasyeti | nanvāgamasiddhasyāpi prameyasyāgamādupāyāntaraṃ pratyakṣamastīti tataḥ punaḥ siddhyapekṣā bhavati |
analyzed: tat etat sa āśaṅkya āha punar iti etat ca punar siddhi ākāṅkṣām abhyupagamya uktam paramārthataḥ tu sakṛt siddhyā eva pramātuḥ nairākāṅkṣyāt punar siddhi ākāṅkṣāyām na kaścid hetuḥ asti iti āha siddhasya iti nanu āgama siddhasya api prameyasya āgamāt upāya antaram pratyakṣam asti iti tatas punar siddhi apekṣā bhavati

original: tataśca kathamucyate heturnāstīti ? yāvadupāyāntarasadbhāvo heturityāśaṅkya dūṣayati—upāyāntaramiti | pramāṇāntaraṃ tarhyanugrāhyatayāpekṣyatām ; prameye tu pūrvasiddhyāt pramāturnairākāṅkṣyameva | na ca prameye siddhe pramāṇāntaraṃ svato'pekṣyam ; prameyasiddhyarthatvāt tadapekṣāyā iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca katham ucyate hetuḥ na asti iti yāvat upāya antara sadbhāvaḥ hetuḥ iti āśaṅkya dūṣayati upāya antaram iti pramāṇa antaram tarhi anugrāhya tayā apekṣyatām prameye tu pūrva siddhyāt pramātuḥ nairākāṅkṣyam eva na ca prameye siddhe pramāṇa antaram svatā upekṣyam prameya siddhi artha tvāt tad apekṣāyāḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: atha siddhasyāpi priyasya punaḥ siddhau prītiviśeṣo bhavati ; priyaścātmā—“tadetat preyaḥ putrāt” iti śruteḥ ; tena prītiviśeṣaḥ punaḥ siddhyapekṣāheturityāśaṅkya nirasyati—prītīti |
analyzed: atha siddhasya api priyasya punar siddhau prīti viśeṣaḥ bhavati priyaḥ ca ātmā tat etat preyaḥ putrāt iti śruteḥ tena prīti viśeṣaḥ punar siddhi apekṣā hetuḥ iti āśaṅkya nirasyati prīti iti

original: yadi jñātasyāpīṣṭasya punarjñānāt prītiviśeṣo bhavati, tathāpi pūrvapramāṇajādapi punardarśanāt sa siddhyatīti na prītiviśeṣasiddhyarthaṃ pramāṇāntaramapekṣaṇīyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yadi jñātasya api iṣṭasya punar jñānāt prīti viśeṣaḥ bhavati tathā api pūrva pramāṇa jāt api punar darśanāt sa siddhi atīti na prīti viśeṣa siddhi artham pramāṇa antaram apekṣaṇīyam iti arthaḥ

original: kiṃ ca yadyāgamajñātamapi prītiviśeṣārthaṃ pratyakṣeṇa punarjñijñāsyeta, tataḥ pratyakṣadṛṣṭamapyanyairanumānādibhirjñijñāsyeta, tatrāpi prītiviśeṣasaṃbhavādeva teṣāṃ viśeṣābhāvādityāha—pratyakṣadṛṣṭamiti | na ca teṣāmaniścāyakatvāt tairna jñijñāsyata ityāha—niścāyakatvamiti |
analyzed: kim ca yadi āgama jñātam api prīti viśeṣa artham pratyakṣeṇa punar jñijñāsyeta tatas pratyakṣa dṛṣṭam api anyaiḥ anumāna ādibhiḥ jñijñāsyeta tatra api prīti viśeṣa saṃbhavāt eva teṣām viśeṣa abhāvāt iti āha pratyakṣa dṛṣṭam iti na ca teṣām aniścāyaka tvāt taiḥ na jñijñāsyate iti āha niścāyaka tvam iti

original: ‘niścāyakatve’ iti pāṭhe tu niścāyakatve viśeṣābhāvamuktvā tatra heturuktaḥ—itareṣāmiti | niścāyakaṃ hi pramāṇaṃ bhavati ; tānyapi ca pramāṇam ; ato niścāyakānītyarthaḥ | pramāṇabhāvāditi ; pramāṇatvādityarthaḥ | athocyeta—saṃnikṛṣṭaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣam, saṃnikṛṣṭaṃ ca hānopādānayogyam ; anumānādi tu viprakṛṣṭaviṣayam, na tena vyavahartuṃ śakyam ;
analyzed: niścāyaka tve iti pāṭhe tu niścāyaka tve viśeṣa abhāvam uktvā tatra hetuḥ uktaḥ itareṣām iti niścāyakam hi pramāṇam bhavati tāni api ca pramāṇam atas niścāyakāni iti arthaḥ pramāṇa bhāvāt iti pramāṇa tvāt iti arthaḥ atha ucyeta saṃnikṛṣṭa viṣayam pratyakṣam saṃnikṛṣṭam ca hāna upādāna yogyam anumāna ādi tu viprakṛṣṭa viṣayam na tena vyavahartum śakyam

original: tenetaraiḥ pramitamapi pratyakṣeṇa pramitsyate, na pratyakṣapramitamitarairiti ; tadāśaṅkyati—hānādīti | hānādiyogyo viṣayo yasya tat tathoktam | saṃnikṛṣṭo'rtho viṣayo yasya tat ; saṃnikṛṣṭārthatvāditi hānādiyogyaviṣayatve hetuḥ | tannirasyati ; yadi saṃnikṛṣṭo'pekṣita

original: starhi taddhetureva prameyasya samīpānayanaṃ pramāturvā tatsamīpagamanapaddeyatām, na tu pramāṇam; taddhi pramitaye'pekṣyate; sā ca pūrvapramāṇādeva siddhetyarthaḥ | prakṛte cātmani prameye naiva saṃnikṛṣṭāsaṃnikṛṣṭalakṣaṇo viśeṣo'sti, yena saṃnikarṣārthaṃ pratyakṣamapekṣyate; ātmano nityasaṃnikṛṣṭatamatvādityabhiprāyeṇāha— P. 34-4. prakṛte ceti |
analyzed: tarhi tad hetuḥ eva prameyasya samīpa ānayanam pramātuḥ vā tad samīpa gamana pad deya tām na tu pramāṇam tat hi pramitayā ipekṣyate sā ca pūrva pramāṇāt eva siddhā iti arthaḥ prakṛte ca ātmani prameye na eva saṃnikṛṣṭa asaṃnikṛṣṭa lakṣaṇaḥ viśeṣaḥ usti yena saṃnikarṣa artham pratyakṣam apekṣyate ātmanaḥ nitya saṃnikṛṣṭatama tvāt iti abhiprāyeṇa āha prakṛte ca iti

original: atha matam—sāmānyaviṣayāḥ śabdādayaḥ, viśeṣaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣam; tena śabdāt sāmānyataḥ pramitamapi viśeṣataḥ pramātuṃ pratyakṣamapekṣyata iti | tadyuktam; evaṃ tarhi śabdena hetunānadhigatameva viśeṣarūpaṃ pratyakṣaviṣayaḥ syāt; tataśca siddho naḥ pakṣaḥ; na siddhasya punaḥ siddhañcapekṣāyāṃ heturasti; tadetatsarvaṃ sāśaṅkumāha—sāmānyeti |
analyzed: atha matam sāmānya viṣayāḥ śabda ādayaḥ viśeṣa viṣayam pratyakṣam tena śabdāt sāmānyataḥ pramitam api viśeṣataḥ pramātum pratyakṣam apekṣyate iti tat yuktam evam tarhi śabdena hetunā anadhigatam eva viśeṣa rūpam pratyakṣa viṣayaḥ syāt tatas ca siddhaḥ naḥ pakṣaḥ na siddhasya punar siddham ca pekṣāyām hetuḥ asti tat etat sarvam sa āśaṅkum āha sāmānya iti

original: itara idānīṃ tathaiva pratyavāteṣṭate—bāḍhamiti | asmākamapyabhimatametat, yacchabdenānavagataviṣayaṃ pratyakṣamiti; atastadarthaṃ karmopāsanādyapekṣā ghaṭiṣyata ityāśayaḥ | uktamiti | 'tasya ca brahma gocaraḥ, na śabdasya' ityatroktamityarthaḥ | tadetat dūṣayati—yadīti |
analyzed: itaraḥ idānīm tathā eva asmākam api abhimatam etat yat śabdena anavagata viṣayam pratyakṣam iti atas tad artham karma upāsana ādi apekṣā ghaṭiṣyate iti āśayaḥ uktam iti tasya ca brahma gocaraḥ na śabdasya iti atra uktam iti arthaḥ tat etat dūṣayati yadi iti

original: yadi śabdena hetunā viśeṣato'nadhigataṃ brahma, kathaṃ tarhi tasmin brahmaṇi viśeṣarūpeṇopāsanā pravartatām? na hyajñātamupāsituṃ śakyamiti bhāvaḥ | na ca śabdādhigataṃ sāmānyarūpamupāsiṣyate, viśeṣarūpaṃ cāparokṣaṃ bhaviṣyatīti vācyam; anyasminnupāsite'nyasya sākṣātkaraṇāsaṃbhavādityāha—na ceti |
analyzed: yadi śabdena hetunā viśeṣataḥ unadhigatam brahma katham tarhi tasmin brahmaṇi viśeṣa rūpeṇa upāsanā pravartatām na hi ajñātam upāsitum śakyam iti bhāvaḥ na ca śabda adhigatam sāmānya rūpam upāsiṣyate viśeṣa rūpam ca aparokṣam bhaviṣyati iti vācyam anyasmin upāsitenyasya sākṣātkaraṇa asaṃbhavāt iti āha na ca iti

original: kiṃ ca sāmānyamātraviṣayāḥ śabdā ityapyasiddham, apahatapāpmānandādiviśeṣasyāpi tataḥ pratīteḥ; yadi tvapahatapāpmānandādipuruṣārtharūpaṃ śabdānna gamyeta, tataḥ kasya rūpasya sākṣātkaraṇāya "yajñena dānena" iti śrutyā yajñādividhānaṃ syāt? api tu na syādevetyabhiprāyeṇāha—kasya ceti |

original: yathā śabdādviśeṣarūpe jñāte yajñādividhānaṃ ghaṭate, yathā cājñāte na ghaṭate tadubhayamāha—śabdeti | ayamarthaḥ—yadi śabdenānandādirūpabrahmasvabhāva ātmā darśitaḥ syāt, tata ānandādipuruṣārthāvāptaye sādhanāpekṣāyāṃ yajñādīnāṃ vidhānamavakalpate;

original: na hyarthe kiṃcidakurvatastādarthamavakalpate ; vikāraśca kāryaḥ ; tena kāryameva sāpekṣam, nārtha ityāśaṅkyāha—na ceti | syādeva yadi jñānena vikāro'rthe janyeta, na tvevamastītyarthaḥ | yadvā jñānena cedartho'bhivyajyate, nūnaṃ jñānādarthe kaścidvikāraḥ syāt, akiṃcitkarasyānabhivyañjakatvāt ;

analyzed: atas ca brahmaṇi abhivyajyamāne tathā eva vikāra āpatteḥ anitya tva doṣaḥ syāt iti āśaṅkya āstām tāvat brahmaṇi arthe api na jñānāt vikāraḥ bhavati iti āha na ca iti yat vā nanu jñānam artham vikṛtya abhivyanakti itarathā sarvadhā ananyathābhūtasya prāk iva abhivyakti ayogāt tatas ca yuktā brahma tu avikārya tvāt abhivyaṅktum aśakyam

analyzed: yadi jñānāt arthe prāk tavya ādi vikāraḥ kaścid bhavet tatas tatra abhivyaktiḥ tāttvikī syāt yadā tu na evam tadā sarvatra eva sā māyām adhī tathā brahmaṇi api kim na syāt na hi māyāyām pūrva ukta anupapatti doṣaḥ anupapanna ādyā eva hi māyā iti ucyate iti bhāvaḥ jñānāt arthasya vikāra abhāve hetum āha tayoḥ iti na asaṃbaddham hi indhanam amiḥ vikaroti

original: asaṃbaddhaṃ ca jñānamāntaraṃ bahirarthena; ato nārthaṃ vikarotītyarthaḥ | athetarasaṃbandhābhāve'pi yogyadeśatālakṣaṇo'rthasya jñānena saṃbandho bhaviṣyatīti cedata āha—yogyeti | yogyadeśatā arthasyārjavenāvasthānam, tacca rūparasādau sapānāśraye sarvatra samānam; ato rūpajñānaṃ rūpa iva rasādāvapi prāktavyākhyāyāṃ vikāraṃ kuryādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: asaṃbaddham ca jñānam āntaram bahis arthena atas na artham vikaroti iti arthaḥ atha itara saṃbandha abhāve pi yogya deśa tā lakṣaṇaḥ ūrthasya jñānena saṃbandhaḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced atas āha yogya iti yogya deśa tā arthasya ārjavena avasthānam tat ca rūpa rasa ādau sa pāna āśraye sarvatra samānam atas rūpa jñānam rūpe iva rasa ādau api vikāram kuryāt iti arthaḥ

original: yadyapi asaṃniruṣṭasya vikārakatvamagnyādiṣu na dṛṣṭamityayamatra parihāraḥ, tathāpyamyupetya parihārāntaramuktamiti | kiṃca jñānaṃ cedarthe prāktavyaṃ janayet tataḥ kasyacidekasya jñānena jāte prāktavye arthaḥ sarveṣāṃ prakaṭaḥ syāt, yathaikasya pākena jātalohityo ghaṭaḥ sarveṣāṃ lohitaḥ, na pakṣareva, tadāha— sarveti |
analyzed: yadi api asaṃniruṣṭasya vikāraka tvam agni ādiṣu na dṛṣṭam iti ayam atra parihāraḥ tathā api ami upetya parihāra antaram uktam iti kiṃca jñānam ced arthe prāktavyam janayet tatas kasyacid ekasya jñānena jāte prāktavye arthaḥ sarveṣām prakaṭaḥ syāt yathā ekasya pākena jāta lohityaḥ ghaṭaḥ sarveṣām lohitaḥ na tat āha sarva iti

original: kiṃca vartamāne'rthe janyatāṃ nāma jñānena prāktavyam; atītānāgate tu liṅgādigamye na tatsaṃbhavaḥ, dharmiṇa evābhāvādityabhiprāyeṇāha— dhvasteti | evaṃ dṛṣṭāntasvarūpamupapādyopasaṃharati—tasmāditi | sphaṭikadravyaṃ hi lohitakambalenāvakuṇṭhanavat na japākusumena tirohitam; nāpi tatprabhayā, tasyā aprabhādravyatvāt;
analyzed: kiṃca vartamāna irthe janyatām nāma jñānena prāktavyam atīta anāgate tu liṅga ādi gamye na tad saṃbhavaḥ dharmiṇaḥ eva abhāvāt iti abhiprāyeṇa āha dhvasta iti evam dṛṣṭānta svarūpam upapādya upasaṃharati tasmāt iti sphaṭika dravyam hi lohita kambalena avakuṇṭhana vat na japā kusumena tirohitam nā api tad prabhayā tasyāḥ a prabhā dravya tvāt

original: atha ca tirohitamivābhāti, na tu tattvatastattirohitam; ata evātirohitatvāt tattvato nābhivyajyate, tathāpyabhivyajyamānamivopadhānāpakarṣaṇaprayatnamapekṣate yathetyarthaḥ | evaṃ dṛṣṭānte siddhamarthaṃ dārṣṭāntike yojayati—tatheti | tathātmatattvamapi kṛṣṇakambaleneva nānādyavidyātirohitam, tathāpi svarūpānavabhāsāt tirohitamiva yajñādi-
analyzed: atha ca tirohitam iva ābhāti na tu tattvataḥ tat tirohitam atas eva atirohita tvāt tattvataḥ na abhivyajyate tathā api abhivyajyamānam iva upadhāna apakarṣaṇa prayatnam apekṣate yathā iti arthaḥ evam dṛṣṭānte siddham artham dārṣṭāntike yojayati tathā iti tathā ātma tattvam api kṛṣṇa kambalena iva nānā ādya vidyā tirohitam tathā api svarūpa anavabhāsāt tirohitam iva yajña ādi
