original: prayatnādabhivyajyata ivetyadoṣa ityarthaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati—tirodhānamabhivyaktiḥ prayatnāpekṣā ceti tritayamapyetadātmano na tāttvikam ; api tu avidyā bhrama eva ; tattvatastu nātmā tirohito na ca nityābhivyaktasvabhāvatvādabhivyajyate, na ca prayatnamapekṣata iti |
analyzed: prayatnāt abhivyajyate iva iti adoṣaḥ iti arthaḥ etat uktam bhavati tirodhānam abhivyaktiḥ prayatna apekṣā ca iti tritayam api etat ātmanaḥ na tāttvikam api tu avidyā bhramaḥ eva tattvataḥ tu na ātmā tirohitaḥ na ca nitya abhivyakta svabhāva tvāt abhivyajyate na ca prayatnam apekṣate iti

original: evam ‘āmnāyataḥ prasiddhim’ ityādinā brahmasiddhau pramāṇamuktvā adhunā tatprameyasya brahmaṇaḥ svarūpamāha—saṃhṛteti | ślokārthaṃ vidyaṇeti— P. 37-19 yata iti | anyairvaihvāviddhiriti pūjārtham, na svamataṃ paryudasitum | saṃhṛtā upasaṃhṛtā akhilā bhedā viśeṣā yasmin sa saṃhṛtākhilabhedaḥ | sāmānyātmā sāmānyasvabhāvaḥ, sa ātmā varṇitaḥ |
analyzed: evam āmnāyataḥ prasiddhim ityādinā brahma siddhau pramāṇam uktvā adhunā tad prameyasya brahmaṇaḥ svarūpam āha saṃhṛta iti śloka artham yatas iti anyaiḥ vaihvā viddhiḥ iti pūjā artham na sva matam paryudasitum saṃhṛtāḥ upasaṃhṛtāḥ akhilāḥ bhedāḥ viśeṣāḥ yasmin sa saṃhṛta akhila bhedaḥ sāmānya ātmā sāmānya svabhāvaḥ saḥ ātmā varṇitaḥ

original: yathā hema kaṭakādibhedānāṃ viśeṣāṇāmupasaṃhāreṇa sūcitaṃ nirūpitaṃ teṣāṃ kaṭakādibhedānāṃ sāmānyaṃ tathetyarthaḥ | pārihāryaṃ kaṭakamucyate | “ sa eṣa mahān ” ityādinā brahmavidyābhiyuktagranthaṃ paṭhati | yadviśeṣāpoddhāreṇa pratīyate, tadviśeṣavat ; yacca viśeṣavat tat sāmānyam, yathā suvarṇatattvam ;
analyzed: yathā hema kaṭaka ādi bhedānām viśeṣāṇām upasaṃhāreṇa sūcitam nirūpitam teṣām kaṭaka ādi bhedānām sāmānyam tathā iti arthaḥ pārihāryam kaṭakam ucyate saḥ eṣa mahān ityādinā brahma vidyā abhiyukta grantham paṭhati yat viśeṣa apoddhāreṇa pratīyate tat viśeṣa vat yat ca viśeṣa vat tat sāmānyam yathā suvarṇa tattvam

original: ātmatattvamapi “ sa eṣa neti neti ” iti sarvaviśeṣāpoddhāreṇa pratīyate ; tasmāt tadapi viśeṣāpoddhāreṇa pratīyamānatvāt sāmānyamiti tātparyārthaḥ | ślokamanyathā vyācaṣṭe—ye veti | yadi nirviśeṣaṃ yat tat sāmānyaṃ na bhavediti nirviśeṣasyāsāmānyarūpatā sādhyate, tataḥ siddhasādhanam ;
analyzed: ātma tattvam api saḥ eṣa na iti na iti iti sarva viśeṣa apoddhāreṇa pratīyate tasmāt tat api viśeṣa apoddhāreṇa pratīyamāna tvāt sāmānyam iti tātparyārthaḥ ślokam anyathā vyācaṣṭe ye vā iti yadi nirviśeṣam yat tat sāmānyam na bhavet iti nirviśeṣasya asāmānya rūpa tā sādhyate tatas siddhasādhanam

original: asmākamapyadvayavādināṃ viyadādiviśeṣāṇāmabhāve vastudṛṣṭyā nātmatattvasāmānyamiṣṭam | kathaṃ tārhi brahmavādibhiḥ sāmānyamuktamata āha—sāmānyaṃ tūktamupacārata iti | nanu kutaścit sādhāraṇāddharmādupacāro bhavati ; yathā tīvratvādabhiśabdasya māṇavake ; tadatra kuto dharmādupacāra ityata āha—viśeṣeti |
analyzed: asmākam api advaya vādinām viyat ādi viśeṣāṇām abhāve vastu dṛṣṭyā na ātma tattva sāmānyam iṣṭam katham tārhi brahma vādibhiḥ sāmānyam uktam atas āha sāmānyam tu uktam upacārataḥ iti nanu kutaścid sādhāraṇāt dharmāt upacāraḥ bhavati yathā tīvra tvāt abhiśabdasya māṇavake tat atra kutas dharmāt upacāraḥ iti atas āha viśeṣa iti

original: suvarṇādau pratiddhāt sāmānyasya dharmāt viśeṣapratyastamayamukhena nirūpyamāṇatvādātmani sādhāraṇādupacāra ityarthaḥ | asmin vyākhyāne prasiddhasuvarṇatattvasāmānyasādṛśyapradarśanārtho'yaṃ śloka iti draṣṭavyam | atha nirviśeṣaṃ yatsāmānyaṃ parairiṣṭaṃ tanna bhavet, nirviśeṣatvāt śaśāviṣāṇavaddhiti tasyābhāva eva sādhyate ;
analyzed: suvarṇa ādau pratiddhāt sāmānyasya dharmāt viśeṣa pratyasta maya mukhena nirūpyamāṇa tvāt ātmani sādhāraṇāt upacāraḥ iti arthaḥ asmin vyākhyāne prasiddha suvarṇa tattva sāmānya sādṛśya pradarśana arthaḥ yam ślokaḥ iti draṣṭavyam atha nirviśeṣam yat sāmānyam paraiḥ iṣṭam tat na bhavet nirviśeṣa tvāt śaśāḥ viṣāṇa vat hi iti tasya abhāvaḥ eva sādhyate

original: tato viśeṣaireva hetoḥ vyabhicāro'naikānti-
analyzed: tatas viśeṣaiḥ eva hetoḥ vyabhicāraḥ na aikānti

original: katā | nanu viśeṣāṇāmapyavāntarāḥ santi viśeṣāḥ, tataśca teṣu nirviśeṣapatvaṃ hetureva nāsti ; kasya vyabhicāra ityata āha—nirviśeṣairiti | yadyapi pūrvaṃ viśeṣāḥ, teṣāmapyanaṅgatvādye nirviśeṣā avaśiṣyante tairvyabhicāra ityarthaḥ | etaccocchlokamuktamiti na ślokayojanāyāmabhiniveṣṭavyam ||
analyzed: nanu viśeṣāṇām api avāntarāḥ santi viśeṣāḥ tatas ca teṣu nirviśeṣapa tvam hetuḥ eva na asti kasya vyabhicāraḥ iti atas āha nirviśeṣaiḥ iti yadi api pūrvam viśeṣāḥ teṣām api anaṅga tvāt ye nirviśeṣāḥ avaśiṣyante taiḥ vyabhicāraḥ iti arthaḥ etat ca ucchlokam uktam iti na śloka yojanāyām abhiniveṣṭavyam

original: iti śrībrahmasiddhivyākhyāne brahmakāṇḍavyākhyānaṃ śaṅkhapaṇinā kṛtam ||
analyzed: iti śrī brahmasiddhi vyākhyāne brahmakāṇḍa vyākhyānam śaṅkhapaṇinā kṛtam

original: ām brahmasiddhivyākhyā śaṅkhapāṇikṛtā tarkakāṇḍaḥ āmnāyapramāṇakramadvayaṃ brahmeti brahmakāṇḍe vṛttam | tatrādhunā yat pratyakṣādiviruddhaṃ vaktavadapramāṇam, pratyakṣādiviruddhatvāt śilāñjavanādivākyavat; advayāmnāyo'pi vyāvṛttastvabhāvano'vagrāhakaiḥ pratyakṣādibhirviruddhaḥ;
analyzed: brahmasiddhi vyākhyā śaṅkhapāṇi kṛtā tarka kāṇḍaḥ āmnāya pramāṇa krama dvayam brahma iti brahmakāṇḍe vṛttam tatra adhunā yat pratyakṣa ādi viruddham vaktavat apramāṇam pratyakṣa ādi viruddha tvāt śilāñjavana ādi vākya vat advaya āmnāyaḥ api vyāvṛttaḥ tu abhāvanā uvagrāhakaiḥ pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ viruddhaḥ

original: ato'pramāṇamityākṣipya pratyakṣādiviruddhatvāditi hetorasiddhatāmabhidhātuṃ pratyakṣavirodhābhāvaṃ tāvadāha—āhuriti | yadi pratyakṣam 'ghaṭaḥ paṭo na P. 39-3. bhavati' iti niṣekṭu syāt, tato bhedaviṣayatvādadvayāmnāyaṃ viruddhyāt; na tu tadviṣekṭu vipaścita āhuḥ; apitu vastustvarūpamātrasya vidhātu grāhakam;
analyzed: atas pramāṇam iti ākṣipya pratyakṣa ādi viruddha tvāt iti hetoḥ asiddha tām abhidhātum pratyakṣa virodha abhāvam tāvat āha āhuḥ iti yadi pratyakṣam ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ na bhavati iti niṣekṭu syāt tatas bheda viṣaya tvāt advaya āmnāyam na tu tat viṣekṭu vipaścitaḥ āhuḥ apitu vastuḥ tva rūpa mātrasya vidhātu grāhakam

original: tena hetunā ekatve'dvayaviṣaye yo'yam 'eka evāyamadvitīyaḥ' ityādirāmnāyaḥ sa pratyakṣeṇa na viruddhyata ityarthaḥ | atredānīṃ pratyakṣādivirodhe'pi nāmnāyasya prāmāṇyaṃ vyāhanyate; pauruṣeyaṃ hi vaco vaktṛpramāṇādhīnaprāmāṇyaṃ tadvirodhe syādapramāṇam, nāpauruṣeyamanapekṣaprāmāṇyam;
analyzed: tena hetunā ekatve dvaya viṣaye yaḥ ayam ekaḥ eva ayam advitīyaḥ ityādiḥ āmnāyaḥ sa pratyakṣeṇa na viruddhyate iti arthaḥ atra idānīm pratyakṣa ādi virodhe api na āmnāyasya prāmāṇyam vyāhanyate pauruṣeyam hi vacaḥ vaktṛ pramāṇa adhīna prāmāṇyam tad virodhe syāt apramāṇam na apauruṣeyam anapekṣa prāmāṇyam

original: tathā satyapi pratyakṣādivirodhe yadi tadapramāṇaṃ tadā viparyaya eva kiṃ na syāt? na hi pratyakṣādirāmnāyasya ca tulye'napekṣatve kaścit viśeṣaheturasti, yena pratyakṣādivirodhādāmnāyo'pramāṇam, na tadvirodhāt pratyakṣādīti; ato vṛthaiva pratyakṣādyavirodhapratipādanaprayāsa iti tadvicārārambhamākṣipati — nanviti |
analyzed: tathā sati api pratyakṣa ādi virodhe yadi tat apramāṇam tadā viparyayaḥ eva kim na syāt na hi pratyakṣa ādiḥ āmnāyasya ca tulyena apekṣa tve kaścid viśeṣa hetuḥ asti yena pratyakṣa ādi virodhāt āmnāya upramāṇam na tad virodhāt pratyakṣa ādi iti atas vṛthā eva pratyakṣa ādi avirodha pratipādana prayāsaḥ iti tad vicāra ārambham ākṣipati nanu iti

original: nāpekṣitā straprāmāṇyāya pratyakṣādeḥ pramāṇāntarasya vṛttiḥ vyāpāraḥ yena sa tathoktaḥ | tadvirodhe iti pratyakṣādivirodhe ityarthaḥ | atraikīyamatena tāvatparihāramāha—tatreti | pratyakṣādivirodhe āmnāyasya daurbalyam; ataḥ pratyakṣādivirodhena tadaprāmāṇyaṃ prāptam;
analyzed: na apekṣitā stra prāmāṇyāya pratyakṣa ādeḥ pramāṇa antarasya vṛttiḥ vyāpāraḥ yena sa tathā uktaḥ tad virodhe iti pratyakṣa ādi virodhe iti arthaḥ atra ekīya matena tāvat parihāram āha tatra iti pratyakṣa ādi virodhe āmnāyasya daurbalyam atas pratyakṣa ādi virodhena tat aprāmāṇyam prāptam

original: na tu tadvirodhe pratyakṣādirityāmnāyaprāmāṇyāya pratyakṣādyavirodhapratipādanamarthavat, na tu vṛthetyarthaḥ | kathaṃ daurbalyamityāha—sāpekṣatvāditi | sāpekṣatvamāha—tathā-
analyzed: na tu tad virodhe pratyakṣa ādiḥ iti āmnāya prāmāṇyāya pratyakṣa ādi avirodha pratipādanam arthavat na tu vṛthā iti arthaḥ katham daurbalyam iti āha sāpekṣa tvāt iti sāpekṣatvam āha tathā

original: hīti | paṭhitasiddhaḥ kaścidāgnāyaḥ śrautapratyakṣamapekṣate, tathācāreṣu kartṛsāmānyānubheyo'numānam, mantraliṅgādigamyaśrārthāpattim, prākṛtaśrāṅgavidheryikṛtānupamānam | evaṃ sarve evāgnāyaḥ pratyakṣādīnyapekṣate ; tadadhīnā hi P. 39-11. tasya svarūpasiddhirityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityāha—tathā ceti | teṣāmiti pratyakṣādīnāmityarthaḥ |
analyzed: hi iti paṭhita siddhaḥ kaścid āgnāyaḥ śrauta pratyakṣam apekṣate tathā ācāreṣu kartṛ sāmānya anubheya unumānam mantra liṅga ādi gamya śra artha āpattim prākṛta śra aṅga vidheḥ yikṛta anupamānam evam sarve eva āgnāyaḥ pratyakṣa ādīni apekṣate tad adhīnā hi tasya svarūpa siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ tatas kim iti āha tathā ca iti teṣām iti pratyakṣa ādīnām iti arthaḥ

original: kuta ityāha—taditi | teṣāṃ pratyakṣādīnāṃ tatprāmāṇyasya vāgnāyenāpavādhane'bhyupagamyamāne satyāgnāyasvarūpasyaiva tāvat siddhirna syāt ; dūrataratvarthasya yata ityarthaḥ | na ca yathāgnāyaḥ pratyakṣādīnyapekṣate tathā tānyapīti, yena tulyabalatvaṃ syāt | ataḥ pratyakṣādisāpekṣatvādāgnāyastebhyo durbala ityāha—na tvevamiti |
analyzed: kutas ityāha tat iti teṣām pratyakṣa ādīnām tad prāmāṇyasya sati āgnāya svarūpasya eva tāvat siddhiḥ na syāt dūratara tu arthasya yatas iti arthaḥ na ca yathā āgnāyaḥ pratyakṣa ādīni apekṣate tathā tāni api iti yena tulya bala tvam syāt atas pratyakṣa ādi sāpekṣa tvāt āgnāyaḥ tebhyaḥ durbalaḥ iti āha na tu evam iti

original: itaśca durbala ityāha—dṛṣṭavyabhicāratvāditi | yadeva yathāvidhamekadārthaṃ saṃvadati vākyam, tadeva tathāvidhameva punaranyadā visaṃvadati ; na hi duṣṭo'pi vaktā śabdaṃ kalādhmātādinā dūṣayati | pratyakṣe tu duṣṭendriyajaṃ vyabhicāri, netaraditi viśeṣaḥ | pratyakṣagrahaṇaṃ tūpalakṣaṇārtham, anumānādyapi draṣṭavyam |
analyzed: itas ca durbalaḥ iti āha dṛṣṭa vyabhicāra tvāt iti yat eva yathāvidham ekadā artham saṃvadati vākyam tat eva tathāvidham eva punar anyadā visaṃvadati na hi duṣṭaḥ api vaktā śabdam kalā dhmāta ādinā dūṣayati pratyakṣe tu duṣṭa indriya jam vyabhicāri na itarat iti viśeṣaḥ pratyakṣa grahaṇam tu upalakṣaṇa artham anumāna ādi api draṣṭavyam

original: yadyapi vede vyabhicāro na dṛṣṭaḥ, tathāpi loke dṛṣṭaḥ śabdatvasāmānyāt tatrāśaṅkyata iti bhāvaḥ | itaścāgnāyo durbala ityāha—apiceti | tataḥ kimityāha—anavakāśāśreti | na tāvadātmā pratyakṣādīnāmavakāśaḥ, tasyendriyādyagocaratvāt ; tatra prapañco'pi cenna syāt tato nirviṣayatvādanavakāśāste syurityarthaḥ | śabdastu sāvakāśa ityāha—sāvakāśa iti |
analyzed: yadi api vede vyabhicāraḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ tathā api loke dṛṣṭaḥ śabda tva sāmānyāt tatra āśaṅkyate iti bhāvaḥ itas ca agnāyo durbalaḥ iti āha api ca iti tatas kim ityāha na tāvat ātmā pratyakṣa ādīnām avakāśaḥ tasya indriya ādi agocara tvāt tatra prapañcaḥ api ced na syāt tatas nirviṣaya tvāt anavakāśāḥ te syuḥ iti arthaḥ śabdaḥ tu sa avakāśaḥ ityāha sa avakāśaḥ iti

original: kathamityāha—gauṇeneti | etadeva spaṣṭayati—tathā hīti | bhinnamapi jagat sattādyātmanā ekatvāt “ekapevādvitīyam” ityupacaryata ityarthaḥ | prakārāntareṇa sāvakāśatvamāha—vivakṣitārthānāmiti | tadeva draḍhayati— upaniṣada iti ; idaṃ svavacanaṃ vedāntānāṃ japopayogitvamāhetyarthaḥ | itaścāgnāyo durbala ityāha—kiñceti | vyākulatvamāha—karmeti |
analyzed: katham iti āha gauṇena iti etat eva spaṣṭayati tathā hi iti bhinnam api jagat sattā ādi ātmanā ekatvāt iti upacaryate iti arthaḥ prakāra antareṇa sāvakāśatvam āha vivakṣita arthānām iti tat eva draḍhayati upaniṣadaḥ iti idam sva vacanam vedāntānām japa upayogitvam āha iti arthaḥ itas ca agnāyaḥ durbalaḥ iti āha kiñca iti vyākulatvam āha karma iti

original: karmaviṣayo hi yasmāt sādhyasādhanādibhedaṃ viṣayatvenāśrayante ; vedāntāstvabhedamadvaitamityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityāha—paraspareti | ataḥ parasparavyāvātādeva tāvat vedāntā durlabhaprāmāṇyāḥ ; parasparamavyāhatam ata evāgnāyasvarūpasiddhyarthatvena vā sarvavādisiddhārthatvena vā pratiṣṭhitaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ yeṣāṃ pratyakṣā-
analyzed: karma viṣayaḥ hi yasmāt sādhya sādhana ādi bhedam viṣaya tvena āśrayante vedāntāḥ tu abhedam advaitam iti arthaḥ tatas kim iti āha paraspara iti atas paraspara vyāvātāt eva tāvat vedāntāḥ durlabha prāmāṇyāḥ parasparam avyāhatam atas eva āgnāya svarūpa siddhi artha tvena vā sarva vādi siddhārtha tvena vā pratiṣṭhitam prāmāṇyam yeṣām pratyakṣa āgnāya svarūpa siddhi artha tvena vā pratiṣṭhitam prāmāṇyam yeṣām pratyakṣa āgnāya svarūpa si

original: dīnāṃ tairvirodhe tu sutarāṃ durlabhaprāmāṇyā ityarthaḥ | upasaṃharati—tasmāditi | P. 89-21 yasmāt pratyakṣādivirodhe vedāntānāmaprāmāṇyaṃ prasajyate tasmādityarthaḥ | sati virodhe pratyakṣādīnāmānmāyavādhakatve hetvantaramāha—mukhyatvāditi | pratyakṣādīnāṃ prāthamyādityarthaḥ | prāthamyamāha—mukhyā hīti |
analyzed: taiḥ virodhe tu sutarām durlabha prāmāṇyāḥ iti arthaḥ upasaṃharati tasmāt iti yasmāt pratyakṣa ādi virodhe vedāntānām aprāmāṇyam prasajyate tasmāt iti arthaḥ sati virodhe pratyakṣa ādīnām ānmāya vādhaka tve hetu antaram āha mukhya tvāt iti pratyakṣa ādīnām prāthamyāt iti arthaḥ prāthamyam āha mukhyāḥ hi iti

original: jātamātrasya jantoḥ prāṇino mukhyāḥ pūrvabhāvinaḥ pratyakṣādayaḥ ; vyutpannapadārthasya ca prabuddhasya kasyacideva paścātkāla āgnāyaḥ pramāṇam | katipayapuruṣasamavetādāmnāyādaśeṣajantugatatvenāpi pratyakṣāderatiśayadyotanārthaṃ jantugrahaṇam | tataḥ kimityāha—sa iti |
analyzed: jāta mātrasya jantoḥ prāṇinaḥ mukhyāḥ pūrva bhāvinaḥ pratyakṣa ādayaḥ vyutpanna padārthasya ca prabuddhasya kasyacid eva paścātkāle āgnāyaḥ pramāṇam katipaya puruṣa samavetāt āmnāyāt aśeṣa jantu gata tvena api pratyakṣa ādeḥ atiśaya dyotana artham jantu grahaṇam tatas kim iti āha saḥ iti

original: sa āgnāyaḥ taiḥ pratyakṣādibhiḥ pūrvabhāvitayānupajātavirodhitvena pratiṣṭhitārthaiḥ pratiṣṭhito bhedarūpo'rtho viṣayo yeṣāṃ tairapahato'panīto yathāśrūyamāṇo'dvaitarūpo viṣayo yasya sa tathoktaḥ, ata eva kalpanīyārthaḥ pratyakṣādivirodhena kalpanīyaṃ śrutādarthāntaraṃ yasya sa bādhyate ;
analyzed: saḥ āgnāyaḥ taiḥ pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ pūrva bhāvi tayā anupajāta virodhi tvena pratiṣṭhita arthaiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ bheda rūpaḥ ṛthaḥ viṣayaḥ yeṣām taiḥ apahata upanītaḥ yathā śrūyamāṇa udvaita rūpaḥ viṣayaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ atas eva kalpanīya arthaḥ pratyakṣa ādi virodhena kalpanīyam śrutāt artha antaram yasya sa bādhyate

original: ananugrāhyaścet tadā pratyakṣādivirodhāt śrutārthatyāgaḥ, arthāntaraṃ ca na kalpyata iti viṣayāpahāralakṣaṇa evāyaṃ bādhaḥ | athānugrāhyaḥ, tadā pratyakṣādyanusāreṇa pratyakṣādigṛhītadvaitāpārityāgena jātyātmanādvaitamityevamarthakalpanāmarhatītyarthaḥ | yadvā pratyakṣādi pratiṣṭhitārtham ;
analyzed: ananugrāhyaḥ ced tadā pratyakṣa ādi virodhāt śruta artha tyāgaḥ artha antaram ca na kalpyate iti viṣaya apahāra lakṣaṇaḥ eva ayam bādhaḥ atha anugrāhyaḥ tadā pratyakṣa ādi anusāreṇa pratyakṣa ādi gṛhīta dvaita apāri tyāgena jāti ātmanā advaitam iti evam artha kalpanām arhati iti arthaḥ yat vā pratyakṣa ādi pratiṣṭhita artham

original: āgnāyastu pramāṇāntarānusāreṇa kalpanīyārthaḥ, ato'pratiṣṭhitārthaḥ ; tena durbalatvāt bādhyate, tadanusāreṇa vārthakalpanamarhatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ svarūpato mukhyatāmuktvārthato'pi pratyakṣādīnāṃ mukhyatāmāha—arthata iti | kathamityāha—padeti |
analyzed: āgnāyaḥ tu pramāṇa antara anusāreṇa kalpanīya arthaḥ tena durbala tvāt bādhyate tad anusāreṇa vā artha kalpanam arhati iti arthaḥ evam svarūpataḥ mukhya tām uktvā arthatas api pratyakṣa ādīnām mukhya tām āha arthataḥ iti katham iti āha pada iti

original: padapadārthavibhāge jñāte satyānmāyārthasya paricchedaḥ, sa ca padapadārthavibhāgaḥ pratyakṣādiṣvāyatate pratyakṣādyāyattaḥ ; etaduktaṃ bhavati—pratyakṣāderviṣayaḥ padapadārthabhedaḥ pūrvabhāvī, āgnāyasya cābhedaḥ paścādbhāvī ; tena viṣayamukhyatvenāpi pratyakṣādermukhyatvāmiti | upasaṃharati—ata iti |
analyzed: pada padārtha vibhāge jñāte satyāt māyā arthasya paricchedaḥ sa ca pada padārtha vibhāgaḥ pratyakṣa ādiṣu āyatate pratyakṣa ādi āyattaḥ etat uktam bhavati pratyakṣa ādeḥ viṣayaḥ pada padārtha bhedaḥ pūrva bhāvī āgnāyasya ca abhedaḥ paścāt bhāvī tena viṣaya mukhya tvena api pratyakṣa ādeḥ mukhya tvām iti upasaṃharati atas iti

original: yato mukhyatvena balīyasā pratyakṣādinā virodhe nāgnāyasya prāmāṇyaṃ syādata ityarthaḥ | matāntaramāha—anya iti | bukhyabalatvameva pūrvāktayā yuktyā nāsti, tathāpi pratyakṣādyāgnāyayorvirodhe dvaitādvaitayoḥ saṃśayaḥ syāt, na nirṇayaḥ | tena taccanirṇayāyāvirodha upapādyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yatas mukhya tvena balīyasā pratyakṣa ādinā virodhe na āgnāyasya prāmāṇyam syāt atas iti arthaḥ mata antaram āha anyaḥ iti bukhya balatvam eva pūrva aktayā yuktyā na asti tathā api pratyakṣa ādi āgnāyayoḥ virodhe dvaita advaitayoḥ saṃśayaḥ syāt na nirṇayaḥ tena tad ca nirṇayāya avirodhaḥ upapādyate iti arthaḥ

original: nanu ṣoḍaśigrahaṇādivat vikalpo bhaviṣyati, na saṃśaya ityāśaṅkyāha—vastviti ; kariṣyamāṇatvādanuṣṭhānaṃ vikalpyate, na tu siddhaṃ vastvityarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ṣoḍaśi grahaṇa ādi vat vikalpaḥ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha vastu iti kariṣyamāṇa tvāt anuṣṭhānam vikalpyate na tu siddham vastu iti arthaḥ

original: P. 40-3. evaṃ matadvayena virodhaparihāraprayojanamuktvā svamatamāha—anyāditi | āmnāyabalavacce nyāyamupanyasyati—paurveti | “adhvaryu niṣkramantaṃ prastonā saṃtanuyāt, tamudgātā, udgātāraṃ pratihartā, taṃ brahmā, brahmāṇaṃ yajamānaḥ” iti somayāge anyonyahastanigraheṇa saṃnatānāmṛtvijāṃ yajñaśālāto niṣkramaṇaṃ śrutam |
analyzed: evam mata dvayena virodha parihāra prayojanam uktvā sva matam āha anyāt iti āmnāya balavat ce nyāyam upanyasyati paurvā iti adhvaryu niṣkramantam prastonā saṃtanuyāt tam udgātā udgātāram pratihartā tam brahmā brahmāṇam yajamānaḥ iti soma yāge anyonya hasta nigraheṇa saṃnatānām ṛtvijām yajña śālāyāḥ niṣkramaṇam śrutam

original: tatra ca naimittikaṃ śrūyate—“yadi prastotāpacchidyeta brahmaṇe varaṃ datvā sa eva pravartitavyaḥ; yadyudgātāpacchidyetādakṣiṇo yajñaḥ saṃsthāpyaḥ; yadi pratihartāpacchidyeta sarvavedasaṃ deyam” iti; apacchidyeteti viśchiṣyetetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatra ca naimittikam śrūyate yadi prastotā apacchidyeta brahmaṇe varam da tvā saḥ eva pravartitavyaḥ yadi udgātā apacchidyeta adakṣiṇaḥ yajñaḥ saṃsthāpyaḥ yadi pratihartā apacchidyeta sarvavedasam deyam iti apacchidyeta iti viśchiṣyeta iti arthaḥ

original: tata udgātṛpratihartvoḥ paurvāparyeṇāpacchedadvaye sati atulyabalatvādadakṣiṇasarvasvadakṣiṇayośca virodhādvikalpasamuccayayorasaṃbhavāt kiṃ pūrvaṃ balavat? athottaram? iti saṃśaye mukhyatvāt śrutiliṅgādivat pūrvabalīyastve prāpte pratyāha—“paurvāparye pūrvadaurbalyaṃ prakṛtibat” iti |
analyzed: tatas udgātṛ pratihartvoḥ paurvāparyeṇa apaccheda dvaye sati atulya bala tvāt adakṣiṇa sarva sva dakṣiṇayoḥ ca virodhāt vikalpa samuccayayoḥ asaṃbhavāt kim pūrvam balavat atha uttaram iti saṃśaye mukhya tvāt śruti liṅga ādi vat pūrva balīyaḥ tve prāpte pratyāha paurvāparye pūrva daurbalyam prakṛti bat iti

original: śrutiliṅgādiṣu pūrvaṃ śīghramāvitvāt prāptaṃ sat atrāptameva paraṃ bādhate; tena tatra paurvāparyameva nāsti, parasyānutpatteḥ | iha tu paramapi pratyakṣaśrutiprāptam; ataḥ paurvāparye naimittikadvayasya pūrvasya daurbalyam, pūrvamanupamṛdya parasyānutpatteḥ; atastadeva bādhyate, prakṛtivrat;
analyzed: śruti liṅga ādiṣu pūrvam śīghram āvi tvāt prāptam sat atra āptam eva param bādhate tena tatra paurvāparyam eva na asti parasya anutpatteḥ iha tu param api pratyakṣa śruti prāptam atas paurvāparye naimittika dvayasya pūrvasya daurbalyam pūrvam an upamṛdya parasya anutpatteḥ atas tat eva bādhyate prakṛti vratam

original: yathā prākṛtāḥ kuśā vikṛtāvatideśaprāptāḥ pratyakṣaśrutaiḥ śarairapodyante tadvadityarthaḥ | etadeva bhaṭṭavākyāt draḍhayati—pūrvābādheneti | nanu paurvāparye bhavatu pūrvadaurbalyam; iha tu tadeva nāsti, pratyakṣāmnāyayoranidaṃ prāthamyādityāśaṅkyāha—tathā hīti |
analyzed: yathā prākṛtāḥ kuśāḥ vikṛtau atideśa prāptāḥ pratyakṣa śrutaiḥ śaraiḥ apodyante tadvat iti arthaḥ etat eva bhaṭṭa vākyāt draḍhayati pūrva ābādhena iti nanu paurvāparye bhavatu pūrva daurbalyam iha tu tat eva na asti pratyakṣa āmnāyayoḥ anidam prāthamyāt iti āśaṅkya āha tathā hi iti

original: sarvasya jantoḥ pratyakṣādinibandhano vibhaktasya bhinnasya vastunaḥ paricchedo nisargajo janmamātrasiddha iti bhedapratyayasya pūrvatvamuktam; nāyaṃ vibhaktavastutattvaparicchedastattvataḥ, kiṃtu māyāmātramiti dyotanārthaḥ kilaśābdaḥ |
analyzed: sarvasya jantoḥ pratyakṣa ādi nibandhanaḥ vibhaktasya bhinnasya vastunaḥ paricchedaḥ nisarga jaḥ janma mātra siddhaḥ iti bheda pratyayasya pūrva tvam uktam na ayam vibhakta vastu tattva paricchedaḥ tattvataḥ kiṃtu māyā mātram iti dyotana arthaḥ kila śābdaḥ

original: advaitāvagamastu vibhaktapadapadārthavastupratyakṣaparicchedāpekṣaḥ, ata eva tatpūrvakaḥ, ata evānisargajo'janmamātrasiddhaḥ, ata evāganturuttarakālabhāvī kasyacideva janakāderbhavati na sarvajantoriti advaitāvagamasya paratvamuktam | evaṃ dvaitādvaitajñānayoḥ paurvāparyamuktvā pūrvasya bādhyatvamāha—sa iti |
analyzed: advaita avagamaḥ tu vibhakta pada padārtha vastu pratyakṣa pariccheda apekṣaḥ atas eva tad pūrvakaḥ atas eva a nisarga jaḥ janma mātra siddhaḥ atas eva āgantuḥ uttara kāla bhāvī kasyacid eva janaka ādeḥ bhavati na sarva jantoḥ iti advaita avagamasya paratvam uktam evam dvaita advaita jñānayoḥ paurvāparyam uktvā pūrvasya bādhya tvam āha saḥ iti

original: āmnāyabalavacce hetvantaramāha—itaśceti; āmnāyo balavānityanuvartate | kuta ityāha—saṃbhavaditi; saṃbhavanto vicitrā nānābhūtāstibhirādayo vibhramahetavo yeṣu te tathoktāḥ | vigalitā-
analyzed: āmnāya balavat ce hetu antaram āha etaḥ ca iti āmnāyaḥ balavān iti anuvartate kutas iti āha saṃbhavat iti saṃbhavantaḥ vicitrāḥ vibhrama hetavaḥ yeṣu te tathā uktāḥ vigalitā

original: vigatā akhilā doṣāśaṅkā yataḥ sa tathoktaḥ ; asaṃbhavadoṣāśaṅkasyāmnāyasya saṃbhavadoṣebhyaḥ pratyakṣādibhyo balīyastvaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | naikarūpaḥ sarvatra bhrame bhramahetuḥ, apitu vicitraḥ ; tenendriyādidoṣāsaṃbhave'pi doṣāntaraṃ prapañcajñāne kalpayiṣyāma iti sūcanārthaṃ vicitragrahaṇam | tatrāmnāyasya vigatadoṣāśaṅkatve hetumāha—puruṣeti |
analyzed: vigatā akhilā doṣa āśaṅkā yatas sa tathā uktaḥ asaṃbhava doṣa āśaṅkasya āmnāyasya saṃbhava doṣebhyaḥ pratyakṣa ādibhyaḥ balīyaḥ tvam yuktam iti arthaḥ na ekarūpaḥ sarvatra bhrame bhrama hetuḥ apitu vicitraḥ tena indriya ādi doṣa asaṃbhave pi doṣa antaram prapañca jñāne kalpayiṣyāmaḥ iti sūcana artham vicitra grahaṇam tatra āmnāyasya vigata doṣa āśaṅkā tve hetum āha puruṣa iti

original: nirdoṣāmnāyabalādeva pratyakṣādiṣu P. 40-8. doṣakalpaneti paścāduktamapyāmnāyanirdoṣatvaṃ pūrvamupapāditam | puruṣāśrayo hi śabde tarvo doṣaḥ ; sa tadabhāve kathamāmnāye saṃbhavedityarthaḥ | nanu pratyakṣādiṣvāpi doṣā na dṛṣṭāḥ ; yeṣu dṛṣṭāḥ na tāni pratyakṣādīni, kiṃtu tadabhāsāḥ ;
analyzed: nirdoṣa āmnāya balāt eva pratyakṣa ādiṣu doṣa kalpanā iti paścāt uktam api āmnāya nirdoṣa tvam pūrvam upapāditam puruṣa āśrayaḥ hi śabde tarvaḥ doṣaḥ sa tad abhāve katham āmnāye saṃbhavet iti arthaḥ nanu pratyakṣa ādiṣu āpi doṣāḥ na dṛṣṭāḥ yeṣu dṛṣṭāḥ na tāni pratyakṣa ādīni kiṃtu tad abhāsāḥ

original: na cānyatra dṛṣṭānāmanyatra pramāṇaṃ vinā kalpanocitā, atiprasaṅgāt ; atasteṣvanupalabhyamānavibhramahetudoṣakalpanāyāṃ kiṃ pramāṇamityāśaṅkya pramāṇamāha—śakyo hīti | ita eva nirdoṣatvasiddhaprāmāṇyādadvaitāmnāyāt dvaitagrāhiṣu pratyakṣādiṣu doṣasaṃbhāvanāniścayau śakyāvityarthaḥ | nanu timirādayo loke doṣāḥ prasiddhāḥ ;
analyzed: na ca anyatra dṛṣṭānām anyatra pramāṇam vinā kalpanā ucitā atiprasaṅgāt atas teṣu anupalabhyamāna vibhrama hetu doṣa kalpanāyām kim pramāṇam iti āśaṅkya pramāṇam āha śakyaḥ hi iti itas eva nirdoṣa tva siddha prāmāṇyāt advaita āmnāyāt dvaita grāhiṣu pratyakṣa ādiṣu doṣa saṃbhāvanā niścayau śakyau iti arthaḥ nanu timira ādayaḥ loke doṣāḥ prasiddhāḥ

original: te ca pratyakṣādiṣu yogyānupalabdhivāritāḥ kathamāmnāyādapi kalpayituṃ śakyā ityāśaṅkyoktam— anādiriti | uktamidam—na hi sarvatraikarūpa eva doṣo bhavatīti ; tena timirādyasaṃbhave'pi avidyāsaṃskārākhyaṃ doṣāntaraṃ kalpayiṣyāma iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: te ca pratyakṣa ādiṣu yogya anupalabdhi vāritāḥ katham āmnāyāt api kalpayitum śakyāḥ iti āśaṅkya uktam anādiḥ iti uktam idam na hi sarvatra ekarūpaḥ eva doṣaḥ bhavati iti tena timira ādi asaṃbhave pi avidyā saṃskāra ākhyam doṣa antaram kalpayiṣyāmaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: avidyāsaṃskārākhyadoṣotpatteḥ prāk nirdoṣasya pratyakṣāderāmnāyena saha tulyabalatvaṃ prāptamityāśaṅkya viśinaṣṭi—anādiriti | dārḍhyamūcanārthaṃ vā— dvaitadarśanam, avidyāsaṃskāraḥ, tataḥ punardvaitadarśanamityevamanādināvidyāsaṃskārākhyadoṣeṇānubaddhatvāt nityamāmnāyāt pratyakṣāderdurbalatvamiti bhāvaḥ | avidyaiva vā saṃskāraḥ ;
analyzed: avidyā saṃskāra ākhya doṣa utpatteḥ prāk nirdoṣasya pratyakṣa ādeḥ āmnāyena saha tulya bala tvam prāptam iti āśaṅkya viśinaṣṭi anādiḥ iti dārḍhyam ūcana artham vā dvaita darśanam avidyā saṃskāraḥ tatas punar dvaita darśanam iti evam anādinā avidyā saṃskāra ākhya doṣeṇa anubaddha tvāt nityam āmnāyāt pratyakṣa ādeḥ durbala tvam iti bhāvaḥ avidyā eva vā saṃskāraḥ

original: saṃskṛyate tathā ātmā atiśayamivāpadyata iti kṛtvā avidyāvāsanā vā avidyāsaṃskāraḥ | niścaya evātrābhimataḥ ; saṃbhāvanā tu doṣasaṃbhāvanāmātreṇāpi yāvatpratyakṣādīnyasaṃbhāvitadoṣādāmnāyāt durbalāni, kimuta niścitadoṣāṇīti prauḍhavādenoktā | saṃbhāvitasya ca sādhyatvāt saṃbhāvanākrameṇa niścaya evoktaḥ |
analyzed: saṃskṛyate tathā ātmā atiśayam iva āpadyate iti kṛtvā avidyā vāsanā vā avidyā saṃskāraḥ niścayaḥ eva atra abhimataḥ saṃbhāvanā tu doṣa saṃbhāvanā mātreṇa api yāvat pratyakṣa ādīni a saṃbhāvita doṣāt āmnāyāt durbalāni kim uta niścita doṣāṇi iti prauḍha vādena uktā saṃbhāvitasya ca sādhya tvāt saṃbhāvanā krameṇa niścayaḥ eva uktaḥ

original: taduktam— “saṃbhāvinaḥ pratijñāyāṃ pakṣaḥ sādhyeta hetunā” iti | ka punarāmnāyāt timiravyatiriktasyānāderavidyāsaṃskārasya vibhramahetutvaṃ prasiddham, yenātra
analyzed: tat uktam saṃbhāvinaḥ pratijñāyām pakṣaḥ sādhyeta hetunā iti ka punar āmnāyāt timira vyatiriktasya anādeḥ avidyā saṃskārasya vibhrama hetu tvam prasiddham yena atra

original: P. 40-10. kalpita ityāśaṅkyāha—deheti | dehe ‘aham’ ityātmajñānaṃ dehātmābhimānaḥ ; tatra yathā dehātiriktātmāvabodhakādāmrāyādanādiravidyāsaṃskāra eva janmani janmani dehātmavibhramahetustathehāpītyarthaḥ | nanu ‘mama śarīram’ iti vyatirekapratyayāt dehātmābhimāne vibhramahetuḥ kṛṣṭaḥ, nāgnāyāt | maivam ;
analyzed: kalpitaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha deha iti dehe aham iti ātma jñānam deha ātma abhimānaḥ tatra yathā deha atirikta ātma avabodhakāt āmrāyāt anādiḥ avidyā saṃskāraḥ eva janmani janmani deha ātma vibhrama hetuḥ tathā iha api iti arthaḥ nanu mama śarīram iti vyatireka pratyayāt deha ātma abhimāne vibhrama hetuḥ kṛṣṭaḥ mā evam

original: ‘mamātmā’ ityavyatireke'pi vyatirekapratyayadarśanāt nāyamaikāntiko hetuḥ | ata āgnāyādeva dehātmābhimāne'nādiravidyāsaṃskāro vibhramahetuḥ kṛṣṭa iti sūktam | avidyāsaṃskārabhramahetutvamātradṛṣṭānto'yam | etāvatā ca kathaṃ sarvajanīnaḥ prapañcapratyayo bhrama ityapi nirastam ; sarvajanīno'pi hi dehātmapratyayo vibhramo dṛṣṭa iti |
analyzed: mama ātmā iti avyatireke api vyatireka pratyaya darśanāt na ayam aikāntikaḥ hetuḥ atas deha ātma abhimānena ādiḥ avidyā saṃskāraḥ vibhrama hetuḥ kṛṣṭaḥ iti su uktam avidyā saṃskāra bhrama hetu tva mātra dṛṣṭāntaḥ yam etāvatā ca katham sarvajanīnaḥ prapañca pratyayaḥ bhramaḥ iti api nirastam sarvajanīnaḥ api hi deha ātma pratyayaḥ vibhramaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti

original: kimiti punarāgnāyāt pratyakṣādiṣu vibhramaheturdoṣaḥ kalpyate, na tu pratyakṣādibalenāgnāya evetyāśaṅkyāha—na tvevamiti | na hi svabhāvataḥ śabdo duṣṭaḥ, kiṃtu puruṣadoṣeṇa ; tenāgnāye nirāśrayasya doṣasya śaṅkāpi kartumaśakyā, dūratastu niścaya ityarthaḥ | śaṅkāyāṃ tu doṣamāha—satyāmiti |
analyzed: kim iti punar āgnāyāt pratyakṣa ādiṣu vibhrama hetuḥ doṣaḥ kalpyate na tu pratyakṣa ādi balena āgnāye eva iti āśaṅkya āha na tu evam iti na hi svabhāvataḥ śabdaḥ duṣṭaḥ kiṃtu puruṣa doṣeṇa tena āgnāye nirāśrayasya doṣasya śaṅkā api kartum aśakyā dūratas tu niścayaḥ iti arthaḥ śaṅkāyām tu doṣam āha satyām iti

original: satyāṃ vā doṣaśaṅkāyāmāgnāyaḥ pramāṇameva na syādityarthaḥ | nanvevaṃ pratyakṣādayo'pi sadoṣāḥ kathaṃ pramāṇam ? asti ca teṣu loke ‘pramāṇam’ iti prasiddhirityāśaṅkyāha—pratyakṣādīnāṃ tviti | tuśabdo viśeṣapradarśanārthaḥ | idamuktaṃ bhavati—dvividhaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ tattvāvedanalakṣaṇaṃ vyavahārāvisaṃvādalakṣaṇaṃ ca |
analyzed: satyām vā doṣa śaṅkāyām āgnāyaḥ pramāṇam eva na syāt iti arthaḥ nanu evam pratyakṣa ādayaḥ api sa doṣāḥ katham pramāṇam asti ca teṣu loke pramāṇam iti prasiddhiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha pratyakṣa ādīnām tu iti tuśabdaḥ viśeṣa pradarśana arthaḥ idam uktam bhavati dvividham prāmāṇyam tattva āvedana lakṣaṇam vyavahāra avisaṃvāda lakṣaṇam ca

original: tatra doṣavacce pratyakṣādīnāmapi tattvāvedanalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ satyaṃ nāstyeva ; vyāvahārikaṃ tvasti ; ato na prasiddhihāniriti | nanu doṣavaccena rajatādibhramavat vyāvahārikamapi prāmāṇyaṃ kathamityāśaṅkyāha—avidyeti | doṣanivṛttau hi vyavahārasaṃvādo bhavati | ayaṃ tvavidyādisaṃskāro'nāditvāt sthiraḥ pūrvavat vyavahāre'pyanuvartate |
analyzed: tatra doṣavat ce pratyakṣa ādīnām api tattva āvedana lakṣaṇam prāmāṇyam satyam na asti eva vyāvahārikam tu asti atas na prasiddhi hāniḥ iti nanu doṣavat cena rajata ādi bhrama vat vyāvahārikam api prāmāṇyam katham iti āśaṅkya āha avidyā iti doṣa nivṛttau hi vyavahāra saṃvādaḥ bhavati ayam tu avidyā ādi saṃskāraḥ nādi tvāt sthiraḥ pūrvavat vyavahāre api anuvartate

original: tena vyavahāraviparyayābhāvāt pratyakṣādīnāṃ vyāvahārikaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ ghaṭata ityarthaḥ | nanu doṣavacce'pi cet vyāvahārikaṃ prāmāṇyam, aprāmāṇyaṃ tarhi ka bhaviṣyati ? asti ca rajatādibhrameṣu tatprasiddhirityāśaṅkyāha—yatra ceti | tena pratyakṣādeḥ rajatabhramasya ca doṣavaccāviśeṣe'pi laukikapramāṇāpramāṇaviveko ghaṭata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tena vyavahāra viparyaya abhāvāt pratyakṣa ādīnām vyāvahārikam prāmāṇyam ghaṭate iti arthaḥ nanu doṣavat ced api ced vyāvahārikam prāmāṇyam aprāmāṇyam tarhi ka bhaviṣyati asti ca rajata ādi bhrameṣu tad prasiddhiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha yatra ca iti tena pratyakṣa ādeḥ rajata bhramasya ca doṣavat ca aviśeṣe pi laukika pramāṇa apramāṇa vivekaḥ ghaṭate iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu doṣavatāmapi cet pratyakṣādīnāṃ prāmāṇyam, tarhi śabde'pi doṣavati tathaiva bhaviṣyati ;
analyzed: nanu doṣavatām api ced pratyakṣa ādīnām prāmāṇyam tarhi śabde api doṣavati tathā eva bhaviṣyati

original: ataḥ 'satyāṃ vā pramāṇameva na syāt' iti yaduktaṃ tadayuktamityāśaṅkya tadupapādayati—śabde tviti | tuśabdaḥ pratyakṣādibhyo viśeṣamāha | P. 40-13. saṃbhāvitadoṣe'pi yāvat śabde nobhayavidhaṃ prāmāṇyam, kimuta niścitadoṣe iti saṃbhāvitaṃ grahaṇam |
analyzed: atas satyām vā pramāṇam eva na syāt iti yat uktam tat ayuktam iti āśaṅkya tat upapādayati śabde tu iti tuśabdaḥ pratyakṣa ādibhyaḥ viśeṣam āha saṃbhāvita doṣe api yāvat śabde na ubhayavidham prāmāṇyam kim uta niścita doṣe iti saṃbhāvitam grahaṇam

original: nanu doṣavati śabde taccāvedanalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ mā bhavatu, vyāvahārikaṃ tu pratyakṣādivat kimiti na bhavatītyāśaṅkyāha— adṛṣṭārthatvāditi | adṛṣṭo'rtho viṣayo yasyeti vigrahaḥ | pratyakṣādiṣu vyavahāraviparyayādarśanāt vyāvahārikaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ yuktam; āmnāyasya tvadṛṣṭārthatvāt na tadyavahārāviparyayajñānamasti;
analyzed: nanu doṣavati śabde tat ca āvedana lakṣaṇam prāmāṇyam mā bhavatu vyāvahārikam tu pratyakṣa ādi vat kim iti na bhavati iti āśaṅkya āha adṛṣṭa artha tvāt iti adṛṣṭa ūrthaḥ viṣayaḥ yasya iti vigrahaḥ pratyakṣa ādiṣu vyavahāra viparyaya adarśanāt vyāvahārikam prāmāṇyam yuktam āmnāyasya tu adṛṣṭa artha tvāt na tad yavahāra aviparyaya jñānam asti

original: ato na tasya vyāvahārikamapi prāmāṇyamityarthaḥ | itaśca sadoṣasya śabdasya na vyavahārāvisaṃvādalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyamityāha—doṣebhya iti | jñānakāraṇadoṣebhyo vyavahāravisaṃvādi jñānamanyatra rajatabhramādiṣu dṛṣṭam;
analyzed: atas na tasya vyāvahārikam api prāmāṇyam iti arthaḥ itas ca sa doṣasya śabdasya na vyavahāra avisaṃvāda lakṣaṇam prāmāṇyam iti āha doṣebhyaḥ iti jñāna kāraṇa doṣebhyaḥ vyavahāra visaṃvādi jñānam anyatra rajata bhrama ādiṣu dṛṣṭam

original: ataśca śabde'pi cet doṣāḥ syuḥ, te'pi vyavahāravisaṃvādijñānahetavaḥ doṣatvāt timirādivaditi sāmānyato dṛṣṭena vyavahāravisaṃvādijñānahetavaḥ kalpyeran; tataśca kuto vyavahārāvisaṃvādalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: atas ca śabde api ced doṣāḥ syuḥ te api vyavahāra visaṃvādi jñāna hetavaḥ doṣa tvāt timira ādi vat iti sāmānyatas dṛṣṭena vyavahāra visaṃvādi jñāna hetavaḥ kalpyeran tatas ca kutas vyavahāra avisaṃvāda lakṣaṇam prāmāṇyam iti arthaḥ

original: nanvevaṃ tarhi pratyakṣādidoṣā api dharmiṇo vyavahāravisaṃvādijñānahetavaḥ doṣatvāt indriyādidoṣavaditi te'pi vyavahāravisaṃvādijñānahetavaḥ kalpyeran, tataśca pratyakṣādīnāmapi doṣavacce vyavahārāvisaṃvādalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ na syāt, virodhādityāśaṅkyāha—pratyakṣādīnāṃ tviti | tuśabdaḥ śabdādviśeṣamāha; pratyakṣādīnāṃ tu vyavahāre saṃvādo dṛśyate;
analyzed: nanu evam tarhi pratyakṣa ādi doṣāḥ api dharmiṇaḥ vyavahāra visaṃvādi jñāna hetavaḥ doṣa tvāt indriya ādi doṣa vat iti te api vyavahāra visaṃvādi jñāna hetavaḥ kalpyeran tatas ca pratyakṣa ādīnām api doṣa vat ce vyavahāra avisaṃvāda lakṣaṇam prāmāṇyam na syāt virodhāt iti āśaṅkya āha pratyakṣa ādīnām tu iti tuśabdaḥ śabdāt viśeṣam āha pratyakṣa ādīnām tu vyavahāre saṃvādaḥ dṛśyate

original: ataḥ pratyakṣāvirodhāt nāsmādanumānāt teṣu vyavahāravisaṃvādijñānahetudoṣaḥ śakyate kalpayitum | evaṃ hi sa kalpyeta yadi teṣu vyavahāre visaṃvādaḥ syāt, sa tu nāstītyuktam | ataḥ satyapi doṣe pratyakṣādīnāṃ vyāvahārikaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ na virudhyate iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: atas pratyakṣa avirodhāt na asmāt anumānāt teṣu vyavahāra visaṃvādi jñāna hetu doṣaḥ śakyate kalpayitum evam hi sa kalpyeta yadi teṣu vyavahāre visaṃvādaḥ syāt sa tu na asti iti uktam atas sati api doṣe pratyakṣa ādīnām vyāvahārikam prāmāṇyam na virudhyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadi pratyakṣādiṣu vyavahārāsaṃvādahetudoṣā na kalpyate, kīdṛśastarhi, kutaśca sa tādṛśaḥ kalpyate— ityapekṣāyām, yādṛśo'sau yataḥ sa tādṛśaḥ kalpyate tadubhayamāha—taccadarśanasya tviti |
analyzed: yadi pratyakṣa ādiṣu vyavahāra asaṃvāda hetu doṣā na kalpyate kīdṛśaḥ tarhi kutas ca sa tādṛśaḥ kalpyate iti apekṣāyām yādṛśaḥ usau yatas sa tādṛśaḥ kalpyate tat ubhayam āha tad ca darśanasya tu iti

original: “ekamevādvitīyam” • ityādivedāntājjāgamānasyādvaitatattvajñānasya pratyakṣādiprameyadvaitapratipakṣatvāt tadvādhakatvāt pratyakṣādiprameyadvaitasya yat tacca pāramārthikaṃ tatpratighātamātraheturevānādiravidyānubandhaḥ kalpyate, na 8
analyzed: ekam eva advitīyam ityādi vedāntāt jāgamānasya advaita tattva jñānasya pratyakṣa ādi prameya dvaita pratipakṣa tvāt tad vādhaka tvāt pratyakṣa ādi prameya dvaitasya yat tat ca pāramārthikam tad pratighāta mātra hetuḥ eva anādiḥ avidyā anubandhaḥ kalpyate na

original: vyavahārapratighātahetustimirādirityarthaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati—na hi pratyakṣādiṣu pramāṇāntaragamyo doṣaḥ ; kiṃ svāmnāyabalāt kalpyaḥ | atastadanusāreṇaiva sa kalpanāmarhati | āmnāyaśrādvaitaṃ darśayan pratyakṣādiprameyadvaitamātrapratipakṣo na vyavahāraṃ raṣṭaśati |
analyzed: vyavahāra pratighāta hetuḥ timira ādiḥ iti arthaḥ etat uktam bhavati na hi pratyakṣa ādiṣu pramāṇa antara gamyaḥ doṣaḥ kim sva āmnāya balāt kalpyaḥ atas tad anusāreṇa eva sa kalpanām arhati darśayan pratyakṣa ādi prameya dvaita mātra pratipakṣaḥ na vyavahāram

original: tena tadanusāreṇa doṣaḥ kalpyamāno'nṛtadvaitajñāna-jananasamartho'vidyāsaṃskāra eva kalpyate, na vyavahāravisaṃvādikṣānajanana-samarthastimirādiriti | ato doṣavacche'pi pratyakṣādiṣu vyavahāravisaṃvāda-P.40-18 lakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ dehātmābhimānavat na virudhyate ityupasaṃharati—tata iti |
analyzed: tena tad anusāreṇa doṣaḥ kalpyamānaḥ nṛta dvaita jñāna janana samarthaḥ vidyā saṃskāraḥ eva kalpyate na vyavahāra visaṃvādi kṣāna janana samarthaḥ timira ādiḥ iti atas doṣa vat śepi pratyakṣa ādiṣu vyavahāra visaṃvāda lakṣaṇam prāmāṇyam deha ātma abhimāna vat na virudhyate iti upasaṃharati tatas iti

original: śabdasya ca sadoṣasya prāmāṇyaṃ na syāditi yaduktaṃ tadapyupasaṃharati—śabdastviti | tatraiva pūrvoktāṃ yuktimapi smārayati—dṛśyate hīti | tacca-pratighātasya cetyatra 'śaṅkitatvāt' ityanuṣajyate | idānīṃ pūrvaprakṛtaṃ pratyakṣādi-virodhe śabdasya balīyastvamupasaṃharati—tasmāditi |
analyzed: śabdasya ca sa doṣasya prāmāṇyam na syāt iti yat uktam tat api upasaṃharati śabdaḥ tu iti tatra eva pūrva uktām yuktim api smārayati dṛśyate hi iti tat ca pratighātasya ca iti atra śaṅkita tvāt iti anuṣajyate idānīm pūrva prakṛtam pratyakṣa ādi virodhe śabdasya balīyaḥ tvam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: yo hi pratyakṣādivirodhe satyāmnāyasyāprāmāṇyamāha sa niyatamavirodhe satyadoṣatvena tasya prāmāṇya-mabhyupagacchati; tathā sati nirdoṣasyāmnāyasya prāguktayuktikalpitadoṣebhyaḥ pratyakṣādibhyo balavaccaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | idānīṃ pratyakṣādisāpekṣatvādāmnāyastebhyo durbala iti yaduktaṃ tadanu-bhāṣate—yacciti | tatra dūṣaṇamāha—tatreti |
analyzed: yaḥ hi pratyakṣa ādi virodhe sati āmnāyasya aprāmāṇyam āha sa niyatam avirodhe satya doṣa tvena tasya prāmāṇyam abhyupagacchati tathā sati nirdoṣasya āmnāyasya prāgukta yukti kalpita doṣebhyaḥ pratyakṣa ādibhyaḥ balavat cam yuktam iti arthaḥ idānīm pratyakṣa ādi sāpekṣa tvāt āmnāyaḥ tebhyaḥ durbalaḥ iti yat uktam tat anubhāṣate yat citi tatra dūṣaṇam āha tatra iti

original: satyaṃ śabdasya pratyakṣādi-viṣayāpekṣāsti ; na tu sā pramitau svārthaparicchede, kiṃtu svarūpasiddhāvi-tyarthaḥ | etadeva draḍhayati—anyatheti | yadi tu pramitau śabdasya pratyakṣā-dyapekṣā syāt tadā anapekṣālakṣaṇatvāt prāmāṇyasya śabdaḥ pramāṇameva na syādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: satyam śabdasya pratyakṣa ādi viṣaya apekṣā asti na tu sā pramitau svārtha paricchede kiṃtu svarūpa siddhau iti arthaḥ etat eva draḍhayati anyathā iti yadi tu pramitau śabdasya pratyakṣa ādi apekṣā syāt tadā anapekṣā lakṣaṇa tvāt prāmāṇyasya śabdaḥ pramāṇam eva na syāt iti arthaḥ

original: yadvā yadi svarūpasiddhau śabdaḥ pratyakṣādi nāpekṣate, tato'-navabuddhaḥ pramāmakurvan pramāṇameva na syādityarthaḥ | yadi tāma pramitāvana-pekṣaḥ śabdaḥ, tataḥ kimityāha—tathā ceti | kārye pramitilakṣaṇe śabdasya pratyakṣādyanapekṣatvāt na śabdaḥ pratyakṣādibhyo hīyate, prāmāṇyāviśeṣādi-tyarthaḥ |
analyzed: yat vā yadi svarūpa siddhau śabdaḥ pratyakṣa ādi na apekṣate tatas navabuddhaḥ pramām akurvan pramāṇam eva na syāt iti arthaḥ yadi pramitau anapekṣaḥ śabdaḥ tatas kim iti āha tathā ca iti kārye pramiti lakṣaṇe śabdasya pratyakṣa ādi anapekṣa tvāt na śabdaḥ pratyakṣa ādibhyaḥ hīyate prāmāṇya aviśeṣāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu kārye'napekṣo'pi śabdaḥ svarūpasiddhau pratyakṣādyapekṣate, na tu pratyakṣādi śabdam ; ataḥ kimiti tebhyo na hīyata ityāśaṅkyāha—pratyakṣādayo'pīti | svarūpasiddhau sāpekṣatvaṃ pratyakṣādiṣvapīndriyādyapekṣatvā-dasti ; na ca tadaprāmāṇyamāvahati ; yataḥ kārye sāpekṣatvaṃ sāmarthyamapakṛṣṭaṃ
analyzed: nanu śabdaḥ svarūpa siddhau pratyakṣa ādi apekṣate na tu pratyakṣa ādi śabdam atas kim iti tebhyaḥ na hīyate iti āśaṅkya āha pratyakṣa ādayaḥ api iti svarūpa siddhau sāpekṣa tvam pratyakṣa ādiṣu api indriya ādi apekṣa tvāt asti na ca tat aprāmāṇyam āvahati yatas kārye sāpekṣa tvam sāmarthyam apakṛṣṭam

original: karoti ; apakṛṣṭasāmarthyaṃ cotkṛṣṭasāmarthyena bādhitamapramāṇībhavati | tena na sāpekṣatvamātramaprāmāṇyahetuḥ, api tu kārye sāpekṣatvam ; tacca śabdasyāpi nāsti ; ato na śabdasyāprāmāṇyamityabhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: karoti apakṛṣṭa sāmarthyam ca utkṛṣṭa sāmarthyena bādhitam apramāṇībhavati tena na sāpekṣa tva mātram aprāmāṇya hetuḥ api tu kārye sāpekṣa tvam tat ca śabdasya api na asti atas na śabdasya aprāmāṇyam iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: idānīṃ pratyakṣādyadhīnatvādānnāyastarūpasiddheravaśyamānnāyastarūpasiddhaye teṣāṃ prāmāṇyamanumantavyam, ataścānnāyavirodhe teṣāmeva balavatvamucitaniti tadanubhāṣate—yatviti | evamanubhāṣya dūṣayati—ko ceti | satyameṣāṃ P. 41-1. prāmāṇyamanumantavyam, kiṃtu dehātmajñānavat vyavahārāvisaṃvādalakṣaṇam, na tattvāvedanalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: idānīm pratyakṣa ādi adhīna tvāt ānnāya starūpa siddheḥ avaśyam ānnāya starūpa siddhaye teṣām prāmāṇyam anumantavyam atas ca annāya virodhe teṣām eva balavatvam tat anubhāṣate iti evam anubhāṣya dūṣayati ca iti satyam eṣām prāmāṇyam anumantavyam kiṃtu deha ātma jñāna vat vyavahāra avisaṃvāda lakṣaṇam na tattva āvedana lakṣaṇam iti arthaḥ

original: kaḥ punarviśeṣahetuḥ ? yena vyāvahārikameva prāmāṇyamanumanyate, na tu tattvāvedanalakṣaṇamityāśaṅkya viśeṣahetumāha—vyāvahāriketi | vyāvahārikaprāmāṇyopetebhyaḥ pratyakṣebhyaḥ siddhādānnāyāditi vyavahārāvisaṃvādasyānnāyasiddhyanuguṇatvenāvirodhādityabādhyatve hetuḥ, tadvirodhāditi ca tattvadarśanaśrutyā bādhyatve |
analyzed: kaḥ punar viśeṣa hetuḥ yena vyāvahārikam eva prāmāṇyam anumanyate na tu tattva āvedana lakṣaṇam iti āśaṅkya viśeṣa hetum āha vyāvahārika iti vyāvahārika prāmāṇya upetebhyaḥ pratyakṣebhyaḥ siddhāt ānnāyāt iti vyavahāra avisaṃvādasya annāya siddhi anuguṇa tvena avirodhāt iti abādhya tve hetuḥ tad virodhāt iti ca tattva darśana śrutyāḥ bādhya tve

original: anenedamuktaṃ bhavati—pratyakṣādiṣu tattvadarśanabādhyatvādvaiṣāṃ tattvāvedanalakṣaṇaprāmāṇyamānnāyenānumanyate ; vyāvahārikaṃ tu svānuguṇatvādabādhyam ; ato'numanyata iti viśeṣaḥ | nanviyamānnāyagrāhiṇī pratyakṣādipratipattirupāyatvādānnāyajanyayā nattvapratipattyāpekṣitā | yadvalena yatsiddhiḥ tattato balavattaramucitam ;
analyzed: anena idam uktam bhavati pratyakṣa ādiṣu tattva darśana bādhya tvāt vā eṣām tattva āvedana lakṣaṇa prāmāṇyam ānnāyena anumanyate vyāvahārikam tu sva anuguṇa tvāt abādhyam atas numanyate iti viśeṣaḥ nanu iyam ānnāya grāhiṇī pratyakṣa ādi pratipattiḥ upāya tvāt ānnāya janyayā yad valena yat siddhiḥ tat tatas balavattaram ucitam

original: taduktam—“yadvalenaiva yatsiddhiḥ kathaṃ tadvalavattaram” iti | tataśca pratyakṣādipratipattibhyaḥ kathamānnāyajanyāyāstattvapratīterbalīyastvam ? kathaṃ ca tadvādhakatvam ? virodhe hi bādhyabādhakabhāvo bhavati ; na copāyopeyayoḥ so'sti, anyathopāyopeyabhāva eva na syāt ;
analyzed: tat uktam yad valena eva yat siddhiḥ katham tat valavattaram iti tatas ca pratyakṣa ādi pratipattibhyaḥ katham ānnāya janyāyāḥ tattva pratīteḥ balīyaḥ tvam katham ca tad vādhaka tvam virodhe hi bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ bhavati na ca upāya upeyayoḥ saḥ usti anyathā upāya upeya bhāvaḥ eva na syāt

original: taduktam—“na cātmahetumevāsau siddhā bādhitumarhati” ityetat vyabhicāradarśanena dūṣayati—dṛṣṭaṃ ceti | pūrvasyāḥ pratipatteriti pañcamī ; parasyā iti ṣaṣṭhī | tadudāharati—yatheti | vanaspatipratipatteriti ; balavattvamityanuṣajyate | nanu hetutvenāpekṣitāyāḥ pūrvapratipattitaḥ parapratipatterbalavattvamudāhartavyam |
analyzed: tat uktam na ca ātma hetum eva asau siddhā bādhitum arhati iti etat vyabhicāra darśanena dūṣayati dṛṣṭam ca iti pūrvasyāḥ pratipatteḥ iti pañcamī parasyāḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī tat udāharati yathā iti vanaspati pratipatteḥ iti balavat tvam iti anuṣajyate nanu hetu tvena apekṣitāyāḥ pūrva pratipattitaḥ para pratipatteḥ balavat tvam udāhartavyam

original: na ceha vanaspatipratipattyā hastipratipattayo hetutvenāpekṣitā iti pramāṇamasti | ataḥ prakṛtānanurūpamudāharaṇamityāśaṅkya prakṛtatulyatvamudāharaṇe tāvatpratijānīte—apekṣitā hīti | hastipratipattaya iti ; bahīnāṃ tāsāṃ hetutvam, naikasyā iti darśayati | yatha 8A
analyzed: na ca iha vanaspati pratipattyā hasti pratipattayaḥ hetu tvena apekṣitāḥ iti pramāṇam asti atas prakṛta ananurūpam udāharaṇam iti āśaṅkya prakṛta tulya tvam udāharaṇe tāvat pratijānīte apekṣitāḥ hi iti hasti pratipattayaḥ iti bahīnām tāsām hetu tvam na ekasyāḥ iti darśayati

original: caitattathā vakṣyāmaḥ | nanvindriyasaṃnikarṣānantarabhāvāt tajjanyaiva vanaspatibuddhiḥ, na hastibuddhijanyā ; tataḥ kathaṃ tadapekṣā setyucyata ityāśaṅkyāha— P. 41-7. na tasyā iti ; vanaspatibuddherityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha—āpāta iti | yadīndriyasaṃnikarṣamātrāt vanaspatibuddherjanma syāt, āpāte prathamameva syāt ; na ca bhavati ;
analyzed: ca etat tathā vakṣyāmaḥ nanu indriya saṃnikarṣa anantara bhāvāt tad janyā eva vanaspati buddhiḥ na hasti buddhi janyā tatas katham tad apekṣā sā iti ucyate iti āśaṅkya āha na tasyāḥ iti vanaspati buddheḥ iti arthaḥ kutas iti āha āpāte iti yadi indriya saṃnikarṣa mātrāt vanaspati buddheḥ janma syāt āpāte prathamam eva syāt na ca bhavati

original: ato nendriyasaṃnikarṣamātrāt tasyā janma, kiṃtu hastibuddhirapi hetutvenāpekṣiteti bhāvaḥ | nanu mā bhavatu kevalādindriyasaṃnikarṣāt tasyā janma, deśaviśeṣasahitāttu bhaviṣyati ; tathāpi kimiti hastibuddhihetutvenāpekṣyata ityāśaṅkyāha—na ca deśeti | tasyā janmetyanuvartate | kuta ityāha—taddeśasyeti |
analyzed: atas na indriya saṃnikarṣa mātrāt tasyāḥ janma kiṃtu hasti buddhiḥ api hetu tvena apekṣitā iti bhāvaḥ nanu mā bhavatu kevalāt indriya saṃnikarṣāt tasyāḥ janma deśa viśeṣa sahitāt tu bhaviṣyati tathā api kim iti hasti buddhi hetu tvena apekṣyate iti āśaṅkya āha na ca deśa iti tasyāḥ janma iti anuvartate kutas ityāha tad deśasya iti

original: yatra dūrasthasya prathamamabhūtaṃ vanaspatijñānaṃ paścāt samīpamupasarpato bhavati tatra syādevam ; yatra tu taddeśasthasyaiva jāyate tatra na deśaviśeṣāt tasyā janmetyarthaḥ | sa eva deśo yasya puṃsaḥ sa tathoktaḥ ; yatra deśe vanaspatijñānamāpātotpannaṃ taṃ 'tat' iti parāmṛśati |
analyzed: yatra dūra sthasya prathamam abhūtam vanaspati jñānam paścāt samīpam upasarpataḥ bhavati tatra syāt evam yatra tu tad deśa sthasya eva jāyate tatra na deśa viśeṣāt tasyāḥ janma iti arthaḥ saḥ eva deśaḥ yasya puṃsaḥ sa tathā uktaḥ yatra deśe vanaspati jñānam āpāta utpannam tam tat iti parāmṛśati

original: evaṃ sthite saṃprati prasaṅgāt codyāntaramapi nirasyati—evaṃ ceti | evamityanantaroktaṃ hastivanaspatyādinyāyaṃ parāmṛśati | yadeke varṇayanti tadapāstamiti vakṣyamāṇenānvayaḥ | yadvarṇayanti tadāha—svayameveti | kathamityāha—nābheda iti | kuta ityāha—bhedopāyā iti ; na hi pramātrādibhedamantareṇābhedasya pratipattirastītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: evam sthite saṃprati prasaṅgāt codya antaram api nirasyati evam ca iti evam iti anantara uktam hasti vanaspati ādi nyāyam parāmṛśati yat eke varṇayanti tat apāstam iti vakṣyamāṇena anvayaḥ yat varṇayanti tat āha svayam eva iti katham ityāha na abhedaḥ iti kutas ityāha bheda upāyāḥ iti na hi pramātṛ ādi bhedam antareṇa abhedasya pratipattiḥ asti iti arthaḥ

original: athāduṣṭahetujanyasya pratyakṣasyāvyabhicāritvamucyate, tacchabdasyāpi samānamityāha—itarayoriti |
analyzed: atha aduṣṭa hetu janyasya pratyakṣasya avyabhicāri tvam ucyate tat śabdasya api samānam iti āha etarayoḥ iti

original: yacca pratyakṣādibalavacce'navakāśatvaṃ kāraṇamuktaṃ tadapi dūṣayati— P. 41-17 tatheti | śābdapratyakṣayoḥ samānamityanuvartate | samānatvamāha—yadīti | vedāntārthatvena prasiddho'rthastasyāvakāśo vācyaḥ, nānyo hiṃsāniṣedhavidherivānavakāśayajñiyahiṃsāvidhibādhyasya bāhyahiṃsā | sa ca mukhyo vā gauṇo vā ; na tūbhau, vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: yat ca kāraṇam uktam tat api dūṣayati tathā iti śābda pratyakṣayoḥ samānam iti anuvartate samāna tvam āha yadi iti vedānta artha tvena prasiddhaḥ ūrthaḥ tasya avakāśaḥ vācyaḥ na anyaḥ hiṃsā niṣedha vidheḥ iva anavakāśa yajñiya hiṃsā vidhi bādhyasya bāhya hiṃsā sa ca mukhyaḥ vā gauṇaḥ vā na tu ubhau vākya bheda prasaṅgāt

original: tadyadi mukhyo vedāntārthaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tato gauṇāvivakṣitārthate na sta eva ; kathamavakāśaḥ ? ato'navakāśatvamāgnāyasyāpi samānamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tat yadi mukhyaḥ vedānta arthaḥ prasiddhaḥ tatas gauṇa avivakṣita artha te na staḥ eva katham avakāśaḥ atonavakāśatvam āgnāyasya api samānam iti arthaḥ

original: atha satyeva dvaye jātyādyātmanaupacārikamekatvaṃ vedāntānāmarthaḥ syāt, avivakṣitārthatā vā japopayogināmityucyate, tato dvaye sati tadviṣayaiḥ pratyakṣādibhiḥ jātyādyātmanaupacārikaikatvavācināṃ japārthānāṃ vā vedāntānāṃ virodha eva nāsti vibhinnaviṣayatvādaviṣayatvādvā ; tatra balābalacintaiva nāvatarati ; virodhe hi sā bhavati |
analyzed: atha sati eva dvaye jāti ādi ātmanā aupacārikam ekatvam vedāntānām arthaḥ syāt avivakṣita arthatā vā japa upayoginām iti ucyate tatas dvaye sati tad viṣayaiḥ pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ jāti ādi ātmanā aupacārika ekatva vācinām japa arthānām vā vedāntānām virodhaḥ eva nā asti vibhinna viṣaya tvāt aviṣaya tvāt vā tatra balābala cintā eva nā avatarati virodhe hi sā bhavati

original: tasyāṃ ca satyāmekasya sāvakāśatvena daurbalyaṃ tadā bhavet ; kutastadityāha—atheti | pakṣadvaye'pi dūṣaṇāntaramāha—kathamiti | buddhakakṣyo'rtho'vakāśo bhavati | na ca mukhyena gauṇasya buddhakakṣyatvam, gauṇamukhyanyāyavirodhācceti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tasyām ca satyām ekasya sāvakāśa tvena daurbalyam tadā bhavet kutas tat iti āha atha iti pakṣa dvaye pi dūṣaṇa antaram āha katham iti bhavati na ca mukhyena gauṇasya buddhakakṣya tvam gauṇa mukhya nyāya virodhāt ca iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathā vācyamarthaṃ prati vācakatvena śabdasya śeṣabhāvaḥ aṅgatvam autpattikaṃ svābhāvikaṃ “dṛṣṭo hi tasyārthaḥ karmāvabodhanam” “aviśiṣṭastu vākyārthaḥ” iti nyāyasiddham ; tat kathamavivakṣitārthatā syādityarthaḥ | athocyate yatra pramāṇāntarāvirodhaḥ, tatra mukhyamarthamucchacchacopacaritārthatvamavivakṣitārthatvaṃ vā na syāt ;
analyzed: tathā vācyam artham prati vācaka tvena śabdasya śeṣa bhāvaḥ aṅgatvam autpattikam svābhāvikam dṛṣṭaḥ hi tasya arthaḥ karma avabodhanam aviśiṣṭaḥ tu vākya arthaḥ iti nyāya siddham tat katham avivakṣita arthatā syāt iti arthaḥ atha ucyate yatra pramāṇa antara avirodhaḥ tatra mukhyam artham ucchacchacā upacarita artha tvam avivakṣita artha tvam vā na syāt

original: iha tu bhedagrāhipratyakṣādipramāṇāntarairadvayāgnāyasya virodhāt mukhyārthāsaṃbhave kimiti tayoranyataranna syāt ; tadetadāśaṅkayati—pramāṇāntareti | taddūṣayati—vārtamiti ; vārtāgatametat, asāraṃ vetyarthaḥ | asāratvamāha—neti | svataḥ prāmāṇyasya sthitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | mukhyārthaparatāsvabhāvatvaṃ svarasam |
analyzed: iha tu bheda grāhi pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇa antaraiḥ advaya agnāyasya virodhāt mukhya artha asaṃbhave kim iti tayoḥ anyatarat na syāt tat etat āśaṅkayati pramāṇa antara iti tat dūṣayati vārtam iti vārtā gatam etat asāram vā iti arthaḥ asāra tvam āha na iti svatas prāmāṇyasya sthita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ mukhya artha para tā svabhāva tvam svarasam

original: pramāṇāntarānapekṣaprāmāṇyasya svarasātyāge hetumāha—taditi | pramāṇāntarāpekṣatvaṃ pramāṇāntarānuguṇatayā vṛttau hetuḥ hi yat ityarthaḥ | vyatirekamāha—nirapekṣasyeti | pramāṇāntaranirapekṣasya tu pramāṇasya svārthaṃ hātumādātuṃ vā viruddhatvāviruddhatvābhyāṃ pramāṇāntarānusaraṇe ko hetuḥ ? na kaścidityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pramāṇa antara anapekṣa prāmāṇyasya svarasa ātyāge hetum āha tat iti pramāṇa antara apekṣa tvam pramāṇa antara anuguṇa tayā vṛttau hetuḥ hi yat iti arthaḥ vyatirekam āha nirapekṣasya iti pramāṇa antara nirapekṣasya tu pramāṇasya sva artham hātum ādātum vā viruddha tva aviruddha tvābhyām pramāṇa antara anusaraṇe kaḥ hetuḥ na kaścid iti arthaḥ

original: nanu loke ‘agnirmāṇavakaḥ’ ityādau pramāṇāntarānuguṇatayā śabdasya
analyzed: nanu loke agniḥ māṇavakaḥ ityādau pramāṇa antara anuguṇa tayā śabdasya

original: pravṛttidṛṣṭā ; ato'trāpi tathaiva bhavituṃ yuktamityāśaṅkya tadvaiṣamyamāha— laukikā iti | laukikāstu śabdāḥ pramāṇāntaradṛṣṭe'rthaṃ prayujyante . tena P. 42-1. te pramāṇāntarāpekṣamarthamabhidadhatīti hetoryuktā teṣāṃ pramāṇāntarānusāriṇī vṛttirityarthaḥ | vyatirekamāha—tulye tviti |
analyzed: pravṛtti dṛṣṭā tathā eva bhavitum yuktam iti āśaṅkya tad vaiṣamyam āha laukikāḥ iti laukikāḥ tu śabdāḥ pramāṇa antara dṛṣṭi ṛtham prayujyante tena te pramāṇa antara apekṣam artham abhidadhati iti hetoḥ yuktā teṣām pramāṇa antara anusāriṇī vṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ vyatirekam āha tulye tu iti

original: pratyakṣāmnāyayoḥ pramāṇāntarānapekṣatve tulye tadviparyayaḥ kiṃ na bhavati ? pratyakṣādīnyevānnāyānuguṇatayā kimiti na nīyanta ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pratyakṣa āmnāyayoḥ pramāṇa antara anapekṣa tve tulye tad viparyayaḥ kim na bhavati pratyakṣa ādīni eva annāya anuguṇa tayā kim iti na nīyante iti arthaḥ

original: viruddhāvyabhicārihetudvayavadanyonyavyāghātādaprāmāṇyameva cobhayorapi kimiti na syāt ? “paurvāparye pūrvadaurbalyam” iti nyāyena rajatajñānasyeva śuktijñānena pūrvasya pratyakṣāderāmnāyena bādhaḥ kimiti na syādityarthaḥ | antya evātra pakṣaḥ siddhānto'bhipretaḥ ;
analyzed: viruddha avyabhicāri hetu dvaya vat anyonya vyāghātāt aprāmāṇyam eva ca ubhayoḥ api kim iti na syāt paurvāparye pūrva daurbalyam iti nyāyena rajata jñānasya iva śukti jñānena pūrvasya pratyakṣa ādeḥ āmnāyena bādhaḥ kim iti na syāt iti arthaḥ antyaḥ eva atra pakṣaḥ siddhānta abhipretaḥ

original: pūrvotu sarvathā pratyakṣādyanuguṇatayāmnāyasya vṛttirna prāpnotītyevaṃparau prauḍhivāditayoktāviti mantavyam | dṛṣṭāntameva draḍhayati—na tvalviti | tvallaśabdaḥ prasiddhidyotanārthaḥ | prasiddhameva tadrajatajñāne yatpūrvavirodhāduttaramaviṣayamanyaviṣayaṃ vā na kalpyate, kiṃtu, pūrvasyaiva bādheti, tathehāpi bhavitumarhatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: sarvathā pratyakṣa ādi anuguṇa tayā āmnāyasya vṛttiḥ na prāpnoti iti evaṃparau prauḍhi vādi tayā uktau iti mantavyam dṛṣṭāntam eva draḍhayati na tvalu iti tvalla śabdaḥ prasiddhi dyotana arthaḥ prasiddham eva tat rajata jñāne yat pūrva virodhāt uttaram aviṣayam anya viṣayam vā na kalpyate kiṃtu pūrvasya eva bādhā iti tathā iha api bhavitum arhati iti bhāvaḥ

original: aviṣayamityāmnāyasyāvibakṣitārthatvapakṣasāmyārthamuktam | nanu pramāṇāntaravirodhe'pi cenmukhyamarthaṃ śabdo na jahāti, kathaṃ tarhi “āpo vai śāntāḥ” ityādiṣu guṇavādaḥ ? na hyatra pramāṇāntaravirodhādanyat guṇavāde nibandhanamasti ; tadetadāśaṅkyati—kathamiti | siddhāntī tvāha—yatreti |
analyzed: aviṣayam iti āmnāyasya avibakṣita artha tva pakṣa sāmya artham uktam nanu pramāṇa antara virodhe pi ced mukhyam artham śabdaḥ na jahāti katham tarhi āpaḥ vai śāntāḥ ityādiṣu guṇa vādaḥ na hi atra pramāṇa antara virodhāt anyat guṇa vāde nibandhanam asti tat etat āśaṅkyati katham iti siddhāntī tvāha yatra iti

original: yadvākyaṃ yāvatpramāṇaṃ tasya tāvato yatra śrautairabhidheyabhūtairmukhyairarthairanyonyamananvayāt artho vākyārthābhūto viṣayo na niṣpadyate, tatra dvitīyasyā api vṛtterloke śabdānāṃ vṛttidarśanāt tayā śabdasya pramāṇasya viṣayalābha āśrīyate ; yathā “vetasaśākhayāvakābhiśrāgniṃ vikarṣati” iti vetasaśākhāvake vidhīyete ;
analyzed: yat vākyam yāvat pramāṇam tasya tāvataḥ yatra śrautaiḥ abhidheya bhūtaiḥ mukhyaiḥ arthaiḥ anyonyam ananvayāt arthaḥ vākya arthābhūtaḥ viṣayaḥ na niṣpadyate tatra dvitīyasyāḥ api vṛtteḥ loke śabdānām vṛtti darśanāt tayā śabdasya pramāṇasya viṣaya lābhaḥ āśrīyate yathā vetasa śākhā yāvaka abhiśra agnim vikarṣati iti vetasa śākhā avake vidhīyete

original: “āpo vai śāntāḥ” iti cāpaḥ stūyante ; tatra vidhistutyorminnaviṣayatvena parasparamananvayāt vākyārthāsiddhau, asatyapi pramāṇāntaravirodhe śrutāmapāṃ stutimullaṅghyābhijanastutyā abhijātaḥ stuto bhavatīti vetasaśākhāvakāstutiparatvamevāśrīyate |
analyzed: āpaḥ vai śāntāḥ iti ca āpaḥ stūyante tatra vidhi stutyoḥ minna viṣaya tvena parasparam ananvayāt vākya artha asiddhau asati api pramāṇa antara virodhe śrutām apām stutim ullaṅghya abhijana stutyā abhijātaḥ stutaḥ bhavati iti vetasa śākhā vakā stuti paratvam eva āśrīyate

original: etaduktaṃ bhavati—na vede pramāṇāntaravirodho gauṇatvahetuḥ, kiṃtu mukhyārthatve pramāṇaviṣayasiddhāvanupapattiḥ | nanu vidhistutyorekaviṣayatvamanyatra pratītam ; atastayorminnaviṣayatve'styevātrāpi pratītivirodhaḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati na vede pramāṇa antara virodhaḥ gauṇa tva hetuḥ kiṃtu mukhya artha tve pramāṇa viṣaya siddhau anupapattiḥ nanu vidhi stutyoḥ eka viṣaya tvam anyatra pratītam atas tayoḥ minna viṣaya tve isti eva atra api pratīti virodhaḥ

original: satyam; vākyārthāniṣpattau tu sa hetuḥ, nāpāṃ śrutaśāntatāparatvotsarge; tadutsargastu vākyārthāniṣpattihetuka eva | nanu “ādityo yūpaḥ” ityādau pramāṇāntaravirodhādeva gauṇatvam; virudhyate hi pramāṇāntareṇānupalabdhyā yūpasyādityatā | na hi tatrāpi pramāṇāntaravirodho gauṇatāyāṃ hetuḥ, api tu pramāṇārthāniṣpattireva |
analyzed: satyam vākya artha aniṣpattau tu sa hetuḥ na apām śruta śānta tā paratva utsarge tad utsargaḥ tu vākya artha aniṣpatti hetukaḥ eva nanu ādityaḥ yūpaḥ ityādau pramāṇa antara virodhāt eva gauṇa tvam virudhyate hi pramāṇa antareṇa anupalabdhyā yūpasya āditya tā na hi tatra api pramāṇa antara virodhaḥ gauṇa tāyām hetuḥ api tu pramāṇa artha aniṣpattiḥ eva

original: sā hi veta-saśākhādau dṛṣṭaśaktiravyabhicāriṇī ca | yūpasyādityatāyāḥ paśuniyojana-vākyārthe'nanvayāt pramāṇārthāniṣpattirastyeva | vyabhicārī tu pramāṇāntara-virodhaḥ, vetasaśākhādāvasatyapi tasmin gauṇatāśrayaṇāt; avyabhicāri ca kāraṇamucitam | tasmādyūpādāvapi pramāṇārthāniṣpattireva gauṇatānimittamiti sthitam | dvitīyasyā dṛtteriti pañcasyau |
analyzed: sā hi vetasa śākhā ādau dṛṣṭa śaktiḥ avyabhicāriṇī ca yūpasya āditya tāyāḥ paśu niyojana vākya arthena anvayāt pramāṇa artha aniṣpattiḥ asti eva vyabhicārī tu pramāṇa antara virodhaḥ vetasa śākhā ādau asati api tasmin gauṇa tā āśrayaṇāt avyabhicāri ca kāraṇam ucitam tasmāt yūpa ādau api pramāṇa artha aniṣpattiḥ eva gauṇa tā nimittam iti sthitam dvitīyasyāḥ dṛtteḥ iti pañcasyau

original: vedānte tu tathā nāstīti na gauṇatvamityabhiprāyeṇa vyatirekamāha—yatra tviti | apāvartante; svarasā-trivartanta ityarthaḥ | atraiva prāguktāṃ yuktiṃ smārayati—na hīti | atraiva matāntaramāśaṅkayati—atheti | evamiti; āmnāyasya gauṇatva-mityarthaḥ | ubhayānugrahaṃ vivṛṇoti—evaṃ hīti |
analyzed: vedānte tu tathā na asti iti na gauṇa tvam iti abhiprāyeṇa vyatirekam āha yatra tu iti apāvartante iti arthaḥ atra eva prāguktām yuktim smārayati na hi iti atra eva mata antaram āśaṅkayati atha iti evam iti āmnāyasya gauṇa tvam iti arthaḥ ubhaya anugraham vivṛṇoti evam hi iti

original: āmnāyasya gauṇatve jātyādyātmanā bhāvānāmabhedaḥ svataśca bheda iti bhinnaviṣayatvenāvirodhādu-bhāvapyanugṛhītau syātām; nāmnāyena pratyakṣāderatyantabādhetyarthaḥ | vyatireka-māha—anyatheti | yadi punarāmnāyo mukhyārthaḥ syāt tadānīmadvaitasya satyatvāt dvaitaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣādyatyantamapabādhitaṃ syāt, nobhayānugrahaḥ;
analyzed: āmnāyasya gauṇa tve jāti ādi ātmanā bhāvānām abhedaḥ svatas ca bhedaḥ iti bhinna viṣayatvena avirodhāt ubhau api anugṛhītau syātām na āmnāyena pratyakṣa ādeḥ atyanta bādhā iti arthaḥ vyatirekam āha anyathā iti yadi punar āmnāyaḥ mukhya arthaḥ syāt tadānīm advaitasya satya tvāt dvaita viṣayam pratyakṣa ādi atyantam apabādhitam syāt na ubhaya anugrahaḥ

original: na cobhayānugrahe satyekasyātyantabādhā yukteti bhāvaḥ | tadetat dūṣayati—naita-diti | kuta ityāha—pramāṇeti; ayamarthaḥ—pramāṇasāmarthyasyānusāreṇa prameye kācit kalpanā bhavati; yathā—brīhiyavaniyamātridhidvayasāmarthyānu-sāreṇa brīhiyavādau prameye vikalpakalpanā; yathā ca—“darśapūrṇamāsā-bhyām” iti dvivacanasāmarthyānusāreṇa samuccayakalpanā;
analyzed: na ca ubhaya anugrahe sati ekasya atyanta bādhā yuktā iti bhāvaḥ tat etat dūṣayati na etat iti kutas iti āha pramāṇa iti ayam arthaḥ pramāṇa sāmarthyasya anusāreṇa prameye kācid kalpanā bhavati yathā brīhi yava niyamāt ridhi dvaya sāmarthya anusāreṇa brīhi yava ādau prameye vikalpa kalpanā yathā ca darśa pūrṇamāsābhyām iti dvivacana sāmarthya anusāreṇa samuccaya kalpanā

original: yathā ca—uditā-nuditahaumādau śāstrāntarasāmarthyānusāreṇa caraṇabhedena vyavasthākalpanā | pramāṇasvarūpe tu svarasataḥ svabhāvenautpattikyā śaktyā yā mukhyārtha-siddhistāṃ parityajya nobhayānugrahāya gauṇatvakalpanāyāṃ kiñcitkāraṇamastīti | upasaṃharati—tasmāditi | prameya ityanuvartate | paroktaṃ hetuṃ nirāha— P. 42-5
analyzed: yathā ca audita anudita hauma ādau śāstra antara sāmarthya anusāreṇa caraṇabhedena vyavasthā kalpanā pramāṇa svarūpe tu svarasataḥ svabhāvena autpattikyā śaktyā yā mukhya artha siddhiḥ tām parityajya na ubhaya anugrahāya gauṇa tva kalpanāyām kiñcid kāraṇam asti iti upasaṃharati tasmāt iti prameyaḥ iti anuvartate para uktam hetum nirāha

original: neti | itara āha—te eveti | ye eva pratyakṣādyāmnāyākhye P. 42-13. parasparaviruddhe pramāṇe te evobhayānugrahe pramāṇam, nāparaṃ pramāṇaṃ tadarthaṃ prārthayata ityarthaḥ | etadeva vivṛṇoti—yadīti | kuta ityāha—pramāṇatvāditi ;
analyzed: na iti itaraḥ āhate eva iti ye eva pratyakṣa ādi āmnāya ākhye paraspara viruddhe pramāṇe te eva ubhaya anugrahe pramāṇam na aparam pramāṇam tad artham prārthayataḥ iti arthaḥ etat eva vivṛṇoti yadi iti kutas iti āha pramāṇa tvāt iti

original: tasyāmnāyādeḥ svīyaṃ yatpramāṇatvaṃ tata eva, na pramāṇāntarabalāt, tenāmnāyādinā dvaitaṃ pratyakṣāderarthaḥ gauṇamadvaitamāmnāyasyārthaṃ ityevamartho vyavasthāpyate yata ityarthaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati—evamavyavasthāpyamāne pratyakṣādyāmnāyau pramāṇameva na syātām, viruddhārthatvāt; pramāṇaṃ ca tau | ataḥ svataḥprāmāṇyabalenaiva viṣayavyavasthā ;
analyzed: tasya āmnāya ādeḥ svīyam yat pramāṇa tvam tatas eva na pramāṇa antara balāt tena āmnāya ādinā dvaitam pratyakṣa ādeḥ arthaḥ gauṇam advaitam āmnāyasya artham iti evam arthaḥ vyavasthāpyate yatas iti arthaḥ etat uktam bhavati evam avyavasthāpyamāne pratyakṣa ādi āmnāyau pramāṇam eva na syātām viruddha artha tvāt pramāṇam ca tau atas svatas prāmāṇya balena eva viṣaya vyavasthā

original: bhedadarśanamevāndhakāraḥ, taccāprakāśasāmyāt; tasya nirūḍhinibiḍatayā lokavacasāṃ ca pratyakṣādibhirbādhadarśanāt pratyakṣādīnāmeva balavaccaṃ yo vā manyate tatpratibodhanāya pratyakṣādivirodho nirasyata ityarthaḥ | nanu mandadhiyā bhrāntena ca varākeṇa pratyakṣādivirodhadūṣitasyānmāyasya na kācit kṣatiḥ;

original: ataḥ kimiti tannirāsāya prayatna ityāśaṅkyāha— na hīti | sarpāpekṣayā mandatripeṇa dṛśyikena dṛṣṭo yo na bhriyate so'pi yathā cikitsyate tathā mandadhiyā bhrāntena ca kenacit pratyakṣādivirodhadūṣito'pyānmāyāścakitsanīyaḥ; tasyāpi virodhākhyadoṣanirāsaḥ kārya
analyzed: atas kim iti tad nirāsāya prayatnaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha na hi iti sarpa apekṣayā manda tripeṇa dṛśyikena dṛṣṭaḥ yaḥ na bhriyate saḥ api yathā cikitsyate tathā manda dhiyā bhrāntena ca kenacid pratyakṣa ādi virodha dūṣita upyāt māyāḥ cakitsanīyaḥ tasya api virodha ākhya doṣa nirāsaḥ kārya

original: ityarthaḥ | 'mriyate' iti pāṭhe tu mandadhiyoktatvāt tadukto doṣo'vicikitsya ityāśaṅkya mandaviṣeṇa dṛśyikena daṣṭo yo deśaviśeṣe mriyate sa yathā cikitsyate tathāmnāyo'pi yo mandadhiyā dūṣito mriyate bahubhirmandabuddhibhirviṣṭāvito'prāmāṇyamṛtyumaśnute so'pi cikitsanīya iti yojyam |

original: evamavirodhalakṣaṇārambhaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya 'āhurvidhātṛ' iti ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe—tatreti | tāneva trīn pakṣān vidyaṇoti—vastviti | pratyakṣaṃ P.

original: 44-10 kiṃ 'ghaṭo'yam' iti vastusvarūpamātraṃ vidhatteḥ kiṃ vā 'paṭo'yaṃ na bhavati' iti vastvantaraṃ vyavacchintiḥ atha gṛhṇāti vyavacchinti ca ? yadāpyubhayaṃ karoti tadāpi kiṃ yugapat vidhivyavacchedau karoti ? atha vidhāya vyavacchintiḥ uta tadvyavacchidya vidhatteḥ iti |
analyzed: kim ghaṭaḥ iyam iti vastu svarūpa mātram vidhatteḥ kim vā paṭaḥ yam na bhavati iti vastu antaram vyavacchintiḥ atha gṛhṇāti ca yadā api ubhayam karoti tadā api kim yugapad vidhi vyavacchedau karoti atha vidhāya vyavacchintiḥ uta tat vyavacchidya vidhatteḥ iti

original: tatra teṣu pakṣeṣu madhye anyavyavacchede ubhayasmin vā pratyakṣavyāpāre abhyupagamyamāne, bhedaḥ pratyakṣagocara iti hetorāmnāyasya bhavati tena virodhaḥ | vastusvarūpavidhimātre kasyacidvastvantarasya vyavacchedena rahite pratyakṣavyāpāre sati na bhedaḥ pratyakṣasya gocaraḥ |
analyzed: tatra teṣu pakṣeṣu madhye anya vyavacchede ubhayasmin vā pratyakṣa vyāpāre abhyupagamyamāne bhedaḥ pratyakṣa gocaraḥ iti hetoḥ āmnāyasya bhavati tena virodhaḥ vastu svarūpa vidhi mātre kasyacid vastu antarasya vyavacchedena rahite pratyakṣa vyāpāre sati na bhedaḥ pratyakṣasya gocaraḥ

original: nirākariṣyamāṇavidhipūrvakavyavacchedapakṣāpekṣayā tāvacchabdaḥ | na tāvadvyavacchedamātraṃ pratyakṣavyāpāraḥ, nāpi yugapadyavacchedavidhī, nāpi vyavacchedapūrvaṃ vidhānam; yataḥ pramāṇāntarasiddhe viṣaye tatsiddhameva niṣidhyate | niṣedhasvarūpamāha—
analyzed: nirākariṣyamāṇa vidhi pūrvaka vyavaccheda pakṣa apekṣayā tāvat śabdaḥ na tāvat vyavaccheda mātram pratyakṣa vyāpāraḥ nā api yugapad yavaccheda vidhī nā api vyavaccheda pūrvam vidhānam yatas pramāṇa antara siddhe viṣaye tat siddham eva niṣidhyate niṣedha svarūpam āha

original: P. 44-20. nedamiha nāyamayamiti | ‘nedamiha’ iti saṃsarganiṣedhaḥ, ‘nāyamayam’ iti tādātmyaniṣedha iti bhedenopanyāsaḥ | ubhayatrāpyudāharaṇamāha—siddha iti | pramāṇāntarasiddhe bhūtale tatsiddho ghaṭo niṣidhyata iti ‘nedamiha’ ityasyodāharaṇam | gavi siddhe siddho'śvo niṣidhyata iti ‘nāyamayam’ ityasyodāharaṇam |
analyzed: na idam iha na ayam ayam iti na idam iha iti saṃsarga niṣedhaḥ na ayam ayam iti tādātmya niṣedhaḥ iti bhedena upanyāsaḥ ubhayatra api udāharaṇam āha siddhaḥ iti pramāṇa antara siddhe bhū tale tad siddhaḥ ghaṭaḥ niṣidhyate iti na idam iha iti asya udāharaṇam gavi siddhe siddha uśvaḥ niṣidhyate iti na ayam ayam iti asya udāharaṇam

original: kutaḥ punaḥ pratiṣedhe viṣayapratiṣedhyayoḥ prasiddhirapekṣyata ityapekṣāyāmāha—neti | na hi pratiṣedho nāma svatantraḥ, kiṃtu kasyāpi kutracit; ato yāvatpratiṣedhyapratiṣedhaviṣayau na jñāyete tāvat pratiṣedha eva na ghaṭate yata ityarthaḥ | atra codayati—kathaṃ tarhīti;
analyzed: kutas punar pratiṣedhe viṣaya pratiṣedhyayoḥ prasiddhiḥ apekṣyate iti apekṣāyām āha na iti na hi pratiṣedhaḥ nāma svatantraḥ kiṃtu kasya api kutracid atas yāvat pratiṣedhya pratiṣedha viṣayau na jñāyete tāvat pratiṣedhaḥ eva na ghaṭate yatas iti arthaḥ atra codayati katham tarhi iti

original: yadi siddhe viṣaye siddhaṃ niṣidhyate, kathaṃ ‘pradhānaṃ nāsti’ ‘khapuṣpaṃ nāsti’ iti ca niṣedha ityarthaḥ | kasmātpunaratra niṣedho nāvakalpata ityata āha—na hīti | deśaviśeṣe kālaviśeṣe hi siddhe sarvo niṣedho dṛṣṭaḥ; na ceha tau staḥ; tena viṣayastāvadatra siddho nāstīti bhāvaḥ | kuta ityāha—ātyantikatvāditi;
analyzed: yadi siddhe viṣaye siddham niṣidhyate katham pradhānam na asti khapuṣpam na asti iti ca niṣedhaḥ iti arthaḥ kasmāt punar atra niṣedhaḥ na avakalpate iti atas āha na hi iti deśa viśeṣe kāla viśeṣe hi siddhe sarvaḥ niṣedhaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na ca iha tau staḥ tena viṣayaḥ tāvat atra siddhaḥ na asti iti bhāvaḥ kutas ityāha ātyantika tvāt iti

original: yatra kvacit sato'nyatra niṣedhaḥ, tatra deśakālaviśeṣaviṣayau bhavataḥ; ayaṃ tvātyantikaḥ ‘sarvatra nāsti’ iti niṣedhaḥ, na punaḥ ‘iha nāsti’ iti deśaviśeṣe kālaviśeṣe vā | atastāvadatra viṣayau na saṃbhavata ityarthaḥ | na kevalamatra viṣayo nāsti, pratiṣedhyo'pi siddho nāstītyāha—nāpīti |
analyzed: yatra kvacid sataḥ anyatra niṣedhaḥ tatra deśa kāla viśeṣa viṣayau bhavataḥ ayam tu ātyantikaḥ sarvatra na asti iti niṣedhaḥ na punar iha na asti iti deśa viśeṣe kāla viśeṣe vā atas tāvat atra viṣayau na saṃbhavataḥ iti arthaḥ na kevalam atra viṣayaḥ na asti pratiṣedhyaḥ api siddhaḥ na asti iti āha na api iti

original: nāpi kutaścit pramāṇāt pradhānāderghaṭādivat kvacit siddhirityarthaḥ | hetumāha—atyantātsvāditi | khapuṣpasya sarvajanīnamatyantāsaccam | pradhānaṃ tu sāṃkhyānāṃ sat, na tu tairniṣedhyam; vādāntarasya tu niṣedhyam, tasya ca pratiṣedhyamasiddham | anenaiva ca bhedenodāharaṇadvayamuktam | tatraikīyamatena parihāramāha—tatreti | yadāhustadāha—kheti |
analyzed: nā api kutaścid pramāṇāt pradhāna ādeḥ ghaṭa ādi vat kvacid siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ hetum āha atyantāt svāt iti khapuṣpasya sarvajanīnam atyanta asaccam pradhānam tu sāṃkhyānām sat na tu taiḥ niṣedhyam vāda antarasya tu niṣedhyam tasya ca pratiṣedhyam asiddham anena eva ca bhedena udāharaṇa dvayam uktam tatra ekīya matena parihāram āha tatra iti yat āhuḥ tat āha kha iti

original: pradhānapratiṣedhagataparihārāpekṣayā tāvacchabdaḥ | pramāṇāntarasiddheṣu khādiṣu tadvidhāḥ pramāṇāntarasiddhā eva puṣpādayo'tra niṣidhyanta iti nātra pramāṇāntarasiddhaviṣayapratiṣedhyāsiddhirityarthaḥ | tathā ‘pradhānaṃ nāsti’ ityatrāpi na viṣayapratiṣedhyayorasiddhirityāha—pradhānamiti | jagatastāvadutpattimakhvāt kāraṇaṃ siddham |
analyzed: pradhāna pratiṣedha gata parihāra apekṣayā tāvat śabdaḥ pramāṇa antara siddheṣu kha ādiṣu tadvidhāḥ pramāṇa antara siddhāḥ eva puṣpa ādayaḥ atra niṣidhyante iti na atra pramāṇa antara siddha viṣaya pratiṣedhya asiddhiḥ iti arthaḥ tathā pradhānam na asti iti atra api na viṣaya pratiṣedhyayoḥ asiddhiḥ iti āha pradhānam iti jagataḥ tāvat utpattim akhvāt kāraṇam siddham

original: pradhānaṃ ca saccarajjñyastamorūpam; kāryakāraṇayorabhedāt tatkāryaṃ sukhaduḥkhamohātmakaṃ sāṃkhyairiṣṭam |
analyzed: pradhānam ca sat ca rajjñyaḥ tamaḥ rūpam kārya kāraṇayoḥ abhedāt tat kāryam sukha duḥkha moha ātmakam sāṃkhyaiḥ iṣṭam

original: punaḥ 'pradhānaṃ nāsti' ityukte siddhe jagatkāraṇe anyatra siddhā sukhaduḥkhamohātmatā nivāryate | tathā kāryakāraṇayoratyantamabhedādavibhaktakāryatvaṃ satkāryatvaṃ ca mṛdvaṭādau 'mṛdayaṃ ghaṭaḥ' ityādipramāṇasiddhaṃ pradhānaniṣedhena vāryate iti nātrāpi viṣayapratiṣedhyayorasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ;
analyzed: punar pradhānam na asti iti ukte siddhe jagatkāraṇe anyatra siddhā sukha duḥkha moha ātmatā nivāryate tathā kārya kāraṇayoḥ atyantam abhedāt avibhakta kārya tvam satkārya tvam ca mṛd vaṭa ādau mṛd ayam ghaṭaḥ ityādi pramāṇa siddham pradhāna niṣedhena vāryate iti na atra api viṣaya pratiṣedhyayoḥ asiddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: avibhaktaṃ saṃbhinnaṃ kāryaṃ yasmāttat tathoktam, tasya bhāvastaccam | atraiva matāntara māha—anye tviti | sādṛśyavāsanānyāyābhāsavākyābhāsādeḥ kutaści P. 45-1. nnimittāt buddhau labdharūpāṇāṃ buddhyākārāṇāṃ satāṃ khapuṣpādīnāṃ bahirvedavabhāsamānānāṃ bahirniṣedhaḥ kriyata ityanye varṇayantītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: avibhaktam saṃbhinnam kāryam yasmāt tat tathā uktam tasya bhāvaḥ taccam atra eva mata antaram āha anye tu iti sādṛśya vāsanā nyāya ābhāsa vākya ābhāsa ādeḥ kutaścid nimittāt buddhau labdha rūpāṇām buddhi ākārāṇām satām khapuṣpa ādīnām bahis veda avabhāsamānānām bahis niṣedhaḥ kriyate iti anye varṇayanti iti arthaḥ

original: ityabhavarṇyamāne tu pratiṣedha eva na siddhyatītyāha—anyatheti | anyathā evamavarṇyamāne sarvathā aprāpte khapuṣpādau daivaniṣiddhe kaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ? na ko'prītyarthaḥ; na hyaprāptaṃ pratiṣidhyate; prāpte ca nātyantiko niṣedhaḥ syādityarthaḥ | tadevaṃ siddhe viṣaye siddhameva niṣidhyata iti yaduktaṃ tadupapannam |
analyzed: tu pratiṣedhaḥ eva na siddhi ati iti āha anyathā iti anyathā evam avarṇyamāne sarvathā aprāpte khapuṣpa ādau daiva niṣiddhe kaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ na koprī iti arthaḥ na hi aprāptam pratiṣidhyate prāpte ca na ātyantikaḥ niṣedhaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ tat evam siddhe viṣaye siddham eva niṣidhyate iti yat uktam tat upapannam

original: siddhaṃ siddhe niṣidhyata ityatraivopapattyantaramāha—api ceti | yadi pratiṣedhe viṣayapratiṣedhyau ghaṭapaṭau nāpekṣyete tato 'nāsti' ityevamaviśeṣeṇa niṣedhaḥ syāt; na 'ghaṭe paṭo nāsti' iti | tataśca sarvatra sarvasyāviśeṣeṇa niṣedhāt sarvaśūnyatā pramāṇasya viṣayaḥ syāt; na bhedaḥ, bhedidvayābhāvā diti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: siddham siddhe niṣidhyate iti atra eva upapatti antaram āha api ca iti yadi pratiṣedhe viṣaya pratiṣedhyau ghaṭa paṭau na apekṣyete tatas na asti iti evam aviśeṣeṇa niṣedhaḥ syāt na ghaṭe paṭaḥ na asti iti tatas ca sarvatra sarvasya aviśeṣeṇa niṣedhāt sarva śūnyatā pramāṇasya viṣayaḥ syāt na bhedaḥ bhedi dvaya abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nāpekṣitau viṣayaniṣedhyau yena sa tathoktaḥ | devāyatto ye niṣedhaḥ sa kīdṛśo bhavatītyapekṣāyāmāha—yastviti | 'idamato bhinnam' iti hi bhedo gṛhyate; sa ca tādṛśo bhedadvayasya pramāṇataḥ siddhimapekṣataṃ ityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityāha—na ceti |
analyzed: na apekṣitau viṣaya niṣedhyau yena sa tathā uktaḥ deva āyattaḥ ye niṣedhaḥ sa kīdṛśaḥ bhavati iti apekṣāyām āha yaḥ tu iti idam atas bhinnam iti hi bhedaḥ gṛhyate sa ca tādṛśaḥ bheda dvayasya pramāṇataḥ siddhim apekṣatam iti arthaḥ tatas kim ityāha na ca iti

original: sā bhedayoḥ siddhirvidhānāt tatpramāṇena vastusvarūpagrahaṇādyate na ghaṭata iti vyavacchedāt prāgvidhāna meṣitavyamityarthaḥ | itaśca prāgvidhānameṣitavyamityāha—vidhipūrvaka iti; sarvavādibhistathaivāṅgīkaraṇādityarthaḥ | itirhetau, ślokārthaparisamāptau vā |
analyzed: sā bhedayoḥ siddhiḥ vidhānāt tad pramāṇena vastu svarūpa grahaṇāt yate na ghaṭate iti vyavacchedāt prāk vidhāna meṣitavyam iti arthaḥ itas ca prāk vidhānam eṣitavyam iti āha vidhi pūrvakaḥ iti sarva vādibhiḥ tathā eva aṅgīkaraṇāt iti arthaḥ itiḥ hetau śloka artha parisamāptau vā

original: labdharūpe pramāṇataḥ siddhasvarūpe kañcit bhūtalādau kiñcit ghaṭādi tādṛgeva pramāṇataḥ siddhasvarūpameva niṣidhyate yataḥ, ato vidhānamantareṇa niṣedhasya na saṃbhava iti ślokārthaḥ | astu tarhi vidhipūrvo vyavaccheda ityata āha—nāpīti | kuta ityata āha—yata iti | ekapratyakṣavijñānavyāpārabhūtayorvidhivyavacchedayoḥ 9
analyzed: labdha rūpe pramāṇataḥ siddha sva rūpe kañcid bhū tala ādau kiñcid ghaṭa ādi tādṛś eva pramāṇataḥ siddha sva rūpam eva niṣidhyate yatas atas vidhānam antareṇa niṣedhasya na saṃbhavaḥ iti śloka arthaḥ astu tarhi vidhi pūrvaḥ vyavacchedaḥ iti atas āha nā api iti kutas iti atas āha yatas iti eka pratyakṣa vijñāna vyāpāra bhūtayoḥ vidhi vyavacchedayoḥ

original: paurvāparyalakṣaṇaḥ kramo yuktyā na saṃgacchate na yuktimān, jñānasya kṣaṇikatvāditi bhāvaḥ | tacca pratyakṣaṃ vijñānaṃ saṃnihitajaṃ saṃnihite viṣaye jāyate | tena tadanyāmarśi na jāyate; tataḥ saṃnihitāt anyat asaṃnihitaṃ parāmraṣṭuṃ śīlaṃ yasya tat tadanyāmarśi tathābhūtaṃ na jāyata P. 46-11 ityarthaḥ | ślokaṃ vivṛṇoti - na khalviti |
analyzed: paurvāparya lakṣaṇaḥ kramaḥ yuktyā na saṃgacchate na yuktimān jñānasya kṣaṇika tvāt iti bhāvaḥ tat ca pratyakṣam vijñānam saṃnihita jam saṃnihite viṣaye jāyate tena tad anya āmarśi na jāyate tatas saṃnihitāt anyat asaṃnihitam parāmraṣṭum śīlam yasya tat tad anya āmarśi tathābhūtam na jāyata iti arthaḥ ślokam vivṛṇoti na khalu iti

original: kuta ityāha -- kṣaṇikatvāditi; jñānasyetyadhyāhāryam | kasmāt punaḥ kṣaṇikasya vyāpārayoḥ kramo na yujyata ityata āha -- kramavatoriti ! yataḥ kramavatorvyāpārayormadhye yaḥ paścāttano vyāpāraḥ sa tasya jñānasya vyāpārā na syādityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha -- vyavadhānāditi |
analyzed: kutas iti āha kṣaṇika tvāt iti jñānasya iti adhyāhāryam kasmāt punar kṣaṇikasya vyāpārayoḥ kramaḥ na yujyate iti atas āha kramavatoḥ iti yatas kramavatoḥ vyāpārayoḥ madhye yaḥ paścāttanaḥ vyāpāraḥ sa tasya jñānasya vyāpārāḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ kutas iti āha vyavadhānāt iti

original: paścāttano vyāpāraḥ pūrvabhāvinā vyāpāreṇa vyavahito na kṣaṇikasya syāt, tasya tadānīṃ naṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ | itaśca na vidhipūrvo vyavaccheda ityāha -- api ceti | arthaparicchedarūpāyā buddherjanmaiva vyāpāro na kāṣṭhādīnāmiva janmātirekeṇa vyāpārāntaramasti | taduktam—“tena janmaiva viṣaye buddhervyāpāra iṣyate” iti |
analyzed: paścāttanaḥ vyāpāraḥ pūrva bhāvinā vyāpāreṇa vyavahitaḥ na kṣaṇikasya syāt tasya tadānīm naṣṭa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ itas ca na vidhi pūrvaḥ vyavacchedaḥ iti āha api ca iti artha pariccheda rūpāyāḥ buddheḥ janma eva vyāpāraḥ na kāṣṭha ādīnām iva janma atirekeṇa vyāpāra antaram asti tat uktam tena janma eva viṣaye buddheḥ vyāpāraḥ iṣyate iti

original: tathā “na hi tatkṣaṇamapyāste jāyate vā pramātmakam” iti ca | arthāvagraharūpāyā iti viśeṣaṇamantaḥkaraṇanivṛttyartham | tataḥ kimityāha—sā cediti | sā buddhirarthavidhānarūpodayā yadi tadā vidhirevāsyā buddhervyāpāro na vyavaccheda iti kuto vyāpāradvayasaṃbhavaḥ, yena kramaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | arthavidhānarūpa udayo janma yasyā iti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: tathā na hi tad kṣaṇam api āste jāyate vā pramā ātmakam iti ca artha avagraha rūpāyāḥ iti viśeṣaṇam antaḥkaraṇa nivṛtti artham tatas kim iti āha sā ced iti sā buddhiḥ artha vidhāna rūpa udayā yadi tadā vidhiḥ eva asyāḥ buddheḥ vyāpāraḥ na vyavacchedaḥ iti kutas vyāpāra dvaya saṃbhavaḥ yena kramaḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ artha vidhāna rūpaḥ udayaḥ janma yasyāḥ iti vigrahaḥ

original: cecchabdo ‘yadi vedāḥ pramāṇam’ itivadgṛhavyaḥ | nanu kimityarthavidhānarūpodayā sā bhavati? vidhivyavacchedobhayarūpodayaiva tāvat kiṃ na syāt? ityāśaṅkyāha yaugapadyeti | nobhayarūpodayā sā, yaugapadyasyānantarameva niṣedhāt | ato vidhānarūpo dayaiva sā buddhiriti na tato vyavacchedaḥ | tasmānna kramaḥ, dvayorhi kramo bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: ced śabdaḥ yadi vedāḥ pramāṇam iti vat gṛhavyaḥ nanu kim iti artha vidhāna rūpa udayā sā bhavati vidhi vyavaccheda ubhaya rūpa udayā eva tāvat kim na syāt iti āśaṅkya āha yaugapadya iti na ubhaya rūpa udayā sā yaugapadyasya anantaram eva niṣedhāt atas vidhāna rūpaḥ dayā eva sā buddhiḥ iti na tatas vyavacchedaḥ tasmāt na kramaḥ dvayoḥ hi kramaḥ bhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu dve tarhi buddheḥ kramavatī janmanī bhaviṣyataḥ; tatraikaṃ vidhānarūpam, aparaṃ vyavacchedarūpamityasti kramasaṃbhava ityāśaṅkyāha—utpannāyā iti | anmiśca pakṣe buddherjanmadvayena vidhivyavacchedayorekasya vijñānasya karmaṇerjanmarūpayorvyāpārayorvā kramaḥ paurvāparyaṃ yuktyā na saṃgacchate, jātasya punarjanmāsaṃbhavāditi ślokārthaṃ yojyam |
analyzed: nanu dve tarhi buddheḥ kramavatī janmanī bhaviṣyataḥ tatra ekam vidhāna rūpam aparam vyavaccheda rūpam iti asti krama saṃbhavaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha autpannāyāḥ iti pakṣe buddheḥ janma dvayena vidhi vyavacchedayoḥ ekasya vijñānasya karmaṇeḥ janma rūpayoḥ vyāpārayoḥ vā kramaḥ paurvāparyam yuktyā na saṃgacchate jātasya punarjanma asaṃbhavāt iti śloka artham yojyam

original: ślokasyottarārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe—api ceti | tataḥ kimityāha—na ceti;
analyzed: ślokasya uttara artham vyācaṣṭe api ca iti tatas kim ityāha na ca iti

original: pratyakṣamityanuvartate | kimityanavabhāsamānaṃ vyavacchettuṃ pratyakṣamaśaktamityata āha—anavabhāsamāne hīti | tatra pratyakṣe ghaṭādau vyavacchedye'navabhāsa- P. 45-16 māne ‘atra bhūtale nāsti ghaṭādi’ iti vyavacchedyaviśeṣarāhitaṃ vyavacchedamātraṃ syāt, na tu ghaṭādervyavacchedyaviśeṣasya kasyacidyavacchedaḥ syāt; dṛśyate cāsau |
analyzed: pratyakṣam iti anuvartate kim iti anavabhāsamānam vyavacchettum pratyakṣam aśaktam iti atas āha anavabhāsamāne hi iti tatra pratyakṣe ghaṭa ādau atra bhū tale na asti ghaṭa ādi iti vyavacchedya viśeṣa rāhitam vyavaccheda mātram syāt na tu ghaṭa ādeḥ vyavacchedya viśeṣasya kasyacid yavacchedaḥ syāt dṛśyate ca asau

original: atha vyavacchedyaṃ vinā vyavacchedānupapattyā vyavacchedyaṃ kalpyate, tatrodgṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvāt bhūtale sarvasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt; na caitadastītyarthaḥ | upasaṃharati—tasmāditi | tataḥ kimityāha—na ceti | ayaṃ ca doṣaḥ pūrvāddiṣṭeṣu caturdhvapi pakṣeṣu samānaḥ | kimarthaṃ tarhīddoṣanyastaḥ? sarvārthaṃ uktaḥ sarvaiḥ saṃbhantasyata iti |
analyzed: atha vyavacchedyam vinā vyavaccheda anupapattyā vyavacchedyam kalpyate tatra udgṛhyamāṇa viśeṣa tvāt bhū tale sarvasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt na ca etat asti iti arthaḥ upasaṃharati tasmāt iti tatas kim ityāha na ca iti ayam ca doṣaḥ pūrvāt diṣṭeṣu caturdhu api pakṣeṣu samānaḥ kimartham tarhi id doṣa nyastaḥ sarva artham uktaḥ sarvaiḥ iti

original: atra punaśrodayati— kathamiti | yadi na niṣedhapuraḥsaro vidhirekajñāne, yadi vā asaṃnihitaniṣedhyāvabhāsaḥ pratyakṣe nāsti, tadā ‘śuktikeyam’ iti bādhakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ nopapadyata ityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha—tatreti | tatra bādhake pratyakṣe pūrvarajatārthaniṣedhapuraḥsaro'nyasyāḥ śuktirvidhirekajñāne'bhyupagamyate |

original: na hyaniṣedhyarajataṃ śuktividhiravakalpate | tathā asaṃnihitasya rajatasya niṣedhyasyāvabhāsaścābhyupeyate, tadanavabhāse tanniṣedhānupapatteḥ | tasmāt na pūrvo niṣedhaḥ, na caikajñānavyāpāre kramaḥ, na cāsaṃnihitāvabhāsaḥ pratyakṣe iti yo'yamanantarokto niyamaḥ sa nāsti, vyabhicārāt; yato bādhake pratyakṣe tritayamapyetadastītyarthaḥ |

original: tadetat siddhānto dūṣayati—naitaditi | asāratvamāha—tatrāpīti | tatrāpi bādhakapratyakṣe ‘rajatamidam’ iti pūrvajñānavihite rajatādau pratiṣedhye, tadīyenaiva ‘idam’ ityaṃśenānidhīritaviśeṣe saṃnihitārthasāmānye viṣaye vihite niṣedho vidhipūrvaka evetyarthaḥ |
