original: etaduktaṃ bhavati—atrāpi viṣayapratiṣedhyavidhipūrvaka eva pratiṣedha iti ‘na pūrvo niṣedhaḥ’ ityasya tāvatra vyabhicāra iti | nanu ‘nedaṃ rajatam, śuktiriyam’ iti niṣedhapūrva eva vidhiravagamyate; tatkathamucyate ‘na niṣedhapūrvako vidhiḥ’ itītyāśaṅkyāha—śuktiketi | virodhino rajatasya niṣedhaḥ pūrvo yasmāditi vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati atra api viṣaya pratiṣedhya vidhi pūrvakaḥ eva pratiṣedhaḥ iti na pūrvaḥ niṣedhaḥ iti asya tau atra vyabhicāraḥ iti nanu na idam rajatam śuktiḥ iyam iti niṣedha pūrvaḥ eva vidhiḥ avagamyate tat katham ucyate na niṣedha pūrvakaḥ vidhiḥ iti iti āśaṅkya āha śuktikā iti virodhinaḥ rajatasya niṣedhaḥ pūrvaḥ yasmāt iti vigrahaḥ

original: tathā satyapi ca nāsmadabhimataniyamanāśa ityāha—vidhīti | ‘na pūrvo niṣedhaḥ’ ityanena viṣayaniṣedhyavidhipūrvatā niṣedhasya niyamenocyate; na ca tadvidhipūrvatvābhāvo niṣedhasya 9A
analyzed: tathā sati api ca na asmad abhimata niyama nāśaḥ iti āha vidhi iti na pūrvaḥ niṣedhaḥ iti anena viṣaya niṣedhya vidhi pūrva tā niṣedhasya niyamena ucyate na ca tad vidhi pūrva tva abhāvaḥ niṣedhasya

original: nivartyate | yadyapi śuktividherniṣedhapūrvatā, tathāpi rajataniṣedhasya rajatedamaṃśasāmānyavidhipūrvatvādavyabhicāra iti bhāvaḥ | etacca paramatenoktam | siddhānte tu na rajataniṣedhaśuktividhyoḥ kramo'sti, 'kramaḥ saṃgacchate yuktyā' ityanena vicāritatvāt; vakṣyati ca—'na ca tatraikajñānasya kramavadyāpāratā' iti |
analyzed: nivartyate yadi api śukti vidheḥ niṣedha pūrva tā tathā api rajata niṣedhasya rajata idam aṃśa sāmānya vidhi pūrva tvāt avyabhicāraḥ iti bhāvaḥ etat ca para matena uktam siddhānte tu na rajata niṣedha śukti vidhyoḥ kramaḥ usti kramaḥ saṃgacchate yuktyā iti anena vicārita tvāt vakṣyati cana ca tatra eka jñānasya krama vat yāpāra tā iti

original: evaṃ vidhipūrvaka eva niṣedha ityasyāvyabhicāramuktvā adhunā naikajñānavyāpāre krama ityasya bādhakapratyakṣeṇa yo vyabhicāra uktastaṃ P. 45-25. pariharati—na ceti | tatreti bādhakajñānaṃ parāmṛśati | kuta ityāha— ubhayeti | śuktividhirajataniṣedharūpaṃ citrameva bādhakajñānaṃ jāyate; janma ca tasya vyāpāra ityuktam |
analyzed: evam vidhi pūrvakaḥ eva niṣedhaḥ iti asya avyabhicāram uktvā adhunā na eka jñāna vyāpāre kramaḥ iti asya bādhaka pratyakṣeṇa yaḥ vyabhicāraḥ uktaḥ tam pariharati na ca iti tatra iti bādhaka jñānam parāmṛśati kutas iti āha ubhaya iti śukti vidhi rajata niṣedha rūpam citram eva bādhaka jñānam jāyate janma ca tasya vyāpāraḥ iti uktam

original: na caikam, utpannasya punaranutpatteḥ; anekatra ca kramo bhavati; naikatra | tena na yugapadeva vidhiniṣedhau tatkaroti | ato naikatra jñāne kramavadyāpāranetyarthaḥ | na ca pūrvasiddhaviṣayaniṣedhyābhāvādubhayarūpotpattyasaṃbhava iti vācyam, 'idaṃ rajatam' iti pūrvajñāne tayordarśitatvādityāha—pūrvajñāneti | yathā caitattathoktam |
analyzed: na ca ekam utpannasya punar anutpatteḥ anekatra ca kramaḥ bhavati na ekatra tena na yugapad eva vidhi niṣedhau tat karoti atas na ekatra jñāne krama vat yāpāranā iti arthaḥ na ca pūrva siddha viṣaya niṣedhya abhāvāt ubhaya rūpa utpatti asaṃbhavaḥ iti vācyam idam rajatam iti pūrva jñāne tayoḥ darśita tvāt iti āha pūrva jñāna iti yathā ca etat tathā uktam

original: idānīṃ pratyakṣe nāsaṃnihitāvabhāsa ityuktavyabhicārārthaṃ bādhakapratyakṣeṇāsaṃnihitāvabhāsa iti yaduktaṃ tatpariharati—pūrvajñāneti | 'idaṃ rajatam' iti jñānenāvabhāsite vyavacchedye rajatavyavacchedasya praśnettarnāsaṃnihitarajatāvabhāsaprasaṅgaḥ pratyakṣa ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: idānīm pratyakṣe na asaṃnihita avabhāsaḥ iti ukta vyabhicāra artham bādhaka pratyakṣeṇa asaṃnihita avabhāsaḥ iti yat uktam tat pariharati pūrva jñāna iti idam rajatam iti jñānena avabhāsite vyavacchedye rajata vyavacchedasya praśna ittarna asaṃnihita rajata avabhāsa prasaṅgaḥ pratyakṣe iti arthaḥ

original: kathamanyaprāpitamanyo niṣedhatīti cet, yathā ṣoḍaśavidhiprāpitaṃ tanniṣedhavidhiḥ | evaṃ tarhi smṛtiprāpitapratiyogivyavacchettṛtvāt pratyakṣasyāsaṃnihitārthāvabhāsitve'pi na doṣaḥ | naivam; abhinnaṃ cet smṛtyā prāpitaṃ na pratiyogi; bhinnaṃ cet itaretarāśrayam | nanu pratyakṣaprāpite'pi pratiyoginyetadūṣaṇamastyeva | astu;
analyzed: katham anya prāpitam anyaḥ niṣedhati iti ced yathā ṣoḍaśa vidhi prāpitam tat niṣedha vidhiḥ evam tarhi smṛti prāpita pratiyogi vyavacchettṛ tvāt pratyakṣasya asaṃnihita artha avabhāsi tve api na doṣaḥ na evam abhinnam ced smṛtyā prāpitam na pratiyogi bhinnam ced itaretara āśrayam nanu pratyakṣa prāpite api pratiyogini etat ūṣaṇam asti eva astu

original: kā no hāniḥ? kimarthaṃ tarhi noktam? dūṣaṇāntaravibhavāt; pratyakṣameva vā prāpakaṃ vyavacchedakaṃ ceti yo manyate taṃ pratyasaṃnihitānavabhāsakatvaṃ doṣa ukta iti | nanu jñānānāmanyonyanirapekṣāṇāmutpatteḥ kathaṃ pūrveṇāvabhāsitaṃ vyavacchedyamanantareṇa vyavacchidyata ityāśaṅkyāha—pūrvāpekṣasyeti |
analyzed: kā no hāniḥ kimartham tarhi na uktam dūṣaṇa antara vibhavāt pratyakṣam eva vā prāpakam vyavacchedakam ca iti yaḥ manyate tam prati asaṃnihita anavabhāsaka tvam doṣaḥ uktaḥ iti nanu jñānānām anyonya nirapekṣāṇām utpatteḥ katham pūrveṇa avabhāsitam vyavacchedyam anantareṇa vyavacchidyate iti āśaṅkya āha pūrva apekṣasya iti

original: syādeva yadi pūrvāparayorjñānayoratrānapekṣatā syāt; saivāsiddhā; bādhakaṃ hi bādhyamapekṣyaivotpadyate, anyathā bādhakatvāyogāditi bhāvaḥ | pūrvamapekṣata iti pūrvāpekṣi | ata eva tad dvirūpamutpadyate; anyathetarajñānavadekarūpamevodiyādityāha—pūrveti | dvirūpaṃ vidhi-
analyzed: syāt eva yadi pūrva aparayoḥ jñānayoḥ atra anapekṣatā syāt sā eva asiddhā bādhakam hi bādhyam apekṣya eva utpadyate anyathā bādhaka tva ayogāt iti bhāvaḥ pūrvam apekṣate iti pūrva apekṣi atas eva tat dvi rūpam utpadyate anyathā itara jñāna vat eka rūpam eva udiyāt iti āha pūrva iti dvi rūpam vidhi

original: niṣeṣarūpam | ekarūpaṃ vidhimātrarūpamityarthaḥ | kiṃca yena vādinā P 46-4. sarvavyavacchedo nirākṛtāḥ, tena rajatādivyavacchedo'pi pakṣīkṛtaḥ; na ca pakṣeṇaiva vyabhicāro yukta ityāha—api ceti |
analyzed: niṣeṣa rūpam eka rūpam vidhi mātra rūpam iti arthaḥ kiṃca yena vādinā sarva vyavacchedaḥ nirākṛtāḥ tena rajata ādi vyavacchedaḥ api pakṣīkṛtaḥ na ca pakṣeṇa eva vyabhicāraḥ yuktaḥ iti āha api ca iti

original: atha rajatādivyavacchedo loke siddha iti tena vyabhicāra ucyate, tato grāmādīnāmanyonyavyavacchedo yo nirākāryatvena pakṣīkṛtaḥ sa kiṃ na lokasiddhaḥ? atastenaiva vyabhicāraḥ kiṃ nocyate? sa cedvicāryamāṇo na ghaṭate, tathā rajatādivyavacchedo'pīti lokasiddhirakiṃcitkaraivetyabhiprāyeṇāha—siddhaḥ sa iti | matāntaramāha—yacciti |
analyzed: atha rajata ādi vyavacchedaḥ loke siddhaḥ iti tena vyabhicāraḥ ucyate tatas grāma ādīnām anyonya vyavacchedaḥ yaḥ nirākārya tvena pakṣīkṛtaḥ sa kim na loka siddhaḥ atas tena eva vyabhicāraḥ kim nā ucyate sa ced vicāryamāṇaḥ na ghaṭate tathā rajata ādi vyavacchedaḥ upi iti loka siddhiḥ akiṃcitkarā eva iti abhiprāyeṇa āha siddhaḥ saḥ iti mata antaram āha yat citi

original: ekasya nīlasya vidhinīlaikasattādarśanamevānyasya pītādivyavacchedaḥ; na tu pratyakṣe vyāpāradvayamasti, yena kramo yaugapadyaṃ vā syāt | atastathorasaṃbhave'pi siddhaṃ pratyakṣasya niṣeṣṭṛtvamiti kathamucyate ‘na niṣeṣṭṛ’ iti? siddhaṃ ca niṣeṣṭṛtvena bhedaviṣayatvāt pratyakṣasyāmnāyaviroddhṛtvamiti bhāvaḥ | etadeva vivṛṇoti—tathā hīti |
analyzed: ekasya nīlasya vidhi nīla eka sattā darśanam eva anyasya pīta ādi vyavacchedaḥ na tu pratyakṣe vyāpāra dvayam asti yena kramaḥ yaugapadyam vā syāt atas tathoḥ asaṃbhave pi siddham pratyakṣasya niṣeṣṭṛ tvam iti katham ucyate na niṣeṣṭṛ iti siddham ca niṣeṣṭṛ tvena bheda viṣaya tvāt pratyakṣasya āmnāya viroddhṛ tvam iti bhāvaḥ etat eva vivṛṇoti tathā hi iti

original: nīlanirvikalpakadarśanaṃ hi pītādiviviktaniyatanīlākāramutpannam; na punaḥ pītādyaviviktanīlākāram | atastadyathaiva nīlaṃ rūpaṃ vidadhāti, tathaiva nīlākāraikapratiniyamāt tato'nyat vyavacchinati | tena vidhirevānīlavyavaccheda iti bhāvaḥ | nanu ‘idaṃ nīlam’ ityanyadeva nīlajñānam; anyacca ‘nedamanīlam’ iti pratiddham;
analyzed: nīla nirvikalpaka darśanam hi pīta ādi vivikta niyata nīla ākāram utpannam na punar pīta ādi avivikta nīla ākāram atas tat yathā eva nīlam rūpam vidadhāti tathā eva nīla ākāra eka pratiniyamāt tatas nyat vyavacchinati tena vidhiḥ eva anīla vyavacchedaḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu idam nīlam iti anyat eva nīla jñānam anyat ca na idam anīlam iti pratiddham

original: ataḥ kathaṃ nīlajñānamevānīlavyavaccheda ityāśaṅkyāha—tadini | tasya nirvikalpakadarśanasya yatsāmarthyaṃ niyataikākāratvaṃ tenānādivāsanāvaśāt pratibhāvitau janitau ‘idam, nedam’ iti vikalpau bhāvābhāvavyavahāraṃ pravartayata ityarthaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati—satyaṃ jñānadvayamidam; savikalpakaṃ tu tat |
analyzed: atas katham nīla jñānam eva anīla vyavacchedaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha tad ini tasya nirvikalpaka darśanasya yat sāmarthyam niyata eka ākāra tvam tena anādi vāsanā vaśāt pratibhāvitau janitau idam na idam iti vikalpau bhāva abhāva vyavahāram pravartayataḥ iti arthaḥ etat uktam bhavati satyam jñāna dvayam idam savikalpakam tu tat

original: yattu nirvikalpakaṃ tathormūlabhūtaṃ tatpratyakṣam | tatra ca vayamekavidhirevānyavyavaccheda iti brūma iti | kasmātpunareva vikalpyata ityata āha—na hīti | anyasaṃsargo'syāstītyanyasaṃsargi, anyasaṃsargi na bhavatītyananyasaṃsargi; etacca ‘ekākārapratiniyamāt’ ityasya vivaraṇam; tathā ca vakṣyati—‘tatpratiniyamo hi tato'nyasyāsaṃsargaḥ’ iti |
analyzed: yat tu nirvikalpakam tathoḥ mūla bhūtam tat pratyakṣam tatra ca vayam eka vidhiḥ eva anya vyavacchedaḥ iti brūmaḥ iti kasmāt punar eva vikalpyate iti atas āha na hi iti anya saṃsargaḥ usya asti iti anya saṃsargi anya saṃsargi na bhavati iti ananya saṃsargi etat ca eka ākāra pratiniyamāt iti asya vivaraṇam tathā ca vakṣyati tad pratiniyamaḥ hi tatonyasya a saṃsargaḥ iti

original: P. 46-11 evaṃ bauddhamatamupanyasyātivyāptyavyāptibhyāṃ dūṣayati—atrocyata iti | ekasya vidhānamevānyasya gocaro'nyasya pratiṣedho na bhavati | kuta ityāha—mā sma bhūdaviśeṣeṇeti | yadyekavidhereva tato'nyasya pratiṣedhaḥ, tato dṛśyādṛśyayoraviśeṣeṇa pratiṣedhaḥ syāt; sa mā bhūdityarthaḥ | smeti pādapūraṇārtham |
analyzed: evam bauddha matam upanyasya ativyāpti avyāptibhyām dūṣayati atra ucyate iti ekasya vidhānam eva anyasya gocaraḥ anyasya pratiṣedhaḥ na bhavati kutas iti āha mā sma bhūt aviśeṣeṇa iti yadi eka vidheḥ eva tatas nyasya pratiṣedhaḥ tatas dṛśya adṛśyayoḥ aviśeṣeṇa pratiṣedhaḥ syāt sa mā bhūt iti arthaḥ sma iti pāda pūraṇa artham

original: evamativyāptidoṣamuktvā avyāptidoṣamāha—mā neti | ekabuddhisevināmekabuddhigocarāṇāṃ citre nīlapītādīnāṃ miśro bhinnānāṃ pratyekamekabuddhyabhāvānmā na bhūdanyonyavaccheda ityarthaḥ | ślokārthaṃ vivṛṇoti—naiketi | kuta ityāha—tatpratiniyamo hīti | tasya nīlādenīlādibuddhāveṣa pratiniyamo yaḥ, tato nīlāderanyasya pītādestatrāsaṃsargo'nanupraveśaḥ |
analyzed: evam ativyāpti doṣam uktvā avyāpti doṣam āha mā na iti eka buddhi sevinām ekabuddhi gocarāṇām citre nīla pīta ādīnām miśraḥ bhinnānām pratyekam eka buddhi abhāvāt mā na bhūt anyonya avacchedaḥ iti arthaḥ śloka artham vivṛṇoti na ekā iti kutas ityāha tad pratiniyamaḥ hi iti tasya nīla āde nīla ādi buddhau eṣa pratiniyamaḥ yaḥ tatas nīla ādeḥ anyasya pīta ādeḥ tatra a saṃsargaḥ ūna anupraveśaḥ

original: tathā sati cāsaṃsargāt pītādivyavacchede'bhyupagamyamāne tasyāsaṃsargasya dṛśyādṛśyayorupalabdhiyogyānupalabdhiyogyayoraviśeṣāt tayorubhayorapi vyavacchedaḥ syāt; na ca so'stīti bhāvaḥ | atredānīmiṣṭa eva dṛśyādṛśyayorvyavacchedaḥ; tena neyamaniṣṭāpattiḥ; aniṣṭāpattiśca doṣa iti manyamānastasya matamāśaṅkayati—atheti |
analyzed: tathā sati ca asaṃsargāt pīta ādi vyavaccheda abhyupagamyamāne tasya asaṃsargasya dṛśya adṛśyayoḥ upalabdhi yogya anupalabdhi yogyayoḥ aviśeṣāt tayoḥ ubhayoḥ api vyavacchedaḥ syāt na ca saḥ asti iti bhāvaḥ atra idānīm iṣṭaḥ eva dṛśya adṛśyayoḥ vyavacchedaḥ tena na iyam aniṣṭa āpattiḥ aniṣṭa āpattiḥ ca doṣaḥ iti manyamānaḥ tasya matam āśaṅkayati atha iti

original: ubhayorvyavaccheda ityanuvartate | etadupapādayati—tathā hīti | tathā hi nīladarśanaṃ nīlaikākāratayā ‘nīlātmakamevedam’ iti niyacchat yāvanto bhāvā asya nīlasyānātmāno'svarūpabhūtā dṛśyāścādṛśyāśca tān sarvānaviśeṣeṇaivāpākaroti vyavacchinnatītyarthaḥ | etadeva draḍhayati—tathā ceti |
analyzed: ubhayoḥ vyavacchedaḥ iti anuvartate etat upapādayati tathā hi iti tathā hi nīla darśanam nīla eka ākāra tayā nīla ātmakam eva idam iti niyacchat yāvantaḥ bhāvāḥ asya nīlasya anātmānaḥ svarūpa bhūtāḥ dṛśyāḥ ca adṛśyāḥ ca tān sarvān aviśeṣeṇa eva apākaroti vyavacchinnati iti arthaḥ etat eva draḍhayati tathā ca iti

original: dṛśyāḥ pītādadho'dṛśyāḥ paramāṇvādayo yāvanto nīlādanye, te sarve'sya nīlasyānātmāno bhaveyuḥ, ekasyānekātmavirodhāt | tena tān sarvānevātadātmanastadātmaniyamāt darśanamapākarotīti bhāvaḥ | yadyanye'nyasyātmāno na bhaveyuḥ kīdṛśāstarhi bhaveyurityapekṣāyāmāha—taddeśeti; tasya deśakālau yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ;
analyzed: dṛśyāḥ pītāt adhas dṛśyāḥ paramāṇu ādayaḥ yāvantaḥ nīlāt anye te sarve sya nīlasya anātmānaḥ bhaveyuḥ ekasya aneka ātma virodhāt tena tān sarvān eva a tad ātmanaḥ tad ātma niyamāt darśanam apākaroti iti bhāvaḥ yadi anye nyasya ātmānaḥ na bhaveyuḥ kīdṛśāḥ tarhi bhaveyuḥ iti apekṣāyām āha tad deśa iti tasya deśa kālau yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ

original: anye anyasya deśakālā bhavanti, na tu tadātmāna ityarthaḥ | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha— rūpādivaditi | yathā rūpeṇa sahaikadeśakālā rasādayaḥ, taddhadityarthaḥ | atra hetumāha—avirodhāditi | rūpasya hi rasātmakatvaṃ virudhyate, na tvekadeśakālatvamityarthaḥ | yadi dṛśyādṛśyāvaviśeṣeṇa darśanamapākaroti, kimarthaṃ
analyzed: anye anyasya deśa kālāḥ bhavanti na tu tad ātmānaḥ iti arthaḥ atra dṛṣṭāntam āha rūpa ādi vat iti yathā rūpeṇa saha eka deśa kālāḥ rasa ādayaḥ tat hat iti arthaḥ atra hetum āha avirodhāt iti rūpasya hi rasa ātmaka tvam virudhyate na tu eka deśa kāla tvam iti arthaḥ yadi dṛśya adṛśyau aviśeṣeṇa darśanam apākaroti kimartham

original: tadvipalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptirnāma viśeṣo vyavacchedyaṃ pratyāśrīyata ityāśaṅkyāha— tatreti | tatra tasminnanyeṣāṃ taddeśakālatve satyupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptirnāma yo P. 46-19 viśeṣaḥ sa yasyaiva taddeśakālasyopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptirasti tasyaiva taddeśakālasya vyavacchedo netarasyetyavadhāraṇārthaḥ, na punarātmavyavacchedāvadhāraṇārthaḥ;
analyzed: tad vipalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ nāma viśeṣaḥ vyavacchedyam pratyāśrīyate iti āśaṅkya āha tatra iti tatra tasmin anyeṣām tad deśa kāla tve sati upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ nāma yaḥ viśeṣaḥ sa yasya eva tad deśa kālasya upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ asti tasya eva tad deśa kālasya vyavacchedaḥ na itarasya iti avadhāraṇa arthaḥ na punar ātma vyavaccheda avadhāraṇa arthaḥ

original: sa punaranupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasyāpi bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | atra hetumāha—saṃbhavatīti | taddeśakālo'nātmā astvarūpabhūto'nupalambho yo bhāvaḥ sā'ta evānyopalabdhāvanupalambhamāno'pi saṃbhavati; ato na tasya vyavacchedaḥ, kintu upalabdhiyogyasyaiveti yuktaṃ tatropalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptirviśeṣasyāśrayaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—rūpeti |
analyzed: sa punar anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya api bhavati iti bhāvaḥ atra hetum āha saṃbhavati iti tad deśa kāla ūna ātmā astu arūpa bhūtaḥ unupalambhaḥ yaḥ bhāvaḥ sā atas eva anya upalabdhau anupalambhamānaḥ api saṃbhavati atas na tasya vyavacchedaḥ kintu upalabdhi yogyasya eva iti yuktam tatra upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ viśeṣasya āśrayaṇam iti bhāvaḥ atra dṛṣṭāntam āha rūpa iti

original: yathā rūpopalabdhyānupalambhastaddeśakālo rūpasthānātmā raso rūpopalabdhāvanupalambhamāno'pi saṃbhavatīti na rūpapratiniyamādrūpopalabdhyā rasavyavacchedastathetyarthaḥ | yastu tadātmā sa tena saha tulyopalambhayogyato na tadupalabdhāvanupalambhamānaḥ saṃbhavati |
analyzed: yathā rūpa upalabdhyā anupalambhaḥ tad deśa kālaḥ rūpa sthāna ātmā rasaḥ rūpa upalabdhau anupalambhamānaḥ api saṃbhavati iti na rūpa pratiniyamāt rūpa upalabdhyā rasa vyavacchedaḥ tathā iti arthaḥ yaḥ tu tad ātmā sa tena saha tulya upalambha yogyataḥ na tad upalabdhau anupalambhamānaḥ saṃbhavati

original: tenānupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpto'pi sa vyavacchedya iti na tadarthamupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptirviśeṣa āśrayaṇīya ityabhiprāyeṇāha—na tulyeti | anupalambhamānaḥ saṃbhavatītyanuṣajyate | tulyā upalambhayogyatā yasya sa tathoktaḥ | kasmānna saṃbhavatītyata āha—niyameneti |
analyzed: tena anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptaḥ api sa vyavacchedyaḥ iti na tad artham upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ viśeṣaḥ āśrayaṇīyaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha na tulyā iti anupalambhamānaḥ saṃbhavati iti anuṣajyate tulyā upalambha yogyatā yasya sa tathā uktaḥ kasmāt na saṃbhavati iti atas āha niyamena iti

original: tulyopalambhayogyataścedasti tato yena saha tulyopalambhayogyatastadupalabdhau niyamenopalambhate, itaravat upalambhamānavat; anyathā tulyopalambhayogyata eva sa na syāt, na cedupalambhate tato na saṃbhavatyeveti bhāvaḥ | tadevaṃ taddeśakālavyavacchede dṛśyatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ;
analyzed: tulya upalambha yogyataḥ ced asti tatas yena saha tulya upalambha yogyataḥ tad upalabdhau niyamena upalambhate itara vat upalambhamāna vat anyathā tulya upalambha yogyataḥ eva sa na syāt na ced upalambhate tatas na saṃbhavati eva iti bhāvaḥ tat evam tad deśa kāla vyavacchede dṛśya tvam viśeṣaḥ

original: tadātmavyavacchede tu dṛśyamadṛśyaṃ cāviśeṣeṇa darśanamapākarotīti bauddhena svamate pratiṣṭhāpite siddhāntavādyāha—satyamiti | taddeśakālavyavacchede dṛśyaṃ vyavacchidyate nādṛśyamiti, tathā taddeśakālavyavacchedāvadhāraṇāya dṛśyatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ na tadātmavyavaccheda ityayaṃ vibhāgaḥ satyamasti;
analyzed: tad ātma vyavacchede tu dṛśyam adṛśyam ca aviśeṣeṇa darśanam apākaroti iti bauddhena sva mate pratiṣṭhāpite siddhāntavādī āha satyam iti tad deśa kāla vyavacchede dṛśyam vyavacchidyate na adṛśyam iti tathā tad deśa kāla vyavaccheda avadhāraṇāya dṛśya tvam viśeṣaḥ na tad ātma vyavacchede iti ayam vibhāgaḥ satyam asti

original: nedānīṃ yo darśanasyaikākārapratiniyamaḥ, tasyānyavyavacchede sāmarthyaṃ syādityarthaḥ | nanu bhūtalapratiniyamasya dṛśyaghaṭādivyacchede sāmarthyamasti; ataḥ kathamucyate nedānīṃ darśanapratiniyamasya sāmarthyamitītyāśaṅkyāha—tathā hīti | rūpe rūpaviṣaye yadarśanaṃ tadyathā rūpavidhimātropakṣayāt tatraiva paryavasitaṃ yatra deśe
analyzed: na idānīm yaḥ darśanasya eka ākāra pratiniyamaḥ tasya anya vyavacchede sāmarthyam syāt iti arthaḥ nanu bhū tala pratiniyamasya dṛśya ghaṭa ādi vyacchede sāmarthyam asti atas katham ucyate na idānīm darśana pratiniyamasya sāmarthyam iti iti āśaṅkya āha tathā hi iti rūpe rūpa viṣaye yat arśanam tat yathā rūpa vidhi mātra upakṣayāt tatra eva paryavasitam yatra deśe

original: kāle rūpaṃ tatra na rasaṃ vyavacchinatti, tathā bhūbhāgadarśanapratiniyamo'pi na dṛśyaṃ vyavacchindyādityarthaḥ | darśanapratiniyamasya cedanyavyavacchede sāmarthyamasti, rūpadarśanasyāpi syāt | atha tatra rūpavidhimātra eva pramāṇavṛtteḥ paryavasānādanyavyavacchedaparyantaṃ sāmarthyaṃ nāsti, tato bhūtale'pi |
analyzed: kāle rūpam tatra na rasam vyavacchinatti tathā bhū bhāga darśana pratiniyamaḥ api na dṛśyam vyavacchindyāt iti arthaḥ darśana pratiniyamasya ced anya vyavacchede sāmarthyam asti rūpa darśanasya api syāt atha tatra rūpa vidhi mātre eva pramāṇa vṛtteḥ paryavasānāt anya vyavaccheda paryantam sāmarthyam na asti tatas bhūta lepi

original: darśanapratiniyamasya tatra cātra ca na kaścidviśeṣo'stīti bhāvaḥ | atha vidhimātraparyavasāyinyapi pramāṇavyāpāre svācchandyenānyavyavaccheda icyate, P. 47-2. tato dṛśyasyādṛśyasya ca sarvasyaiva vyavacchedaḥ syādityāha—vyavaccheda iti | upasaṃharati—tasmāditi |
analyzed: darśana pratiniyamasya tatra ca atra ca na kaścid viśeṣaḥ usti iti bhāvaḥ atha vidhi mātra paryavasāyini api pramāṇa vyāpāre svācchandyena anya vyavacchedaḥ icyate tatas dṛśyasya adṛśyasya ca sarvasya eva vyavacchedaḥ syāt iti āha vyavacchedaḥ iti upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: darśanapratiniyamasyāsāmarthyamupapādya ‘ghaṭaḥ paṭo na bhavati’ ityādau tadātmavyavacchede'pi yojayannāha—tathā ceti | tatra ceddhetyantaramupāsyamihāpi tata eva vyavacchedaḥ setsyati, na darśanapratiniyamāditi bhāvaḥ | tata iti; darśanapratiniyamādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: darśana pratiniyamasya asāmarthyam upapādya ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ na bhavati ityādau tad ātma vyavacchede api yojayan āha tathā ca iti tatra ced ha iti antaram upāsyam iha api tatas eva vyavacchedaḥ setsyati na darśana pratiniyamāt iti bhāvaḥ tatas iti darśana pratiniyamāt iti arthaḥ

original: yadi tvekavidhiranyaṃ vyavacchindyādapi, tataḥ svavidheyābhāvavyavacchedarūpatvāt svavidheyābhāvaṃ vyavacchindyāt; na tu ‘nīlaṃ pītaṃ na bhavati’ iti nīlātmanaḥ pītamātmāntaraṃ yattasya sattāṃ vyavacchindyādityāha—kāmamiti | vidhinīlādidarśanam; vidheyo nīlādiviṣayaḥ |
analyzed: yadi tu eka vidhiḥ anyam vyavacchindyāt api tatas sva vidheya abhāva vyavaccheda rūpa tvāt sva vidheya abhāvam vyavacchindyāt na tu nīlam pītam na bhavati iti nīla ātmanaḥ pītam ātma antaram yat tasya sattām vyavacchindyāt iti āha kāmam iti vidhi nīla ādi darśanam vidheyaḥ nīla ādi viṣayaḥ

original: yadyapi vidhividheyasattāmava-bhāsayati na tu vidheyāsattvavyavacchedam, tathāpi vidheyameva vyavacchedamantareṇa sattāṃ nāvakalpata iti nāntarīyakatvādvidheyāsattvavyavacchedarūpatvamuktam | bhāvasyābhāvābhāvarūpatvādvā vidheyameva vidheyāsattvavyavacchedo nānyo vidheyā-kārasya vidhiriti manvānena taduktamiti draṣṭavyam |
analyzed: yadi api vidhi vidheya sattām avabhāsayati na tu vidheya asattva vyavacchedam tathā api vidheyam eva vyavacchedam antareṇa sattām na avakalpate iti nāntarīyaka tvāt vidheya asattva vyavaccheda rūpa tvam uktam bhāvasya abhāva abhāva rūpa tvāt vā vidheyam eva vidheya asattva vyavacchedaḥ na anyaḥ vidheya ākārasya vidhiḥ iti manvānena tat uktam iti draṣṭavyam

original: atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—taddeśeti | yathā nīladarśanamanupalabhyasya paramāṇvādenīlasya deśe kāle ca na sattāṃ vyavacchinatti tadvadityarthaḥ | nanu yadi darśanaṃ dṛśyāsattvaṃ vyavacchinatti, prāptaṃ tarhi dṛśyasya jagataḥ sattvam | ataḥ pratyakṣe bheda-magṛhṇatyapi bhedamātraṃ na syāt;
analyzed: atra dṛṣṭāntam āha tad deśa iti yathā nīla darśanam anupalabhyasya deśe kāle ca na sattām vyavacchinatti tadvat iti arthaḥ nanu yadi darśanam dṛśya asattvam vyavacchinatti prāptam tarhi dṛśyasya jagataḥ sattvam atas pratyakṣe bhedam agṛhṇati api bheda mātram na syāt

original: dṛśyaṃ tu jagat pramāṇasiddhatvāt kena vāryate? ato nādvaitasiddhiḥ | ucyate—bhedābhāve jagadekaṃ tattvaṃ syāt; tadapi na dṛśyam, tasya jaḍatvena svato bhedābhāvena vānyatā'siddheḥ | ataḥ svataḥ siddha ātmā, tadekaṃ tattvamiti siddhamātmādvaitam; abhyupa-gamavādamātraṃ vā tat |
analyzed: dṛśyam tu jagat pramāṇa siddha tvāt kena vāryate atas na advaita siddhiḥ ucyate bheda abhāve jagat ekam tattvam syāt tat api na dṛśyam tasya jaḍa tvena svatas bheda abhāvena vā anyatā siddheḥ atas svatas siddhaḥ ātmā tat ekam tattvam iti siddham ātma advaitam abhyupagama vāda mātram vā tat

original: na hi vidhividheyāsattvaṃ vyavacchinatti, asatyapi vidheye svaksarpādau vidherdarśanāt | vibhramaḥ sa iti cet, idaṃ nāma kim?
analyzed: na hi vidhi vidheya asattvam vyavacchinatti asati api vidheye svak sarpa ādau vidheḥ darśanāt vibhramaḥ saḥ iti ced idam nāma kim

original: yathā cāsya vibhramatvaṃ tathoktamāmrāyabalavattvapradarśanapradeśa ityuparamyate | athocyate -- naikasya bahava ātmānaṃḥ saṃbhavanti ; ata ekākāraniyamaṃ darśanamanekātmānaṃ vyavacchinatīti, tadāha -- naikasyeti | atrottaramāha -- P. 47-6. anyata iti | ekavidhirevānyavyavaccheda iti te pakṣaḥ ;
analyzed: yathā ca asya vibhrama tvam tathā uktam āmrāya balavat tva pradarśana pradeśaḥ iti uparamyate atha ucyate na ekasya bahavaḥ ātmānaḥ saṃbhavanti atas eka ākāra niyamam darśanam aneka ātmānam vyavacchinati iti tat āha na ekasya iti atra uttaram āha anyatas iti eka vidhiḥ eva anya vyavacchedaḥ iti te pakṣaḥ

original: sa virodhāt vyavacchede sati na te sidhyediti bhāvaḥ | nanu cānātmavyavacchedena naḥ kāryam ; sa cedvirodhāṅgavati, bhavatu ; tāvatā bhedaḥ sidhyatyeva ; kiṃ no darśananiyamavyavacchettṛtvagraheṇetyāśaṅkya virodhādapi na vyavaccheda ityāha -- asatīti | anyonyavyavacchinnānāṃ hi bahutvaṃ bhavati ;
analyzed: sa virodhāt vyavacchede sati na te sidhyet iti bhāvaḥ nanu ca anātma vyavacchedena naḥ kāryam sa ced virodha aṅgavati bhavatu tāvatā bhedaḥ sidhyati eva kim no darśana niyama vyavacchettṛ tva graheṇa iti āśaṅkya virodhāt api na vyavacchedaḥ iti āha asati iti anyonya vyavacchinnānām hi bahu tvam bhavati

original: vyavacchedaśca vimatyadhikaraṇabhāvāpanno nādyāpi sidhyati | ato'sati vyavacchede kuto bahutvam ? satyapi bahutve bahutvaikatvayorasati vyavacchede dvitīyasya virodhino'bhāvāt kuto virodhaḥ ? atha vyavacchedāt virodho virodhācca vyavaccheda ityucyate, tathā sati itaretarāśrayatvaṃ syāt | ato virodhādapi vyavacchedo nāstīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: vyavacchedaḥ ca vimati adhikaraṇa bhāva āpannaḥ na adya api sidhyati atas sati vyavacchede kutas bahutvam sati api bahutve bahutva ekatvayoḥ asati vyavacchede dvitīyasya virodhinaḥ bhāvāt kutas virodhaḥ atha vyavacchedāt virodhaḥ virodhāt ca vyavacchedaḥ iti ucyate tathā sati itaretara āśraya tvam syāt atas virodhāt api vyavacchedaḥ na asti iti bhāvaḥ

original: athavā asati vyavacchede kuto bahutvaṃ tadabhāvācca kuto virodha iti yojyam ; tadā ca vāśabdaścārthaṃ | upasaṃharati -- tasmāditi | idānīṃ 'mā na bhūt' iti ślokapādaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- api ceti | ekadarśanabhājāmiti ; ekena citrajñānena gṛhyamāṇānāmityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha -- eketi |
analyzed: athavā asati vyavacchede kutas bahu tvam tad abhāvāt ca kutas virodhaḥ iti yojyam tadā ca vā śabdaḥ ca artham upasaṃharati tasmāt iti idānīm mā na bhūt iti śloka pādam vyācaṣṭe api ca iti eka darśana bhājām iti ekena citra jñānena gṛhyamāṇānām iti arthaḥ kutas iti āha eka iti

original: nīlādīnāmekatra citrajñāne prameyatvena saṃbandhādekatra nīle pīte vā citrajñānasyāniyamāt tanniyatākārajñānasāmarthyānna bhedasiddhirityarthaḥ ; tatra cedanyad bhede pramāṇam, tadeva sarvatra syādityakāraṇaṃ darśanapratiniyama iti bhāvaḥ | evamekavidhirevānyavyavaccheda iti mate niraste bhāvāvyatiriktabhedavādī codayati -- nanviti |
analyzed: nīla ādīnām ekatra citra jñāne prameya tvena saṃbandhāt ekatra nīle pīte vā citra jñānasya aniyamāt tad niyata ākāra jñāna sāmarthyāt na bheda siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ tatra ced anyat bhede pramāṇam tat eva sarvatra syāt iti akāraṇam darśana pratiniyamaḥ iti bhāvaḥ evam eka vidhiḥ eva anya vyavacchedaḥ iti mate niraste bhāva avyatirikta bheda vādī codayati nanu iti

original: prakṛtyaiveti ; svabhāvenetyarthaḥ | tadvidhāniti ; bhinnasvabhāvānityarthaḥ | nanu vyāvṛttirvyāvṛttimato'nyā ; tena vyāvṛttimadvahaṇe'pi na gṛhyata ityāśaṅkyāha -- na hīti | vyāvṛttitadvatoranyatve'navasthā syāt ; ato vyāvṛttisvabhāva eva bhāva iti bhāvaḥ | kimevaṃ sati syādityatrāha -- tatreti | kuta ityāha -- yaditi |
analyzed: prakṛtyā eva iti svabhāvena iti arthaḥ tadvidhān iti bhinna svabhāvān iti arthaḥ nanu vyāvṛttiḥ vyāvṛttimataḥ nyā tena vyāvṛttimat vahaṇe api na gṛhyate iti āśaṅkya āha na hi iti vyāvṛtti tadvatoḥ anyatvena avasthā syāt atas vyāvṛtti svabhāvaḥ eva bhāvaḥ iti bhāvaḥ kim evam sati syāt iti atra āha tatra iti kutas ityāha yat iti

original: vyatirekamāha -- anyatheti ; yo yatsvarūpaḥ sa cet tena svarūpeṇa na pratīyate, tataḥ svarūpāpratītyā pratīta
analyzed: vyatirekam āha anyathā iti yaḥ yad svarūpaḥ sa ced tena svarūpeṇa na pratīyate tatas svarūpa apratītyā pratīta

original: eva na syādityarthaḥ | evaṃ sāmānyena nyāyaṃ vyutpādya prakṛte yojayati— P. 47-14. vyāvṛtteti | yathāyathamiti ; svena svena rūpeṇāsaṃkīrṇena darśaneṣu nirbhāsate yata ityarthaḥ | siddhāntī tvatrāpi pūrvoktadoṣamatidiśannāha—atrāpīti |

original: yadyekaikāśrayo'nyo'nyo bhedaḥ kathaṃ tarhi bhedasyānekāśrayatvaṃ prasiddhaṃ satsyatītyarthaḥ | tatra paraṃ āhuḥ— apekṣāta iti | ekatra vartamāno'pi dvitīyamapekṣata ityanekāśrayatvaṃ bhedasya, na tu naikatra vartamānatvādityarthaḥ | ekatraiva cedvartate bhedaḥ, kathamanyamapekṣate? na hi ghaṭasyaṃ śauktyaṃ paṭhamapekṣata ityāśaṅkyāha—tathā hīti |
analyzed: yadi eka eka āśrayaḥ anyonyaḥ bhedaḥ katham tarhi bhedasya aneka āśraya tvam prasiddham satsyati iti arthaḥ tatra param āhuḥ apekṣātaḥ iti ekatra vartamānaḥ api dvitīyam apekṣate iti aneka āśraya tvam bhedasya na tu na ekatra vartamāna tvāt iti arthaḥ ekatra eva ced vartate bhedaḥ katham anyam apekṣate na hi ghaṭasyam śauktyam paṭham apekṣate iti āśaṅkya āha tathā hi iti

original: bhedo hi kasyacit kutaścidbhavati | ataśca yato bhavati taṃ pratiyoginamapekṣya tasya svarūpaṃ vyavasthitam | tenaikasthasyāpi yuktānyāpekṣetyarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityāha—tathā ceti | tathā ca sati yathāyathaṃ svīyasvīyabhedena pratibhāvaṃ bhinnena pratiyogyapekṣeṇātmabhūtena bhāvāvyatirekiṇā bhinnāḥ sarve bhāvāḥ;
analyzed: bhedaḥ hi kasyacid kutaścid bhavati atas ca yatas bhavati tam pratiyoginam apekṣya tasya svarūpam vyavasthitam tena ekasthasya api yuktā anya apekṣā iti arthaḥ tatas kim iti āha tathā ca iti tathā ca sati yathāyatham svīya svīya bhedena pratibhāvam bhinnena pratiyogi apekṣeṇa ātma bhūtena bhāva a vyatirekiṇā bhinnāḥ sarve bhāvāḥ

original: tena pratibhāvaṃ bhedānyatvāt na tadekatvena bhedavyati rekāt bhedavadbhedināṃ bhedābhāvadoṣaprasaṅga iti tātparyārthaḥ | atra dūṣaṇamucyate—pauruṣeyīmiti | tadyācaṣṭe—puruṣo hīti | puruṣo hyekamarthaṃ mṛtpiṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā paraṃ cakrādyapekṣate, tāvatā ghaṭādikāryasiddheḥ |
analyzed: tena pratibhāvam bheda anyatvāt na tad eka tvena bheda vyati rekāt bheda vat bhedinām bheda abhāva doṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti tātparya arthaḥ atra dūṣaṇam ucyate pauruṣeyīm iti tat yācaṣṭe puruṣaḥ hi iti puruṣaḥ hi ekam artham mṛd piṇḍam gṛhītvā param cakra ādi apekṣate tāvatā ghaṭa ādi kārya siddheḥ

original: bhāvāstu svahetubhyaḥ kenacidrūpeṇa hīnāśredātmānaṃ labheran, tatastadrūpalābhāyānyadapekṣeran; teṣāṃ tu svahetubhyaḥ prāptasaṃpūrṇarūpāṇāṃ kimarthānyāpekṣetyarthaḥ | apara āhuḥ—nanviti | svabhāva eṣa bhedasya, yadekastho'pi dvitīyaṃ pratiyoginamapekṣate; kiṃ kurva ityarthaḥ | nanu śauktyādīnāmayaṃ svabhāvo na dṛṣṭa ityāśaṅkyāha—nāneti | tacce;
analyzed: bhāvāḥ tu sva hetubhyaḥ kenacid rūpeṇa hīnāḥ średa ātmānam labheran tatas tad rūpa lābhāya anyat apekṣeran teṣām tu sva hetubhyaḥ prāpta saṃpūrṇa rūpāṇām kim arthā anya apekṣā iti arthaḥ apare āhuḥ nanu iti svabhāvaḥ eṣa bhedasya yat ekasthaḥ upi dvitīyam pratiyoginam apekṣate kim kurve iti arthaḥ nanu śauktya ādīnām ayam svabhāvaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha nānā iti tat ced

original: svarūpa ityarthaḥ | sādhyakoṭinikṣipto bhedaḥ pratiyogyapakṣitayā sarvajanasiddha iti tamevodāharati— yatheti | atra siddhāntavādyāha—na tarhīni | yadi bhedārupo bhāva-
analyzed: sva rūpe iti arthaḥ sādhya koṭi nikṣiptaḥ bhedaḥ pratiyogi apakṣi tayā sarva jana siddhaḥ iti tam eva udāharati yathā iti atra siddhāntavādī āha tarhi yadi yadi bheda ārupaḥ bhāva

original: svabhāvo'nyamapekṣata na tarhi svahetubhyaḥ saṃpūrṇasvabhāvā bhāvā jātāḥ ; kiṃtu bhedākhyena svabhāvena vikalā ityabhyupeyam ; anyathānyāpekṣānupapatteḥ ; na caitadviṣṭamityarthaḥ | kiṃca bhāvasvabhāvo bhāvahetubhya eva bhāvasamakālameva jāyate, yathāgnerīṣṇyam ;
analyzed: svabhāvaḥ anyam apekṣata na tarhi sva hetubhyaḥ saṃpūrṇa svabhāvāḥ bhāvāḥ jātāḥ kiṃtu bheda ākhyena svabhāvena vikalāḥ iti abhyupeyam anyathā anya apekṣā anupapatteḥ na ca etat viṣṭam iti arthaḥ kiṃca bhāva svabhāvaḥ bhāva hetubhyaḥ eva bhāva sama kālam eva jāyate yathā agneḥ īṣṇyam

original: bhedastu bhāvahetubhyo hetvantarāt pratiyogino bhāve jāte paścājjāyamāno na bhāvasvabhāvaḥ syāt ; ataḥ svabhāvabhūtā bheda P. 49-11. itīyaṃ pratijñā te hīyenetyāha —hetvantarāditi | atra punaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate —syādetaditi | syādetat tvadīyaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ yadi bhedarūpavikalo bhāvaḥ svahetubhyo jāyeta ;
analyzed: bhedaḥ tu bhāva hetubhyaḥ hetu antarāt pratiyoginaḥ bhāve jāte paścāt jāyamānaḥ na bhāva svabhāvaḥ syāt atas svabhāva bhūtāḥ bheda iti iyam pratijñā te hīyena iti āha hetu antarāt iti atra punar pratyavatiṣṭhate syāt etat iti syāt etat tvadīyam dūṣaṇam yadi bheda rūpa vikalaḥ bhāvaḥ sva hetubhyaḥ jāyeta

original: sa tu bhedādibhiḥ sarvarūpairavikalaḥ saṃpūrṇa eva svahetubhyo jāyate | ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ—yadrūpāntarasya pratiyogyanapekṣasvabhāvatvam ; bhedākhyaṃ tu rūpaṃ pratiyogisāpekṣam, yataḥ pratiyogyanapekṣaṃ kadācidapi na dṛṣṭaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | iti hetvarthaḥ | kuta ityāha —tasyeti |
analyzed: sa tu bheda ādibhiḥ sarva rūpaiḥ avikalaḥ saṃpūrṇaḥ eva sva hetubhyaḥ jāyate ayam tu viśeṣaḥ yat rūpa antarasya pratiyogi anapekṣa svabhāva tvam bheda ākhyam tu rūpam pratiyogi sāpekṣam yatas pratiyogi anapekṣam kadācid api na dṛṣṭam bhavati iti arthaḥ iti hetvarthaḥ kutas iti āha tasya iti

original: tasya bhedākhyasya rūpasya tadvidhatvāt pratiyogisāpekṣasvabhāvatvādityarthaḥ | atastena bhedena tadvidhenaiva svabhāvenaiva saha bhāvo jāyata iti hetorna bhedena vikalarūpasya prādurbhāvo janma, yena tvadukto doṣaḥ syādityarthaḥ | atra dūṣaṇamāha —atreti | bhavatu tadvidhasya bhedasahitasyaiva bhāvasya prādurbhāvaḥ ;
analyzed: tasya bheda ākhyasya rūpasya tadvidha tvāt pratiyogi sāpekṣa svabhāva tvāt iti arthaḥ atas tena bhedena tadvidhena eva svabhāvena eva saha bhāvaḥ jāyate iti hetoḥ na bhedena vikala rūpasya prādurbhāvaḥ janma yena tvad uktaḥ doṣaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ atra dūṣaṇam āha atra iti bhavatu tadvidhasya bheda sahitasya eva bhāvasya prādurbhāvaḥ

original: pratiyogyapekṣāyāstu arthaḥ prayojanaṃ vaktavyam ; na ca te tadastīti bhāvaḥ | kuta ityāha —yasya hīti | yadāyattaṃ hi yatra kiṃcidbhavati tat tadapekṣam, anyat tannirapekṣamitīyaṃ sāpekṣanirapekṣayorvyavasthā ; nānyetyarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityāha —tatreti | na tāvadbhedasyotpattiḥ pratiyogyāyattā, yenāsyotpattyarthaṃ bhedastamapekṣata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pratiyogi apekṣāyāḥ tu arthaḥ prayojanam vaktavyam na ca te tat asti iti bhāvaḥ kutas iti āha yasya hi iti yad āyattam hi yatra kiṃcid bhavati tat tad apekṣam anyat tad nirapekṣam iti iyam sāpekṣa nirapekṣayoḥ vyavasthā na anyā iti arthaḥ tatas kim iti āha tatra iti na tāvat bhedasya utpattiḥ pratiyogi āyattā yena asya utpatti artham bhedaḥ tam apekṣate iti arthaḥ

original: kuta ityāha —sveti | svahetubhya evāvikalasya bhedasahitasyaiva bhāvasya prāmutpatterityarthaḥ | athodakāharaṇādyarthakriyā ghaṭādebhedasya pratiyogyāyattetyucyate, tadapi netyāha —neti | kuta ityāha —taditi | paṭādipratiyogyasaṃnidhāne'pi ghaṭasyārthakriyā dṛśyate | sā yadi pratiyogisāpekṣā syāt, tadasaṃnidhāne na syāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kutas iti āha sva iti sva hetubhyaḥ eva avikalasya bheda sahitasya eva bhāvasya prām utpatteḥ iti arthaḥ atha udaka āharaṇa ādi arthakriyā ghaṭa ādeḥ bhedasya pratiyogi āyattā iti ucyate tat api na iti āha na iti kutas iti āha tat iti paṭa ādi pratiyogi asaṃnidhāne api ghaṭasya arthakriyā dṛśyate sā yadi pratiyogi sāpekṣā syāt tad asaṃnidhāne na syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: bhedapratītiḥ pratiyogyāyattetyāśaṅkayati —pratītiriti | etadeva draḍhayati —tathā hīti | yasya yato bhedaḥ pratīyate tatpratiyoginamanapekṣya bhedo na pratīyate yataḥ, atastatpratītiḥ
analyzed: bheda pratītiḥ pratiyogi āyattā iti āśaṅkayati pratītiḥ iti etat eva draḍhayati tathā hi iti yasya yatas bhedaḥ pratīyate tad pratiyoginam an apekṣya bhedaḥ na pratīyate yatas atas tad pratītiḥ

original: pratiyogyāyattetyarthaḥ | evamāśaṅkya dūṣayati—neti | evaṃ cettarhi P. 49-21. bhedākhyo bhāvasvabhāvo na pratiyogyapekṣaḥ ; kiṃtu tasmin bhede pūrvamavasthite bhedākhyasya vastunaḥ sthiteruttarakālā tatpratītiḥ pratiyogisāpekṣetyāpannam | ato bheda eva pratiyogisāpekṣa iti pratijñātaṃ hīyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: pratiyogi āyattā iti arthaḥ evam āśaṅkya dūṣayati na iti evam ced tarhi bheda ākhyaḥ bhāva svabhāvaḥ na pratiyogi apekṣaḥ kiṃtu tasmin bhede pūrvam avasthite bheda ākhyasya vastunaḥ sthiteḥ uttara kālā tad pratītiḥ pratiyogi sāpekṣā iti āpannam atas bhedaḥ eva pratiyogi sāpekṣaḥ iti pratijñātam hīyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: na ca pratītau sāpekṣāyāṃ tatprameyaṃ vastu sāpekṣaṃ syādityatra dṛṣṭāntamāha—yatheti | vyavasthitāśra te sahetubhyo labdhātmānaḥ, ata evānapekṣasvabhāvāśreti vigrahaḥ | vyavasthitau anapekṣaḥ svabhāvo yeṣāmiti vā | nanvastu bhedapratītireva sāpekṣā, tadarthameva svato nirapekṣo'pi bhedaḥ pratiyoginamapekṣiṣyata ityāśaṅkyāha—itaretareti |
analyzed: na ca pratītau sāpekṣāyām tat prameyam vastu sāpekṣam syāt iti atra dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā iti vyavasthitāḥ śra te sa hetubhyaḥ labdha ātmānaḥ atas eva anapekṣa svabhāvāḥ śra iti vigrahaḥ vyavasthitau anapekṣaḥ svabhāvaḥ yeṣām iti vā nanu astu bheda pratītiḥ eva sāpekṣā tad artham eva svatas nirapekṣaḥ api bhedaḥ pratiyoginam apekṣiṣyate iti āśaṅkya āha aitaretara iti

original: yato bhedena pratītādāsya bhedaḥ pratyetavyaḥ, tasyāpi tatastathetītaretarāśrayaḥ | ato bhedasya pratītirapi parasparāyattā itaretarasāpekṣā na ghaṭata ityarthaḥ | nanu vastumātrādagṛhītabhedādbhedaḥ pratyeṣyate ; ato netaretarāśraya ityāśaṅkyāha—na ceti | hetumāha—ekasminniti | yadyevaṃ syāt svato'pi svasya bhedaḥ pratīyeta ;
analyzed: yatas bhedena pratītāt ā asya bhedaḥ pratyetavyaḥ tasya api tatas tathā iti itaretarāśrayaḥ atas bhedasya pratītiḥ api paraspara āyattā itaretara sāpekṣā na ghaṭate iti arthaḥ nanu vastu mātrāt agṛhīta bhedāt bhedaḥ pratyeṣyate atas na itaretarāśrayaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha na ca iti hetum āha ekasmin iti yadi evam syāt svatas api svasya bhedaḥ pratīyeta

original: na caivamastīti bhāvaḥ | prakṛtamupasaṃharati—tasmāditi | asyaivānyā vyākhyā ; tāmāha—neti | hetumāha—apekṣika iti ; pratiyogyapekṣayā yataḥ sa bhedaḥ pratīyata ityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityāha— sa ceti | apekṣā hi puruṣasya pratyayaviśeṣaḥ ; na ca taṃ varatvanuvartate ; na ca puruṣapratyayamanu vastuvyavasthetyarthaḥ | hetumāha—vyavasthiteti |
analyzed: na ca evam asti iti bhāvaḥ prakṛtam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti asya eva anyā vyākhyā tām āha na iti hetum āha apekṣikaḥ iti pratiyogi apekṣayā yatas sa bhedaḥ pratīyate iti arthaḥ tatas kim iti āha sa ca iti apekṣā hi puruṣasya pratyaya viśeṣaḥ na ca tam varatu anuvartate na ca puruṣa pratyayam anu vastu vyavasthā iti arthaḥ hetum āha vyavasthitā iti

original: yathā vastu hi puruṣapratyayo yuktaḥ ; anyathā nirālambanaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | itiḥ ślokārthaparisamāptau | nanu yadyapekṣikaṃ na vastuno rūpam, kathaṃ tarhi pitṛtvādayo vastuno rūpam ? te'pi hyāpekṣikā eva ; na hi te putrādyapekṣayā vinā bhavantītyataste yathāpekṣikā api vastuno rūpaṃ tathā bhedo'pītyabhiprāyeṇa pṛcchati—kathamiti |
analyzed: yathā vastu hi puruṣa pratyayaḥ yuktaḥ anyathā nirālambanaḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ itiḥ śloka artha parisamāptau nanu yadi āpekṣikam na vastunaḥ rūpam katham tarhi pitṛ tva ādayaḥ vastunaḥ rūpam te api hi āpekṣikāḥ eva na hi te putra ādi apekṣayā vinā bhavanti iti atas te yathā āpekṣikāḥ api vastunaḥ rūpam tathā bhedaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa pṛcchati katham iti

original: na ca khapuṣpavadasantaḥ ; na ca gandharvanagarādivadasatyā ityāha—na ceti | astāṃ vyavahāra eva nāsti ; asatyena tu visaṃvādī ; pitṛtvādayastu vyavahārasya hetutvena loke siddhā, sa cāvisaṃvādīti nāsanto nāpyasatyā ityarthaḥ | atrottaramāha—ucyata iti |
analyzed: na ca khapuṣpa vat asantaḥ na ca gandharvanagara ādi vat asatyāḥ iti āha na ca iti vyavahāraḥ eva na asti asatyena tu visaṃvādī pitṛ tva ādayaḥ tu vyavahārasya hetu tvena loke siddhā sa ca avisaṃvādī iti na asantaḥ na api asatyāḥ iti arthaḥ atra uttaram āha ucyate iti

original: yadi pitṛtvādayo'pyapekṣikāḥ, te'pi tarhi bhedavadvastuno rūpaṃ mā bhūvan, asatyā eva santu; kā no hāniḥ? na ca teṣāmavisaṃvādivyavahārahetutvena siddhatvādbhedādviśeṣaḥ; bhedo'pyevamavisaṃvādivyavahārahetutvena pitṛtvādivadvastuvadvā kiṃ na loke siddhaḥ? api tu siddha eva; ato nāyamapi viśeṣa ityarthaḥ | P. 50-6.
analyzed: yadi pitṛ tva ādayaḥ api apekṣikāḥ te api tarhi bheda vat vastunaḥ rūpam mā bhūvan asatyāḥ eva santu kā no hāniḥ na ca teṣām avisaṃvādi vyavahāra hetu tvena siddha tvāt bhedāt viśeṣaḥ bhedaḥ upi evam avisaṃvādi vyavahāra hetu tvena pitṛ tva ādi vat vastu vat vā kim na loke siddhaḥ api tu siddhaḥ eva atas na ayam api viśeṣaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ pitṛtvādibhedaporaviśeṣamuktvā saṃprati viśeṣamāha—api ceti | pitrādau viṣaye putrādyapekṣā jananādinā bhavati | hrasvadīrghayorapyanyonyāpekṣā, ekasyāḥ deśavyāptikriyāyā nyūnādhikabhāvaviśeṣeṇa bhavati | na ca bhede tādṛśo'pekṣāhetuḥ kaścidastīti bhāvaḥ | etadyācaṣṭe—vyavasthite iti |
analyzed: evam pitṛ tva ādi bhedapoḥ aviśeṣam uktvā saṃprati viśeṣam āha api ca iti pitṛ ādau viṣaye putra ādi apekṣā janana ādinā bhavati hrasva dīrghayoḥ api anyonya apekṣā ekasyāḥ deśa vyāpti kriyāyāḥ nyūna adhika bhāva viśeṣeṇa bhavati na ca bhede tādṛśa upekṣā hetuḥ kaścid asti iti bhāvaḥ etat yācaṣṭe vyavasthite iti

original: vyavasthite autpattike anyonyanairapekṣyeṇa sthite, na tu vastusthityuttarakālamanyāpekṣāprabhave pitṛputrayorjanyajanakaśaktī pitṛputrayorabhidheye; yathāsaṃkhyamatrāvivakṣitam | etacca śaktiḥ kārakamityabhipretyoktam | śaktimatkārakamiti pakṣe'pi sarvamūhyam | kathaṃ tarhi tayoranyonyāpekṣitvamityāśaṅkyāha—te tviti |
analyzed: vyavasthite autpattike anyonya nairapekṣyeṇa sthite na tu vastu sthiti uttarakālam anya apekṣā prabhave pitṛ putrayoḥ janya janaka śaktī pitṛ putrayoḥ abhidheye yathā saṃkhyam atra avivakṣitam etat ca śaktiḥ kārakam iti abhipretya uktam śaktimat kārakam iti pakṣe api sarvam ūhyam katham tarhi tayoḥ anyonya apekṣi tvam iti āśaṅkya āhate tu iti

original: janyajanakayoḥ kartṛkarmakārakaśaktī samānaśrāptau jananākhyo vyāpārastadviṣaye sati tā pitṛputraśabdau āskandataḥ viṣayīkurutaḥ | te vā śaktī kartṛbhūte tau śabdau karmabhūtau āskandataḥ svavācakatvena svīkuruta ityarthaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati—yadaikasyāṃ jananakriyāyāmekaḥ puruṣaḥ kartā, aparaḥ karma, tadā tau pitṛputraśabdavācyau bhavataḥ;
analyzed: janya janakayoḥ kartṛ karma kāraka śaktī samāna śrāptau janana ākhyaḥ vyāpāraḥ tad viṣaye sati tā pitṛ putra śabdau āskandataḥ viṣayīkurutaḥ te vā śaktī kartṛ bhūte tau śabdau karma bhūtau āskandataḥ sva vācaka tvena svīkurutaḥ iti arthaḥ etat uktam bhavati yadā ekasyām janana kriyāyām ekaḥ puruṣaḥ kartā aparaḥ karma tadā tau pitṛ putra śabda vācyau bhavataḥ

original: nānyatheti | kutaḥ? svabhāvabhedāt; īdṛśa eva tayoḥ śabdayoḥ svabhāvaviśeṣo yenedṛśa eva viṣaye vartate, netaratretyarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityāha—ata iti | samānatvaṃ hi kriyāyā dvayorbhavati; ato yasya kriyā yena samānā tasya tatrāpekṣā bhavatītyarthaḥ | uktamarthaṃ prakṛtopayogitayā spaṣṭayati—etaditi |

original: pitṛputraśabdayorarthastatra pitrādau sāpekṣaḥ, na tu janyajanakaśaktyākhyaṃ vastu; tattu pūrvaṃ vyavasthitamevetyuktam | etaduktaṃ bhavati—yadā janyena samānajanikriyo janako bhavati, tadā pitṛśabdārtho bhavati; nānyadā | ataśca yena sā kriyā samānā tajjanyamepakṣya janakaḥ pitṛśabdārtho jāta iti śabdārthaḥ sāpekṣa ityucyate | ataḥ śabdamatraṃ

original: tvatra sāpekṣaṃ na vastviti | apekṣāhetuśca tatra pivādau sādhāraṇī janakakriyā vidyate, yadyapi janyajanakaśaktyākhyavastunī vyavasthite anyonyanirapekṣe ityarthaḥ | na dvitīyena vinā sādhāraṇyaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | bhedetu vaiṣamyamāha—bhāveti | vastutattvagata iti; na śabdagata ityarthaḥ; tena P. 50-12. vastveva tatra sāpekṣamiti bhāvaḥ |

original: hastādāvapi yadvastu yāvatparimāṇaṃ tattāvatparimāṇamanyanirapekṣameva svahetubhyo jātam | śabdapravṛttimātraṃ tu sāpekṣam; apekṣāhetuścaikajātīyāyā deśavyāptikriyāyā nyūnādhikabhāvaḥ; yadapekṣayā yasya deśavyāptikriyādhikā tat tato dīrghamityucyate; yā yasyonā taddhastvamiti | yā yāvaddeśaikasya vyāptiḥ, anyasya na tāvaddeśātadūnam;

original: itaradadhikamiti nyūnādhikavivekaḥ; tena nyūnādhikayoranyonyāpekṣitādoṣo nāsti | yadi jananakāryaviśeṣāt pitrādāvapekṣā iṣyate, vastubhedo'pi tarhi kāryasyaiva bhedādiṣyatāmiti paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate—yadīti | kiṃca evaṃ sati yadyapi pratyakṣaṃ vastuvidhimātravyāpāraṃ na vyavacchinati na tadbhede pramāṇam, tathāpi kāryabhedādanumāsyāmahe;
analyzed: itarat adhikam iti nyūna adhika vivekaḥ tena nyūna adhikayoḥ anyonya apekṣita ādoṣaḥ na asti yadi janana kārya viśeṣāt pitṛ ādau apekṣā iṣyate vastu bhedaḥ upi tarhi kāryasya eva bhedāt iṣyatām iti paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate yadi iti kiṃca evam sati yadi api pratyakṣam vastu vidhi mātra vyāpāram na vyavacchinati na tad bhede pramāṇam tathā api kārya bhedāt anumāsyāmahe

original: ato na bhedasyāpramāṇatvamapītyāha— kiṃceti | vidhimātramanyavyavacchedarahitaṃ vyāpāro yasyeti vigrahaḥ | vipakṣādavyāvṛttau heturagamaka iti tato vyāvṛttimāha—naikatva iti | anvayastvadvaitinaṃ pratyasiddho na ca bauddhairiṣṭa iti nokta ityadoṣaḥ | atra hetumāha—kāraṇeti | tadvivṛṇoti—taditi | siddhāntī tu kāryabhedo'pyasmākamasiddhaḥ;
analyzed: atas na bhedasya apramāṇa tvam api iti āha kiṃca iti vidhi mātram anya vyavaccheda rahitam vyāpāraḥ yasya iti vigrahaḥ vipakṣāt avyāvṛttau hetuḥ agamakaḥ iti tatas vyāvṛttim āha na ekatve iti anvayaḥ tu advaitinam prati asiddhaḥ na ca bauddhaiḥ iṣṭaḥ iti na uktaḥ iti adoṣaḥ atra hetum āha kāraṇa iti tat vivṛṇoti tat iti siddhāntī tu kārya bhedaḥ upi asmākam asiddhaḥ

original: atastena na bhāvabhedānumānam | naikasyāneke svabhāvāḥ, tadbhede bhedaprasaṅgāditi bhedāt bhedaprasādhanamaśobhanamityāha—tadidamiti | yadapyuktaṃ kāraṇaikatve kāryabhedo nāvakalpata iti, tadapyuktam, ekatve'pi tadarśanādityāha—api ceti | dāhādikāryabhedāt 'dāhakaḥ pācakaḥ' iti vyapadeśamātraṃ bhidyate, na tu vastvityarthaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam |
analyzed: atas tena na bhāva bheda anumānam na ekasya aneke svabhāvāḥ tad bhede bheda prasaṅgāt iti bhedāt bheda prasādhanam aśobhanam iti āha tat idam iti yat api uktam kāraṇa ekatve kārya bhedaḥ na avakalpate iti tat api uktam ekatve pi tad darśanāt iti āha api ca iti dāha ādi kārya bhedāt dāhakaḥ pācakaḥ iti vyapadeśa mātram bhidyate na tu vastu iti arthaḥ śeṣam sugamam

original: arthakriyākṛte bhede aṅgīkriyamāṇa ityanvayaḥ | nanvalāpi rūpādisamudāyamātraṃ vahniḥ; na tvavayavyeko bhinno'bhinno vā saṃbhavati; ato rūpādiguṇabhedādeva kāryabheda ityāśaṅkayati—atheti | siddhāntī tu bhavatvevam; tathā- 10
analyzed: arthakriyā kṛte bhede aṅgīkriyamāṇe iti anvayaḥ rūpa ādi samudāya mātram vahniḥ na tu avayavī ekaḥ bhinnaḥ bhinnaḥ vā saṃbhavati atas rūpa ādi guṇa bhedāt eva kārya bhedaḥ iti āśaṅkayati atha iti siddhāntī tu bhavatu evam tathā

original: pyuṣṇasparśāttāvadekasādāhapākakāryabhedo'sti ; ato P. 51-1. vipakṣādavyāvṛttirhetostadavasthaivetyāha—kāmamiti | na ca pākadāhayorbhedo'siddha iti vācyamityāha— tau ceti | yadyapi vahnisaṃyogavikriyā pāko'pīti tadvikriyātvasāmānyamubhayatrāpyekamasti, tathāpyavāntarabhedastayorlokaprasiddhatvānnāpalapanīya ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pi uṣṇa sparśāt tāvat eka sā dāha pāka kārya bhedaḥ usti atas vipakṣāt avyāvṛttiḥ hetoḥ tad avasthā eva iti āha kāmam iti na ca pāka dāhayoḥ bhedaḥ usiddhaḥ iti vācyam iti āha tau ca iti yadi api vahni saṃyoga vikriyā pākaḥ upi iti tad vikriyā tva sāmānyam ubhayatra api ekam asti tathā api avāntarabhedaḥ tayoḥ loka prasiddha tvāt na apalapanīyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: na kevalaṃ lokasiddhamekasāt kāryabhinnatvam, api tu vādibhirapi sarvairidamiṣṭamityāha—karmeti | muktasyeṣorgatikarma pūrvāparadeśābhyāṃ vibhāgasaṃyogayorvegākhyasya saṃskārasya heturasamavāyikāraṇam ; ātmā cecchāsukhādīnāṃ hetuḥ samavāyikāraṇamiti kaṇabhujeṣṭam |
analyzed: na kevalam loka siddham ekasāt kārya bhinna tvam api tu vādibhiḥ api sarvaiḥ idam iṣṭam iti āha karma iti muktasya iṣoḥ gati karma pūrva apara deśābhyām vibhāga saṃyogayoḥ vega ākhyasya saṃskārasya hetuḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam ātmā ca icchā sukha ādīnām hetuḥ samavāyi kāraṇam iti kaṇabhuja iṣṭam

original: tathā saccādayaḥ pratyekamabhedā avidyamānabhedāṃśā aṅgalādhavārthaprakāśādīnāṃ hetava iti yojyam | kvacidabhedāditi pāṭhaḥ ; tatrāyamarthaḥ—na ca te bhinnā iti vācyam ; kutaḥ ? pratyekaṃ sattvarajastamasāmabhedāt | ataścaikasādapi kāryabhedo'stīti bhāvaḥ | tatra sattvaṃ lādhavādīnām, rajaḥ pravṛttiduḥkhānāṃ heturiti kapilasyeṣṭam |
analyzed: tathā sat ca ādayaḥ pratyekam abhedāḥ avidyamāna bheda aṃśāḥ aṅga lādhava artha prakāśa ādīnām hetavaḥ iti yojyam kvacid abhedāt iti pāṭhaḥ tatra ayam arthaḥ na ca te bhinnāḥ iti vācyam kutas pratyekam sattva rajaḥ tamasām abhedāt atas ca eka sāt api kārya bhedaḥ usti iti bhāvaḥ tatra sattvam lādhava ādīnām rajaḥ pravṛtti duḥkhānām hetuḥ iti kapilasya iṣṭam

original: tathā rūpādayaḥ pratyekaṃ svagocarāṇāṃ jñānānāṃ hetava ālambanapratyayāḥ rūpaṃ rūpakṣaṇānāṃ raso rasakṣaṇānāṃ copādānapratyaya iti bauddhamatam | nanu nārthakriyābhedamātrāt bhāvabhedaṃ brūmaḥ ; api tu yato yasya bhedaḥ, tatrādṛṣṭatvenāsaṃbhāvanī yārthakriyā, tata iti paraśrodayati—nanviti | atraivodāharaṇamāha—yatheti |
analyzed: tathā rūpa ādayaḥ pratyekam sva gocarāṇām jñānānām hetavaḥ ālambana pratyayāḥ rūpam rūpa kṣaṇānām rasaḥ rasa kṣaṇānām ca upādāna pratyayaḥ iti bauddha matam nanu na arthakriyā bheda mātrāt bhāva bhedam brūmaḥ api tu yatas yasya bhedaḥ tatra adṛṣṭa tvena asaṃbhāvanī yā arthakriyā tatas iti paraśrodayati nanu iti atra eva udāharaṇam āha yathā iti

original: yathā badhire satyapi cakṣuṣi śabdabuddhiradṛṣṭatvenāsaṃbhāvanī ; tataścakṣuṣo bhinnaṃ śrotraṃ kalpyata ityarthaḥ | nanvevamanyatra kathaṃ bhedasiddhirityāśaṅkyāha—prāyeṇeti | parasparāsaṃbhavīni kāryāṇi yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ ; sarvatraiva prāyeṇānyakāryamanyatra na dṛśyate ; ato bhedasiddhirityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yathā badhire sati api cakṣuṣi śabda buddhiḥ adṛṣṭa tvena asaṃbhāvanī tatas cakṣuṣaḥ bhinnam śrotram kalpyate iti arthaḥ nanu evam anyatra katham bheda siddhiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha prāyeṇa iti paraspara asaṃbhavīni kāryāṇi yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ sarvatra eva prāyeṇa anya kāryam anyatra na dṛśyate atas bheda siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: śaraśṛṅgayorviśaraṇaikakāryayornivṛttyarthaṃ prāyagrahaṇam | kathaṃ tarhi tayorbheda ityāśaṅkya viśaraṇaikakāryatve'pi prāyeṇa parasparāsaṃbhavīni kāryāntarāṇi tayorapi sannīti prāyeṇeti punaryojyam | siddhāntī tvāha— atheti ; anyakāryasyānyatrāsaṃbhavaḥ kathaṃ pratyetavya ityarthaḥ | para āha— nanviti | taddūṣayati—neti |
analyzed: śara śṛṅgayoḥ viśaraṇa eka kāryayoḥ nivṛtti artham prāya grahaṇam katham tarhi tayoḥ bhedaḥ iti āśaṅkya viśaraṇa eka kārya tve pi prāyeṇa paraspara asaṃbhavīni kārya antarāṇi tayoḥ api sanni iti prāyeṇa iti punar yojyam siddhāntī tu āha atha iti anya kāryasya anyatra asaṃbhavaḥ katham pratyetavyaḥ iti arthaḥ paraḥ āha nanu iti tat dūṣayati na iti

original: advaitināmekatraiva sarvaṃ kāryaṃ dṛśyate ; ato nānyakāryasyānyatrādarśanamasti | tatra sati bhede anyakāryamanyatra na dṛśyata iti vācyam | evaṃ ca bhede sati kāryādarśanam, adarśane sati bheda itītaretarāśrayaḥ syāt | ato na kāryabhedāt bhāvabhedānumānamityarthaḥ | atha satyapi paṭhe ghaṭakāryasyādṛṣṭasya paścāttaddheto-
analyzed: advaitinām ekatra eva sarvam kāryam dṛśyate atas na anya kāryasya anyatra adarśanam asti tatra sati bhede anya kāryam anyatra na dṛśyate iti vācyam evam ca bhede sati kārya adarśanam adarśane sati bhedaḥ iti itaretara āśrayaḥ syāt atas na kārya bhedāt bhāva bheda anumānam iti arthaḥ atha sati api paṭhe ghaṭa kāryasya adṛṣṭasya paścāt tad hetoḥ

original: ghaṭasya bhedo'numīyate ; tayorabhede hi paṭhakāryavat ghaṭakāryamapi pūrvameva dṛśyeteti paramatamāśaṅkayati—atheti | taddūṣayati—taditi | ekasyāpi P. 51-10 puruṣasya krameṇānekabhojanādyarthakriyāṃ kurvataḥ pūrvamadṛṣṭā kriyā paścādṛśyate ; na ca tasya bheda ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: ghaṭasya bhedaḥ anumīyate tayoḥ abhede hi paṭha kārya vat ghaṭa kāryam api pūrvam eva dṛśyeta iti paramatam āśaṅkayati atha iti tat dūṣayati tat iti ekasya api puruṣasya krameṇa aneka bhojana ādi arthakriyām kurvataḥ pūrvam adṛṣṭā kriyā paścāt dṛśyate na ca tasya bhedaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanvatyantamabhede puruṣasya tasya sarvārthakriyāsamarthatvāt samarthasya ca kṣepāyogāt yugapat sarvakāryadarśanaṃ syāt ; ataḥ kasyacit kāryasya pūrvamadarśanaṃ paścācca darśanaṃ pūrvāvasthāto'viśeṣānna syāt ; ato'sti pūrvasāt kaścidviśeṣo yadāgame pūrvamadṛṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ paścāt dṛśyate ; ato naikāntena bhedaḥ, nāpyabheda ityāśaṅkayati—syāditi |
analyzed: nanu atyantam abhede puruṣasya tasya sarva artha kriyā samartha tvāt samarthasya ca kṣepa ayogāt yugapad sarva kārya darśanam syāt atas kasyacid kāryasya pūrvam adarśanam paścāt ca darśanam pūrva avasthātaḥ viśeṣāt na syāt atas sti pūrvasāt kaścid viśeṣaḥ yat āgame pūrvam adṛṣṭam kāryam paścāt dṛśyate atas na ekāntena bhedaḥ na api abhedaḥ iti āśaṅkayati syāt iti

original: atrottaramāha—na tarhīti | yadi viśeṣamātrabhede'pi kāryabhedo ghaṭate, na tarhi kāryabhedo vastvabhedaṃ bādhate ; kiṃtu kāryabhedāt vastvabhedānupamadena viśeṣamātrabhedo'numīyeta, abhinne'pi vastuni tāvataiva kāryabhedopapatteḥ | ato yaduktaṃ kāryabhedādvastubheda iti tadevaṃ sati vighaṭitamityabhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: atra uttaram āha na tarhi iti yadi viśeṣa mātra bhede api kārya bhedaḥ ghaṭate na tarhi kārya bhedaḥ vastu abhedam bādhate kiṃtu kārya bhedāt vastu abheda anupamadena viśeṣa mātra bhedaḥ unumīyeta abhinne api vastuni tāvatā eva kārya bheda upapatteḥ atas yat uktam kārya bhedāt vastu bhedaḥ iti tat evam sati vighaṭitam iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: nanu viśeṣamātrabhede'pi nādvaitasiddhirityāśaṅkyāha—tacceti | satyaṃ viśeṣamātraṃ bhinnamicchāmaḥ ; kiṃtu na tastatyam ; api tu kālpanikam ; taccāvastutvānna dvatamāvahatīti bhāvaḥ | nanu satyameva tat kiṃ na syādityāśaṅkyāha—vastviti | vastuvṛttyā satastasya viśeṣamātrasyāyogādaghaṭamānatvādityarthaḥ | tatra hetumāha—tacceti |
analyzed: nanu viśeṣa mātra bhede pi na advaita siddhiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha tat ca iti satyam viśeṣa mātram bhinnam icchāmaḥ kiṃtu na api tu kālpanikam tat ca avastu tvāt na āvahati iti bhāvaḥ nanu satyam eva tat kim na syāt iti āśaṅkya āha vastu iti vastu vṛttyā sataḥ tasya viśeṣa mātrasya ayogāt aghaṭamāna tvāt iti arthaḥ tatra hetum āha tat ca iti

original: tadbhāvastaccam abhinnatvam ; vastuto viśeṣāṇāṃ bhinnatvābhinnatvayorasaṃbhavādityarthaḥ | te cedvastuno na bhinnāḥ, tato vastveva param ; na te pṛthak santi | atha bhinnāḥ, na tarhi vastunaḥ, asaṃbandhāt | na hi bhinnayostādātmyamarbudahemanayorāva | nāpi samavāyaḥ ; so'pi hi samavāyibhyāṃ bhinno'bhinno vā syāt ; yadyabhinnaḥ, na pṛthagasti ;
analyzed: tad bhāvaḥ taccam abhinnatvam vastutaḥ viśeṣāṇām bhinnatva abhinnatvayoḥ asaṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ te ced vastunaḥ na bhinnāḥ tatas vastu eva param na te pṛthak santi atha bhinnāḥ na tarhi vastunaḥ asaṃbandhāt na hi bhinnayoḥ tādātmyam arbuda hemanayoḥ āva nā api samavāyaḥ saḥ api hi samavāyibhyām bhinnaḥ bhinnaḥ vā syāt yadi abhinnaḥ na pṛthak asti

original: bhinnaścet, na tayoḥ syāt, asaṃbandhāt ; tasyāpi tābhyāṃ samavāyāntarakalpane cānavasthā | bhinno'pi samavāyastābhyāṃ svata eva saṃbandhaścet tāveva tathā stām ; kiṃ tena ? asaṃbandho hi saṃbandhamapekṣate, na saṃbandhaḥ, pradīpa iva pradīpāntaramiti cenna ; samavāyinorasau saṃbandho nātmanaḥ ;
analyzed: bhinnaḥ ced na tayoḥ syāt asaṃbandhāt tasya api tābhyām samavāya antara kalpane ca anavasthā bhinnaḥ api samavāyaḥ tābhyām svatas eva saṃbandhaḥ ced tau eva tathā stām kim tena asaṃbandhaḥ hi saṃbandham apekṣate na saṃbandhaḥ pradīpaḥ iva pradīpa antaram iti ced na samavāyinoḥ asau saṃbandhaḥ na ātmanaḥ

original: tenātmanaḥ samavāyibhyāṃ saṃbandhāya samavāyāntarāpekṣā yukteti yuktānavasthā | pradīpopekṣataṃ cakṣuritaravatpradīpamapyupalambhayatīti yuktā tatra pradīpāntarānapekṣeti | kiṃca saṃbandhaścetsaṃbandhāntaraṃ nāpekṣate, 104
analyzed: tena ātmanaḥ samavāyibhyām saṃbandhāya samavāya antara apekṣā yuktā iti yuktā anavasthā cakṣuḥ itara vat pradīpam api upalambhayati iti yuktā tatra pradīpa antara anapekṣā iti kiṃca saṃbandhaḥ ced saṃbandha antaram na apekṣate

original: saṃyogo'pi nāpekṣeta samavāyam ; nacaivaṃ vaiṣamyam | kiṃca samavāyaḥ svasaṃbandhibhyāṃ samavāyenānyena saṃbadhyate, saṃbandhatvāt, saṃyogavat | evaṃ so'pyanenetyanavasthā | kiṃca iha pratyayahetuḥ samavāyaḥ ; na ca gotvādiṣvihapratyayo'sti | na hi 'iha gavi gauḥ' iti pratyayaḥ, api tu 'gaurayam' iti sarveṣām |
analyzed: saṃyogaḥ upi nā apekṣeta samavāyam na ca evam vaiṣamyam kiṃca samavāyaḥ sva saṃbandhibhyām samavāyena anyena saṃbadhyate saṃbandha tvāt saṃyoga vat evam saḥ api anena iti anavasthā kiṃca iha pratyaya hetuḥ samavāyaḥ na ca go tva ādiṣu iha pratyayaḥ asti na hi iha gavi gauḥ iti pratyayaḥ api tu gauḥ ayam iti sarveṣām

original: ataḥ samavāyo nāstīti na so'pi vastuviśeṣayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ | nāpi saṃyogaḥ | so'pi hi saṃyogibhyāmabhinnaśretrāsti ; bhinnaśret kena tābhyāṃ saṃbadhyeta ? samavāyeneti cet, sa nirastaḥ | na ca svatantraḥ saṃbhavati | tasmāt so'pi nāsti | tena saṃyogo'pi na vastuviśeṣayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ | ato vastuno bhinno'pi viśeṣo na bhavatīti sūktam |
analyzed: atas samavāyaḥ na asti iti na saḥ api vastu viśeṣayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ na api saṃyogaḥ saḥ upi hi saṃyogibhyām abhinna śretrā asti bhinna śret kena tābhyām saṃbadhyeta samavāyena iti ced sa nirastaḥ na ca svatantraḥ saṃbhavati tasmāt saḥ api na asti tena saṃyogaḥ upi na vastu viśeṣayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ atas vastunaḥ bhinnaḥ api viśeṣaḥ na bhavati iti su uktam

original: evaṃ vastvekatve'pi kālpanikaviśeṣamātrabhedāt kāryabhedaṃ sthiravādinaḥ P. 51-15 pratyāpādya kṣaṇikavādinaṃ prati viśeṣeṇa tamāha—yastviti | tuśabdo viśeṣārthaḥ |
analyzed: evam vastu ekatve api kālpanika viśeṣa mātra bhedāt kārya bhedam sthira vādinaḥ pratyāpādya kṣaṇika vādinam prati viśeṣeṇa tam āha yaḥ tu iti tuśabdaḥ viśeṣa arthaḥ

original: yastu kṣaṇikatvavādī taccamevābhedameva saccādyātmanā viśeṣasya na manyate—viśeṣā evātyantavilakṣaṇāḥ kṣaṇikaṃ vastu, na tvekajātyādi sthāyi kiñcidastīti manvānaḥ—tasya kāraṇasvabhāvānuvartī kāryasvabhāva iti vrīhikṣaṇānāṃ tatsāmānyarūpeṇāsatyabhede tebhyaḥ kathamekarūpavrīhyakurākhyakāryotpādaḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ tu kṣaṇikatva vādī sat ca ādi ātmanā viśeṣasya na manyate viśeṣāḥ eva atyanta vilakṣaṇāḥ kṣaṇikam vastu na tu eka jāti ādi sthāyi kiñcid asti iti manvānaḥ tasya kāraṇa svabhāva anuvartī kārya svabhāvaḥ iti vrīhi kṣaṇānām tad sāmānya rūpeṇa asati abhede tebhyaḥ katham eka rūpa vrīhi akura ākhya kārya utpādaḥ

original: athātyantabhinnānāmapi teṣāṃ kalpitājjātirūpeṇābhedāt kāryatulyatācyate, evaṃ tarhi kāraṇaikatve'pi kalpitādeva bhedāt kāryabhedasiddheḥ kāryabhedasiddhaye kāraṇabhedakalpanā gurvī dṛṣṭaivetyarthaḥ | niranvayo vināśo yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ | kṣaṇikavādināṃ ghaṭanāśe ghaṭatvasya ghaṭāntare mṛdaśra svakapālādāvanvayo nāstīti niranvaya ityucyate |
analyzed: atha atyanta bhinnānām api teṣām kalpitāt jāti rūpeṇa abhedāt kārya tulya tā ācyate evam tarhi kāraṇa ekatve pi kalpitāt eva bhedāt kārya bheda siddheḥ kārya bheda siddhaye kāraṇa bheda kalpanā gurvī dṛṣṭā eva iti arthaḥ niranvayaḥ vināśaḥ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ kṣaṇika vādinām ghaṭa nāśe ghaṭa tvasya ghaṭa antare mṛdaḥ śra sva kapāla ādau anvayaḥ na asti iti niranvayaḥ iti ucyate

original: atha bhinnebhyo'pi cakṣurviṣayasamanantarapratyayebhya ekajñānotpatterna kāryābhedāya kāraṇābhedo'pekṣyate, tenātyantabhinnebhyo'pi kṣaṇebhyastulyarūpaṃ kāryamutpattyata ityucyate, tathā sati kāryasvabhāvasya kāraṇasvabhāvānuvartitvavyabhicārāt yathā bhinnādapyekarūpaṃ kāryaṃ tathaikasmādapi kāryabhedopapatterna kāryabhedasiddhaye kāraṇabhedaḥ
analyzed: atha bhinnebhyaḥ api cakṣuḥ viṣaya samanantara pratyayebhyaḥ eka jñāna utpatteḥ na kārya abhedāya kāraṇa abhedā upekṣyate tena atyanta bhinnebhyaḥ api kṣaṇebhyaḥ tulya rūpam kāryam utpattyataḥ iti ucyate tathā sati kārya svabhāvasya kāraṇa svabhāva anuvarti tva vyabhicārāt yathā bhinnāt api eka rūpam kāryam tathā ekasmāt api kārya bheda upapatteḥ na kārya bheda siddhaye kāraṇa bhedaḥ

original: kalpyaḥ ; tadetadāha—atheti | yadapi bhinnānāmekakāryatve cakṣurādyudāhataṃ tadapi tasyaivāsiddham ; tathāhi—cakṣuṣo rūpagrahaṇaniyame, samanantarajñānasya jñānātmatve, viṣayasya ca tadākāratve vyāpāra iti vadata
analyzed: kalpyaḥ tat etat āha atha iti yat api bhinnānām eka kārya tve cakṣuḥ ādi udāhatam tat api tasya eva asiddham tathā hi cakṣuṣaḥ rūpa grahaṇa niyame samanantara jñānasya jñāna ātma tve viṣayasya ca tad ākāra tve vyāpāraḥ iti vadata

original: cakṣurādikāraṇavyāpārāṇāṃ bhinno viṣayastenaivoktaḥ; tasmānna tatrāpi kāryabheda ityāha—api ceti | kāryasāmyasya kāraṇābhedānapekṣatve doṣāntaramāha— P. 51-21. yadi ceti | tarhi brīhyaṅkurānmṛtpracchannasya brīheranumānaṃ na syādityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha—bhinneti; yavakṣaṇādapi brīhyaṅkurasyotpattisaṃbhavādityarthaḥ | etadevopapādayati—hetviti |
analyzed: cakṣuḥ ādi kāraṇa vyāpārāṇām bhinnaḥ viṣayaḥ tena eva uktaḥ tasmāt na tatra api kārya bhedaḥ iti āha api ca iti kārya sāmyasya kāraṇa abheda anapekṣa tve doṣa antaram āha yadi ca iti tarhi brīhi aṅkurāt mṛd pracchannasya brīheḥ anumānam na syāt iti arthaḥ kutas iti āha bhinna iti yava kṣaṇāt api brīhi aṅkurasya utpatti saṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ etat eva upapādayati hetu iti

original: kāryasāmye hetusāmye cennopayujyate, tato yayaikasādvīhikṣaṇādatyantabhinnādvīhikṣaṇāntarāt brīhyaṅkuro bhavati tathā yavakṣaṇādapi syāt, abhedakalpanāṃ vinā tayoraviśeṣāditi bhāvaḥ | tatrāvaśyaṃ kāryasāmyāya hetvabhedakalpanā tvayāpyāstheyeti tulyatvamāvayorityuktaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati—tatreti | atra paraśrodayati—syāditi |
analyzed: kārya sāmye hetu sāmye ced na upayujyate tatas yayā ekasāt vīhi kṣaṇāt atyanta bhinnāt vīhi kṣaṇa antarāt brīhi aṅkuraḥ bhavati tathā yava kṣaṇāt api syāt abheda kalpanām vinā tayoḥ aviśeṣāt iti bhāvaḥ tatra avaśyam kārya sāmyāya hetu abheda kalpanā tvayā api āstheyā iti tulya tvam āvayoḥ iti uktam pratiṣṭhāpayati tatra iti atra syāt iti

original: yadarthakriyākāri, tat sat; netaracca śaśaśṛṅgādi | bhedo'pi cedarthakriyāhetuḥ, na tarhi kalpitaḥ; kiṃtu sannevetyarthaḥ | siddhānto tvāha—tulyamiti | abhedo'pi tava kāryatulyatvaheturna kalpitaḥ syādityarthaḥ | atha mataṃ nārthakriyābhedamātrādvastubhedaṃ brūmaḥ; kiṃtu viruddhārthakriyābhedāt; na hyasāvekatra saṃbhavati; tadāha—yo'pīti |
analyzed: yat arthakriyā kāri tat sat na itarat ca śaśa śṛṅga ādi bhedaḥ upi ced arthakriyā hetuḥ na tarhi kalpitaḥ kiṃtu san eva iti arthaḥ tvā āha tulyam iti abhedaḥ upi tava kārya tulya tva hetuḥ na kalpitaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ atha matam na arthakriyā bheda mātrāt vastu bhedam brūmaḥ kiṃtu viruddha arthakriyā bhedāt na hi asau ekatra saṃbhavati tat āha yaḥ upi iti

original: etadeva prapañcayati—tathā heti | tasyottaramāha—tasyāpīti | nanu viruddhārthakriyābhedādbhāvabheda uktaḥ; na ca dāhapākau viruddhau; ataḥ kathamidamuttaramityabhiprāyeṇa pṛcchati—kathamiti | siddhānto tvasyottaratvamupapādayati—idamiti | yadi tāvadekatra jananamaraṇādīnāmasaṃbhavo virodhaśabdasyārthaḥ, so'dvaitināmasmākamasiddhaḥ;
analyzed: etat eva prapañcayati tathā ha iti tasya uttaram āha tasya api iti nanu viruddha artha kriyā bhedāt bhāva bhedaḥ uktaḥ na ca dāha pākau viruddhau atas katham idam uttaram iti abhiprāyeṇa pṛcchati katham iti tvasya uttara tvam upapādayati idam iti yadi tāvat ekatra janana maraṇa ādīnām asaṃbhavaḥ virodha śabdasya arthaḥ sa udvaitinām asmākam asiddhaḥ

original: asmākaṃ hi viruddhaṃ ca sarvamekatrātmani samavetam | atha mitho vyavacchinnatā virodhaḥ, jananamaraṇādayaśca tathetyucyate, tato'nyato vastubhedasiddhiḥ | ekasyāpi vahermitho vyavacchinnayordāhapākayordarśanādityarthaḥ | na ca tayormitho vyavacchinnatvamasiddham, nānātvena tasmiddheḥ |
analyzed: asmākam hi viruddham ca sarvam ekatra ātmani samavetam atha mithas vyavacchinna tā virodhaḥ janana maraṇa ādayaḥ ca tathā iti ucyate tatas nyatas vastu bheda siddhiḥ ekasya api vaheḥ mithas vyavacchinnayoḥ dāha pākayoḥ darśanāt iti arthaḥ na ca tayoḥ mithas vyavacchinna tvam asiddham nānātvena

original: atastathābhūtāccedvastubhedaḥ, tato'nekarūparasādiṣarmakapṛthivyādyapi naikaṃ syādityarthaḥ | atha harṣaḥ śokābhāvātmakaḥ, śokaśca harṣābhāvātmaka ityayamanayorvirodhaḥ; tatra tau cedekatra yugapat syātām, tataḥ śokasya bhāvaḥ, tadabhāvātmakasya harṣasya bhāvāccābhāvaḥ; tathā harṣasyāpi bhāvaḥ, harṣābhāvātmakasya śokasya bhāvāccābhāvaḥ;
analyzed: atas tathābhūtāt ced vastu bhedaḥ tatas aneka rūpa rasa ādi ṣarmaka pṛthivī ādi api na ekam syāt iti arthaḥ atha harṣaḥ śoka abhāva ātmakaḥ śokaḥ ca harṣa abhāva ātmakaḥ iti ayam anayoḥ virodhaḥ tatra tau ced ekatra yugapad syātām tatas śokasya bhāvaḥ tad abhāva ātmakasya harṣasya bhāvāt ca abhāvaḥ tathā harṣasya api bhāvaḥ harṣa abhāva ātmakasya śokasya bhāvāt ca abhāvaḥ

original: na caikatraikasyaikadā bhāvābhāvau saṃbhavataḥ;
analyzed: na ca ekatra ekasya ekadā bhāva abhāvau saṃbhavataḥ

original: atastayorīdṛśādvirodhāt tadāśrayamūtabhāvabhedo'vasīyate ; evaṃ jananādibhyo'pīti cet ; tadasat ; evaṃ hi parasparābhāvātmakatvāddharmaveva bhāvarūpī na staḥ ; kutastayorvirodhādbhāvabhedāvagatiḥ ? tathā khaṇḍapādiṣu P.52-13. harṣaśokayorabhāvādanyonyābhāvātmakayostayoḥ prasaṅgaḥ | tadetatsarvamāha—atheti |
analyzed: atas tayoḥ īdṛśāt virodhāt evam janana ādibhyaḥ api iti ced tat asat evam hi paraspara abhāva ātmaka tvāt dharmau eva bhāva rūpī na staḥ kutas tayoḥ virodhāt bhāva bheda avagatiḥ tathā harṣa śokayoḥ abhāvāt anyonya abhāva ātmakayoḥ tayoḥ prasaṅgaḥ tat etat sarvam āha atha iti

original: atha vadhyaghātakabhāvo'nayorvirodha ityucyate, tadapi na ; yato jāto ghātako vadhyaṃ hanti, na ca bhinnādhikaraṇe ityato bhūtvaiva vadhyena caikādhikaraṇe vadhyaṃ ghātako hanyāt | tataścaikādhikaraṇayoreva vadhyaghātakabhāvāt na tato'dhikaraṇabhedāvagatiḥ |
analyzed: atha vadhya ghātaka bhāva ūnayoḥ virodhaḥ iti ucyate tat api na yatas jātaḥ ghātakaḥ vadhyam hanti na ca bhinna adhikaraṇe iti atas bhūtvā eva vadhyena ca eka adhikaraṇe vadhyam ghātakaḥ hanyāt tatas ca eka adhikaraṇayoḥ eva vadhya ghātaka bhāvāt na

original: athāpi syāt, tathāpyekādhikaraṇatvadarśanānnādhikaraṇa-bhedānumānamavyabhicāram, ekādhikaraṇayorapi vadhyaghātakayordarśanādityāha—atheti | na vidyate vyabhicāro'syeti vigrahaḥ | atha bhāvābhāvarūpī dharmo virodhinau ; yathā—nityatvānityatve mūrtatvāmūrtatve ca ; tayoreka-dharmatvāsaṃbhavāddharmibhedo'vasīyata ityucyate, tadapi na ;
analyzed: atha api syāt tathā api eka adhikaraṇa tva darśanāt na adhikaraṇa bheda anumānam avyabhicāram eka adhikaraṇayoḥ api vadhya ghātakayoḥ darśanāt iti āha atha iti na vidyate vyabhicāraḥ usya iti vigrahaḥ atha bhāva abhāva rūpī dharmaḥ virodhinau yathā nitya tva anitya tve mūrta tva amūrta tve ca tayoḥ eka dharma tva asaṃbhavāt dharmi bhedaḥ vasīyate iti ucyate tat api na

original: na hi yo dharmo yatra vartate sa tamavaśyaṃ vyāpnoti ; na hi rathā rathasaṃyogā vā nabho vyāmuvanti pṛthivyādīṃśra, rathānāmavacchinnatvāt avacchinnarathāśrayatvena tatsaṃyogānāmapyavacchinnatvāt | yathā rathādayastatsaṃyogāścaivamanye'pi ye'vacchinnāḥ | ye ca nityānityatvādayo dharmoḥ, te nānavacchinnāḥ |
analyzed: na hi yaḥ dharmaḥ yatra vartate sa tam avaśyam vyāpnoti na hi rathāḥ ratha saṃyogāḥ vā nabhaḥ rathānām avacchinna tvāt avacchinna ratha āśraya tvena tad saṃyogānām api avacchinna tvāt yathā ratha ādayaḥ tad saṃyogāḥ ca evam anye api yevacchinnāḥ ye ca nitya anitya tva ādayaḥ te na anavacchinnāḥ

original: ata evānantātmākhyamarthamāśrayanto'pi na taṃ vyāmuvanti | tataśca teṣāṃ nityatvātmakabhāvatadabhāvau na virudhyete | ato na bhāvābhāvayorvirodhāt taddharmiṇo bhedāvagatiriti | tatsarvamāha—atheti | nanu saṃyogāderavyāpitvādekatra vyomni bhāvābhāvau yuktau ; nityatvaṃ tvātmano vyāpi ;
analyzed: atas eva ananta ātma ākhyam artham āśrayantaḥ api na tam vyāmuvanti tatas ca teṣām nitya tva ātmaka bhāva tad abhāvau na virudhyete atas na bhāva abhāvayoḥ virodhāt tad dharmiṇaḥ bheda avagatiḥ iti tat sarvam āha atha iti nanu saṃyoga ādeḥ avyāpi tvāt ekatra vyomni bhāva abhāvau yuktau nitya tvam tu ātmanaḥ vyāpi

original: tataśca tadabhāvasyānityatvasya tadekāśrayatvāsaṃbhavādātmano bhinnaṃ kṣityādyāśrayaḥ pratīyata eva | atra brūmaḥ—syādevaṃ yadyanityatvaṃ nāma dharmastaccato'sti ; māyāmātraṃ tu tat kṣityādirūpeṇātmani kalpitam | na ca māyāyāṃ virodho'sti ; na hyekasya candramaso dvitvaṃ virudhyata iti bhāvaḥ | matāntarabhāśaṅkayati—yastviti |
analyzed: tatas ca tad abhāvasya anitya tvasya tad eka āśraya tva asaṃbhavāt ātmanaḥ bhinnam kṣiti ādi āśrayaḥ pratīyate eva atra brūmaḥ syāt evam yadi anitya tvam nāma dharmaḥ tat catosti māyā mātram tu tat kṣiti ādi rūpeṇa ātmani kalpitam na ca māyāyām virodhaḥ usti na hi ekasya candramasaḥ dvi tvam virudhyate iti bhāvaḥ mata antara bhās āśaṅkayati yaḥ tu iti

original: vyatirekamāha—ekatva iti | avyavasthāmāha—tathā ceti | anyatheti ; yadi tilāt tailameva syāt, na dadhi, yadi caikasmin naśyatītarastra naśyet tadetyarthaḥ | atra paravacanaṃ paṭhati—taditi | sarvaṃ sarvatropayujyeteti ; sarvaṃ payastilādi sarvatraiva
analyzed: vyatirekam āha ekatve iti avyavasthām āha tathā ca iti anyathā iti yadi tilāt tailam eva syāt na dadhi yadi ca ekasmin naśyati itaraḥ tra naśyet tadā iti arthaḥ atra para vacanam paṭhati tat iti sarvam sarvatra upayujyeta iti sarvam payaḥ tila ādi sarvatra eva

original: tailadadhyādiṣu hetutvenopayujyetyarthaḥ | evamāśaṅkya dūṣayati—tasyāpīti | P. 58-7. yadi kāryanānātvaṃ vyavasthā, tayā tilānāṃ payasaśra bhedaṃ pratijānāti, tadedemevottaramityanvayaḥ | nanu kṣīrād dvyo janma nānyata itīyaṃ vyavasthoktā, na kāryanānātvamātram ; ataḥ ko'yamanukopālambhaḥ ? satyamuktam ;

original: yadeva kāryabhedādivipakṣavyāvṛttimukhena bauddhānāmanumānamuktaṃ tadevānyeṣāmanyathānupapadyamānamarthāpattiriti matvoktam—arthāpadyā veti | anyonyābhāvo hi bhedaḥ ; na ca so'kṣagocaraḥ, bhāvamātragrahaṇayogyatvādindriyāṇām | na ca liṅgagamyaḥ, pramāṇāntarāgocare saṃbandhinyabhāve
analyzed: yat eva kārya bheda ādi vipakṣa vyāvṛtti mukhena bauddhānām anumānam uktam tat eva anyeṣām anyathā anupapadyamānam arthāpattiḥ iti matvā uktam arthāpadyā vā iti anyonya abhāvaḥ hi bhedaḥ na ca sokṣa gocaraḥ bhāva mātra grahaṇa yogya tvāt indriyāṇām na ca liṅga gamyaḥ pramāṇa antara agocare saṃbandhini abhāve

original: liṅgini, tena saha kasyacillaṅgasyādṛṣṭasaṃgatitvāt | arthāpattirapi payaso dadho janma nānyata iti vyavasthāhetukāḥ sā cetaretarāśrayatvadoṣagrastatvājñānyonyābhāvarūpe bhede pramāṇam |
