original: tasmāt bhāvopalambhahetubhyaścakṣurādibhyaḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ pramāṇānutpādalakṣaṇaṃ, vidhāyakādvā bhāvajñānāt pramāṇāntaraṃ vyavacchedakatvena 'nāsti' iti jñānamanyonyābhāvāyāśrayitavyam ; tadadhīnā hi bhāvānāmanyonyamasaṃkarṇiteti ye manyante tān pratyucyate— P. 57-3. anyonyeti | pramāntareti ; pramāśabdaḥ karaṇasādhano bhāvasādhano vā ;
analyzed: tasmāt bhāva upalambha hetubhyaḥ cakṣuḥ ādibhyaḥ pramāṇa antaram pramāṇa anutpāda lakṣaṇam vidhāyakāt vā bhāva jñānāt pramāṇa antaram vyavacchedaka tvena na asti iti jñānam anyonya abhāvāya āśrayitavyam tad adhīnā hi bhāvānām anyonyam asaṃkarṇitā iti ye manyante tān pratyucyate anyonya iti pramā antara iti pramā śabdaḥ karaṇa sādhanaḥ bhāva sādhanaḥ vā

original: tathāca darśitam—'sadupalambhahetubhyaḥ' ityādinā ; viṣayapratiṣedhyayorbhedādvinā 'asmin bhūtale nedaṃ ghaṭādi' 'nāyaṃ ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ' iti cobhayavidhā niṣedhadhīnaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | nanvanyonyābhāvo bheda iti pareṇoktam ; sa ca tādātmyābhāvo nādhārādheyābhāvaḥ ; tatra 'nāyamayam' itimātraṃ vācyam ; na 'nāsminnidam' iti | satyam ; na vyartham ;
analyzed: tathā ca darśitam sat upalambha hetubhyaḥ ityādinā viṣaya pratiṣedhyayoḥ bhedāt vinā asmin bhū tale na idam ghaṭa ādi na ayam ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ iti ca ubhayavidhā niṣedha dhīnam bhavati iti arthaḥ nanu anyonya abhāvaḥ bhedaḥ iti pareṇa uktam sa ca tādātmya abhāvaḥ na ādhāra ādheya abhāvaḥ tatra na ayam ayam iti mātram vācyam na na asmin idam iti satyam na vyartham

original: dṛṣṭāntārthaṃ hi tat ! ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe—neti | khaluśabdaḥ prasiddhidyotanārthaḥ | kuta ityāha— nānapekṣiteti | na hi yatra yo niṣedhyate tāvanapekṣya 'nedamiha' 'nāyamayam' iti niṣedho bhavati ; bhavan vā 'na' ityetāvanmātraṃ syāt ; tataścāgṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvāt sarvaśūnyatāmāpādayati ;
analyzed: dṛṣṭānta artham hi tat ślokam vyācaṣṭena iti khaluśabdaḥ prasiddhi dyotana arthaḥ kutas iti āha na anapekṣita iti na hi yatra yaḥ niṣedhyate tau an apekṣya na idam iha na ayam ayam iti niṣedhaḥ bhavati bhavan vā naḥ iti etāvat mātram syāt tatas ca agṛhyamāṇa viśeṣa tvāt sarva śūnyatām āpādayati

original: na bhāvaviśeṣayoranyonyābhāvarūpaṃ bhedamiti 'api cānapekṣitaviṣayaniṣedhyavyavacchede śūnyatā pramāṇārthaḥ' ityatroktam | etacca pareṣāmapi saṃmatamiti gṛhītvā ityādinā darśitam |
analyzed: na bhāva viśeṣayoḥ anyonya abhāva rūpam bhedam iti api ca anapekṣita viṣaya niṣedhya vyavacchede śūnyatā pramāṇa arthaḥ iti atra uktam etat ca pareṣām api saṃmatam iti gṛhītvā ityādinā darśitam

original: tadevaṃ viṣayaniṣedhyapratītau siddhārthā yadi sā tayoranavagatabhedayorvastumātratvena syāt, tadā 'idaṃ niṣedhyam, viṣayastvayam' iti vibhāgābhāvānniṣedha eva na syāt | vastumātraṃ hyanavagatabhedaṃ yadi viṣayaḥ, niṣedhyaṃ na syāt | atha niṣedhyaḥ, tato viṣayo na syāt |
analyzed: tat evam viṣaya niṣedhya pratītau siddhārthā yadi sā tayoḥ anavagata bhedayoḥ vastu mātra tvena syāt tadā idam niṣedhyam viṣayaḥ tu ayam iti vibhāga abhāvāt niṣedhaḥ eva na syāt vastu mātram hi anavagata bhedam yadi viṣayaḥ niṣedhyam na syāt atha niṣedhyaḥ tatas viṣayaḥ na syāt

original: viṣayābhāve ca 'ghaṭo nāsti' iti ghaṭasyātyantiko niṣedhaḥ syāt, nānyatra siddhasya deśaviśeṣe ; na kvacitsiddhasyātyantiko niṣedho yujyate ; na cātyantamasiddhasya, aprasakte ; etacca 'anyathā daivaniṣiddha kaḥ pratiṣedho'prāptarūpe ?' ityādinoktam | vyavacchedāvadhiḥ vyavacchidyate asminniti viṣayo'bhipretaḥ |
analyzed: viṣaya abhāve ca ghaṭaḥ na asti iti ghaṭasya ātyantikaḥ niṣedhaḥ syāt na anyatra siddhasya deśa viśeṣe na kvacid siddhasya ātyantikaḥ niṣedhaḥ yujyate na ca atyantam asiddhasya aprasakte etat ca anyathā ityādinā uktam vyavaccheda avadhiḥ vyavacchidyate asmin iti viṣayaḥ abhipretaḥ

original: atha na vastumātrasya viṣayaniṣedhyatve, kiṃtu vastuviśeṣayoreva yayoḥ kayościdityucyate, tataḥ sarvasya sarvatra niṣedhaḥ syāt, viśeṣā-
analyzed: atha na vastu mātrasya viṣaya niṣedhya tve kiṃtu vastu viśeṣayoḥ eva yayoḥ kayoḥ cid iti ucyate tatas sarvasya sarvatra niṣedhaḥ syāt viśeṣāḥ

original: navadhāraṇāt | tasmāt bhinnasvabhāvena viśiṣṭau ca viṣayaniṣedhyau pratipadya pūreṇa niṣedhaḥ pratipattavyaḥ ; evaṃ hi sa saṃbhavet ; anyathā viṣayaniṣedhyayorvibhāgāpratipattau na saṃbhavet | viśiṣṭayośca tayoḥ pratītau kvacideva niṣedhyata iti niyamaḥ syāt | anyathā sarvaḥ sarvatra niṣedhyetetyuktam | kiṃca pratiyogī niṣedhyaḥ ;
analyzed: nava dhāraṇāt tasmāt bhinna svabhāvena viśiṣṭau ca viṣaya niṣedhyau pratipadya pūreṇa niṣedhaḥ pratipattavyaḥ evam hi sa saṃbhavet anyathā viṣaya niṣedhyayoḥ vibhāga apratipattau na saṃbhavet viśiṣṭayoḥ ca tayoḥ pratītau kvacid eva niṣedhyate iti niyamaḥ syāt anyathā sarvaḥ sarvatra niṣedhyeta iti uktam kiṃca pratiyogī niṣedhyaḥ

original: na cānavagatabhedaḥ sa bhavati ; anyathā svasya svayaṃ sa syāt | yadvā anavagatabhedaḥ sāmānyamātreṇāvagataḥ pratiyogī bhavati | tataḥ sthāṇāvaviśeṣeṇa pratīte puruṣo'pyūrdhvatāsāmānyena pratītaḥ pratiyogī syāt ; atastasyāṃbhāvapratītiḥ syāt | na caivam | ataśca bhinnau niṣedhyaviśeṣau buddhau svīkṛtyābhāvaḥ pratipattavya iti siddham |
analyzed: na ca anavagata bhedaḥ sa bhavati anyathā svasya svayam sa syāt yat vā anavagata bhedaḥ sāmānya mātreṇa avagataḥ pratiyogī bhavati tatas sthāṇau aviśeṣeṇa pratīte puruṣaḥ api ūrdhvatā sāmānyena pratītaḥ pratiyogī syāt atas tasyām bhāva pratītiḥ syāt na ca evam atas ca bhinnau niṣedhya viśeṣau buddhau svīkṛtya abhāvaḥ pratipattavyaḥ iti siddham

original: tathāca loke'pi tatpratītistathaiva pratyātmamupalakṣyate | tathāca sati viṣayaniṣedhyayorbhedajñāne satyabhāvapratītiḥ, tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ tayoranyonyābhāvātmakabhedapratītiritītaretarāśrayatve syādityarthaḥ | idānīmitaretarāśrayatvamucchlokamāha—apiceti | nānupalabdhimātrāt P. 67-20 vastvabhāvajñānam, suṣupte'pi prasaṅgāt ;
analyzed: tathāca loke api tad pratītiḥ tathā eva pratyātmam upalakṣyate tathā ca sati viṣaya niṣedhyayoḥ bheda jñāne satya bhāva pratītiḥ tasyām ca satyām tayoḥ anyonya abhāva ātmaka bheda pratītiḥ iti itaretarāśraya tve syāt iti arthaḥ idānīm itaretarāśraya tvam ucchlokam āha api ca iti na anupalabdhi mātrāt vastu abhāva jñānam suṣupte api prasaṅgāt

original: kiṃtu upalabdhisādhanasākalye satyanupalabdhyā | na hi suṣupte'nupalabdhilakṣaṇaḥ svarūpāvaśeṣaḥ kaścidasti, yasya sāmarthyātiśayāt cakṣurādiriva rūpāderabhāvasya bodhakaḥ ; kiṃtu pramāṇasāmagrīvaikalpena tatrānupalabdhiḥ | avaikalpe tu prameyābhāvamantareṇa tadasaṃbhavānnāntarīyakatvena sā vastvabhāvaṃ gamayati |
analyzed: kiṃtu upalabdhi sādhana sākalye sati anupalabdhyā na hi suṣuptena upalabdhi lakṣaṇaḥ svarūpa avaśeṣaḥ kaścid asti yasya sāmarthya atiśayāt cakṣuḥ ādiḥ iva rūpa ādeḥ abhāvasya bodhakaḥ kiṃtu pramāṇa sāmagrī vaikalpena tatra anupalabdhiḥ a vaikalpe tu prameya abhāvam antareṇa tad asaṃbhavāt nāntarīyaka tvena sā vastu abhāvam gamayati

original: evaṃ ca dhūmādivat jñātā sā gamikatyāpannam | sā ca dvividheṣṭā—pratiyogyupalabdhirūpeṇātmano'pariṇāmo vā, tato'nyasya vā viṣayasya jñānam ; taduktam—“sātmano'pariṇāmo vā vijñānaṃ vānyavastuni” iti | tatra yadyanyavastujñānamanupalabdhiḥ, tato nāptiddhe vastubhede sā sidhyati | atastajjñānāya vastubhedo jñātavyaḥ |
analyzed: evam ca dhūma ādi vat jñātā sā gamika tyā āpannam sā ca dvividha iṣṭa a pratiyogi upalabdhi rūpeṇa ātmanā upariṇāmaḥ vā tatonyasya vā viṣayasya jñānam tat uktam sa ātmanā upariṇāmaḥ vā vijñānam vā anya vastuni iti tatra yadi anya vastu jñānam anupalabdhiḥ tatas vastu bhede sā sidhyati atas tad jñānāya vastu bhedaḥ jñātavyaḥ

original: na ca vācyam—niṣedhyajñānādanyat jñānamanupalabdhiḥ ; ato jñānabhedo'tra gamyate, na vastubhedaḥ ; tatkathamucyate ‘nāptiddhe vastubheda’ iti ? | yato jñeyānumeyaṃ tajjñānam, ato bhedo'pi tasya jñeyabhedānumeya ityarthaḥ | jñeyavastubhedo vijñātavyaḥ ;
analyzed: na ca vācyam niṣedhya jñānāt anyat jñānam anupalabdhiḥ atas jñāna bhedaḥ utra gamyate na vastu bhedaḥ tat katham ucyate vastu bhedaḥ iti yatas jñeya anumeyam tat jñānam atas bhedaḥ upi tasya jñeya bheda anumeyaḥ iti arthaḥ jñeya vastu bhedaḥ vijñātavyaḥ

original: tatastu bhedaṃ vinānyatvātiddherbhede jñāte'nupalabdhijñānam, tasyāṃ ca jñātāyāmanyonyābhāvātmakabhedajñānamitītaretarāśrayatvaṃ syāt | athātmano'pariṇāmo'nupalabdhiḥ, sāpi nātmanaḥ
analyzed: tatas tu bhedam vinā anyatva atiddheḥ bhede jñāte nupalabdhi jñānam tasyām ca jñātāyām anyonya abhāva ātmaka bheda jñānam iti itaretarāśraya tvam syāt atha ātmanā upariṇāmaḥ ūnupalabdhiḥ sā api na ātmanaḥ

original: sarvavijñānaśūnyatārūpā stimitāvasthā, sarvāpratipattau kasyacinniyatasya paṭāderabhāvāt | tasmāt ghaṭādibhyo bhinne paṭādau jñānapariṇāme satyeva tadvitre ghaṭādau jñānapariṇāmo'bhāvajñānaheturiti vācyam ; na caiṣo'nupalabdherviśeṣo ghaṭapaṭayorbhedajñānāt prāk sidhyati | tataśca pūrvavaditaretarāśrayatvam | nanu pratyakṣeṇaiva bhedo gṛhyate ;
analyzed: sarva vijñāna śūnyatā rūpā stimita avasthā sarva apratipattau kasyacid niyatasya paṭa ādeḥ abhāvāt tasmāt ghaṭa ādibhyaḥ bhinne paṭa ādau jñāna pariṇāme sati eva tad vitre ghaṭa ādau jñāna pariṇāmaḥ bhāva jñāna hetuḥ iti vācyam na ca eṣaḥ anupalabdheḥ viśeṣaḥ ghaṭa paṭayoḥ bheda jñānāt prāk sidhyati tatas ca pūrvavat itaretara āśraya tvam nanu pratyakṣeṇa eva bhedaḥ gṛhyate

original: tathāhi—nirvikalpakapratyakṣasya sāmānyamātraviṣayatāmapākurvatā vārtikakṛtā “tadayuktam” ityādyuktam | nanu “vastvasaṃkarasiddhiśca tatprāmāṇyamupāśritā” ityapi tenoktam ; bāḍham ; saṃyogasamavāyātmakāsaṃkarābhiprāyaṃ tu tat—iti ye tvāhuḥ, te prāgeva ‘āhurvidhātṛ pratyakṣam’ ityatra nirastāḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi nirvikalpaka pratyakṣasya sāmānya mātra viṣayatām apākurvatā vārtika kṛtā tat ayuktam ityādi uktam nanu vastu asaṃkara siddhiḥ ca tat prāmāṇyam upāśritā iti api tena uktam bāḍham saṃyoga samavāya ātmaka asaṃkara abhiprāyam tu ye tu āhuḥ te prāk eva āhuḥ vidhātṛ pratyakṣam iti atra nirastāḥ

original: ye'pi kāṇādā pūrvamāhuḥ—bhūtalādivastugrahaṇapratiyogismaraṇarūpayetikartavyatayā'nugṛhītādakṣāt saṃyuktaviśeṣaṇasaṃnikarṣeṇa labdhaṃ janma yeta tat pratyakṣāntaramabhāvagrāhakam | na ca vācyam—akṣajaṃ taccedviṣayajñānavat prathamameva syāt, na paścāt ; pratiyogismaraṇavyavahite cākṣavyāpāre jātaṃ kathaṃ tadakṣajam ? iti ;
analyzed: ye api pūrvam āhuḥ bhū tala ādi vastu grahaṇa pratiyogi smaraṇa rūpayā itikartavyatayā anugṛhītāt akṣāt saṃyukta viśeṣaṇa saṃnikarṣeṇa labdham janma tat pratyakṣa antaram abhāva grāhakam na ca vācyam akṣa jam tat ced viṣaya jñāna vat prathamam eva syāt na paścāt pratiyogi smaraṇa vyavahite ca akṣa vyāpāre jātam katham tat akṣa jam iti

original: yato yathā śabdasmaraṇapekṣitvāt savikalpakaṃ nirvikalpakāt paścādbhāvi, yathā ca śabdasmaraṇavyavadhāne'pi tadanugṛhītādakṣādutpatternānakṣajam ; tathā ‘nāsti’ ityapi jñānaṃ pratiyogismaraṇāpekṣitvāt paścādbhāvi, pratiyogismṛtivyavadhāne'pi ca tadanugṛhītādakṣāpa. 58-14 dutpatteścākṣajamiti, tān pratīdameva vaktavyam—anyonyasaṃśrayāt iti |
analyzed: yatas yathā śabda smaraṇa apekṣi tvāt savikalpakam nirvikalpakāt paścāt bhāvi yathā ca śabda smaraṇa vyavadhāne api tad anugṛhītāt akṣāt utpatteḥ na an akṣa jam tathā na asti iti api jñānam pratiyogi smaraṇa apekṣi tvāt paścāt bhāvi pratiyogi smṛti vyavadhāne api ca tad anugṛhītāt akṣa āpa t utpatteḥ ca akṣa jam iti tān prati idam eva vaktavyam anyonya saṃśrayāt iti

original: pramāṇāntaram ; pratyakṣāntaramityarthaḥ | pratyakṣeṇāpi viṣayaniṣedhyau bhedena gṛhītvā tayoranyonyābhāvo grahītavyaḥ ; tataścābhāvagamya iva pratyakṣagamye'pyabhāve tulyamitaretarāśrayatvamityarthaḥ | itaścānyatrānyābhāvajñānāsaṃbhava ityāha—kiñceti | mīyamānamekaṃ sanmātrarūpaṃ yeṣāṃ bhāvānāmiti vigrahaḥ | tadvidyuṇoti—apiceti |
analyzed: pramāṇa antaram pratyakṣa antaram iti arthaḥ pratyakṣeṇa api viṣaya niṣedhyau bhedena gṛhītvā tayoḥ anyonya abhāvaḥ grahītavyaḥ tatas ca abhāva gamyaḥ iva pratyakṣa gamye ipi abhāve tulyam itaretara āśraya tvam iti arthaḥ itas ca anyatra anya abhāva jñāna asaṃbhavaḥ iti āha kiñca iti mīyamānam ekam sat mātra rūpam yeṣām bhāvānām iti vigrahaḥ tat vidyuṇoti api ca iti

original: yathāpramāṇaṃ hi prameyavyavasthā ; tacca ghaṭapaṭau sanmātrarūpatayā pramiṇoti, na viśeṣarūpatayā ; ataḥ sanmātrasvabhāvāveva tau, na bhinnasvabhāvau ; tataśca na tayoritaretarāśrayatvam ; ataścetaratvenābhimate ghaṭe netarasya paṭasya
analyzed: yathāpramāṇam hi prameya vyavasthā tat ca ghaṭa paṭau sat mātra rūpatayā pramiṇoti na viśeṣa rūpatayā atas sat mātra svabhāvau eva tau na bhinna svabhāvau tatas ca na tayoḥ itaretara āśraya tvam atas ca itaratvena abhimate ghaṭe na itarasya paṭasya

original: pramānutpādo'nupalabdhiḥ, dvayoḥ sanmātraikarūpatvāt; ekopalabdhau cetarasyāpi tena rūpeṇopalabdhatvāt; ato netaratretarābhāvajñānaṃ saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ | atra sattāpahavavādī codayati—nanviti | ekarūpapratyabhijñānāt P 58-22. govyaktiṣu gotvamupeyate | na ca yathaikāṃ gāṃ dṛṣṭavato gavāntare tadasti, tathā sarṣapaṃ dṛṣṭavato merau |
analyzed: pramā anutpādaḥ ūnupalabdhiḥ dvayoḥ sat mātra eka rūpa tvāt eka upalabdhau ca itarasya api tena rūpeṇa upalabdha tvāt atas na itaratra itara abhāva jñānam saṃbhavati iti arthaḥ atra sattā apahava vādī codayati nanu iti eka rūpa pratyabhijñānāt go vyaktiṣu go tvam upeyate na ca yathā ekām gām dṛṣṭavataḥ gava antare tat asti tathā sarṣapam dṛṣṭavataḥ merau

original: na svalla dvayoranyonyapratiṣedhamantareṇa bhedapratītiḥ; na kevalo vidhisamakālo vidhitaḥ paścādvā pratiṣedhākhyaḥ pramāṇavyāpāraḥ saṃbhavati | na ca vastuvidhirevānyapratiṣedha iti 'labdharūpe kacit' ityādau varṇitam | ato na bhedaḥ pramāṇasya viṣayaḥ | tadyadyabhinnamapi rūpaṃ na gṛhyeta, nirviṣayameva pramāṇaṃ syāt |
analyzed: dvayoḥ anyonya pratiṣedham antareṇa bheda pratītiḥ na kevalaḥ vidhi sama kālaḥ vidhitaḥ paścāt vā pratiṣedha ākhyaḥ pramāṇa vyāpāraḥ saṃbhavati na ca vastu vidhiḥ eva anya pratiṣedhaḥ iti labdha rūpe kacid ityādau varṇitam atas na bhedaḥ pramāṇasya viṣayaḥ tat yadi abhinnam api rūpam na gṛhyeta nirviṣayam eva pramāṇam syāt

original: ato'śeṣabhāvagatamabhinnamekaṃ rūpameṣṭavyam | tacca naḥ sattā | saiva ca pramāṇasya viṣayaḥ; na bhedāḥ | tena bhedā eva pramāṇaviṣayatayā śabdavācyā ityapi pratyuktam | yattu merusarṣapayoḥ 'sat' iti pratyabhijñānaṃ nāstītyuktam, tadasiddham; astyeva hi sadrūpatayā tatrāpi pratyabhijñānam |
analyzed: atas śeṣa bhāva gatam abhinnam ekam rūpam eṣṭavyam tat ca naḥ sattā sā eva ca pramāṇasya viṣayaḥ na bhedāḥ tena bhedāḥ eva pramāṇa viṣaya tayā śabda vācyāḥ iti api pratyuktam yat tu meru sarṣapayoḥ sat iti pratyabhijñānam na asti iti uktam tat asiddham asti eva hi sat rūpatayā tatra api pratyabhijñānam

original: atha satyapi sadrūpānugame vailakṣaṇyānnetyucyate, tarhi yādṛśamekasyāṃ gavi vyaktaṃ na tādṛśamekāṃ gāṃ dṛṣṭavato gavāntare, vyaktibhedāditi tatrāpi na syāt | athāsti tatra tāvat satyapi vyaktibhede 'sa evāyam' iti pūrvāparānusaṃdhānam, na tu sataḥ sarṣapasya sadantare merau;

original: sattāvādinaḥ 'so'yam' iti pūrvāparānusaṃdhānādekatvam, nābhinnarūpasaṃvittiḥ; tena merusarṣapayoḥ satyabhinnarūpasaṃvidanugame'pi 'so'yam' ityanusaṃdhānābhāvānnaikatvamiti; tadidamayuktam; anusaṃdhānaṃ vināpyabhinnarūpasaṃvittita eva prathamamekavyaktidarśane tadekatvaniścayāt | anusaṃdhānaṃ hi deśakālabhedena punardarśane bhavati;
analyzed: sattāvādinaḥ saḥ ayam iti pūrva apara anusaṃdhānāt ekatvam na abhinna rūpa saṃvittiḥ tena meru sarṣapayoḥ satya bhinna rūpa saṃvid anugame pi saḥ yam iti anusaṃdhāna abhāvāt na ekatvam iti tat idam ayuktam anusaṃdhānam vinā api abhinna rūpa saṃvittitaḥ eva prathamam eka vyakti darśane tad ekatva niścayāt anusaṃdhānam hi deśa kāla bhedena punar darśane bhavati

original: na ca prathamadarśane so'sti | tasmādabhinnarūpasaṃvittita evānekatvaikatvaniścaya iti siddham; tathā mahiṣīmaṇḍalāvyāhṛtāt 'gauḥ' ityabhinnarūpānnirvikalpakapratyayātprathamādeva gomaṇḍale govyaktīnāṃ deśabhede'- 11
analyzed: na ca prathama darśane saḥ usti tasmāt abhinna rūpa saṃvittitaḥ eva anekatva ekatva niścayaḥ iti siddham tathā mahiṣī maṇḍala a vyāhṛtāt gauḥ iti abhinna rūpāt nirvikalpaka pratyayāt prathamāt eva go maṇḍale go vyaktīnām deśa bhede

original: P.59-14. pyekagotvaniścayasyeṣṭatvāt ; taduktam—“nirvikalpaka—” ityādi | na hyatrāpyanusaṃdhānamasti ; taddhi dṛṣṭasya kālabhedena punardarśane bhavati ; gomaṇḍale ca vyaktīnāṃ deśabhede'pi na kālabhedaḥ | tasmādatrāpyabhinnarūpasaṃvittita evābhedādhyavasāyaḥ |
analyzed: pi eka go tva niścayasya iṣṭatvāt tat uktam nirvikalpakaḥ ityādi na hi atra api anusaṃdhānam asti tat hi dṛṣṭasya kāla bhedena punar darśane bhavati go maṇḍale ca vyaktīnām deśa bhede pi na kāla bhedaḥ tasmāt atra api abhinna rūpa saṃvittitaḥ eva abheda adhyavasāyaḥ

original: api ca yadyanusaṃdhānādekatvam , tato yathā maṇikaṃ dṛṣṭvā maṇikāntare'nusaṃdhānaṃ na tathā śarāvaṃ dṛṣṭvā ; tatra mṛjātirapi na syāt | atha maṇikamiva śarāvamapi dṛṣṭvā astyeva maṇikāntare'nusaṃdhānam ; ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ—yanmaṇikayormaṇikāvayavasāmānyānāṃ bhūyastvādutkaṭam , maṇikaśarāvayostu mṛtsāmānyamātrānugamādanutkaṭam ; ato'sti mṛjātiriti ;
analyzed: api ca yadi anusaṃdhānāt ekatvam tatas yathā maṇikam dṛṣṭvā maṇika antara inusaṃdhānam na tathā śarāvam dṛṣṭvā tatra mṛ jātiḥ api na syāt atha maṇikam iva śarāvam api dṛṣṭvā asti eva maṇika antara inusaṃdhānam ayam tu viśeṣaḥ yat maṇikayoḥ maṇika avayava sāmānyānām bhūyaḥ tvāt utkaṭam maṇika śarāvayoḥ tu mṛd sāmānya mātra anugamāt anutkaṭam atas asti mṛ jātiḥ iti

original: evaṃ tarhi yathā maṇikaśarāvayoranutkaṭamanusaṃdhānaṃ tataśca mṛjātisiddhiḥ , tathaiva sarṣeṣu dṛṣṭvā merāvapi sarṣeṣatvarūpeṇānanusaṃdhāne'pi sadrūpeṇānutkaṭamanusaṃdhānamasti ; ataḥ sajātirapi siddhā | ataḥ sūktam—‘mīyamānaikarūpeṣu’ iti | etadeva paramatenākṣipya samādhatte—bhedeti | bhidyate iti bhedo viśeṣarūpaṃ vyāvṛttam ;
analyzed: evam tarhi yathā maṇika śarāvayoḥ anutkaṭam anusaṃdhānam tatas ca mṛ jāti siddhiḥ tathā eva sarṣeṣu dṛṣṭvā merau api sat rūpeṇa anutkaṭam anusaṃdhānam asti atas sa jātiḥ api siddhā atas su uktam mīyamāna eka rūpeṣu iti etat eva paramatena ākṣipya samādhatte bheda iti bhidyate iti bhedaḥ viśeṣa rūpam vyāvṛttam

original: abhedastadviruddhamanuvṛttaṃ sāmānyarūpam ; tadubhayāvabhāsinī ‘san’ iti ‘ghaṭaḥ’ iti dve vijñāne staḥ | ‘san’ iti sarvatrānuvṛttam , ‘ghaṭaḥ’ iti ca paṭādibhyo vyāvṛttam | tathā ‘gauḥ śābaleyaḥ’ ityādyapi draṣṭavyam | yadi tu dve vijñāne neṣyete tato dvirūpo vyavahāro na syāt | asti cāsau ;
analyzed: abhedaḥ tad viruddham anuvṛttam sāmānya rūpam tad ubhaya avabhāsinī san iti ghaṭaḥ iti dve vijñāne staḥ san iti sarvatra anuvṛttam ghaṭaḥ iti ca paṭa ādibhyaḥ vyāvṛttam tathā gauḥ śābaleyaḥ ityādi api draṣṭavyam yadi tu dve vijñāne neṣyete tatas dvi rūpaḥ vyavahāraḥ na syāt asti ca asau

original: tathāhi—vatsau mātaramanvicchan sāmānyabuddhyā gogaṇamabhidhāvati , viśeṣabuddhyā ca svamātaram | atastato'nuvṛttavyāvṛttākāre dve jñāne | jñānādhīnā cārthavyavasthā | anyathā hyabhedo'pi tava na syāt ; so'pi jñānabalenaiva tvayābhyupeyate | tasmād dvirūpameva jagat , naikarūpamiti cet ; tanna ;
analyzed: tathā ahi vat sau mātaram anvicchan sāmānya buddhyā go gaṇam abhidhāvati viśeṣa buddhyā ca sva mātaram atas tatas nuvṛtta vyāvṛtta ākāre dve jñāne jñāna adhīnā ca artha vyavasthā anyathā hi abhedaḥ api tava na syāt saḥ api jñāna balena eva tvayā abhyupeyate tasmāt dvi rūpam eva jagat na eka rūpam iti ced tat na

original: na hi jñānamātrādarthatattvavyavasthā , alātacakrādijñāneṣvabhāvāt | tasmājjātamapi jñānaṃ yuktyā virudhyate , na vā ; ata eva pramāṇotpannaṃ na veti parīkṣyam ; na jñānamityevāstheyam | yadvā yuktyā virudhyate na veti yuktivirodhāvirodhe parīkṣā ; pramāṇotthamiti ca pramāṇasāmarthyāsāmarthyaparīkṣeti viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: na hi jñāna mātrāt artha tattva vyavasthā alāta cakra ādi jñāneṣu abhāvāt tasmāt jātam api jñānam yuktyā virudhyate na vā atas eva pramāṇa utpannam na vā iti parīkṣyam na jñānam iti eva āstheyam yat vā yuktyā virudhyate na vā iti yukti virodha avirodhe parīkṣā pramāṇa uttham iti ca pramāṇa sāmarthya asāmarthya parīkṣā iti viśeṣaḥ

original: nanu kathaṃ pratyakṣaṃ yuktyā bādhyate ? satyam , na bādhyeta yadi tat pratyakṣaṃ syāt ; pratyakṣābhāsarūpaṃ tu taditi ‘āhurvidhātṛ pratyakṣam’
analyzed: nanu katham pratyakṣam yuktyā bādhyate satyam na bādhyeta yadi tat pratyakṣam syāt pratyakṣa ābhāsa rūpam tu tat iti āhuḥ vidhātṛ pratyakṣam

original: ityādāvevāveditam | ataśca svapnadṛśyālātacakrādijñānavat jāgradṛśyālātacakrādijñānaṃ yathā sadapi na taccānugamanimittaṃ tathā bhedajñānamapi | nanu 'na bhedaḥ kevalaḥ, na vidhisahitaḥ, na vidheḥ paścāt pramāṇasya vyāpāraḥ' ityuktanyāyena pramāṇādanyato'pi bhedajñānasyodayo na bhavatītyucyate;
analyzed: ityādau eva āveditam atas ca svapna dṛśya alāta cakra ādi jñāna vat jāgra dṛśya alāta cakra ādi jñānam yathā sat api na tat ca anugama nimittam tathā bheda jñānam api nanu na bhedaḥ kevalaḥ na vidhi sahitaḥ na vidheḥ paścāt pramāṇasya vyāpāraḥ iti ukta nyāyena pramāṇāt anyatas api bheda jñānasya udayaḥ na bhavati iti ucyate

original: ko vānyathāha ? vayamapi bhedamapahuvānā bhedajñānānudayameva brūmaḥ; na hi paramārthato bhedāvagamo'sti; yadi sa syāt, tato nirviṣayasya jñānasyāsaṃbhavāt kathamasmābhirbhedo'pahūyeta ? apahṛve ca prāguktahetubhiḥ kathaṃ bhedāvagamaḥ ? na hyavagamyaṃ vināvagamo ghaṭate, sakarmakatvādavagateḥ |
analyzed: kaḥ vā anyathā āha vayam api bhedam apahuvānāḥ bheda jñāna anudayam eva brūmaḥ na hi paramārthataḥ bheda avagamaḥ usti yadi sa syāt tatas nirviṣayasya jñānasya asaṃbhavāt katham asmābhiḥ bheda upahūyeta ca prāgukta hetubhiḥ katham bheda avagamaḥ na hi avagamyam vinā avagamaḥ ghaṭate sakarmaka tvāt avagateḥ

original: nanu yadi bhedatadavagamau na staḥ, tarhi yadidaṃ jagadbhirbrahmaṃ bhāti tatkimucyate ? avidyā | tāmeva paryāyāntareṇa vyanakti—vibhrama iti; ajñānamavidyā, tadupādāno vā P. 60-7. vibhrama ityarthaḥ | sa cānirvacanīyaḥ; tathāhi—yathāvabhāsaṃ vedyasadbhāve na vibhramaḥ, kiṃtu samyagjñānaṃ syāt | asati ca svapuṣpavadavagamo'nupapannaḥ |
analyzed: nanu yadi bheda tad avagamau na staḥ tarhi yat idam jagadbhiḥ brahmam bhāti tat kim ucyate avidyā tām eva paryāya antareṇa vyanakti vibhramaḥ iti ajñānam avidyā tad upādānaḥ vā vibhramaḥ iti arthaḥ sa ca anirvacanīyaḥ tathā hi yathāvabhāsam vedya sadbhāve na vibhramaḥ kiṃtu samyak jñānam syāt asati ca sva puṣpa vat avagamaḥ anupapannaḥ

original: tasmādvibhramaḥ sadasaccābhyāṃ niścitya loke nocyate | ato'nirvacanīya evāsau, itthaṃbhūtasyaiva sarvapravādeṣu siddhatvāt | etacca 'sarvapravādibhiścetthamiyamāsyeyā' ityatroktam | uktamapyanirvacanīyatvaprasaṅgāt punaruktam | athavā tatrārthavibhramasyānirvacanīyatvamuktam; iha tu jñānavibhramasyeti viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt vibhramaḥ sat asat ca ābhyām niścitya loke nā ucyate atonirvacanīyaḥ eva asau itthaṃbhūtasya eva sarva pravādeṣu siddha tvāt etat ca sarva pravādibhiḥ ca ittham iyam āsya iyāḥ iti atra uktam uktam api anirvacanīya tva prasaṅgāt punar uktam athavā tatra artha vibhramasya anirvacanīya tvam uktam iha tu jñāna vibhramasya iti viśeṣaḥ

original: tadā ca jñeyaṃ vinā jñānaṃ nāsti, tat kimidaṃ yatsarvasya bhedajñānamavabhāsate ? iti praśno yojyaḥ | vedyasadbhāve iti cāvivakṣitakarmanirdeśaḥ | avabhāsasadbhāve; jñānasadbhāva ityarthaḥ | tadevaṃ jñānadvaye satyapi kiṃ tadyuktyā virudhyate naveti parīkṣyam |
analyzed: tadā ca jñeyam vinā jñānam na asti tat kim idam yat sarvasya bheda jñānam avabhāsate iti praśnaḥ yojyaḥ vedya sadbhāve iti ca avivakṣita karma nirdeśaḥ avabhāsa sadbhāve jñāna sadbhāve iti arthaḥ tat evam jñāna dvaye sati api kim tat yuktyā virudhyate na vā iti parīkṣyam

original: tatra ca bhedajñānaṃ na pramāṇasāmarthyārthamiti 'āhurvidhātṛ' ityatra 'kramaḥ saṃgacchate' ityatra ca yuktyā virudhyata ityāveditamasmābhiḥ | ato na bhedaḥ paramārthata iti bhāvaḥ ! kiṃtu itopi tat jñānadvayaṃ parīkṣyamityāha—apiceti | tāṃ kalpanāmāha—jñānabhedāditi |
analyzed: tatra ca bheda jñānam na pramāṇa sāmarthya artham iti āhuḥ vidhātṛ iti atra kramaḥ saṃgacchate iti atra ca yuktyā virudhyate iti āveditam asmābhiḥ atas na bhedaḥ paramārthataḥ iti bhāvaḥ kiṃtu itas api tat jñāna dvayam parīkṣyam iti āha api ca iti tām kalpanām āha jñāna bhedāt iti

original: anuvṛttavyāvṛttajñānabhedāt yathājñānaṃ ca vastuvyavasthiteḥ sāmānyavyaktivibhāgena vastudvayamāhuḥ kāṇādāḥ, ye jātivyaktyoratyantabhinnayoḥ samavāyarūpaṃ saṃsargamāhuḥ | yadvā jñānadvayasya 'san ghaṭaḥ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyenopapatteḥ, atyantabhede ca tadasaṃbhavāt sāmānya- 114
analyzed: anuvṛtta vyāvṛtta jñāna bhedāt yathājñānam ca vastu vyavasthiteḥ sāmānya vyakti vibhāgena vastu dvayam āhuḥ kāṇādāḥ ye jāti vyaktyoḥ atyanta bhinnayoḥ samavāya rūpam saṃsargam āhuḥ yat vā jñāna dvayasya san ghaṭaḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena upapatteḥ atyanta bhede ca tad asaṃbhavāt sāmānya

original: viśeṣātmakamekaṃ vastu; yathāhuranekāntavādino bhāṣṭāḥ, ye jātivyaktyorekāntena na bhedo nāpyabheda ityāhuḥ | yadvā vyaktaya eva vastūni; na sāmānyaṃ vastu | jātirūpeṇābhedaḥ | sa ca bhinnābhinnajātyasaṃbhāvāt sarvapuṃsāṃ svābhāvikatvāt vyaktigatātyantikabhedaniścayāsāmarthyādanādidhāsanāvaśāt vyaktyupādāno vyaktiviṣaya eva kalpanājñānagocaraḥ |
analyzed: viśeṣa ātmakam ekam vastu yathā āhuḥ anekāntavādinaḥ bhāṣṭāḥ ye jāti vyaktyoḥ ekāntena na bhedaḥ na api abhedaḥ iti āhuḥ yat vā vyaktayaḥ eva vastūni na sāmānyam vastu jāti rūpeṇa abhedaḥ sa ca bhinna abhinna jāti asaṃbhāvāt sarva puṃsām svābhāvika tvāt vyakti gata ātyantika bheda niścaya asāmarthyāt anādidhāsanā vaśāt vyakti upādānaḥ vyakti viṣayaḥ eva kalpanā jñāna gocaraḥ

original: na cedamadṛṣṭam; dṛṣṭā hi bhinneṣu taruṣu 'vanam' ityabhedakalpaneti bauddhāḥ | ekamadvayaṃ vā taccam | tasya deśakālādyanavacchinnasya ata evānantasya tena rūpeṇāvidyayā niścetumaśakteravidyāyāśrānāditvāt anādayo'napekṣitāgantukakaraṇādidoṣāśrābhedopādānāstatprabhavatvāt tadviṣayāśra tatraivotpattebhedakalpanāḥ | nedamadṛṣṭam;
analyzed: na ca idam adṛṣṭam dṛṣṭā hi bhinneṣu taruṣu vanam iti abheda kalpanā iti bauddhāḥ ekam advayam vā tasya deśa kāla ādi anavacchinnasya atas eva anantasya tena rūpeṇa avidyayā niścetum aśakteḥ avidyāyāḥ śra anādi tvāt anādayaḥ an apekṣita āgantuka karaṇa ādi doṣāḥ śra bheda upādānāḥ tad prabhava tvāt tad viṣayāḥ śra tatra eva utpatti bheda kalpanāḥ na idam adṛṣṭam

original: dṛṣṭā hi taraṅgabhedādabhinne candramasi bhedakalpaneti svamatam | tadevaṃ vā ivipratipatteḥ saṃśaye nāparīkṣya taccaniścaya iti satyapyanugrahacyāvṛttākāre jñānadvaye parīkṣā kāryatyarthaḥ | tatra parī| '60-19. kṣāyāṃ prāptāyāmāha—na tāvaditi |

original: ataḥ samavāye'pi saṃbandhe tayorbhedena bhāvyam, tena samavāyinoḥ svarūpabhedasya tābhyāmanapāyāt | tathāca naikātmyena buddhiryujyate | asti ca sā | atastadviruddhaḥ prakhyābhedaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣavastunorbhedaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ nālamityarthaḥ | evaṃ prakhyābhedasāmānādhikaraṇyapratyayayorbhedamāśritya pūrvasya pareṇa viruddhatvamuktam |

original: yadā tvekaiva prakhyā dve vastunī samānādhikaraṇatvena bodhayati, tadāha—svayamiti | svayaṃ vā vyāhatatvāt prakhyābhedo na vastubhedavyavasthāyai bhavati | vyāhatatve hetumāha—eketi | sāmānyena prakhyābhedasya sāmānādhikaraṇyenotpatterityarthaḥ |

original: etaduktaṃ bhavati—yadyanuvṛttavyāvṛttaprakhyā ghaṭe paṭaprakhyeva vaiyadhikaraṇyena syāt, tato na svayaṃ vyāhatā syāt ; yadā tu sāmānyaviśeṣau na bhedena darśayati, tadā viruddhabhedābhedopadarśitvāt svayameva vyāhateti | atra codayati—nanviti | atrottaramāha—bhedeti |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yadi anuvṛtta vyāvṛtta prakhyā ghaṭe paṭa prakhyā iva vaiyadhikaraṇyena syāt tatas na svayam vyāhatā syāt yadā tu sāmānya viśeṣau na bhedena darśayati tadā viruddha bheda abheda upadarśi tvāt svayam eva vyāhatā iti atra codayati nanu iti atra uttaram āha bheda iti

original: tasyārthaḥ—atha sāmānyaviśeṣayoratyantabhede'pi bhedatirodhānasāmarthyaṃ samavāyasyābhyupeyate, evaṃ tarhi ekasyaivātmanastasāmarthyaṃ kiṃ nābhyupeyate ? yataḥ sāmarthyaviśeṣāt nānārūpeṇa tadavabhāsata iti | vṛttirnigadavyākhyātā |
analyzed: tasya arthaḥ atha sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ atyanta bhede pi bheda tirodhāna sāmarthyam samavāyasya abhyupeyate evam tarhi ekasya eva ātmanaḥ kim na abhyupeyate yatas sāmarthya viśeṣāt nānā rūpeṇa tat avabhāsate iti vṛttiḥ nigada vyākhyātā

original: P. 61-16. na hyasti viśeṣa ityuktam; tatra codayati—nanviti | agnyayoguḍādiṣu saṃsargasya bhinnayoragnilohaguḍakayorbhedatirodhānasāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭam; tathāhi—‘agnirayam’ iti lohaguḍakaṃ pratiyanti | tena dṛṣṭatvāttatrābhyupeyate; naikasya nānāvabhāsasāmarthyam, adarśanāditi paroktaviśeṣamāśaṅkaya siddhāntī punaraviśeṣamāha—dṛṣṭa iti |
analyzed: na hi asti viśeṣaḥ iti uktam tatra codayati nanu iti agni ayas guḍa ādiṣu saṃsargasya bhinnayoḥ agni loha guḍakayoḥ bheda tirodhāna sāmarthyam dṛṣṭam tathā hi agniḥ ayam iti loha guḍakam pratiyanti tena dṛṣṭa tvāt tatra abhyupeyate na ekasya nānā avabhāsa sāmarthyam adarśanāt iti para ukta viśeṣam āśaṅkaya siddhāntī punar aviśeṣam āha dṛṣṭaḥ iti

original: bhinnayorbhedatirodhānasāmarthyaṃ nāma dharmaḥ saṃsargasya dṛṣṭa ityasti viśeṣa iti yadyucyeta, tatrocyeta—nāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ; ekamapi hi citraṃ rūpamekā ca buddhirnānāvabhāsate yatra ityarthaḥ | tadvivṛṇoti—dṛṣṭamiti |

original: na ca vācyaṃ citraṃ nāma paṭasya rūpāntaraṃ nāstyeva, tantūnāmeva tu nīlapītādirūpāṇi samāhitāni parasparamilitāni citramityucyate iti; yato nīlādirūpāṇāṃ tantuṣu samavetatvāt paṭastarhi nīrūpaḥ syāt | nīrūpatve ca rūpalakṣaṇasya viṣayasaṃskārātiśayaviśeṣasyābhāvādvāyuvadacākṣuṣaḥ syāt |
analyzed: na ca vācyam citram nāma paṭasya rūpa antaram na asti eva tantūnām eva tu nīla pīta ādi rūpāṇi samāhitāni paraspara militāni citram iti ucyate iti yatas nīla ādi rūpāṇām tantuṣu samaveta tvāt paṭaḥ tarhi nīrūpaḥ syāt nīrūpa tve ca rūpa lakṣaṇasya viṣaya saṃskāra atiśaya viśeṣasya abhāvāt vāyu vat acākṣuṣaḥ syāt

original: svayamarūpasyāpi paṭasya rūpiṣu tantuṣu samavāyādekatvādisaṃkhyāgatyādikarmaṇoriva cākṣuṣatvaṃ syāditi cet; tanna; yasmādevamuktaṃ vaiśeṣikatantre—‘mahati dravye tryaṇukādau viṣaye yā upalabdhiścākṣuṣī sā anekadravyasamavāyāt rūpācca’ iti | tatra paramāṇoḥ rūpavato'pi cākṣuṣatvanivṛttyarthamanekadravyasamavāyādityuktam |
analyzed: svayam arūpasya api paṭasya rūpiṣu tantuṣu samavāyāt eka tva ādi saṃkhyā gati ādi karmaṇoḥ iva cākṣuṣa tvam syāt iti ced tat na yasmāt evam uktam vaiśeṣika tantre mahati dravye tryaṇuka ādau viṣaye yā upalabdhiḥ cākṣuṣī sā aneka dravya samavāyāt rūpāt ca iti tatra paramāṇoḥ rūpavataḥ api cākṣuṣa tva nivṛtti artham aneka dravya samavāyāt iti uktam

original: anekatvaṃ cātra bahutvamabhipretam; tena dvyaṇukasyāpyacākṣuṣatvamuktaṃ bhavati | anekadravyasamavetasyāpi vāyoścākṣuṣatvanivṛttyarthaṃ rūpādityuktam | yadvā anekadravyasamavāyāditi mahattvopalakṣaṇam; tena mahattvādityarthaḥ | tatra mahattvena paramāṇudvyaṇukayornivṛttiḥ, rūpādityanena ca vāyavāderiti |

original: etaduktaṃ bhavati—guṇakarmādernīrūpasyāpi dravyasamavāyācākṣuṣatvam, na dravyasya; tasya tu rūpādeva cākṣuṣatvam | ataḥ paṭasya citrarūpānabhyupagame tasyācākṣuṣatvaprasaṅga iti | kiṃca svayamarūpasyāpyasti ceccākṣuṣatvam, tato ghaṭāderapi rūpistvāvayavasamavāyena cākṣuṣatvopagateḥ svayamarūpatvaṃ syāt |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati guṇa karma ādeḥ nīrūpasya api dravya samavāya acākṣuṣa tvam na dravyasya tasya tu rūpāt eva cākṣuṣa tvam atas paṭasya citra rūpa anabhyupagame tasya acākṣuṣa tva prasaṅgaḥ iti kiṃca svayam arūpasya api asti ced cākṣuṣa tvam tatas ghaṭa ādeḥ api rūpistva avayava samavāyena cākṣuṣa tva upagateḥ svayam arūpa tvam syāt

original: atha dravyasyārūpasya cākṣuṣatvaṃ neṣṭamiti ghaṭādernīrūpatvaprasaṅgaḥ, tataścitre'pi paṭe tathaiva syāditi so'pi nārūpaḥ | ato'sti citraṃ rūpam | taccaikamapi nīlādiprabhedenāvabhāsata ityekasya nānāvabhāsaḥ | tathā nagarabuddhetvailokyabuddheśca bhedābhāve'pi svata ekatve'pi gṛhaprāsādādibhedena nānāva-
analyzed: atha dravyasya arūpasya cākṣuṣa tvam na iṣṭam iti ghaṭa ādeḥ nīrūpa tva prasaṅgaḥ tatas citre api paṭe tathā eva syāt iti saḥ api nā arūpaḥ atas sti citram rūpam tat ca ekam api nīla ādi prabhedena avabhāsate iti ekasya nānā avabhāsaḥ tathā nagara buddheḥ tvailokya buddheḥ ca bheda abhāve pi svatas ekatve pi gṛha prāsāda ādi bhedena nānā avabhāsaḥ

original: bhāsitvaṃ dṛṣṭam | paratantre'pyetatsiddhamiti darśayituṃ viṣayākāra ityādyuktam | ca ca vācyaṃ buddherākārā nānāvabhāsante, na buddhiḥ; ato naikaṃ nānāvabhāsata iti; yasmādekabuddhitattvāvyatirekātparasparamapi teṣāṃ tattvato bhedo nāsti, api tu bhrāntiḥ | kimuta buddheḥ sakāśāt | tasmādbuddhireva nānāvabhāsata iti |
analyzed: bhāsi tvam dṛṣṭam paratantre api etat siddham iti darśayitum viṣaya ākāraḥ ityādi uktam ca ca vācyam buddheḥ ākārāḥ nānā avabhāsante na buddhiḥ atas na ekam nānā avabhāsate iti yasmāt eka buddhi tattva avyatirekāt parasparam api teṣām tattvataḥ bhedaḥ nā asti api tu bhrāntiḥ kim uta buddheḥ sakāśāt tasmāt buddhiḥ eva nānā avabhāsate iti

original: buddhyavyatirekaśca pareṣāṃ svatantre siddhaḥ | atha matam—yeṣu nīlapītādayo guṇāḥ samavetāḥ, teṣveva paṭāvayavī; tatra citraguṇasya samavāyo yaḥ, sa eva nīlādibhiḥ saha citraguṇasyetyekārthasamavetasamavāyalakṣaṇaḥ saṃsargaḥ | tata eva nīlādigataṃ nānātvaṃ citre pratibhāti | tenaiṣo'pi saṃsargasya mahimā |
analyzed: buddhi avyatirekaḥ ca pareṣām svatantre siddhaḥ atha nīla pīta ādayaḥ guṇāḥ samavetāḥ teṣu eva paṭa avayavī tatra citra guṇasya samavāyaḥ yaḥ saḥ eva nīla ādibhiḥ saha citra guṇasya iti ekārtha samaveta samavāya lakṣaṇaḥ saṃsargaḥ tatas eva nīla ādi gatam nānātvam citre pratibhāti tena eṣaḥ api saṃsargasya mahimā

original: atastanmahimaiva jātivyaktī bhinne apyabhinne pratibhāsyata iti cettatrāha—na ceti | P. 62-7. saṃbandhapūrvakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ saṃsargo na bhavati; kutaḥ? vyavadhānādityarthaḥ | nanu vyavadhāne'pi saṃsargo bhavati; yathā—dravyasaṃyuktasya cakṣuṣo rūpeṇetyata bhāha—saṃśleṣo hīti | saṃśleṣo hi saṃsargaḥ;

original: tasmācca parasyāyogolakasya parasyāgre rūpeṇāvabhāso bhavati; na yataḥ kutaścit saṃbandhāt | sa ca saṃśleṣo'tyantamavyavadhāne yujyate; naikavyavadhāne'pi | tantugatasya nīlādirūpasya paṭagatasya citrarūpasya ca tantupaṭadvayena vyavadhānāstutarāṃ saṃśleṣo na yujyata ityarthaḥ | vyartho ceyaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣayoratyantabhedakarupanetyāha—kiṃcetti |
analyzed: tasmāt ca parasya ayaḥ golakasya parasya agre rūpeṇa avabhāsaḥ bhavati na yatas kutaścid saṃbandhāt sa ca saṃśleṣa utyantam avyavadhāne yujyate na eka vyavadhāne api tantu gatasya nīla ādi rūpasya paṭa gatasya citra rūpasya ca tantu paṭa dvayena saṃśleṣaḥ na yujyate iti arthaḥ ca iyam sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ atyanta bhedaka rupanā iti āha kiṃca iti

original: ‘gāṃ śuṅkāmānaya’ iti jātiguṇopādhau vyavahāre vyavahārāṅgabhūtā sarvā dhīrte yathārthā yadā, tadā sāmānyaviśeṣayorbhāvayorbhedakarupanā vyarthetyarthaḥ | tadvyācaṣṭe—yasyeti |
analyzed: gām śuṅkām ānaya iti jāti guṇa upādhau vyavahāre vyavahāra aṅga bhūtā sarvā dhīrte yathārthā yadā tadā sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ bhāvayoḥ bhedaka rupanā vyarthā iti arthaḥ tat vyācaṣṭe yasya iti

original: yasya sāmānyaviśeṣayoratyantabhedavādinaḥ ‘śuṅko gauḥ’ ityādyā buddhayo vyavahārāṅgabhūtā dravyeṣu guṇajātyupadhānena tadanurañjanena tadvyāvāpatyā tadabhedena bhavanti, tasya tā buddhayo na yathāvastu; anyathābuddhaya ityarthaḥ | kutaḥ? jātiguṇābhyāṃ dravyasyārthāntaratvāt bhedāt; bhinnaṃ vastu; buddhayaścābhedena;
analyzed: yasya sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ atyanta bheda vādinaḥ śuṅkaḥ gauḥ ityādyāḥ buddhayaḥ vyavahāra aṅga bhūtāḥ dravyeṣu guṇa jāti upadhānena tad anurañjanena tad vyāvāpatyā tad abhedena bhavanti tasya tāḥ buddhayaḥ na yathāvastu anyathā buddhayaḥ iti arthaḥ kutas jāti guṇābhyām dravyasya artha antara tvāt bhedāt bhinnam vastu buddhayaḥ ca abhedena

original: ato na yathāvastu tā ityarthaḥ | tulyanyāyatvādguṇopanyāsaḥ, vyāvṛttabuddhipradarśanārtho vā | tataḥ kimityāha—tathā ceti; tathā sati bhinnavastunibandhano vyavahāro na syādityarthaḥ | kuta ityāha—
analyzed: atas na yathāvastu tāḥ iti arthaḥ tulya nyāyatvāt guṇa upanyāsaḥ vyāvṛtta buddhi pradarśana arthaḥ vā tatas kim iti āha tathā ca iti tathā sati bhinna vastu nibandhanaḥ vyavahāraḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ kutas ityāha

original: P. 62-16 buddhyeti | jñātaṃ hi vyavahārāṅgaṃ bhavati, nājñātam | ajñātaṃ ca bhinnaṃ vastu; tato na vyavahārāṅgamityarthaḥ | tathābhāvāditi; vyavahārāṅgatvadityarthaḥ | tathāpi kimityāha—evaṃ ceti | satyapi jātiguṇabhyāṃ dravyāṇāṃ bhede, buddhimātraparigatena jātiguṇabhyāmabhinnaivārthena 'gauḥ' ityanuvṛttaḥ 'śuklaḥ' iti vyāvṛtto vyavahāro hṛśyate;
analyzed: buddhyā iti jñātam hi vyavahāra aṅgam bhavati na ajñātam ajñātam ca bhinnam vastu tatas na vyavahāra aṅgam iti arthaḥ tathā bhāvāt iti vyavahāra aṅga tvat iti arthaḥ tathā api kim iti āha evam ca iti sati api jāti guṇabhyām dravyāṇām bhede buddhi mātra parigatena jāti guṇabhyām abhinnā eva arthena gauḥ iti anuvṛttaḥ śuklaḥ iti vyāvṛttaḥ vyavahāraḥ hṛśyate

original: ato vastubhedasya vyavahārānupayogādabhedasyaiva ca tadupayogāt vyartho vastubhedābhyupagama ityarthaḥ | itaśca vyarthaḥ—yato vyāvahārikabuddhīnāṃ yathārthatvāya vastubhedaḥ kalpyate; tasmin kalpite'pi 'śuklaḥ' ityādivyāvahārikabuddhīnāṃ jātiguṇopādhitvāt tadabhedenotpatternāyathārthatvaparihāraḥ; ato vyathā vastubhedakalpanetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: atas vastu bhedasya vyavahāra anupayogāt abhedasya eva ca tad upayogāt vyarthaḥ vastu bheda abhyupagamaḥ iti arthaḥ itas ca vyarthaḥ yatas vyāvahārika buddhīnām yathārtha tvāya vastu bhedaḥ kalpyate tasmin kalpite api śuklaḥ ityādi vyāvahārika buddhīnām jāti guṇa upādhi tvāt tad abhedena utpatteḥ na ayathārtha tva parihāraḥ atas vyathā vastu bheda kalpanā iti arthaḥ

original: parastu vastubhedakalpanāyāḥ sārthatvamāha—syāditi | sthāṇau puruṣabuddhiḥ śuklau rajatabuddhirūddhvatārūpasāmānyahetukā dṛṣṭā | tasmāt 'gauḥ' śuklaḥ' ityabhedabuddherayathārthāyā api hetunā bhāvyam | yadi ca dve vastunī syātāṃ tataste sāmānādhikaraṇyatayā pratibhātaḥ |
analyzed: paraḥ tu vastu bheda kalpanāyāḥ sārtha tvam āha syāt iti sthāṇau puruṣa buddhiḥ śuklau rajata buddhiḥ ūddhva tā rūpa sāmānya hetukā dṛṣṭā tasmāt gauḥ śuklaḥ iti abheda buddheḥ ayathārthāyāḥ api hetunā bhāvyam yadi ca dve vastunī syātām tatas te sāmānādhikaraṇya tayā pratibhātaḥ

original: nāsati vastubhede anuvṛttavyāvṛttarūpagrāhi vyāvahārikamayathārthamabhedajñānaṃ syāt; hetvabhāvāt; ato vastubhedakalpanāyā vyavahārānaṅgatve'pi vyavahārāṅgabhūtā yathārthasāmānādhikaraṇyabuddhibījatvānna vyarthatvamityarthaḥ | taddūṣayati—ucyata iti | nirbījā cenna bhrāntiḥ, avidyābījā bhaviṣyati; alaṃ vastubhedakalpanayetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: na asati vastu bhede anuvṛtta vyāvṛtta rūpa grāhi vyāvahārikam ayathārtham abheda jñānam syāt hetu abhāvāt atas vastu bheda kalpanāyāḥ vyavahāra anaṅga tve pi vyavahāra aṅga bhūtā yathārtha sāmānādhikaraṇya buddhi bīja tvāt na vyartha tvam iti arthaḥ tat dūṣayati ucyate iti nirbījā ced na bhrāntiḥ avidyā bījā bhaviṣyati alam vastu bheda kalpanayā iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ saṃsargavādino mataṃ dūṣayitvā anekāntavādino mataṃ dūṣayitumavatārayati—astviti | sāmānyaviśeṣātmakamekaṃ vastvastvityarthaḥ | asya matasya pūrvasmādatyantabhedapakṣācadgatadoṣābhāvena viśeṣamāha—evamiti | sāmānyaviśeṣayoratyantabhede 'gaurayam, śuklo'yam' ityaikātmyaprakhyā nāvakalpata ityuktam;
analyzed: evam saṃsarga vādinaḥ matam dūṣayitvā anekānta vādinaḥ matam dūṣayitum avatārayati astu iti sāmānya viśeṣa ātmakam ekam vastu astu iti arthaḥ asya matasya viśeṣam āha evam iti sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ atyanta bhede gauḥ ayam śuklaḥ yam iti aikātmya prakhyā na avakalpate iti uktam

original: tattāvadiha nāsti, vastunaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣātmakatvenābhedapratipacyupapatteḥ | yadapi samavāyākhyasaṃbandharūpasyārthasya bhedāntardhānasāmarthyaṃ kalpitam, tacca saṃbandhavastuno bhedaviṣayatvāt viparītabhinnayorahetutvādvā vastuviparītam; tadapi na bhavati ekasyādhyātmatvena vastunaḥ svayamevābhedāt | tathā vastuno dvyātmakatve
analyzed: tat tāvat iha nā asti vastunaḥ sāmānya viśeṣa ātmaka tvena abheda pratipacī upapatteḥ yat api samavāya ākhya saṃbandha rūpasya arthasya bheda antardhāna sāmarthyam kalpitam tat ca saṃbandha vastunaḥ bheda viṣaya tvāt viparīta bhinnayoḥ ahetu tvāt vā vastu viparītam tat api na bhavati ekasya adhyātma tvena vastunaḥ svayam evā abhedāt tathā vastunaḥ dvi ātmaka tve

original: ‘gauḥ śuklaḥ’ ityādivyavahāro vastunibandhano bhavati ; tena ‘vyavahāre paropādhau’ iti vyāvahārikajñānānāṃ yadayathārthatvamuktaṃ tadapi na bhavati | tasmātsādhurayaṃ pakṣa ityastu sa eva | virodhamāśaṅkayati—syāditi | P. 63-7. virodhamāha—ekamiti | ekaṃ tadviparītamanekamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: gauḥ śuklaḥ ityādi vyavahāraḥ vastu nibandhanaḥ bhavati tena vyavahāre para upādhau iti vyāvahārika jñānānām yat ayathārtha tvam uktam tat api na bhavati tasmāt sādhuḥ ayam pakṣaḥ iti astu saḥ eva virodham āśaṅkayati syāt iti virodham āha ekam iti ekam tad viparītam anekam iti arthaḥ

original: prakārāntareṇa virodhāt dvayorekatvasya duravagamatvamāha—api ceti | tatpariharati—neti | yat pramāṇena pratīyate tadaviruddham, yathā rasabati rūpam ; tato'nyadviruddham, yathoṣṇe śaityam | tasmādyadyathā pramāṇena pramīyate tattathaiva yuktam | tatra pramāṇamanāhatya cedvirodho'bhidhīyate, tato virodhāvirodhavyavasthā nirhetukaiva syāt |
analyzed: prakāra antareṇa virodhāt dvayoḥ eka tvasya duravagama tvam āha api ca iti tat pariharati na iti yat pramāṇena pratīyate tat aviruddham yathā rūpam tatonyat viruddham yathā uṣṇe śaityam tasmāt yat yathā pramāṇena pramīyate tat tathā eva yuktam tatra pramāṇam an āhatya ced virodhaḥ abhidhīyate tatas virodha avirodha vyavasthā nirhetukā eva syāt

original: tasmādyat pramāṇena pramīyate tadaviruddham ; pramīyate caikaṃ vyātmakam ; tathā hyanuvṛttivyāvṛttirūpeṇa buddhibhedāt vyātmakatvam, sāmānādhikaraṇyena cāvagamādekatvamityarthaḥ | tadevamanekāntavādimatamavatārya dūṣayati—tadidamiti | hetumāha—yat iti | vyātmakavastujñānamapramāṇam, vipratiṣiddhārthatvāt, saṃśayajñānavadityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt yat pramāṇena pramīyate tat aviruddham pramīyate ca ekam vyātmakam tathā hi anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti rūpeṇa buddhi bhedāt vyātmaka tvam sāmānādhikaraṇyena ca avagamāt ekatvam iti arthaḥ tat evam anekāntavādi matam avatārya dūṣayati tat idam iti hetum āha yat iti vyātmaka vastu jñānam apramāṇam vipratiṣiddha artha tvāt saṃśaya jñāna vat iti arthaḥ

original: svarūpaviparyayo'tra vipratiṣedhaḥ, na sahānavasthānam ; sa cāstyekatvānekatvayoriti na hetvasiddhirāśaṅkyā | yadi tvekasya dvyātmakatvajñānaṃ vipratiṣiddhārthamapi pramāṇaṃ syāt, tatastulyatvāt saṃśayajñānamapi pramāṇaṃ syāt ; tataśca saṃśayyamāno'pyartho dvyātmā syāt ; na tvetadiṣṭamityabhiprāyeṇāha—anyatheti | atra hetumāha—dvyātmeti |
analyzed: svarūpa viparyayaḥ atra vipratiṣedhaḥ na saha anavasthānam sa ca asti ekatva anekatvayoḥ iti na hetu asiddhiḥ āśaṅkyā yadi tu ekasya dvi ātmaka tva jñānam vipratiṣiddha artham api pramāṇam syāt tatas tulya tvāt saṃśaya jñānam api pramāṇam syāt tatas ca saṃśayyamānaḥ api arthaḥ dvi ātmā syāt na tu etat iṣṭam iti abhiprāyeṇa āha anyathā iti atra hetum āha dvi ātmā iti

original: yathā ‘gaurayam’ iti jñānamanuvṛttavyāvṛttākāram, tathā saṃśayajñānamapi sthāṇupuruṣadvyātmakākāram ; yathā ca tatra sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tathā saṃśaye'pi tadākārayoḥ sthāṇupuruṣayoḥ | ato dvyātmakavastutulyatvāt saṃśayaviṣayo'pi dvyātmā syādityarthaḥ | atrātulyatvamāśaṅkayati—atheti |
analyzed: yathā gauḥ ayam iti jñānam anuvṛtta vyāvṛtta ākāram tathā saṃśaya jñānam api sthāṇu puruṣa dvi ātmaka ākāram yathā ca tatra sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam tathā saṃśaye api tad ākārayoḥ sthāṇu puruṣayoḥ atas dvi ātmaka vastu tulya tvāt saṃśaya viṣayaḥ api dvi ātmā syāt iti arthaḥ atra atulya tvam āśaṅkayati atha iti

original: yathā sāmānyaviśeṣavatyarthe ‘gauśrāyaṃ śāntyeyaśrāyam’ iti samuccayapratītiḥ, na tathā saṃśaya ityarthaḥ | atrottaramāha—mā bhūditi | para āha—so'pīti | na hyekameva vastu pakṣe sthāṇuḥ pakṣe puruṣa ityupapadyate, tasya vyavasthitaikarūpasya svahetuta utpatteḥ ; taduktam—“na hi vastu vikalpyate” iti |
analyzed: yathā sāmānya viśeṣavati arthe gauśrāyam iti samuccaya pratītiḥ na tathā saṃśayaḥ iti arthaḥ atra uttaram āha mā bhūt iti paraḥ āha saḥ upi iti na hi ekam eva vastu pakṣe sthāṇuḥ pakṣe puruṣaḥ iti upapadyate tasya vyavasthita ekarūpasya sva hetutaḥ utpatteḥ tat uktam na hi vastu vikalpyate iti

original: siddhāntī tu yadi vastuno vikalpo'nupapanna iti neṣyate, ekasyāpi tarhi dvyātmatā
analyzed: siddhāntī tu yadi vastunaḥ vikalpaḥ anupapannaḥ iti nā iṣyate ekasya api tarhi dvi ātma tā

original: virodhādanupapanneti sāpi na syādityarthaḥ | atrāpi svarūpaviparyayo virodhaḥ, na sahānavasthānam, tasya sādhyatvāt | tadevaṃ sati yajñavati P. 63-20. tadāha—tatreti | aikādhikaraṇyādityasyānantaram 'apramāṇam' ityanuvartanīyam | nanu saṃśayajñānaṃ na virodhādapramāṇam; api tu sthāṇupuruṣayoranyataranirṇayajñānena bādhanāt |
analyzed: virodhāt anupapannā iti sā api na syāt iti arthaḥ atra api svarūpa viparyayaḥ virodhaḥ na saha anavasthānam tasya sādhya tvāt tat evam sati yajñavati tat āha tatra iti aikādhikaraṇyāt iti asya anantaram apramāṇam iti anuvartanīyam nanu saṃśaya jñānam na virodhāt apramāṇam api tu sthāṇu puruṣayoḥ anyatara nirṇaya jñānena bādhanāt

original: tacca sāmānyaviśeṣapratīternāsti | ataḥ satyapi virodhe bādhakābhāvāt sā pramāṇameva | ataḥ saṃśayavadvipratiṣedhāt sāmānyaviśeṣajñānamapramāṇamityuktamayuktamityabhiprāyeṇa codayati—syāditi | siddhāntī tvāha—yatreti |
analyzed: tat ca sāmānya viśeṣa pratīteḥ na asti atas sati api virodhe bādhaka abhāvāt sā pramāṇam eva atas saṃśaya vat vipratiṣedhāt sāmānya viśeṣa jñānam apramāṇam iti uktam ayuktam iti abhiprāyeṇa codayati syāt iti siddhāntī tvāha yatra iti

original: yadi saṃśayasya nirṇayena bādhanānna prāmāṇyam, evaṃ tarhi yatra pāśupatanikhātapṛthivīmadhyopalakṣaṇakīlakanirdeśāt 'madhyam, amadhyaṃ vā' iti saṃśayastatraikasya vikalpyamānadvyātmataiva syāt; na caivamiṣṭam | ato virodhādevāprāmāṇyam | evaṃ cet tato'satyapi bādhane sāmānyaviśeṣapratīteḥ saṃśayavadvirodhādapramāṇyamiti sūktamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yadi saṃśayasya nirṇayena bādhanāt na prāmāṇyam evam tarhi yatra pāśupata nikhāta pṛthivī madhya upalakṣaṇa kīlaka nirdeśāt madhyam amadhyam vā iti saṃśayaḥ tatra ekasya vikalpyamāna dvi ātma tā eva syāt na ca evam iṣṭam atas virodhāt eva aprāmāṇyam evam ced bādhane sāmānya viśeṣa pratīteḥ saṃśaya vat virodhāt apramāṇyam iti su uktam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ viruddhātmatvena sāmānyaviśeṣajñānasya saṃśayavadpramāṇyamuktam | idānīmekatvānekatvajñānayorviruddhārthayorekenaikanirākṛtau na dvyātmatā; parasparanirākṛtau tu saṃśayatulyatvamityāha—api ceti |
analyzed: evam viruddha ātma tvena sāmānya viśeṣa jñānasya saṃśaya vat pramāṇyam uktam idānīm ekatva anekatva jñānayoḥ viruddha arthayoḥ ekena eka nirākṛtau na dvi ātmatā paraspara nirākṛtau tu saṃśaya tulya tvam iti āha api ca iti

original: rajatajñānasya śuktijñānena bādhāyāmekasya rajatajñānasya śuktijñānena balīyasā nirākaraṇāt bādhanādaprāmāṇyaṃ yathā, tathā ekatvānekatvajñānayorvirodhe'pi dvayorekasya vā jñānasyāprāmāṇyam | kutaḥ? viruddhayorekānekatvarūpayormahaṇe viruddharūpa grāhiṇorjñānayoranyānyanirākaraṇāt |
analyzed: rajata jñānasya śukti jñānena bādhāyām ekasya rajata jñānasya śukti jñānena balīyasā nirākaraṇāt bādhanāt aprāmāṇyam yathā tathā ekatva anekatva jñānayoḥ virodhe pi dvayoḥ ekasya vā jñānasya aprāmāṇyam kutas viruddhayoḥ eka anekatva rūpayoḥ mahaṇe viruddha rūpa grāhiṇoḥ jñānayoḥ anya anya nirākaraṇāt

original: tatra yadyekaṃ balavat tato rajatādijñānavadekasya nirākaraṇe parasmāt śuktijñānādiva niścayaḥ; tatraikameva vā vastu syāt, dvyātmakaṃ vā; na tvekaṃ dvyātmakaṃ ca | viruddhāvyabhicārihetudvayavat tulyabalayoḥ parasparanirākṛtau tu bādhāyāmekatvadvyātmakatvayorniścayābhāvādāpannaṃ saṃśayatulyatvaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣapratipatteḥ |
analyzed: tatra yadi ekam balavat tatas rajata ādi jñāna vat ekasya nirākaraṇe parasmāt śukti jñānāt iva niścayaḥ tatra ekam eva vā vastu syāt dvi ātmakam vā na tu ekam dvi ātmakam ca viruddha avyabhicāri hetu dvaya vat tulya balayoḥ paraspara nirākṛtau tu bādhāyām ekatva dvi ātmaka tvayoḥ niścaya abhāvāt āpannam saṃśaya tulya tvam sāmānya viśeṣa pratipatteḥ

original: tasmādekāntena naikaṃ nāpyanekaṃ vastu, kiṃtu ekaṃ dvyātmakaṃ cetyetadvāhi jñānaṃ suniścitamiti svapakṣavarṇanamātramidam; na bhūtaṃ tathetyarthaḥ | itaśca naikaṃ dvyātmakamityāha—api ceti | ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe— avaśyamityādi | avaśyamid jātivyaktyādipadārthānāṃ bhedābhedavyavasthāṃ
analyzed: tasmāt ekāntena na ekam na api anekam vastu kiṃtu ekam dvi ātmakam ca iti etad vāhi jñānam su niścitam iti sva pakṣa varṇana mātram idam na bhūtam tathā iti arthaḥ itas ca na ekam dvi ātmakam iti āha api ca iti ślokam vyācaṣṭe avaśyam ityādi avaśyam id jāti vyakti ādi padārthānām bheda abheda vyavasthām

original: kurvatānena sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ pratyekaṃ bhedābhedayorlakṣaṇaṃ tāvadavaśyaṃ vācyam | pratyekaṃ ca tayoḥ rūpavirodhāvirodhāvanyonyābhāvatadviparyayarūpau bhedābhedalakṣaṇe ; yato rūpavirodhādanyonyābhāvarūpādviśeṣāṇāmanyonyabhedaḥ, tadviparyayācca teṣu bhinneṣu sāmānyamabhinnam |
analyzed: kurvatā anena sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ pratyekam bheda abhedayoḥ lakṣaṇam tāvat avaśyam vācyam pratyekam ca tayoḥ rūpa virodha avirodhau anyonya abhāva tad viparyaya rūpau bheda abheda lakṣaṇe yatas rūpa virodhāt anyonya abhāva rūpāt viśeṣāṇām anyonya bhedaḥ tad viparyayāt ca teṣu bhinneṣu sāmānyam abhinnam

original: tatraitādṛśi bhedābhedalakṣaṇe yadi sāmānyaviśeṣayorapi virodhā'nyonyābhāvarūpaḥ, tato viśeṣāṇāmiva nānyonyabhekatvam | atha sāmānyaviśeṣabuddhyoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyenotpattiḥ, ato na tau viruddhatvabhāvāvityavirodhena tayorekatvamucyate ;
analyzed: tatra etādṛśi bheda abheda lakṣaṇe yadi sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ api virodha anyonya abhāva rūpaḥ tatas viśeṣāṇām iva na anyonya bheka tvam atha sāmānya viśeṣa buddhyoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena utpattiḥ atas na tau viruddha tva bhāvau iti avirodhena tayoḥ ekatvam ucyate

original: tato rūpavirodhasya bhedalakṣaṇasyābhāvādasati bhede bhedādhiṣṭhānadvitvābhāvādyathā sāmānyabhāgo viśeṣabhāgaśrāntirbhaktaḥ pratyekamavāntaravibhāgarahito na dvirūpaḥ, tathā sāmānyaviśeṣayorapi rūpavirodhābhāvādasati bhede bhedādhiṣṭhānadvitvābhāvāt naikaṃ dvyātmakam | sāmānādhikaraṇyabuddheriti rūpavirodhābhāve hetuḥ | P. 64-15.
analyzed: tatas rūpa virodhasya bheda lakṣaṇasya abhāvāt asati bhede bheda adhiṣṭhāna dvi tva abhāvāt yathā sāmānya bhāgaḥ viśeṣa bhāga śrāntiḥ bhaktaḥ pratyekam avāntara vibhāga rahitaḥ na dvi rūpaḥ tathā sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ api rūpa virodha abhāvāt asati bhede bheda adhiṣṭhāna dvi tva abhāvāt na ekam dvi ātmakam sāmānādhikaraṇya buddheḥ iti rūpa virodha abhāve hetuḥ

original: yadītyādinā cāyabhevārthaḥ saṃkṣipya spaṣṭīkṛta iti | atha matam—yadi rūpavirodhādanyonyābhāvalakṣaṇānnānātvaṃ tadviparyayācaikatvaṃ syāt, tataḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayo rūpavirodhābhāvādanyatarāṃśavat dvitvaṃ na syāt ; na caivam ; kiṃtu yatra dvirūpā buddhistatra nānātvam, yatra caikarūpā tatraikatvam |
analyzed: yadi ityādinā saṃkṣipya spaṣṭīkṛtaḥ iti atha matam yadi rūpa virodhāt anyonya abhāva lakṣaṇāt nānātvam tad viparyayāt ca ekatvam syāt tatas sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ rūpa virodha abhāvāt anyatara aṃśa vat dvitvam na syāt na ca evam kiṃtu yatra dvi rūpā buddhiḥ tatra nānātvam yatra ca eka rūpā tatra ekatvam

original: ataśca sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ 'gaurayam' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena pratīterasatyapyanyonyābhāvalakṣaṇavirodhe'dvirūpabuddhivedyatvādekatvam ; ato vastuno dvirūpabuddhivedyatvāt dvyātmateti ; tatrocyate—aikānyeti | aikānyabuddhirekarūpā buddhiḥ ;
analyzed: atas ca sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ gauḥ ayam iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena pratīteḥ asati api anyonya abhāva lakṣaṇa virodhe dvi rūpa buddhi vedya tvāt ekatvam atas vastunaḥ dvi rūpa buddhi vedya tvāt dvi ātma tā iti tatra ucyate aikānyā iti aikānya buddhiḥ eka rūpā buddhiḥ

original: tayoḥ samuccitena bhedalakṣaṇena virahādeśavat dvyātmatā na syādityuktaṃ 'dvyātmatā katham' ityatra | P. 65-9 atha matam—buddhirūpābhedaḥ parasparātmapratipattiśca dve pratyekamabhedalakṣaṇe ; tadubhayābhāvaśca samuccito bhedalakṣaṇamiti | tataḥ sāmānyāṃśasya viśeṣāṃśasya ca buddhirūpābhedādabhedalakṣaṇāt pratyekamekatvam |
analyzed: tayoḥ samuccitena bheda lakṣaṇena viraha ādeśa vat dvi ātmatā na syāt iti uktam dvi ātmatā katham iti atra atha matam buddhi rūpa abhedaḥ paraspara ātma pratipattiḥ ca dve pratyekam abheda lakṣaṇe tad ubhaya abhāvaḥ ca samuccitaḥ bheda lakṣaṇam iti tatas sāmānya aṃśasya viśeṣa aṃśasya ca buddhi rūpa abhedāt abheda lakṣaṇāt pratyekam ekatvam

original: yadi tu tanneṣyate tato nirvījāvakalpanāpi na syādityāha— anyathati | siddhāntī tvāha—ka iti | bhedaprasaṅga iti | sāmānyaviśeṣau dve vastunī syātāmityarthaḥ | nāpyaṃśo vastuno'nyat svayaṃ vastvityāha—nāpāti | atha na vastvevāṃśaḥ, nāpi vastuno'nyaḥ, svayaṃ vastvityucyate, tataḥ pariśeṣāt kalpanāviṣaya eva syāt;
analyzed: yadi tu tat na iṣyate tatas nirvījau akalpanā api na syāt iti āha anyathā iti siddhāntī tu āhakaḥ iti bheda prasaṅgaḥ iti sāmānya viśeṣau dve vastunī syātām iti arthaḥ na api aṃśaḥ vastunaḥ anyat svayam vastu iti āha atha na vastu eva aṃśaḥ na api vastunaḥ anyaḥ svayam vastu iti ucyate tatas pariśeṣāt kalpanā viṣayaḥ eva syāt

original: taccānyatvābhyāṃ vastuno bhinnābhinnatvādanirvācyo yata ityarthaḥ | atra paraśrodayati—nanviti | nāṃśaḥ aṃśino'tyantabhinno nāpyabhinna ityarthaḥ | atra hetumāha—ubhayatheti | bhede'pyaṃśo na bhavati, yathā ghaṭasya na paṭaḥ; nābhede'pi, yathā ghaṭasya ghaṭaḥ | ato nāṃśaḥ aṃśino bhinno nāpyabhinna ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tat ca anyatvābhyām vastunaḥ bhinna abhinna tvāt anirvācyaḥ yatas iti arthaḥ atra nanu iti na aṃśaḥ aṃśinā utyanta bhinnaḥ na api abhinnaḥ iti arthaḥ atra hetum āha ubhayathā iti bhede api aṃśaḥ na bhavati yathā ghaṭasya na paṭaḥ na abhede api yathā ghaṭasya ghaṭaḥ atas na aṃśaḥ aṃśinaḥ bhinnaḥ na api abhinnaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu tattvātaccābhyāmanirvācyatvādavastu tarhītyāśaṅkyāha—nāpīti | ata eveti; aṃśatvādeva; na hyavastunaḥ aṃśatvaṃ dṛṣṭam; na hi svapuṣpādyavastu kasyacidaṃśo bhavatītyathaḥ | tataḥ kimityata āha—tatreti | tasya tadavyatirekādityabhedābhiprāyam | taddūṣayati—naitaditi |
analyzed: nanu tattva ataccābhyām anirvācya tvāt avastu tarhi iti āśaṅkya āha na api iti atas eva iti aṃśa tvāt eva na hi avastunaḥ aṃśa tvam dṛṣṭam na hi sva puṣpa ādi avastu kasyacid aṃśaḥ bhavati iti athaḥ tatas kim iti atas āha tatra iti tasya tad avyatirekāt iti abheda abhiprāyam tat dūṣayati na etat iti

original: yadi sāmānyāṃśasya viśeṣāntare'nugamādvastuno'nugama ucyate, tato viśeṣāṃśānanugamādananugamaḥ kasmānna syādityarthaḥ | nanu sāmānyāṃśena vastuno'nugamo'pyastīti nātyantabhedavādaprasaṅga ityāśaṅkya vastuno'nanugamamāha—api ceti | vastunaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣadvayarūpatvādekasya viśeṣāṃśasya vyavatyantareṣvabhāve vastunasteṣvabhāvāt sāmānyānugame'pi na
analyzed: yadi sāmānya aṃśasya viśeṣa antara anugamāt vastunaḥ anugamaḥ ucyate tatas viśeṣa aṃśa ananugamāt ananugamaḥ kasmāt na syāt iti arthaḥ nanu sāmānya aṃśena vastunaḥ anugamaḥ upi asti iti na atyanta bheda vāda prasaṅgaḥ iti āśaṅkya vastunaḥ ananugamam āha api ca iti vastunaḥ sāmānya viśeṣa dvaya rūpa tvāt ekasya viśeṣa aṃśasya vyavati antareṣu abhāve vastunaḥ teṣu abhāvāt sāmānya anugame api na anya anugamaḥ asti

original: vastuno'nugama ityarthaḥ | etadeva sādhayati—tathā hīti | samāhāraḥ P. 67-2. samuccayaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam | evaṃ viśeṣāṃśānugamādvedavādaprasaṅgamāpādya adhunā sāmānyāṃśānugamāmyupagame satyabhedavādaṃ prasaṅgayati—yadi veti | sāmānyāṃśānugamāttasya vastvavyatirekādvastvanugame'bhyupagamyamānaṃ sati, advaitavādaḥ prasajyeta ;
analyzed: vastunaḥ anugamaḥ iti arthaḥ etat eva sādhayati tathā hi iti samāhāraḥ samuccayaḥ śeṣam sugamam evam viśeṣa aṃśa anugamāt veda vāda prasaṅgam āpādya adhunā sāmānya aṃśa anugama amyupagame sati abheda vādam prasaṅgayati yadi vā iti sāmānya aṃśa anugamāt tasya vastu avyatirekāt vastu anugame abhyupagamyamānam sati advaita vādaḥ prasajyeta

original: tathā hi—gaustāvat svayaṃ gauḥ, so'śvasya dravyatvādisāmānyāṃśānugamāt aśvavastuno'pyanugamādaśvo'pi syāt ; tataśca gaurgauraśvaḥ ; evamaśvo'pyaśvo gauśca ; tataśca gorgautvamaśvatvaṃ ca, aśvasyāpyaśvatvaṃ gotvaṃ ceti so'yaṃ tadbhāvo'nyabhāvaḥ, tābhyāṃ gavāśvayorabhedaḥ | evamanyeṣāmapi bhāvānām | ato vacanavyaktyantareṇādvaitamevoktamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi gauḥ tāvat svayam gauḥ sā uśvasya dravya tva ādi sāmānya aṃśa anugamāt aśva vastunā upi anugamāt aśvaḥ api syāt tatas ca gauḥ gauḥ aśvaḥ evam aśvaḥ upi aśvaḥ gauḥ ca tatas ca goḥ gau tvam aśva tvam ca aśvasya api aśva tvam go tvam ca iti saḥ yam tad bhāvaḥ nyabhāvaḥ tābhyām gava aśvayoḥ abhedaḥ evam anyeṣām api bhāvānām atas vacana vyakti antareṇa advaitam eva uktam iti arthaḥ

original: tadbhāvānyabhāvābhyāmiti ‘tadatattvataḥ’ ityasya vivaraṇam | etāvatā ca tadatattvāṃ pratyekaṃ tvasya saṃbandhaḥ, pañcamyantāttasilityuktam | taccātacca tadatadī, tadatadorbhāvastadatattvam, tata iti vyutpattiḥ | nanu satyamadvaitam ; kiṃtu bhāvānyabhāvābhyāmabheda iti tvayaivoktam ; ataśca gauraśvasyābhāvaścet tato dvaitamapyasti ;
analyzed: tad bhāva anyabhāvābhyām iti tad atattvataḥ iti asya vivaraṇam etāvatā ca pratyekam tvasya saṃbandhaḥ pañcamī antāt tasil iti uktam tat ca a tat ca tad a tadī tad a tadoḥ bhāvaḥ tat a tattvam tatas iti vyutpattiḥ nanu satyam advaitam kiṃtu bhāva anyabhāvābhyām abhedaḥ iti tvayā eva uktam atas ca gauḥ aśvasya abhāvaḥ ced tatas dvaitam api asti

original: tena dvaitādvaitātmakaṃ sarvam ; tacceṣṭamevāsmākamityabhiprāyeṇa codayati—satyamiti | siddhāntī tvāha—naitaditi | lokasiddhamanyatvamabhipretya parapratipādanārthamanyābhāva ityasmābhiruktam | taccatastu gavāśvayoranyonyamabhede kuto'nyatvam ? yato dvaitamapi syādityarthaḥ | nanu gavāśvayorabhede ‘gauścāśvaśca’ iti bhedenābhidhānaṃ na syāt ;
analyzed: tena dvaita advaita ātmakam sarvam tat ca iṣṭam eva asmākam iti abhiprāyeṇa codayati satyam iti siddhāntī tu āha na etat iti loka siddham anyatvam abhipretya para pratipādana artham anya abhāvaḥ iti asmābhiḥ uktam tat catas tu gavāśvayoḥ anyonyam abhede kutonyatvam yatas dvaitam api syāt iti arthaḥ nanu gavāśvayoḥ abhede gauḥ ca aśvaḥ ca iti bhedena abhidhānam na syāt

original: ato bhedo'pyastītyāśaṅkyāha—gauśceti | abhidhānabhedo'pi lokasiddha eva parapratipādanārthamuktaḥ ; na tu gavāśvayoḥ pratyekaṃ gavāśvatvena tasya kāraṇamastītyarthaḥ | nanu yadyapi sāmānyāṃśānugamādabhedaḥ, tathāpi viśeṣāṃśasya vyāvṛtterbhedo'pyasti ; ato dvaitādvaitātmakaṃ jagat syāt ; tacceṣṭamevāsmākamiti codayati—nanviti |
analyzed: atas bhedaḥ upi asti iti āśaṅkya āha gauḥ ca iti abhidhāna bhedaḥ api loka siddhaḥ eva para pratipādana artham uktaḥ na tu gavāśvayoḥ pratyekam gavāśva tvena tasya kāraṇam asti iti arthaḥ nanu yadi api sāmānya aṃśa anugamāt abhedaḥ tathā api viśeṣa aṃśasya vyāvṛtteḥ bhedaḥ upi asti atas dvaita advaita ātmakam jagat syāt tat ca iṣṭam eva asmākam iti codayati nanu iti

original: siddhāntī tu dūṣayitumidaṃ vikalpayati—atheti | ubhayarūpaṃ vastu ; ato'sya viśeṣavyāvṛttito vyāvṛttatvāt viśeṣāntare'nugamo nāsti ; tadudāharati—aśvavastu govastu na bhavatīti | athāsti vastuno vastvantare'nugamaḥ, tadudāharati—aśvo'pi gaurbhavatīti | tatrādye
analyzed: siddhāntī tu dūṣayitum idam vikalpayati atha iti ubhaya rūpam vastu atas sya viśeṣa vyāvṛttitaḥ vyāvṛtta tvāt viśeṣa antara inugamaḥ na asti tat udāharati aśva vastu go vastu na bhavati iti atha asti vastunaḥ vastu antara inugamaḥ tat udāharati aśvaḥ api gauḥ bhavati iti tatra ādye

original: P. 67-19. pakṣe doṣamāha—tatreti | tatra tayoḥ pakṣayormadhye vastuno vastvantarānanugamapakṣe tāvat vastuno vastvantare'nanugamādanugacchataḥ sāmānyāṃśasya kevalasya svayamavastutvāt prāguktanyāyena kalpanāgocaratvāt bhedavādaprasaṅga ityuktaṃ ‘tasyānanvayataḥ’ ityatra |
analyzed: pakṣe doṣam āha tatra iti tatra tayoḥ pakṣayoḥ madhye vastunaḥ vastu antara ananugama pakṣe tāvat vastunaḥ vastu antareṇa anugamāt anugacchataḥ sāmānya aṃśasya kevalasya svayam avastu tvāt prāgukta nyāyena kalpanā gocara tvāt bheda vāda prasaṅgaḥ iti uktam tasya ananvayāt iti atra

original: atha viśeṣavyāvṛttau satyāmapi tadvastu vastvantare'nugatam, tadudāharati—bhavatīti | tatra gavāśvayorabheda eva, kuto'nyatvasiddhirityarthaḥ | yadi matam—divyatvādirūpeṇāśvo govastu ; ananugataṃ ca viśeṣarūpeṇa, ato ‘nātyantabhedasyābhedasya vā prasaṅga iti ; ‘bhavati cāśvo gauḥ’ ityaśvasya gorūpatvaṃ vadatā dravyatvādinānugatatvamuktam ;
analyzed: atha viśeṣa vyāvṛttau satyām api tat vastu vastu antara inugatam tat udāharati bhavati iti tatra gavāśvayoḥ abhedaḥ eva kutonyatva siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ yadi matam divya tva ādi rūpeṇa aśvaḥ go vastu ananugatam ca viśeṣa rūpeṇa atas na atyanta bhedasya abhedasya vā prasaṅgaḥ iti bhavati ca aśvaḥ gauḥ iti aśvasya go rūpatvam vadatā dravya tva ādinā anugata tvam uktam

original: ‘gaurgaureva’ iti gorgorūpeṇāśve'nanugatatvamuktam | kathaṃ punagorgorūpeṇāśvādyāvṛttatvamityata āha—bhavatyeveti | yadyaśvasya gobhāve gorviśiṣṭaṃ svaṃ gorūpaṃ na bhavet, tato'śvānna vyāvartate ; yatastu bhavatyeva, na bhavati tatra gavi govastunastasya svarūpābhāva iti yāvat, tadā tasya svarūpeṇa vyāvṛttatvādanyatvasiddhiriti |
analyzed: gauḥ gauḥ eva iti goḥ go rūpeṇa aśvena anugata tvam uktam katham punar goḥ go rūpeṇa aśva ādi āvṛtta tvam iti atas āha bhavati eva iti yadi aśvasya go bhāve goḥ viśiṣṭam svam go rūpam na bhavet tatas ūśvāt na vyāvartate yatas tu bhavati eva na bhavati tatra gavi go vastunaḥ tasya sva rūpa abhāvaḥ iti yāvat tadā tasya sva rūpeṇa vyāvṛtta tvāt anyatva siddhiḥ iti

original: ‘yadi matam’ ityādinā paramatamāśaṅkya vikalpya dūṣayati—atheti | athetyākṣepe ; yadvovastu svarūpeṇāśvādyāvṛttaṃ tatkathaṃ kiṃprakāramiti pareṇa vaktavyam | kiṃ yadvaurbhavatyevāśvarūpeṇa ? na bhavatyapi ? etaduktaṃ bhavati—kiṃ gaurasādhāraṇagorūpa eva, utāśvarūpo'pi ? yadi gaurgorūpa eva, tato'śvo'pyaśvarūpa eveti bhedavādaḥ |
analyzed: yadi matam ityādinā para matam āśaṅkya vikalpya dūṣayati atha iti atha iti ākṣepe yat vo vastu sva rūpeṇa aśva ādi āvṛttam tat katham kiṃprakāram iti pareṇa vaktavyam kim yat vauḥ bhavati eva aśva rūpeṇa na bhavati api etat uktam bhavati kim gauḥ asādhāraṇa go rūpaḥ eva uta aśva rūpaḥ upi yadi gauḥ go rūpaḥ eva tatas ūśvaḥ api aśva rūpaḥ eva iti bheda vādaḥ

original: atha gauraśvarūpo'pi tato gaurgavāśvarūpo'pi, aśvo'pi gavāśvarūpa ityabhedavādaḥ | nanvevamabhede satyapi viśeṣāntareṇāśvādanyatvaṃ govastu vyavasthāpayiṣyāmaḥ ; ataśca bhedo'pyastītyāśaṅkya prakṛtaṃ bhedābhedavādaprasaṅgaṃ saṃkṣepeṇapapādayati— sarvatheti |
analyzed: atha gauḥ aśva rūpaḥ upi tatas gauḥ gavāśva rūpaḥ upi aśvaḥ upi gavāśva rūpaḥ iti abheda vādaḥ nanu evam abhede sati api viśeṣa antareṇa aśvāt anyatvam go vastu vyavasthāpayiṣyāmaḥ atas ca bhedaḥ upi asti iti āśaṅkya prakṛtam bheda abheda vāda prasaṅgam saṃkṣepeṇa papādayati sarvathā iti

original: evaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣātmakamekaṃ vastviti mataṃ dūṣayitvā dravyaparyāyātmakamekaṃ vastviti mate'pi tadūṣaṇamatidiśati—dravyeti | ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe— ye'pīti | mṛdo ghaṭādayaḥ, suvarṇasya rucakādayo viśeṣāḥ | paryāyeṇa jāyamānāḥ paryāyā ucyante | apāyina ityavasthitamṛdādidravyādvedamāha | avyatirekā ityabhedam ; nānti vyatireko yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ ;
analyzed: evam sāmānya viśeṣa ātmakam ekam vastu iti matam dūṣayitvā dravya paryāya ātmakam ekam vastu iti mate api tad ūṣaṇam atidiśati dravya iti ślokam vyācaṣṭe ye pi iti mṛdaḥ ghaṭa ādayaḥ suvarṇasya rucaka ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ paryāyeṇa jāyamānāḥ paryāyāḥ ucyante apāyinaḥ iti avasthita mṛd ādi dravyāt vedam āha avyatirekāḥ iti abhedam na anti vyatirekaḥ yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ

original: bhinnābhinnā ityuktaṃ bhavati | etadevopapādayati—na ceti | yadi rucakādayaḥ
analyzed: bhinna abhinnāḥ iti uktam bhavati etat eva upapādayati na ca iti yadi rucaka ādayaḥ

original: suvarṇadravyameva syuḥ ; tatasteṣāṃ nāśe suvarṇamapi naśyet | ato rucakanāśe vardhamāne nāvatiṣṭhet ; na caivam, tatrāpi pratyabhijñānāt | na ca dravyādvidyate ; bhedenānupalabdheḥ, dravyasyaiva rucakādirūpeṇopalabdheḥ | tadevaṃ dravyaparyāyayoginnābhinnatvāt tadubhayātmakamekaṃ vastu, na dravyamātraṃ paryāyamātraṃ vā |
analyzed: suvarṇa dravyam eva syuḥ tatas teṣām nāśe suvarṇam api naśyet atas rucaka nāśe vardhamāne na avatiṣṭhet na ca evam tatra api pratyabhijñānāt na ca dravyāt vidyate bhedena anupalabdheḥ dravyasya eva rucaka ādi rūpeṇa upalabdheḥ tat evam dravya paryāya yogin na abhinna tvāt tad ubhaya ātmakam ekam vastu na dravya mātram paryāya mātram vā

original: dravyamātre hi vastuni rucakāderabhāvāt tadutpāde tadvināśo ca tadarthino harṣaśokau na syātām | paryāyamātre ca vastuni tadutpāde vināśaḥ ca hemo'pyutpattivināśānmadhyasthatā na syāt | dvyātmake tu vastuni harṣādikamapyavakalpate |
analyzed: dravya mātre hi vastuni rucaka ādeḥ abhāvāt tad utpāde tad vināśaḥ ca tad arthinaḥ harṣa śokau na syātām paryāya mātre ca vastuni tad utpāde vināśaḥ ca hema upi utpatti vināśāt madhyastha tā na syāt dvi ātmake tu vastuni harṣa ādikam api avakalpate

original: tasmāt dvyātmakamekaṃ vastviti ye manyante—dravyaparyāyārthakāḥ dravyaparyāyarūpo'rtho vastu yeṣāṃ te, teṣāmapi nītirenaivātyantabhedābhedavādaprasaṅganirākaraṇaprakāreṇa nirākṛtā | etadeva prapañcayati—tathāhīti | avasthitaṃ hi dravyamucyate ; tadyadi P. 68-17. rucakavardhamānakavastunorhemāṃśānābhedādabheda ucyate, tata ekameva vastu ;
analyzed: tasmāt dvi ātmakam ekam vastu iti ye manyante dravya paryāya arthakāḥ dravya paryāya rūpaḥ ṛthaḥ vastu yeṣām te teṣām api nītiḥ enā eva atyanta bheda abheda vāda prasaṅga nirākaraṇa prakāreṇa nirākṛtā etat eva prapañcayati tathā hi iti avasthitam hi dravyam ucyate tat yadi rucaka vardhamānaka vastunoḥ hema aṃśān ābhedāt abhedaḥ ucyate tatas ekam eva vastu

original: tacca anityamavasthitamiti dravyamātraṃ jagadityeṣā nītiḥ syāt | atha hemarucakādyubhayarūpatvāt vastuno rucakasya vardhamānakādvyāvṛttyā vastvapi vyāvṛttam, yattu hemāṃśamātraṃ vardhamānake'pyanuvṛttaṃ na tadanuvṛttyā vastuno'nuvṛttiḥ, tasya kevalasya tvayamavastutvāt ityucyate ;
analyzed: tat ca anityam avasthitam iti dravya mātram jagat iti eṣā nītiḥ syāt atha hema rucaka ādi ubhaya rūpa tvāt vastunaḥ rucakasya vardhamānakāt vyāvṛttyā vastu api vyāvṛttam yat tu hema aṃśa mātram vardhamānake pi anuvṛttam na tad anuvṛttyāḥ vastunaḥ anuvṛttiḥ tasya kevalasya tu ayam avastu tvāt iti ucyate

original: tataḥ paryāyamātraṃ jagaditīyaṃ nītiḥ syāt, yataḥ parasparavyāvṛttāḥ paryāyā ucyante, na tu dravyam ; yato'vasthitaṃ dravyamucyate ; na ca paryāyamātre kiṃcidvastvavasthitamasti, teṣāmutpattivināśasaṃbandhāt | yā tu hemāṃśamātrasya rucakanāśe'pi vardhamānake'vasthānakalpanā, sā kalpanaiva ; yato dravyaparyāyarūpaṃ citraṃ vastu ;
analyzed: tatas paryāya mātram jagat iti iyam nītiḥ syāt yatas paraspara vyāvṛttāḥ paryāyāḥ ucyante na tu dravyam dravyam ucyate na ca paryāya mātre kiṃcid vastu avasthitam asti teṣām utpatti vināśa saṃbandhāt yā tu hema aṃśa mātrasya sā kalpanā eva yatas dravya paryāya rūpam citram vastu

original: hemāṃśamātrasya ca na tathātvamityarthaḥ | atraiva dūṣaṇāntaramāha—api cati | dravyāt paryāyāṇāṃ bhede dravyasya sthitatvāt paryāyayośra nāśotpādāt tadarthināṃ madhyasthatāśokaharṣavyavasthā ghaṭet | abhede tu tadeva tiṣṭhati tadeva jāyate tadeva vinaśyatīti sthitijanmanāśānāmekatraiva samavāyaḥ syāt ;
