analyzed: yadi yāvān abhedaḥ sa sarvaḥ bheda upādāna tvāt mithyā tatas paramāṇuḥ api ekaḥ na syāt tad abhedaḥ upi bheda upādānaḥ eva syāt tathā tad aṃśa tad aṃśaḥ upi iti anavasthā syāt tatas ca na kiñcid ekam syāt atas ca ekaika paramāṇu samuccaya rūpaḥ tad abhedaḥ na asti eva

original: kuto 'vanam' ityabheda-kalpanā syāt ? atha dūramapi gatvā kiñcidekaṃ tattvamabhedopādānatva-rahitamiṣyate, tatastenaiva heturanekānta ityarthaḥ | tadabhāvata iti ; ekaika-paramāṇusamuccayarūpasya sthūlasya vṛkṣādirūpasya bhedasyābhāvata ityarthaḥ | bhedasya mithyātve anumānāntaramāha—api ceti |
analyzed: kutas vanam iti abheda kalpanā syāt atha dūram api gatvā kiñcid ekam tattvam abheda upādāna tva rahitam iṣyate tatas tena eva hetuḥ anekāntaḥ iti arthaḥ tad abhāvataḥ iti ekaika paramāṇu samuccaya rūpasya sthūlasya vṛkṣa ādi rūpasya bhedasya abhāvataḥ iti arthaḥ bhedasya mithyātve anumāna antaram āha api ca iti

original: bhedo dharmī, mṛṣeti sādhyo dharmaḥ, 'idam' iti 'tat' iti 'arthaḥ' iti 'vastu' iti 'sat' iti ca pratyekamabhedenānugatatvāt ; yo ya eva sa mṛṣā, yathā candramasastaraṅgabhedādyo bhedaḥ sa pratyekaṃ 'candraḥ' ityabhedānuviddho mṛṣetyarthaḥ | tarubhedo 'vanam' ityabhedānuviddho'pi na mṛṣā ; atastena vyabhicāro mā bhūditi pratyekamityuktam |
analyzed: bhedaḥ dharmī mṛṣā iti sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ idam iti tat iti arthaḥ iti vastu iti sat iti ca pratyekam abhedena anugata tvāt yaḥ yaḥ eva sa mṛṣā yathā candramasaḥ taraṅga bhedāt yaḥ bhedaḥ sa pratyekam candraḥ iti abheda anuviddhaḥ mṛṣā iti arthaḥ taru bhedaḥ vanam iti abheda anuviddhaḥ api na mṛṣā atas tena vyabhicāraḥ mā bhūt iti pratyekam iti uktam

original: kiṃca kalpanālāghavādapyabhedopādānā bhedakalpanocitā, na tu viparyaya ityāha—api ceti | na tu minnānām ; mahimetyanuṣajya kalpya ityadhyā-hāryam | nanu tvayaikasya nānāvabhāsasāmarthyaṃ kalpyam, na mayā ;
analyzed: kiṃca kalpanā lāghavāt api abheda upādānāḥ bheda kalpanā ucitāḥ na tu viparyayaḥ iti āha api ca iti na tu minnānām mahimā iti anuṣajya kalpyaḥ iti adhyāhāryam nanu tvayā ekasya nānā avabhāsa sāmarthyam kalpyam na mayā

original: ato mamaiva lāghavamityāśaṅkaya āvayoḥ sāmarthyakalpanā tulyā, tathāpi tvayā bahūnāṃ bahūni sāmarthyāni kalpyāni, mayā tvekasyaiva sāmarthyātiśaya iti
analyzed: atas mama eva lāghavam iti āśaṅkaya āvayoḥ sāmarthya kalpanā tulyā tathā api tvayā bahūnām bahūni sāmarthyāni kalpyāni mayā tu ekasya eva sāmarthya atiśayaḥ iti

original: P. 72-25. sapakṣe kalpanālāvavamupapādayitumupakramate—idamiti | bhedavādino'tyantabhinnāsu vyaktiṣu kathaṃ 'gaurgoḥ' ityabhedāvabhāsaḥ ? na hi nirnimittaṃ jñānaṃ bhavati | na ca bheda evābhedajñānasya svarūpeṇa nimittam ; 'gāmānaya' ityukte ca yāṃ vyaktimānayati punarukte tatsāmānyamevānayati, na yāṃ kāṃcidaśvādivyaktimapi ;
analyzed: sapakṣe kalpanā lāvavam upapādayitum upakramate idam iti bheda vādinā utyanta bhinnāsu vyaktiṣu katham gauḥ goḥ iti abheda avabhāsaḥ na hi nirnimittam jñānam bhavati na ca bhedaḥ eva abheda jñānasya svarūpeṇa nimittam gām ānaya iti ukte ca yām vyaktim ānayati punar ukte tad sāmānyam eva ānayati na yām kāṃcid aśva ādi vyaktim api

original: so'yamatyantabhede kathamanuvṛttāvabhāso vyavahāraśca ? atha govyaktīnāṃ sādṛśyādanuvṛttāvabhāsavyavahāraḥ, tadayuktam ; yataḥ sādṛśyamapyavayavasāmānyānvayena bhavati, na cātyantabhedavādinaḥ so'sti | atha govyaktīnāmanyonyavyāvṛttirna gṛhyate, gṛhyate'śvādivyaktibhyaḥ ;
analyzed: saḥ uyam atyanta bhede katham anuvṛtta avabhāsaḥ vyavahāraḥ ca atha go vyaktīnām sādṛśyāt anuvṛtta avabhāsa vyavahāraḥ tat ayuktam yatas sādṛśyam api avayava sāmānya anvayena bhavati na ca atyanta bheda vādinaḥ saḥ usti atha go vyaktīnām anyonya vyāvṛttiḥ na gṛhyate gṛhyate śva ādi vyaktibhyaḥ

original: tena govyaktiṣu bhinnāsvapyanuvṛttāvabhāsavyavahāraḥ, tadaviśeṣe'pi nāśvādivyaktiṣu saṃbhavati ; bhavati ca satyā api govyaktīnāṃ vyāvṛtteragrahaṇaṃ guḍyāpravālarāgayoriva sūkṣmatvenetyucyate ; tadasat ; yatastava vyāvṛttirnāma bhāvānāṃ svabhāva eva, na tato bhinnā ; tatra tasyā agrahaṇe tatsvabhāvānāmapyagrahaṇaṃ syāt ;
analyzed: tena go vyaktiṣu bhinnāsu api anuvṛtta avabhāsa vyavahāraḥ tad aviśeṣe pi na aśva ādi vyaktiṣu saṃbhavati bhavati ca satyāḥ api go vyaktīnām vyāvṛtteḥ agrahaṇam guḍyā pravāla rāgayoḥ iva sūkṣma tvena iti ucyate tat asat yatas tava vyāvṛttiḥ nāma bhāvānām svabhāvaḥ eva na tatas bhinnā tatra tasyāḥ agrahaṇe tad svabhāvānām api agrahaṇam syāt

original: anyathā tatsvabhāvataiva na syāditi bhāvaḥ | atha nirvikalpakatvena pratyakṣamaniścayātmakam ; savikalpakaṃ tu niścayātmakam ; taccāpratyakṣam | ato niścayapratyakṣayoḥ svarūpabhedaḥ | tena govyaktiṣu pratyakṣāsu tatsvabhāvabhūtānyonyavyāvṛttirapi yadyapi pratyakṣā, tathāpi tanniścayābhāvādanuvṛttāvabhāsavyavahārau bhavata iti cet ; tadasat ;
analyzed: anyathā tad svabhāva tā eva na syāt iti bhāvaḥ atha nirvikalpaka tvena pratyakṣam aniścaya ātmakam savikalpakam tu niścaya ātmakam tat ca apratyakṣam atas niścaya pratyakṣayoḥ svarūpa bhedaḥ tena go vyaktiṣu pratyakṣāsu tad svabhāva bhūta anyonya vyāvṛttiḥ api yadi api pratyakṣā tathā api tad niścaya abhāvāt anuvṛtta avabhāsa vyavahārau bhavataḥ iti ced tat asat

original: yato vyāvṛtteraniścaye gosāmānyanibandhana eva vyavahāraḥ syāt, na viśeṣāntaravyāvṛttaḥ ; sa ca dṛśyate ; tathāhi—'kālākṣīmānaya' ityukte gavāntaravyāvṛttāmeva gāmānayati ; na ca tadvadyāvṛtteraniścaye yujyate | tasmānnaiṣo'pi pakṣaḥ sādhuḥ | athaikā govyaktiryāmarthakriyāṃ dohanādilakṣaṇāṃ karoti tāmevāparā ;
analyzed: yatas vyāvṛtteḥ aniścaye go sāmānya nibandhanaḥ eva vyavahāraḥ syāt na viśeṣa antara vyāvṛttaḥ sa ca dṛśyate tathā hi kāla akṣīm ānaya iti ukte gava antara vyāvṛttām eva gām ānayati na ca yujyate tasmāt na eṣaḥ api pakṣaḥ sādhuḥ atha ekā go vyaktiḥ yām arthakriyām dohana ādi lakṣaṇām karoti tām eva aparā

original: tataśca yathaikā aśvādibhyo'tatkāribhyo vyāvṛttā tathā parāpītyatatkārivyāvṛttestulyatvāt govyaktiṣvatyantabhinnāsvapyekarūpāvabhāsavyavahāro bhavatīti cet ; tadapi na śobhanam ; yato yaikasyā govyakterarthakriyā na saivāparasyāḥ ; nāpi tajjātīyā, tairjāteraniṣṭhatvāt | ato govyaktīnāṃ naikārthakriyākāritvam |
analyzed: tatas ca yathā ekā aśva ādibhyaḥ tatkāribhyaḥ vyāvṛttā tathā parā api iti atatkāri vyāvṛtteḥ tulya tvāt go vyaktiṣu atyanta bhinnāsu api eka rūpa avabhāsa vyavahāraḥ bhavati iti ced tat api na śobhanam yatas yā ekasyāḥ go vyakteḥ arthakriyā na sā eva aparasyāḥ nā api tad jātīyā taiḥ jāteḥ aniṣṭha tvāt atas go vyaktīnām na eka arthakriyā kāri tvam

original: ataśca yathaikasyā govyakteratadarthakriyākāriṇo vyāvṛttiḥ evaṃ govyaktyantarādapi, tasyāpi tata iti kathamatatkārivyāvṛttistulyā ? kiṃca vyāvṛttirvastunaḥ svabhāvaścet,
analyzed: atas ca yathā ekasyāḥ go vyakteḥ atadarthakriyā kāriṇaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ evam go vyakti antarāt api tasyāḥ api tatas iti katham atatkāri vyāvṛttiḥ tulyā kiṃca vyāvṛttiḥ vastunaḥ svabhāvaḥ ced

original: vastūnāṃ bhede kathaṃ sā tulyāḥ athāsvabhāvaḥ, tadā tādātmyādisaṃbandhābhāvāt kathaṃ sā vastūnāṃ syāt ? tataśca tato'pyekameva tattvaṃ syāt, na bhedaḥ | athānādivāsanānibandhano bhinnāstvapi vyaktiṣvekarūpāvabhāsaḥ ; tataśca tadanurūpo vyavahāraḥ, na tu vyaktigataḥ kaścidviśeṣo'pekṣyat ityucyate ; tadapyayuktam ;
analyzed: vastūnām bhede katham sā tulyāḥ atha asvabhāvaḥ tadā tādātmya ādi saṃbandha abhāvāt katham sā vastūnām syāt tatas ca tatas upi ekam eva tattvam syāt na bhedaḥ atha anādi vāsanā nibandhanaḥ bhinnāḥ tu api vyaktiṣu eka rūpa avabhāsaḥ tatas ca tad anurūpaḥ vyavahāraḥ na tu vyakti gataḥ kaścid viśeṣa upekṣyat iti ucyate tat api ayuktam

original: vyaktigataviśeṣānāśrayaṇe hi govyaktiṣveva ‘gauḥ’ ityekarūpāvabhāso bhavati, nāścavyaktiṣvityayaṃ niyamo na syāt ; asti ca | tasmānna vāsanāmātranibandhano'yamabhedāvabhāsaḥ | na ca vāsanānāṃ bhedāt kācideva vāsanā kāścideva vyaktiṣvabhedāvabhāsaṃ karoti, na sarvāstiti vācyam ;
analyzed: vyakti gata viśeṣa an āśrayaṇe hi go vyaktiṣu eva gauḥ iti eka rūpa avabhāsaḥ bhavati na aśca vyaktiṣu iti ayam niyamaḥ na syāt asti ca tasmāt na vāsanā mātra nibandhanaḥ yam abheda avabhāsaḥ na ca vāsanānām bhedāt kācid eva vāsanā kāścid eva vyaktiṣu abheda avabhāsam karoti na sarvā asti iti vācyam

original: sā hi pūrvānubhavajaṭṭasaṃskārānuvedharūpatvāt pūrvānubhūtāstveva vyaktiṣvabhedāvabhāsaṃ kuryāt, na bhinnāsu | sādṛśyāttatrāpi karotīti cet ; na, tasya nirastvāt | tataḥ kāścidvacaktayaḥ kasyacidabhedāvabhāsasya prakṛtyaiva samarthāḥ, na sarvāḥ sarvasyeti tāsāṃ sāmarthyātiśayāḥ kalpyāḥ |
analyzed: sā hi pūrva anubhava jaṭṭa saṃskāra anuvedha rūpa tvāt pūrva anubhūtāḥ tu eva vyaktiṣu abheda avabhāsam kuryāt na bhinnāsu sādṛśyāt tatra api karoti iti ced na tasya nirasta vāt tatas kāścid kasyacid abheda avabhāsasya prakṛtyā eva samarthāḥ na sarvāḥ sarvasya iti tāsām sāmarthya atiśayāḥ kalpyāḥ

original: bhinnānāṃ vyaktīnāṃ bhedāvabhāsahetava eva sāmarthyātiśayā yuktāḥ ; ime tvabhedāvabhāsasya hetava iti svabhāvaviparītā ityucyante | P. 73-11. tatra teṣāmanantāni vastūni, anantāśca sāmarthyātiśayāḥ kalpyā iti kalpanāgauravam | mama tvekaṃ tattvaṃ kalpyamiti kalpanālāghavam | tasmādekasyaivāstu mahimā yannānevāvabhāsate ;
analyzed: bhinnānām vyaktīnām bheda avabhāsa hetavaḥ eva sāmarthya atiśayāḥ yuktāḥ ime tu abheda avabhāsasya hetavaḥ iti svabhāva viparītāḥ iti ucyante tatra teṣām anantāni vastūni anantāḥ ca sāmarthya atiśayāḥ kalpyāḥ iti kalpanā gauravam mama tu ekam tattvam kalpyam iti kalpanā lāghavam tasmāt ekasya eva astu mahimā yat nānā iva avabhāsate

original: na tu bhinnānām, yadabhedena bhāsanta ityarthaḥ | yathāvastu vyavahāro yuktaḥ ; tatrābhinne tattve ghaṭapaṭādibhedavyavahāraste kathamiti cedata āha—bhedeti | yathāvabhāsaṃ hi vyavahāraḥ, na yathāvastu, rajjusarpāvabhāse palāyanadarśanāt | avabhāsate ca bhedaḥ | ato'vabhāsānurūpā bhedavyavahārāḥ setsyanti ;
analyzed: na tu bhinnānām yat abhedena bhāsante iti arthaḥ yathāvastu vyavahāraḥ yuktaḥ tatra abhinne tattve ghaṭa paṭa ādi bheda vyavahāraḥ te katham iti ced atas āha bheda iti yathāvabhāsam hi vyavahāraḥ na yathāvastu rajju sarpa avabhāse palāyana darśanāt avabhāsate ca bhedaḥ atas vabhāsa anurūpāḥ bheda vyavahārāḥ setsyanti

original: yathā—bhedavādināṃ bhinnāsu vyaktiṣu ‘gauḥ’ ityabhedavyavahāraḥ | na kevalaṃ teṣām ; apitu jātivyavasyoratyantabhinnayoḥ samavāyākhyasaṃsargavādināmapi ; kaṇabhujāṃ jātervyaktibhyo'rthāntaratvāt ‘gotvavartī vyaktimānaya’ iti yathāvastu bhedāvabhāsena na vyavahāraḥ ; kiṃtu ‘gāmānaya’ ityabhedāvabhāsenaiva viśeṣeṣu sāmānyavyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: yathā abheda vādinām bhinnāsu vyaktiṣu gauḥ iti abheda vyavahāraḥ na kevalam teṣām apitu jāti vyavasyoḥ atyanta bhinnayoḥ samavāya ākhya saṃsarga vādinām api kaṇabhujām jāteḥ vyaktibhyaḥ artha antara tvāt go tva vartī vyaktim ānaye iti yathā vastu bheda avabhāsena na vyavahāraḥ kiṃtu gām ānaye iti abheda avabhāsena eva viśeṣeṣu sāmānya vyavahāraḥ

original: tathā ye'pi vyaktibhyo jātimanarthāntarabhūtāṃ vadanti bhāṭṭāḥ, teṣāmapi dvyātmakaṃ vastu | na ca tasya tādṛśasya śabdasya vastvantare'nugamo'sti | yasya tvasti sāmānyāṃśamātrasya, tadekamavastveva | tataśca
analyzed: tathā ye api vyaktibhyaḥ jātim anartha antara bhūtām vadanti bhāṭṭāḥ teṣām api dvi ātmakam vastu na ca tasya tādṛśasya śabdasya yasya tu asti sāmānya aṃśa mātrasya tat ekam avastu eva tatas ca

original: yo'yaṃ ‘gaurgauḥ’ ityanugatarūpo vyavahāraḥ, sa yathāvabhāsameva na yathāvastviti ‘tasyānanvayataḥ’ ityatra darśitam | itiḥ tarkakāṇḍīyanyāyoktisamāptau | P. 78-50. anantaroktamarthaṃ ślokena saṃgṛhṇāti—yatheti | bāhyāḥ ; bāhyāthavādino vedāntavivekabāhyā vādinaḥ | itiḥ tarkakāṇḍagranthasamāptau |
analyzed: yaḥ yam gauḥ gauḥ iti anugata rūpaḥ vyavahāraḥ sa yathāvabhāsam eva na yathā vastu iti tasya ananvayataḥ iti atra darśitam itiḥ tarkakāṇḍīya nyāyokti samāptau anantara uktam artham ślokena saṃgṛhṇāti yathā iti bāhyāḥ bāhya athavādinaḥ vedānta viveka bāhyāḥ vādinaḥ itiḥ tarkakāṇḍa grantha samāptau

original: iti śrībrahmasiddhivyākhyāne tarkakāṇḍavyākhyānaṃ śaṅkhapāṇinā kṛtam ||
analyzed: iti śrī brahmasiddhi vyākhyāne tarka kāṇḍa vyākhyānam śaṅkhapāṇinā kṛtam

original: **niyogakāṇḍaḥ**
analyzed: niyoga kāṇḍaḥ

original: idānīṃ kāṇḍāntaramārabhate—evamiti | vṛttavartiṣyamāṇasaṃkīrtanaṃ kāṇḍayoḥ saṃgatipradarśanārtham | sthite bupacaritārthatvanirāsenopaniṣadāṃ mukhyārthatve, ko'sau mukhyo'rthaḥ ? svarūpaṃ kāryaṃ vā iti cintāvatarati, nānyathā | kāryaṃ evārthaṃ vedasya prāmāṇyamiti ; sāmānyadvāreṇa P. 74-8.
analyzed: idānīm kāṇḍa antaram ārabhate evam iti vṛtta vartiṣyamāṇa saṃkīrtanam kāṇḍayoḥ saṃgati pradarśana artham sthite mukhya artha tve kaḥ asau mukhyaḥ arthaḥ svarūpam kāryam vā iti cintā avatarati na anyathā kāryam eva artham vedasya prāmāṇyam iti sāmānya dvāreṇa

original: vedāntagatānāmupaniṣadāmapi kārye'rthaṃ prāmāṇyamityabhiprāyaḥ | pratijñātamarthamṛṣijuṣṭatvena prasādhayati—evamiti | tadvacācaṣṭe—codaneti | mantrārthavādopaniṣadāṃ codanaikavākyatvena [a]pṛthagvedatvācodanātmaka eva kṛtsno vedaḥ | tena tadarthaṃ eva vedārthaḥ, nāparaḥ kaścidastīti | nanvanena codanāpramāṇako vedārtha iti yāvadityuktam ;
analyzed: vedānta gatānām upaniṣadām api kārya ṛtham prāmāṇyam iti abhiprāyaḥ pratijñātam artham ṛṣi juṣṭa tvena prasādhayati evam iti tadvat ācaṣṭe codanā iti mantra arthavāda upaniṣadām codanā eka vākya tvena apṛthak veda tva a codana ātmakaḥ eva kṛtsnaḥ vedaḥ tena tad artham eva veda arthaḥ na aparaḥ kaścid asti iti nanu anena codanā pramāṇakaḥ veda arthaḥ iti yāvat iti uktam

original: tataḥ kimityata āha—codanā ceti | codanā hi pravartakaṃ vacanam ; na ca sā vāyuvat pravartayati ; | katu pravṛttihetubhūtamarthamavagamayantī | pravṛttihetuḥ svakāryam ; tathāhi—iṣṭasādhanamapi ‘mamedaṃ kāryam’ ityapratipadya na kaścit pravartate | tasmāt kārye'rthaṃ vedaḥ pramāṇamityarthaḥ | nanu bhavatvevamanyatra ;
analyzed: tatas kim iti atas āha codanā ca iti codanā hi pravartakam vacanam na ca sā vāyu vat pravartayati pravṛtti hetu bhūtam artham avagamayantī pravṛtti hetuḥ sva kāryam tathā hi iṣṭa sādhanam api mama idam kāryam iti a pratipadya na kaścid pravartate tasmāt kārya ṛtham vedaḥ pramāṇam iti arthaḥ nanu bhavatu evam anyatra

original: vedānteṣu tu kaḥ kāryavidhiḥ, yatra teṣāṃ prāmāṇyam—ityāśaṅkyāha—vedāntānāmiti | ‘ātmā pratipattavyaḥ’ iti pratipattikartavyatāpramāṇam ; tatsevināṃ pratipattikartavyatāyāṃ pratipattavyatvenānugatamanvitaṃ yat siddharūpamātmatattvaṃ tadviṣayapratipattikartavyatāmukhenāvabodhakatvam, na tu svatantrāṇām | ataste'pi kāryaniṣṭhā evetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: vedānteṣu tu kaḥ kārya vidhiḥ yatra teṣām prāmāṇyam iti āśaṅkya āha vedāntānām iti ātmā pratipattavyaḥ iti pratipatti kartavyatā pramāṇam tad sevinām pratipatti kartavyatāyām pratipattavya tvena anugatam anvitam yat siddha rūpam ātma tattvam tad viṣaya pratipatti kartavyatā mukhena avabodhaka tvam na tu svatantrāṇām atas te api kārya niṣṭhāḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: etaduktaṃ bhavati—ātmapratipattikartavyatāvidhyapekṣitapratipattavyātmasvarūpasamarpakatvena vedāntānāṃ prāmāṇyamiti | etadeva bhāṣyoktyā draḍhayati—tathā ceti | yadi kārye'rthaṃ vedaḥ pramāṇaṃ kathaṃ tarhi mantrārthāḥ sopaniṣatkāḥ siddhamarthamāhurityāśaṅkya “codanā hi” ityādyuktam |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati ātma pratipatti kartavyatā vidhi apekṣita pratipattavya ātma svarūpa samarpaka tvena vedāntānām prāmāṇyam iti etat eva bhāṣya uktyā draḍhayati tathā ca iti yadi kārya irtham vedaḥ pramāṇam katham tarhi mantra arthāḥ sa upaniṣatkāḥ siddham artham āhuḥ iti āśaṅkya codanā hi ityādi uktam

original: ayamarthaḥ— mantrādīnāṃ vidhyekavākyatvādekaiveyaṃ tāvatī codanā | sā ca kāryaṃ
analyzed: ayam arthaḥ mantra ādīnām vidhi eka vākya tvāt ekā evā iyam tāvatī codanā sā ca kāryam

original: gamayantī tatparatayā bhūtādikamarthamekadeśena brūte, na svaniṣṭhatvena | tenopaniṣado'pi pratipattikartavyatāparā eva, na siddhārthaparā iti ye manyante P.74-10. tān pratyucyate—tisra iti | śabdāt vedāntākhyāt yadātmajñānaṃ tat ‘ātmā pratipattavyaḥ’ iti vidhinā na vidhīyate;
analyzed: gamayantī tad para tayā bhūta ādikam artham eka deśena brūte na sva niṣṭha tvena tena upaniṣadaḥ api pratipatti kartavyatā parāḥ eva na siddhārtha parāḥ iti ye manyante tān pratyucyatā itisraḥ iti śabdāt vedānta ākhyāt yat ātma jñānam tat ātmā pratipattavyaḥ iti vidhinā na vidhīyate

original: yasmādadhītavedasya śabdasāmarthyādeva karmāvabodhavat tadātmajñānaṃ bhavati; ataḥ kiṃ tatra vidhineti bhāvaḥ | nanu pramāṇāntarajaṃ jñānamupekṣya kimiti śābdameva jñānaṃ na vidheyamatroktamityāśaṅkyoktam— brahmaṇo hīti | śeṣaṃ sugamam | karmāvabodhavaditi dṛṣṭāntitam; tatra vidhyanapekṣāmāha—svargeti |
analyzed: yasmāt adhīta vedasya śabda sāmarthyāt eva karma avabodha vat tad ātma jñānam bhavati atas kim tatra vidhinā iti bhāvaḥ nanu pramāṇa antara jam jñānam upekṣya kim iti śābdam eva jñānam na vidheyam atra uktam iti āśaṅkya uktam brahmaṇaḥ hi iti śeṣam sugamam karma avabodha vat iti dṛṣṭāntitam tatra vidhi anapekṣām āha svarga iti

original: “svargakāmo yajeta” ityasmin śābde vākyārthabodhe nānyo vidhirapekṣyate, tadvidhivākyārthabodhe'pi vidhyantarapekṣāyāmanavasthāprasaṅgāt | na ca yo'yaṃ ‘yajeta’ iti vidhiḥ sa evāpekṣyate, tasya karmaṇi vyavasthiteḥ; karma hi tena vidhīyate, na tu tadbodha ityarthaḥ | atra caudayati—nanviti |
analyzed: svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti asmin śābde vākya artha bodhe na anyaḥ vidhiḥ apekṣyate tad vidhi vākya artha bodhe pi vidhi antar apekṣāyām anavasthā prasaṅgāt na ca yaḥ yam yajeta iti vidhiḥ saḥ eva apekṣyate tasya karmaṇi vyavasthiteḥ karma hi tena vidhīyate na tu tad bodhaḥ iti arthaḥ atra ca odayati nanu iti

original: yathā svargakāmādivākyānāmadhyayane “svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ” iti vidhirapekṣyate, svādhyāyādhyayanavidhyadhyayane tu na vidhyantaramapekṣyata iti nānavasthā; tathaiṣāmarthabodhe'pi vidhyapekṣāstu; tadvidhyarthabodhe tu na vidhyantaramapekṣyate; ato nānavasthā bhavatītyarthaḥ | na ca vedārthajñānapravṛttau vidhirnāstītyāha—asti ceti |
analyzed: yathā svarga kāma ādi vākyānām adhyayane svādhyāyaḥ udhyetavyaḥ iti vidhiḥ apekṣyate svādhyāya adhyayana vidhi adhyayane tu na vidhi antaram apekṣyate iti na anavasthā tathā eṣām artha bodhe pi vidhi apekṣā astu tad vidhi artha bodhe tu na vidhi antaram apekṣyate atas na anavasthā bhavati iti arthaḥ na ca veda artha jñāna pravṛttau vidhiḥ na asti iti āha asti ca iti

original: taddūṣayati— viṣama iti | vaiṣamyamāha—apravṛtto'pīti | yadyadhyayanavidhiḥ svayamadhīto vākyāntarāṇyadhyāpayati, tatastadadhyayanamapyadhyayanavidhyantarādhīnamityanavasthā syāt |
analyzed: tat dūṣayati viṣamaḥ iti vaiṣamyam āha apravṛttaḥ api iti yadi adhyayana vidhiḥ svayam adhītaḥ vākya antarāṇi adhyāpayati tatas tad adhyayanam api adhyayana vidhi antara adhīnam iti anavasthā syāt

original: yatastu svayamapravṛtto'pyadhyayanavidhyadhyayane puruṣaḥ puruṣāntarādhītādadhyayanavidhestasyānyeṣāṃ ca vākyānāmadhyayane pravartate, tena tatrānavasthā na bhavatītyarthaḥ | nanvanyenādhītādadhyayanavidheranyasya kathaṃ pravṛttiḥ? adhītaṃ hi vākyaṃ pravartayati, nānadhītam, agṛhītasya pravartakatvāyogādityata āha—śākheti |
analyzed: yatas tu svayam apravṛttaḥ api adhyayana vidhi adhyayane puruṣaḥ puruṣa antara adhītāt adhyayana vidheḥ tasya anyeṣām ca vākyānām adhyayane pravartate tena tatra anavasthā na bhavati iti arthaḥ nanu anyena adhītāt adhyayana vidheḥ anyasya katham pravṛttiḥ adhītam hi vākyam pravartayati na anadhītam agṛhītasya pravartaka tva ayogāt iti atas āha śākhā iti

original: nādhyayanaṃ pravṛttau tantram, apitu grahaṇam; tacca śravaṇamātrādapi bhavatyeva; yathā svayamanadhītādapi śākhāntaroktādaṅvākyāt tadadhyāyibhyaḥ śrutāt tadaṅkopasaṃhāraḥ prayogeṣu kriyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: na adhyayanam pravṛttau tantram apitu grahaṇam tat ca śravaṇa mātrāt api bhavati eva yathā svayam anadhītāt api śākhā antara uktāt aṅ vākyāt tad adhyāyibhyaḥ śrutāt tad aṅka upasaṃhāraḥ prayogeṣu kriyate iti arthaḥ

original: nanu puruṣāntarāṇāmapi kathamadhyayanavidhivākyādhyayanamityāśaṅkyāha—yatheti | P. 76-16 evaṃ svargakāmādivākyādhyayane nānavasthādoṣa ityuktam | tadarthabodhe tu “vedaḥ kṛtsno'dhigantavyaḥ” iti vidhyantarāpekṣā saṃbhavati | yatastadapyanavabuddhārthaṃ na svargakāmādivākyārthajñāne pravartayitumalam , atastadartho'pi vidhyapekṣaḥ |
analyzed: nanu puruṣa antarāṇām api katham adhyayana vidhi vākya adhyayanam iti āśaṅkya āha yathā iti evam svarga kāma ādi vākya adhyayane na anavasthā doṣaḥ iti uktam tad artha bodhe tu vedaḥ kṛtsnaḥ adhigantavyaḥ iti vidhi antara apekṣā saṃbhavati yatas tat api anavabuddha artham na svarga kāma ādi vākya artha jñāne pravartayitum alam atas tad arthaḥ api vidhi apekṣaḥ

original: na ca sa eva svārthabodhe pravartayati, anavabuddhārthasya pravartakatvāyogāt ; tadarthabodhāt pravṛttiḥ, pravṛttasya ca tadarthabodha iti itaretarāśrayaṃ hi syāt | ataśca “vedaḥ kṛtsno'dhigantavyaḥ” ityasyārthabodhe vidhyantaramapekṣyam , tatrāpyevamityanavasthā syāditi mūkam—‘viṣama upanyāsaḥ’ iti | yaccoktam—‘asti vidhiḥ’ iti, tadapyayuktam ;
analyzed: na ca saḥ eva sva artha bodhe pravartayati anavabuddha arthasya pravartaka tva ayogāt tad artha bodhāt pravṛttiḥ pravṛttasya ca tad artha bodhaḥ iti itaretara āśrayam hi syāt atas ca vedaḥ kṛtsnaḥ adhigantavyaḥ iti asya artha bodhe vidhi antaram apekṣyam tatra api evam iti anavasthā syāt iti mūkam viṣamaḥ upanyāsaḥ iti yat ca uktam asti vidhiḥ iti tat api ayuktam

original: yato'pūrvārthaprāpako vidhirbhavati ! ayaṃ tvadhyayanavidherdṛṣṭārthatvena nyāyaprāptānuvādaka ityāha—na ceti | abhyupagamyāsya vidhitvaṃ vedārthabodhe ‘ātmā pratipattavyaḥ’ iti pṛthagvidhyanapekṣāmāha—atheti |
analyzed: yatas upūrva artha prāpakaḥ vidhiḥ bhavati ayam tu adhyayana vidheḥ dṛṣṭārtha tvena nyāya prāpta anuvādakaḥ iti āha na ca iti abhyupagamya asya vidhi tvam veda artha bodhe ātmā pratipattavyaḥ iti pṛthak vidhi anapekṣām āha atha iti

original: nanu svādhyāyādhyayanavidhyākṣiptaṃ cet vedārthajñānaṃ “vedaḥ kṛtsno'dhigantavyaḥ” ityanenocyate, tato'dhyayanavidhiprāptānuvāda evāyaṃ syāt ; kathaṃ vidhyupagamaḥ? ucyate—vidhyākṣiptamapi vidhīyate ; yāgavidhyākṣiptamiva vrīhyādi | vilambī hyarthākṣepaḥ, śīghrabhāvinī śrutiḥ ; sā arthākṣepavyāpārāt prāgaprāptameva vidhatte |
analyzed: nanu svādhyāya adhyayana vidhi ākṣiptam ced veda artha jñānam vedaḥ kṛtsnaḥ adhigantavyaḥ iti anena ucyate tatas adhyayana vidhi prāpta anuvādaḥ eva ayam syāt katham vidhi upagamaḥ ucyate vidhi ākṣiptam api vidhīyate yāga vidhi ākṣiptam iva vrīhi ādi vilambī hi artha ākṣepaḥ śīghra bhāvinī śrutiḥ sā artha ākṣepa vyāpārāt prāk aprāptam eva vidhatte

original: phalaṃ tvanyanivṛttiḥ ; arthākṣepe hyanyadapyākṣipyeteti na doṣaḥ | karmavidhivākyavadityuktam ; tadvivṛṇvan tatra punaḥ ślokaṃ yojayati—yatheti |
analyzed: phalam tu anya nivṛttiḥ artha ākṣepe hi anyat api ākṣipyeta iti na doṣaḥ karma vidhi vākya vat iti uktam tat vivṛṇvan tatra punar ślokam yojayati yathā iti

original: vidhau satyapi cedvidhyantaramapekṣyate tatastatrāpyevamityanavasthānāt svargakāmādivākyeṣu “vedaḥ kṛtsno'dhigantavyaḥ” iti sāmānyavidhinārthabodhe pravṛttisiddhestadarthaṃ yathā nānyo vidhirapekṣyate—na ca svargakāmādivākyagataḥ, tasya karmaviṣayatvāt—evaṃ vedānteṣvapi vākyasāmarthyādeva tadarthabodhotpatteḥ ‘ātmā pratipattavyaḥ’ iti
analyzed: vidhau sati api ced vidhi antaram apekṣyate tatas tatra api evam iti anavasthānāt svarga kāma ādi vākyeṣu vedaḥ kṛtsnaḥ adhigantavyaḥ iti sāmānya vidhinā artha bodhe pravṛtti siddheḥ tad artham yathā na anyaḥ vidhiḥ apekṣyate ena ca svarga kāma ādi vākya gataḥ tasya karma viṣaya tvāt evam vedānteṣu api vākya sāmarthyāt eva tad artha bodha utpatteḥ ātmā pratipattavyaḥ iti

original: vidhirnāpekṣitavya ityarthaḥ | nanu karmavidhivadatrāpi sāmānyavidhisiddhatvameva vācyam ; tatkimidamuktam—‘vākyasāmarthyāt’ iti? ucyate—vedānteṣu ‘ātmā pratipattavyaḥ’ iti viśeṣavidhivādī sāmānyavidhestadanyaviṣayateti manyate ; atastadabhiprāyeṇa sāmānyavidhisiddhārthatā nāstīti ‘vākyasāmarthyāt’ ityuktam |
analyzed: vidhiḥ na apekṣitavyaḥ iti arthaḥ nanu karma vidhi vat atra api sāmānya vidhi siddhatvam eva vācyam tat kim idam uktam vākya sāmarthyāt iti ucyate vedānteṣu ātmā pratipattavyaḥ iti viśeṣa vidhi vādī sāmānya vidheḥ tad anya viṣaya tā iti manyate atas tad abhiprāyeṇa sāmānya vidhi siddhārtha tā na asti iti vākya sāmarthyāt iti uktam

original: sāmānyavidhiśeṣatve'pi copaniṣadāṃ siddhārthatā na syāditi taccheṣatvamapyanicchatedamuktamityadoṣaḥ |
analyzed: sāmānya vidhi śeṣa tve api ca upaniṣadām siddhārtha tā na syāt iti tad śeṣa tvam api an icchatā idam uktam iti adoṣaḥ

original: P. 76-3. itaśca śabdāt yadātmavijñānaṃ tanna vidhīyata ityāha—itaśceti | vidheyāvagamāduttarakālīnā yā pravṛttiḥ, saiva vidheḥ phalam, na tu śabdaprabhavo yo vidheyabodhaḥ sa ityarthaḥ | kutaḥ ? anyonyasaṃśrayāt— śabdārthabodhe sati pravṛttiḥ, pravṛttasya ca śabdārthabodha ityātmāśrayatā |
analyzed: itas ca śabdāt yat ātma vijñānam tat na vidhīyate iti āha etas ca iti vidheya avagamāt uttara kālīnā yā pravṛttiḥ sā eva vidheḥ phalam na tu śabda prabhavaḥ yaḥ vidheya bodhaḥ saḥ iti arthaḥ kutas anyonya saṃśrayāt śabda artha bodhe sati pravṛttiḥ pravṛttasya ca śabda artha bodhaḥ iti ātma āśraya tā

original: yastu taccāvabodhaparādvedāntavākyāt taccāvabodhaḥ, sa na śabdārthabodhāt paraḥ uttarakālīnaḥ ; kiṃtu sa evātmā | ato na 'ātmā pratipattavyaḥ' iti vidheḥ phalamityarthaḥ | itaśca śabdajñānamavidheyamityāha—apiceti | kiṃca śabdājjāte'rthabodhe na ṣuruṣaḥ 'ātmā pratipattavyaḥ' iti vidhinā pravartyaḥ | sādhye hi pravartyate, na siddhe |
analyzed: yaḥ tu tad ca avabodha parāt vedānta vākyāt tad ca avabodhaḥ sa na śabda artha bodhāt paraḥ uttara kālīnaḥ kiṃtu saḥ eva ātmā atas na ātmā pratipattavyaḥ iti vidheḥ phalam iti arthaḥ itas ca śabda jñānam avidheyam iti āha api ca iti kiṃca śabdāt jāti ṛtha bodhe na ātmā pratipattavyaḥ iti vidhinā pravartyaḥ sādhye hi pravartyate na siddhe

original: atha śabdo'rthasyānavabodhaka eva, tena tajjñāne pravartyaḥ, tatrāpi śabdārthabodhasyāsaṃbhavāt sutarāṃ na pravartanīyaḥ | na hyasaṃgate viṣaye kaścitpravartyate | śabdājjāte'rthārthabodhe tanniścaye pravartyate iti cet, ata āha—śabdeneti | na niścaye'pi pravartyaḥ ; so'pi hi śabdajanyo vā syāt, pramāṇāntarajanyo vā ;
analyzed: atha śabdaḥ ūrthasya anavabodhakaḥ eva tena tad jñāne pravartyaḥ tatra api śabda artha bodhasya asaṃbhavāt sutarām na pravartanīyaḥ na hi asaṃgate viṣaye kaścid pravartyate śabdāt jāta īrtha artha bodhe tad niścaye pravartyate iti ced atas āha śabdena iti na niścaye pi pravartyaḥ saḥ api hi śabda janyaḥ vā syāt pramāṇa antara janyaḥ vā

original: na tāvacchabdādartha taccāvabodhe tasmādava yo niścayaḥ, tatra pravartyaḥ ; sa hi śabdena prathamameva kṛtaḥ ; kiṃ tatra vidhinā ? atha śabdādavabuddhe tacce anyasmātmāṇāntarādyo niścayastatra vidhinā pravartyaḥ, tato'nyasya pramāṇāntarasya vācchanamapekṣā syāt | ataśca śabdastatra niścayaheturna syāt | na caitadiṣṭamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: na tāvat śabdāt artha tat ca avabodhe tasmāt ava yaḥ niścayaḥ tatra pravartyaḥ sa hi śabdena prathamam eva kṛtaḥ kim tatra vidhinā atha śabdāt avabuddhe anyasmāt māṇa antarāt yaḥ niścayaḥ tatra vidhinā pravartyaḥ tatonyasya pramāṇa antarasya vācchanam apekṣā syāt atas ca śabdaḥ tatra niścaya hetuḥ na syāt na ca etat iṣṭam iti arthaḥ

original: idānīṃ vikalpāntaraṃ karoti—atheti | upaṣṭhavo'vagama ityarthaḥ | bhūtārthavaiyarthyamatātparye hetuḥ ; atātparyasyāpi darśanāditi sāṃśayikatve | tadbūṣayati—tadvārtamiti ; tadasāram | kutaḥ ? yato lokavedayoḥ śabdānāmarthaparatvam "aviśiṣṭastu vākyārthaḥ" iti nyāyenautsargikam | nimittāntarāttu śabdasvarūpapradhānatvam ;
analyzed: idānīm vikalpa antaram karoti atha iti iti arthaḥ bhūta artha vaiyarthyam atātparye hetuḥ atātparyasya api darśanāt iti sāṃśayika tve tat būṣayati tat vārtam iti tat asāram kutas yatas loka vedayoḥ śabdānām artha paratvam aviśiṣṭaḥ tu vākya arthaḥ iti nyāyena autsargikam nimitta antarāt tu śabda svarūpa pradhāna tvam

original: ata evāvivakṣitārthatvaṃ tadapavādaḥ ; yathā—'gavityayamāha' iti 'iti'śabdāt, yathā japamantreṣu japasyoccāraṇātmakasyoccāryamāṇaśabdasvarūpaniṣṭhatvam | na ca vedānteṣu tannimittāntaramastīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva avivakṣita artha tvam tad apavādaḥ yathā gauḥ iti ayam āha iti iti śabdāt yathā japa mantreṣu japasya uccāraṇa ātmakasya uccāryamāṇa śabda svarūpa niṣṭhatvam na ca vedānteṣu tad nimitta antaram asti iti bhāvaḥ

original: itaśca vedāntānāṃ vivakṣitārthatvāya 'ātmā pratipattavyaḥ' iti vidhirnāpekṣyata ityāha—hṛṣṭeti | karmavidhivākyādhyayane svādhyāyavidheyā P. 77-10 dṛṣṭārthatā, sātra vedāntādhyayane na bhidyate, na viśiṣyate, samāneti yāvat | ataḥ svādhyāyavidheṣṭeṣṭārthatvenaiva karmavākyavadvedāntānāmapyavivakṣitārthatā nivṛttaiva;
analyzed: itas ca vedāntānām vivakṣita artha tvāya ātmā pratipattavyaḥ iti vidhiḥ na apekṣyate iti āha hṛṣṭa iti karma vidhi vākya adhyayane svādhyāya vidheyā dṛṣṭārtha tā sā atra vedānta adhyayane na bhidyate na viśiṣyate samānā iti yāvat atas svādhyāya vidha iṣṭa iṣṭa artha tvena eva karma vākya vat vedāntānām api avivakṣita artha tā nivṛttā eva

original: kiṃ pratipattividhinā tadartheneti bhāvaḥ | itarathā yadi tu vedāntādhyayane dṛṣṭārthatā na syāt, tataḥ 'ātmā pratipattavyaḥ' iti vidhyarthena saha vidhyarthaḥ kṛtvā vedāntārtho'vivakṣitaḥ syādityarthaḥ | phalāntarakalpaneti; viśvajihvayāyena sargo rātrisatranyāyena dadhimadhukulyādi vā phalāntaramuktam;
analyzed: kim pratipatti vidhinā tad arthena iti bhāvaḥ itarathā yadi tu vedānta adhyayane dṛṣṭārtha tā na syāt tatas ātmā pratipattavyaḥ iti vidhi arthena saha vidhi arthaḥ kṛtvā vedānta arthaḥ vivakṣitaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ phala antara kalpanā iti viśvajihva yāyena sargaḥ rātri satra nyāyena dadhi madhu kulyā ādi vā phala antaram uktam

original: tathā vedāntānāmavivakṣitārthānāmadhyayanātphalāntarakalpanā, tatrāpyātmāvabodhasya karmāvabodhavaddṛṣṭatvādityanvayaḥ | nanu karmavākyānāṃ pradattinivṛttyupayogenārthavaccādhuktaṃ vivakṣitārthatvam; na tu vedāntotthāyāḥ siddhārthapratipatteḥ, pravṛttinivṛttyanupayogena vaiyarthyāt |
analyzed: tathā vedāntānām avivakṣita arthānām adhyayanāt phala antara kalpanā tatra api ātma avabodhasya karma avabodha vat dṛṣṭa tvāt iti anvayaḥ nanu karma vākyānām vivakṣita artha tvam na tu vedānta utthāyāḥ siddhārtha pratipatteḥ pravṛtti nivṛtti anupayogena vaiyarthyāt

original: ataḥ svādhyāyavidhidṛṣṭārthatā tu bhidyata ityāśaṅkyāha—na ceti | kiṃca pratipattividhāvapi vaiyarthyasya tulyatvameva | tacca pratipattividhau tulyamityatra vakṣyata ityāha—pratipattīti | 'bhavet' ityādiślokārdhaṃ vyācaṣṭe—avaśyamiti | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyaṃ yat svādhyāyavidheṣṭeṣṭārthatvena vedāntānāmapi vivakṣitārthatā |
analyzed: atas svādhyāya vidhi dṛṣṭārtha tā tu bhidyate iti āśaṅkya āha na ca iti kiṃca pratipatti vidhau api vaiyarthyasya tulya tvam eva tat ca pratipatti vidhau tulyam iti atra vakṣyate iti āha pratipatti iti bhavet ityādi śloka ardham vyācaṣṭe avaśyam iti avaśyam ca etat evam vijñeyam yat svādhyāya vidha iṣṭa iṣṭa artha tvena vedāntānām api vivakṣita artha tā

original: anyathā 'ātmā pratipattavyaḥ' iti vidhāyakena saha kṛtsnasya vedāntasyāvivakṣitārthatā syāt | kutaḥ? yataḥ pratipattividhāyakaśabdanibandhanamityareṣāṃ vedāntānāṃ vivakṣitārthatvam | vidhāyakasya tu na vivakṣitārthatvasya nibandhanaṃ heturasti |
analyzed: anyathā ātmā pratipattavyaḥ iti vidhāyakena saha kṛtsnasya vedāntasya avivakṣita arthatā syāt kutas yatas pratipatti vidhāyaka śabda nibandhanam iti areṣām vedāntānām vivakṣita artha tvam vidhāyakasya tu na vivakṣita artha tvasya nibandhanam hetuḥ asti

original: ato vidhāyakasyāvivakṣitārthatvānna tadvalenetareṣāṃ vedāntānāṃ vivakṣitārthatvamiti saha vidhāyakena sarve vedāntā avivakṣitārthāḥ syuḥ | atha vidhāyakaḥ śabdaḥ prakṛtyā śabdasyārthaparatvasvabhāvatvena dṛṣṭārthatvena ca vivakṣitārtha ityucyate, tata itare'pi vedāntāstathaiva vivakṣitārthā bhaviṣyantīti kiṃ vidhāyakenetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: atas vidhāyakasya avivakṣita artha tvāt na tad valena itareṣām vedāntānām vivakṣita artha tvam iti saha vidhāyakena sarve vedāntāḥ avivakṣita arthāḥ syuḥ atha vidhāyakaḥ śabdaḥ prakṛtyā śabdasya artha paratva svabhāva tvena dṛṣṭārtha tvena ca vivakṣita arthaḥ iti ucyate tatas itare api vedāntāḥ tathā eva vivakṣita arthāḥ bhaviṣyanti iti kim vidhāyakena iti arthaḥ

original: athāpuruṣārthasādhane vidhiḥ pravartayituṃ nālamiti vidhyadhīnaṃ puruṣārthatvam; ataḥ śabdotthasyātmajñānasya puruṣārthatvasiddhyartham 'ātmā pratipattavyaḥ' iti vidhiripyate, tadapi netyāha—jñānasyeti |
analyzed: atha a puruṣa artha sādhane vidhiḥ pravartayitum na alam iti vidhi adhīnam puruṣa artha tvam atas śabda utthasya ātma jñānasya puruṣa artha tva siddhi artham ātmā pratipattavyaḥ iti vidhiḥ ipyate tat api na iti āha jñānasya iti

original: aśobhanatvamāha—śeyeti | jñānasya jñeyaprāptirdṛṣṭaṃ phalam | na dṛṣṭaphale vidhiḥ, dṛṣṭasyānvayavyatirekasiddhatvena vidhyanapekṣatvāt | mokṣo jñānasyādṛṣṭaṃ phalam, tadartho vidhirbhaviṣyatīti cet ; tanna ; na hi sa sādhyaḥ ; kutaḥ ? taccacyuteḥ, mokṣatvahānāt | ātyantikī hi saṃsāranivṛttirmokṣa ucyate ;
analyzed: aśobhana tvam āha śeya iti jñānasya jñeya prāptiḥ dṛṣṭam phalam na dṛṣṭa phale vidhiḥ dṛṣṭasya anvaya vyatireka siddha tvena vidhi anapekṣa tvāt mokṣaḥ jñānasya adṛṣṭam phalam tad arthaḥ vidhiḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced tat na na hi sa sādhyaḥ kutas tad ca cyuteḥ mokṣa tva hānāt ātyantikī hi saṃsāra nivṛttiḥ mokṣaḥ ucyate

original: tasya kāryatve ghaṭādivadvināśāt punaḥ saṃsāraḥ syāt | ato mokṣasyātyantikasaṃsāranivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ mokṣatvaṃ hīyeta | nanu ghaṭādināśavatkāryo'pi mokṣo na naṅkṣyati ; naivam, bhāvasya kāryasya nāśenāvinābhāvāt ; bhāvaśca mokṣaḥ, niratiśayānandaiścaryalakṣaṇatvāt |
analyzed: tasya kārya tve ghaṭa ādi vat vināśāt punar saṃsāraḥ syāt atas mokṣasya ātyantika saṃsāra nivṛtti lakṣaṇam mokṣa tvam hīyeta nanu ghaṭa ādi nāśa vat kāryaḥ api mokṣaḥ na naṅkṣyati na evam bhāvasya kāryasya nāśena avinābhāvāt bhāvaḥ ca mokṣaḥ niratiśaya ānanda aiścarya lakṣaṇa tvāt

original: nanu ātyantikī saṃsāranivṛttirmokṣa ityucyate ityuktvā, kathamāha bhāvarūpo mokṣa iti ? ucyate—mokṣe sā bhavatītyupacārāt saiva mokṣa ityuktamityavirodhaḥ ; mokṣe vā sā śrutyādibhirucyate ityarthaḥ | nanvāgāmidehendriyabuddhisaṃyogābhāvo mokṣaḥ ; sa ca kāryo'pyabhāvatvāt ghaṭābhāvavat naṅkṣyati | naivam ; prāgabhāvo hi saḥ ;
analyzed: nanu ātyantikī saṃsāra nivṛttiḥ mokṣaḥ iti ucyate iti uktvā katham āha bhāva rūpaḥ mokṣaḥ iti ucyate mokṣe sā bhavati iti upacārāt sā eva mokṣaḥ iti uktam iti avirodhaḥ mokṣe vā sā śruti ādibhiḥ ucyate iti arthaḥ nanu āgāmi deha indriya buddhi saṃyoga abhāvaḥ mokṣaḥ sa ca kāryā upya bhāva tvāt ghaṭa abhāva vat naṅkṣyati na evam prāgabhāvaḥ hi saḥ

original: na cāsau kāryaḥ, anāditvāt ghaṭādiprāgabhāvavat | nanu bandhahetudhvaṃso mokṣaḥ ; sa ca ghaṭadhvaṃsavat kāryo'pi nānityaḥ | satyam ; kiṃtu asau vidyāyā na pṛthak | ato na tatkāryam | yasmādavidyottho bandhaḥ, vidyaiva ca tadvirodhinī tadabhāvaḥ, na pṛthak ; pṛthakca kāryaṃ bhavati | athaveti ‘taccacyuteḥ’ ityasyāparā vyākhyā |
analyzed: na ca asau kāryaḥ anādi tvāt ghaṭa ādi prāgabhāva vat nanu bandha hetu dhvaṃsaḥ mokṣaḥ sa ca ghaṭa dhvaṃsa vat kāryaḥ api na anityaḥ satyam kiṃtu asau vidyāyāḥ na pṛthak atas na tat kāryam yasmāt avidyā utthaḥ bandhaḥ vidyā eva ca tad virodhinī tad abhāvaḥ na pṛthak pṛthak ca kāryam bhavati athavā iti tat ca cyuteḥ iti asya aparā vyākhyā

original: ātmanaḥ svarūpasthitilakṣaṇo mokṣaḥ śrutyoktaḥ ; sa cetkāryaḥ syāt, evaṃlakṣaṇānmokṣatvāccyaveta ; na hi kāryaṃ nityasyātmanaḥ svarūpaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | kāryatve mokṣasyānityatvāt punarāvṛttiḥ syāt | apunarāvṛttiśrutiviruddhatvāt ‘yat kāryaṃ tadanityam’ ityanumānamapramāṇam ;
analyzed: ātmanaḥ svarūpa sthiti lakṣaṇaḥ mokṣaḥ śrutyā uktaḥ sa ced kāryaḥ syāt evaṃlakṣaṇāt mokṣa tvāt cyaveta na hi kāryam nityasya ātmanaḥ sva rūpam bhavati iti bhāvaḥ kārya tve mokṣasya anitya tvāt punarāvṛttiḥ syāt apunarāvṛtti śruti viruddha tvāt yat kāryam tat anityam iti anumānam apramāṇam

original: tena kāryatve'pi mokṣasya nityatvāt yaduktaṃ kāryatve vināśāt tasya punaḥ saṃsāra iti tadayuktamityanubhāṣate—yacciti | taddūṣayati—dṛṣṭeti | dṛṣṭā sarvakāyāṇāmanityatvādvināśitā ; mokṣasya kāryatve'pyapunarāvṛttiśrutibalānnityatvamāśrayeta, yadi śruteranyā gatirna syāt ; asti tu setyarthaḥ | tāmanyāṃ gatimāha—yadā tviti | anavayaveneti ;
analyzed: tena kārya tve api mokṣasya nitya tvāt yat uktam kārya tve vināśāt tasya punar saṃsāraḥ iti tat ayuktam iti anubhāṣate yat citi tat dūṣayati dṛṣṭā iti dṛṣṭā sarva kāyāṇām anitya tvāt vināśitā mokṣasya kārya tve pi apunarāvṛtti śruti balāt nitya tvam āśrayeta yadi śruteḥ anyā gatiḥ na syāt asti tu sā iti arthaḥ tām anyām gatim āha yadā tu iti anavayavena iti

original: niḥśeṣata iti yāvat | avidyā punarāvṛttihetuḥ ; tasyāṃ vidyayā niḥśeṣato gatāyāṃ hetvabhāvādeva
analyzed: niḥśeṣataḥ iti yāvat avidyā punarāvṛtti hetuḥ tasyām vidyayā niḥśeṣataḥ gatāyām hetu abhāvāt eva

original: punarāvṛttyabhāvo'pītyarthaḥ | tamarthavādenānuvadatyeṣā 'na ca punarāvartate' iti vartamānaśrutiḥ | ato na tatprāmāṇyādanantamokṣaphalatvaṃ pratipattiviṣe rityarthaḥ | arthavādatvamevāsyāḥ śruterdraḍhayati—tathāhīti | vartamānāpa- P. 78-19 deśo hi prārabdhāparisamāptamāha, nāgāmi sādhyamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: punarāvṛtti abhāvaḥ api iti arthaḥ tam arthavādena anuvadati eṣā na ca punar āvartate iti vartamāna śrutiḥ atas na tad prāmāṇyāt ananta mokṣa phalatvam pratipatti viṣeḥ iti arthaḥ arthavāda tvam eva asyāḥ śruteḥ draḍhayati tathā hi iti vartamāna apa deśaḥ hi prārabdha aparisamāptam āha na āgāmi sādhyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadi ca svargakāmādivat kāmopabandhaḥ syāt, tato'pi sādhyaṃ kāmyate na nityamityapunarāvṛtteḥ sādhyatā gamyeta ; na tu so'pyatvāsti | tasmādarthavādo'punarāvṛttiśrutirityarthaḥ | nanvarthavādādapi phalakarūpanā dṛṣṭā ; yathā— rātrisatrādau pratiṣṭhāderityata āha—arthavādāditi | satyam ; anirjñātapārādhyeṣu sā |
analyzed: yadi ca svarga kāma ādi vat kāma upabandhaḥ syāt syāt tatas upi sādhyam kāmyate na nityam iti apunarāvṛtteḥ sādhya tā gamyeta na tu tasmāt arthavāda upunarāvṛtti śrutiḥ iti arthaḥ nanu arthavādāt api phalaka rūpanā dṛṣṭā yathā rātri satra ādau pratiṣṭhā ādeḥ iti atas āha arthavādāt iti satyam a nirjñāta pārādhyeṣu sā

original: nirjñātapārādhyeṣu tu “dravyasaṃskārakarmasu phalaśrutiḥ parārthatvādarthavādaḥ syāt” iti nyāyaḥ paṭhitaḥ | nirjñātapārādhye ca jñānaṃ jñeyataccāvabhāsena dṛṣṭenārthena nirākāṅkṣam | ato'tra na sā yuktetyarthaḥ | nanu jñeyasyātmanastaccāvabhāso'pi svayamapuruṣārthaḥ ; ato'styeva puruṣārthākāṅkṣā ;
analyzed: nirjñāta pārādhyeṣu tu dravya saṃskāra karmasu phala śrutiḥ parārtha tvāt artha vādaḥ syāt iti nyāyaḥ paṭhitaḥ nirjñāta pārādhye ca jñānam jñeya tad ca avabhāsena dṛṣṭena arthena nirākāṅkṣam atas utra na sā yuktā iti arthaḥ nanu jñeyasya ātmanaḥ tad ca avabhāsaḥ api svayam apuruṣa arthaḥ atas asti eva puruṣa artha ākāṅkṣā

original: tat kathaṃ nairākāṅkṣyamityata āha— puruṣārthateti | matāntaramāśaṅkayati—anya iti | vidhervinā kāryaśūnyaṃ bhūtārthaṃ yadvacaḥ, tat bhūtasyārthasya pramāṇāntaragatatvādanuvādakaṃ syāt ; anuvādaśca pramāṇāntaragocare bhavati ; atastadanuvādakaṃ vacaḥ pramāṇāntarāpekṣaṃ sat anapekṣatvalakṣaṇaprāmāṇyamativartate, na pramāṇaṃ syāt |
analyzed: tat katham nairākāṅkṣyam iti atas āha puruṣa artha tā iti mata antaram āśaṅkayati anyaḥ iti vidheḥ vinā kārya śūnyam bhūta artham yat vacaḥ tat bhūtasya arthasya pramāṇa antara gata tvāt anuvādakam syāt anuvādaḥ ca pramāṇa antara gocare bhavati atas tad anuvādakam vacaḥ pramāṇa antara apekṣam sat anapekṣa tva lakṣaṇa prāmāṇyam ativartate na pramāṇam syāt

original: vidhyarthe tu kārye pramāṇāntarāviṣaye yat pratiṣṭhitaṃ paryavasitaṃ vacaḥ tat pramāṇāntarānapekṣaṃ sat pramāṇatvaṃ labhate ; yathā agnihotrādikarmavākyam | ataśca yadyapyātmataccāvabodhāt parā uttarakālīnā paṭhattirvidhiphalamatra nāsti, tathāpi vedāntānāṃ prāmāṇyārthaṃ pratividhirāśrayitavya ityarthaḥ | śeṣaṃ spaṣṭam | atrocyate—pramāṇeti |
analyzed: vidhi arthe tu kārye pramāṇa antara aviṣaye yat pratiṣṭhitam paryavasitam vacaḥ tat pramāṇa antara anapekṣam sat pramāṇa tvam labhate yathā agnihotra ādi karma vākyam atas ca yadi api ātma tad ca avabodhāt parā uttara kālīnā paṭhattiḥ vidhi phalam atra na asti tathā api vedāntānām prāmāṇya artham pratividhiḥ āśrayitavyaḥ iti arthaḥ śeṣam spaṣṭam atra ucyate pramāṇa iti

original: pramāṇāntareṇa yātaḥ prāpto'rtho yasya vacasaḥ tattathoktam, tadvāvastattā ; tathā bhūtaḥ siddho'rtho yasya vacasaḥ tadvūtārtham, tadvāvastattā |
analyzed: pramāṇa antareṇa yātaḥ prāpta ūrthaḥ yasya vacasaḥ tat tathā uktam tat vāva tad tā tathā bhūtaḥ siddhaḥ ūrthaḥ yasya vacasaḥ tat vūta artham tat vāva tad tā

original: pramāṇāntaraprāptārthatā pramāṇāntarajñātatvena jñāpitvaṃ kimanuvādatā ? uta bhūtārthatāmātram ? tatra pramāṇāntaralabdhārthatā cedanuvādatābhipretā, tato yadapauruṣeyaṃ vedāntavacaḥ pramāṇāntarajñātatvena na bodhakaṃ,
analyzed: pramāṇa antara prāpta artha tā pramāṇa antara jñāta tvena jñāpi tvam kim anuvādatā uta bhūta artha tā mātram tatra pramāṇa antara labdha artha tā ced anuvāda tā abhipretā tatas yat apauruṣeyam vedānta vacaḥ pramāṇa antara jñāta tvena na bodhakam

original: na tadanuvādakam ; ato nāpekṣam ; ato nāpramāṇam | pauruṣeyaṃ hi pramāṇāntaralabdhārthakamiti bhāvaḥ | P. 79-22 atha bhūtārthatāmātramanuvādatā, tatrāha—sāpekṣatāyā iti | smṛtau darśanāditi ; smṛtau pramāṇāntarasaṃsparśasya pramāṇāntarāpekṣāhetutvena darśanādityarthaḥ | etadevāha—sā hīti |
analyzed: na tad anuvādakam atas na apekṣam atas na apramāṇam pauruṣeyam hi pramāṇa antara labdha arthakam iti bhāvaḥ atha bhūtārtha tā mātram anuvāda tā tatra āha sāpekṣatāyāḥ iti smṛtau darśanāt iti smṛtau pramāṇa antara saṃsparśasya pramāṇa antara apekṣā hetutvena darśanāt iti arthaḥ etat eva āha sā hi iti

original: sā hi smṛtiḥ ‘sa ghaṭaḥ’ iti pūrvādhigatameva ghaṭaṃ ‘saḥ’ iti sarvanāmnā pūrvādhigataparāmarśinollikhantyādhigamāntarasaṃsparśārthā jāyata iti hetostasyādhigamāntaramapekṣata ityarthaḥ | adhigamāntareṇa saṃbhinnaḥ saṃspṛṣṭo'rtho viṣayo yasyā iti vigrahaḥ | apauruṣeye siddhārthe'pi vacasi sāpekṣatvaheturnāstītyuktam ; tatra para āha—syāditi |
analyzed: sā hi smṛtiḥ sa ghaṭaḥ iti pūrva adhigatam eva ghaṭam saḥ iti sarvanāmnā pūrva adhigata parāmarśinā ullikhantyā adhigama antara saṃsparśa arthā jāyate iti hetoḥ tasya adhigama antaram apekṣate iti arthaḥ adhigama antareṇa saṃbhinnaḥ saṃspṛṣṭa arthaḥ viṣayaḥ yasyāḥ iti vigrahaḥ apauruṣeye siddhārthe api vacasi sāpekṣatva hetuḥ na asti iti uktam tatra paraḥ āha syāt iti

original: pratyakṣādipramāṇāntaraṃ siddhaviṣayam | ato vaidikasyāpi siddhārthasya vacaso viṣaye pramāṇāntarasya saṃbhavāt tadapekṣā yuktetyarthaḥ | siddhārthe pramāṇāntarasaṃbhave'pi kimiti tadapekṣata ityata āha—tathāhīti | pramāṇāntarasaṃvādāpekṣāyāṃ ca nairapekṣyalakṣaṇaṃ vedāntānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇa antaram siddha viṣayam atas vaidikasya api siddhārthasya vacasaḥ viṣaye pramāṇa antarasya saṃbhavāt tad apekṣā yuktā iti arthaḥ siddhārthe pramāṇa antara saṃbhave pi kim iti tat apekṣate iti atas āha tathā hi iti pramāṇa antara saṃvāda apekṣāyām ca nairapekṣya lakṣaṇam vedāntānām prāmāṇyam na syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadā tu pramāṇāntarāgocare kāryarūpe pratipattividhyarthe paryavasyanti vedāntāḥ, tadā tatrāsaṃbhavati pramāṇāntare na kutaścitpramāṇāntarādvisaṃvādāśaṅketi na saṃvādāya pramāṇāntaramapekṣaṇīyam ; ato nairapekṣyalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ sidhyati | pramāṇāntaraviṣaye hi tatsaṃvādavisaṃvādau syātām, nānyatreti bhāvaḥ | atrocyate—na ceti |
analyzed: yadā tu pramāṇa antara agocare kārya rūpe pratipatti vidhi arthe paryavasyanti vedāntāḥ tadā tatra asaṃbhavati pramāṇa antare na kutaścid pramāṇa antarāt visaṃvāda āśaṅkā iti na saṃvādāya pramāṇa antaram apekṣaṇīyam atas nairapekṣya lakṣaṇam prāmāṇyam sidhyati pramāṇa antara viṣaye hi tad saṃvāda visaṃvādau syātām na anyatra iti bhāvaḥ atra ucyate na ca iti

original: śabdaviṣaye pramāṇāntarasya saṃbhavamātreṇa pramāṇāntarāpekṣā śabde na yujyate | kutaḥ ? yatastadā tayoḥ pramāṇāntaraśabdayoḥ, śabda eva sāpekṣo na pramāṇāntaramityatra viśeṣo na gandhetetyarthaḥ | śabdaḥ pramāṇāntarasāpekṣo loke dṛṣṭaḥ, na pramāṇāntaramityasti viśeṣaḥ ;
analyzed: śabda viṣaye pramāṇa antarasya saṃbhava mātreṇa pramāṇa antara apekṣā śabde na yujyate kutas yatas tadā tayoḥ pramāṇa antara śabdayoḥ śabdaḥ eva sāpekṣaḥ na pramāṇa antaram iti atra viśeṣaḥ na gandheta iti arthaḥ śabdaḥ pramāṇa antara sāpekṣaḥ loke dṛṣṭaḥ na pramāṇa antaram iti asti viśeṣaḥ

original: tasmācchabdasyaiva sāpekṣatā, na pramāṇāntarasya adṛṣṭatvāt iti yadyucyeta, tataḥ kārye'pi pramāṇāntarāgocare śabdasya prāmāṇyaṃ loke na dṛṣṭamiti tatrāpi buddhavākyavat sutarāṃ śabdasya prāmāṇyaṃ na syāt | tadidaṃ sarvamāha—yadīti | natarāmityuktamatiśayārthamāha—pramāṇāntareti |
analyzed: tasmāt śabdasya eva sāpekṣa tā na pramāṇa antarasya adṛṣṭa tvāt iti yadi ucyeta tatas kārye api pramāṇa antara agocare śabdasya prāmāṇyam loke na dṛṣṭam iti tatra api buddha vākya vat sutarām śabdasya prāmāṇyam na syāt tat idam sarvam āha yadi iti natarām iti uktam atiśaya artham āha pramāṇa antara iti

original: pramāṇāntaraviṣaye hi tatsaṃbhavādapi tāvacchabdasyāptavākyavat prāmāṇyaṃ
analyzed: pramāṇa antara viṣaye hi tad saṃbhavāt api tāvat śabdasya āpta vākya vat prāmāṇyam

original: syāt | pramāṇāntarāgocare tu kārye pramāṇāntarāsaṃbhavāt buddhavākyavat tatprāmāṇyaṃ durlabham | atha pauruṣeyatvakāritā lokavacasāṃ pramāṇāntarādhigataviṣayatā, na śabdasāmarthakāritā ; śabdasya tu svataḥ pramāṇāntarāgocara etārthaṃ sāmarthyam ; tena pramāṇāntarāgocare'pi kāryaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ na durlabhamityucyate, tanna ;
analyzed: syāt pramāṇa antara agocare tu kārye pramāṇa antara asaṃbhavāt buddha vākya vat tat prāmāṇyam durlabham atha pauruṣeya tva kāri tā loka vacasām pramāṇa antara adhigata viṣaya tā na śabda sāmartha kāri tā śabdasya tu svatas pramāṇa antara agocare sāmarthyam tena pramāṇa antara agocare pi kāryam prāmāṇyam na durlabham iti ucyate tat na

original: yadi śabdaḥ pramāṇāntarānapekṣasāmarthyastarhi tulyasāmarthyatvānna śabda eva tadviṣaye pramāṇāntarasaṃbhave pramāṇāntarasāpekṣaḥ syāt, apitu pramāṇāntaramapi tadviṣaye śabdasāpekṣaṃ syāt | kimataḥ ? yadyevamidamato bhavati pramāṇāntarasya śabdasāpekṣatvenāprāmāṇyam ; aprāmāṇye ca sati tatsaṃvādavisaṃvādānupayogānna śabdasya tadapekṣā yujyate |
analyzed: yadi śabdaḥ pramāṇa antara anapekṣa sāmarthyaḥ tarhi tulya sāmarthya tvāt na śabdaḥ eva tad viṣaye pramāṇa antara saṃbhave pramāṇa antara sāpekṣaḥ syāt apitu pramāṇāntaram api tad viṣaye śabda sāpekṣam syāt kim atas yadi evam idam atas bhavati pramāṇa antarasya śabda sāpekṣa tvena aprāmāṇyam aprāmāṇye ca sati tad saṃvāda visaṃvāda anupayogān na śabdasya tad apekṣā yujyate

original: pramāṇasāpekṣaṃ na pramāṇaṃ bhavati | śabdastu na pramāṇam | ato na tadapekṣayā pramāṇāntaramapramāṇam ; apitu pramāṇameva, anapekṣatvāditi cet . tatrocyate—śabdasyaivāprāmāṇyaṃ kṛta iti | para āha—pramāṇāntarāpekṣatvā P. 80-22. diti | siddhāntī tvāha—pramāṇāntarasyāpi prāmāṇyaṃ śabdānapekṣatvāt ; tadanapekṣatvaṃ ca śabdasyāprāmāṇyāt |
analyzed: pramāṇa sāpekṣam na pramāṇam bhavati śabdaḥ tu na pramāṇam atas na tad apekṣayā pramāṇa antaram apramāṇam apitu pramāṇam eva anapekṣa tvāt iti ced tatra ucyate śabdasya eva aprāmāṇyam kṛte iti paraḥ āha pramāṇa antara apekṣa tvāt iti siddhāntī tu āha pramāṇa antarasya api prāmāṇyam śabda anapekṣa tvāt tad anapekṣa tvam ca śabdasya aprāmāṇyāt

original: ataḥ śabdāprāmāṇye tadanapekṣatvāt pramāṇāntarasya prāmāṇyam ; tatprāmāṇye ca tadapekṣatvāt śabdasyāprāmāṇyamitītaretarāśrayaṃ syāt | śabdasyāprāmāṇyāt pramāṇāntarasyā'napekṣatvaṃ prasādhayati—pramāṇe hīti | yadi śabdaḥ pramāṇaṃ syāt tataḥ pramāṇāntarasya viṣaye śabde saṃbhavati pramāṇāntaramapi śabdasāpekṣaṃ syāt, tatsaṃbhava iva śabdaḥ |
analyzed: atas śabda aprāmāṇye tad anapekṣa tvāt pramāṇa antarasya prāmāṇyam tad prāmāṇye ca tad apekṣa tvāt śabdasya aprāmāṇyam iti itaretarāśrayam syāt śabdasya aprāmāṇyāt pramāṇa antarasya anapekṣa tvam prasādhayati pramāṇe hi iti yadi śabdaḥ pramāṇam syāt tatas pramāṇa antarasya viṣaye śabde saṃbhavati pramāṇa antaram api śabda sāpekṣam syāt tad saṃbhavaḥ iva śabdaḥ

original: tasmācchabdasyāprāmāṇyāt pramāṇāntarasyānapekṣatvamiti yuktamitaretarāśrayatvam | na ca pramāṇāntarasaṃbhave śabdaḥ sāpekṣaḥ, na tu śabdasaṃbhave taditi viśeṣo'stītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt śabdasya aprāmāṇyāt pramāṇa antarasya anapekṣa tvam iti yuktam itaretara āśraya tvam na ca pramāṇa antara saṃbhave śabdaḥ sāpekṣaḥ na tu śabda saṃbhave tat iti viśeṣaḥ usti iti arthaḥ

original: yadi ca siddhārthaṃ śabde pramāṇāntarasaṃbhavamātreṇa tatsāpekṣatvaṃ syāt, evaṃ sati pratyakṣānumānayorapi sparśanakampādiliṅgayorekatra vāyāvanyonyagocare pravṛtteḥ parasparasāpekṣatvamaviśeṣaṃ śabda iva prasajyate | tataśca tayorapyaprāmāṇyaṃ syāt | tathendriyāntaraviṣaye yadīndriyaṃ pravartate tadapi sāpekṣaṃ syāt |
analyzed: yadi ca siddhārtham śabde pramāṇa antara saṃbhava mātreṇa tad sāpekṣa tvam syāt evam sati pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ api sparśana kampa ādi liṅgayoḥ ekatra vāyau anyonya gocare pravṛtteḥ paraspara sāpekṣa tvam aviśeṣam śabde iva prasajyate tatas ca tayoḥ api aprāmāṇyam syāt tathā indriya antara viṣaye yadi indriyam pravartate tat api sāpekṣam syāt

original: taduktam— pratyakṣānumānayorityādinā | satteti ; rūpādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ sattāguṇatve pañcendriyagrāhye ; dravyaṃ tu ghaṭādi tvakcakṣurgrāhyamiti vivekaḥ | atha śabdasyaiva pramāṇāntarasaṃbhave sāpekṣatvam, na pratyakṣānumānayorityucyate, tato 13
analyzed: tat uktam pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ ityādinā sattā iti rūpa ādīnām pañcānām sattā guṇa tve pañca indriya grāhye dravyam tu ghaṭa ādi tvac cakṣuḥ grāhyam iti vivekaḥ atha śabdasya eva pramāṇa antara saṃbhave sāpekṣa tvam na pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ iti ucyate tatas

original: viśeṣaheturvācyaḥ ; na ca so'sti | atha śabdaḥ pramāṇāntarādhigataviṣayo loke dṛṣṭaḥ ; ato'smādviśeṣācchabda eva pramāṇāntarasaṃbhave sāpekṣaḥ, na pratyakṣānume iti cet, uktamatrottaram 'pramāṇāntarasyāviṣaye tarhi natarām' P. 81-11. ityatra | uktamarthaṃ prapañcayati—yadīti |
analyzed: viśeṣa hetuḥ vācyaḥ na ca saḥ asti atha śabdaḥ pramāṇa antara adhigata viṣayaḥ loke dṛṣṭaḥ atas asmāt viśeṣāt śabdaḥ eva pramāṇa antara saṃbhave sāpekṣaḥ na pratyakṣa anume iti ced uktam atra uttaram pramāṇa antarasya aviṣaye tarhi natarām iti atra uktam artham prapañcayati yadi iti

original: yadi pauruṣeyāpauruṣeyaśabdamātradharmo'yaṃ pramāṇāntarādhigatārthatvaṃ nāma, tataḥ pramāṇāntarasaṃbhavādeva buddhādivākyavadaprāmāṇyaṃ śabdasya syāt ; pramāṇāntarasaṃbhava eva tvāptavākyavat prāmāṇyaṃ syāt | ataśca vedāntānāṃ siddhārthatve pramāṇāntarasaṃbhavādaprāmāṇyam, kāryārthatve tu pramāṇāntarāsaṃbhavātprāmāṇyamityuktamayuktamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yadi pauruṣeya apauruṣeya śabda mātra dharmaḥ ūyam pramāṇa antara adhigata artha tvam nāma tatas pramāṇa antara saṃbhavāt eva buddha ādi vākya vat aprāmāṇyam śabdasya syāt pramāṇa antara saṃbhavaḥ eva tu āpta vākya vat prāmāṇyam syāt atas ca vedāntānām siddhārtha tve pramāṇa antara saṃbhavāt aprāmāṇyam kārya artha tve tu pramāṇa antara asaṃbhavāt prāmāṇyam iti uktam ayuktam iti bhāvaḥ

original: atha pauruṣeyaśabdadharmaḥ syāt, tato'pauruṣeyasya vedāntaśabdasya pramāṇāntarādhigatārthatvaṃ nāstīti tasya siddhārthatvena saṃbhavatpramāṇāntaraviṣayasyāpi na sāpekṣatvam | ato nāprāmāṇyam | saṃbhavat pramāṇāntaraṃ yatra tat saṃbhavatpramāṇāntaram, tadeva viṣayo yasyeti samāsaḥ | pauruṣeyatvanimittaṃ hi sāpekṣatvam |
analyzed: atha pauruṣeya śabda dharmaḥ syāt vedānta śabdasya pramāṇa antara adhigata artha tvam na asti iti tasya siddhārtha tvena saṃbhavat pramāṇa antara viṣayasya api na sāpekṣa tvam atas na aprāmāṇyam saṃbhavat pramāṇa antaram yatra tat saṃbhavat pramāṇa antaram tat eva viṣayaḥ yasya iti samāsaḥ pauruṣeya tva nimittam hi sāpekṣa tvam

original: apauruṣeyaśabde satyapi saṃbhavatpramāṇāntaraviṣayatve nimittanivṛttau nivartate, na tu śabdatvasāmānyāt prasajyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: apauruṣeya śabde sati api saṃbhavat pramāṇa antara viṣaya tve nimitta nivṛttau nivartate na tu śabda tva sāmānyāt prasajyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: kiṃca yadyanyatra dṛṣṭamanyatrāpi kenacit sāmānyena syāt, tataḥ svareṇa putrānumānaṃ viśeṣataḥ pratyakṣādhigataviṣayaṃ dṛṣṭamityanumānatvasāmānyāt sāmānyato dṛṣṭasyāpi deśāntaraprāptyā sūrye gatyanumānasya pratyakṣādhigataviṣayatā syāt | ṣaḍjādivivekaviṣayaṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ gānaśāstrapūrvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti ghaṭādipratyakṣamapi tathā syāt | na caivam |
analyzed: kiṃca yadi anyatra dṛṣṭam anyatra api kenacid sāmānyena syāt tatas svareṇa putra anumānam viśeṣataḥ pratyakṣa adhigata viṣayam dṛṣṭam iti anumāna tva sāmānyāt sāmānyatas dṛṣṭasya api deśa antara prāptyā sūrye gati anumānasya pratyakṣa adhigata viṣaya tā syāt ṣaḍja ādi viveka viṣayam ca pratyakṣam gāna śāstra pūrvam dṛṣṭam iti ghaṭa ādi pratyakṣam api tathā syāt na ca evam

original: ato yathā tatrānyatra dṛṣṭapanyatra na bhavati, evaṃ pauruṣeye sāpekṣatvaṃ dṛṣṭamapi nāpauruṣeyasya bhūtārthasyāpi bhavitumarhanti | yadi pauruṣeye yadṛṣṭaṃ tadapauruṣeye'pi syāt, tataḥ pauruṣeyaṃ pramāṇāntarādhigatārthaṃ pramāṇaṃ dṛṣṭamityapauruṣeye pramāṇāntarāsaṃbhavāt prāmāṇyaṃ na syādityuktaṃ natarāmityarthaḥ |
analyzed: atas yathā tatra anyatra na bhavati evam pauruṣeye sāpekṣa tvam dṛṣṭam api na apauruṣeyasya bhūta arthasya api bhavitum arhanti yadi pauruṣeye yat dṛṣṭam tat apauruṣeye pi syāt tatas pauruṣeyam pramāṇa antara adhigata artham pramāṇam dṛṣṭam iti apauruṣeye pramāṇa antara asaṃbhavāt prāmāṇyam na syāt iti uktam natarām iti arthaḥ

original: 'mānāntarasyāviṣaye vidhyarthe tu pratiṣṭhitam | anapekṣatvaṃ pramāṇatvamaśnute' ityuktam ; tatra dūṣaṇamāha—aniceti | yadi niyoganiṣṭhatve tatra pramāṇāntarāsaṃbhavādanapekṣatvena śabdasya prāmāṇyaṃ bhavatītyucyate, tadoṣadhapānasikatābhakṣaṇaniyogayoḥ pramāṇāntarāsaṃbhavāttadanapekṣatvena tadvākyayoḥ prāmāṇyaṃ syāt ;
analyzed: māna antarasya aviṣaye vidhi arthe tu pratiṣṭhitam anapekṣatvam pramāṇa tvam aśnute iti uktam tatra dūṣaṇam āha anica iti yadi niyoga niṣṭhatve tatra pramāṇa antara asaṃbhavāt anapekṣa tvena śabdasya prāmāṇyam bhavati iti ucyate tat oṣadha pāna sikatā bhakṣaṇa niyogayoḥ pramāṇa antara asaṃbhavāt tad anapekṣa tvena tad vākyayoḥ prāmāṇyam syāt

original: na caitadiṣṭam, ekatrānuvādakatvāt aparatra ca nirbhūlatvenāprāmāṇyādityarthaḥ | atra laukikavaidikaniyogavākyayoḥ parābhipretaṃ
analyzed: na ca etat iṣṭam ekatra anuvādaka tvāt aparatra ca nirbhūla tvena aprāmāṇyāt iti arthaḥ atra laukika vaidika niyoga vākyayoḥ para abhipretam

original: viśeṣamāśaṅkayati—nareti | tadviṣṭatam—athetyāditā | sādhyasādhanabhāva P. 81-22 iti viniyogavivaraṇam ; sa ca jvaranāśauṣadhapānayoḥ svargasikatābhakṣaṇayośca draṣṭavyaḥ | yo veti ; viniyogasyārthāntarakathanam | tatra niyojyo jvaraviyogakāmaḥ, viṣayaḥ pānam, niyogastu 'pibet' iti liṅghyaḥ |
analyzed: viśeṣam āśaṅkayati nara iti tat viṣṭatam atha ityādi tā sādhyasādhana bhāva iti viniyoga vivaraṇam sa ca jvara nāśa auṣadha pānayoḥ svarga sikatā bhakṣaṇayoḥ ca draṣṭavyaḥ yaḥ vā iti viniyogasya artha antara kathanam tatra niyojyaḥ jvara viyoga kāmaḥ viṣayaḥ pānam niyogaḥ tu pibet iti liṅghyaḥ

original: etaduktaṃ bhavati—yadi nāmedaṃ niyoge'napekṣaṃ vacaḥ, tathāpi viniyoge sāpekṣatvādapramāṇam | vede tu viniyoge'pi na sāpekṣatvamityanapekṣatvāt prāmāṇyamiti | evaṃ pareṇa lokavedaniyogavākyayorviśeṣa ukte, siddhāntī pratyāha— nṛbuddhīti | hanteti tarhyaye |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yadi nāma idam niyogena apekṣam vacaḥ tathā api viniyoge sāpekṣa tvāt apramāṇam vede tu viniyoge api na sāpekṣa tvam iti anapekṣa tvāt prāmāṇyam iti evam pareṇa loka veda niyoga vākyayoḥ viśeṣe ukte siddhāntī pratyāha nṛ buddhi iti hantā iti tarhi aye

original: yathā tvamāttha, itthamevaṃ tarhi puruṣabuddhipūrvatraiva vacasaḥ pramāṇāntaravyapekṣāyā nibandhanaṃ kāraṇam, tadbhāve loke sāpekṣatvāt tadabhāve vede nirapekṣatvāt ; na tadviṣaye pramāṇāntarasaṃbhavaḥ kāraṇam, yataḥ pramāṇāntarābhāve'pi laukikaniyogavākye sāpekṣatā dṛśyata ityarthaḥ | punaratraiva viśeṣāntaramāśaṅkayati—atheti |
analyzed: yathā tvam āttha ittham evam tarhi puruṣa buddhi pūrvatra eva vacasaḥ pramāṇa antara vyapekṣāyāḥ nibandhanam kāraṇam tad bhāve loke sāpekṣa tvāt tad abhāve vede nirapekṣa tvāt na tad viṣaye pramāṇa antara saṃbhavaḥ kāraṇam yatas pramāṇa antara abhāve pi laukika niyoga vākye sāpekṣa tā dṛśyate iti arthaḥ punar atra eva viśeṣa antaram āśaṅkayati atha iti

original: tat tasmāt vede na pramāṇāntaravyapekṣā, loke tu tadvyapekṣeti yojyam | yadvaco yatra paryavasitaṃ tasya pramāṇāntaragocaratvāgocaratvābhyāṃ tat sāpekṣamanapekṣaṃ ca yuktam, nānyatreti bhāvaḥ | siddhāntī tvāha—neti | yatheti vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ | na śabdamātrakṛto'yaṃ vibhāga ityuktam ; tatrāśaṅkayati—atheti |
analyzed: tat tasmāt vede na pramāṇa antara vyapekṣā loke tu tad vyapekṣā iti yojyam yat vacaḥ yatra paryavasitam tasya pramāṇa antara gocara tva agocara tvābhyām tat sāpekṣam anapekṣam ca yuktam na anyatra iti bhāvaḥ siddhāntī tu āha na iti yathā iti vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ na śabda mātra kṛtaḥ iyam vibhāgaḥ iti uktam tatra āśaṅkayati atha iti

original: pramāṇāntarādarthaṃ jñātvā tatra puruṣo vacaḥ prayuṅkte | tena tat pauruṣeyaṃ vacastanniṣṭhaṃ pramāṇāntaragocaraviniyoganiṣṭham | itarattu apauruṣeyam anyathā niyoganiṣṭhatvena sthitamityarthaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati—śabdasāmarthyena niyoganiṣṭhataivautsargikī | pauruṣeye tu viniyoganiṣṭhatā tadapavādaḥ, na tu śabdasāmarthyakṛta evāyaṃ vibhāga iti |
analyzed: pramāṇa antarāt artham jñātvā tatra puruṣaḥ vacaḥ prayuṅkte tena tat pauruṣeyam vacaḥ tad niṣṭham pramāṇa antara gocara viniyoga niṣṭham itarat tu apauruṣeyam anyathā niyoga niṣṭha tvena sthitam iti arthaḥ etat uktam bhavati śabda sāmarthyena niyoga niṣṭha tā eva autsargikī pauruṣeye tu viniyoga niṣṭha tā tad apavādaḥ na tu śabda sāmarthya kṛtaḥ eva ayam vibhāgaḥ iti

original: vaidikaṃ tviti ; vaidikaṃ tu śabdasāmarthyena niyogapradhānam, niyogasya kāryatvādityarthaḥ | aboddhyate—mānāntareti | saṃbhavi anyat pramāṇaṃ yatra sa saṃbhavyanyapramāṇakaḥ | tadyamarthaḥ—hanta tarhi mānāntarasāpekṣatvāt asya puruṣavacasaḥ saṃbhavyanyapramāṇako viniyogo viṣayaḥ ; na punaḥ asmān saṃbhavyanyapramāṇa- 18A
analyzed: vaidika tu iti vaidika tu śabda sāmarthyena niyoga pradhānam niyogasya kārya tva iti artha saṃbhavin anyat pramāṇam yatra sa saṃbhavin anya pramāṇaka tad yad artha hanta tarhi māna antara sāpekṣa tvāt asya puruṣa vacas saṃbhavin anya pramāṇaka viniyoga viṣaya na punar asmad saṃbhavin anya pramāṇaka

original: P. 83-10. katvāt asya puruṣavacaso mānāntare vyapekṣeti | tadvidhasyeti ; saṃbhavatpramāṇāntarasya viniyogasyetyarthaḥ | uktamarthaṃ sopapatikamupasaṃharati—tasmāditi | mānāntarāt arthaṃ gatvā jñātvā parasya śroturarthapratipattaye puruṣo vacaḥ prayuhyakte |
analyzed: ka tvāt asya puruṣa vacasaḥ māna antare vyapekṣā iti tadvidhasya iti saṃbhavat pramāṇa antarasya viniyogasya iti arthaḥ uktam artham sopapatikam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti māna antarāt artham gatvā jñātvā parasya śrotuḥ artha pratipattaye puruṣaḥ vacaḥ

original: tena tadviri puruṣavacasi pramāṇāntarasaṃbhavāt puruṣavacasaḥ pramāṇāntarasaṃbhavedo bhavāti | ato na pramāṇāntarasaṃbhavātpuruṣavacasaḥ pramāṇāntaravyapekṣetyarthaḥ | pramāṇāntarasāpekṣatvena puruṣavacasaḥ saṃbhavatpramāṇāntaro viniyogo viṣayo jātaḥ, na tu saṃbhavatpramāṇāntaraviṣayatvenāsya mānāntaravyapekṣetyuktaṃ bhavati | tatreti ;
analyzed: tena tat viri puruṣa vacasi pramāṇa antara saṃbhavāt puruṣa vacasaḥ atas na pramāṇa antara saṃbhavāt puruṣa vacasaḥ pramāṇa antara vyapekṣā iti arthaḥ pramāṇa antara sāpekṣa tvena puruṣa vacasaḥ saṃbhavat pramāṇa antaraḥ viniyogaḥ viṣayaḥ jātaḥ na tu saṃbhavat pramāṇa antara viṣaya tvena asya māna antara vyapekṣā iti uktam bhavati tatra iti

original: puruṣavacasītyarthaḥ | apekṣāphalamāha—yatreti | saṃbhavatyasyetyasyāsaṃbhavadupalambhabuddhādivākyamadṛṣṭaviṣayaṃ vyatirekaḥ, na cānupalambhya ityasya ca saṃbhavadupalabdhikramapi dṛṣṭaviṣayamanāptavākyaṃ vyatireka iti vivakaḥ | svoktamarthamāvāryasaṃmatyā draḍhayati—apauruṣeyeti |
analyzed: puruṣa vacasi iti arthaḥ apekṣā phalam āha yatra iti saṃbhavati asya iti asya asaṃbhavat upalambha buddha ādi vākyam adṛṣṭa viṣayam vyatirekaḥ na ca anupalambhyaḥ iti asya ca dṛṣṭa viṣayam anāpta vākyam vyatirekaḥ iti vivakaḥ sva uktam artham āvārya saṃmatyā draḍhayati apauruṣeya iti

original: tena yata eva pauruṣeyāpauruṣeyatvanibandhane sāpekṣatvānapekṣatve, tenaiva hetunetyarthaḥ | anapekṣavyapekṣatvayornimitte iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | yataḥ pauruṣeyatvanibandhanaṃ sāpekṣatvam, ato puruṣabuddhijaṃ yadvedāntavākyaṃ tadbhūtārthamapi sat na sāpekṣam ; ato nāpramāṇam |
analyzed: tena yatas eva pauruṣeya apauruṣeya tva nibandhane sāpekṣatva anapekṣatve tena eva hetunā iti arthaḥ anapekṣa vyapekṣa tvayoḥ nimitte iti ṣaṣṭhī samāsaḥ yatas pauruṣeya tva nibandhanam sāpekṣatvam puruṣa buddhi jam yat vedānta vākyam tat bhūta artham api sat na sāpekṣam atas na apramāṇam

original: atastasyānapekṣatvena prāmāṇyasiddhyarthaṃ kāryaparatvakalpanā vyartheti bhāvaḥ | kathamautapattikatvenānapekṣatvamityuktamata āha— autpattike hīti ; nitye hi śabdārthasaṃbandhe sati apauruṣeyatvāt pramāṇānapekṣatvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | nanu satsaṃprayogasūtreṇa pramāṇāntarāsaṃbhavo'pyuktaḥ ;
analyzed: atas tasya anapekṣa tvena prāmāṇya siddhi artham kārya paratva kalpanā vyarthā iti bhāvaḥ katham autapattika tvena anapekṣa tvam iti uktam atas āha autpattike hi iti nitye hi śabda artha saṃbandhe sati apauruṣeya tvāt pramāṇa anapekṣa tvam bhavati iti arthaḥ nanu satsaṃprayoga sūtreṇa pramāṇa antara asaṃbhavaḥ upi uktaḥ

original: tato'saṃbhavo'napekṣatve heturiti siddhyarthatve pramāṇāntarasaṃbhavāt sāpekṣatvenāprāmāṇyaṃ mā bhūditi tadasaṃbhavāya kāryārthatvaṃ vedāntānāmavaśyamāśrayaṇīyamityabhiprāyeṇa codayati—nanviti | siddhāntī tu satyamuktaṃ pramāṇāntarā saṃbhavaḥ ; kiṃtu pramāṇāntare sati codanaivaityavadhāraṇaṃ na syāt ; atastadarthaṃ sa uktaḥ ;
analyzed: hetuḥ iti siddhi artha tve pramāṇa antara saṃbhavāt sāpekṣa tvena aprāmāṇyam mā bhūt iti tad asaṃbhavāya kārya artha tvam vedāntānām avaśyam āśrayaṇīyam iti abhiprāyeṇa codayati nanu iti siddhāntī tu satyam uktam pramāṇa antarā saṃbhavaḥ kiṃtu pramāṇa antare sati codanā eva eti avadhāraṇam na syāt atas tad artham saḥ uktaḥ

original: na tvanapekṣatvena codanāprāmāṇyārthamityāha—satyamiti | yadi pramāṇāntarasaṃbhave'pi codanāprāmāṇyaṃ syāt, tataḥ kiṃ nirākaraṇena ? tena sāpekṣatvena codanāprāmāṇyavyāghāto mā bhūditi pramāṇāntaranirākaraṇaṃ kṛtam ; ato yuktaṃ siddhyarthānāṃ ca vedāntānāṃ saṃbhava-
analyzed: na tu anapekṣa tvena codanā prāmāṇya artham iti āha satyam iti yadi pramāṇa antara saṃbhave pi codanā prāmāṇyam syāt tatas kim nirākaraṇena tena sāpekṣa tvena codanā prāmāṇya vyāghātaḥ mā bhūt iti pramāṇa antara nirākaraṇam kṛtam atas yuktam siddhi arthānām ca vedāntānām saṃbhava

original: tpramāṇāntarārthatvena sāpekṣatvādaprāmāṇyaṃ syāditi pramāṇāntarāsaṃbhavāya kāryaparatvamāśrayitavyamityabhiprāyeṇa paraḥ pṛcchati—atheti | siddhāntī tu P. 84-8. pramāṇāntarasaṃbhavāt sāpekṣatvaṃ mā bhūtviti nedaṃ tannirākaraṇasya prayojanam ; apitu dharmatattvajñānam ; sāpekṣatvamapauruṣeyatvādeva dūranirastāvakāśamityabhiprāyeṇāha—dharmeti |
analyzed: pramāṇa antara artha tvena sāpekṣa tvāt aprāmāṇyam syāt iti pramāṇa antara asaṃbhavāya kārya paratvam āśrayitavyam iti abhiprāyeṇa paraḥ pṛcchati atha iti siddhāntī tu pramāṇa antara saṃbhavāt sāpekṣatvam mā bhūtu iti na idam tad nirākaraṇasya prayojanam apitu dharma tattva jñānam sāpekṣatvam apauruṣeya tvāt eva dūra nirasta avakāśam iti abhiprāyeṇa āha dharma iti

original: kuta ityata āha—pramāṇeti | pramāṇāntarasaṃbhave hi buddhādipratyakṣaṇocaraśraityavandanādirapi dharmaḥ syāt ; tatrāgnihotrādireva dharmatattvamavadhāritaṃ na syādityarthaḥ | kiṃ tenāvadhāriteneti cet, ata āha—taditi | ayaṃ yatna iti ; pramāṇāntarānirākaraṇayatna ityarthaḥ | atha codanāprāmāṇyārtha eva sa kiṃ na syādityata āha—codaneti |
analyzed: kutas iti atas āha pramāṇa iti pramāṇa antara saṃbhave hi buddha ādi pratyakṣa nocara śraitya vandana ādiḥ api dharmaḥ syāt tatra agnihotra ādiḥ eva dharma tattvam avadhāritam na syāt iti arthaḥ kim tena avadhāritena iti ced atas āha tat iti ayam yatnaḥ iti pramāṇa antara anirākaraṇa yatnaḥ iti arthaḥ atha codanā prāmāṇya arthaḥ eva sa kim na syāt iti atas āha codanā iti

original: codanāprāmāṇyamapi dharmatattvanirṇayārthamevānviṣyate | ataḥ sa eva pradhānam, na codanāprāmāṇyam | na ca pradhānārthatve saṃbhavatyapradhānārthatociteti bhāvaḥ | athavā pramāṇāntarasaṃbhave viruddhārthamapi kadācitsyāt ; yathā agnīṣomīyahiṃsāderadharmatve vihārapraveśādeśca dharmatve buddhapratyakṣam ;
analyzed: codanā prāmāṇyam api dharma tattva nirṇaya artham eva anviṣyate atas saḥ eva pradhānam na codanā prāmāṇyam na ca pradhāna artha tve saṃbhavati a pradhāna artha tā ucitā iti bhāvaḥ athavā pramāṇa antara saṃbhave viruddha artham api kadācid syāt yathā agnīṣomīya hiṃsā ādeḥ adharma tve vihāra praveśa ādeḥ ca dharma tve buddha pratyakṣam

original: tatra ca durbalatve codanāyāstena bādhā syāt, tulyabalatve ca saṃśayaḥ saṃbhavet ; tena bādhasaṃśayotthāprāmāṇyanivṛttaye pramāṇāntarāsaṃbhavaḥ pratipādyate satsaṃprayogasūtreṇa ; na tu pramāṇāntarasaṃbhave sāpekṣatānibandhanāprāmāṇyanivṛttyarthamityāha—athaveti | nanu yadi virodhipramāṇāntare saṃbhavati śabdo na pramāṇaṃ syāt ;
analyzed: tatra ca durbala tve codanāyāḥ tena bādhā syāt tulya bala tve ca saṃśayaḥ saṃbhavet tena bādha saṃśaya uttha aprāmāṇya nivṛttaye pramāṇa antara asaṃbhavaḥ pratipādyate sat saṃprayoga sūtreṇa na tu pramāṇa antara saṃbhave sāpekṣatā nibandhana aprāmāṇya nivṛtti artham iti āha athavā iti nanu yadi virodhi pramāṇa antare saṃbhavati śabdaḥ na pramāṇam syāt

original: tatprāmāṇyāya tarhi virodhinaḥ pramāṇāntarasyābhāvo'pekṣaṇīyaḥ ; ataśca sāpekṣatvaṃ tadavastham | bhūtārtheṣu ca vedānteṣu yeṣu pramāṇāntarasaṃbhavānna tadabhāvaḥ, teṣāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ na syādityabhiprāyeṇa codayati—nanviti | siddhāntī tu kāmamapekṣyatāṃ virodhipramāṇāntarābhāvaḥ, tatrāpi na tāvacchabdasya sāpekṣatvam ;
analyzed: tad prāmāṇyāya tarhi virodhinaḥ pramāṇa antarasya abhāva upekṣaṇīyaḥ atas ca sāpekṣatvam tad avastham bhūtārtheṣu ca vedānteṣu yeṣu pramāṇa antara saṃbhavān na tad abhāvaḥ teṣām prāmāṇyam na syāt iti abhiprāyeṇa codayati nanu iti siddhāntī tu kāmam apekṣyatām virodhi pramāṇa antara abhāvaḥ tatra api na tāvat śabdasya sāpekṣatvam

original: pramāṇāntarāpekṣatvaṃ hi sāpekṣatvam ; na ca pramāṇāntarābhāvaḥ pramāṇāntaram, anavabodhakatvādityāha—kāmamiti | yadi ca bhūtārtheṣu virodhipramāṇāntarasaṃbhavamātreṇāprāmāṇyaṃ syāt, tataḥ pratyakṣādāvapi bhūtārthe tatsyādityāha—virodhīti | kiṃca virodhipramāṇāntara saṃbhavādaprāmāṇyaṃ kāryaniṣṭhatve'pi vedāntānāmaparihārthamityāha—apiceti |
analyzed: pramāṇa antara apekṣa tvam hi sāpekṣa tvam na ca pramāṇa antara abhāvaḥ pramāṇa antaram anavabodhaka tvāt iti āha kāmam iti yadi ca bhūta artheṣu virodhi pramāṇa antara saṃbhava mātreṇa aprāmāṇyam syāt tatas pratyakṣa ādau api bhūta arthe tat syāt iti āha virodhi iti kiṃca virodhi pramāṇa antara saṃbhavāt aprāmāṇyam kārya niṣṭha tve pi vedāntānām aparihārtham iti āha apica iti

original: kuta ityāha—kartavyeti | kāryaniṣṭhatve'pi vedāntānāṃ pratipattikartavyatāpekṣitapratipattavyātmasvarūpabhūtārthapratipatteriṣṭhatvāt, tatra ca pramāṇāntaravirodha-
analyzed: kutas iti āha kartavyā iti kārya niṣṭhatve api vedāntānām pratipatti kartavyatā apekṣita pratipattavya ātma svarūpa bhūta artha pratipatteḥ iṣṭhatvāt tatra ca pramāṇa antara virodha

original: saṃbhāvanā yato'stītyarthaḥ | evaṃ tāvat ‘na tu tadabhāvo'pekṣaṇīyaḥ’ iti paroktaṃ dūṣitam | adhunā parābhiprāyamanubhāṣya tatra pūrvoktaṃ doṣa-manukīrtya tamupajīvya ‘bhūtārthamapi’ ityupasaṃhāraparaṃ ślokārthaṃ yojayati— P. 84-19 bhūtārthasyeti | teneti ; pareṇetyarthaḥ | kilaśabdo'rucidyotanārthaḥ |
analyzed: saṃbhāvanā yatas asti iti arthaḥ evam tāvat na tu tad abhāva upekṣaṇīyaḥ iti para uktam dūṣitam adhunā para abhiprāyam anubhāṣya tatra pūrva uktam doṣam anukīrtya tam upajīvya bhūta artham api iti upasaṃhāra param śloka artham yojayati bhūta arthasya iti tena iti pareṇa iti arthaḥ kila śabdaḥ ūruci dyotana arthaḥ

original: kārya-niṣṭhatve tu svatantreṇetyatra ‘arthaṃ pratipādayati’ ityanuṣajyate | tatra gocaratvāt ityantena parābhiprāyānubhāṣaṇam | ‘uktena’ ityādinā ‘na ca saṃbhava-mātraṃ sāpekṣatvam’ ityantenoktadoṣānukīrtanam | bhūtārthamapītyādinā copa-saṃhāra iti nivekaḥ |
analyzed: kārya niṣṭhatve tu svatantreṇa iti atra artham pratipādayati iti anuṣajyate tatra gocara tvāt ityantena para abhiprāya anubhāṣaṇam uktena ityādinā na ca saṃbhava mātram sāpekṣatvam ityantena ukta doṣa anukīrtanam bhūta artham api ityādinā ca upasaṃhāraḥ iti nivekaḥ

original: idānīṃ vedāntānāmavidhiśeṣatve kriyāṃ vinā padārthasaṃsarga eva na syāditi paroktaṃ doṣamāśaṅkayati—atheti | kriyayā vinā padārthā na saṃsargabhājo bhavanti ; tasmāt ‘satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma’ ityādipadārthānāṃ tava saṃsargo na syāditi bhāvaḥ | taddūṣayati—kimiti | kriyāṃ vinā cenna saṃsargaḥ, astu tarhi kriyā ;
analyzed: idānīm vedāntānām avidhi śeṣa tve kriyām vinā padārtha saṃsargaḥ eva na syāt iti para uktam doṣam āśaṅkayati atha iti kriyayā vinā padārthāḥ na saṃsarga bhājaḥ bhavanti tasmāt satyam jñānam anantam brahma ityādi padārthānām tava saṃsargaḥ na syāt iti bhāvaḥ tat dūṣayati kim iti kriyām vinā ced na saṃsargaḥ astu tarhi kriyā

original: kimāyātaṃ vidheḥ ? yena tadanupraveśo vedāntānāṃ varṇyata ityarthaḥ | nanu sāpyaśrūyamāṇā vedānteṣu durlabhetyata āha—sāpīti | sāpi kriyā astyādirūpā ka na sulabhā ? apitu sarvatraiva sulabhā ; yatrānyat kriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate, tatra “astirbhavantīparaḥ prayoktavyaḥ” iti nyāyenāstikriyā sulabhaivetyarthaḥ | ‘astiḥ’ iti dhātunā tadarthaṃ lakṣayati ;
analyzed: kim āyātam vidheḥ yena tad anupraveśaḥ vedāntānām varṇyate iti arthaḥ nanu sā api aśrūyamāṇā vedānteṣu durlabhā iti atas āha sā api iti sā api kriyā asti ādi rūpā na sulabhā apitu sarvatra eva sulabhā yatra anyat kriyā padam na śrūyate tatra astiḥ bhavantī paraḥ prayoktavyaḥ iti nyāyena asti kriyā sulabhā eva iti arthaḥ astiḥ iti dhātunā tad artham lakṣayati

original: “yajātastu dravyadevatākriyam” itivat | ādiśabdena yathāsaṃbhavamanyāḥ kriyā gṛhyante ; yathā ‘dvāraṃ dvāram’ ityatra ‘apātriyatāṃ, saṃtriyatām’ iti | vedānteṣvastikriyaiva vivakṣitā | etadvivṛṇoti—yadītyādi | ākhyātapadārthaḥ kriyā, tāṃ vinā na prātipadikārthānāṃ saṃsargaḥ ;
analyzed: yajātaḥ tu dravya devatā kriyam iti vat ādi śabdena yathāsaṃbhavam anyāḥ kriyāḥ gṛhyante yathā dvāram dvāram iti atra apātriyatām saṃtriyatām iti vedānteṣu asti kriyā eva vivakṣitā etat vivṛṇoti yadi ityādi ākhyāta padārthaḥ kriyā tām vinā na prātipadika arthānām saṃsargaḥ

original: yataḥ kriyāprātipadikārthānāmanyonyamaruṇaikahāyanīnyāyena saṃśleṣahetuḥ kṛtaḥ | prātipadikārthānāmanyonyasaṃsargabhāve kriyāyāḥ sākāṅkṣatvāt ; kriyā hi sādhyā, prātipadikārthaśca siddhaḥ ; sādhyaṃ ca siddhamapekṣate ; tacca viśiṣṭaṃ padārthāntarasaṃsargeṇa viśiṣṭaṃ bhavati, ekahāyanī-vāruṇinnā | tenānyonyaṃ nānyārthā kriyā saṃsargamākāṅkṣate ;
analyzed: yatas kriyā prātipadika arthānām anyonyam aruṇa ekahāyanī nyāyena saṃśleṣa hetuḥ kṛtaḥ prātipadika arthānām anyonya saṃsarga bhāve kriyāyāḥ sākāṅkṣa tvāt kriyā hi sādhyā prātipadika arthaḥ ca siddhaḥ sādhyam ca siddham apekṣate tat ca viśiṣṭam padārtha antara saṃsargeṇa viśiṣṭam bhavati ekahāyanī vāruṇinnā tena anyonyam na anya arthā kriyā saṃsargam ākāṅkṣate

original: ākāṅkṣā-hetukaśca padārthānāṃ saṃsargaḥ | tena kriyā teṣāṃ saṃsargahetuḥ | atastathā vinā na bhūtārthasaṃsargasiddhirityarthaḥ | ataḥ ko doṣa ityata āha—ata
analyzed: ākāṅkṣā hetukaḥ ca padārthānām saṃsargaḥ tena kriyā teṣām saṃsarga hetuḥ atas tathā vinā na bhūta artha saṃsarga siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ atas kaḥ doṣaḥ iti atas āha atas

original: iti | na śabdagocara iti ; na padārtha ityarthaḥ | aviditasaṃgatitve P. 85-8. brahmaṇo vācyasya pramāṇāntareṇāvagamo hetuḥ | tatra siddhāntyāha—evamiti | padārthasiddhiriti ; brahmapadārtho'bhipretaḥ | kaścidartha ityarthaśabdaḥ prayojanārthaḥ | sā cāstyādikriyatvanvayaḥ | atra hetumāha—astirityanena |
analyzed: iti na śabda gocaraḥ iti na padārthaḥ iti arthaḥ avidita saṃgati tve brahmaṇaḥ vācyasya pramāṇa antareṇa avagamaḥ hetuḥ tatra siddhāntī āha evam iti padārtha siddhiḥ iti brahma padārthaḥ abhipretaḥ kaścid arthaḥ iti artha śabdaḥ prayojana arthaḥ sā ca asti ādi kriyatu anvayaḥ atra hetum āha astiḥ iti anena

original: yatrānyakriyāpadaṃ na dṛśyata iti nyāyo darśitaḥ | itirhetau ; asmācyādityarthaḥ | bhavantī vartamānārthā vibhaktiḥ | tadevamastikriyālābhe tannivandhana eva vedānteṣu padārthasaṃsarge na doṣa ityāha—tatreti ; astikriyālābhe satītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: yatra anya kriyā padam na dṛśyate iti nyāyaḥ darśitaḥ itiḥ hetau asmācyāt iti arthaḥ bhavantī vartamāna arthā vibhaktiḥ tat evam asti kriyā lābhe tad nivandhane eva vedānteṣu padārtha saṃsarge na doṣaḥ iti āha tatra iti asti kriyā lābhe sati iti arthaḥ

original: nanvastyarthaniṣṭhaṃ cedvākyam , kathaṃ svarūpapratipattiparam ? na hyekaṃ vākyamubhayaparaṃ yujyate, vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt | ato'styarthaniṣṭhatve vedāntānāṃ na tataḥ satyānantādirūpasya viśiṣṭasya brahmavastunaḥ siddhirityāśaṅkyāha—sattāyā iti | 'devadattaḥ pacati' iti kartā kriyāśeṣaḥ ; kriyaiva tu sādhyatayā pradhānam |
analyzed: nanu asti artha niṣṭham ced vākyam katham svarūpa pratipatti param na hi ekam vākyam ubhaya param yujyate vākya bheda prasaṅgāt atas asti artha niṣṭha tve vedāntānām na tatas satya ananta ādi rūpasya viśiṣṭasya brahma vastunaḥ siddhiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha sattāyāḥ iti devadattaḥ pacati iti kartā kriyāśeṣaḥ kriyā eva tu sādhyatayā pradhānam

original: satyajñānānantarūpaṃ brahmāstīti tu brahmapradhāna evāstyarthaḥ , na pākavatpradhānatayā pratīyate | nanvatra dvitīyā nāsti ; kathaṃ kārakapradhānatvata āha—prakṛtyaiveti | svabhāva eṣa sattāyāḥ satpradhānatā | kiṃca 'brahmāsti' iti sattāviśiṣṭaṃ brahma pratīyate ; ato viśeṣyatvādapi svatastasya pradhānatetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: satya jñāna ananta rūpam brahma asti iti tu brahma pradhānaḥ eva asti arthaḥ na pāka vat pradhānatayā pratīyate nanu atra dvitīyā na asti katham kāraka pradhānatvataḥ āha prakṛtyā eva iti svabhāvaḥ eṣa sattāyāḥ sat pradhānatā kiṃca brahma asti iti sattā viśiṣṭam brahma pratīyate atas viśeṣya tvāt api svatas tasya pradhānatā iti arthaḥ

original: atra sattāsāmānyāpahavavādina āhuḥ—pramāṇāvagamyataiva sattā, na tato'nyeti ; tadāha—atreti | tatra hetumāha—tathāhīti | viparyaya iti ; pramāṇānavagamya ityarthaḥ | nanvayaṃ sadasadvibhāgahetuḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha—na khalviti | nanu kimityanyo heturna lakṣyate ? yāvatārthakriyābhāvābhāvāveva hetū bhaviṣyataḥ ;
analyzed: atra sattā sāmānya apahava vādinaḥ āhuḥ pramāṇa avagamya tā eva sattā na tatonyā iti tat āha atra iti tatra hetum āha tathā hi iti viparyayaḥ iti pramāṇa an avagamyaḥ iti arthaḥ nanu ayam sat asat vibhāga hetuḥ kim na syāt iti atas āha na khalu iti nanu kim iti anyaḥ hetuḥ na lakṣyate yāvatā arthakriyā bhāva abhāvau eva hetū bhaviṣyataḥ

original: tathāhi—yadarthakriyākāri tatsat, anyattu nṛśṛṅgādyasadityucyata ityāśaṅkyati—artheti | taddṛṣayati—neti | arthakriyābhāvābhāvāvapyarthakriyāgrāhiṇaḥ pramāṇasya bhāvābhāvābhyām , nānyataḥ | evaṃ cedvastusadasattvamapi tābhyāmevāstu ; kimarthakriyābhāvābhāvābhyām ? iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi yat arthakriyā kāri tat sat anyat tu nṛśṛṅga ādi asat iti ucyate iti āśaṅkyati artha iti tat dṛṣayati na iti arthakriyā bhāva abhāvau api arthakriyā grāhiṇaḥ pramāṇasya bhāva abhāvābhyām na anyatas evam ced vastu sat asat tvam api tābhyām eva astu kim arthakriyā bhāva abhāvābhyām iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu arthakriyābhāvābhāvāvapyarthakriyābhāvābhāvanivandhanau bhaviṣyataḥ ; na pramāṇabhāvābhāvanivandhanāvityāśaṅkyāha—tathāhīti | tadviparyayāditi ; pramāṇābhāvādityarthaḥ | evaṃ pramāṇavipayatāṃ sattāṃ prasādhya prakṛte yojayati— tathāceti | tathāca vedāntānāmastyarthaniṣṭhatve pramāṇāntarasāpekṣatvenā-
analyzed: nanu arthakriyā bhāva abhāvau api arthakriyā bhāva abhāva nivandhanau bhaviṣyataḥ na pramāṇa bhāva abhāva nivandhanau iti āśaṅkya āha tathā hi iti tad viparyayāt iti pramāṇa abhāvāt iti arthaḥ evam pramāṇa vipayatām sattām prasādhya prakṛte yojayati tathā ca iti tathāca vedāntānām asti artha niṣṭhatve pramāṇa antara sāpekṣa tvena ātmanaḥ asti artha niṣṭhatve pramāṇa antara sāpekṣa tvena ātmanaḥ asti artha niṣṭhatve pramāṇa antara sā

original: prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt prāmāṇyāya teṣāṃ kāryaniṣṭhatvameṣṭavyamiti bhāvaḥ | taddūṣa- P. 86-18 yati—atreti | itiśabdo buddhiśabdau nirdiśati ; tenāyamarthaḥ— ‘asti’iti buddheḥ śabdasya ca mānāvagamyatvaṃ na ca viṣayo matam ; na mānāvagamyatā satteyarthaḥ | ‘asti’ ityavivakṣitakālanirdeśaḥ, ata eva abhūt, asti, bhaviṣyatīti buddhiḥ |
analyzed: prāmāṇya prasaṅgāt prāmāṇyāya teṣām kārya niṣṭha tvam eṣṭavyam iti bhāvaḥ tad dūṣa yati atra iti iti śabdaḥ buddhi śabdau nirdiśati tena ayam arthaḥ asti iti buddheḥ śabdasya ca māna avagamya tvam na ca viṣayaḥ matam na māna avagamya tā sattā iyarthaḥ asti iti avivakṣita kāla nirdeśaḥ atas eva abhūt asti bhaviṣyati iti buddhiḥ

original: jāte hi māne mānaviṣayatā, na pūrvareva ; ataśca na mānaviṣayatvam ‘asti’ iti buddherviṣayaḥ | tato dhūmādibhyo vahnyādau jāte māne paścāt ‘asti’ iti buddhiḥ syāt | sā tu svayaṃmānaiva ‘asti’ iti jāyate | ato mānaviṣayatvādanyā vastusvabhāvabhūtā sattāstīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: jāte hi māne māna viṣaya tā na atas ca na māna viṣaya tvam asti iti buddheḥ viṣayaḥ tatas dhūma ādibhyaḥ vahni ādau jāte māne paścāt asti iti buddhiḥ syāt sā tu svayaṃmānā eva asti iti jāyate atas māna viṣaya tvāt anyā vastu svabhāva bhūtā sattā asti iti bhāvaḥ

original: ‘asti’buddhāveva dūṣaṇopapattau bhūtabhaviṣyadarthabuddhyupanyāso vakṣyamāṇadūṣaṇārthaḥ | atha māne jāte paścāt ‘asti’buddhirbhavatītyucyate, tatrāha—bhidyeteti | pramāṇāduttarakāle ‘asti’ iti buddhirbhavatīti na vidhā bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānaviṣayatvena bhidyeta, api tu vartamānaviṣayaiva syāt |
analyzed: astibuddhau eva dūṣaṇa upapattau bhūta bhaviṣyat artha buddhi upanyāsaḥ vakṣyamāṇa dūṣaṇa arthaḥ atha māne jāte paścāt astibuddhiḥ bhavati iti ucyate tatra āha bhidyeta iti pramāṇāt uttara kāle asti iti buddhiḥ bhavati iti na vidhā bhūta bhaviṣyat vartamāna viṣaya tvena bhidyeta api tu vartamāna viṣayā eva syāt

original: yadyapi vastu trikālam, tathāpi pramāṇasaṃbandhastriṣvapi vartamāna evetyarthaḥ | vāśabdaḥ pakṣāntaravikalpārthaḥ | nāstīti buddheriti ; ‘asti’ iti buddheḥ tatpramāṇāvagamyatvaṃ na viṣaya iti yojyam | pūraviśeṣāditi ; setubhimittapūraniṣṭhasyarthaṃ viśeṣagrahaṇam | meghodbhaviśeṣāditi ca virodhivāyusaṃyuktameghanivṛttyartham | vaiyākhyāditi ;
analyzed: yadi api vastu trikālam tathā api pramāṇa saṃbandhaḥ triṣu api vartamānaḥ eva iti arthaḥ vā śabdaḥ pakṣa antara vikalpa arthaḥ na asti iti buddheḥ iti asti iti buddheḥ tad pramāṇa avagamya tvam na viṣayaḥ iti yojyam pūra viśeṣāt iti viśeṣa grahaṇam megha udbha viśeṣāt iti ca virodhi vāyu saṃyukta megha nivṛtti artham vaiyākhyāt iti

original: dhāṣṭarcādityarthaḥ | atha svātmasaṃbandhitayā yā pramāṇaviṣayatā, saiva dhūmādiliṅgatrayajena pramāṇena gṛhyate ; ato'styarthabuddheḥ pramāṇaviṣayāyā api nottarakālatā, na ca mite syādityucyate ; tathāpi trikāleṣvartheṣu tatpramāṇāvagamyatayā vartamānatvādastyarthabuddhirna tridhā bhidyeta |

original: kiṃca itthaṃ sati svaviṣayatayaivā styarthaḥ pramāṇena gṛhyata ityastyarthaniṣṭhe'pi vacasi pramāṇāntarāpekṣā na syāt | ato yaduktam—tathā cāstyarthaniṣṭhaṃ vākyaṃ pramāṇāntarāpekṣamiti, tadayuktamiti | tadetat sarvamāha—atheti | atha svaviṣayatā liṅgena pramāṇena na gṛhyate, kiṃtu pramāṇāntaraviṣayatā ;
analyzed: kiṃca ittham sati sva viṣaya tayā eva asti arthaḥ pramāṇena gṛhyate iti asti artha niṣṭhe api vacasi pramāṇa antara apekṣā na syāt atas yat uktam tathā ca asti artha niṣṭham vākyam pramāṇa antara apekṣam iti tat ayuktam iti tat etat sarvam āha atha iti atha sva viṣaya tā liṅgena pramāṇena na gṛhyate kiṃtu pramāṇa antara viṣaya tā

original: kiṃ tat pramāṇāntaramiti cet, pratyakṣamiti hyamaḥ | tacca trikālam ; tathāhi—bhūte bhūtaṃ kasyacitpratyakṣam, anāgate anāgatam

original: vartamāne vartamānam | ataḥ pratyakṣasya traikālyāt tadviṣayatāpi trikāleti ‘abhūt, asti, bhaviṣyati’ iti tridhā bhedopapattiḥ | pramāṇāntarāpekṣatvāccāstyarthaniṣṭhatve vedāntānāmapramāṇyaprasaṅgāt kāryaniṣṭhatvameṣṭavyamiti cet; ucyate—tadasāram |
