original: evaṃ hi sati nityānumeye paramāṇavapratyakṣe pramāṇāntaraviṣayatā nāstīti sthūladarśanena paramāṇurnānumīyeta | tathā mantraliṅgānumeyā viniyojikā śrutirapyatrodāhāryā | kiñcaivaṃ sati na kevalaṃ vedāntānāmeva sāpekṣatvādaprāmāṇyam, apitu liṅgasyāpi dhūmādeḥ syāt; ato'numānamapi pramāṇaṃ na syāt; tadetadāha—anyeti | atrāśaṅkayati— P. 86-18.
analyzed: evam hi sati nitya anumeye paramāṇava pratyakṣe pramāṇa antara viṣaya tā na asti iti sthūla darśanena paramāṇuḥ na anumīyeta tathā mantra liṅga anumeyā viniyojikā śrutiḥ api atra udāhāryā kiñca evam sati na kevalam vedāntānām eva sāpekṣa tvāt aprāmāṇyam apitu liṅgasya api dhūma ādeḥ syāt atas anumānam api pramāṇam na syāt tat etat āha anyā iti atra āśaṅkayati

original: tatsiddhāṃreti | tata eva dhūmāderliṅgāt tatsiddheḥ pramāṇāntarasya siddheḥ prasiddheḥ jñānāt liṅgasya nairapekṣyaṃ yadītyarthaḥ; saṃvādakapramāṇāntarānapekṣāṃ hi nairapekṣyaṃ vyāharanti | iha tu pramāṇāntaraṃ na saṃvādāyāpekṣyate, apitu pramīyate | tatpramitau ca liṅgaṃ nirapekṣameva | taddvāreṇa cāptavākyavadarthasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: tad siddhāṃrā iti tatas eva dhūma ādeḥ liṅgāt tad siddheḥ pramāṇa antarasya siddheḥ prasiddheḥ jñānāt liṅgasya nairapekṣyam yadi iti arthaḥ saṃvādaka pramāṇa antara anapekṣām hi nairapekṣyam vyāharanti iha tu pramāṇa antaram na saṃvādāya apekṣyate apitu pramīyate tad pramitau ca liṅgam nirapekṣam eva tad dvāreṇa ca āpta vākya vat artha siddhiḥ

original: ataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ liṅgasyetyabhiprāyaḥ | vecchabdaḥ pādapūraṇārthaḥ | yadvā tata eva vettatsiddhiḥ, tathā sati na nairapekṣyaṃ yadīti yojyam | atrottaramāha— neti | itthaṃ yannairapekṣyaṃ tadastyarthaniṣṭhe'pi vede rājadaṇḍairlaguḍairvāpi na nivāryate | vedānteṣvapyetat samānam |

original: teṣāmapi hi pramāṇāntarasya tataḥ siddheḥ tatpramitidvāreṇa cārthasiddheḥ prāmāṇyamapratihatamityarthaḥ | tatra paro vedāntaliṅgayorvaiṣamyamāha—tatsaṃbhava iti | laiṅgike nadīpūradhūmādiliṅgagranthe dṛṣṭyādāvarthe tatsaṃbhavaḥ pramāṇāntarasya saṃbhavaḥ | tena tatra tatpramitidvāreṇārthasiddheryuktaṃ prāmāṇyam;
analyzed: teṣām api hi pramāṇa antarasya tatas siddheḥ tad pramiti dvāreṇa ca artha siddheḥ prāmāṇyam apratihatam iti arthaḥ tatra paraḥ vedānta liṅgayoḥ vaiṣamyam āha tad saṃbhavaḥ iti laiṅgike nadīpūra dhūma ādi liṅga granthe dṛṣṭi ādau arthe tad saṃbhavaḥ pramāṇa antarasya saṃbhavaḥ tena tatra tad pramiti dvāreṇa artha siddheḥ yuktam prāmāṇyam

original: na tvatra vedāntaikavedabrahmaṇīti yat, tadasamañjasam; kutaḥ ? brahmaṇyapi sākṣātkaraṇābhyupagamāt sākṣātkāri jñānamasti | atastatpramitidvāreṇārthasiddhau vedāntānāmapi prāmāṇyamapratihatamiti bhāvaḥ | evamiti; pramāṇāntarapramitisiddhestatpramitidvāreṇa vārthadvāreṇa vā tatprameyasiddherityarthaḥ | arthe tasyeti;

original: govyaktiṣu gośabdasya daṇḍiṣu daṇḍaśabdasya vibhītakādiṣu cākṣaśabda syetyāśaṅkya, satyaṃ dṛṣṭvā, kiṃtu tribhiḥ prakāraiḥ ; iha tu sattāmekāṃ vinā teṣāmeko'pi prakāro nāstīti hṛdi kṛtvā tatprakāratrayaṃ tāvadupanyasyati— tathāhīti | minnaṃ vibhītakṛtvādijātitrayaṃ nimittaṃ pravṛttau yasyeti vigrahaḥ | P. 89-6.
analyzed: go vyaktiṣu go śabdasya daṇḍiṣu daṇḍa śabdasya vibhītaka ādiṣu ca akṣa śabdasya iti āśaṅkya satyam dṛṣṭvā kiṃtu tribhiḥ prakāraiḥ iha tu sattām ekām vinā teṣām ekaḥ api prakāraḥ na asti iti hṛdi kṛtvā tad prakāra trayam tāvat upanyasyati tathā hi iti minnam vibhīta kṛtvā ādi jāti trayam nimittam pravṛttau yasya iti vigrahaḥ

original: tatra svabuddhyā-rajyate yena viśeṣyaṃ taddhi viśeṣaṇam ; upalakṣaṇaṃ tu cihnamātram ; taccātītamapi bhavati | na ca pramāṇayogyeṣvastiśabdapravṛttāveṣāmanyatamaḥ prakāro'stīti darśayituṃ sādhāraṇaśabdaṃ tāvannirasyati—na tāvaditi | anantāśca te arthasvabhāvā iti vigrahaḥ | hetumāha— saṃbandheti | saṃbandhino gṛhītvā hi saṃbandho grāhyaḥ ;
analyzed: tatra sva buddhyā ārajyate yena viśeṣyam tat hi viśeṣaṇam upalakṣaṇam tu cihna mātram tat ca atītam api bhavati na ca pramāṇa yogyeṣu astiśabda pravṛttau eṣām anyatamaḥ prakāraḥ usti iti darśayitum sādhāraṇa śabdam tāvat nirasyati na tāvat iti anantāḥ ca te artha svabhāvāḥ iti vigrahaḥ hetum āha saṃbandha iti saṃbandhinaḥ gṛhītvā hi saṃbandhaḥ grāhyaḥ

original: na cānantā grahītuṃ śakyāḥ saṃbandhinaḥ | atastaistacchabdasya saṃbandhagrahaṇāsāmarthyamityarthaḥ | akṣādiṣu tu sādhāraṇaśabdatvaṃ yuktamityāha—parimiteti | vibhītakṛtvādijātiviṣayāḥ, tadupalakṣitā vākṣādiśabdāḥ | tena tatra parimitajātitrayeṇa taddāreṇa vā anantābhirapi taddhyaktibhiḥ saṃbandhagrahaṇasaṃbhava iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na ca anantāḥ grahītum śakyāḥ saṃbandhinaḥ atas taiḥ tad śabdasya saṃbandha grahaṇa asāmarthyam iti arthaḥ akṣa ādiṣu tu sādhāraṇa śabda tvam yuktam iti āha parimita iti vibhīta kṛtvā ādi jāti viṣayāḥ tad upalakṣitāḥ vā akṣa ādi śabdāḥ tena tatra parimita jāti trayeṇa tad dāreṇa vā anantābhiḥ api tad hyaktibhiḥ saṃbandha grahaṇa saṃbhavaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu mamāpi dravyatvādijātitrayopalakṣitānāmanantānāmapyarthānāṃ sacchabdaḥ sādhāraṇo bhaviṣyati, kiṃ sattayeti codayati—syāditi | etacca tripadārthasāṃkarī satteti dṛṣṭyoktam | taddūṣayati—tanneti | kathamityāha— na kileti |
analyzed: nanu mama api dravya tva ādi jāti traya upalakṣitānām anantānām api arthānām sat śabdaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ bhaviṣyati kim sattayā iti codayati syāt iti etat ca tripada artha sāṃkarī sattā iti dṛṣṭyā uktam tat dūṣayati tat na iti katham iti āha na kila iti

original: na hi sarṣapaṃ dṛṣṭavato merau ‘tadevedam’ iti parāmarśo'stīti sattāpahave yā yuktiḥ, sā dravyatvādyapahave'pi tulyā yana ityarthaḥ | kiṃca jātyādiṣvapi sacchabdo'sti, sa dravyatvādinimittatve na syādityāha— apiceti | nanvaupacārikasteṣu sacchabda ityāha—na teṣviti | hetumāha—pratyaya iti |
analyzed: na hi sarṣapam dṛṣṭavataḥ merau tat eva idam iti parāmarśaḥ usti iti sattā apahave yā yuktiḥ sā dravya tva ādi apahave pi tulyā iti arthaḥ kiṃca jāti ādiṣu api sat śabdaḥ asti sa dravya tva ādi nimitta tve na syāt iti āha apica iti nanu aupacārikaḥ teṣu sat śabdaḥ ityāha na teṣu iti hetum āha pratyayaḥ iti

original: yatra hi pratyayavailakṣaṇyaṃ tatrānyaśabdo'nyatropacaritaḥ syāt ; yathā agniśabdo māṇavake | jātyādiṣu ‘sat’ iti pratyayasyāvailakṣaṇyam ; ato nopacāra ityarthaḥ | taduktam—“jātyādiṣvapi sadbuddheḥ sattā tajjātiṣu sthitā” iti | kiṃca śauryādisāmānyāt siddhādiśabdānāmupacāro dṛṣṭaḥ ; na ca dravyāditrayasya jātyāditraye kiñcidekaṃ sāmānyamasti ;
analyzed: yatra hi pratyaya vailakṣaṇyam tatra anya śabdaḥ anyatra upacaritaḥ syāt yathā agni śabdaḥ māṇavake jāti ādiṣu sat iti pratyayasya availakṣaṇyam atas na upacāraḥ iti arthaḥ tat uktam jāti ādiṣu api sat buddheḥ sattā tad jātiṣu sthitā iti kiṃca śaurya ādi sāmānyāt siddha ādi śabdānām upacāraḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na ca dravya ādi trayasya jāti ādi traye kiñcid ekam sāmānyam asti

original: ato nopacāra ityāha—na ceti | athāsti sāmānyamekam ; tataḥ siddhamasmadiṣṭamityāha—satīti | tulyatvāditi ; dravyādiṣu-ca ‘sat’ iti pratyayāviśeṣādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: atas na upacāraḥ iti āha na ca iti atha asti sāmānyam ekam tatas siddham asmad iṣṭam iti āha sati iti tulya tvāt iti dravya ādiṣu ca sat iti pratyaya aviśeṣāt iti arthaḥ

original: prakārāntareṇa sacchabdasya sādhāraṇanāmāśaṅkayati—atheti | kaṇasugādipravaktṛṇāṃ pravādeṣu pravacaneṣu sarve padārthāḥ parimitaiḥ kaiścit ṣaḍbhiḥ pañcabhirvā dharmaiḥ ṣaṭpañcādiprabhedena saṃgṛhītāḥ |
analyzed: prakāra antareṇa sat śabdasya sādhāraṇa nām āśaṅkayati atha iti kaṇa suk ādi pravaktṛṇām pravādeṣu pravacaneṣu sarve padārthāḥ parimitaiḥ kaiścid ṣaḍbhiḥ pañcabhiḥ vā dharmaiḥ ṣaṣ pañca ādi prabhedena saṃgṛhītāḥ

original: tataśca ṣaṭpañcādiparimitadharmopalakṣaṇānāmanantānāmapyarthānāṃ ‘san’ iti sādhāraṇaśabdo bhaviṣyati, yathā vibhītakatvādijātitrayopalakṣaṇānāmanantānāṃ vyaktīnāmakṣaśabdaḥ ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca ṣaṣ pañca ādi parimita dharma upalakṣaṇānām anantānām api arthānām san iti sādhāraṇa śabdaḥ bhaviṣyati yathā vibhītaka tva ādi jāti traya upalakṣaṇānām anantānām vyaktīnām akṣa śabdaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tatra guṇavaccaṃ dravyāśrayatvaṃ nirguṇatvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgayoranapekṣakāraṇatvam anuvṛttabuddhihetutvam atyantatryāvṛttabuddhihetutvam ihapratyayahetutvamityetairdharmaidravyādiṣaṭpadārthāḥ kaṇasukpravāde saṃgṛhītāḥ | evamanyeṣvapi pravādeṣu vācyam | taddūṣayati—tadeti | ayuktatvamāha—saṃgraha iti |
analyzed: tatra dravya āśraya tvam nirguṇa tvam saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ anapekṣa kāraṇatvam anuvṛtta buddhi hetu tvam atyanta tryāvṛtta buddhi hetu tvam iha pratyaya hetu tvam iti etaiḥ dharmaiḥ dravya ādi ṣaṣ padārthāḥ kaṇasukpravāde saṃgṛhītāḥ evam anyeṣu api pravādeṣu vācyam tat dūṣayati tadā iti ayukta tvam āha saṃgrahaḥ iti

original: na hi ‘ṣaḍ gāvaḥ’ ityekena gotvena vinā ṣaḍ govyaktayaḥ saṃgrahītuṃ śakyāḥ | tatra sattānamyupagamādyadi sacchabdatāyāṃ saṃgrahaḥ—kriyate—ṣaṭprabhedaḥ sacchabdārtha iti, tataḥ sacchabdārthasya ṣaṭsaṃkhyātvamuktaṃ syāt, na tu padārthāntaratvam | tat kṛtsnaṃ jaganna saṃgṛhītaṃ syāt ;
analyzed: na hi ṣaṭ gāvaḥ iti ekena go tvena vinā ṣaḍ go vyaktayaḥ saṃgrahītum śakyāḥ tatra sattā anamyupagamāt yadi sat śabdatāyām saṃgrahaḥ kriyate ṣaṣ prabhedaḥ sat śabda arthaḥ iti tatas sat śabda arthasya ṣaṣ saṃkhyā tvam uktam syāt na tu padārtha antara tvam tat kṛtsnam jagat na saṃgṛhītam syāt

original: yathā ‘navavidho gośabdārthaḥ’ ityukte gośabdārthasya navavidhatvamuktam, na punargośabdārthādanye na santīti | tatraitāvatprabhedā eva jagatyarthāḥ, nānye ityeṣārthatattvāvagatiḥ pravādebhyo na syāditi kṛtsnajagatsaṃgrahāya pravṛttāḥ pravādāstadabhāve vyarthāḥ syurityarthaḥ | para āha—nanviti |
analyzed: yathā navavidhaḥ go śabda arthaḥ iti ukte go śabda arthasya navavidha tvam uktam na punar go śabda arthāt anye na santi iti tatra etāvat prabhedāḥ eva jagatī arthāḥ na anye iti eṣā artha tattva avagatiḥ pravādebhyaḥ na syāt iti kṛtsna jagat saṃgrahāya pravṛttāḥ pravādāḥ tad abhāve vyarthāḥ syuḥ iti arthaḥ paraḥ āha nanu iti

original: sacchabdasya sādhāraṇatvābhāvastava sādhyaḥ, na pravādānāmarthavattā | ato yadi nāma te'pyarthāḥ, tathāpi tadupadarśitaiḥ parimitairdharmaiḥ sacchabdasādhāraṇatvopapattena tavābhimatasādhyasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | siddhāntāntaradūṣaṇākhyaṃ nigrahasthānaṃ cedam | siddhāntī tvāha—neti | sādhyamāha—kiñciti | pravādinaḥ pravaktāraḥ kaṇādādayaḥ |
analyzed: sat śabdasya sādhāraṇa tva abhāvaḥ tava sādhyaḥ na pravādānām arthavattā atas yadi nāma te api arthāḥ tathā api tad upadarśitaiḥ parimitaiḥ dharmaiḥ sat śabda sādhāraṇa tva upapattena tava abhimata sādhya siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ siddhānta antara dūṣaṇa ākhyam nigrahasthānam ca idam siddhāntī tu āha na iti sādhyam āha kiñcid iti pravādinaḥ pravaktāraḥ kaṇāda ādayaḥ

original: hetumāha—yata iti | yathā ‘ṣaḍ gāvaḥ’ iti naikamupasaṃgrāhakaṃ gotvaṃ vinā ṣaṭsaṃkhyāniveśaḥ, tathā pañca ṣaḍityādipadārthasaṃgrahe'pi naikaṃ sāmānyaṃ vinā pañcaṣaḍādisaṃkhyāniveśaḥ | tasmādekaṃ kiñcitsāmānyaṃ pravādinaḥ pratiṇdyante; tacca sattetyarthaḥ | bauddhānāṃ vijñānavādināṃ rūpavijñānavedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārākhyāḥ pañca padārthāḥ ;
analyzed: hetum āhayataḥ iti yathā ṣaṭ gāvaḥ iti na ekam upasaṃgrāhakam go tvam vinā ṣaṣ saṃkhyā niveśaḥ tathā pañca ṣaṣ ityādi padārtha saṃgrahe api na ekam sāmānyam vinā pañca ṣaṣ ādi saṃkhyā niveśaḥ tasmāt ekam kiñcid sāmānyam pravādinaḥ pratindyante tat ca sattā iti arthaḥ bauddhānām vijñāna vādinām rūpa vijñāna vedanā saṃjñā saṃskāra ākhyāḥ pañca padārthāḥ

original: kaṇasujo dravyādayaḥ ṣaṭ ; ādiśabdena sāṃkhyādyuktapañcaviṃśatyādayo draṣṭavyāḥ | nanu yadyekamupasaṃgrāhakaṃ vinā na saṃkhyāniveśaḥ, tarhi pramāṇayogyatāyāmarthakriyāsāmarthye caikasminnupasaṃgraho'stu, kiṃ sattayetyāśaṅkayati—atheti |
analyzed: dravya ādayaḥ ṣaṭ ādi śabdena sāṃkhya ādi ukta pañcaviṃśati ādayaḥ draṣṭavyāḥ nanu yadi ekam upasaṃgrāhakam vinā na saṃkhyā niveśaḥ tarhi pramāṇa yogya tāyām artha kriyā sāmarthye ca ekasmin upasaṃgrahaḥ ustu kim sattayā iti āśaṅkayati atha iti

original: evamāśaṅkya dūṣayati—tābhyāmiti | yadi ca P. 89-25. jagadvartyakapramāṇayogyatvamarthakriyāsāmarthyaṃ vopasaṃgrāhakamiṣyate, tato varaṃ tābhyāmeva sacchabdārtha upalakṣyatām, prat pramāṇayogyamarthakriyāsamarthaṃ vā tat sacchabdārtha iti ; te eva sacchabdapravṛttau nimittamiti yāvat | tataśca parimitadharmopanyāso vyarthaḥ |
analyzed: evam āśaṅkya dūṣayati tābhyām iti yadi ca jagat vartyaka pramāṇa yogya tvam arthakriyā sāmarthyam vā upasaṃgrāhakam iṣyate tatas varam tābhyām eva sat śabda arthaḥ upalakṣyatām pramāṇa yogyam arthakriyā samartham vā tat sat śabda arthaḥ iti te eva sat śabda pravṛttau nimittam iti yāvat tatas ca parimita dharma upanyāsaḥ vyarthaḥ

original: evaṃ ca sacchabdasya sādhāraṇatāpi na syādityāha—tatreti | yo bhinnanimitto bhinneṣvartheṣvekaḥ śabdaḥ sa sādhāraṇaḥ, yathā akṣādiḥ | eke eva tu jagadvartinī pramāṇayogyatvārthakriyāsāmarthye nimitte iti sacchabdasya sāmānyaśabdataiva syāt, na sādhāraṇatā | atha te pratyarthabhinne, na tarhi upasaṃgrāhake ; yat ekamupasaṃgrāhakamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: evam ca sat śabdasya sādhāraṇa tā api na syāt iti āha tatra iti yaḥ bhinna nimittaḥ bhinneṣu artheṣu ekaḥ śabdaḥ sa sādhāraṇaḥ yathā akṣa ādiḥ eke eva tu jagat vartinī pramāṇa yogya tva artha kriyā sāmarthye nimitte iti sat śabdasya sāmānya śabdatā eva syāt na sādhāraṇa tā atha te prati artha bhinne na tarhi upasaṃgrāhake yat ekam upasaṃgrāhakam iti bhāvaḥ

original: sacchabdasya sādhāraṇaśabdatāyāṃ doṣāntaramāha—bhinneti | yathā ‘akṣamānaya’ ityukte vibhītakatvādijātīnāṃ nimittabhūtānāṃ bhedāt kena nirmitenāya pravṛtta iti saṃdeho bhavati, tathā ‘san ghaṭaḥ’ ityatrāpi syāt, na sattākhyaviśeṣapratītiḥ ; na ca so'sti, ‘śuklaḥ paṭaḥ’ itivat ‘san ghaṭaḥ’ ityatra pratipattunairākāṅkṣyādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: sat śabdasya sādhāraṇa śabdatāyām doṣa antaram āha bhinna iti yathā akṣam ānaya iti ukte vibhītaka tva ādi jātīnām nimitta bhūtānām bhedāt kena pravṛttaḥ iti saṃdehaḥ bhavati tathā san ghaṭaḥ iti atra api syāt na sattā ākhya viśeṣa pratītiḥ na ca saḥ asti śuklaḥ paṭaḥ iti vat san ghaṭaḥ iti atra pratipattu nairākāṅkṣyāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sattāyāmapi dravyaṃ guṇaḥ karma veti, tathā rūpamarthaḥ san vijñānaṃ veti saṃśayādastyevākṣāditukhyatvamityāśaṅkyāha— yastviti | satyamastyayaṃ saṃśayaḥ, kiṃtu vādināṃ, na tu laukikānām ; ato laukikāḥ sacchabdapravṛttāvabhinnameva nimittaṃ pratipadyanta ityavagacchām ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu sattāyām api dravyam guṇaḥ karma vā iti tathā rūpam arthaḥ san vijñānam vā iti saṃśayāt asti eva akṣa ādi tukhya tvam iti āśaṅkya āha yaḥ tu iti satyam asti ayam saṃśayaḥ kiṃtu vādinām na tu laukikānām atas laukikāḥ sat śabda pravṛttau abhinnam eva nimittam pratipadyante iti avagacchām iti arthaḥ

original: kiṃca sādhāraṇaśabdāt śabdotthaḥ ‘ko'syārthaḥ’ iti saṃśayo bhavati ; yathā akṣādeḥ | jātiśabdārthamasaṃśayaṃ pratītya ‘kiṃtvarūpo'yam’ ityarthotthastadviśeṣasaṃśayaḥ ; yathā gośabdādgotvaṃ pratītya vyakterbhinnamabhinnaṃ veti vādinām | sacchabdasya tu ‘ko'syārthaḥ’ iti na saṃśayaḥ ;
analyzed: kiṃca sādhāraṇa śabdāt śabda utthaḥ kaḥ sya arthaḥ iti saṃśayaḥ bhavati yathā akṣa ādeḥ jāti śabda artham asaṃśayam pratītya kiṃtu arūpaḥ yam iti artha utthaḥ tad viśeṣa saṃśayaḥ yathā go śabdāt go tvam pratītya vyakteḥ bhinnam abhinnam vā iti vādinām sat śabdasya tu kaḥ sya arthaḥ iti na saṃśayaḥ

original: kiṃtu sattākhyamarthaṃ pratītya paścāt ‘dravyaṃ guṇaḥ karma vā’ iti tadantaraviśeṣe | tasmādeṣa sādhāraṇaśabda iti | tadāha—athacciti | nātraśabdāt saṃśayaḥ ; kiṃtu arthottha iti | atra hetuṃ pṛcchati—kuta iti | uttaramāha— viśeṣa iti |
analyzed: kiṃtu sattā ākhyam artham pratītya paścāt dravyam guṇaḥ karma vā iti tad antara viśeṣe tasmāt eṣa sādhāraṇa śabdaḥ iti tat āha atha citi na atraśabdāt saṃśayaḥ kiṃtu artha utthaḥ iti atra hetum pṛcchati kutas iti uttaram āha viśeṣaḥ iti

original: ‘dravyaṃ guṇaḥ karma vā’ iti sattāyāṃ ye viśeṣā vādivipratipattiviṣayāḥ, tatpratītiṃ vināpi ‘san ghaṭaḥ’ iti ghaṭasattāpratītimātreṇaiva pratipattenairākāṅkṣyāt nātra śabdāt saṃśaya ityarthaḥ | nanvarthotye'pi saṃśaye tadviśeṣākāṅkṣāstyeva ; atha kathaṃ nairākāṅkṣyamityata āha—
analyzed: dravyam guṇaḥ karma vā iti sattāyām ye viśeṣāḥ vādi vipratipatti viṣayāḥ tad pratītim vinā api san ghaṭaḥ iti ghaṭa sattā pratīti mātreṇa eva pratipad tā nairākāṅkṣyāt na atra śabdāt saṃśayaḥ iti arthaḥ saṃśaye tad viśeṣa ākāṅkṣā asti eva atha katham nairākāṅkṣyam iti atas āha

original: P. 90-6. yatreti | anyatheti; yadi tatrāpi sādhanaviśeṣākāṅkṣā syāt, tatastadviśeṣākāṅkṣāyāmanavasthā syāt; ato dūramapi gatvā yasya kasyacidupādānānnairākāṅkṣayeṇa bhavitavyam; tadvaramādāveva tadastīti bhāvaḥ | kva tarhi sākāṅkṣatvamityata āha—yatra liti |
analyzed: yatra iti anyathā iti yadi tatra api sādhana viśeṣa ākāṅkṣā syāt tatas tad viśeṣa ākāṅkṣāyām anavasthā syāt atas dūram api gatvā yasya kasyacid upādānāt bhavitavyam tat varam ādau eva tat asti iti bhāvaḥ kva tarhi sākāṅkṣatvam iti atas āha yatra

original: yatra tu ‘aśvamānaya’ ityakṣaśabdādanekārthāt ‘ko'syārthaḥ’ iti saṃśayo bhavati, tatrārthasyaivānavadhāraṇādapravṛttiriti bhavatyarthaviśeṣākāṅkṣā | sacchabdāttu ‘ko'syārthaḥ’ ityākāṅkṣā nāstyeva; apitu ‘kiṃsvabhāvo'syārthaḥ’ iti vaiṣamyamiti bhāvaḥ | upasaṃharati—naditi; tasmādityarthaḥ | evamiti anantaroktaṃ yuktiprakāraṃ nirdiśati |

original: nanvatītatvādeva pramāṇasaṃbandhasya pramitanaṣṭe sacchabdāprayogasaṃdehāvupapatsyete ityāha—chatteti | atītamapyupalakṣaṇaṃ śabdapravṛttau naṣṭam | tataścātītasyāpi pramāṇatvopalakṣaṇatvāt saccameva syāt, nāsaccam | smarthamāṇe ca saccaniścaya eva syāt, na saṃśaya ityarthaḥ | vṛttaḥ pramāṇasaṃbandho yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ |

original: nanu mā bhavatu pramāṇamekamupalakṣaṇaṃ vā, pramāṇayogyatvameva tadvividhyati; tathāpi sattā na

original: sidhyati | kathaṃ ca viśeṣaṇamapyekaṃ pramāṇamityuktam ? taddhi pratiprameyaṃ bhinnamucyate ; na pramāṇayogyatvaṃ nāma kaścidasti | ataḥ pāriśeṣyāt pramāṇameva viśeṣaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ vāsyeyamiti manyate | pramāṇayogyatāṃ vinā kathamarthasya prameyatvamiti cet ; na, pramāṇasāmarthyādevātītānāgatavadupapatteḥ |
analyzed: sidhyati katham ca viśeṣaṇam api ekam pramāṇam iti uktam tat hi prati prameyam bhinnam ucyate na pramāṇa yogya tvam nāma kaścid asti atas pāriśeṣyāt pramāṇam eva viśeṣaṇam upalakṣaṇam vā asya iyam iti manyate pramāṇa yogya tām vinā katham arthasya prameya tvam iti ced na pramāṇa sāmarthyāt eva atīta anāgata vat upapatteḥ

original: na hyatītānāgatayorasatoḥ pramāṇayogyatvamasti, asati dharmiṇi dharmānupapatteḥ | ataśca pramāṇayogyatvameva viśeṣaṇamastu, kiṃ sattayetyuktam | kiṃca sattāpahvanyāyena pramāṇayogyatvamapyekaṃ tairneṣṭam, teṣāmānantyena ekaśabda-pravṛttāvanimittatvāt |
analyzed: na hi atīta anāgatayoḥ asatoḥ pramāṇa yogya tvam asti asati dharmiṇi dharma anupapatteḥ atas ca pramāṇa yogya tvam eva viśeṣaṇam astu kim sattayā iti uktam kiṃca sattā apahva nyāyena pramāṇa yogya tvam api ekam taiḥ na iṣṭam teṣām ānantyena eka śabda pravṛttau animitta tvāt

original: yadapi pratiprameyaṃ pramāṇaṃ bhinnaṃ na tvekamityuktam, tadapi pācakādivadupapatterayuktamityuktam | idānīmarthakriyāyāḥ sacchabdapravṛttau viśeṣaṇatvopalakṣaṇatve nirasyati— yo'pīti | yadarthakriyāvat tat sat | tatrāṅkurajanmanaḥ prāk bījaṃ P. 90-19. ‘sat’ iti nocyeta |
analyzed: yat api prati prameyam pramāṇam bhinnam na tu ekam iti uktam tat api pācaka ādi vat upapatteḥ ayuktam iti uktam idānīm arthakriyāyāḥ sat śabda pravṛttau viśeṣaṇa tva upalakṣaṇa tve nirasyati yaḥ upi iti yat arthakriyāvat tat sat tatra aṅkura janmanaḥ prāk bījam sat iti na ucyeta

original: atha bījapratyakṣe bījamapi janakam, anyathendriyasāmarthyāviśeṣānna tanniyatārthaṃ syāt ; ato'pi svaviṣayapramāṇajananamevārthakriyā ; tato bījaṃ ‘sat’ iti vyapadeśyata iti cet, tanna ; evaṃ hi pramāṇajananākhyāmarthakriyāṃ vijñāya paścāt ‘asti’ iti buddhiḥ syāt, na pramāṇādeva ; na caivam ; vijñāyamānameva bījam ‘asti’ iti jñāyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: atha bīja pratyakṣe bījam api janakam anyathā indriya sāmarthya aviśeṣāt na tat niyata artham syāt atas upi sva viṣaya pramāṇa jananam eva arthakriyā tatas bījam sat iti vyapadeśyate iti ced tat na evam hi pramāṇa janana ākhyām arthakriyām vijñāya paścāt asti iti buddhiḥ syāt na pramāṇāt eva na ca evam vijñāyamānam eva bījam asti iti jñāyate iti arthaḥ

original: atha nirvikalpaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam | ‘asti’buddhistu śabdānuvedhāt savikalpikā | nirvikalpapūrvakaṃ ca savikalpakam | ataḥ pramāṇottarakāla eva ‘asti’ buddhiḥ, na pramāṇādevetyucyate ; evaṃ tarhi liṅgāddhūmāderagnyādau ‘asti’ buddhirna syādityarthaḥ | anumānaṃ savikalpakameveṣyate ;
analyzed: atha nirvikalpam pratyakṣam pramāṇam asti buddhiḥ tu śabda anuvedhāt savikalpikā nirvikalpa pūrvakam ca savikalpakam atas pramāṇa uttara kāle eva asti buddhiḥ na pramāṇāt eva iti ucyate evam tarhi liṅgāt dhūma ādeḥ agni ādau asti buddhiḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ anumānam savikalpakam eva iṣyate

original: na tatra pṛṣṭhabhāvinirvikalpakamasti, yajjananenārthakriyayā paścāt ‘asti’ iti buddhiḥ savikalpikā syāditi bhāvaḥ | athocyate—yadyapyanumāne nirvikalpakaṃ neṣyate, tasya sattā cāstibuddhyā na gṛhyate ; tathāpi kāryeṇa kāraṇamanumeyam | ataśca ‘asyedaṃ kāryam’ iti nirjñātadhūmādikāryasaṃbandhamevāgnyādiliṅgena dhūmādinā anu paścādramyate |
analyzed: na tatra pṛṣṭha bhāvi nirvikalpakam asti yat jananena arthakriyayā paścāt asti iti buddhiḥ sa vikalpikā syāt iti bhāvaḥ atha ucyate yadi api anumāne nirvikalpakam na iṣyate tasya sattā ca asti buddhyā na gṛhyate tathā api kāryeṇa kāraṇam anumeyam atas ca asya idam kāryam iti nirjñāta dhūma ādi kārya saṃbandham eva agni ādi liṅgena dhūma ādinā anu paścāt ramyate

analyzed: dhūma ādi kāryavat tā lakṣaṇā eva sattā dhūma ādi kāryavat tayā gamyate iti uktam bhavati iti atra āha tathā hi iti kāryavat tā sattā sā ced agni ādeḥ jñātā eva kim param adhikam anumīyate kāryavat tayā eva ca kāryavat tā avagamyate iti aśobhanam ekasya sādhya sādhana tva virodhāt iti bhāvaḥ etena ajñātā eva kāryavat tā kāryavat tayā anumāsyate iti api pratyuktam 14

original: jñātaṃ hi sādhanam, ajñātaṃ hi sādhyam | na caikameva jñātamajñātaṃ ca bhavati | nanu tavāpi 'asyedaṃ vyāpyam' iti jñātasaṃbandhameva liṅgena gamyata iti doṣo'styeva ; ucyate—mama sāmānyayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ, viśeṣataśca prameti naiṣa doṣaḥ | bauddhānāṃ tu na sāmānyamastīti viśeṣaḥ | śiśapātvāddṛkṣatvānumāne nirjñātakāryasaṃbandhatāpyastītyūhyam |

original: kiṃca kṣaṇika-vādināṃ kāryakṣaṇakāle kāraṇakṣaṇamasat; ato'sya na kāryaviśiṣṭatā ; P. 90-24. ataśca na kāraṇasya sattā syādityabhiprāyeṇāha—kāryeti | athopalakṣaṇaṃ kāryavattā sacchabdapravṛttāvityucyate, tadapi na, pūrvoktadoṣādityāha—atheti | upasaṃharati—tasmāditi |

original: yathā nīlādiśabdānāmartho'rthātmako yasya kāryaṃ yasya vā pramāṇaṃ sa nīlaśabdārtha iti kāryapramāṇalakṣyo na bhavati, kāryapramāṇayorapi tacca kāryapramāṇābhyāṃ lakṣyaṃ tayorapi tadanantarābhyāmityanavasthānāt ;
analyzed: yathā nīla ādi śabdānām arthaḥ ṛtha ātmakaḥ yasya kāryam yasya vā pramāṇam sa nīla śabda arthaḥ iti kārya pramāṇa lakṣyaḥ na bhavati kārya pramāṇayoḥ api tat ca kārya pramāṇābhyām lakṣyam tayoḥ api tad anantarābhyām iti anavasthānāt

original: apitu kāryapramāṇasaṃbandhanirapekṣatvahetubhyaḥ svarūpeṇa vyavasthitā yathāpramāṇamavasīyate—pramāṇamavabodhakamātramiti yāvat—tathā sacchābdo'pītyarthaḥ | yaduktamanavasthānāditi, tadvivṛṇvan svārthasya kāryapramāṇalakṣyatvābhāvaṃ draḍhayati—kāryeti | tasyeti ; vyavahāravibhāga-syetyarthaḥ |

original: evaṃ dṛḍhīkṛtya svapakṣaṃ punarupasaṃharati—tasmāditi | evaṃ pramāṇayogyatā sacchābdārthaḥ naikā satteti pakṣe dūṣite, parāvṛtya pramāṇayogyatvasattāpakṣe punaḥ pratīkāramāśaṅkayati—atheti |

original: yadi pramāṇa-yogyatvamarthasvabhāvaḥ sattā syāt, tato'styarthaniṣṭheṣvapi vedānteṣu pramāṇāntarānapekṣatvāt astyarthaniṣṭhaṃ sāpekṣamiti parābhimataṃ prakṛtaṃ hīyeta; yadi tu pramāṇahetusaṃbhavastadyogyatā tadā hetau satyavaśyaṃ pramāṇena bhāvyam ; atastasāpekṣatvānna prakṛtahānamiti bhāvaḥ | na caivaṃ nṛśṛṅgādīnāṃ saccaprasaṅga ityāha—na ceti |

original: etāvatā ca pramāṇahetubhāvācca sadyavahāra ityuktam | nadīpūrākhyapramāṇahetusaddhāve vṛṣṭeratītāyā api saccaṃ syāditi yadyapyatra dūṣaṇamasti, tathāpyasya pūrvamuktatvāduttaravibhavācca dūṣaṇāntaramāha—taditi | bhūmau nirvātamiti bhūbhāgatirohitatvādindriyasaṃnikarṣasya pratyakṣaheto-rabhāvamāha ; niliṅgamiti anumānahetoliṅgasya ;
analyzed: etāvatā ca pramāṇa hetu bhāvāt ca sat yavahāraḥ iti uktam nadīpūra ākhya pramāṇa hetu saddhāve vṛṣṭeḥ atītāyāḥ api saccam syāt iti yadi api atra dūṣaṇam asti tathā api asya pūrvam ukta tvāt uttara vibhavāt ca dūṣaṇa antaram āha tat iti bhūmau nirvātam iti bhū bhāga tirohita tvāt indriya saṃnikarṣasya pratyakṣa hetoḥ abhāvam āha niliṅgam iti anumāna hetoḥ liṅgasya

original: avedyānupapannakāmiti

original: arthāpattihetoranyathānupapannasya ; na vedyamanupapannaṃ yatreti vigrahaḥ ; tathā naṣṭadraṣṭṛkamiti āsāgamahetorāsasya | upamānasya ca P. 91-10. sādṛśyaviṣayatvātaddheturnidhisvarūpapratītau dūrāpeta eva | tadevaṃ sarvapramāṇayogyatāmatikāmati nidhidravyam ; na ca tadasat , apitu saṃśayitam | tvatpakṣe cāsat syāt , na saṃśayitamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: arthāpatti hetoḥ anyathā anupapannasya na vedyam anupapannam yatra iti vigrahaḥ tathā naṣṭa draṣṭṛkam iti āsa āgama hetoḥ āsasya upamānasya ca sādṛśya viṣaya tvāt tad hetuḥ nidhi svarūpa pratītau dūra apetaḥ eva tat evam sarva pramāṇa yogyatām atikāmati nidhi dravyam na ca tat asat apitu saṃśayitam tvad pakṣe ca asat syāt na saṃśayitam iti arthaḥ

original: atha na pramāṇahetusadbhāvaḥ sattā ; apitu arthagata eva kaścitsamāvaviśeṣaḥ pramāṇaṃ prati yogyaḥ sattocyate, tadapi na, prakṛtahānādiyuktam | ślokamanyathā vyācaṣṭe—athaveti | pramāṇaviśiṣṭaṃ sadiyucyate | ataḥ pramāṇasadasadbhāvasaṃśaye pramāṇaviśiṣṭābhidhāyisacchabdānuviddhaḥ 'sadvā, asadvā' iti saṃśayo yujyate |

original: tathāhi—yatra rajatamāropyate tamāropaviṣayaṃ śuktikām āropyaṃ ca rajatamajānāno na rajatabhramavān bhavati | tataḥ kimityata āha— nābhāveti | vyavahāro vyavahṛt; abhāvena hi sā viśiṣṭā vyavahṛt, abhāvavyavahāra ityarthaḥ; tadabhāvaśca na dhīpade na buddhiviṣayāvityarthaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati—bhāvavyavahārābhāve abhāvavyavahārabhramastvayeṣyate |

original: tatra bhāvavyavahārābhāvaḥ śuktikāvadāropaviṣayaḥ abhāvavyavahāraśca rajatavadāropyaḥ | na cābhāvaprameyamicchatastau jñātau | ato bhramo na ghaṭata iti | 'nābhāvabhinnā vyavahṛt' ityupalakṣaṇam; abhāvabuddhirapi pūrvaślokanirdiṣṭā vaktavyā | ata evāha—na ca buddhyabhāva iti | anyatheti;
analyzed: tatra bhāva vyavahāra abhāvaḥ śuktikā vat āropa viṣayaḥ abhāva vyavahāraḥ ca rajata vat āropyaḥ na ca abhāva prameyam icchataḥ tau jñātau atas bhramaḥ na ghaṭate iti na abhāva bhinnā vyavahṛt iti upalakṣaṇam abhāva buddhiḥ api pūrva śloka nirdiṣṭā vaktavyā atas eva āha na ca buddhi abhāve iti anyathā iti

original: āropaviṣayāropyājñāne tu yadi dvayorajñānaṃ tato'pratipattiḥ; athāropaviṣayamātrasya, tato rajatasmṛtiḥ; athāropyasya, tato'navadhāritaviśeṣapurovartidravyasāmānyapratītirityarthaḥ | atra cobhayājñānādapratipattireva syādityabhipretam; smṛtisāmānyapratipattī tu prasaṅgādukte | na ca buddhyabhāva ityādinā āropaviṣayājñānamuktam |
analyzed: āropa viṣaya āropya ajñāne tu yadi dvayoḥ ajñānam atha āropa viṣaya mātrasya tatas rajata smṛtiḥ atha āropyasya tatas anavadhārita viśeṣa purovarti dravya sāmānya pratītiḥ iti arthaḥ atra ca ubhaya ajñānāt apratipattiḥ eva syāt iti abhipretam smṛti sāmānya pratipattī tu prasaṅgāt ukte na ca buddhi abhāvaḥ ityādinā āropa viṣaya ajñānam uktam

original: nābhāvabuddhirityādinā cāropyājñānamiti vivekaḥ | abhāvabuddhiḥ abhāvavyavahāra ityabhāvo viśeṣaṇam; buddhyabhāvaḥ vyavahārābhāva ityatra tu viśeṣyaḥ | tena viśeṣaṇasyetyupalakṣaṇam, viśeṣyasyāpi draṣṭavyam | 'adṛṣṭau dhvāntadṛṣṭivrat' iti dṛṣṭāntaśca sādhyavikala ityāha—tama iti | tatra yacchāyāmiti paurāṇikīṃ dṛṣṭimāśrityoktam; taduktaṃ purāṇe
analyzed: na abhāva buddhiḥ ityādinā ca āropya ajñānam iti vivekaḥ abhāva buddhiḥ abhāva vyavahāraḥ iti abhāvaḥ viśeṣaṇam buddhi abhāvaḥ vyavahāra abhāvaḥ iti atra tu viśeṣyaḥ tena viśeṣaṇasya iti upalakṣaṇam viśeṣyasya api draṣṭavyam adṛṣṭau dhvānta dṛṣṭi vrat iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ ca sādhya vikalaḥ iti āha tamaḥ iti tatra yat chāyām iti paurāṇikīm dṛṣṭim āśritya uktam tat uktam purāṇe

original: “bhūtaguṇaśruteḥ” iti | atra bhūtaguṇatvaṃ bhūpāratantryamātramuktam, na tu chāyā guṇaḥ dravyāt pṛthagupalabdheḥ ; api tu dravyāntaram ; guṇavatī dvisā ; guṇavacca dravyam | guṇaśca mahadalpatvākhyaṃ parimāṇam | calā ca sā | ataḥ kriyāvaccādapi tat dravyam ; taduktam—“mahadalpaṃ calācalam” iti |
analyzed: bhūta guṇa śruteḥ iti atra bhūta guṇa tvam bhū pāratantrya mātram uktam na tu chāyā guṇaḥ dravyāt pṛthak upalabdheḥ api tu dravya antaram guṇavatī dvi sā guṇavat ca dravyam guṇaḥ ca mahat alpa tva ākhyam parimāṇam calā ca sā atas tat dravyam tat uktam mahat alpam cala acalam iti

original: sā dravyaṃ kiñcinnimittīkṛtya sūkṣmaiśrāvayavairdṛṣṭairārabhyate | kāṣṭhamivāśritya jvālā tejo'vayavaiḥ | ata eva dravyānugatā jvālā ! sā ca dravyam ; prabhāvasvācca | sūkṣmāstitve ca sthūlameva liṅgam, yathā pṛthivyādau | yathā vāyurarūpaḥ sparśavān, tathā chāyā rūpavatparaparśā, vaicitryādbhāvasya | ato bhāvasvarūpā sā | ata eva cākṣuṣeti |
analyzed: sā dravyam kiñcid nimittīkṛtya sūkṣmaiḥ śra avayavaiḥ dṛṣṭaiḥ ārabhyate kāṣṭham iva āśritya jvālā tejaḥ vayavaiḥ atas eva dravya anugatā jvālā sā ca dravyam prabhāva svāt ca sūkṣma astitve ca sthūlam eva liṅgam yathā pṛthivī ādau yathā vāyuḥ arūpaḥ sparśavān tathā chāyā rūpavat para parśā vaicitryāt bhāvasya atas bhāva svarūpā sā atas eva cākṣuṣā iti

original: yasya tu matam—ālokābhāve bhāvāt tadbhāve cābhāvāt ālokābhāva eva chāyāstu, kiṃ kalpanāgauraveṇa ? mahatā ca taruṇā mahati bhūbhāge āloke'panīte mahatī, alpena cālpā | calā tāvat dravyeṇa ; yatra yatrāloko'panīyate, tatra tatra calantīva lakṣyate | na tu sā mahatī alpā calā ceti na tato dravyasiddhiriti—tanmatenālokābhāvameva vetyuktam |
analyzed: yasya tu matam āloka abhāve bhāvāt tad bhāve ca abhāvāt āloka abhāve eva chāyā astu kim kalpanā gauraveṇa mahatā ca taruṇā mahati bhū bhāge āloka upanīte mahatī alpena ca alpā calā tāvat dravyeṇa yatra yatra āloka upanīyate tatra tatra calantī iva lakṣyate na tu sā mahatī alpā calā ca iti na tatas dravya siddhiḥ iti tad matena āloka abhāvam eva vā iti uktam

original: nanvevamandhasya chāyāmālokābhāvaṃ cāpaśyataḥ kathaṃ tamodṛṣṭiḥ ? ucyate—adṛṣṭarajatasyeva śuktāvadṛṣṭatvāttasyālokādaśane'prameye'pi sadṛśavastumātrapratibhānātmikā bhrāntirupapadyate | yaspunaḥ ‘āropaviṣayāropye nājānan rajatabhramī’ ityuktam, tadviśiṣṭarajatādivastubhramābhiprāyamityavirodhaḥ |
analyzed: nanu evam andhasya chāyām āloka abhāvam ca apaśyataḥ katham tamaḥ dṛṣṭiḥ ucyate adṛṣṭa rajatasya iva śuktau adṛṣṭa tvāt tasya ālokāt aśane prameye api sadṛśa vastu mātra pratibhāna ātmikā bhrāntiḥ upapadyate yaḥ punar āropa viṣaya āropye na a jānan rajata bhramī iti uktam tad viśiṣṭa rajata ādi vastu bhrama abhiprāyam iti avirodhaḥ

original: idānīṃ pramāṇayogyatāṃ sattāmabhyupagamya, astyarthaniṣṭhatve'pi vedāntānāṃ na sāpekṣatādoṣa ityāha—astviti | bhavatu vā pramāṇayogyatā sattā ; P. 96-1. saivāstyarthaniṣṭhā vedāntānāṃ prameyāstu ; tathā tasmin mānayogyatve pramite, tadyogyasya vastuno brahmaṇaḥ sattvaṃ vedāntārtho bhavati |
analyzed: idānīm pramāṇa yogyatām sattām abhyupagamya asti artha niṣṭhatve pi vedāntānām na sāpekṣa tā doṣaḥ iti āha astu iti bhavatu vā pramāṇa yogyatā sattā sā eva asti artha niṣṭhā vedāntānām prameyā astu tathā tasmin māna yogyatve pramite tad yogyasya vastunaḥ brahmaṇaḥ sattvam vedānta arthaḥ bhavati

original: yogyatāpramāmukhena brahmasvarūpe vedāntānāṃ prāmāṇyasiddhirbrahmasvarūpasiddhiśca bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati | na caivaṃ pramāṇāntarasāpekṣatā doṣaḥ, kutaḥ ? pramāṇāntarasaṃbhedābhāvāt | yatra hi pramāṇāntarasparśena pramāṇāntarādhīnā arthasiddhiḥ, tatra sāpekṣatvaṃ doṣahetuḥ |
analyzed: yogyatā pramā mukhena brahma svarūpe vedāntānām prāmāṇya siddhiḥ brahma svarūpa siddhiḥ ca bhavati iti uktam bhavati na ca evam pramāṇa antara sāpekṣa tā doṣaḥ kutas pramāṇa antara saṃbheda abhāvāt yatra hi pramāṇa antara sparśena pramāṇa antara adhīnā artha siddhiḥ tatra sāpekṣa tvam doṣa hetuḥ

original: atra tu ‘pramāṇayogyo'yam’ ityetāvanmātramavagamyate, na tu pramāṇāntareṇa saṃbhedaḥ saṃsparśaḥ ; na pramāṇāntarādhīnā arthasiddhiriti yāvat | ato na sāpekṣatā ; tathāhi—ye'pi pramāṇagrāhyatāṃ pramāṇasaṃbandhaṃ sattāmāhurna tato'nyām, te'pi antarā arthavibhinnatāṃ pramāṇāntara-
analyzed: atra tu pramāṇa yogyaḥ yam iti etāvat mātram avagamyate na tu pramāṇa antareṇa saṃbhedaḥ saṃsparśaḥ na pramāṇa antara adhīnā artha siddhiḥ iti yāvat atas na sāpekṣa tā tathā hi ye api pramāṇa grāhya tām pramāṇa saṃbandham sattām āhuḥ na tatonyām te api antarā artha vibhinna tām pramāṇa antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara antara ant

original: saṃbhedaṃ necchanti ; yathoktam—‘pramāṇasya prameyakoṭipraviṣṭatvānnecchanti’ iti ; tairapi na pramāṇāntarasaṃsparśena pramāṇāntaramanveṣyam, kiṃmuta P. 95-5. ye'rthasvābhāvatāmarthasthāṃ yogyatāṃ sattāmāhustairityarthaḥ | tatprameyamiti ; tasyāḥ sattāyā avinābhāvena prameyamityarthaḥ | atra paraścodayati—kathamiti |
analyzed: saṃbhedam na icchanti yathā uktam pramāṇasya prameya koṭi praviṣṭa tvāt na icchanti iti taiḥ api na pramāṇa antara saṃsparśena pramāṇa antaram anveṣyam kim muta

original: yadā astyarthaniṣṭhaṃ vedāntavacaḥ pramāṇayogyatāmātre nivṛttavyāpāraṃ viśiṣṭasyānandādirūpayogyatāviśiṣṭasya yogyasya brahmaṇaḥ saccaṃ na bodhayati, tadā viśiṣṭārthasaccasiddhaye yatpramāṇayogyo'sāvarthastatpramāṇaṃ kathaṃ nāpekṣyam ? apitu apekṣyamevetyarthaḥ | siddhāntī tu pṛcchati—kimarthamiti | para āha—viśiṣṭeti |
analyzed: yadā asti artha niṣṭham vedānta vacaḥ pramāṇa yogyatā mātre nivṛtta vyāpāram viśiṣṭasya ānanda ādi rūpa yogyatā viśiṣṭasya yogyasya brahmaṇaḥ saccam na bodhayati tadā viśiṣṭa artha sacca siddhaye yad pramāṇa yogyaḥ asau arthaḥ tat pramāṇam katham na apekṣyam apitu apekṣyam eva iti arthaḥ siddhāntī tu pṛcchati kimartham iti paraḥ āha viśiṣṭa iti

original: astyarthaniṣṭhaṃ vaco yogyatāmātraṃ pratipādyoparatavyāpāraṃ na viśiṣṭārthasaccamavagamayati ; atastadarthaṃ pramāṇāntaramanveṣyamityarthaḥ | punaḥ siddhāntī pṛcchati—kimiti | kiṃ punaviśiṣṭasyārthasya saccam, yasyāstyarthaniṣṭhena vacasānavagamitasyāvagamāya pramāṇāntaramanveṣyamityarthaḥ | para āha—pramāṇeti | siddhāntyāha— adhigatamiti |
analyzed: asti artha niṣṭham vacaḥ yogyatā mātram pratipādya uparata vyāpāram na viśiṣṭa artha saccam avagamayati atas tad artham pramāṇa antaram anveṣyam iti arthaḥ punar siddhāntī pṛcchati kim iti kim punar viśiṣṭasya arthasya saccam yasya asti artha niṣṭhena vacasā anavagamitasya avagamāya pramāṇa antaram anveṣyam iti arthaḥ paraḥ āha pramāṇa iti siddhāntī āha adhigatam iti

original: yadi pramāṇayogyatvaṃ viśiṣṭārthasaccam, evaṃ tarhi astyarthaniṣṭhatvādvacaso'dhigatameva tat ; yataḥ pramāṇayogyataivāstyartha ityarthaḥ | yadyapi yogyatāvinābhāvena yogyasya siddhirityuktatvānna tadarthaṃ pramāṇāntaramapekṣyamityuttaramasti, tathāpyuttaravibhavāduttarāntaramuktam |
analyzed: yadi pramāṇa yogya tvam viśiṣṭa artha saccam evam tarhi asti artha niṣṭhatvāt vacasā adhigatam eva tat yatas pramāṇa yogyatā eva asti arthaḥ iti arthaḥ yadi api yogyatā avinābhāvena yogyasya siddhiḥ iti ukta tvāt na tad artham pramāṇa antaram apekṣyam iti uttaram asti tathā api uttara vibhavāt uttara antaram uktam

original: pramāṇāntarasaṃbhedābhāvādastyarthaniṣṭhānāṃ vedāntānāmapramāṇayadoṣābhāva uktaḥ ; adhunā tu pramāṇāntarasaṃbhedābhyupagame'pi na doṣa ityāha—pramāṇāntareti | nośabdo niṣedhārthaḥ | pramāṇāntareṇa bhinnaḥ saṃsṛṣṭo'rtho yasya vacasastadapi nāpramāṇam, apitu pramāṇameva, yathā—āptavākyam | nanu pramāṇāntarabhinnārthaṃ cet, tataḥ sāpekṣam ;
analyzed: pramāṇa antara saṃbheda abhāvāt asti artha niṣṭhānām vedāntānām apramāṇayā doṣa abhāvaḥ uktaḥ adhunā tu pramāṇa antara saṃbheda abhyupagame pi na doṣaḥ iti āha pramāṇa antara iti nośabdaḥ niṣedha arthaḥ pramāṇa antareṇa bhinnaḥ saṃsṛṣṭa ūrthaḥ yasya vacasaḥ tat api na apramāṇam apitu pramāṇam eva yathā āpta vākyam nanu pramāṇa antara bhinna artham ced tatas sāpekṣam

original: yacca pramāṇam, tatkathaṃ sāpekṣaṇityāśaṅkyāha—nirapekṣamiti | yacchabdātpratīṣiṣitam, ‘idaṃ vastu mayā pramitam’ iti, ihāsminnarthe vakrabhiprāyarūpe śrotrā pramāṇāntareṇāpratīte śabdodevānyanirapekṣādavagamyamāne nirapekṣaṃ tadvaca ityarthaḥ ; tathāhi— pauruṣeyādvacanāt ‘evamayaṃ puruṣo veda’ iti pratītiḥ, na tu ‘evamarthaḥ’ iti |
analyzed: yat ca pramāṇam tat katham sāpekṣaṇā iti āśaṅkya āha nirapekṣam iti yad śabdāt idam vastu mayā pramitam iti iha asmin arthe vakra abhiprāya rūpe śrotrā pramāṇa antareṇa apratīte śabda udeva anya nirapekṣāt avagamyamāne nirapekṣam tat vacaḥ iti arthaḥ tathā hi pauruṣeyāt vacanāt evam ayam puruṣaḥ veda iti pratītiḥ na tu evam arthaḥ iti

original: ‘pramitaṃ mayā’ iti vakturvākyena svapramāṇaprakāśanamuktam ; śrotā tu ‘pramitamanena’ iti budhyate | kva nāma tatsāpekṣamityata āha—
analyzed: pramitam mayā iti vaktuḥ vākyena sva pramāṇa prakāśanam uktam śrotā tu pramitam anena iti budhyate kva nāma tat sāpekṣam iti atas āha

original: artheti | arthamātre tadvacaḥ sāpekṣam | atra hetumāha—anyeti ; P. 95-18. vaktṛpramāṇadvāreṇārthaṃ bodhayati, na tu tannirapekṣamityarthaḥ | anyat vaktṛpramāṇaṃ svasiddhaye'pekṣata ityanyāpekṣaḥ, sa cāsāvarthaścetyanyāpekṣārthaḥ, tasya bodhanādanyāpekṣārthabodhanāditi |
analyzed: artha iti artha mātre tat vacaḥ sāpekṣam atra hetum āha anya iti vaktṛ pramāṇa dvāreṇa artham bodhayati na tu tad nirapekṣam iti arthaḥ anyat vaktṛ pramāṇam sva siddhayā ipekṣate iti anya apekṣaḥ sa ca asau arthaḥ ca iti anya apekṣa arthaḥ tasya bodhanāt anya apekṣa artha bodhanāt iti

original: tadevaṃ vaktṛrūpalabdhipramāṇāntaranirapekṣameva tadvaco bodhayatīti tannirapekṣatvātprāmāṇyamaśnute, taddvāreṇa cārtha iti sthitam | nanvarthaṃ tatsāpekṣamityuktam; ataḥ kathaṃ tatra prāmāṇyamucyate ? abādhitārthatvāt arthaṃ tadavisaṃvādamātrābhiprāyeṇārthaṃ tatpramāṇayityuktamityadoṣaḥ |
analyzed: tat evam vaktṛ rūpa labdhi pramāṇa antara nirapekṣam eva tat vacaḥ bodhayati iti tad nirapekṣa tvāt prāmāṇyam aśnute tad dvāreṇa ca arthaḥ iti sthitam nanu artham tat sāpekṣam iti uktam atas katham tatra prāmāṇyam ucyate abādhita artha tvāt artham tad avisaṃvāda mātra abhiprāyeṇa artham tat pramāṇayiti uktam iti adoṣaḥ

original: nanu yadi sāpekṣamapyabādhitārthaṃ bacaḥ pramāṇaṃ bhavati, tarhi caityavandanādipuruṣavacaḥ kathamabādhitārthamapi tatsāpekṣatvadoṣādapramāṇamucyata ityāśaṅkyāha— abādhitamiti | yadyapi tatra nārthaṃ bādhaḥ, tathāpi mūlabhūte vaktṛpramāṇe tadapabādhyate, tathāhi—na tadvacaḥ pratyakṣādimūlam, dharmasya tadagocaratvāt |
analyzed: nanu yadi sāpekṣam api abādhita artham bacaḥ pramāṇam bhavati tarhi caitya vandana ādi puruṣa vacaḥ katham abādhita artham api tad sāpekṣa tva doṣāt apramāṇam ucyate iti āśaṅkya āha abādhitam iti yadi api tatra na artham bādhaḥ tathā api mūla bhūte vaktṛ pramāṇe tat apabādhyate tathā hi na tat vacaḥ pratyakṣa ādi mūlam dharmasya tad agocara tvāt

original: na ca buddhasya manvāderiva vedasaṃyogo'sti | tadevaṃ pramāṇāṃśe tadvādhyate; tadabhāvāccārthe'pi | taduktam “puruṣāśaktitastatra sāpavādatvasaṃbhavaḥ” iti; puruṣasya dharmaṃ draṣṭumaśaktitaḥ tatra buddhavacanādau apavādaḥ aprāmāṇyaṃ tasya saṃbhava ityarthaḥ | tena vaktṛḥ pramāṇe'rthaṃ ca na tatpramāṇatāmeti |
analyzed: na ca buddhasya manu ādeḥ iva veda saṃyogaḥ usti tat evam pramāṇa aṃśe tat vādhyate tad abhāvāt ca arthe api tat uktam puruṣa aśaktitaḥ tatra sa apavāda tva saṃbhavaḥ iti puruṣasya dharmam draṣṭum aśaktitaḥ tatra buddha vacana ādau apavādaḥ aprāmāṇyam tasya saṃbhavaḥ iti arthaḥ tena vaktṛḥ ca na tat pramāṇatām eti

original: evamanāptavākye'pi yathāsaṃbhavaṃ yojyam | āptavākye tu tadvaiparītyena prāmāṇyamāha—āpteti | pramāṇāṃśa iti, arthaṃ tu sāpekṣamityuktaṃ bhavati | evamāptavākyeṣu pramāṇāntarasaṃsparśe'pi prāmāṇyamupapādya vedāntānāmapi pramāṇāntarasaṃsparśe satyapi tathaiva prāmāṇyamityāha—mayeti |

original: tatra vaidikīṣu P 105-21 pravṛttiṣu laukikapravṛttihetorasaṃbhavādalaukike pravṛttihetau vaidikādeva vyavahārāt saṃbandhajñānam | ato na lokāvagamyo vede liṅādyarthaḥ, kiṃtu anyathaiva | 'laukika—' iti nyāyavirodhaśrāddhavanīyādiśabdavat parihartavyaḥ | ato na laukikāsaṃbhave mithyātvam |

analyzed: na ca vaidikīṣu api pravṛttiṣu pravṛtti hetoḥ pravṛtti anumeya tvam aviśiṣṭam iti anuvāda tvāt na vimucyate iti vācyam yatas na tatra pravṛttyā pravṛtti hetuḥ anumīyate apitu prayojya vṛddhasya tad pratyayaḥ pravṛtti hetoḥ ca siddhiḥ tad pratyaya sāmarthyena sa ca prayojyasya pravṛtti hetu pratyayaḥ śabda utthaḥ iti pravṛtti hetoḥ niyogasya śabda eka gamya tvam

original: yaccoktam—laukikasya śreyaḥsādhanatvasya saṃbhavāt nālaukiko vidhyarthaḥ karaṇyata iti, tadayuktam ; yato laukikī śreyaḥsādhanatā pramāṇāntaragamyā, pramāṇāntaragamye liṅādeḥ prayogadarśanāt | laukikaprayogānusāreṇa ca vede śabdārtho'nusartavyaḥ |

original: tatra śreyaḥsādhanatā cedvede liṅyarthaḥ syāt tataḥ pramāṇāntaramapi śabdārthaḥ syāt, tathaiva vyutpatteḥ ; na caivam ; apauruṣeyatvādvede pramāṇāntarābhāvāt | tenālaukika eva pramāṇāntaragocaro vede liṅyarthaḥ, nānuvādabhāk |

original: ato'pūrvaṃ saṃsargamākṣeptumalamiti cenmatam, tatro'cyate—bhavatu vedavyavahārāt vede śabdārthayoranugamo'nvayaḥ saṃbandhajñānamiti yāvat, tathāpi na vidhyarthasya pramāṇāntaragocaratā vyāvartate ;
analyzed: atopūrvam saṃsargam ākṣeptum alam iti ced matam tatra ucyate bhavatu veda vyavahārāt vede śabda arthayoḥ anugamaḥ nvayaḥ saṃbandha jñānam iti yāvat tathā api na vidhi arthasya pramāṇa antara gocara tā vyāvartate

original: tathāhi—alaukike vidhyarthe yadā liṅādiśabdasya vācakasāmarthyaṃ gamyate, tadā sa vidhyarthaḥ pramitaḥ, na vā apramitaḥ ? tatra pramitaścet, tato na tata eva liṅādeḥ śabdāt tasya tadaiva jñāyamānasaṃbandhatvena pūrvamajñātasaṃbandhasyābodhakatvāt | ato'vaśyaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa pramitiriti vācyam | ata āpannaṃ pramāṇāntaragocaratvam |
analyzed: tathā hi alaukike vidhi arthe yadā liṅ ādi śabdasya vācaka sāmarthyam gamyate tadā sa vidhi arthaḥ pramitaḥ na vā apramitaḥ tatra pramitaḥ ced tatas na tatas eva liṅ ādeḥ śabdāt tasya tadā eva jñāyamāna saṃbandha tvena pūrvam ajñāta saṃbandhasya abodhaka tvāt atas vaśyam pramāṇa antareṇa pramitiḥ iti vācyam atas āpannam pramāṇa antara gocara tvam

original: atha na pramitaḥ, tato yadāpi śabdaḥ pramitaḥ, tadā vidhyartho na pramitaḥ ; tataśca dvayoḥ saṃbandhinorajñānāt tadāśrayaḥ saṃbandho jñātumaśakyaḥ | etaccābhyupagamyoktam | taccatastu na liṅādayaḥ kevalā vaidikāḥ ; tena teṣāṃ paśvādiśabdavallaukikādeva vyutpattiryuktā | 15A

original: yo'pi manyate—śaktiḥ śabdasya saṃbandhaḥ | sā ca nārthe pravṛttihetau, tasya tatpratyayadvāreṇa pratīyamānatvena vyavahitatvāt | kiṃtu tatpratyaye ; sa hi śabdasya sākṣātkāryaḥ | sa eva ca prayojyavṛddhasya pravṛttyānumito na pravṛttihetuḥ | tenaiva ca liṅgadeḥ śabdasya saṃbandhajñānam | tena na pravṛttihetoḥ pramāṇāntaragocaratā |
analyzed: yaḥ api manyate śaktiḥ śabdasya saṃbandhaḥ sā ca na arthe pravṛtti hetau tasya tad pratyaya dvāreṇa pratīyamāna tvena vyavahita tvāt kiṃtu tad pratyaye sa hi śabdasya sākṣātkāryaḥ saḥ eva ca prayojya vṛddhasya pravṛttyā anumitaḥ na pravṛtti hetuḥ tena eva ca liṅga ādeḥ śabdasya saṃbandha jñānam tena na pravṛtti hetoḥ pramāṇa antara gocara tā

original: na ca saṃbandhajñānānupapattiḥ, pravṛttihetāva- P.106-15 pramite'pi tatpratyayena pramitena tadupapatteriti | sa idaṃ praṣṭavyaḥ—kiṃ pratyayamātre śabdasya sāmarthyaṃ gṛhyate? athālaukikapravṛttihetupratyaye? yadyādyaḥ pakṣaḥ, tadā tataḥ prayojyasya pratyayāttatpravṛttyānumitāt bālena yatkiñcitpratīyeta, nālaukikaḥ pravṛttihetuḥ |
analyzed: na ca saṃbandha jñāna anupapattiḥ pravṛtti hetau tad pratyayena pramitena tad upapatteḥ iti saḥ idam praṣṭavyaḥ kim pratyaya mātre śabdasya sāmarthyam gṛhyate atha alaukika pravṛtti hetu pratyaye yadi ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ tadā tatas prayojyasya pratyayāt tad pravṛttyā anumitāt bālena yat kiñcid pratīyeta na alaukikaḥ pravṛtti hetuḥ

original: atha prayojyasya pravṛttihetupratyayaḥ, tatpravṛttyā laukikāsambhavena ca pāriśeṣyādalaukikārthaviṣayamanumāya tatra bālaḥ śabdasya sāmarthyaṃ pratyeti, tato viśiṣṭaprayojyapratyayānumitau tadviśeṣaṇasya pravṛttihetorapi pravṛttipāriśeṣyābhyāmanumitatvādāpannaṃ tasya pramāṇāntaragocaratvam;
analyzed: atha prayojyasya pravṛtti hetu pratyayaḥ tad pravṛttyā laukika asambhavena ca pāriśeṣyāt alaukika artha viṣayam anumāya tatra bālaḥ śabdasya sāmarthyam pratyeti tatas viśiṣṭa prayojya pratyaya anumitau tad viśeṣaṇasya pravṛtti hetoḥ api pravṛtti pāriśeṣyābhyām anumita tvāt āpannam tasya pramāṇa antara gocara tvam

original: tathāhi—smṛtaṃ vā viśeṣaṇaṃ viśiṣṭapramitāvaṅgaṃ bhavati, yathā—‘abhimān dhūmāt’ ityādisaṃbandhajñānasamaye smarthamāṇo'mristadviśiṣṭaparvatapramitau; pramitaṃ vā, yathā—‘śuklo gauḥ’ iti śauklyaṃ tadviśiṣṭagopramitau |
analyzed: tathā hi smṛtam vā viśeṣaṇam viśiṣṭa pramitau aṅgam bhavati yathā abhimān dhūmāt ityādi saṃbandha jñāna samaye smarthamāṇaḥ ūmriḥ tad viśiṣṭa parvata pramitau pramitam vā yathā śuklaḥ gauḥ iti śauklyam tad viśiṣṭa go pramitau

original: tadiha yadi pravṛttihetustatpratyayasya smṛtau yadi vā pramitau viśeṣaṇam, ubhayathāpi pramāṇāntaraviṣayo na śabdaikagamyaḥ, śabdasya tadānīmagṛhītasaṃbandhatvāt | tatra yadi smṛtyākṛṣṭaḥ pravṛttihetustatpratyayasya viśeṣaṇam, tataḥ smṛteḥ pramitijanyatvādavaśyaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ smṛtisiddhye'nveṣṭavyam | ataḥ pramitatvānna śabdaikagamyatvam |
analyzed: tat iha yadi pravṛtti hetuḥ tad pratyayasya smṛtau yadi vā pramitau viśeṣaṇam ubhayathā api pramāṇa antara viṣayaḥ na śabda eka gamyaḥ śabdasya tadānīm agṛhīta saṃbandha tvāt tatra yadi smṛti ākṛṣṭaḥ pravṛtti hetuḥ tad pratyayasya viśeṣaṇam tatas smṛteḥ pramiti janya tvāt avaśyam pramāṇa antaram smṛti siddhyā inveṣṭavyam atas pramita tvāt na śabda eka gamya tvam

original: atha pramitau viśeṣaṇam, tadāpi viśiṣṭānumitau viśeṣaṇasyāpyanumitatvāt pravṛttihetoḥ pramāṇāntaragocaratvam | atha matam—satyaṃ pratītālaukikapravṛttihetuviśiṣṭa eva prayojyapratyayastatpravṛttyā pāriśeṣyādanumānenānumīyate, tathāpi prayojyasya pratyaya evānumānasya pramāṇyaṃ na tadviśeṣaṇe pravṛttihetau;
analyzed: atha pramitau viśeṣaṇam tadā api viśiṣṭa anumitau viśeṣaṇasya api anumita tvāt pravṛtti hetoḥ pramāṇa antara gocara tvam atha matam satyam pratīta alaukika pravṛtti hetu viśiṣṭaḥ eva prayojya pratyayaḥ tad pravṛttyā pāriśeṣyāt anumānena anumīyate tathā api prayojyasya pratyayaḥ eva anumānasya pramāṇyam na tad viśeṣaṇe pravṛtti hetau

original: tasya tu tatra pratītimātram, na tu pramitiḥ; pramitistu tasya pravṛttyānumitāt prayojyapratyayādeva; sa ca śabda iti nānumeyatvam; taccapramitasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ kimedamanyatra dṛṣṭam | dṛṣṭamiti brūmaḥ; yathā—āptavacanaṃ viśiṣṭe kṣattupratyaye pramāṇam, na pratyayamātre; viśiṣṭatā ca pratyayasyārthānubandhena, na svataḥ | sa cārthaḥ
analyzed: tasya tu tatra pratīti mātram na tu pramitiḥ pramitiḥ tu tasya pravṛttyā anumitāt prayojya pratyayāt eva sa ca śabdaḥ iti na anumeya tvam tat ca pramitasya viśeṣaṇa tvam kim idam anyatra dṛṣṭam dṛṣṭam iti brūmaḥ yathā āpta vacanam viśiṣṭe kṣattu pratyaye pramāṇam na pratyaya mātre viśiṣṭa tā ca pratyayasya artha anubandhena na svatas sa ca arthaḥ

original: pratīta eva pratyayaṃ viśinaṣṭi | na cāptavacanapramitaḥ, tasya vaktṛpratyaya mātre prāmāṇyāt; arthasya ca tata eva vaktṛpratyayāduttarakāle pramiteḥ, tataḥ pūrvameva ca viśiṣṭapratyayapratīteḥ | tasmātpratītamātraḥ pravṛttihetu-statpratyayānumitau viśeṣaṇam, na smṛto na pramita iti | tadayuktam; P.
analyzed: pratītaḥ eva pratyayam viśinaṣṭi na ca āpta vacana pramitaḥ tasya vaktṛ pratyaya mātre prāmāṇyāt arthasya ca tatas eva vaktṛ pratyayāt uttara kāle pramiteḥ tatas pūrvam eva ca viśiṣṭa pratyaya pratīteḥ tasmāt pratīta mātraḥ pravṛtti hetuḥ tad pratyaya anumitau viśeṣaṇam na smṛtaḥ na pramitaḥ iti tat ayuktam

original: 107-4 pañcavidhā hi pratītiḥ—pramāṇasaṃśayaviparyayavikalpasmṛtirūpā | tatra yayā pratītyā pravṛttihetuḥ pratītamātraṃ ucyate, tayāvaśyaṃ pramāṇādiṣu madhye'nyatarayā bhāvyam | tatra na tāvatsmṛtiḥ, prāganavagateḥ; avagataṃ hi smaryate | na saṃśayaḥ, ubhayakoṭisaṃsparśaśirahāt | na ca vikalpaḥ; sa hi vastu-śūnyam;
analyzed: pañcavidhā hi pratītiḥ pramāṇa saṃśaya viparyaya vikalpa smṛti rūpā tatra yayā pratītyā pravṛtti hetuḥ pratīta mātram ucyate tayā avaśyam pramāṇa ādiṣu madhye nyatarayā bhāvyam tatra na tāvat smṛtiḥ prāk anavagateḥ avagatam hi smaryate na saṃśayaḥ ubhaya koṭi saṃsparśa śirahāt na ca vikalpaḥ sa hi vastu śūnyam

original: taduktam—“śabdajñānānupānī vastuśūnyo vikalpaḥ” iti | tatra pravṛttihetupratītiścet tadviṣayavastuśūnyā syāt, tataḥ pravṛttihetorabhāvāttatpratyayasyāpi prayojyavṛddhagatasya bālenānumīyamānasya vastuśūnyatayā vikalpatvaṃ prasajyeta | tadā ca pravṛttihetu vastu nāstyeva; ko vidhyartho bhaviṣyati ? na ca viparyayaḥ;
analyzed: tat uktam śabda jñāna anupānī vastu śūnyaḥ vikalpaḥ iti tatra pravṛtti hetu pratītiḥ ced tad viṣaya vastu śūnyā syāt tatas pravṛtti hetoḥ abhāvāt tad pratyayasya api prayojya vṛddha gatasya bālena anumīyamānasya vastu śūnya tayā vikalpa tvam prasajyeta tadā ca pravṛtti hetu vastu na asti eva kaḥ vidhi arthaḥ bhaviṣyati na ca viparyayaḥ

original: yatastatra pravṛttihetau yathārthatve prayojya-pratyayasyābhimate satyārthagrāhiṇī satī bālasya pravṛttihetuḥ pratītiḥ katha-marthaśūnyā syāt ? smṛtitvaṃ ca nirastam | pāriśeṣyāt pramāṇamityāpannā pravṛttihetoḥ pramāṇāntaragocaratā | yacca prayojyapratyayādvālasya pravṛttihetu-pramitiḥ; sa ca pratyayaḥ śabdottha ityananyapramāṇakatvamuktam;
analyzed: yatas tatra pravṛtti hetau yathārtha tve prayojya pratyayasya abhimate satya artha grāhiṇī satī bālasya pravṛtti hetuḥ pratītiḥ katham artha śūnyā syāt smṛti tvam ca nirastam pāriśeṣyāt pramāṇam iti āpannā pravṛtti hetoḥ pramāṇa antara gocara tā yat ca prayojya pratyayāt vālasya pravṛtti hetu pramitiḥ sa ca pratyayaḥ śabda utthaḥ iti ananya pramāṇaka tvam uktam

original: tadapyayuktam; prayojyavṛddhasya hi śabdotthaḥ, na bālasya | na cānyapratyayenānyo'vabudhyate | tasmādvālaḥ pratyayāntareṇa budhyata iti na śabdaikagamyatā vidhyarthasya | atha matam—na prayojyapratyayena bālo budhyate, apitu svapratyayenaiva; pravṛttyanumitaśabdotthaprayojyapratyayasāmarthyena tu tataḥ; tena tasya śabdaika-gamyatvamiti |
analyzed: tat api ayuktam prayojya vṛddhasya hi śabda utthaḥ na bālasya na ca anya pratyayena anyaḥ avabudhyate tasmāt vālaḥ pratyaya antareṇa budhyate iti na śabda eka gamya tā vidhi arthasya atha matam na prayojya pratyayena bālaḥ budhyate apitu sva pratyayena eva pravṛtti anumita śabda uttha prayojya pratyaya sāmarthyena tu tatas tena tasya śabda eka gamya tvam iti

original: tatra pṛcchāmaḥ—yadvālasya svaṃ jñānam, tat kṛtamat pramāṇam ? na tāvacchābdam; śabdajñānādvi yadarthajñānaṃ tacchābdam; na ca bālasya pūrvamavyutpannasya śabdajñānādarthajñānam, apitu prayojyasya |
analyzed: tatra pṛcchāmaḥ yat vālasya svam jñānam tat kṛtamat pramāṇam na tāvat śābdam śabda jñānāt vi yat artha jñānam tat śābdam na ca bālasya pūrvam avyutpannasya śabda jñānāt artha jñānam apitu prayojyasya

original: yacchabdātpravṛttiheturūpārthajñānaṃ bālena pravṛttyānumitaṃ tataśca bālasya jñānaṃ na śābdamiti tadgamyasya vidhyarthasyāpannaṃ pramāṇāntaragocaratvam | atha matam—na brūmo bālasya svajñānaṃ śābdamiti;
analyzed: yad śabdāt pravṛtti hetu rūpa artha jñānam bālena pravṛttyā anumitam tatas ca bālasya jñānam na śābdam iti tat gamyasya vidhi arthasya āpannam pramāṇa antara gocara tvam atha matam na brūmaḥ bālasya sva jñānam śābdam iti

original: kiṃtu yatprayojyasya pravṛtti-hetuviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ pravṛttyā bālenānumīyate, yanmukhena pravṛttihetuṃ bālaḥ pratyeti, tasya prāmāṇye sati tadviṣayapravṛttihetubālasya pratidhyati, nānyathā |
analyzed: kiṃtu yad prayojyasya pravṛtti hetu viṣayam jñānam pravṛttyā bālena anumīyate yad mukhena pravṛtti hetum bālaḥ pratyeti tasya prāmāṇye sati tad viṣaya pravṛtti hetu bālasya na anyathā

original: tasya ca prāmāṇyaṃ nirdoṣācchabdāduddhavati | tena śabdādhīnastatra bālajñāne pravṛttihetuniścaya iti | yadyapi bālaḥ svajñānena prayojyapratyayaviśeṣaṇatvena pravṛttihetuṃ pratyeti, tathāpi nirdoṣaśabdabalena tatra niścaya iti śabdasya tatra pravṛttihetau prāmāṇyamucyate; na bālajñānasya, tasyāniścayakatvāditi | P.107-15 tadapyasāram;

original: yataḥ śabdādyadarthajñānaṃ tacchābdam; na tu paramparayāpi yatra śabdādhīno niścayaḥ, tacchābdam | yaduktam—āptavākyāt vaktṛjñāne pratīte tata evārthasiddhiḥ, pratītimātreṇaiva vaktṛjñāne'rtho viśeṣaṇamiti; tadapyayuktam; yataḥ puruṣavacanamapi nārthaṃ na pramāṇam, na hyarthamapratītya jñānaviśeṣaḥ pratyetuṃ śakyaḥ |

original: tathā coktaṃ vārttikakṛtā—“prāmāṇyasthāpanaṃ tu syādvaktṛdhīhetusaṃbhavāt” iti | etaduktaṃ bhavati—puṃvacaso'rthaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ svata eva; vaktṛdhīhetusaṃbhavena tu pratiṣṭhāpyeta | yadi tu vaktṛbuddherheturna saṃbhavet caityavandanādāviva buddhabuddheḥ, tato bādhyeta | tenābādhanamatra sthāpanamabhipretam, na tu prāmāṇyameva |

original: tathā prāmāṇyasthāpanamityuktam, na tu prāmāṇyamiti | etacca prāmāṇyasthāpanaṃ vākyasya, na tu vaktṛdhiya eva | tena na vaktṛdhiyo'rthaṃ prāmāṇyam, apitu vākyasya | kiṃca “autpattikastu śabdasyārthena saṃbandhaḥ” ityartha-
analyzed: tathā prāmāṇya sthāpanam iti uktam na tu prāmāṇyam iti etat ca prāmāṇya sthāpanam vākyasya na tu vaktṛ dhiyaḥ eva tena na vaktṛ dhiyāḥ artham prāmāṇyam apitu vākyasya kiṃca autpattikaḥ tu śabdasya arthena saṃbandhaḥ iti artha

original: grahaṇādaparyante śabdasya vācyavācakayogyatālakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, na jñānena | sa cāpramite saṃbandhinyarthe jñātumaśakya ityāpannaṃ vidhyarthasya pramāṇāntaragocaratvam | na ca vācyam—syādevaṃ yadi pramite vidhyarthe jñānādeḥ saṃbandho gṛhyata, kiṃtu pratītimātra iti ; yataḥ sā pratītirna tāvatsaṃśayaḥ, ubhayakoṭisparśavirahāt |
analyzed: grahaṇāt aparyante śabdasya vācya vācaka yogyatā lakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ na jñānena sa ca apramite saṃbandhini arthe jñātum aśakyaḥ iti āpannam vidhi arthasya pramāṇa antara gocara tvam na ca vācyam syāt evam yadi pramite vidhi arthe jñāna ādeḥ saṃbandhaḥ gṛhyata kiṃtu pratīti mātre iti yatas sā pratītiḥ na tāvat saṃśayaḥ ubhaya koṭi sparśa virahāt

original: tatra yadyarthavatī, tataḥ smṛtiḥ pramāṇaṃ vā syāt | P 108-11 tatra ca vidhyarthasya pramāṇāntaragocaratvamuktam | atha viparyayavikalparūpā nārthavatī ; tano vidhyartho nāstyeva ;

original: kena liṅādeḥ saṃbandhaḥ ? kiṃca yadi śabdapratīteranyayāpyaprāmāṇikayā pratītyā vidhyarthaḥ pratīyeta, tataḥ śabdaikagamyatvātikramāt pramāṇāntaragamyatvamapyāśaṅkyeta | yadapyuktam—laukikaśreyaḥsādhanatā pramāṇāntaragocaratā ; tataḥ sā yadi liṅarthaḥ syāt, tataḥ pramāṇāntaragocaratāpi śabdārthānupraveśinī syāditi ; tadapyayuktam ;
analyzed: kena liṅ ādeḥ saṃbandhaḥ kiṃca yadi śabda pratīteḥ anyayā api aprāmāṇikayā pratītyā vidhi arthaḥ pratīyeta tatas śabda eka gamya tva atikramāt pramāṇa antara gamya tvam api āśaṅkyeta yat api uktam laukika śreyaḥ sādhana tā pramāṇa antara gocara tā tatas sā yadi liṅ arthaḥ syāt tatas pramāṇa antara gocara tā api śabda artha anupraveśinī syāt iti tat api ayuktam

original: yataḥ tasmin sati śabdaḥ prayujyate, yadvā tasminnasati na prayujyate, ityetāvanmātreṇa na śabdārtho bhavati ; anyathā vṛkṣatve sati śiśapāśabdaḥ prayujyate, tasminnasati ghaṭādau na prayujyate iti tadapi śabdārthaḥ syāt | ka nāma dvitīyo'pi śabdārtho bhavati ? tathā satsu kṣitipavanādiṣu bījābhāve nāṅkurotpattiriti bījamapi heturgamyate |

original: evaṃ yatraikasminprayojake śabdaprayoganimitte satyapi dvitīyasyābhāvānna śabdasya prayogaḥ, tatra so'pi prayojakaḥ prayoganimittaṃ gamyate, yathā gau(śo)ṇaśabde ; tatra hi satyapyaruṇatve gavādāvaprayogādaśvatvamapi prayojakamityeṣā tāvadanyatra sthitiḥ |

original: iha ca liṅādau śreyohetau liṅādidarśanāt tadabhāve cāśreyohetoḥ pramāṇāntaragocaratve satyapyadarśanāt śreyohetutvaṃ tāvacchabdārthaḥ |

original: tatra śreyaḥsādhanatāyāḥ pūrvaṃ prayojakatvasyāvadhāritatvāt tadabhāve tadabhāvanibandhana evāprayogaḥ, na pramāṇāntaragamyatvābhāvanibandhana

original: P.109-1 iti niścīyate | tataśca śreyaḥsādhanatve sati prayogaḥ tadabhāve cāprayoga ityanvayavyatirekayorupapattī na pramāṇāntaragamyatvasya śabdārthatve kiñcitpramāṇamasti | ataḥ śreyaḥsādhanatāyāḥ śabdārthatve pramāṇāntaragamyatāpi śabdārthaḥ syāditi yaduktaṃ tannirastam |

original: yadi punaryarthoktaprakāraṃ vinā anvayavyatirekamāleṇa śabdārthatvaṃ syāt, tataḥ sattāvṛkṣatvādiṣu satsu śiśapāyāṃ prayogāt tadabhāve ca nṛśṛṅgādāvaprayogāt sattādayo'pi śiśapāśabdārthāḥ syuḥ |

original: atha nṛśṛṅgādau śiśapārthābhāvādevāprayogopapatterna sattāvabhāvasyāprayogahetutvam, ato na sattādeḥ śiśapāśabdārthatvamityucyate, tacchiṅgādāvapi samānam | yathā caitattathoktam | atha śreyaḥsādhanatā pramāṇāntaragamyā; sā cedvidhyarthaḥ syāt, tato vede pramāṇāntarābhāvāt prāmāṇyaṃ na syāt |

original: nāyamapi doṣaḥ, yataḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ dṛṣṭaviṣayam | adṛṣṭaviṣayastu śabdaḥ | tenādṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇāntarasya viṣaya eva na bhavati | na ca yo yasyāviṣayaḥ sa tenānupalabdhyā bādhyate, yathā cakṣuṣānupalabdhyā rasaḥ | śaśaśṛṅgaṃ ca na kenāpi pramāṇena gṛhyate | śreyaḥsādhanatā tu śabdena gamyate | na caikapramāṇagamyamanyājñānādvādhyate rasavadeva |

original: atha pramāṇāntaraviṣayā cet sādhanatā vede liṅyaḥ syāt, tataḥ pramāṇāntaraviṣaye pramāṇāntareṇa virodhāt vedasyāprāmāṇyaṃ syāt; asti ca yāgādau anantaraphalānupalabdhyestathaiva virodhaḥ; pramāṇāntarāviṣaye tu liṅye naiṣa doṣa iti pramāṇāntarāviṣaya eva vede vidhyartha āśrīyate, netara iti cet; tadasat;

original: yato yadi vede phalasyānantaryaṃ coditaṃ syāt, tato'nantaraphalānupalabdhyā virodhaḥ syāt; na tvetadasti | taduktam—“ānantaryaṃ hyacoditam” iti |

original: nanu yadyapyānantaryamacoditam; pramāṇāntaragamyatā ca na śabdārthaḥ; P.109-14 tathāpi pramāṇāntarasiddhā cet śreyaḥsādhanatā vede'pi liṅyaḥ, tato yādṛśī sā loke siddhā tādṛśyāśrayitavyā | sā cānantarabhāviśreyaḥ sādhanatā pramāṇāntarasiddhā | ato vede tādṛśyevāśrayitavyā; anyathā na śabdatā syāt |

original: tenāyamarthaḥ—pratipattividhivākyaṃ svagataniyoge samāptaṃ tatparyavasitaṃ sat prajñādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisaṃbandhyate prajñādivākyenānvīyate; tena pratipattividhivākyasya svagataniyoganiṣṭhatā na hīyata iti cet, ucyate— svarūpaniṣṭhatve'pi vedāntavākyasya tulyametat yaduktaṃ tvayā |

original: ato na niyoganirapekṣāṇāṃ teṣāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ tvadiṣṭaṃ sidhyatītyabhiprāyeṇāśaṅkayati—niyogeneti | atrottaramāha—na ceti | viṣayasamarpaṇārthaścet ātmatattvāvabodhavidhiḥ, tato vedāntā eva tat samarpa-

original: utpattividhirajñātajñāpake, adhikāravidhirapravṛttapravartane iti vivekaḥ | utpattividhipūrvako'dhikāravidhiriti sūcanārtho'thaśabdaḥ | taddūṣayati—etaditi | tādṛśamiti ; asāramityarthaḥ | asāratvamāha—karmeti |

original: tatra utpattivākye vidheḥ vidhīyate'neneti vidhāyakasya śabdasya nāgneyādikarmasvarūpāvagama eva phalam, kiṃtu kāryaṃ phalaṃ vinā niṣphalasya vidhyanupapattyā kāryāpekṣasyotpattividheḥ phalavākyena phalavatā darśapūrṇamāsavākyena saṃgatiḥ phalamityarthaḥ |

original: atra ca phalavākyena saṃgatyā tadgatameva svargādi phalamiti upacārātsaṅgatiḥ phalamityuktam | na ca taccapratipattividherapi tadeva phalamityāha—iheti | ihātmataccāvabodhe vidhau yasyātmataccasya prajñāya mānatvena upāsyamānatvena ca “prajñāṃ kurvīta” “ātmetyevopāsāta” ityadhikārasaṃbandhaḥ, tatra vidhīyate | bhāvo'rtho hi vidhīyate |

original: na ca dadhyādividhiḥ, karmakārakatvāt | yastu vidhīyate taccāvabodhaḥ, tasya “prajñāṃ kurvīta” ityādyadhikārānupraveśitā nāstītyathaḥ | nanvanavabuddhasyopāsitumaśakyatvāt tadavabodho'pyadhikārānupraveśītyāśaṅkyāha—na hīti | na hyapratyakṣo brīhyādirnāṅgamiti tatpratyakṣamadhikārabhāk adhikāramanupraviśati, prayogekadeśatāṃ yātīti yāvat |

original: yataḥ pramitānāṃ tepāvadhikāra-

original: 115-1 tadvocaratā pratipattividherityate | tadāha—idānīmiti | nanūpāsanākhya-dvitīyapratipattigocaravidhimatikramya tṛtīyapratipattividhinirākaraṇamayuktamityā-śaṅkyāha—taccāvabodheti | tṛtīyapratipattigocaro vidhiḥ pramāṇātmataccāvabodha-viṣaya ityanena saṃbandhena sa evānantaraṃ buddhistho bhavati, na dvitīyapratipatti-gocaraḥ |

original: sa hi na pramāṇabhūtataccāvabodhaviṣayaḥ, kiṃtu smṛtirūpataccā-bhyāsaviṣaya ityarthaḥ | tatra tṛtīyapratipattividhipakṣamupanyasyati—sopāya-miti | yadi śābdaṃ jñānaṃ pratipattividhinā na vidhīyate, tarhi śābdāt jñānādanyadidamanantaravakṣyamāṇasvarūpaṃ jñānaṃ sopāyaṃ śamābupāyasahitaṃ vidhīyate |

original: kīdṛśaṃ tajjñānamityapekṣāyāmāha—pralīnaprahaṇagrāhyavibhāgo-dvāhamiti | pralīnaṃ pratyastamitam ‘idaṃ grahaṇam, idaṃ grāhyam’ iti vibhāgodvāho bhedāvabhāso yatreti vigrahaḥ | dvitīyatathāvidhajñānābhāvāt pramātṛprabheyādidvayavirahādvā advayaṃ jñānamityarthaḥ | śābdājjñānādanya-dityuktam; tatra hetumāha—na hīti |

original: bhinnānāṃ padārthānāṃ saṃsargaḥ, tadrūpo vākyārthaḥ, tatra dhīḥ, tasyāḥ padaṃ viṣayaḥ na niṣprapañcamātmatattvaṃ yataḥ, ataḥ śābdajñānādanyadidaṃ jñānamityarthaḥ | nānārthasaṃsargātmā vākyārthaḥ, tadviruddharūpamadvayaṃ cātmatattvam; ato na tadbuddhiviṣaya ityuktaṃ bhavati |

original: tadayaṃ vākyārthaḥ—anavacchedavibhramo'dvayātmaprakāśo yo'sau svātmasthitiḥ supraśāntā phalam, tanna vidherviṣayo na vidheyamityarthaḥ | avacchedakallupatayeti ; avacchidyate'nenetyavacchedo dehendriyādi, tena kallupatayā tadanātmasvarūpeṇa prakāśate |

original: na tato'dvayātmasvarūpādanyastaccanodhaḥ, kiṃtu advayātmaprakāśasvarūpameveti satyajñānānandātmakaḥ sa ityarthaḥ | na ca—phale'pyajñātopāye na pravartate ; ataḥ kathaṃ tatra svayaṃ pravṛttiḥ ? apitu upāyaprajñāpanadvāreṇa vidhita eveti vācyam ; yata icchā pravṛtteḥ pūrvarūpam | icchayā hi pravartate | tā cāsti phale'pi | nāpi vidhinā |

original: atastata eva pravṛttisiddhena tatra vidhyapekṣetyarthaḥ | kiṃca ajñātopāye cetphale na pravartate tatrāvaśyamupāyajñāpanayā phalamuddiśya upāye pravartyaḥ ; na phale'pi, vākyamedaprasaṅgāt | tāvatā ca jñātopāyatvaṃ saṃvṛttapiti tata eva phale'pi pravṛttiḥ siddheti na tatra pravṛttyarthaṃ vidhivyāpāra āśrayitavyaḥ |
analyzed: atas tatas eva pravṛtti siddhena tatra vidhi apekṣā iti arthaḥ kiṃca ajñāta upāye ced phale na pravartate tatra avaśyam upāya jñāpanayā phalam uddiśya upāye pravartyaḥ na phale api vākya meda prasaṅgāt tāvatā ca jñāta upāya tvam tatas eva phale api pravṛttiḥ siddhā iti na tatra pravṛtti artham vidhi vyāpāraḥ āśrayitavyaḥ

original: taduktam—“tasya lipsārthalakṣaṇā” | tasya phalasya lābhecchā arthalakṣaṇā prayojanalakṣaṇā, na vidhilakṣaṇetyarthaḥ | tasmānna phalaṃ vidhīyate, api tu tatsādhanam | taduktam—tatsādhaneti | nanu yaḥ phalamicchati, so'nupāyasya phalasyāsiddhestadupāyamapīcchatyeva | ataḥ phalavatpupāye'pi phalavadarthalakṣaṇeva pravṛttiḥ, na vidhilakṣaṇā ;
analyzed: tat uktam tasya lipsā artha lakṣaṇā tasya phalasya lābha icchā artha lakṣaṇā prayojana lakṣaṇā na vidhi lakṣaṇā iti arthaḥ tasmāt na phalam vidhīyate api tu tat sādhanam tat uktam tad sādhanā iti nanu yaḥ phalam icchati saḥ unupāyasya phalasya asiddheḥ tad upāyam api icchati eva atas phalavat pupāye pi phalavat artha lakṣaṇā iva pravṛttiḥ na vidhi lakṣaṇā

original: ataḥ sādhane'pi na vidhervyāpāra iti pareṇa codite siddhāntī pṛcchati— ka tarhīti | para āha—itthaṃmāna iti ; kartavyatvāṃśa ityarthaḥ | taddūṣayati—nasīdīta | sādhanaviśeṣa tātrādvidheḥ pūrvamajñāte nārthalakṣaṇā
analyzed: atas sādhane api na vidheḥ vyāpāraḥ iti pareṇa codite siddhāntī pṛcchati kaḥ tarhi iti paraḥ āha etthaṃmānaḥ iti kartavya tva aṃśe iti arthaḥ tat dūṣayati sādhana viśeṣa tātrāt vidheḥ pūrvam ajñāte na artha lakṣaṇā

original: pravṛttiḥ | atha sādhanasāmānye, itthaṃbhāvasāmānye'pi samānā ; yato yathā phalārthī tadupāyasāmānyamicchati, tathā tadanugrahakasāmānyamapi ; niranugrahasya sādhanasyāsamarthatvāt | athetthaṃbhāvaviśeṣo vidhīyate, tataḥ sādhanaviśeṣo'pi tathā vidhāsyata iti na tatrāpyarthalakṣaṇā pravṛttirityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pravṛttiḥ atha sādhana sāmānye itthaṃbhāva sāmānye api samānā yatas yathā phala arthī tad upāya sāmānyam icchati tathā tad anugrahaka sāmānyam api niranugrahasya sādhanasya asamartha tvāt atha itthaṃbhāva viśeṣaḥ vidhīyate tatas sādhana viśeṣaḥ api tathā vidhāsyate iti na tatra api artha lakṣaṇā pravṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: -itaśca phalasādhane vidhāyakasya vyāpāra ityāha—apekṣiteti | apravṛtta- P.116-17 pravartanarūpo vidhiḥ | pravṛttihetuśca dharmaḥ pravartanā | sa ca dvividhaḥ— iṣṭatā, tatsādhanatā ca | yata iṣṭe tatsādhane vā puruṣaḥ pravartate, nānyatra | tatreṣṭatāyāmiṣṭaphaladharmabhūtāyāṃ jānātyevāsau ‘mayaitatkartavyam’ iti ;
analyzed: itas ca phala sādhane vidhāyakasya vyāpāraḥ iti āha apekṣita iti apravṛtta pravartana rūpaḥ vidhiḥ pravṛtti hetuḥ ca dharmaḥ pravartanā sa ca dvividhaḥ iṣṭa tā tad sādhana tā ca yatas iṣṭe tad sādhane vā puruṣaḥ pravartate na anyatra tatra iṣṭa tāyām iṣṭa phala dharma bhūtāyām jānāti eva asau mayā etat kartavyam iti

original: pramāṇāntarasiddhāyāṃ svayameva puruṣasya pravṛttiḥ, nāpravṛttapravartanātvam | ato na sā vidhiḥ | iṣṭasādhanatā tu yāgāderna pramāṇāntarāvaseyā ; apitu śabdaikagamyā | teneṣṭasādhane śabdādeva pravṛttiḥ, nānyata iti tasyā eva pravṛttihetutvam | teneṣṭasādhanataiva śabdapramāṇikā satī vidhiriti gīyate |
analyzed: pramāṇa antara siddhāyām svayam eva puruṣasya pravṛttiḥ na apravṛtta pravartanā tvam atas na sā vidhiḥ iṣṭa sādhana tā tu yāga ādeḥ na pramāṇa antara avaseyā apitu śabda eka gamyā tena iṣṭa sādhane śabdāt eva pravṛttiḥ na anyatas iti tasyāḥ eva pravṛtti hetu tvam tena iṣṭa sādhana tā eva śabda pramāṇikā satī vidhiḥ iti gīyate

original: nanvastu iṣṭasādhanaṃ pravṛttihetuḥ, sa ca vidhiḥ | anuṣṭhānaṃ tu kathaṃ tadviṣayamavagamyate ? athānyaviṣayameva kasmānna bhavati ? ityata āha— anutiṣṭhata iti | neṣṭasādhanaṃ vāyuvadyasya kasyacitpravṛttihetuḥ, apitu anutiṣṭhataḥ | anutiṣṭhataścānuṣṭheyaṃ sat iṣṭasādhanaṃ pravṛttihetuḥ ; na vāyuvat svataḥ siddham |
analyzed: nanu astu iṣṭasādhanam pravṛtti hetuḥ sa ca vidhiḥ anuṣṭhānam tu katham tad viṣayam avagamyate atha anya viṣayam eva kasmāt na bhavati iti atas āha anutiṣṭhataḥ iti na iṣṭasādhanam vāyu vat yasya kasyacid pravṛtti hetuḥ apitu anutiṣṭhataḥ anutiṣṭhataḥ ca anuṣṭheyam sat iṣṭasādhanam pravṛtti hetuḥ na vāyu vat svatas siddham

original: tenānutiṣṭhata iṣṭasādhanatā vidhiḥ | yataśca anutiṣṭhato vidhiḥ, ataḥ tadidamanuṣṭhānamanuṣṭheyāpekṣamanuṣṭheyabhūteṣṭasādhanaviṣayameva vidhāyakāliṅādiśabdādarthādgamyate, nānyaviṣayamityarthaḥ | sādhanaṃ pravṛttiheturiti dharmadharmiṇorabhedāduktam | na ca godohanādinā ananuṣṭheyena vyabhicāraḥ ; taddhi na svarūpeṇeṣṭasādhanam ;
analyzed: tena anutiṣṭhataḥ iṣṭa sādhana tā vidhiḥ yatas ca anutiṣṭhataḥ vidhiḥ atas tat idam anuṣṭhānam anuṣṭheya apekṣam anuṣṭheya bhūta iṣṭa sādhana viṣayam eva vidhāyaka āliṅ ādi śabdāt arthāt gamyate na anya viṣayam iti arthaḥ sādhanam pravṛtti hetuḥ iti dharma dharmiṇoḥ abhedāt uktam na ca godohana ādinā ananuṣṭheyena vyabhicāraḥ tat hi na svarūpeṇa iṣṭa sādhanam

original: apitu tatsādhyā praṇayanakriyā ; ata eva tāṃ prākaraṇikīmapekṣate ; sā cānuṣṭheyaivetyavyabhicāraḥ | nanvadhyavasāyādilakṣaṇo vidhiriti vidhivido vidhimācakṣate ; tatkathamiṣṭasādhanatā vidhirityāśaṅkacāha—tata iti |
analyzed: apitu tad sādhyā praṇayana kriyā atas eva tām prākaraṇikīm apekṣate sā ca anuṣṭheyā eva iti avyabhicāraḥ nanu adhyavasāya ādi lakṣaṇaḥ vidhiḥ iti vidhi vidaḥ vidhim ācakṣate tat katham iṣṭa sādhanatā vidhiḥ iti āśaṅkaca āha tatas iti

original: ‘mamedaṃ kāryam’ ityadhyavasāyo niścayaḥ, tataḥ ākūtaḥ saṃkalpaviśeṣaḥ, tata ādyā pravṛttiḥ, tathā ‘pacet’ iti kālatrayāparicchinnaṃ pravṛttimātram, tathā pramāṇāntareṇājñāto yāgādikriyāyāstatkartuśca saṃbandho ‘yajeta’ ityasmādeva gamyamāna ityayamadhyavasāyādistata eveṣṭasādhanatvāt bhavati ; nākasmāt kāraṇaṃ vinetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: mama idam kāryam iti adhyavasāyaḥ niścayaḥ tatas ākūtaḥ saṃkalpa viśeṣaḥ tatas ādyā pravṛttiḥ tathā pacet iti kāla traya aparicchinnam pravṛtti mātram tathā pramāṇa antareṇa ajñātaḥ yāga ādi kriyāyāḥ tad kartuḥ ca saṃbandhaḥ yajeta iti asmāt eva gamyamānaḥ iti ayam adhyavasāya ādiḥ tatas eva iṣṭa sādhana tvāt bhavati na akasmāt kāraṇam vinā iti arthaḥ

original: etaduktaṃ bhavati— iṣṭasādhanatāyā evāvagamyāyā adhyavasāyādirbhavati | naivameva ; ataḥ saiva 16
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati iṣṭa sādhana tāyāḥ eva avagamyāyāḥ adhyavasāya ādiḥ bhavati na evam eva atas sā eva

original: mūlabhūtā pravṛttiheturiti saiva vidhiḥ, nādhyavasāyādīti | liṅādibhirabhipa. 117-6 dhānādevādhyavasāyādirbhaviṣyati, kiṃ vidhineti cet, atrāha—nābhidhānata iti | nābhidhānata eṣāmutpattiḥ; apitu pratītimātram | na ca pratītimātreṇa teṣāṃ pravṛttihetutvam | na hi pratītimātreṇa ghaṭādayaḥ pravṛttihetava ityuktaṃ vidhiviveke |
analyzed: mūla bhūtā pravṛtti hetuḥ iti sā eva vidhiḥ na adhyavasāya ādi iti liṅ ādibhiḥ abhipadhānāt eva adhyavasāya ādiḥ bhaviṣyati kim vidhinā iti ced atra āha na abhidhānataḥ iti na abhidhānataḥ eṣām utpattiḥ apitu pratīti mātram na ca pratīti mātreṇa teṣām pravṛtti hetu tvam na hi pratīti mātreṇa ghaṭa ādayaḥ pravṛtti hetavaḥ iti uktam vidhi viveke

original: utpattistu teṣāmiṣṭasādhanatāyāḥ; tena taiva vidhiriti bhāvaḥ | anyo'rthaḥ—abhidhīyate'nenetyabhidhānaṃ liṅādiśabdaḥ; tata evādhyavasāyāderutpattirbhaviṣyatīti kimiṣṭasādhanatayetyāśaṅkyāha—nābhidhānata iti | na liṅādiśabdādadhyavasāyāderutpattiḥ; sa hyadhyavasāyāderjñāpakaḥ, na kārakaḥ | yadi tu kārakaḥ syāt, vāyuvadavyutpannamapi prerayet;
analyzed: utpattiḥ tu teṣām iṣṭa sādhanatāyāḥ tena tā eva vidhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ anyorthaḥ abhidhīyate inena iti abhidhānam liṅ ādi śabdaḥ tatas eva adhyavasāya ādeḥ utpattiḥ bhaviṣyati iti kim iṣṭa sādhanatayā iti āśaṅkya āha na abhidhānataḥ iti na liṅ ādi śabdāt adhyavasāya ādeḥ utpattiḥ sa hi adhyavasāya ādeḥ jñāpakaḥ na kārakaḥ yadi tu kārakaḥ syāt vāyu vat avyutpannam api prerayet

original: ataśca saṃbandhavyutpattyapekṣā śabde na syāt; na caivam ityapi vidhiviveka evoktam | tato hyadhyavasāyādiḥ; anyo'rthaḥ—‘mamedaṃ kāryam’ iti yato'dhyavasāyaḥ ‘niyukto'smi’ iti buddhiḥ, sa evālaukiko niyogo vidhiriti yo manyate, taṃ pratyucyate | tata eveṣṭasādhanatvādadhyavasāyādi rbhavati |
analyzed: atas ca saṃbandha vyutpatti apekṣā śabde na syāt na ca evam iti api vidhi viveke eva uktam tatas hi adhyavasāya ādiḥ anyaḥ arthaḥ mama idam kāryam iti yatas adhyavasāyaḥ niyuktaḥ asmi iti buddhiḥ saḥ eva alaukikaḥ niyogaḥ vidhiḥ iti yaḥ manyate tam pratyucyate tatas eva iṣṭa sādhana tvāt adhyavasāya ādiḥ bhavati

original: ato'dhyavasāyahetāvapi vidhāviṣṭasādhanataiva vidhiḥ, na laukiko'nya ityarthaḥ | tathāhi—iṣṭasyābhyupāye kṛpyādau ‘mamedaṃ kartavyam’ iti kartubuddhiloke bhavati | iṣṭābhyupāyābhāve cākartavyabuddhiḥ | ato'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ te buddhī iṣṭābhyupāyānabhyupāyaviṣaye gamyete; tathāhi—‘pravṛtto'smi’ iti pravṛttihetupratītirbhavati;
analyzed: atas adhyavasāya hetau api vidhau iṣṭa sādhanatā eva vidhiḥ na laukikaḥ nyaḥ iti arthaḥ tathā hi iṣṭasya abhyupāye kṛpi ādau mama idam kartavyam iti kartu buddhi loke bhavati iṣṭa abhyupāya abhāve ca akartavya buddhiḥ atas nvaya vyatirekābhyām te buddhī iṣṭa abhyupāya anabhyupāya viṣaye gamyete tathā hi pravṛttaḥ asmi iti pravṛtti hetu pratītiḥ bhavati

original: na punarvāyunevātmānaṃ pravartitaṃ manyata iti tavāpyabhimatam | na ceṣṭasādhanatāyā anyo'laukikaḥ saṃbhavati, tasyā eva kṛṣyādau pravṛttihetutāyā loke dṛṣṭatvāt | na ca loke nṛsāmarthyaṃ pravṛttiheturahetuḥ, apitu anya evālaukika ityakasmātkāraṇaṃ vinā yuktaṃ vaktum | laukikatyāgenālaukikakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt |
analyzed: na punar vāyunā iva ātmānam pravartitam manyate iti tava api abhimatam na ca iṣṭa sādhanatāyāḥ anyaḥ laukikaḥ saṃbhavati tasyāḥ eva kṛṣi ādau pravṛtti hetutāyāḥ loke dṛṣṭa tvāt na ca loke nṛ sāmarthyam pravṛtti hetuḥ ahetuḥ apitu anyaḥ eva alaukikaḥ iti akasmāt kāraṇam vinā yuktam vaktum laukika tyāgena alaukika kalpanāyām pramāṇa abhāvāt

original: itaśca nālaukikakalpanocitā—yataḥ śabdena tasyābhidhānamiṣyate | na cālaukikasyābhidhānaṃ saṃbhavati, saṃbandhāgrahāt ityuktaṃ ‘padaṃ svadharmaṃ vyutkrāmet’ ityatra | tato'dhyavasāyaḥ, prārambhaḥ saṃkalpaḥ, tato'nuṣṭhānaṃ, tato'nuṣṭhitasya samāpanetyetatsarvamiṣṭasādhanatvādeva bhavati, nānyasmāt |
analyzed: itas ca na alaukika kalpanā ucitā āyatas śabdena tasya abhidhānam iṣyate na ca alaukikasya abhidhānam saṃbhavati saṃbandha agrahāt iti uktam padam svadharmam vyutkrāmet iti atra tatas adhyavasāyaḥ prārambhaḥ saṃkalpaḥ tatas nuṣṭhānam tatas nuṣṭhitasya samāpanā iti etat sarvam iṣṭa sādhana tvāt eva bhavati na anyasmāt

original: iṣṭasādhanatvasadvāva eva niyuktasya pravṛtteḥ, yasya kasyacidiṣṭasādhanatāmajñātvā niyuñjānasyānāptasya niyogāt puṃsāmapravṛtteḥ | tasmādiṣṭasādhanataiva vidhiḥ |

original: nanu 'mamedaṃ kartavyam' iti pratyayātpravartate; anyathā yadi kartavyāvagamānna pravartate, tataḥ pramāṇabhūtāt vedāt yatkartavyamavagataṃ tanna kṛtaṃ syāt | na ca taduktam | na ceṣṭasādhanamapi 'mamedaṃ kartavyam' iti yāvanna pratīyate tāvattatra kaścitpravartate | tasmātkartavyatāvagamādeva pravṛttiḥ, neṣṭasādhanatvāt |

original: ucyate—bāḍhaṃ kartavyatāvagamātpravṛttiḥ; na tu tadutpādo'kasmātkāraṇaṃ vinā bhavati | sa hi sārthamiṣṭamasmādavāpyata ityanena nimitteneṣṭasādhane bhavati | nanu na brūmo'kasmādbhavatīti; kiṃtu śabdādeva kartavyatābuddhirbhavati; tatrocyate—nābhidhānata iti | na hi liṅādi-P.118-3. śabdātkartavyatābuddhiḥ; yato niyogaḥ śabdārthastvayeṣṭaḥ |
