original: sa ca preṣaṇādirūpo niyoktṛdharmo vā syāt | yadvā na niyoktṛdharmaḥ; kiṃtu svatantra eva, phalaniṣpatteḥ; ato vināśī ca | kartavyatā kriyamāṇabhāvārthākhyaviṣayadharmo na niyoktṛdharmaḥ; na ca svatantraḥ | ato na taddhyadirabhidhānataḥ |
analyzed: sa ca preṣaṇa ādi rūpaḥ niyoktṛ dharmaḥ vā syāt yat vā na niyoktṛ dharmaḥ kiṃtu svatantraḥ eva phala niṣpatteḥ atas vināśī ca kartavya tā kriyamāṇa bhāva artha ākhya viṣaya dharmaḥ na niyoktṛ dharmaḥ na ca svatantraḥ atas na tat hi adiḥ abhidhānataḥ

original: atha niyogo viṣayadharma ucyate, tato viṣayasyeṣṭasādhanatvādanyasya dharmasyābhāvādiṣṭasādhanataiva niyoga ityāpannam | atha na śabdātkartavyatābuddhiḥ, apitu niyogādityucyate; tathāpi na tāvattasyāṃ śabdaḥ pramāṇam, tasya niyogābhidhāyakatvāt | na ca niyogānupapattyā arthātkartavyatābuddhiḥ, arkatavye'pyanāsaniyogadarśanāt |
analyzed: atha niyogaḥ viṣaya dharmaḥ ucyate tatas viṣayasya iṣṭa sādhana tvāt anyasya dharmasya abhāvāt iṣṭa sādhana tā eva niyogaḥ iti āpannam atha na śabdāt kartavya tā buddhiḥ apitu niyogāt iti ucyate tathā api na tāvat tasyām śabdaḥ pramāṇam tasya niyoga abhidhāyaka tvāt na ca niyoga anupapattyā arthāt kartavya tā buddhiḥ

original: atha matam—sā kartavyatāviṣayasya mokṣasya dharma ucyate, tato viṣayamokṣasādhanatvādvidhānamāpannamiti; tato bhinnaṃ mokṣaṃ manvānaḥ paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate—syādetaditi | advayātmajñānasya mokṣasādhanatvaṃ śrutibhirupapādayati—śrūyata iti | anuvidya vijānātīti; śabdātprathamaṃ viditvā paścādviśeṣeṇāparokṣatayā jānātītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: atha matam sā kartavya tā viṣayasya mokṣasya dharmaḥ ucyate tatas viṣaya mokṣa sādhana tvāt vidhānam āpannam iti tatas bhinnam mokṣam manvānaḥ paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate syāt etat iti advaya ātma jñānasya mokṣa sādhana tvam śrutibhiḥ upapādayati śrūyate iti anuvidya vijānāti iti śabdāt prathamam viditvā paścāt viśeṣeṇa aparokṣa tayā jānāti iti arthaḥ

original: nanu mokṣasya sādhanasādhyatve ghaṭavadanityatvaṃ syāt, ataśca muktasya punarāvṛttiḥ syādityāśaṅkyāha—na ceti | hetumāha—śabdeti | śabdamāha—na ceti | nanu sādhyatvānmokṣasya ghaṭavadantavattvaṃ tarkeṇa prāpnoti; ataḥ kathamapunarāvṛttirityāśaṅkyāha—na hīti | na khalvagnīṣāmīyādihiṃsā śabdāvagatadharmatā, bāhyahiṃsāvat;
analyzed: nanu mokṣasya sādhana sādhya tve ghaṭa vat anitya tvam syāt atas ca muktasya punarāvṛttiḥ syāt iti āśaṅkya āha na ca iti hetum āha śabda iti śabdam āha na ca iti nanu sādhya tvāt mokṣasya ghaṭa vat antavat tvam tarkeṇa prāpnoti atas katham apunarāvṛttiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha na hi iti na khalu agnīṣāmīya ādi hiṃsā śabda avagata dharmatā bāhya hiṃsā vat

original: hiṃsātvādadharma iti tarkeṇādharmo bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | nityātmasvabhāvabhūtāṃ vidyāmabhipretya parihārāntaramāha—ananteti | kṣaṇikajñānavādi- 16A
analyzed: hiṃsā tvāt adharmaḥ iti tarkeṇa adharmaḥ bhavati iti bhāvaḥ nitya ātma svabhāva bhūtām vidyām abhipretya parihāra antaram āha ananta iti kṣaṇika jñāna vādi

original: P. 119-1 mate'pi vidyānantyamāha—kṣaṇiketi | atra siddhāntamāha—na ceti | ślokārthamupapādayituṃ mokṣasvarūpanirūpaṇāya pṛcchati—kaḥ punariti | tatra na tāvadanāgatadehādyanutpādo mokṣaḥ, tasya prāṇabhāvatvenāsādhyatvādityāha— yadīti | aśarīraṃ vāveti vāvaśṭhaddo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ |
analyzed: mate api vidyā ānantyam āha kṣaṇikā iti atra siddhāntam āha na ca iti śloka artham upapādayitum mokṣa svarūpa nirūpaṇāya pṛcchati kaḥ punar iti tatra na tāvat anāgata deha ādi anutpādaḥ mokṣaḥ tasya prāṇa bhāva tvena asādhya tvāt iti āha yadi iti aśarīram vāva iti

original: tadevamasaṃbhavādasminyakṣe niraste sāretaravibhāgāya anekānmokṣapakṣānupanyasyati—atheti | caitragrāmayoriveti; gatipūrvā saṃyogalakṣaṇāṃ brahmaprāptimāha | āyanniti; gacchannityarthaḥ | sa yāvaditi; manasaḥ kṣiprasyaiva brahmaprāptyarthamādityalokaṃ gacchato yoginaḥ kṣipratāmāha | etadvai khakhiti mārgastutiḥ | arciriti arcirādimārgakathanam |
analyzed: tat evam asaṃbhavāt asmin yakṣe niraste sāra itara vibhāgāya anekān mokṣa pakṣān upanyasyati atha iti caitra grāmayoḥ iva iti gati pūrvā saṃyoga lakṣaṇām brahma prāptim āha āyan iti gacchan iti arthaḥ sa yāvat iti manasaḥ kṣiprasya eva brahma prāpti artham āditya lokam gacchataḥ yoginaḥ kṣipra tām āha etat vai khakh iti mārga stutiḥ arciḥ iti arciḥ ādi mārga kathanam

original: madhukṛto madhumakṣikāḥ | vidhūyeti apanīyetyarthaḥ | nirañjana iti; dehādivyañjanarahita ityarthaḥ | yogavyāpravaditi; yathā yogabalena prāptāṣṭaguṇaiśvaryā vyāghrarūpeṇātmānaṃ pariṇamayanti, tadvadityarthaḥ | ‘brahma saṃpadyate’ ityatra darśanādityanuvartate | rāgādyapakarṣaṇa iti; japādyupādhikahipatarāgāpanayane;
analyzed: madhukṛtaḥ madhumakṣikāḥ vidhūya iti apanīya iti arthaḥ nirañjanaḥ iti deha ādi vyañjana rahitaḥ iti arthaḥ yogavyāpra vat iti yathā yoga balena prāpta aṣṭaguṇa aiśvaryāḥ vyāghra rūpeṇa ātmānam pariṇamayanti tadvat iti arthaḥ brahma saṃpadyate iti atra darśanāt iti anuvartate rāga ādi apakarṣaṇe iti japa ādi upādhika hipata rāga apanayane

original: rajyate aneneti vā rāgaḥ japādireva, tadapakarṣaṇa ityarthaḥ | tatra pṛthaksvarūpasya gatipūrvakabrahmaprāptipakṣaṃ tāvat dūṣayati—tatreti | hetumāha—sarveti | caitragrāmayoḥ prāptiryuktā; na tu jīvabrahmaṇoḥ, brahmaṇaḥ sarvagatatvāt; sarvagatasya ca nityaprāptatvāditi bhāvaḥ | sarvagatatvaṃ śrutidvayena ghaṭayati—taditi |
analyzed: rajyate anena iti vā rāgaḥ japa ādiḥ eva tad apakarṣaṇaḥ iti arthaḥ tatra pṛthak svarūpasya gati pūrvaka brahma prāpti pakṣam tāvat dūṣayati tatra iti hetum āha sarva iti caitragrāmayoḥ prāptiḥ yuktā na tu jīva brahmaṇoḥ brahmaṇaḥ sarvagata tvāt sarva gatasya ca nitya prāpta tvāt iti bhāvaḥ sarvagata tvam śruti dvayena ghaṭayati tat iti

original: “tadantarasya sarvasya tadu sarvasyāsya bāhataḥ” iti śrutiḥ “nityaṃ vibhum” iti ca śrutiḥ brahmaṇaḥ sarvagatatvamāhetyarthaḥ | ‘vibhum’ ityasya vivaraṇaṃ sarvagatam iti | vividhabhāvādvā vibhurityapaunuruktyam | kiṃca grāmādvinnasya caitrasya grāmaprāptigatipūrvakā yuktā | jīvastu brahmaṇo nānyo brahmaiva san |
analyzed: tat antarasya sarvasya tat u sarvasya asya bāhataḥ iti śrutiḥ nityam vibhum iti ca śrutiḥ brahmaṇaḥ sarva gata tvam āha iti arthaḥ vibhum iti asya vivaraṇam sarva gatam iti vividha bhāvāt vā vibhuḥ iti apaunuruktyam kiṃca grāmāt vinnasya caitrasya grāma prāpti gati pūrvakāḥ yuktāḥ jīvaḥ tu brahmaṇaḥ na anyaḥ brahma eva san

original: tasmādadhyasya gatihetukā na brahmaprāptirityāha—ananyatvācceti | ananyatve hetumāha—taditi | “ātmāni vijñāte sarvamidaṃ vijñātaṃ bhavati” iti śrutiḥ jīvabrahmaṇorananyatve ghaṭate, nānyatve | na hyanyasminvijñāte'nyadvijñātaṃ bhavati | ato'nanyatvam | tathā “tattvamasi” iti tvamiti jīvamuddiśya tadarthādbrahmaṇo'nanyatvamuktam |
analyzed: tasmāt adhi asya gati hetukā na brahma prāptiḥ iti āha ananyatvāt ca iti ananyatve hetum āha tat iti ātmāni vijñāte sarvam idam vijñātam bhavati iti śrutiḥ jīva brahmaṇoḥ ananyatve ghaṭate na anyatve na hi anyasmin vijñāte nyat vijñātam bhavati atas ananyatvam tathā tat tvam asi iti tvam iti jīvam uddiśya tad arthāt brahmaṇaḥ nanyatvam uktam

original: tathā “anena jīvenātmanā”
analyzed: tathā anena jīvena ātmanā

original: iti ātmaśabdena pratyagātmadṛttinā svātmavācinā jīvo nirdiṣṭaḥ | na cānyatsvātmā bhavati | tathā “yo'nyāṃ devatāmupāsta anyo'sāvanyo'hamiti na sa veda” iti jīvaparayorbhedadarśanaṃ nindayā niṣiddham | ato'nayorananyatvamityarthaḥ | yata eva jīvabrahmaṇorananyatvam, ata eva madhuni nānārasavat nadīsamudravacca nānayoravibhāgopapattimokṣaḥ ;
analyzed: iti ātma śabdena pratyagātma dṛttinā svātma vācinā jīvaḥ nirdiṣṭaḥ na ca anyat svātmā bhavati tathā yonyām devatām upāste anyaḥ asau anyaḥ ham iti na sa veda iti jīva parayoḥ bheda darśanam nindayā niṣiddham atas nayoḥ ananya tvam iti arthaḥ yatas eva jīva brahmaṇoḥ ananya tvam atas eva madhuni nānā rasa vat nadī samudra vat ca na anayoḥ avibhāga upapatti mokṣaḥ

original: vibhāge hi sā bhavati, nānanyatve ityabhiprāyeṇāha—ata iti | kiṃca P. 120-7. sāvayavānāmanyonyāvayavamiśratālakṣaṇo'vibhāgo bhavati | ātmā ca “niṣkalaḥ” iti śruteranavayavaḥ | ato nāsyāvibhāgopapattirityāha—niravayava iti | ekādaśendriyāṇi pañcamahābhūtāni ṣoḍaśa kalāḥ, tadrahitatvenātmano niṣkalaśabdenānavayavatvamuktam |
analyzed: vibhāge hi sā bhavati na ananyatve iti abhiprāyeṇa āha atas iti kiṃca sa avayavānām anyonya avayava miśra tā lakṣaṇaḥ vibhāgaḥ bhavati ātmā ca niṣkalaḥ iti śruteḥ anavayavaḥ atas na asya avibhāga upapattiḥ iti āha niravayavaḥ iti ekādaśa indriyāṇi pañca mahābhūtāni ṣoḍaśa kalāḥ tad rahita tvena ātmanaḥ niṣkala śabdena anavayavatvam uktam

original: tathā—“yathāgrejvalataḥ śuddhā visphuliṅgā vyuccaranti, evamevāsmādātmanaḥ” ityādiśruteḥ jīvasya brahmakāryatvam, kāryasya kāraṇabhāvāpattirbrahmaprāptirityayamapi pakṣo naityāha—nāpīti | sarvadā kāryamupādānakāraṇātmakam | ato'sya tadbhāvāpattirnityasiddhā, na vidyāsādhyā ; vidyāsādhyaśca mokṣaḥ śruta iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tathā yathā agre jvalataḥ śuddhāḥ visphuliṅgāḥ vyuccaranti evam eva asmāt ātmanaḥ ityādi śruteḥ jīvasya brahma kāryatvam kāryasya kāraṇa bhāva āpattiḥ brahma prāptiḥ iti ayam api pakṣaḥ na eti āhana api iti sarvadā kāryam upādānakāraṇa ātmakam atas sya tad bhāva āpattiḥ nitya siddhā na vidyā sādhyā vidyā sādhyaḥ ca mokṣaḥ śrutaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: atha kāryasya nityaṃ kāraṇātmatve'pi jaivasya kāryarūpasya vināśaḥ kāraṇe brahmaṇi layo mokṣaḥ ; tato jīvasyoccheda eva mokṣaḥ syāt | tatra “vidyayāmṛtamaśnute” iti śrutivirodhaḥ | tadā hi vidyayā ucchedaḥ prasajyeta, nāmṛtatvamaparatvam | kiṃca nātmana ucchedaṃ kaścidicchati | na ca niṣpramāṇaṃ phalaṃ bhavati | tatra niṣphalaiva vidyā syāt |
analyzed: atha kāryasya nityam kāraṇa ātma tve pi jaivasya kārya rūpasya vināśaḥ kāraṇe brahmaṇi layaḥ mokṣaḥ tatas jīvasya ucchedaḥ eva mokṣaḥ syāt tatra vidyayā amṛtam aśnute iti śruti virodhaḥ tadā hi vidyayā ucchedaḥ prasajyeta na amṛta tvam aparatvam kiṃca na ātmanaḥ ucchedam kaścid icchati na ca niṣpramāṇam phalam bhavati tatra niṣphalā eva vidyā syāt

original: apica jīvabrahmaṇostāvadākāśaghaṭākāśayoriva bhedasyaupādhikatvāt kāryakāraṇabhāvo nāstyeva | yatrāpyasau prasiddhaḥ, tatrāpi paramārthato nāstītyuktam | kiṃ svātantryeṇa ? na, vācārambhaṇaśrutyā vikārānṛtatvapratipādanāt ; tathāhi—vikāro ghaṭādiḥ ‘ghaṭaḥ’ iti nāmadheyaṃ ca vācā kevalamāramyate, na tu tathvato'sti |
analyzed: apica jīva brahmaṇoḥ tāvat ākāśa ghaṭa ākāśayoḥ iva bhedasya aupādhika tvāt kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ na asti eva yatra api asau prasiddhaḥ tatra api paramārthataḥ na asti iti uktam kim svātantryeṇa na vācā ārambhaṇa śrutyā vikāra anṛta tva pratipādanāt tathā hi vikāraḥ ghaṭa ādiḥ ghaṭaḥ iti nāmadheyam ca vācā kevalam āramyate na tu

original: kāraṇamātrameva tu satyam, mṛttiketyeva tu satyamiti | vāgiti vyavahāro lakṣyate ; tena vyavahārasādhanamātramidaṃ ghaṭādi, na tathvato'stītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: kāraṇa mātram eva tu satyam mṛttikā iti eva tu satyam iti vāc iti vyavahāraḥ lakṣyate tena vyavahāra sādhana mātram idam ghaṭa ādi na

original: P.120-13 na ca yogavyāghravadeva jīvasya brahmarūpeṇa pariṇāmo mokṣaḥ; anyasya brahmarūpeṇa pariṇāmo bhavati, yogina iva vyāghrarūpeṇa | na ca jīvabrahmaṇoranyatvamastītyuktam | apica pūrvāvasthāto viśeṣāpattiḥ pariṇāme; sā nāsti, caitanyabrahmarūpasya jīvānāmaviśeṣāt |
analyzed: na ca yoga vyāghra vat eva jīvasya brahma rūpeṇa pariṇāmaḥ mokṣaḥ anyasya brahma rūpeṇa pariṇāmaḥ bhavati yoginaḥ iva vyāghra rūpeṇa na ca jīva brahmaṇoḥ anya tvam asti iti uktam api ca pūrva avasthātaḥ viśeṣa āpattiḥ pariṇāme sā na asti caitanya brahma rūpasya jīvānām aviśeṣāt

original: pūrvaṃ śokamohādi caitanyamāsīt, caitanyamātrasvabhāvabrahmapariṇāme tu jīvānāṃ śokādyabhāvo bhūta ityasti viśeṣa iti cet, na; asminnapi pakṣe yadi śokādayo jīvānāṃ svabhāvabhūtāḥ, tato jīvānāṃ nityatvātte'pi jīvavadanucchedyāḥ |
analyzed: pūrvam śoka moha ādi caitanyam āsīt caitanya mātra svabhāva brahma pariṇāme tu jīvānām śoka ādi abhāvaḥ bhūtaḥ iti asti viśeṣaḥ iti ced na asmin api pakṣe yadi śoka ādayaḥ jīvānām svabhāva bhūtāḥ tatas jīvānām nitya tvāt te api jīva vat anucchedyāḥ

original: atha jīvebhyo'rthāntarabhūtāḥ kṣaṇikā guṇāḥ, tataḥ kṣaṇikatvādeva vina ṅkṛtyantīti na tadarthaṃ vidyākhyaṃ sādhanamapekṣitamiti vidyāvaiphalyam | na cāgāmināṃ śokādīnāmanutpattaye sādhanamapekṣitamiti vācyam | sa hi teṣāṃ prāgabhāvaḥ; sa cāsādhya ityuktam | ato na tadarthamapi sādhanāpekṣā | atha brahmaṇyaiśvaryaviśeṣo'sti;
analyzed: atha jīvebhyaḥ ṛtha antara bhūtāḥ kṣaṇikāḥ guṇāḥ tatas kṣaṇika tvāt eva vinā ṅkṛtyanti iti na tad artham vidyā ākhyam sādhanam apekṣitam iti vidyā vaiphalyam na ca āgāminām śoka ādīnām anutpattaye sādhanam apekṣitam iti vācyam sa hi teṣām prāgabhāvaḥ sa ca asādhyaḥ iti uktam atas na tad artham api sādhana apekṣā atha brahmaṇi aiśvarya viśeṣaḥ usti

original: tatprāptireva brahmarūpapariṇāmo mokṣa ucyate; tathāhi—“sa svarāṅ bhavati” iti śrutirmuktasya svayaṃprabhutvamāha | tadasat, anekeśvaratvānupapatteḥ | tathāhi—brahmaṇo nyūnaṃ samaṃ vā muktānāmaiśvaryaṃ syāt; tatra nyūnatve na brahmarūpāpattiḥ, na ca svayaṃprabhutvam; mukteśvarāṇāṃ parameśvaraparatvadarśanāt |
analyzed: tad prāptiḥ eva brahma rūpa pariṇāmaḥ mokṣaḥ ucyate tathā hi sa svarāj bhavati iti śrutiḥ muktasya svayaṃprabhu tvam āha tat asat aneka īśvara tva anupapatteḥ tathā hi brahmaṇaḥ nyūnam samam vā muktānām aiśvaryam syāt tatra nyūna tve na brahma rūpa āpattiḥ na ca svayaṃprabhu tvam mukta īśvarāṇām parameśvara para tva darśanāt

original: tathā sati cānyarājanyatvaṃ muktānāṃ syāt | anyarājanyatve “atha ye'nyathāto viduḥ, anyarājānaste kṣayyalokā bhavanti” iti śrutirmuktānāmaiśvaryasyāntavaccaṃ, tataśca svargiṇāmiva punarāvṛttiḥ syāt | ato brahmātmabhāvāt anyathā ye viurityanvayaḥ | anyo rājā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ |

original: na cāntavaccamanupapannam, loke parameśvarecchayā nyūneśvarāṇāmaiśvaryapracyutidarśanāt | brahmaiśvaryasamasya caiśvaryasya muktānāṃ yugapadanupapattireva; tathāhi—ekaśredīśvaraḥ sarvasya jagato'dhipatiḥ praśāsitā ca syāt, tato'parasya kartavyameva nāsti; sa kiṃ kurvannīśvaraḥ syāt? virodhācca samasyaiśvaryasya yugapadanupapattiḥ;
analyzed: na ca antavat cam anupapannam loke parameśvara icchayā nyūna īśvarāṇām aiśvarya pracyuti darśanāt brahma aiśvarya samasya ca aiśvaryasya muktānām yugapad anupapattiḥ eva tathā hi ekaśret īśvaraḥ sarvasya jagataḥ adhipatiḥ praśāsitā ca syāt kartavyam eva na asti sa kim kurvan īśvaraḥ syāt virodhāt ca samasya aiśvaryasya yugapad anupapattiḥ

original: na khalu yadekasyeśvarasyābhipretaṃ tadaparasyāpīti niyame heturasti | tatraikasminvastuni viruddhābhiprāyayordvayorīśvarayormadhye yadyekābhiprāyānuvidhāyitvaṃ tasya vastunaḥ syāt, tato yasyeśvarasyābhiprāyaṃ tadvastu nānuvidhaste na tadabhiprāyānurūpaṃ bhavati tasyānīśvaratvaṃ syāt | ubhayeśvarābhiprāyānuvartitvaṃ ca vastuno-
analyzed: na khalu yat ekasya īśvarasya abhipretam tat aparasya api iti niyame hetuḥ asti tatra ekasmin vastuni viruddha abhiprāyayoḥ dvayoḥ īśvarayoḥ madhye yadi eka abhiprāya anuvidhāyi tvam tasya vastunaḥ syāt tatas yasya īśvarasya abhiprāyam tat vastu na anuvidhaste na tat abhiprāya anurūpam bhavati tasya anīśvara tvam syāt ubhaya īśvara abhiprāya anuvarti tvam ca vastunaḥ

original: 'saṃbhāvyeva, virodhāt | atha ubhayorabhiprāyaṃ nānuvartate, yādṛśaṃ vastu P. 121-9 ubhayorabhiprāyaṃ tato'nyathaiva syāt | tathobhayorapyanīśvaratvaṃ syāt | athocyeta—syādevaṃ yadyaikamatye na heturasti; na tvevam | anaikamatye hīśvarāṇāṃ parasparavirodhāt kāryaṃ na sidhyet | tataśca kāryasiddhireva teṣāmaikamatye hetuḥ |
analyzed: saṃbhāvya iva virodhāt atha ubhayoḥ abhiprāyam na anuvartate yādṛśam vastu ubhayoḥ abhiprāyam tatas anyathā eva syāt tathā ubhayoḥ api anīśvara tvam syāt atha ucyeta asya adevam yadi aikamatye na hetuḥ asti na tu evam anaikamatye hi īśvarāṇām paraspara virodhāt kāryam na sidhyet tatas ca kārya siddhiḥ eva teṣām aikamatye hetuḥ

original: bhavati ca kāryasiddhaye bahūnāmaikamatyam, yathā vyavahārādiṣu pariṣada iti cet; tanna; evaṃ hi pratyekamanīśvaratvaṃ syāt | etacca karmahetuke'pyaikamatye tulyam | atha pūrvoktavirodhābhāvāya paryāyeṇa teṣāmīśvaratvamucyate, tato yasyaiśvaryamuparataṃ tadīyasyaiśvaryalakṣaṇasya mokṣasyāntavaccaṃ syāt | anantaśrāptau, apunarādṛtiśruteḥ |
analyzed: bhavati ca kārya siddhaye bahūnām aikamatyam yathā vyavahāra ādiṣu pariṣadaḥ iti ced tat na evam hi pratyekam anīśvara tvam syāt etat ca karma hetuka ipi aikamatye tulyam atha pūrva ukta virodha abhāvāya paryāyeṇa teṣām īśvara tvam ucyate tatas yasya aiśvaryam uparatam tadīyasya aiśvarya lakṣaṇasya mokṣasya antavat cam syāt ananta śrāptau apunarādṛti śruteḥ

original: itaśca na brahmatulyamaiśvaryaṃ muktānām, yato brahma jagatsṛjati na muktāḥ | te tu sṛṣṭyuttarakālamīśvaropāsanenāpadṛjyante | ataḥ sṛṣṭisamaye na santyeva; kutasteṣāṃ sraṣṭṛtvam? atasteṣāṃ sraṣṭṛtvābhāvāt na brahmatulyamaiśvaryam |
analyzed: itas ca na brahma tulyam aiśvaryam muktānām yatas brahma jagat sṛjati na muktāḥ te tu sṛṣṭi uttara kālam īśvara upāsanena apadṛjyante atas sṛṣṭi samaye na santi eva kutas teṣām sraṣṭṛ tvam atas teṣām sraṣṭṛ tva abhāvāt na brahma tulyam aiśvaryam

original: tasmādyathā śuddhatvarūpasya sphaṭikasya japādyupādhikalpitarāgatirohitatvarūpasya rāgāpanaye vidyamānameva tvarūpamāvirbhavati, na tvapūrvaṃ janyate, tathā “taccamasi” “anena jīvenātmanā” ityādiśrutisiddhabrahmatvarūpasya jīvasyāvidyātirohitatadrūpasya vidyayā avidyāpanaye nijabrahmarūpāvirbhāvamātraṃ brahmaprāptiḥ, na rūpāntarāpattiḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt yathā śuddha tva rūpasya sphaṭikasya japa ādi upādhi kalpita rāga tirohita tva rūpasya rāga apanaye vidyamānam eva tu arūpam āvirbhavati na tu apūrvam janyate tathā tat camasi anena jīvena ātmanā ityādi śruti siddha brahma tva rūpasya jīvasya avidyā tirohita tad rūpasya vidyayā avidyā apanaye nija brahma rūpa āvirbhāva mātram brahma prāptiḥ na rūpa antara āpattiḥ

original: tathā ca “svena rūpeṇa” iti śrutau svaśabda upapadyate, nānyarūpaniṣpattau | svaśabdo'yamātmātmīyavacanaḥ | tatrānyadapi rūpaṃ yadyabhinnaṃ niṣpadyate, tadā tvam, atha bhinnaṃ tadā tvīyam, ityabhedāt saṃbandhādvānyarūpaniṣpattāvapi svaśabdopapattiriti cet; na, ‘svena’ iti viśeṣaṇātarthakyaprasaṅgāt | saṃbhave vyabhicāre hi viśeṣaṇamarthavat |
analyzed: tathā ca svena rūpeṇa iti śrutau sva śabdaḥ upapadyate na anya rūpa niṣpattau sva śabdaḥ ūyam ātma ātmīya vacanaḥ tatra anyat api rūpam yadi abhinnam niṣpadyate tadā tvam atha bhinnam tadā tvīyam iti abhedāt saṃbandhāt vā anya rūpa niṣpattau api sva śabda upapattiḥ iti ced na svena iti viśeṣaṇa ātarthakya prasaṅgāt saṃbhave vyabhicāre hi viśeṣaṇam arthavat

original: anyarūpasya niṣpadyamānasya svatvaṃ svīyatvaṃ vā saṃbhavatyeva, na vyabhicarati | ataḥ ‘svena’ iti viśeṣaṇānarthakyam | svatvāditi; svaśabda ātmātmīyavacanaḥ | nijasyaiva brahmatvarūpasyābhivyaktimātraṃ yadi muktiḥ, kathaṃ tarhi niṣpadyata iti? niṣpattirhi janma; taccābhūtaprādurbhāvaḥ, na tu vidyamānarūpābhivyaktimātram iti cenna;
analyzed: anya rūpasya niṣpadyamānasya svatvam svīya tvam vā saṃbhavati eva na vyabhicarati atas svena iti viśeṣaṇa ānarthakyam sva tvāt iti sva śabdaḥ ātma ātmīya vacanaḥ nijasya eva brahmatva rūpasya abhivyakti mātram yadi muktiḥ katham tarhi niṣpadyate iti niṣpattiḥ hi janma tat ca abhūta prādurbhāvaḥ na tu vidyamāna rūpa abhivyakti mātram iti ced na

original: abhivyaktāvapyevaṃviśeṣaśabdaprayogadarśanāt; yathā—malāpakarṣaṇābhivyaktaśaucchye ‘ghaṭaḥ śuklo jātaḥ, niṣpannaḥ, bhūtaḥ’ iti cocyate | nenāyamapyadoṣaḥ | tathā “brahmaiva san brahmāpyeti” itīyamapi śrutiḥ
analyzed: abhivyaktau api evam viśeṣa śabda prayoga darśanāt yathā amala apakarṣaṇa abhivyakta śaucchye ghaṭaḥ śuklaḥ jātaḥ niṣpannaḥ bhūtaḥ iti ca ucyate nena ayam api adoṣaḥ tathā brahma eva san brahma apyeti iti iyam api śrutiḥ

original: jīvasya vidyamānabrahmarūpāvirbhāvameva mokṣamāha—anyathā “brahmaiva san” iti na ghaṭate | evaṃ mokṣasvarūpaṃ nirūpya ‘sādhyo mokṣo na cāparaḥ’ iti ślokārtha- P.121-19 mupapādayan vyācaṣṭe—tadevamiti | na ceti nakāraḥ kākākṣivat ‘na sādhyaḥ’ ‘na cāparaḥ’ ityubhābhyāṃ saṃbadhyate | ‘na sādhyaḥ’ ityatra pūrvo vā vartate |
analyzed: jīvasya vidyamāna brahma rūpa āvirbhāvam eva mokṣam āha anyathā brahma eva san iti na ghaṭate evam mokṣa svarūpam nirūpya sādhyaḥ mokṣaḥ na ca aparaḥ iti śloka artha mupapādayan vyācaṣṭe etat evam iti na ca iti nakāraḥ kāka akṣi vat na sādhyaḥ na ca aparaḥ iti ubhābhyām saṃbadhyate na sādhyaḥ iti atra pūrvaḥ vā vartate

original: yadvā ‘na ca’ ityasya sādhya ityanena saṃbandhaḥ | apara iti cānyo na bhavatītyarthaḥ | kvacittu ‘na nāparaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ; tatra na sādhyo nāpara ityarthaḥ | na cānyatvamiti; vidyāto mokṣasya nānyatvamityarthaḥ | etacca ‘nāparaḥ’ ityasya vyākhyānam | ananyatve hetumāha—yat iti |

original: yato brahmasvarūpabhūtanityavidyāvirbhāva eva mokṣaḥ, ato na vidyāto'nyaḥ | anyacca sādhyaṃ bhavati | ato na vidyāsādhya iti prakṛtopayogaḥ | yadyapi ‘avidyāstamayo mokṣaḥ’ ityuktaṃ śloke, tathāpi vidyaivāvidyāstamaya iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt vṛttau vidyādhigamo muktiruktetyadoṣaḥ ! ‘avidyāvigamaḥ’ iti pāṭhe tvavirodha eva | ukteneti;

analyzed: sphaṭika nyāyena advaya ātma prakāśaḥ asau iti vā anena uktena iti arthaḥ advaya ātma prakāśa rūpāyāḥ vidyāyāḥ mokṣa tvam upapādayati avidyā iti avidyā nivṛttau api mokṣe saṃsāra nivṛttiḥ mokṣaḥ iti prasiddheḥ na doṣaḥ iti nanu tathā api avidyā nivṛttiḥ mokṣaḥ na vidyā iti āśaṅkya āha vidyā eva iti agraha rūpā vā avidyā viparyaya jñāna rūpā vā

original: tatra yadi tāvadagrahaṇamavidyā, tato vidyaiva tannivṛttiḥ, yato'grahaṇaprāgabhāvo grahaṇam | tasya grahaṇabhāva eva nivṛttiḥ, nānyā; ghaṭaprāgabhāvasyaiva ghaṭabhāvaḥ | atha viparyayajñānamavidyā, tathāpi tadvirodhitattvajñānodaya eva tannivṛttirityarthaḥ | etat dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati—na hoti | tatra śuktijñānāsādhyatve hetumāha—tayoriti |

original: tathāhi—‘veda’ iti viderleṅantasya “vido layo vā” iti tipo ṇaladeśātprayogaḥ; ‘vidvān’ iti ca “videḥ śaturvasuḥ” iti śaturvasvādeśāt, anupaśyata iti vyaktā vartamānatā | tadevaṃ vartamānaikakālatvānna vidyāprāptyoḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ | “tadātmānam” ityatra tu ‘avet, abhayat’ ityanayobhūtārthatvādanekakālatā draṣṭavyā;

original: nanu yadi vijñānātmabo'dvayabrahmarūpasya tatsvarūpāvirbhāvarūpavidyodaya eva mokṣaḥ; tato yatraiva vidyodayastatraiva sa mucyeta;
analyzed: nanu yadi tad svarūpa āvirbhāva rūpa vidyā udayaḥ eva mokṣaḥ tatas yatra eva vidyā udayaḥ tatra eva sa mucyeta

original: tato gatyabhāvāt “te'cirabhisaṃbhavantyaciṣo'haḥ” ityādyā mārgaśrutayaḥ katham? kathaṃ ca “loke yathā madhukṛtaḥ” iti “yathā saugya nadyaḥ” ityādyāśra jīvabrahmaṇorasati vibhāge vibhāgasyāpyayaṃ layaṃ śrāvayantyaḥ śrutayaḥ? kathaṃ cādvayātmasvarūpāvirbhāve “sa ekadhā bhavati, dvidhā” ityādyāḥ śrutayaḥ?— iti pṛcchati—kathamiti |
analyzed: tatas gati abhāvāt ityādyāḥ mārga śrutayaḥ katham katham ca loke yathā madhukṛtaḥ iti yathā saugya nadyaḥ ityādyāḥ śra jīva brahmaṇoḥ asati vibhāge vibhāgasya api ayam layam śrāvayantyaḥ śrutayaḥ katham ca advaya ātma svarūpa āvirbhāve saḥ ekadhā bhavati dvidhā ityādyāḥ śrutayaḥ iti pṛcchati katham iti

original: atrottaramāha—tatreti | ācāryā ityadhyāhāryameva | tacca pūjārthamuktam | na svamataparyudāsāya | vidyā saguṇā
analyzed: atra uttaram āha tatra iti ācāryāḥ iti adhyāhāryam eva tat ca pūjā artham uktam na sva mata paryudāsāya vidyā saguṇā

original: nirguṇā ca | tatra mārgādiśrutayo na nirguṇavidyāviṣayāḥ ; tatra hi gatiniṣedhaḥ eva “brahmaiva san” iti śrūyate | brahmasvarūpasyaiva brahmabhāvaṃ vadantī śrutireṣā svarūpasya tatraiva deśe sulabhatvādanyatra gatiṃ niṣedhati |
analyzed: nirguṇā ca tatra mārga ādi śrutayaḥ na nirguṇa vidyā viṣayāḥ tatra hi gati niṣedhaḥ eva brahma eva san iti śrūyate brahma svarūpasya eva brahma bhāvam vadantī śrutiḥ eṣā svarūpasya tatra eva deśe sulabha tvāt anyatra gatim niṣedhati

original: tathā “na tasmātprāṇāḥ” ityādyā ca śrutiḥ tasmādviduṣo dehāstra prāṇā utkrāmanti, apitu atraiva samavanīyante pralīyante iti vadantī viduṣo vijñānātmano gatiṃ niṣedhati | gatyarthaśca mārgopadeśaḥ | sa gatyabhāve nirguṇavidyāyāmanarthaka ityāśayaḥ | nanu prāṇānāmayaṃ gatiniṣedho na vijñānātmana P.122-14 ityāśaṅkyāha—prāṇeti |
analyzed: tathā na tasmāt prāṇāḥ ityādyā ca śrutiḥ tasmāt viduṣaḥ dehāḥ tra prāṇāḥ utkrāmanti apitu atra eva samavanīyante pralīyante iti vadantī viduṣaḥ vijñānātmanaḥ gatim niṣedhati gati arthaḥ ca mārga upadeśaḥ sa gati abhāve nirguṇa vidyāyām anarthakaḥ iti āśayaḥ nanu prāṇānām ayam gati niṣedhaḥ na vijñānātmanaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha prāṇa iti

original: atra hetumāha—na hīti | yathā vimbasyaivādarśādyupādhervimbāṅgedena prativimbatvam, evaṃ brahmaṇa eva prāṇopādheḥ brahmaṇo bhedena vijñānātmatvam; tatra prāṇānāmagamane satyupādherabhāvādvijñānātmatvameva nāsti; kasya gamanaṃ bhavatviti arthātprāṇagamane vijñānātmana evāgatiruktā bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: atra hetum āha na hi iti yathā vimbasya eva ādarśa ādi upādheḥ vimba aṅga edena prativimba tvam evam brahmaṇaḥ eva prāṇa upādheḥ brahmaṇaḥ bhedena vijñāna ātma tvam tatra prāṇānām agamane sati upādheḥ abhāvāt vijñāna ātma tvam eva na asti kasya gamanam bhavatu iti arthāt prāṇa gamane vijñāna ātmanaḥ eva āgatiḥ uktā bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: atrāha—“na tasmātprāṇā utkrāmanti” iti jīvāpādānā prāṇānāmutkrāntiranena niṣidhyate, na dehāpādānā | tenāyamasyārthaḥ— jīvamujjhitvā prāṇā notkrāmanti, apitu jīvena sahaiva dehādutkrāmantīti |
analyzed: atra āhana tasmāt prāṇāḥ utkrāmanti iti jīva apādānā prāṇānām utkrāntiḥ anena niṣidhyate na deha apādānā tena ayam asya arthaḥ jīvam ujjhitvā prāṇāḥ na utkrāmanti apitu jīvena saha eva dehāt utkrāmanti iti

original: evaṃ ca “na tasya prāṇā utkrāmanti” iti śākhāntaraśrutirapi ‘tasya prāṇāḥ kuto notkrāmanti? kiṃ dehāt? uta dehinaḥ?’ ityapekṣāyāṃ “na tasmāt” iti śrutibalāt dehina iti viśeṣe sthāpyate |
analyzed: evam ca na tasya prāṇāḥ utkrāmanti iti śākhā antara śrutiḥ api tasya prāṇāḥ kutas nā utkrāmanti kim dehāt uta dehinaḥ iti apekṣāyām na tasmāt iti śruti balāt dehinaḥ iti viśeṣe sthāpyate

original: kiṃca prāptipūrvakatvānniṣedhasya “tamutkrāmantaṃ prāṇā anūtkrāmanti” iti dehāntaragrahaṇāyāviduṣo yotkrāntiḥ śrutā, sā “na tasmātprāṇāḥ” ityanena viduṣi niṣidhyate, na parabrahmaprāptyarthā | taduktam—“dehāntarārthā yotkrāntiḥ sā tatra pratiṣidhyate” iti | tena viduṣo'pyutkrāntirastīti paravidyāviṣayā api mārgaśrutayaḥ |
analyzed: kiṃca prāpti pūrvaka tvāt niṣedhasya tam utkrāmantam prāṇāḥ anūtkrāmanti iti deha antara grahaṇāya aviduṣaḥ yā utkrāntiḥ śrutā sā na tasmāt prāṇāḥ iti anena viduṣi niṣidhyate na para brahma prāpti arthā tat uktam deha antara arthā yā utkrāntiḥ sā tatra pratiṣidhyate iti tena viduṣaḥ api utkrāntiḥ asti iti para vidyā viṣayāḥ api mārga śrutayaḥ

original: tathā ca tatprakaraṇe'pi sāḥ paṭhyanta iti | tadidamasaṃbaddham; tathāhi—yadyaviduṣo yotkrāntiḥ sā viduṣo niṣidhyate, tarhi sā dehācchrutā kathaṃ jīvānniṣidhyate? atha dehādeva sotkrāntiniṣiddhā; kiṃ tu dehāntarārthā, na brahmaprāptyarthetyucyate; tato'nena dehāntarārthotkrāntirviduṣo niṣiddhā;
analyzed: tathā ca tad prakaraṇe api sāḥ paṭhyante iti tat idam asaṃbaddham tathā hi yadi aviduṣaḥ yā utkrāntiḥ sā viduṣaḥ niṣidhyate tarhi sā dehāt śrutā katham jīvāt niṣidhyate atha dehāt eva sā utkrānti niṣiddhā kim tu deha antara arthā na brahma prāpti arthā iti ucyate tatas unena deha antara artha utkrāntiḥ viduṣaḥ niṣiddhā

original: brahmaprāptyarthā tu kena vihitā? na tāvadanenaiva, vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt | na cārthākṣepasiddhā, vinaiva tayā dehāntarotkrāntiniṣedhopapatteḥ, brahmaprāptyupapatteśca | tathāhi—yadanyat dūrasthaṃ ca, tadgatyā prāpyate | brahma tu jīvasya nijaṃ rūpaṃ sarvagataṃ ca; ato nānyat,
analyzed: brahma prāpti arthā tu kena vihitā na tāvat anena eva vākya bheda prasaṅgāt na ca artha ākṣepa siddhā vinā eva tayā deha antara utkrānti niṣedha upapatteḥ brahma prāpti upapatteḥ ca tathā hi yat anyat dūra stham ca tad gatyā prāpyate brahma tu jīvasya nijam rūpam sarva gatam ca atas na anyat

original: na ca dūrastham | ataḥ kiṃ tatra gatyā, yena sārthādākṣipyeta ? kiṃca “atraiva samavanīyante” iti ca tatraiva deśe prāṇānāṃ pralayamabhivadantī śrutiḥ viduṣo'nuktānti sūcayati | atreti brahmocyate, na deśaviśeṣa iti cet ; mahābhijño bhavān śabdavṛttasya |
analyzed: na ca dūra stham atas kim tatra gatyā yena sārthāt ākṣipyeta kiṃca atra eva samavanīyante iti ca tatra eva deśe prāṇānām pralayam abhivadantī śrutiḥ sūcayati atra iti brahma ucyate na deśa viśeṣaḥ iti ced mahā abhijñaḥ bhavān śabda vṛttasya

original: na hi ‘rājā na gataḥ, atraiva tiṣṭhati’ ityukte yato na gataḥ, tato deśādanyat ‘atra’ ityucyate | tasmādviduṣo brahmaprāptyarthā notkrāntiriti vyarthā mārgaśrutayaḥ paraprakaraṇe'pi paṭhitāḥ | yatrārthavatyaḥ, tatra pūṣānumantraṇamantravat duṣyanta ityalaṃ prapañcena | kiṃviṣayā nāma tā mārgaśrutayaḥ ? ityapekṣāyāmāha—yatra tviti |
analyzed: na hi rājā na gataḥ atra eva tiṣṭhati iti ukte yatas na gataḥ tatas deśāt anyat atra iti ucyate tasmāt viduṣaḥ brahma prāpti arthā na utkrāntiḥ iti vyarthāḥ mārga śrutayaḥ para prakaraṇe api paṭhitāḥ yatra arthavatyaḥ tatra pūṣa anumantraṇa mantra vat duṣyantaḥ iti alam prapañcena kiṃviṣayāḥ nāma tāḥ mārga śrutayaḥ iti apekṣāyām āha yatra tu iti

original: P.122-16 saguṇavidyāviṣayāstā ityarthaḥ | na ca nirguṇavidyānyāyena tatrāpi tāsāmanupayoga ityabhiprāyeṇāha—tatra ceti | parabrahma hi jīvasya nijaṃ rūpam, tacca nityaprāptameva sadavidyayā karasthamuvarṇavadaprāptaṃ vidyayā avidyānivṛttau tatraiva sulabhamiti na gatimapekṣate ; tena yuktastatra mārgaśrutīnāmanupayogaḥ |
analyzed: saguṇa vidyā viṣayāḥ tāḥ iti arthaḥ na ca nirguṇa vidyā nyāyena tatra api tāsām anupayogaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha tatra ca iti para brahma hi jīvasya nijam rūpam tat ca nitya prāptam eva sat avidyayā kara stham uvarṇa vat aprāptam vidyayā avidyā nivṛttau tatra eva sulabham iti na gatim apekṣate tena yuktaḥ tatra mārga śrutīnām anupayogaḥ

original: kāryabrahmalokaḥ punaḥ itastṛtīyasyāṃ divi tiṣṭhati ; tena sa dūrasthaḥ ; tatprāptaye āmavat gatimapekṣata iti tatra mārgaśrutayaṃ upayujyanta ityarthaḥ | kāryabrahmalokāstitvaṃ śrautatvena darśayati—yatreti | kāryaṃ ca brahmalokaṃ ye'pi na parabrahmavidaste'pi yānti |
analyzed: kārya brahma lokaḥ punar itas tṛtīyasyām divi tiṣṭhati tena sa dūra sthaḥ tad prāptaye āma vat gatim apekṣate iti tatra mārga śrutayaḥ upayujyante iti arthaḥ kārya brahma loka astitvam śrauta tvena darśayati yatra iti kāryam ca brahma lokam ye api na para brahma vidaḥ te api yānti

original: tatra śraddhāsatyatapasāmupāsakānāṃ kāryabrahmalokaṃ śrutyā draḍhayati—tathā ceti | nanu saguṇopāsakānāmapi brahmaprāptireva kiṃ na syādityāśaṅkyāha—pareti | atra hetumāha—vidyayeti | mṛtyumatyetītyanvayaḥ | nanu saguṇopāsakānāṃ kāryabrahmalokaprāptiśret, tatastasya mahāpralaye nāśāt teṣāṃ punarāvṛttyā bhāvyam ;
analyzed: tatra śraddhā satya tapasām upāsakānām kārya brahma lokam śrutyā draḍhayati tathā ca iti nanu saguṇa upāsakānām api brahma prāptiḥ eva kim na syāt iti āśaṅkya āha para iti atra hetum āha vidyayā iti mṛtyum atyeti iti anvayaḥ nanu saguṇa upāsakānām kārya brahma loka prāptiḥ tatas tasya mahāpralaye nāśāt teṣām punarāvṛttyā bhāvyam

original: atha katham “imaṃ mānavamāvartaṃ nāvartante” ityanāvṛttiśrutiriti pṛcchati—apunarāvṛttīti | atra matabhedenottaramāha—atreti | tatprapañcayati—taditi ; kāryabrahmalokasthānaṃ nirdiśati ;
analyzed: atha katham imam mānavam āvartam na āvartante iti anāvṛtti śrutiḥ iti pṛcchati apunarāvṛtti iti atra mata bhedena uttaram āha atra iti tat prapañcayati tat iti kārya brahmaloka sthānam nirdiśati

original: tat kāryabrahmaloke sthānaṃ prāpya tatrotpannasarvopādhinirmuktabrahmatattvavijñānā mahāpralaye prāpte krameṇa paraṃ padamaśnuvate iti teṣāmapi punarāvṛttyabhāvāt apunarāvṛttiśrutyupapattiḥ | atra vākyaṃ paṭhati—yatheti | vedāntavijñānena suniścito'rtho yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ, utpannavākyārthamātrajñānāḥ,
analyzed: tat kārya brahma loke sthānam prāpya tatra utpanna sarva upādhi nirmukta brahma tattva vijñānāḥ mahāpralaye prāpte krameṇa param padam aśnuvate iti teṣām api punarāvṛtti abhāvāt apunarāvṛtti śruti upapattiḥ atra vākyam paṭhati yathā iti vedānta vijñānena su niścita ūrthaḥ yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ utpanna vākya artha mātra jñānāḥ

original: anutpannādvayātmasākṣātkārā iti yāvat | ata eva sahasā na mucyante, apitu kāryabrahmalokaṃ gatvānantaraṃ mucyante | “te brahmalokeṣu” iti parameva brahmocyate ; atastatprāptirevānena kathyate, na kāryabrahmalokaprāpti- P.123-14 rityāśaṅkyāha—brahmeti | paraṃ brahmaikamanavayavaṃ ca | atastasya na svato nāpyavayavadvāreṇa bahutvamavakalpate ;
analyzed: anutpanna advaya ātma sākṣātkārāḥ iti yāvat atas eva sahasā na mucyante apitu kārya brahma lokam gatvā anantaram mucyante te brahma lokeṣu iti param eva brahma ucyate atas tad prāptiḥ eva anena kathyate na kārya brahma loka prāptiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha brahma iti param brahma ekam anavayavam ca atas tasya na svatas na api avayava dvāreṇa bahutvam avakalpate

original: kāryabrahmalokastu yadyapyekaḥ, tathāpyavayavabahutvena tatra bahuvacanamupapadyate ; tena sa evocyate, na paramityarthaḥ | atra kecit grahaikatvavadvahutvamavidheyatvādavivakṣitam ; ataḥ paraṃ brahmaivātra brahmalokamityāhuḥ ; tadayuktam ; parāntakālapratīkṣaṇāt ;
analyzed: kārya brahma lokaḥ tu yadi api ekaḥ tathā api avayava bahutvena tatra bahuvacanam upapadyate tena saḥ eva ucyate na param iti arthaḥ atra kecid graha ekatva vat vahutvam avidheya tvāt avivakṣitam atas param brahma eva atra brahma lokam iti āhuḥ tat ayuktam parānta kāla pratīkṣaṇāt

original: na hi viduṣo mahāpralayakāle parabrahmaprāptiḥ, apitu dehapātānantaramiti teṣāmapyabhimatam | tathāca sūtram—“pāte tu” iti | lokaśabdaśra bhogabhūmau mukhyo na parabrahmaṇi | ādhāratvamapi tasyaiva kāryabrahmalokasya nivāsasthānatvāt ghaṭate | tasmātkāryabrahmalokanirdeśa evāyam |
analyzed: na hi viduṣaḥ mahāpralaya kāle para brahma prāptiḥ apitu dehapāta anantaram iti teṣām api abhimatam tathā ca sūtrampāte tu iti loka śabdaḥ śra bhogabhūmau mukhyaḥ na para brahmaṇi ādhāra tvam api tasya eva kārya brahma lokasya nivāsa sthāna tvāt ghaṭate tasmāt kārya brahma loka nirdeśaḥ eva ayam

original: evaṃ ca sati bahuvacanamapi kathaṃcidavakalpata iti tadapi liṅgasthānīyamuktamityadoṣaḥ | sarvamidaṃ kartrādi brahmetyupāsanāditi ; yogaśabdena upāsanāmātramucyate, na tacchajñānamityuktaṃ bhavati | ata eva kāryabrahmalokaprāptiḥ phalam | atraivārthe smṛtimāha—tathāceti |
analyzed: evam ca sati bahuvacanam api kathaṃcid avakalpate iti tat api liṅga sthānīyam uktam iti adoṣaḥ sarvam idam kartṛ ādi brahma iti upāsanāt iti yoga śabdena upāsanā mātram ucyate na tad śa jñānam iti uktam bhavati atas eva kārya brahma loka prāptiḥ phalam atra eva arthe smṛtim āha tathā ca iti

original: brahmalokaṃ gatāste sarve kṛtātmānaḥ saṃskṛtabuddhayaḥ parasya pradhānasya brahmaṇo'nte adhikārasamāptau yadā pratisaṃcaro mahāpralayo bhavati tadā brahmaṇā saha paraṃ padaṃ praviśantītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: brahma lokam gatāḥ te sarve kṛtātmānaḥ saṃskṛta buddhayaḥ parasya pradhānasya brahmaṇaḥ ante adhikāra samāptau yadā pratisaṃcaraḥ mahāpralayaḥ bhavati tadā brahmaṇā saha param padam praviśanti iti arthaḥ

original: anye tu anāvṛttiśruterimarthaṃ manyante—yathā karmiṇo dhūmādimārgeṇa candralokaṃ gatāste tatra patanakālaparyantaṃ sthitvā bhuktvā bhogāṃstasmin sthita eva nivartante, naiva sthite brahmaloke tatra gatānāṃ tata āvṛttiḥ ; apitu brahmalokapralayaparyantaṃ tatraiva siṣṭanti | na ca vācyam—tathāpi tatpralaye teṣāmāvṛtteḥ kathamanādṛttiśrutiriti ;
analyzed: anye tu anāvṛtti śruteḥ imam artham manyante yathā karmiṇaḥ dhūma ādi mārgeṇa candra lokam gatāḥ te tatra patana kāla paryantam sthitvā bhuktvā bhogān tasmin sthite eva nivartante na eva sthite brahmaloke tatra gatānām tatas āvṛttiḥ apitu brahmaloka pralaya paryantam tatra eva siṣṭanti na ca vācyam tathā api tad pralaye teṣām āvṛtteḥ katham anādṛtti śrutiḥ iti

original: yatastasmin sati na tata ādṛttirbhavati ; tatpralaye tu sa eva nāsti ; kutastata āvṛttiḥ ? ataścaivamanāvṛttiḥ śrūyate | yatra tu ‘tatpralaye hi tata āvṛttiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tatra tataḥ pralayāt prāgāvṛttirnāsti, tataścānāvṛttiḥ śrūyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yatas tasmin sati na tatas ādṛttiḥ bhavati tad pralaye tu saḥ eva na asti kutas tatas āvṛttiḥ atas ca evam anāvṛttiḥ śrūyate yatra tu tad pralaye hi tatas āvṛttiḥ iti pāṭhaḥ tatra tatas pralayāt prāk āvṛttiḥ na asti tatas ca anāvṛttiḥ śrūyate iti arthaḥ

original: tathāca “imaṃ mānavam” iti “iha nāvartante” iti ‘imam iha’ iti viśeṣaṇam asyāṃ saṃnihitāyāṃ vartamānasṛṣṭāvanāvṛttimāha | sarvathānāvṛttau duryojametat | “apṛtatvayeti” iti cāpṛtatvaṃ ye prāṇinaḥ pralayādaryāgeva adhinte tānapekṣya |
analyzed: tathā ca imam mānavam iti iha na āvartante iti imam iha iti viśeṣaṇam asyām saṃnihitāyām vartamāna sṛṣṭau anāvṛttim āha sarvathā anāvṛttau duryojam etat apṛta tvayā iti iti ca apṛta tvam ye prāṇinaḥ tān apekṣya

original: mahāpralaye mriyamāṇānāmapi teṣāṃ devānāmivāmaratvamupapadyate | tathā ca “ābhūtasaṃjñavaṃ sthānam” iti smṛtiḥ yāvadbhūtagrāmasyāvasthānaṃ tāvadbhūtatvam, pralaye mriyanta ityāha | yattu manyate—brahmaṇaḥ prādeśiko'yaṃ bhūtabhautikavikāro na sārvatrikaḥ | P. 124-5 tenāvikṛto'pyasya pradeśo'sti |
analyzed: mahāpralaye mriyamāṇānām api teṣām devānām iva amara tvam upapadyate tathā ca ābhūtasaṃjñavam sthānam iti smṛtiḥ yāvat bhūta grāmasya avasthānam tāvat bhūta tvam pralaye mriyante iti āha yat tu manyate brahmaṇaḥ prādeśikaḥ yam bhūta bhautika vikāraḥ na sārvatrikaḥ tena avikṛtaḥ pi asya pradeśaḥ asti

original: yāpi madhu-nadīnidarśanena jīvabrahmaṇoravibhāgaśrutiḥ, sāpi yathā madhuni kuṣumarasānāṃ yathā ca samudre nadīnāṃ saṃsarge dravyatvena parasparamavibhāgaḥ, tathā jīvabrahmaṇorityevaṃparā na bhavati, tayorasaṃsargidravyatvāt ; apitu yathā tatra vivekena jñānābhāvaḥ, tathā jīvabrahmaṇorapītyevaṃparā ; kiṃcitsādṛśyenāpi dṛṣṭāntopādānāt |

original: tathā sṛṣṭiśrutīnāṃ sṛṣṭiparatve sṛjyamānaprapañcasatyatvādradvaitahaniśaṅkānivṛttyarthaṃ tā api prasaṅgato vyācaṣṭe—sargeti | tā api na sṛṣṭiparāḥ ; ātmaiko jagatastattvam, na tato'nyat dvitīyaṃ jagadastītyetatpratipattiparāḥ | tenātmaikatvānugrahastāsāmartho vyavasthāpyaḥ, nānyathā | ātmaikatvaṃ vākyārthībhūtaṃ virudhyate |

original: kathaṃ tāsāmātmaikatvaparatvamucyate ? “kasminnu bhagavo vijñāte sarvamidaṃ vijñātaṃ bhavati” ityupakramaḥ | yadi ca ātmaikaḥ sarvasya taccaṃ na taccāntaramasti, tadā ātmani jñāte sarvamidaṃ jñātaṃ bhavati, nānyathā ! tenātmaikatvenopakrama iti gamyate | tathā “sadeva somya” ityatra “ekamevādvitīyam” ityekatvenopakramaḥ |
analyzed: katham tāsām ātma ekatva paratvam ucyate kasmin nu bhagavaḥ vijñāte sarvam idam vijñātam bhavati iti upakramaḥ yadi ca ātmā ekaḥ sarvasya tat cam na tat ca antaram asti tadā ātmani jñāte sarvam idam jñātam bhavati na anyathā tena ātma ekatvena upakramaḥ iti gamyate tathā sat eva somyaḥ iti atra ekam eva advitīyam iti ekatvena upakramaḥ

original: tathā “aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvam” ityekatvenopasaṃhāraḥ | tenātmaikatvapratipattiparamidaṃ vākyam | tatra yadi bhūtasṛṣṭiparā satyatayā pratipādyeta, tato vākyabhedaḥ syāt | ato yathopāṃśuyājayākye “jāmi vā etadyajñasya kriyate
analyzed: tathā aitadātmyam idam sarvam iti ekatvena upasaṃhāraḥ tena ātma ekatva pratipatti param idam vākyam tatra yadi bhūta sṛṣṭi parā satya tayā pratipādyeta tatas vākya bhedaḥ syāt atas yathā upāṃśuyāja yākye jāmi vai etat yajñasya kriyate

original: ityevamupāṃśuyājastutyarthatayā vyavatiṣṭhante, tathā sṛṣṭiśrutayo vākyārthabhūtasṛjyamānaprapañcabhedapratipattiparāḥ | yata ekatvenaivopakramopasaṃhārau sarvatra śrutau, yena ca tau śrutau sa eva vākyārthaḥ, yaśca vākyārthaḥ sa eva pradhānam, yacca pradhānaṃ tadarthamevānyadyuktam | aphalaṃ ca bhedajñānam |
analyzed: iti evam upāṃśuyāja stuti artha tayā vyavatiṣṭhante tathā sṛṣṭi śrutayaḥ vākya artha bhūta sṛjyamāna prapañca bheda pratipatti parāḥ yatas ekatvena eva upakrama upasaṃhārau sarvatra śrutau yena ca tau śrutau saḥ eva vākya arthaḥ yaḥ ca vākya arthaḥ saḥ eva pradhānam yat ca pradhānam tad artham eva anyat yuktam aphalam ca bheda jñānam

original: ātmaikatvajñānaṃ tu dṛṣṭena ca śokādinivṛttiphalena phalavat | ataḥ ‘phalavatsaṃnidhāvaphalaṃ tadaṅgam’ iti nyāyenāpyaikātmyaparatvaṃ sṛṣṭiśrutīnām | tatra viśuddhetyādinā phalasya dṛṣṭatvamuktam | “tatra ko mohaḥ” ityādinā śrutatvamiti vivekaḥ | sargaśrutayaḥ ekatvopāyatayā P.125-7. vyavatiṣṭhanta ityuktam, tadupāyatvaṃ darśayati—upāyatvaṃ ceti |
analyzed: ātma ekatva jñānam tu dṛṣṭena ca śoka ādi nivṛtti phalena phalavat atas phalavat saṃnidhau aphalam tat aṅgam iti nyāyena api aikātmya paratvam sṛṣṭi śrutīnām tatra viśuddha ityādinā phalasya dṛṣṭa tvam uktam tatra kaḥ mohaḥ ityādinā śruta tvam iti vivekaḥ sarga śrutayaḥ ekatva upāyatayā vyavatiṣṭhante iti uktam tad upāyatvam darśayati upāyatvam ca iti

original: nedamasanmūlamiti “kathamasataḥ sajjāyeta” iti śrutyartha uktaḥ | advitīyaikasanmūlamiti tu “sadevedamagra āsīdekamevādvitīyam” iti śrutyarthaḥ | nanvevaṃ kāryakāraṇayorbhedāt kathamātmaikatvamityāśaṅkyāha—kāraṇeti | syādevaṃ yadi tayorvyatirekaḥ syāt; sa eva tu nāsti; ‘mṛdayaṃ ghaṭaḥ’ ityabhedapratīteriti bhāvaḥ | idamiti ; jagadityarthaḥ |

original: atra dṛṣṭāntamāha— ghaṭādīti | yathā mṛdūpeṇa ghaṭādīnāmekatvam, evaṃ sadūpeṇa jagata ityarthaḥ | nanu yadi sanmūlaṃ jagat tato mukhya eva kāryakāraṇabhāva uktaḥ syāt | ataśca prapañcasatyatā | tatra cādvaitahānirityabhiprāyeṇa codayati— nanviti | pariharati—neti | etatprapañcayati—na svakhviti; ekatvāvatāro pāyatvaṃ vivṛṇoti |
analyzed: atra dṛṣṭāntam āha ghaṭa ādi iti yathā mṛd dūpeṇa ghaṭa ādīnām ekatvam evam sat dūpeṇa jagataḥ iti arthaḥ nanu yadi sat mūlam jagat tatas mukhyaḥ eva kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ uktaḥ syāt atas ca prapañca satyatā tatra ca advaita hāniḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa codayati nanu iti pariharati na iti etat prapañcayati na ekatva avatāra upāyatvam vivṛṇoti

original: taduktam— “mṛddhohavisphuliṅgādyaiḥ sṛṣṭiryā coditā śrutau | upāyaḥ so'vatārāya nāsti bhedaḥ kathaṃcana ||” iti | bhedābhiniveśātiśayāt sahasraivābhedaṃ boddhumaśaktaḥ sadupādānatayā sadūpeṇābhinnaṃ jagat ghaṭādivanmṛdūpeṇeti pratibodhyata ityuktaṃ bhavati | nanu
analyzed: tat uktam mṛd dhoha visphuliṅga ādyaiḥ sṛṣṭiḥ yā coditā śrutau upāyaḥ na asti bhedaḥ kathaṃcana iti bheda abhiniveśa atiśayāt sahasrā evā abhedam boddhum aśaktaḥ sat upādānatayā sat dūpeṇa abhinnam jagat ghaṭa ādi vat mṛd dūpeṇa iti pratibodhyate iti uktam bhavati nanu

original: mukhya eva kāryakāraṇabhāve ekatvāvatāropāyo bhaviṣyati; tathāpi prapañcasatyatā na vyāhanyata ityāśaṅkyāha—sa ceti | sa ca mukhya ekatva- P.125-13 virodhī; tenāmukhyo gṛhyata ityarthaḥ | nanu mukhye'pi kāryakāraṇabhāve, kāryātmanā nānātvaṃ kāraṇātmanā caikṛtvamiti naikatvasya kaściddirodha ityāśaṅkya tanniṣedhayati—ekamiti |
analyzed: mukhyaḥ eva kārya kāraṇa bhāve ekatva avatāra upāyaḥ bhaviṣyati tathā api prapañca satyatā na vyāhanyate iti āśaṅkya āha sa ca iti sa ca mukhyaḥ ekatva virodhī tena amukhyaḥ gṛhyate iti arthaḥ nanu mukhye api kārya kāraṇa bhāve kārya ātmanā nānātvam kāraṇa ātmanā ca aikṛtvam iti na ekatvasya kaścid dirodhaḥ iti āśaṅkya tat niṣedhayati ekam iti

original: kiṃca yadi kāryātmanā nānātvaṃ tataḥ, kāryasyāpi satyatvāt “tatsatyam” iti tacchabdoktasya kāraṇasyāsādhāraṇyena satyatvaṃ śrutirnāvadhārayet; avadhārayati ca | ano na kāryātmanā nānātvamityāha—tatsatyamiti | nanu kārye'pi satyaśrutirasti: yathā—“mṛttiketyeva satyam” iti “prāṇā vai satyam” iti ca |
analyzed: kiṃca yadi kārya ātmanā nānātvam tatas kāryasya api satya tvāt tat satyam iti tad śabda uktasya kāraṇasya asādhāraṇyena satya tvam śrutiḥ na avadhārayet avadhārayati ca anaḥ na kārya ātmanā nānātvam iti āha tat satyam iti nanu kārye pi satya śrutiḥ asti yathā mṛttikā iti eva satyam iti prāṇāḥ vai satyam iti ca

original: ucyate—yathā antaratame mukhya ātmani vivakṣite “anyo'ntara ātmā prāṇamayaḥ” ityātmaśabdoktaṃ bodhayituṃ prāṇamayādiṣu prayujyate; na caitāvatā teṣāṃ mukhyamātmatvam, tathā mūlakāraṇamukhyasatyatvavivakṣayā mṛttikāyāmajñasiddhasatyatve kāraṇe prāṇeṣu cāsiddhasatyatveṣu “teṣāmeṣa satyam” iti mukhyasatyavivakṣayā satyaśabdaḥ prayukta ityadoṣaḥ |
analyzed: ucyate yathā antaratame mukhye ātmani vivakṣite anyaḥ ntaraḥ ātmā prāṇa mayaḥ iti ātma śabda uktam bodhayitum prāṇa maya ādiṣu prayujyate na ca etāvatā teṣām mukhyam ātma tvam tathā mūlakāraṇa mukhya satya tva vivakṣayā mṛttikāyām ajña siddha satya tve kāraṇe prāṇeṣu ca asiddha satya tveṣu teṣām eṣa satyam iti mukhya satya vivakṣayā satya śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ iti adoṣaḥ

original: kāryātmanā nānātvābhāve śrutidvayamaparamāha—anyatreti | atraiva hetvantaramāha—bhedeti | ‘ekatvamavirodhena’ ityatra varṇitamatra smartavyam | tasmādetatsamastaśrutyavirodhena yathā bimbāpratibimbāni vikalpāḥ, varṇebhyaśca padāni vikalpāḥ, tathā jagadvikalpasyātmopādānam | tathā sṛṣṭiśrutirvarṇyata ityāha—etaditi |
analyzed: kārya ātmanā nānātva abhāve śruti dvayam aparam āha anyatra iti atra eva hetu antaram āha bheda iti ekatvam avirodhena iti atra varṇitam atra smartavyam tasmāt etat samasta śruti avirodhena yathā bimba apratibimbāni vikalpāḥ varṇebhyaḥ ca padāni vikalpāḥ tathā jagat vikalpasya ātma upādānam tathā sṛṣṭi śrutiḥ varṇyate iti āha etat iti

original: dṛṣṭāntadvayaṃ vivṛṇoti—yathā hīti | yathā bimbāt pratibimbāni saṃbhūtānītyucyante na ca tāni paramārthataḥ santi, tathā “ātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ, ākāśādvāyuḥ” ityucyata iti | kiṃca svapne'pi sṛṣṭiśrutirasti; na ca tāvatā tatra rathādīnāṃ satyatvam | tadvadeṣāpi bhūtasṛṣṭirbhaviṣyati, ātmaikatvapratipattiratvādityāha—apiceti |
analyzed: dṛṣṭānta dvayam vivṛṇoti yathā hi iti yathā bimbāt pratibimbāni saṃbhūtāni iti ucyante na ca tāni paramārthataḥ santi tathā ātmanaḥ ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ ākāśāt vāyuḥ iti ucyate iti kiṃca svapne pi sṛṣṭi śrutiḥ asti na ca tāvatā tatra ratha ādīnām satya tvam tadvat eṣā api bhūta sṛṣṭiḥ bhaviṣyati ātma ekatva pratipattiḥ atvāt iti āha api ca iti

original: kiṃca rathādapi bhūtasṛṣṭiḥ pāramārthikī, yadi svayameva vācārambhaṇaśrutyā “mṛttiketyeva satyam” iti kāraṇamātrasya satyatvamavadhārayantyā pāramārthikī soktā; na caitadastītyāha—svayamiti | evaṃ sṛṣṭiśrutīnāṃ gatimuktvā aiśvaryaśrutīnāmāha—aiśvaryeti | saguṇavidyāyāṃ svargādisthānīyaṃ phalamihānekadhādibhāvaḥ śrūyate; na tu mokṣaḥ; sa
analyzed: kiṃca rathāt api bhūta sṛṣṭiḥ pāramārthikī yadi svayam eva vācā ārambhaṇa śrutyā mṛttikā iti eva satyam iti kāraṇa mātrasya satya tvam avadhārayantyā pāramārthikī sā uktā na ca etat asti iti āha svayam iti evam sṛṣṭi śrutīnām gatim uktvā aiśvarya śrutīnām āha aiśvarya iti saguṇa vidyāyām svarga ādi sthānīyam phalam iha anekadhā ādi bhāvaḥ śrūyate na tu mokṣaḥ sa eva anekadhā ādi bhāvaḥ śrūyate na tu mokṣaḥ sa eva anekadhā ād

original: hi nirguṇavidyānimitta ityarthaḥ | kathaṃ punastatrāpi kvacidapunarāvṛttismṛti- P.126-10 rityāśaṅkyāha—yadapīti | dvayā gatiriti ; kramamuktyabhiprāyaṃ vā vartamānasargānāvṛttyabhiprāyaṃ vā anāvṛttiśravaṇaṃ vyākhyātamityarthaḥ | aiśvaryaśrutiṣu matāntaramāha—anya iti |
analyzed: hi nirguṇa vidyā nimitte iti arthaḥ katham punar tatra api kvacid apunarāvṛtti smṛtiḥ riti āśaṅkya āha yat api iti dvayā gatiḥ iti krama mukti abhiprāyam vā vartamāna sarga anāvṛtti abhiprāyam vā anāvṛtti śravaṇam vyākhyātam iti arthaḥ aiśvarya śrutiṣu mata antaram āha anye iti

original: yato brahma sarvātmakaṃ, sarveśvaraṃ, sarvopabhogānāṃ ca bhoktṛ, sarvajñaṃ, devādyānandāśra brahmānandasya mātrā, ato yatkiñcidīśvaratvādi brahmādisthāvarānteṣu bhūteṣu tatsarvaṃ brahmaṇi, yacca brahmaṇi tatsarvamāvirbhūtabrahmasvarūpo vidvān brahmaṇaḥ sarvātmatvāt āpnoti, tena “sarvānkāmānāmoti” ityādi tasya
analyzed: yatas brahma sarva ātmakam sarva īśvaram sarva upabhogānām ca bhoktṛ sarvajñam deva ādi ānandāḥ brahma ānandasya mātrāḥ atas yat kiñcid īśvara tva ādi brahma ādi sthāvara anteṣu bhūteṣu tat sarvam brahmaṇi yat ca brahmaṇi tat sarvam āvirbhūta brahma svarūpaḥ vidvān brahmaṇaḥ sarva ātma tvāt āpnoti tena sarvān kāmān āmoti ityādi tasya

original: svarūpāvirbhāvalakṣaṇamokṣapraśaṃsārthamucyata ityarthaḥ | nanu yadyāvirbhūtabrahmasvarūpo vidvān sarvātmatvātsarvakāmānāmoti, tataḥ sarvātmatvādeva sarvabhūtagataśokādyavāmuyāt ; tataśca mokṣe duḥkhamapi syādityabhiprāyeṇa codayati—nanviti | pariharati—neti | brahmaṇo rūpaṃ vidvānāmoti ; śokādayastu na brahmaṇo rūpamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: svarūpa āvirbhāva lakṣaṇa mokṣa praśaṃsā artham ucyate iti arthaḥ nanu yadi āvirbhūta brahma sva rūpaḥ vidvān sarva ātma tvāt sarva kāmān āmoti tatas sarva ātma tvāt eva sarva bhūta gata śokāt yavāmuyāt tatas ca mokṣe duḥkham api syāt iti abhiprāyeṇa codayati nanu iti pariharati na iti brahmaṇaḥ rūpam vidvān āmoti śoka ādayaḥ tu na brahmaṇaḥ rūpam iti arthaḥ

original: atra hetumāha—avidyeti | jñānaiśvaryādayaśca brahmaṇo rūpam ; tena brahmaprāptau prāpyata iti yuktamityāha—jñāneti | kutaḥ punarjñānādīnāṃ brahmarūpatvaṃ gamyata ityāha—vijñānamiti | “nānyo'to'sti draṣṭā” iti ca jñānarūpatve, “etasya” ityānandātmatve, “sarvasyeśvānaḥ” iti caiśvaryātmatve śrutiriti vivekaḥ |
analyzed: atra hetum āha avidyā iti jñāna aiśvarya ādayaḥ ca brahmaṇaḥ rūpam tena brahma prāptau prāpyate iti yuktam iti āha jñāna iti kutas punar jñāna ādīnām brahma rūpa tvam gamyate iti āha vijñānam iti draṣṭā iti ca jñāna rūpa tve etasya iti ānanda ātmatve sarvasya īśvānaḥ iti ca aiśvarya ātmatve śrutiḥ iti vivekaḥ

original: tadevaṃ śokādīnāmavidyādhyastatvāt jñānādīnāṃ ca brahmarūpatvāt yuktaṃ yadāvirbhūtabrahmasvarūpo vidvān jñānādīnaśnute, na śokādīnityāha—tathāceti | atra codayati—nanviti | tatpariharati— naitaditi | dṛṣṭāntau trivṛṇoni—siddheneti | nanu prakāśyānadhīne'pi prakāśarūpe brahmaṇo'dvayatvādasati sarvasmin kathaṃ sarvajñatvamityāśaṅkyāha— tathāceti |
analyzed: tat evam śoka ādīnām avidyā adhyasta tvāt jñāna ādīnām ca brahma rūpatvāt yuktam yat āvirbhūta brahma svarūpaḥ vidvān jñāna ādīn aśnute na śoka ādīn iti āha tathā ca iti atra codayati nanu iti tat pariharati na etat iti dṛṣṭāntau nanu prakāśya anadhīne api prakāśa rūpe brahmaṇā udvaya tvāt asati sarvasmin katham sarvajñatvam iti āśaṅkya āha tathā ca iti

original: tathāca sati prakāśyānapekṣe brahmaṇaḥ prakāśarūpatve sati, taccataḥ sarvābhāve'pi avidyāvasthāyāṃ sarvasya prapañcasya “tasya bhāsā” ityādiśrutisiddhātmacaitanyenāvagāsatvāt ātmanaḥ sarvajñatvamityarthaḥ | evamadvaye brahmaṇi sarvābhāve sarveśvaratvānupapattimāśaṅkya tadupapādayati— sarveti |
analyzed: tathā ca sati prakāśya anapekṣe brahmaṇaḥ prakāśa rūpa tve sati taccataḥ sarva abhāve api avidyā avasthāyām sarvasya prapañcasya tasya bhāsā ityādi śruti siddha ātma caitanyena avagāsa tvāt ātmanaḥ sarvajñatvam iti arthaḥ evam advaye brahmaṇi sarva abhāve sarva īśvara tva anupapattim āśaṅkya tat upapādayati sarva iti

original: atrāpyavidyāvasthāyāmeva brahmendrādīnāmīśvarāṇāṃ yathāyathaṃ sveṣu svepvīśitavyeṣu yadaiśvaryaṃ tatsarvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sarvātmatvāt tadaiśvaryeṇaiveti tasya sarveśvaratvamityarthaḥ | “eṣa bhūtāvipatiḥ” ityādāvapi eṣeva yojanetyāha—
analyzed: atra api avidyā avasthāyām eva brahma indra ādīnām īśvarāṇām yathāyatham sveṣu sveṣu īśitavyeṣu yat aiśvaryam tat sarvam brahmaṇaḥ sarvātma tvāt tad aiśvaryeṇa eva iti tasya sarva īśvara tvam iti arthaḥ eṣa bhūtāvi patiḥ ityādau api eṣā iva yojanā iti āha

original: evamiti | tatrāpyavidyāvasthāyāmeva bhūteṣu lokeṣu ca brahmandrādīnāṃ yadai- P.127-14 śvaryaṃ tat karmopāsanāviśeṣeṇa parameśvarasyaiva sarvātmanā teṣvavacchinnamabhivyaktam | tenendrādīnāṃ yadaiśvaryaṃ tat “eṣa bhūnādhipatiḥ” ityādinā parameśvarasyoktamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: evam iti tatra api avidyā avasthāyām eva bhūteṣu lokeṣu ca brahma indra ādīnām yat aiśvaryam tat karma upāsanā viśeṣeṇa parameśvarasya eva sarva ātmanā teṣu avacchinnam abhivyaktam tena indra ādīnām yat aiśvaryam tat eṣa ityādinā parameśvarasya uktam iti arthaḥ

original: evamavirbhūtādvayabrahmasvarūpaṃ prati sarvasya svargādeḥ kāmasyābhāvāt sarvakāmāvāntiśruteranupapannatvamāśaṅkya tāmapyupapādayati— sarveti | atrāpyavidyābhūmāveva karmaṇo yānyānkāmānāpnuvanti teṣu teṣu ya ānandāḥ, te “etasyaivānandasyānyāni bhūtāni mātrāmupajīvanti” iti śruteḥ brahmānanda eva |
analyzed: evam āvirbhūta advaya brahma svarūpam prati sarvasya svarga ādeḥ kāmasya abhāvāt sarva kāma avānti śruteḥ anupapanna tvam āśaṅkya tām api upapādayati sarva iti atra api avidyā bhūmau eva karmaṇaḥ yān yān kāmān āpnuvanti teṣu teṣu ye ānandāḥ te etasya eva ānandasya anyāni bhūtāni mātrām upajīvanti iti śruteḥ brahma ānandaḥ eva

original: ataśca brahma prāpto vidvān tatsarvānandānāmotīti “sarvānkāmānavāmoti” ityucyate | na tu svarūpeṇaiva sarvakāmānavāmotītyarthaḥ | etāmeva yojanāṃ śrutyantare'pyatidiśati— evamiti | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—yatheti | dṛṣṭāntāsiddhimāśaṅkya tatsādhayati—na hīti | dvitīyena hi krīḍā mithunībhāvaśca bhavati | na cādvayaṃ brahma prāptasya dvitīyamasti |
analyzed: atas ca brahma prāptaḥ vidvān tat sarva ānandān āmoti iti sarvān kāmān avāmoti iti ucyate na tu svarūpeṇa eva sarva kāmān avāmoti iti arthaḥ etām eva yojanām śruti antare pi atidiśati evam iti atra dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā iti dṛṣṭānta asiddhim āśaṅkya tat sādhayati na hi iti dvitīyena hi krīḍā mithunībhāvaḥ ca bhavati na ca advayam brahma prāptasya dvitīyam asti

original: tenātra yathā mithunībhāvānandaprāptyā “ātmamithunaḥ” ityuktam, tathā “ramamāṇaḥ strībhiḥ” ityādyapi yathoktanyāyena tadānandaprāptyoktamityarthaḥ | brahmaṇa eva yāni jñānādīnyanavacchinnāni tānyeva kalpitāvacchedāni bhūteṣu, nānyānītīmamarthaṃ gītayā draḍhayati—yataśceti |
analyzed: tena atra yathā mithunībhāva ānanda prāptyā ātma mithunaḥ iti uktam tathā ramamāṇaḥ strībhiḥ ityādi api yathā ukta nyāyena tad ānanda prāptyā uktam iti arthaḥ brahmaṇaḥ eva yāni jñāna ādīni anavacchinnāni tāni eva kalpita avacchedāni bhūteṣu na anyāni iti imam artham gītayā draḍhayati yatas ca iti

original: yata eva brahmaṇa eva jñānānandādīni yānyanavacchinnāni tānyevāvacchinnāni sarvabhūteṣu | ata eva yatra yatra bhūteṣu jñānādīnāṃ nātyantamavacchedaḥ alpībhāvaḥ, tāni vyāsādibhūtāni jñānādīnāṃ samutkarṣāt bhagavataḥ pratyāsannāni, bhagavān “munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāsaḥ” ityātmatvenoktvā “munīnām” ityādi yaduktaṃ tat “yadyadvibhūtimatsatvam”
analyzed: yatas eva brahmaṇaḥ eva jñāna ānanda ādīni yāni anavacchinnāni tāni eva avacchinnāni sarva bhūteṣu atas eva yatra yatra bhūteṣu jñāna ādīnām na atyantam avacchedaḥ alpībhāvaḥ tāni vyāsa ādi bhūtāni jñāna ādīnām samutkarṣāt bhagavataḥ pratyāsannāni bhagavān munīnām api aham vyāsaḥ iti ātmatvena uktvā munīnām ityādi yat uktam tat yat yat vibhūtimat satvam

original: ityupasaṃjaharityarthaḥ | paramātmajñānamevānavacchinnaṃ sat darśanādivyavahāraheturiti gamyata iti jñānaṃ prati viśeṣeṇāha—tatheti | tathā sarvabhūtadarśanaśravaṇādīnāṃ paramātmajñānanibandhanatvam “adṛṣṭaṃ draṣṭu” ityādiṣu śrutamityarthaḥ | evaṃ sarvajñatvādikamupapādya tatra matāntaramāha—anya iti |
analyzed: iti upasaṃjahar iti arthaḥ paramātma jñānam eva anavacchinnam sat darśana ādi vyavahāra hetuḥ iti gamyate iti jñānam prati viśeṣeṇa āha tathā iti tathā sarva bhūta darśana śravaṇa ādīnām paramātma jñāna nibandhana tvam adṛṣṭam draṣṭu ityādiṣu śrutam iti arthaḥ evam sarvajñatva ādikam upapādya tatra mata antaram āha anye iti

original: nāmarūpe śabdārthāvāśrayau yasya sa tathoktaḥ | dhyānamevādhyānam | tatra dṛṣṭāntamāha—yatheti | tadupapādayati—na hīti | svamahimapratiṣṭhasyeti | ādhārā- 17
analyzed: nāma rūpe śabda arthau āśrayau yasya sa tathā uktaḥ dhyānam eva adhyānam tatra dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā iti tat upapādayati na hi iti sva mahima pratiṣṭhasya iti ādhārāḥ

original: P.128-10 napekṣatvamāha | deśaviśeṣaḥ ādityamaṇḍalaṃ svarūpaṃ ca hiraṇyayādi | nanu parabrahmaṇa eva deśaviśeṣo rūpaṃ coktamiti kuto'yaṃ gamyata ityāha— para iti | śrutimāha—udita iti | pāpmaśabdena puṇyamapyucyate ; tena sarvebhyaḥ puṇyapāpebhya udita utkramyordhvaṃ vā gataḥ ; tairasaṃsṛṣṭa iti yāvat |
analyzed: āha deśa viśeṣaḥ āditya maṇḍalam sva rūpam ca hiraṇyaya ādi nanu para brahmaṇaḥ eva deśa viśeṣaḥ rūpam ca uktam iti kutas iyam gamyate iti āha paraḥ iti śrutim āha oditaḥ iti pāpma śabdena puṇyam api ucyate tena sarvebhyaḥ puṇya pāpebhyaḥ uditaḥ utkramya ūrdhvam vā gataḥ taiḥ asaṃsṛṣṭaḥ iti yāvat

original: puṇyapāpāsaṃsparśaśca “anyatra dharmāt” iti parasya śrutaḥ | tasmātparasyaivaiṣa deśaviśeṣo rūpaṃ ca śrutam | na ca te tasya vibhorarūpasya ca saṃbhavataḥ | tena dhyānaṃ tena rūpeṇa vidhīyate | tathā sarvajñatvādyapi draṣṭavyamiti |
analyzed: puṇya pāpa a saṃsparśaḥ ca anyatra dharmāt iti parasya śrutaḥ tasmāt parasya eva eṣa deśa viśeṣaḥ rūpam ca śrutam na ca te tasya vibhoḥ arūpasya ca saṃbhavataḥ tena dhyānam tena rūpeṇa vidhīyate tathā sarvajña tva ādi api draṣṭavyam iti

original: tadevaṃ svarūpāvirbhāvalakṣaṇe mokṣa mārgādiśrutīstadviśvārthāḥ tathā anyāśca prasaṅgāgatāḥ samādhāya tameva mokṣaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati— tadevamiti | brahmātmana iti ; brahmaiva ātmā yasya viduṣaḥ sa tathoktaḥ ; tadūpāvirbhāva ityarthaḥ | sā ca tatprāptirātmano jñānasvarūpatvādvidyaivetyāha—sā ceti |
analyzed: tat evam sva rūpa āvirbhāva lakṣaṇe mokṣa mārga ādi śrutīḥ tad viśva arthāḥ tathā anyāḥ ca prasaṅga āgatāḥ samādhāya tam eva mokṣam pratiṣṭhāpayati tat evam iti brahma ātmanaḥ iti brahma eva ātmā yasya viduṣaḥ sa tathā uktaḥ tad ūpa āvirbhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ sā ca tad prāptiḥ ātmanaḥ jñāna sva rūpa tvāt vidyā eva iti āha sā ca iti

original: evaṃ sthite ‘na sādhyo mokṣo na ca vidyāyā anyaḥ’ iti yaduktaṃ tadupasaṃharati—tasmāditi | matāntaramāśaṅkayati—atheti | ukte'rthe pramāṇamāha—śrūyata iti | nanu pāpmamātrasya vidyayā dāhaḥ śrutaḥ, na puṇyasya ; tadapi ca vandhahetuḥ | ato nāśeṣavandhakṣayaheturvidyetyāśaṅkyāha—pāpmeti | atra hetumāha—sāvadyeti |
analyzed: evam sthite na sādhyaḥ mokṣaḥ na ca vidyāyāḥ anyaḥ iti yat uktam tat upasaṃharati tasmāt iti mata antaram āśaṅkayati atha iti ukta arthe pramāṇam āha śrūyate iti nanu pāpma mātrasya vidyayā dāhaḥ śrutaḥ na puṇyasya tat api ca vandha hetuḥ atas na aśeṣa vandha kṣaya hetuḥ vidyā iti āśaṅkya āha pāpmā iti atra hetum āha sāvadya iti

original: sāvadyaṃ sadoṣaṃ phalaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ | doṣaśca saṃsārānuvandhitvaṃ patanādiheyavatvaṃ ca | pāpmaśabdena puṇyamapyucyata ityatrārthe hetvantaramāha—anyatreti | sukṛtaduṣkṛtopakramaḥ pāpmaśabdastatra dvayorapi tathorvartate yata ityarthaḥ | yadi ca karmakṣayamantareṇa mokṣaḥ syāt tato nāsau sādhyeta ; na caitadastītyāha—na ceti |
analyzed: sāvadyam sa doṣam phalam yasya iti vigrahaḥ doṣaḥ ca saṃsāra anuvandhi tvam patana ādi heyavatvam ca pāpma śabdena puṇyam api ucyate iti atra arthe hetu antaram āha anyatra iti sukṛta duṣkṛta upakramaḥ pāpma śabdaḥ tatra dvayoḥ api tathoḥ vartate yatas iti arthaḥ yadi ca karma kṣayam antareṇa mokṣaḥ syāt tatas na asau sādhyeta na ca etat asti iti āha na ca iti

original: phalaikavināśyatvāt karmaṇo nādattaphalasya nivṛttiḥ ; ataḥ kathaṃ vidyayā tatkṣaya ityāśaṅkyāha—prāyaścittānāmiti | govadhādidoṣasaṃyogena prāyaścittānyāgnāyante ; na ca tannimittamātramityuktam | ato doṣakṣayahetutvameṣāṃ gamyate | tena prāyaścittenādattaphalameva pāpaṃ karma kṣīyate | tathā vidyayā vandhahetukarmakṣaya ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: phala eka vināśya tvāt karmaṇaḥ na adatta phalasya nivṛttiḥ atas katham vidyayā tad kṣayaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha prāyaścittānām iti go vadha ādi doṣa saṃyogena prāyaścittāni āgnāyante na ca tad nimitta mātram iti uktam atas doṣa kṣaya hetu tvam eṣām gamyate tena prāyaścittena adatta phalam eva pāpam karma kṣīyate tathā vidyayā vandha hetu karma kṣayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu vandhahetukarmakṣayaścet vidyāsādhyo na tārhe vidyāto muktirityāśaṅkyāha—saiveti | evaṃ ca svarūpāvirbhāvo mokṣa ityapi pratyuktam |
analyzed: nanu vandha hetu karma kṣayaḥ ced vidyā sādhyaḥ na tārhe vidyātaḥ muktiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha sā eva iti evam ca svarūpa āvirbhāvaḥ mokṣaḥ iti api pratyuktam

original: nanu karmakṣayasya vidyākāryatve kāryatvāt ghaṭavat antavaccaṃ syāt ; ataśca punaḥ karmaprādurbhāvāt muktasya punarbandhaḥ syādityāśaṅkyāha—evamiti | na hi ghaṭadhvaṃso vināśī, ghaṭasya punaḥ prādurbhāvādarśanāditi bhāvaḥ | P. 129-5 - evaṃ paramatamupanyasya dūṣayati—tatreti | prāyaścitte yā nyāyadik tayā |
analyzed: nanu karma kṣayasya vidyā kārya tve kārya tvāt ghaṭa vat antavat cam syāt atas ca punar karma prādurbhāvāt muktasya punar bandhaḥ syāt iti āśaṅkya āha evam iti na hi ghaṭa dhvaṃsaḥ vināśī ghaṭasya punar prādurbhāva adarśanāt iti bhāvaḥ evam para matam upanyasya dūṣayati tatra iti prāyaścitte yā nyāya diś tayā

original: bandhahetoḥ karmaṇa ucchedaḥ kṣayo na bhavati ; yataḥ sarvāvidyāpravilaye chedyaṃ karma nāvaśiṣyata iti | tatra hetumāha—bandheti | bandhahetuḥ karma avidyopādānatvāt avidyātvabhāvam | tatra vidyāyāṃ satyāmavidyā kātsnyena praṇaṣṭā | tenāvidyānivṛttyaiva tadātmabandhaheturapi nivṛtta iti na pṛthak chedyamavaśiṣyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: bandha hetoḥ karmaṇaḥ ucchedaḥ kṣayaḥ na bhavati yatas sarva avidyā pravilaye chedyam karma na avaśiṣyate iti tatra hetum āha bandha iti bandha hetuḥ karma avidyā upādāna tvāt avidyā tva bhāvam tatra vidyāyām satyām avidyā kātsnyena praṇaṣṭā tena avidyā nivṛttyā eva tad ātma bandha hetuḥ api nivṛttaḥ iti na pṛthak chedyam avaśiṣyate iti arthaḥ

original: vidyotpattirevāvidyātmakabandhahetunivṛttiḥ | ato na sā tatsādhyeti bhāvaḥ | vṛttiḥ spaṣṭārthā | avidyocchedena karmocchede liṅgaṃ darśayati—yataśceti | avidyocchedena ucchidyamānābhyāṃ saṃśayaviparyayābhyāṃ saha karmaṇām “bhidyate hṛdayagranthiḥ” ityatra saṃkhyānamavidyocchedena teṣāmucchedaṃ sūcayatītyarthaḥ | hṛdayagranthirviparyayo'bhipretaḥ |
analyzed: vidyā utpattiḥ eva avidyā ātmaka bandha hetu nivṛttiḥ atas na sā tad sādhyā iti bhāvaḥ vṛttiḥ spaṣṭa arthā avidyā ucchedena karma ucchede liṅgam darśayati yatas ca iti avidyā ucchedena ucchidyamānābhyām saṃśaya viparyayābhyām saha karmaṇām bhidyate hṛdaya granthiḥ iti atra saṃkhyānam avidyā ucchedena teṣām ucchedam sūcayati iti arthaḥ hṛdayagranthiḥ viparyayaḥ abhipretaḥ

original: atra codayati—nanviti | atra doṣamāha—tasyeti | utpannajñānasya tāvadeva ciraṃ kālavilambo yāvad dehena vimokṣyate | chāndasastakāralopaḥ | atha dehavimokṣānantaraṃ brahma saṃpatsyata ityarthaḥ | kasya nāmeyaṃ śrutirna bādhyate ityatrāha—yasyeti |
analyzed: atra codayati nanu iti atra doṣam āhatasya iti utpanna jñānasya tāvat eva ciram kāla vilambaḥ yāvat dehena vimokṣyate chāndasaḥ takāra lopaḥ atha deha vimokṣa anantaram brahma saṃpatsyate iti arthaḥ kasya nāma iyam śrutiḥ na bādhyate iti atra āha yasya iti

original: yasya karmakṣayaheturvidyā śāstrāt gamyate, tasya śāstrānusāreṇa keṣāṃcitkarmaṇāṃ vidyayā kṣayaḥ, keṣāṃcidupabhogeneti vyavasthopapadyata ityarthaḥ | śāstrānusāramāha—tatreti ; tasmin pakṣa ityarthaḥ | tata iti ; vidyāta ityarthaḥ | aviśeṣeṇotsargato vidyayā sarvakarmakṣayaprāptau sa mukterdehapātāvaṣitvaśrutyāpodyata ityatra hetumāha—na hīti |
analyzed: yasya karma kṣaya hetuḥ vidyā śāstrāt gamyate tasya śāstra anusāreṇa keṣāṃcid karmaṇām vidyayā kṣayaḥ keṣāṃcid upabhogena iti vyavasthā upapadyate iti arthaḥ śāstra anusāram āha tatra iti tasmin pakṣe iti arthaḥ tatas iti vidyātaḥ iti arthaḥ aviśeṣeṇa utsargataḥ vidyayā sarva karma kṣaya prāptau sa mukteḥ dehapātau aṣitva śrutyā apodyate iti atra hetum āha na hi iti

original: sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ vidyayā kṣaye vidyodayānantarameva muktiḥ syāt ; ato dehapātapratīkṣā nopapadyeta ; śrūyate cāsau | ataḥ keṣāṃcit karmaṇāṃ bhogena kṣaya iti gamyata ityarthaḥ | ācāryajuṣṭaśrāyaṃ mārga ityāha—taduktamiti | anārabdhakārya apradattaphale vartamānadehānārambhake puṇyapāpe pūrvopāse vidyayā kṣayapitvā, 17A
analyzed: sarveṣām karmaṇām vidyā kṣaya vidyā udaya anantara eva muktiḥ syāt atas dehapāta pratīkṣā na upapadyeta śrūyate ca asau atas keṣāṃcid karmaṇām bhoga kṣaya iti gamyate iti arthaḥ ācārya juṣ śra ayam mārga iti āha tad ukta iti anārabdha kārya apradatta phala vartamāna deha anārambhaka puṇya pāpa pūrva upāsā vidyā

original: itare tu ārabdhakārye tadavadhermukterdehapātāvadhiśruterbhegena kṣapayitvā brahma saṃpadyata iti sūtrārthaḥ | yasya tu karmaphalavyavahāraṃ dṛṣṭenaiva vidyocchinatti, tasya vidyayā sarvāvidyocchintāvaviśeṣeṇa sarvakarmocchedādanantarameva mucyeta; ataśca P.130-6. dehapātāvadhiśrutirbādhyetetyāha—vidyayeti | tatpariharati—naiṣa iti |
analyzed: itare tu ārabdha kārye tad avadheḥ mukteḥ dehapāta avadhi śruteḥ bhegena kṣapayitvā brahma saṃpadyate iti sūtra arthaḥ yasya tu karma phala vyavahāram dṛṣṭena eva vidyā ucchinatti tasya vidyayā sarva avidyā ucchintau aviśeṣeṇa sarva karma ucchedāt anantaram eva mucyeta atas ca dehapāta avadhi śrutiḥ bādhyeta iti āha vidyayā iti tat pariharati na eṣa iti

original: eṣa dehapātāvadhiśrutivādhadoṣo nāstītyarthaḥ | tatra hetumāha—na hīti | yadīyaṃ śrutirdehapātāvadhi cirakālatāviśiṣṭatvaṃ ca mukterbrūyāt, tataḥ syādeṣa doṣaḥ; na tvedastītyarthaḥ | kiṃ nāmāhetyapekṣāyāmāha—kiṃ tviti | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—yatheti |
analyzed: eṣa dehapāta avadhi śruti vādha doṣaḥ na asti iti arthaḥ tatra hetum āha na hi iti yadi iyam śrutiḥ dehapāta avadhi cirakālatā viśiṣṭatvam ca mukteḥ brūyāt tatas syāt eṣa doṣaḥ na tvā id asti iti arthaḥ kim nāma āha iti apekṣāyām āha kim tu iti atra dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā iti

original: yathā kaścit 'kṣiprataraṃ gaccha' iti niyuktaḥ kṣiprataratvaṃ pratipādayannāha—'tāvadeva me ciraṃ yat snāto bhuñjānasya upānahau vā kramamāṇasyāśvaṃ vārohataḥ' iti, tathaivamapītyarthaḥ | yadi tu ciratvamātraṃ śrutau vivakṣitaṃ syāt tataściramityeva brūyāt, na tu tāvadevetyavadhiviśeṣam |
analyzed: yathā kaścid kṣiprataram gaccha iti niyuktaḥ kṣipratara tvam pratipādayan āha tāvat eva me ciram yat snātaḥ bhuñjānasya upānahau vā kramamāṇasya aśvam vā ārohataḥ iti tathā evam api iti arthaḥ yadi tu ciratva mātram śrutau vivakṣitam syāt tatas ciram iti eva brūyāt na tu tāvat eva iti avadhi viśeṣam

original: dehapātāvadhiṃ tu darśayantyāḥ śruterayamabhiprāyaḥ—yadavidyājena dehena vidyayā avidyānivṛttāvanantarameva patitavyam, ataḥ kṣiprameva muktiriti | evaṃ kṣepyūparatā śruterlakṣyata ityāha—anyatheti | upasaṃharati—ata iti | na pratīkṣaṇīyamiti; bhogenārabdhakarmakṣapaṇaṃ na pratīkṣaṇīyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: dehapāta avadhim tu darśayantyāḥ śruteḥ ayam abhiprāyaḥ yat avidyā jena dehena vidyayā avidyā nivṛttau anantaram eva patitavyam atas kṣipram eva muktiḥ iti evam kṣepya upara tā śruteḥ lakṣyate iti āha anyathā iti upasaṃharati atas iti na pratīkṣaṇīyam iti bhogena ārabdha karma kṣapaṇam na pratīkṣaṇīyam iti arthaḥ

original: yadā cānantarameva muktiḥ, tadā dehapātamantareṇa tadasaṃbhavānnāntarīyakatvādehapāto'pyanantaraṃ bhavatyevetyāha—deheti | asyāstāvacchruterarthāntaramāha—athaveti | ubhayavidhau doṣamāha— anyatheti | tadevaṃ sati yaḥ śruterarthaḥ saṃpadyate tamāha—tatreti | anyataḥ prāpta kasyacinmukteściratvamanūdya dehavimokṣaṇamavadhirvidhīyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yadā ca anantaram eva muktiḥ tadā dehapātam antareṇa tad asaṃbhavāt nāntarīyaka tvāt dehapātaḥ api anantaram bhavati eva iti āha deha iti asyāḥ tāvat śruteḥ artha antaram āha athavā iti ubhaya vidhau doṣam āha anyathā iti tat evam sati yaḥ śruteḥ arthaḥ saṃpadyate tam āha tatra iti anyatas kasyacid mukteḥ ciratvam anūdya deha vimokṣaṇam avadhiḥ vidhīyate iti arthaḥ

original: tatra pūrvasmin śrutyarthaṃ codayati—nanviti | vidyodayānantaraṃ muktau sthitaḥ prājñaḥ patitadehatvānnāstyeva; kasya lakṣaṇamucyate? ityarthaḥ | dvitīye'pi śrutyarthaṃ codayati—dvitīye'pīti | vidyātaḥ sarvakarmakṣaye karmajasya śarīrasyānantarameva pātāla kasyacinmukteściratvamasti; ato na tadanuvādenāvadhiviśeṣavidhānamupapadyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatra pūrvasmin śruti artham codayati nanu iti vidyā udaya anantaram muktau sthitaḥ prājñaḥ patita deha tvāt na asti eva kasya lakṣaṇam ucyate iti arthaḥ dvitīye api śruti artham codayati dvitīye api iti vidyātaḥ sarva karma kṣaye karma jasya śarīrasya anantaram eva pātāla kasyacid mukteḥ ciratvam asti atas na tad anuvādena avadhi viśeṣa vidhānam upapadyate iti arthaḥ

original: tatrāsyaṃ codyaṃ tāvatpariharati—ucyata iti | vigalitāyāṃ nikhilāyāmavidyāyāṃ siddhaḥ, vigalita^1^
analyzed: tatra āsyam codyam tāvat pariharati ucyate iti vigalitāyām nikhilāyām avidyāyām siddhaḥ vigalita

original: nikhilā avidyā yasyāṃ vidyāyāṃ tayā vā siddho vigalitanikhilāvidyāsiddhaḥ | yo yogābhyāsaparipākādutpannādvayātmasākṣātkāraprakāśo'nantarameva mucyate, na sa sthitaprajñaḥ; kiñcadvayātmasākṣātkāraprakārasya sādhaka evāvasthāviśeṣaṃ prāptaḥ siddheḥ kiñcidarvācīnāyāmavasthāyāṃ vartamāno yaḥ siddhabhrāyo nādyāpi sidhyati sa sthitaprajñaḥ |
analyzed: nikhilā avidyā yasyām vidyāyām tayā vā siddhaḥ vigalita nikhila avidyā siddhaḥ yaḥ yoga abhyāsa paripākāt utpannāt vaya ātma sākṣātkāra prakāśaḥ anantaram eva mucyate na sa sthita prajñaḥ kiñca dvaya ātma sākṣātkāra prakārasya sādhakaḥ eva avasthā viśeṣam prāptaḥ siddheḥ kiñcid arvācīnāyām avasthāyām vartamānaḥ yaḥ siddha bhrāyaḥ na adya api sidhyati sa sthita prajñaḥ

original: tasya cāpratitadehasya lakṣaṇābhidhānaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | dvitīyaṃ codyaṃ pariharati—na ceti | ārabdha- P.130-21 kāryakarmānapekṣaṇe yastidhyati, tadāha—tatreti | bhogena karmakṣayāpekṣāyāṃ sarvasya cireṇaivāpavargaḥ | tadanapekṣāyāṃ ca kasyacittatkālaḥ, kasyaciccireṇa; yasya cireṇa tasya ciratvamanūdyāvadhiviśeṣavidhānamupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tasya ca apratita dehasya lakṣaṇa abhidhānam yuktam iti arthaḥ dvitīyam codyam pariharati na ca iti ārabdha kārya karma anapekṣaṇe yaḥ tidhyati tat āha tatra iti bhogena karma kṣaya apekṣāyām sarvasya cireṇa eva apavargaḥ tad anapekṣāyām ca kasyacid tad kālaḥ kasyacid cireṇa yasya cireṇa tasya ciratvam anūdya avadhi viśeṣa vidhānam upapadyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu yadāpyārabdhakāryakarmakṣayaṃ bhogena na pratīkṣate, tadāpi vidyayā avidyājñakṛtsnakarmanivṛttau tajjanyadehasyānantarameva viyogaḥ; ataḥ kathaṃ kasyacit cirakālo'pavarga ityāśaṅkyāha—yatheti | tatsaṃskārāditi; tacchabdena bhayaṃ kampādi cocyate |
analyzed: nanu yadā api ārabdha kārya karma kṣayam bhogena na pratīkṣate tadā api vidyayā avidyā jña kṛtsna karma nivṛttau tad janya dehasya anantaram eva viyogaḥ atas katham kasyacid cira kāla upavargaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha yathā iti tad saṃskārāt iti tad śabdena bhayam kampa ādi ca ucyate

original: bhujyamāne vipakve prārabdhakāryasya karmaṇaḥ phale 'ahaṃ śarīrī bhoktā, idaṃ bhogyam' iti yaḥ saṃskāro jātaḥ, tasyānuvṛttiḥ, tannibandhanetyarthaḥ | saṃskārātkāryānuvṛttau dṛṣṭāntamāha— kulaleti | atra codayati—nanviti | tatra ca doṣamāha—tathāceti |
analyzed: bhujyamāne vipakve prārabdha kāryasya karmaṇaḥ phale aham śarīrī bhoktā idam bhogyam iti yaḥ saṃskāraḥ jātaḥ tasya anuvṛttiḥ tad nibandhanā iti arthaḥ saṃskārāt kārya anuvṛttau dṛṣṭāntam āha kulala iti atra codayati nanu iti tatra ca doṣam āha tathā ca iti

original: athaitaddoṣabhayāt bhoktādivibhāgadarśanasyāvidyāhetukasya vidyayā avidyocchedādananuvṛttirityucyate, tadā kṣaṇamapi na bhoktādivibhāgadarśanaṃ syāditi sa eva dehapātāvadhiśrutivirodhaḥ | saiṣā ubhayato doṣādubhayataḥspāśā rajjurityupamayocyata ityāha—atheti | tatrānanuvṛttipakṣamanabhyupagamyaivānuvṛttipakṣoktadoṣaṃ pariharati—ucyata iti |
analyzed: atha etad doṣa bhayāt bhokta ādi vibhāga darśanasya avidyā hetukasya vidyayā avidyā ucchedāt ananuvṛttiḥ iti ucyate tadā kṣaṇam api na bhokta ādi vibhāga darśanam syāt iti saḥ eva dehapāta avadhi śruti virodhaḥ sā eṣā ubhayatas doṣāt ubhayatas spāśā rajjuḥ iti upamayā ucyate iti āha atha iti tatra ananuvṛtti pakṣam an abhyupagamya eva anuvṛtti pakṣa ukta doṣam pariharati ucyate iti

original: na ca mūlakāraṇeti | mūlakāraṇaṃ bhayaṃ tato yathā kampādi sābhiniveśaṃ prabalataraṃ tathā tatsaṃskārādityarthaḥ | etacca yathā karmaṇo mūlakāraṇasya phalaṃ sābhiniveśaṃ na tathā tatsaṃskāraphalamiti vakṣyamāṇaviśeṣopayogitayoktam | tata eveti; rajjutvadarśanādevetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: na ca mūla kāraṇa iti mūla kāraṇam bhayam tatas yathā kampa ādi sa abhiniveśam prabalataram tathā tad saṃskārāt iti arthaḥ etat ca yathā karmaṇaḥ mūla kāraṇasya phalam sa abhiniveśam na tathā tad saṃskāra phalam iti vakṣyamāṇa viśeṣa upayogi tayā uktam tatas eva iti rajju tva darśanāt eva iti arthaḥ

original: nanu kṣaṇikaṃ tat, ataḥ kathaṃ krameṇa nivṛttiḥ? ucyate—yathā yāgādeḥ kṣaṇikādapūrvādhānadvāreṇa phalasiddhiḥ, tathā tattvadarśanādapi saṃskārādhānadvāreṇa bhayasaṃskāranivṛttirityadoṣaḥ | svayameva
analyzed: nanu kṣaṇikam tat atas katham krameṇa nivṛttiḥ ucyate yathā yāga ādeḥ kṣaṇikāt apūrva ādhāna dvāreṇa phala siddhiḥ tathā tattva darśanāt api saṃskāra ādhāna dvāreṇa bhaya saṃskāra nivṛttiḥ iti adoṣaḥ svayam eva

original: vetyatra cakrabhramaṇasaṃskāro dṛṣṭāntaḥ | etacca sarvaṃ 'na ca bhayavigame'pyanuvṛttirityetāvatā cirakālā bhavati' ityetadupayogitayoktam | svayaṃ betyatra krameṇetyanuvartate | nanu kṣaṇikasya sahetuko nāśo dṛṣṭaḥ ; tatkathaṃ svayamityucyate ; cakrasaṃskāro'pi phalavināśyeva |
analyzed: vā ityatra cakra bhramaṇa saṃskāraḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ etat ca sarvam na ca bhaya vigame api anuvṛttiḥ iti etāvatā cira kālā bhavati iti etat upayogi tayā uktam svayam bā iti atra krameṇa iti anuvartate nanu kṣaṇikasya sa hetukaḥ nāśaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tat katham svayam iti ucyate cakra saṃskāraḥ api phala vināśī eva

original: atha karabhūbhāgādisparśavadvyasaṃyogādvā naśyatītyasiddho dṛṣṭāntaḥ | ucyate—ko vā brūte na sahetuka iti ? kāla eva heturbhaviṣyati ; ata eva krameṇetyuktam | dṛṣṭaṃ ca kālasyāpi sūtakadoṣādivināśakatvam | tathehāpi bhaviṣyati | kathaṃ tarhi svayamityuktam ? prayatnāntarānapekṣamātravivakṣayoktamityadoṣaḥ |
analyzed: atha kara bhū bhāga ādi sparśavat vyasaṃyogāt vā naśyati iti asiddhaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ ucyate kaḥ vā brūte na sa hetukaḥ iti kālaḥ eva hetuḥ bhaviṣyati atas eva krameṇa iti uktam dṛṣṭam ca kālasya api sūtaka doṣa ādi vināśaka tvam tathā iha api bhaviṣyati katham tarhi svayam iti uktam prayatna antara anapekṣa mātra vivakṣayā uktam iti adoṣaḥ

original: evaṃ P.131-16 dṛṣṭāntaṃ prasādhya dārṣṭāntike yojayati—tatheti | karmasu cārabdhakāryeṣvanārabdhakāryeṣvityatra 'nivṛttāyām' iti liṅgavacanavyatyayena 'nivṛtteṣu' iti kṛtvā yojyam | rūḍhābhiniveśa iti ; rūḍhaḥ prādurbhūto'bhiniveśaḥ āsthātiśayo yasyeti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: evam dṛṣṭāntam prasādhya dārṣṭāntike yojayati tathā iti karmasu ca ārabdha kāryeṣu anārabdha kāryeṣu iti atra nivṛttāyām iti liṅga vacana vyatyayena nivṛtteṣu iti kṛtvā yojyam rūḍha abhiniveśaḥ iti rūḍhaḥ prādurbhūta ubhiniveśaḥ āsthā atiśayaḥ yasya iti vigrahaḥ

original: tenāyamarthaḥ—vidyayā avidyāyāṃ karmasu cāviśeṣādārabdhānārabdhakāryeṣu nivṛtteṣu ārabdho bhujyamāno vipākaḥ prārabdhakāryasya karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ tatsaṃskārāt vidvānāṃ śarīriṇaṃ bhoktāraṃ cātmānamābhāsamātreṇa āsthāvikalaṃ pratyeti | na tvavidvānivāsthātiśayopetamiti |
analyzed: tena ayam arthaḥ vidyayā avidyāyām karmasu ca aviśeṣāt ārabdha anārabdha kāryeṣu nivṛtteṣu ārabdhaḥ bhujyamānaḥ vipākaḥ prārabdha kāryasya karmaṇaḥ phalam tad saṃskārāt vidvānām śarīriṇam bhoktāram ca ātmānam ābhāsa mātreṇa āsthā vikalam pratyeti na tu avidvān iva āsthā atiśaya upetam iti

original: etaduktaṃ bhavati—yatprārabdhaphalaṃ karma, tasminnivṛtte'pi tatphale bhujyamāne yaḥ śarīritvādisaṃskāra udbhūtaḥ, tenottarakālamapi śarīriṇaṃ bhoktāramiva cātmānaṃ manyata iti | atrāntare vivakṣitamarthamasamāpyaiva sthitaprajñalakṣaṇābhidhānopapattaye sthitaprajñasvarūpaṃ tāvadāha—sa cāyamiti |
