original: pūrvaṃ sādhakaḥ sthitaprajña uktaḥ, adhunā siddha eveti viśeṣaḥ | tasya ca "prajñahāti yadā kāmān" "ātmanyevātmanā tuṣṭaḥ" "duḥkheṣvanuddhimanāḥ" ityādilakṣaṇaṃ saṃpādayitumāha—vigateti | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—yatheti | uktamarthaṃ dārṣṭāntike yojayati—tatheti | kṣāṇā karmakṛtā avidyā yasya, kṣaṇi vā karmāvidye yasyeti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: pūrvam sādhakaḥ sthita prajñaḥ uktaḥ adhunā siddhaḥ eva iti viśeṣaḥ tasya ca yadā kāmān ātmani eva ātmanā tuṣṭaḥ duḥkheṣu anuddhi manāḥ ityādi lakṣaṇam saṃpādayitum āha vigata iti atra dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā iti uktam artham dārṣṭāntike yojayati tathā iti kṣāṇā karma kṛtā avidyā yasya kṣaṇi vā karma avidye yasya iti vigrahaḥ

original: tatsaṃskārāditi tacchabdena karma parāmṛśyate ; dvitīye'pi vigrahe karmāvidye ; tadā cāvidyāsaṃskāro'pi sūcita iti mantavyam | chāyāmātreṇetyabhiniveśavaikalyaṃ darśayati | viduṣaḥ śarīrādiṣvidyamabhiniveśavaikalyaṃ śrutyā draḍhayati—tathā ceti | ahinirvayanī ahestvak, sā yathā pratyastā
analyzed: tad saṃskārāt iti tad śabdena karma parāmṛśyate dvitīye api vigrahe karma avidye tadā ca avidyā saṃskāraḥ api sūcitaḥ iti mantavyam chāyā mātreṇa iti abhiniveśa vaikalyam darśayati viduṣaḥ śarīra ādiṣu idyam abhiniveśa vaikalyam śrutyā draḍhayati tathā ca iti ahi nirvayanī aheḥ tvac sā yathā pratyastā

original: pratikṣiptā tyaktā satī ahaṃmānaśūnyatayā sā vikalā śeta iva, tathā viduṣaḥ saṃskāramātrānuvarti śarīramityarthaḥ | kimiti punaḥ karmeva śarīre saṃskāravartinyapyāsthā na syādityāśaṅkyāha—yata iti | atulyatvaṃ ca P. 132-3. duśmitaṃ bhayasaṃskāre |
analyzed: pratikṣiptā tyaktā satī ahaṃmāna śūnya tayā sā vikalā śete iva tathā viduṣaḥ saṃskāra mātra anuvarti śarīram iti arthaḥ kim iti punar karma iva śarīre saṃskāra vartini api āsthā na syāt iti āśaṅkya āha yatas iti atulya tvam ca duśmitam bhaya saṃskāre

original: idānīṃ saṃskārāccedbhoktādivibhāgadarśanamanuvartate, dehapātāduttarakāle'pyanuvartateti yaduktaṃ tatpariharati—kampādīti | atra hetumāha—alpeti | nanu saṃskāraścedanuvartate tannivṛttaye hetvantaramupāsyam, na ca viduṣastadastītyāśaṅkyāha—tadvadeveti | “tatra tasyeva” iti saptamīsamarthādvatiḥ |
analyzed: idānīm saṃskārāt ced bhoktā ādi vibhāga darśanam anuvartate dehapātāt uttara kāle api anuvartata iti yat uktam tat pariharati kampa ādi iti atra hetum āha alpa iti nanu saṃskāraḥ ced anuvartate tad nivṛttaye hetu antaram upāsyam na ca viduṣaḥ tat asti iti āśaṅkya āha tadvat eva iti tatra tasya iva iti saptamī samarthāt vatiḥ

original: tatra kampādī yathā saṃskāranivṛttaye na hetvantaramapekṣyate, tathātrāpītyarthaḥ | idānīmanenaiva prasaṅgena jīvanmuktimapi darśayati—sā ceti | saṃskārakṣayaḥ kathamavagamyata iti cet ata āha—prārabdheti | nanu kvacidbujyamānavipākasaṃskāra ityucyate, kvacitkarmasaṃskāra iti ;
analyzed: tatra kampa ādī yathā saṃskāra nivṛttaye na hetu antaram apekṣyate tathā atra api iti arthaḥ idānīm anena eva prasaṅgena jīvanmuktim api darśayati sā ca iti saṃskāra kṣayaḥ katham avagamyate iti ced atas āha prārabdha iti nanu kvacid bujyamāna vipāka saṃskāraḥ iti ucyate kvacid karma saṃskāraḥ iti

original: kimidaṃ viplutābhidhānam ? na viplutam, pakṣadvayasyāpi vikalpeneṣṭatvāt; tathā ca vakṣyati—labdhavṛttikāraṇasaṃskārādvā kāryaśeṣaḥ, kāryasaṃskārādeva veti | yadvā tatrāpi bhujyamāno vipāko yasya saḥ, tathā prārabdho vipāko yasyeti ca bahuvrīhiṇā prārabdhakāryaṃ karmavocyata ityavirodhaḥ | kathamityāha—taditi |
analyzed: kim idam vipluta abhidhānam na viplutam pakṣa dvayasya api vikalpena iṣṭa tvāt tathā ca vakṣyati labdha vṛtti kāraṇa saṃskārāt vā kārya śeṣaḥ kārya saṃskārāt eva vā iti yat vā tatra api bhujyamānaḥ vipākaḥ yasya saḥ tathā prārabdhaḥ vipākaḥ yasya iti ca bahuvrīhiṇā prārabdha kāryam karma vā ucyate iti avirodhaḥ katham iti āha tat iti

original: tadaiva dehapāte prārabdhakāryakarmasaṃskārasya kṣīṇatvāt tannimittasya karmaphalasya vipākābhāsamātreṇāpi dehapātottarakāle darśanaṃ na śakyata ityāha—itīti | itiśabdo hetvarthaḥ kākākṣivadubhayatra saṃbadhyate | prārabdhakāryakarmasaṃskārakṣaye liṅgamuktam | upapattirucyate—yena hīti |
analyzed: tadā eva dehapāte prārabdha kārya karma saṃskārasya kṣīṇa tvāt tad nimittasya karma phalasya vipāka ābhāsa mātreṇa api dehapāta uttara kāle darśanam na śakyate iti āha eti iti iti śabdaḥ hetu arthaḥ kāka akṣi vat ubhayatra saṃbadhyate prārabdha kārya karma saṃskāra kṣaye liṅgam uktam upapattiḥ ucyate yena hi iti

original: yena karmaṇā yaccharīramārabdham, tatraiva tatphalaṃ dadāti, nānyatra | yatra ca tatphalaṃ dadāti, tatraiva saṃskārādapi tatphalaśeṣābhāsatā yuktetyarthaḥ | nanu yathā nivṛtte'pyārabdhaphale karmaṇi tatsaṃskāro'nuvartate, tathā anārabdhaphalānāmapi karmaṇāṃ saṃskāraḥ kasmānnānuvartate ? tadanuvṛttau ca dīrghaḥ saṃskāraḥ syāt;
analyzed: yena karmaṇā yat śarīram ārabdham tatra eva tad phalam dadāti na anyatra yatra ca tat phalam dadāti tatra eva saṃskārāt api tad phala śeṣa ābhāsa tā yuktā iti arthaḥ nanu yathā nivṛtte api ārabdha phale karmaṇi tad saṃskāraḥ nuvartate tathā anārabdha phalānām api karmaṇām saṃskāraḥ kasmāt na anuvartate tad anuvṛttau ca dīrghaḥ saṃskāraḥ syāt

original: ataḥ sa eva dehapātāvadhiśrutivirodha ityāśaṅkyāha—anārabdheti | atra hetumāha—labdheti; labdhā kāryāya vṛttirbyāpāro yena tat tathoktam | etat dṛṣṭāntena sādhayati—na svalpiti | alabdhavṛttau ata evānupajanitakampādī iti hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ | na labdhā vṛttiryena,
analyzed: atas saḥ eva dehapāta avadhi śruti virodhaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha anārabdha iti atra hetum āha labdha iti labdhā kāryāya vṛttiḥ byāpāraḥ yena tat tathā uktam etat dṛṣṭāntena sādhayati na alabdha vṛttau atas eva anupajanita kampa ādī iti hetu hetumat bhāvaḥ na labdhā vṛttiḥ yena

original: anupajanitaṃ kampādi yeneti vigrahaḥ ; bhayamanyapadārthaḥ | prakṛtamupasaṃharati— P.132-12 tasmāditi | etena ‘nanu brahmavido'pi cet’ ityādinā ‘nāvaśyaṃbhāvi kaivalyaṃ syāt’ ityantena yaccoditaṃ tatparihṛtam | idānīṃ sarvathābhimatasiddheḥ saṃskāraviśeṣāvadhāraṇaṃ pratyanādaraṃ darśayati—atra ceti | kāraṇaṃ karma, kāryaṃ ca tatphalam ;
analyzed: anupajanitam kampa ādi yena iti vigrahaḥ bhayam anya padārthaḥ prakṛtam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti etena nanu brahma vidaḥ api ced ityādinā na avaśyaṃbhāvi kaivalyam syāt iti antena yat coditam tat parihṛtam idānīm sarvathā abhimata siddheḥ saṃskāra viśeṣa avadhāraṇam prati anādaram darśayati atra ca iti kāraṇam karma kāryam ca tad phalam

original: tena labdhavṛtteḥ prārabdhakāryasya karmaṇaḥ saṃskārāt tatkāryasaṃskārādvā viduṣo'pi kāryaśeṣo'nuvartata ityarthaḥ | tathā dṛṣṭānte'pyeṣaiva digiti darśayati—tatheti | tasmātsaṃskāraviśeṣo nādriyata ityapekṣāyāmāha—sarvatheti | kāraṇamatra bhayam ; kāryaśeṣaḥ saṃskārajakampādiḥ | prakṛtamupasaṃharati—ata iti |
analyzed: tena labdha vṛtteḥ prārabdha kāryasya karmaṇaḥ saṃskārāt tad kārya saṃskārāt vā viduṣaḥ api kārya śeṣaḥ nuvartate iti arthaḥ tathā dṛṣṭānte api eṣā eva diś iti darśayati tathā iti tasmāt saṃskāra viśeṣaḥ na ādriyate iti apekṣāyām āha sarvathā iti kāraṇam atra bhayam kārya śeṣaḥ saṃskāra ja kampa ādiḥ prakṛtam upasaṃharati atas iti

original: tena na dehapātāvadhiśrutivirodha iti bhāvaḥ | ‘etena kṣaṇamapi na syāt’ iti yaccoditaṃ tadapi parihṛtam | idameva svapakṣaṃ kāpilatantrasiddhatvena draḍhayati—taduktamiti | pravṛttabhogānāṃ karmaṇāṃ pravṛttavegasyeveṣośraktasyeva vānyena vidyayā pratibandho'śakyaḥ ;
analyzed: tena na dehapāta avadhi śruti virodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ etena kṣaṇam api na syāt iti yat coditam tat api parihṛtam idam eva sva pakṣam kāpila tantra siddha tvena draḍhayati tat uktam iti pravṛtta bhogānām karmaṇām pravṛtta vegasya iva iṣoḥ śraktasya iva vā anyena vidyayā pratibandhaḥ śakyaḥ

original: ato bhogena teṣāṃ kṣayapratīkṣeti sūktaṃ “bhogena tvitare kṣapayitvā” iti bhagavatpādīyamatamupanyasyati—ye tviti | taddūṣayati— taditi | pravṛttavego'pīṣuḥ kubjādibhiḥ pratibandhu śakyaḥ ; ato dṛṣṭānta evāsiddhaḥ |
analyzed: atas bhogena teṣām kṣaya pratīkṣā iti sūktam bhogena tu itare kṣapayitvā iti bhagavat pādīya matam upanyasyati ye tu iti tat dūṣayati tat iti pravṛtta vega upīṣuḥ kubja ādibhiḥ pratibandhu śakyaḥ atas dṛṣṭāntaḥ eva asiddhaḥ

original: tena tatra yathā kubjādibhiḥ pravṛttavegasyāpīṣoḥ pratibandhaḥ, tathā karmaṇāmapi vidyayeti na bhogena tatkṣayapratīkṣā yukteti bhāvaḥ | āstāṃ tāvatpratibandhaḥ ; nāśo'pi yāvacchakyata iti pratibandhaṃ daṇḍāpūpanyāyasiddhaṃ darśayituṃ ‘nāśayitum’ ityuktam | dṛṣṭārthasyeṣoḥ pratibandhaḥ śakyaḥ, na tvadṛṣṭaphalasya karmaṇa iti cedata āha—svameti |
analyzed: tena tatra yathā kubja ādibhiḥ pravṛtta vegasya api iṣoḥ pratibandhaḥ tathā karmaṇām api vidyayā iti na bhogena tad kṣaya pratīkṣā yuktā iti bhāvaḥ āstām tāvat pratibandhaḥ nāśaḥ api yāvat śakyate iti pratibandham daṇḍa apūpa nyāya siddham darśayitum nāśayitum iti uktam dṛṣṭa arthasya iṣoḥ pratibandhaḥ śakyaḥ na tu adṛṣṭa phalasya karmaṇaḥ iti ced atas āha svamā iti

original: svarārohaṇādisvamena gṛbhrapatanādyāpātena ca sūcitaḥ upasthitaḥ pratyāsanno vipākaḥ phalaṃ yasya, tacca vartamānadehabhogyaṃ ca tat karma ceti samāptaḥ | svapakṣamupasaṃharati—tasmāditi | saṃskārādeveti prārabdhakāryasya karmaṇaḥ kṣayapratīkṣāṃ nivartayati | nanveva sati ‘sarvāvidyāpravilye na cchedyamavaśiṣyate’ iti yaduktaṃ tadvighaṭitam ;
analyzed: svara ārohaṇa ādi svamena gṛbhra patana ādi āpātena ca sūcitaḥ upasthitaḥ pratyāsannaḥ vipākaḥ phalam yasya tat ca vartamāna deha bhogyam ca tat karma ca iti samāptaḥ sva pakṣam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti saṃskārāt eva iti prārabdha kāryasya karmaṇaḥ kṣaya pratīkṣām nivartayati nanu eva sati sarva avidyā pravilye na chedyam avaśiṣyate iti yat uktam tat vighaṭitam

original: tanna, yataḥ saṃskārakāryaśeṣābhāsau svayameva pravilyete iti na pravilyāpye ityabhiprāyeṇa tāvat ‘na cchedyamavaśiṣyate’ ityuktam |
analyzed: tat na yatas saṃskāra kārya śeṣa ābhāsau svayam eva pravilyete iti na pravilyāpye iti abhiprāyeṇa tāvat na chedyam avaśiṣyate iti uktam

original: tayośrāvidyātmanorapyakiṃcitkaratvāt, aputranyāyenāsattvamadhyāropya chedyābhiprāyeṇa 'sarvāvidyāpravilaye' ityuktamityubhayatra parihārābhiprāyaḥ | vilīnatulyatvadarśanārthaṃ hetumāha—akiṃciditi | yadi līnaṃ tadakiṃcitkaram, P. 138-6. abandhaḥ, svanivṛttaye hetvantarānapekṣaṃ ca | saṃskārakāryaśeṣāvapi tathā | atastāvapi vilīnakalpāvityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tayoḥ śrāvidya ātmanoḥ api akiṃcitkaratvāt aputra nyāyena asattvam adhyāropya chedya abhiprāyeṇa sarva avidyā pravilaye iti uktam iti ubhayatra parihāra abhiprāyaḥ vilīna tulya tva darśana artham hetum āha akiṃcid iti yadi līnam tat akiṃcitkaram abandhaḥ sva nivṛttaye hetu antara anapekṣam ca saṃskāra kārya śeṣau api tathā atas tau api vilīna kalpau iti arthaḥ

original: tatra svanivṛttaye hetvantarānapekṣatvaṃ tata eva krameṇa nivartate, svayameva vā ityatroktamityupekṣya akiṃcitkaratvābandhatvayorupapattyabhidhānapuraḥsaraṃ kāryaśeṣābhāsasya pravilīnaprāyatvamāha—viśuddhamiti | prārabdhakāryasya karmaṇaḥ kāryaśeṣābhāso vipākābhāsaḥ; sa viśuddhaṃ prapañcakāluṣyeṇāsaṃspṛṣṭamātmānaṃ paśyantaṃ na spṛśati |
analyzed: tatra sva nivṛttaye hetu antara anapekṣa tvam tatas eva krameṇa nivartate svayam eva vā iti atra uktam iti upekṣya akiṃcitkara tva abandha tvayoḥ upapatti abhidhāna puraḥsaram kārya śeṣa ābhāsasya pravilīna prāya tvam āha viśuddham iti prārabdha kāryasya karmaṇaḥ kārya śeṣa ābhāsaḥ vipāka ābhāsaḥ sa viśuddham prapañca kāluṣyeṇa a saṃspṛṣṭam ātmānam paśyantam na spṛśati

original: na ca tamasaṃspṛśat tasya kiṃcitkaroti, badhnāti ca tam | ataśchiddhābhramiva pralīnaprāya eva sa ityarthaḥ | yadyapi pūrvaṃ saṃskārasyāpyakiṃcitkaratvaṃ pratijñātam; tathāpi kāryaśeṣābhāsāveśamukhena tasyākiṃcitkaratā; atastasminnakiṃcitkare tasyāpyakiṃcitkaratā arthādukteti pṛthagihoktā | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—yatheti |
analyzed: na ca tam a saṃspṛśat tasya kiṃcid karoti badhnāti ca tam atas chiddha abhram iva pralīna prāyaḥ eva saḥ iti arthaḥ yadi api pūrvam saṃskārasya api akiṃcitkara tvam pratijñātam tathā api kārya śeṣa ābhāsa āveśa mukhena tasya akiṃcitkara tā atas tasmin akiṃcitkare tasya api akiṃcitkara tā arthāt uktā iti pṛthak iha uktā atra dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā iti

original: srcādyābhāsa ityatra pravilīna evetyanuvartate; pravilīnaprāya evetyarthaḥ | rāgādīnāmiti akiṃcitkaratvamuktam | dṛṣṭāntāntaramāha—tatheti | ātmānamiti, ātmaśabdena laukikaḥ śarīrātmocyate | avadātaṃ gauram | viparītam anavadātam |
analyzed: srcā ādi ābhāsaḥ iti atra pravilīnaḥ eva iti anuvartate pravilīna prāyaḥ eva iti arthaḥ rāga ādīnām iti akiṃcitkaratvam uktam dṛṣṭānta antaram āha tathā iti ātmānam iti ātma śabdena laukikaḥ śarīra ātmā ucyate avadātam gauram viparītam anavadātam

original: tatrāvadātasya bhukhasya khaḍgādau śyāmābhāso'navadātasya ca purvādau avadātāvabhāsa utpanno'pi mukhasya rūpatattvajñānādātmasaṃsparśaṃ pratyavakāśamalabhamānaṃ: pravilīnaprāya evetyarthaḥ | pravilīnaprāyatvameva draḍhayati—tathā ceti | etena karmasaṃskāranimittayoḥ śarīrasthityormahānviśeṣaḥ, viduṣo yathoktakarmaphalanivṛttyā karmakṣayo gamyate;
analyzed: tatra avadātasya bhukhasya khaḍga ādau śyāma ābhāsaḥ ūnavadātasya ca puru ādau avadāta avabhāsaḥ utpannaḥ api mukhasya rūpa tattva jñānāt ātma saṃsparśam pratyavakāśam alabhamānam pravilīna prāyaḥ eva iti arthaḥ pravilīna prāya tvam eva draḍhayati tathā ca iti etena karma saṃskāra nimittayoḥ śarīra sthityoḥ mahān viśeṣaḥ viduṣaḥ yathā ukta karma phala nivṛttyā karma kṣayaḥ gamyate

original: tataśca karmaṇaḥ kṣīṇatvānna bhogena kṣayapratīkṣetyuktaṃ bhavati | viduṣo vipākābhāsasyānabhinandyamānādviṣyamāṇatve gītayā draḍhayati—tathā ceti | vidvānābhāsamātmasaṃsparśinaṃ na manyata iti yaduktaṃ tadapi gītayaiva draḍhayati—tathā ceti | atra vākyārthajñānādeva muktiriti manvānaśrodayati—nanviti | tasyeti; tattvajñānasyetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca karmaṇaḥ kṣīṇa tvāt na bhogena kṣaya pratīkṣā iti uktam bhavati viduṣaḥ vipāka ābhāsasya anabhinandyamāna adviṣyamāṇa tve gītayā draḍhayati tathā ca iti vidvān ābhāsam ātma saṃsparśinam na manyate iti yat uktam tat api gītayā eva draḍhayati tathā ca iti atra vākya artha jñānāt eva muktiḥ iti manvānaḥ środayati nanu iti tasya iti tattva jñānasya iti arthaḥ

original: pariharati—ucyata iti | samānajātīyaṃ hi virodhi bhavati, na vijātīyam; pratyakṣasya ca prapañcābhāsasya parokṣaṃ jñātuṃ
analyzed: pariharati ucyate iti samāna jātīyam hi virodhi bhavati na vijātīyam pratyakṣasya ca prapañca ābhāsasya parokṣam jñātum

original: taccajñānaṃ vijātīyam; tena tayoravirodhāt parokṣeṇa taccajñānenāparokṣasya prapañcābhāsasyātmāsaṃsparśitvamakicitkaratvamasaṃbandhatvaṃ vāpādayituṃ na śakyata | P.134.4. ityarthaḥ | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—yaśceti |
analyzed: tat ca jñānam vijātīyam tena tayoḥ avirodhāt parokṣeṇa tad ca jñānena aparokṣasya prapañca ābhāsasya ātma asaṃsparśi tvam akicitkaratvam asaṃbandha tvam vā āpādayitum na śakyate iti arthaḥ atra dṛṣṭāntam āha yaḥ ca iti

original: yathā khaṇḍo madhuraḥ khaṇḍatvāt, prāganubhūtakhaṇḍavat ityanumānādāttavacanādvā pramāṇāntarāvagatamādhurye'pi khaṇḍadravye pratyakṣasaṃrūpa indriyajastiktāvabhāsaḥ sa khaṇḍadravyāsaṃsparśī nābhāsamātratayā anabhinandyamāno'dviṣyamāṇaścātmāsaṃsparśitayāvatiṣṭhate, apitu dviṣyata ityarthaḥ | etadeva draḍhayati—tathā ceti |
analyzed: yathā khaṇḍaḥ madhuraḥ khaṇḍa tvāt prāk anubhūta khaṇḍa vat iti anumānāt ātta vacanāt vā pramāṇa antara avagata mādhurye api khaṇḍa dravye pratyakṣa saṃrūpaḥ indriya jaḥ tikta avabhāsaḥ sa khaṇḍa dravya asaṃsparśī na ābhāsa mātra tayā an abhinandyamāna udviṣyamāṇaḥ ca ātma asaṃsparśi tayā avatiṣṭhate apitu dviṣyate iti arthaḥ etat eva draḍhayati tathā ca iti

original: duḥkhāya bhavatīti dviṣyamāṇatvamuktam | tathā ca dhūrutya tyāgādityuktam | upāsanāyāṃ tu satyāṃ tayā sākṣātkṛtātmataccasya viduṣo'parokṣeṇātmataccajñānenāparokṣasya prapañcābhāsasya samānajātīyatvena virodhaḥ; tataśca sannapi prapañcābhāsastenāsatsamīkṛto nātmasaṃsparśī na sukhāya vā bhavati | tenāstyupāsanopayoga iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: duḥkhāya bhavati iti dviṣyamāṇa tvam uktam tathā ca dhūḥ utya tyāgāt iti uktam upāsanāyām tu satyām tayā sākṣātkṛta ātma taccasya viduṣā uparokṣeṇa ātma tacca jñānena aparokṣasya prapañca ābhāsasya samāna jātīya tvena virodhaḥ tatas ca san api prapañca ābhāsaḥ tena asat samīkṛtaḥ na ātma saṃsparśī na sukhāya vā bhavati tena asti upāsana upayogaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: atra dṛṣṭāntamāha—devadatteti | itaścātmataccāparokṣāyopāsanāpekṣitavyetyāha—nityaśceti | ātmataccaprakāśaḥ ātmanaḥ “sutyaṃ jñānamanantam” iti jñānātmakasya prakāśaḥ “avināśī vāre'yamātmā” iti nityaḥ | atastasminnāvibhūte na punaḥ prapañcabhrāntyavabhāso bhavati | tenātyantikasaṃsāranivṛttirupapadyate | śābdaṃ tu jñānaṃ kṣaṇikam |
analyzed: atra dṛṣṭāntam āha devadatta iti itas ca ātma tad ca aparokṣāya upāsanā apekṣitavyā iti āha nityaḥ ca iti ātma tad ca prakāśaḥ ātmanaḥ sutyam jñānam anantam iti jñāna ātmakasya prakāśaḥ avināśī ātmā iti nityaḥ atas tasmin na avibhūte na punar prapañca bhrānti avabhāsaḥ bhavati tena ātyantika saṃsāra nivṛttiḥ upapadyate śābdam tu jñānam kṣaṇikam

original: atastasminnaṣṭe pramāṇānanusaṃdhāne punarapi prapañcabhrāntiravakāśaṃ labhate | tasya punarāvṛttiḥ syāt | tato nityātmaprakāśāvirbhāvāyopāsanā yuktetyarthaḥ | dṛṣṭaṃ caitat—pramāṇānanusaṃdhāne bhrāntirbhavati, sā ca duḥkhaheturityāha—dṛṣṭamiti | nanu pramāṇānanusaṃdhāne cetpunarbhrāntirbhavati, tato'trāpi śābdamevātmajñānaṃ saṃtatamanusaṃdhīyatām;

original: tata eva punarbhrāntirna bhaviṣyati; kimupāsanayetyāśaṅkayati—aśceti | taddūṣayati— kimiti | saṃtatānusaṃdhānamevopāsanā, nāparā | atastaccedāśrīyate, kathamupāsanā neṣṭetyarthaḥ | evaṃ dehapātāvadhiśrutivirodhaṃ parihṛtya vākyārthajñānātiriktopāsanopāyaṃ coktvā ‘na cchedyamavaśiṣyate’ iti yaduktaṃ tadupasaṃharati—tasmāditi |
analyzed: tatas eva punar bhrāntiḥ na bhaviṣyati kim upāsanayā iti āśaṅkayati tat dūṣayati kim iti saṃtata anusaṃdhānam eva upāsanā na aparā atas tat ced āśrīyate katham upāsanā na iṣṭā iti arthaḥ evam dehapāta avadhi śruti virodham parihṛtya vākya artha jñāna atirikta upāsana upāyam ca uktvā na chedyam avaśiṣyate iti yat uktam tat upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: evamavidyānivṛttimukhena dṛṣṭenaiva vidyā prārabdhānārabdhakāryapūrvakarmakṣayaheturiti prasādhya utpannātmatattvabodhasyottarakālīnena pramādajena pāpenālepamadṛṣṭaśaktyā vidyā karotīti ye manyante, tānnirākartuṃ tatrāpi dṛṣṭenaiva vidyā heturityatidiśati—evamiti | tatrottarāghāśleṣaśrutiṃ tāvatpaṭhati—yatheti |
analyzed: evam avidyā nivṛtti mukhena dṛṣṭena eva vidyā prārabdha anārabdha kārya pūrva karma kṣaya hetuḥ iti prasādhya utpanna ātma tattva bodhasya uttara kālīnena pramāda jena pāpena ālepam adṛṣṭa śaktyā vidyā karoti iti ye manyante tān nirākartum tatra api dṛṣṭena eva vidyā hetuḥ iti atidiśati evam iti tatra uttara agha āśleṣa śrutim tāvat paṭhati yathā iti

original: P.134-14 yathā ca tatra dṛṣṭenaiva vidyā hetustathā darśayati—kartriti | karturhi kartavyena karmaṇā saṃbandhaḥ ; ato yāvadevātmānaṃ kartāraṃ kartavyaṃ ca pāpakarmāvidyayā manyate, tāvadeva tacchepaḥ | vidyāyāṃ tūditāyāmavidyāvilayāt kartṛkartavyavibhāga eva nāsti ; kasya kena śleṣaḥ ? evaṃ dṛṣṭenaivottarāghāśleṣe'pi vidyā heturityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yathā ca tatra dṛṣṭena eva vidyā hetuḥ tathā darśayati kartṛ iti kartuḥ hi kartavyena karmaṇā saṃbandhaḥ atas yāvat eva ātmānam kartāram kartavyam ca pāpa karma avidyayā manyate tāvat eva tad śepaḥ vidyāyām tu uditāyām avidyā vilayāt kartṛ kartavya vibhāgaḥ eva na asti kasya kena śleṣaḥ evam dṛṣṭena eva uttara agha āśleṣe pi vidyā hetuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: idānīṃ dṛṣṭenaiva vidyā pūrvottarakarmaṇoḥ kṣayāśleṣayorheturityasya svapakṣasya sādhutvaṃ darśayan adṛṣṭaśaktyā vidyā tayorheturityasya pakṣasyāsattāṃ sūcayati—evamiti | adṛṣṭaśaktivādināmadṛṣṭā śaktistāvat kalpyā ; sā ca pūrvottarakarmakṣayāśleṣayormedādaneketi kalpanāgauravam ;
analyzed: idānīm dṛṣṭena eva vidyā pūrva uttara karmaṇoḥ kṣaya āśleṣayoḥ hetuḥ iti asya sva pakṣasya sādhu tvam darśayan adṛṣṭa śaktyā vidyā tayoḥ hetuḥ iti asya pakṣasya asattām sūcayati evam iti adṛṣṭa śakti vādinām adṛṣṭā śaktiḥ tāvat kalpyā sā ca pūrva uttara karma kṣaya āśleṣayoḥ medāt anekā iti kalpanā gauravam

original: “na ca punarāvartate” ityādivartamānāpadeśānāṃ ca vipariṇāmena phalavidhitvakalpaneti doṣaḥ ; na tvasmākamityarthaḥ | nanvavidyātvāditarāvidyāvat saṃskārakāryaśeṣāvidyayā vinivartitavyam ; ataḥ kathaṃ pravilīnaprāyayorapi tayoranuvṛttirucyate ; anumānamidam ; taccābhāsānuvacyarthāpattidehapātāvadhiśrutibhyāṃ viruddhatvādapramāṇam |
analyzed: na ca punar āvartate ityādi vartamāna apadeśānām ca vipariṇāmena phala vidhi tva kalpanā iti doṣaḥ na tu asmākam iti arthaḥ nanu avidyā tvāt itara avidyā vat saṃskāra kārya śeṣa avidyayā vinivartitavyam atas katham pravilīna prāyayoḥ api tayoḥ anuvṛttiḥ ucyate anumānam idam tat ca ābhāsa anuvaci arthāpatti dehapāta avadhi śrutibhyām viruddha tvāt apramāṇam

original: saṃskāraśca svahetunivṛttāvapyanuvartate, bhayādisaṃskāravat | idānīṃ tṛtīyāpratipattividhivādinā yaduktaṃ nānāpadārthasaṃsargātmikāyāḥ śābdapratipatteraprapañcaṃ brahma na viṣaya iti, tadupanyasya dūṣayati—yaditi | yadi vedāntaśabdajanitadhīgamyaṃ brahma na bhavati, tataḥ ‘ātmā jñātavyaḥ’ iti brahmadhiyo vidhiraśakyaḥ ;
analyzed: saṃskāraḥ ca sva hetu nivṛttau api anuvartate bhaya ādi saṃskāra vat idānīm tṛtīyā pratipatti vidhi vādinā yat uktam nānā padārtha saṃsarga ātmikāyāḥ śābda pratipatteḥ aprapañcam brahma na viṣayaḥ iti tat upanyasya dūṣayati yat iti yadi vedānta śabda janita dhī gamyam brahma na bhavati tatas ātmā jñātavyaḥ iti brahma dhiyaḥ vidhiḥ aśakyaḥ

original: yato nānirūpitapado'navagataviṣayo vidhirbhavati, na tattvamātramaviśiṣṭaṃ vidherviṣayaḥ, kiṃtu dhīviśeṣaḥ | viśeṣaśca svayamanākārāyā dhiyo'rthanibandhanaḥ | arthaścāsiddho'navagato dhīviśeṣasya prarūpāya nirūpaṇāya na kṣamaḥ | ato'rthe brahmaṇyavagate brahmajñānaṃ vidhātuṃ śakyam | na ca tasya śabdādanyato'vagatirasti |
analyzed: yatas na anirūpita padaḥ ūnavagata viṣayaḥ vidhiḥ bhavati na tattva mātram aviśiṣṭam vidheḥ viṣayaḥ kiṃtu dhī viśeṣaḥ viśeṣaḥ ca svayam anākārāyāḥ dhiyaḥ ūrtha nibandhanaḥ arthaḥ ca asiddhaḥ ūnavagataḥ dhī viśeṣasya prarūpāya nirūpaṇāya na kṣamaḥ atas ṛthe brahmaṇi avagate brahma jñānam vidhātum śakyam na ca tasya śabdāt anyatas vagatiḥ asti

original: tasmācchabdagamyaṃ brahmaiṣṭavyamityarthaḥ | kiṃca yasya pratipattiviśeṣavidhiparā vedāntāḥ tasyātmatattvamapramāṇakameva syādityāha—api ceti | vidhiḥ niyogaḥ svasiddhiniṣṭhaḥ svakārya-
analyzed: tasmāt śabda gamyam brahma eṣṭavyam iti arthaḥ kiṃca yasya pratipatti viśeṣa vidhi parāḥ vedāntāḥ tasya ātma tattvam apramāṇakam eva syāt iti āha api ca iti vidhiḥ niyogaḥ sva siddhi niṣṭhaḥ sva kārya

original: P.135-9. tāyāṃ paryavasitaḥ; athavā kriyāsiddhiparaḥ, kriyātmano viṣayasya tataḥ kāryatā gamyate; tatrādye pakṣe vidhiḥ svātmani paryavasitaḥ, śabdo'pyadvayātmapratipattiviṣayo niyogaḥ kārya ityatraiva paryavasitaḥ | dvitīye viṣayasiddhau vidhiḥ paryavasitaḥ, śabdo'pi tatheti advayātmapratipattirahetukā apramāṇikā syāt |

original: atha niyogāt “vijaro vimṛtyurviśokaḥ” ityādipadānāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt kvacit, anyatrānyathā vā vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā saṃbandhāt ātmasvarūpādhigatirbhaviṣyatīti cedata āha—viniyogāditi | viniyogādātmasvarūpādhigatiryā, asyā ātmasvarūpādhigateḥ ‘ātmā jñātavyaḥ’ iti yā jñānakriyā vihitā tadarthatā tatparatā, nātmasvarūpaparatā |
analyzed: atha niyogāt vijaraḥ vimṛtyuḥ viśokaḥ ityādi padānām sāmānādhikaraṇyāt kvacid anyatra anyathā vā vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā saṃbandhāt ātma svarūpa adhigatiḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced atas āha viniyogāt iti viniyogāt ātma svarūpa adhigatiḥ yā asyāḥ ātma svarūpa adhigateḥ ātmā jñātavyaḥ iti yā jñāna kriyā vihitā tad artha tā tatpara tā na ātma svarūpa para tā

analyzed: viraja ādi sva rūpaḥ ātmā jñātavyaḥ iti evaṃparā na punar viraja ādi rūpaḥ ātmā iti evaṃparā iti uktam bhavati atas ca jñāna kriyā paryavasita ātma adhigatiḥ atatparā ātma svarūpa parā na bhavantī na ātma svarūpe pramāṇam yathā vidhi stuti parā arthavāda utthā buddhiḥ pūjā kāryā iti atra eva paryavasitā na punar advayaḥ ātmā iti ātma svarūpe

original: tatrobhayathā advayātmarūpaparatvābhāvaḥ | yatparaśca śabdaḥ sa śabdārtho loke | ato'dvayātmapratipattirapramāṇikā; yathā “prajāpatirvapāmudakkhidat” ityādivṛttānteṣu | vṛttāvanyathā vetyasya vaiyadhikaraṇyena vetyarthaḥ | tatra ca “yato vā imāni bhūtāni jāyante” ityādyudāharaṇavidhirna svaniṣṭho nāpi kriyāsiddhiniṣṭhaḥ;

original: kiṃtu ātmasvarūpameva vidhīyate | ataḥ śabdasya tatparatvāt sa eva tatra pramāṇamiti nādvaitātmapratipattirapramāṇiketi cedata āha—vidhiriti | anuṣṭheye hi viṣaye vidhiḥ puṃsāṃ pravartakaḥ; anuṣṭheyā ca kriyā; ataḥ kriyāgocaratvāt siddharūpatayā svaśabdenopāse'nuṣṭheye ātmadravye vidhirna vyāpārāya kṣamaḥ | vṛttau siddhavaditi svārthe vatiḥ |
analyzed: kiṃtu ātma svarūpam eva vidhīyate atas śabdasya tatparatvāt saḥ eva tatra pramāṇam iti na advaita ātma pratipattiḥ apramāṇikā iti ced atas āha vidhiḥ iti anuṣṭheye hi viṣaye vidhiḥ puṃsām pravartakaḥ anuṣṭheyā ca kriyā atas kriyā gocara tvāt siddha rūpatayā ātma dravye vidhiḥ na vyāpārāya kṣamaḥ vṛttau siddha vat iti svārthe vatiḥ

original: vivekena vidhimadhye guṇamātraphalatvādityadoṣaḥ | kiṃca īdṛśaṃ vastu abhūt asti bhaviṣyati vā iti kālatrayasyānyatareṇa saṃsṛṣṭayā sattvānvitasya dravyasya pratītiriti hetone kevalaṃ vidhidravyaṃ vidhātuṃ kṣamaḥ ; pratyuta duṣyati yāvat, svarūpahānāt | kālakartranavācchinnabhāvārthaviṣayatāsvarūpo nahi saḥ |

original: na hi 'yajet' ityādau kālatrayasya madhye'nyatareṇa viśiṣṭā sattā pratīyate | nanu vihitamanuṣṭhāsyate, anuṣṭheyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ; ataśca bhaviṣyatkālā tasya sattā pratīyate | naitat | na vihitamavaśyamanuṣṭhīyate ; anyathā hi tasyākaraṇaṃ na syāt ; ataśca "akurvanvihitaṃ karma" iti doṣaśrutiranārthikā syāt |

original: tasmātmūkam—kālatrayānyatarasaṃsparśe sa duṣyatīti | nanu yathā "somena yajet" iti somaviśiṣṭahomakriyāvidhivākyameva tadviśeṣaṇe some pramāṇaṃ na pṛthak, tathā 'evaṃbhūta ātmā pratipattavyaḥ' iti pratipattikartavyatāpramāṇamevātmasvarūpe pramāṇam ; ataḥ kathamapramāṇikātmataccapratītirityāśaṅkyocyate—viśiṣṭeti |

original: yadayaṃ paraṃ jñānamapekṣate, tadapyanāśvāso'petaṃ tathātvaparicchedakameva | asti ca tādṛśaṃ jñānam | atastasya ko'parādhaḥ? yenānyanmṛgyate | nanu parasyānyathākhyātimanicchato'nāśvāso nāstyeva; ataḥ kathaṃ taṃ pratīdamuktam? tasyāpyekatra vivekāgrahāt sarvatra vivekāgrahaśaṅkayā anāśvāsastukhya iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yat ayam param jñānam apekṣate tat api anāśvāsa upetam tathātva paricchedakam eva asti ca tādṛśam jñānam atas tasya kā uparādhaḥ yena anyat mṛgyate nanu parasya anyathā khyātim an icchataḥ nāśvāsaḥ na asti eva atas katham tam prati idam uktam tasya api ekatra viveka agrahāt sarvatra viveka agraha śaṅkayā anāśvāsaḥ tukhyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: athaikatra vyabhicārayogāt sarvatrārthaparicchedaṃ pratyasamarthaṃ jñānamapramāṇaṃ P.144-13 syāt, tathā sati cānāśvāsamapi na nirudhyādityucyate, tatrāha—vyabhicārāditi | vyabhicārādarthaparicchede pramāṇasya nāsāmarthyam, arthaparicchedasya tatkāryasya lābhataḥ pramāṇasya paricchedaphalatvādeva siddhatvāt |
analyzed: atha ekatra vyabhicāra yogāt sarvatra artha paricchedam prati asamartham jñānam apramāṇam syāt tathā sati ca anāśvāsam api na nirudhyāt iti ucyate tatra āha vyabhicārāt iti vyabhicārāt artha paricchede pramāṇasya na asāmarthyam artha paricchedasya tad kāryasya lābhataḥ pramāṇasya pariccheda phala tvāt eva siddha tvāt

original: ataśca paricchedaścedasti, tataḥ satyapi vyabhicāre prāmāṇyaṃ siddham; yataḥ paricchedāparicchedābhyāṃ prāmāṇyāprāmāṇye; na tu vyabhicārāvyabhicārābhyām, prāmāṇyāprāmāṇye prati tayoratantratvāt; tathāhi—dhūmāderavyabhicārasyāpi saṃbandhasmaraṇādivaikalyātkadācitparicchedamakurvato'sati paricchede na prāmāṇyam;
analyzed: atas ca paricchedaḥ ced asti tatas sati api vyabhicāre prāmāṇyam siddham yatas pariccheda aparicchedābhyām prāmāṇya aprāmāṇye na tu vyabhicāra avyabhicārābhyām prāmāṇya aprāmāṇye prati tayoḥ atantra tvāt tathā hi dhūma ādeḥ avyabhicārasya api saṃbandha smaraṇa ādi vaikalyāt kadācid paricchedam akurvatoḥ asati paricchede na prāmāṇyam

original: cakṣuṣaśca kṛṣṇādiviṣaye vyabhicāravato'pi sati paricchede prāmāṇyaṃ dṛśyate | kiṃca bādhakāraṇadoṣāveva sarvatra prāmāṇyopadhātinau dṛṣṭau, na vyabhicāraḥ, satyapi vyabhicāre cakṣuṣaḥ pramāṇatvāt; uktaṃ ca ‘yatra ca dṛṣṭaṃ karaṇam’ ityādi | nanu—vyabhicārādapyaprāmāṇyaṃ dṛṣṭam;
analyzed: cakṣuṣaḥ ca kṛṣṇa ādi viṣaye vyabhicāravataḥ api sati paricchede prāmāṇyam dṛśyate kiṃca bādha kāraṇa doṣau eva sarvatra prāmāṇya upadhātinau dṛṣṭau na vyabhicāraḥ sati api vyabhicāre cakṣuṣaḥ pramāṇa tvāt uktam ca yatra ca dṛṣṭam karaṇam ityādi nanu vyabhicārāt api aprāmāṇyam dṛṣṭam

original: yathā śabdasya nityānityatvayoḥ sādhyayoḥ sādhāraṇānaikāntikasya prameyatvādeḥ | maivam, na tatra vyabhicārādaprāmāṇyam; api tu paricchedākhyaṃ kāryameva tatra na labhyate, liṅgābhāvāt | yasmādavyabhicāri liṅgaṃ bhavati; prameyatvādi ca na tathā |
analyzed: yathā śabdasya nitya anitya tvayoḥ sādhyayoḥ sādhāraṇa anaikāntikasya prameya tva ādeḥ mā evam na tatra vyabhicārāt aprāmāṇyam api tu pariccheda ākhyam kāryam eva tatra na labhyate liṅga abhāvāt yasmāt avyabhicāri liṅgam bhavati prameya tva ādi ca na tathā

original: yatra tu cakṣurādāvavyabhicāraḥ paricchede na kāraṇam, tatra sati paricchede prāmāṇyaṃ vyabhicāre'pyavivādam | jñānaṃ cakṣurādivadeva vyabhicāryapi paricchede nimittam, na tu liṅgavadavyabhicāri | athocyate—vyabhicāraḥ ‘arthastathā, anyathā vā’ iti saṃśayamutpādayan prāmāṇyamupahanti;
analyzed: yatra tu cakṣuḥ ādau avyabhicāraḥ paricchede na kāraṇam tatra sati paricchede prāmāṇyam vyabhicāre pi avivādam jñānam cakṣuḥ ādi vat eva vyabhicāri api paricchede nimittam na tu liṅga vat avyabhicāri atha ucyate vyabhicāraḥ arthaḥ tathā anyathā vā iti saṃśayam utpādayan prāmāṇyam upahanti

original: yathā ūrdhvatvasya sthāṇupuruṣadvayagatatvena dvaividhyaṃ saṃśayahetuḥ, tathā jñānasyāpi tathātvānyathātvobhayakoṭisaṃsparśitayā dvaividhyaṃ saṃśayahetuḥ syāditi | tanna ; yato jñānamutpattyārthaṃ ‘tathaiva’ iti paricchinatti; tannāsato dvaividhyasya kutaḥ saṃśayahetutvam? na hi sthāṇau paricchinne
analyzed: yathā ūrdhva tvasya sthāṇu puruṣa dvaya gata tvena dvaividhyam saṃśaya hetuḥ tathā jñānasya api tathātva anyathātva ubhaya koṭi saṃsparśi tayā dvaividhyam saṃśaya hetuḥ syāt iti tat na yatas jñānam utpattyā artham tathā eva iti paricchinatti tat na asataḥ dvaividhyasya kutas saṃśaya hetu tvam na hi sthāṇau paricchinne

original: dvaividhyādūrdhvastre saṃśerate | atha 'tathaiva' ityavadhārake sati mā bhavatu P.145-6. saṃśayaḥ ; anavadhārake tu syādityucyate | tadayuktam ; yatastadapramāṇameva ; pramāṇaṃ cātra kvaciddhyabhicārāt 'pramāṇam', apramāṇaṃ vā' iti vicāryamāṇatayādhikṛtam | tatra kuto'pramāṇasya prasaṅgaḥ | pramāṇācca 'tathaiva' ityavadhāraṇam |
analyzed: dvaividhyāt ūrdhvastre saṃśerate atha tathā eva iti avadhārake sati mā bhavatu saṃśayaḥ anavadhārake tu syāt iti ucyate tat ayuktam yatas tat apramāṇam eva pramāṇam ca atra kvacid hi abhicārāt pramāṇam apramāṇam vā iti vicāryamāṇa tayā adhikṛtam tatra kutas pramāṇasya prasaṅgaḥ pramāṇāt ca tathā eva iti avadhāraṇam

original: na ca tataḥ 'anyathā vā' ityanavadhāraṇaṃ yujyate, vipratiṣedhāt | tadevamasmākaṃ tāvadanāśvāso nāsti ; pratyuta ya eva sarvajñānānāmavyabhicāramāśvāsanārthaṃ prārthayate, tasyaivānāśvāsaḥ | nanu jñānasyāvyabhicāritvajñānaṃ yat, satyameva tat ; ataḥ kathamanyasyānāśvāsaḥ ? maivam, sarvajñānānāmavyabhicāritvagrāhiṇāpi jñānenāśvāsāt |
analyzed: na ca tatas anyathā vā iti anavadhāraṇam yujyate vipratiṣedhāt tat evam asmākam tāvat anāśvāsaḥ na asti pratyuta yaḥ eva sarva jñānānām avyabhicāram āśvāsana artham prārthayate tasya eva anāśvāsaḥ nanu jñānasya avyabhicāri tva jñānam yat satyam eva tat atas katham anyasya anāśvāsaḥ mā evam sarva jñānānām avyabhicāri tva grāhiṇā api jñānena āśvāsāt

original: nanvavyabhicāragrāhi jñānaṃ sāmānyena sarvajñānānāmavyabhicāraṃ gṛhṇāti ; tataśca svayamapyavyabhicāri sarveṣāmavyabhicāraṃ gṛhṇāti ; tataśca svayayadi tat svayaṃ siddhāvyabhicāraṃ syāt, tataḥ svasya jñānāntarāṇāṃ cāvyabhicāraṃ gṛhṇāti ; tataśca svayaṃ siddhāvyabhicāre tasmin anyāvyabhicāranirṇayaḥ |
analyzed: nanu avyabhicāra grāhi jñānam sāmānyena sarva jñānānām avyabhicāram gṛhṇāti tatas ca svayam api avyabhicāri sarveṣām avyabhicāram gṛhṇāti tatas ca tat svayam siddha avyabhicāram syāt tatas svasya jñāna antarāṇām ca avyabhicāram gṛhṇāti tatas ca svayam siddha avyabhicāre tasmin anya avyabhicāra nirṇayaḥ

original: tannirṇaye ca tasya siddhāvyabhicāritvamitītaretarāśrayaṃ syāt | atha jñānāntarāt tasyāvyabhicārasiddhiḥ, tatastatrāpyevamityanavasthā | kiṃca jñānasyārthaparicchedakatvalakṣaṇāt svarūpādyadi nāśvāsaḥ, tato'rthasyaivāsiddhatvānna tena saha jñānasyāvyabhicāro gṛhyata | tasmāccayāpi jñānarūpādevārthāśvāsa iti vācyam |
analyzed: tad nirṇaye ca tasya siddha avyabhicāri tvam iti itaretarāśrayam syāt atha jñāna antarāt tasya avyabhicāra siddhiḥ tatas tatra api evam iti anavasthā kiṃca jñānasya artha paricchedaka tva lakṣaṇāt svarūpāt yadi na āśvāsaḥ tatas ṛthasya eva asiddha tvāt na tena saha jñānasya avyabhicāraḥ tasmāt cayā api jñāna rūpāt eva artha āśvāsaḥ iti vācyam

original: evaṃ cedasmākamapi tathā bhaviṣyati | kiṃca jñānasya yathābhūtārthaparicchedakatvaṃ nāma yat svarūpaṃ tadviparītarūpātāvayathārthaparicchedakatvādvirudhyata ityevaṃ jñānasvarūpādeva jñānasyāvyabhicāraḥ kathyate | tataścāvyabhicārārthamapi cet jñānasvarūpamāśrayitavyam, tathā sati tata evārthasiddhirbhaviṣyati ;
analyzed: evam ced asmākam api tathā bhaviṣyati kiṃca jñānasya yathābhūta artha paricchedaka tvam nāma yat svarūpam tad viparīta rūpātau ayathārtha paricchedaka tvāt virudhyate iti evam jñāna svarūpāt eva jñānasya avyabhicāraḥ kathyate tatas ca avyabhicāra artham api ced jñāna svarūpam āśrayitavyam tathā sati tatas eva artha siddhiḥ bhaviṣyati

original: tataḥ kuto nāśvāsaḥ ? yena tannirṇaye ca tataśca svayaṃ siddhāvyabhicāraḥ prārthayate | na ca vācyaṃ vyabhicāre sati prāmāṇyameva na syāditi, yato vyabhicāraḥ prāmāṇyaṃ nopahantītyuktamityarthaḥ | kiṃca udvekasya kāryādhikyasya kāraṇadoṣāstimirādayo na hetavaḥ | kiṃ tarhi ? kāraṇasya kārye yatsāmarthyaṃ tasya dhātinaḥ |
analyzed: tatas kutas nā āśvāsaḥ yena tad nirṇaye ca tatas ca svayam siddha avyabhicāraḥ prārthayate na ca vācyam vyabhicāre sati prāmāṇyam eva na syāt iti yatas vyabhicāraḥ prāmāṇyam na upahanti iti uktam iti arthaḥ kiṃca udvekasya kārya ādhikyasya kāraṇa doṣāḥ timira ādayaḥ na hetavaḥ kim tarhi kāraṇasya kārye yat sāmarthyam tasya dhātinaḥ

original: atasteṣāṃ saccāt kāraṇasya grahaṇākhyakāryasāmarthyapratighātādagrahaḥ | asaccācca kāryasāmarthyāpratighātāt graha ityevaṃ doṣasadasaccaṃ smṛtahṛdayayovivekāgrahaṇe ame 'atra
analyzed: atas teṣām saccāt kāraṇasya grahaṇa ākhya kārya sāmarthya pratighātāt agrahaḥ asaccāt ca kārya sāmarthya apratighātāt grahaḥ iti evam doṣa sat asat cam smṛta hṛdayayoḥ viveka agrahaṇe ame atra

original: vivekāgrahaḥ, atra na' iti vivekasya nirṇayasya yatkāraṇaṃ parasyeṣṭaṃ tadviparyayadarśane'pi agre na daṇḍairnivāryate | ato viparyayadarśane pramāṇatadā- P.145-16 bhāsavivekānnābhāsavyabhicāreṇa pramāṇe'pyanāśvāsa ityabhiprāyeṇāha—api ceti | atra hetumāha—viparyaya iti |
analyzed: viveka agrahaḥ atra naḥ iti vivekasya nirṇayasya yat kāraṇam parasya iṣṭam tad viparyaya darśane api agre na daṇḍaiḥ nivāryate atas viparyaya darśane pramāṇa tad ābhāsa vivekāt na ābhāsa vyabhicāreṇa pramāṇe pi anāśvāsaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha api ca iti atra hetum āha viparyayaḥ iti

original: yataḥ kāryasāmarthyapratighātino doṣā iti yaduktaṃ tadviparyaye agre'pi sutarāṃ prakalpate ghaṭate | kathamityapekṣāyāmāha—dṛṣṭeni | agrahaṇe agre doṣebhya iṣṭasya grahaṇākhyakāryasya nirodhamātraṃ bhavati | viparyayalakṣaṇe tu agre na kevalaṃ tattvagrahaṇasya doṣebhyo nirodhaḥ ; apitu tatpratipakṣaviparītajñānodayaśca bhavati |
analyzed: yatas kārya sāmarthya pratighātinaḥ doṣāḥ iti yat uktam tad viparyaye agre api sutarām prakalpate ghaṭate katham iti apekṣāyām āha dṛṣṭa ini agrahaṇe agre doṣebhyaḥ iṣṭasya grahaṇa ākhya kāryasya nirodha mātram bhavati viparyaya lakṣaṇe tu agre na kevalam tattva grahaṇasya doṣebhyaḥ nirodhaḥ apitu tad pratipakṣa viparīta jñāna udayaḥ ca bhavati

original: tena tattvagrahaṇākhyamiṣṭaṃ kāryasvarūpataḥ pratipakṣotthāpanena ca doṣairatyantaṃ niruddhamityatiśayārthaḥ | tasmādagrahaṇe agre doṣāṇāṃ sattvādagrahaḥ ; doṣāsattvācca graha iti grahāgrahaviveko yaḥ, sa viparyayalakṣaṇe'pi agre ghaṭata ityāha—tasmāditi | yatra doṣo'san, tatrāduṣṭādindriyāt tattvagraha ityāśaṅkānivṛttirityuktam ;
analyzed: tena tattva grahaṇa ākhyam iṣṭam kārya svarūpataḥ pratipakṣa utthāpanena ca doṣaiḥ atyantam niruddham iti atiśaya arthaḥ tasmāt agrahaṇe agre doṣāṇām sattvāt agrahaḥ doṣa asattvāt ca grahaḥ iti graha agraha vivekaḥ yaḥ sa viparyaya lakṣaṇe api agre ghaṭate iti āha tasmāt iti yatra doṣaḥ usan tatra aduṣṭāt indriyāt tattva grahaḥ iti āśaṅkā nivṛttiḥ iti uktam

original: taddūṣayati—doṣa iti | atra hetumāha— na hīti | yadi kāraṇasadbhāve kāryasattā niyogato niyogena syāt, tato nirdoṣendriyasadbhāve tattvagrahākhyakāryabhāvādagrahāśaṅkā nivarteta, na tvetadasti | tathāhi—satyapi nirdoṣe cakṣuṣi vistite jñānānudayo dṛśyate | na ca cakṣurmātraṃ kārakam, apitu sāmagryapi ; sā ca tatra nāstīti kāryānudaya iti vācyam |
analyzed: tat dūṣayati doṣaḥ iti atra hetum āha na hi iti yadi kāraṇa sadbhāve kārya sattā niyogataḥ niyogena syāt tatas nirdoṣa indriya sadbhāve tattva graha ākhya kārya bhāvāt agraha āśaṅkā nivarteta na tu etat asti tathā hi sati api nirdoṣe cakṣuṣi vistite jñāna anudayaḥ dṛśyate na ca cakṣuḥ mātram kārakam apitu sāmagrī api sā ca tatra na asti iti kārya anudayaḥ iti vācyam

original: yataḥ pratyekavartinī kārakaśaktiḥ, na samāhāravartinī | kārakāṇāṃ hi kāryasiddhye samāsaḥ, na militānāṃ karaṇatvam | tasmāccakṣurapi kāraṇam | na ca tasminnaduṣṭe'pi kāryasiddhiriti sūktam—‘na hi kāraṇasadbhāve’ iti | ato na parasya grahāgrahavivekasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | kiṃca evaṃ sati viparyayaḥ syādityāha—pratyakṣamiti |
analyzed: yatas pratyeka vartinī kāraka śaktiḥ na samāhāra vartinī kārakāṇām hi kārya siddhye samāsaḥ na militānām karaṇa tvam tasmāt cakṣuḥ api kāraṇam na ca tasmin aduṣṭe api kārya siddhiḥ iti su uktam na hi kāraṇa sadbhāve iti atas na parasya graha agraha viveka siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ kiṃca evam sati viparyayaḥ syāt iti āha pratyakṣam iti

original: pratyakṣayā hi saṃvityā kāraṇamanumīyata iti yuktam ; parasya tu pratyakṣaṃ saṃvittilakṣaṇaṃ kāryamaduṣṭena karaṇenānumīyata iti viparyayaḥ | anyathākhyātau tu doṣasya hetorabhāvāt kāryasyābhāvo yujyate | atastatra doṣābhāvāt viparyayadarśanākhyaphalābhāvānumānaṃ yuktamityāha—viparyaya iti |
analyzed: pratyakṣayā hi saṃvityā kāraṇam anumīyate iti yuktam parasya tu pratyakṣam saṃvitti lakṣaṇam kāryam aduṣṭena karaṇena anumīyate iti viparyayaḥ anyathā khyātau tu doṣasya hetoḥ abhāvāt kāryasya abhāvaḥ yujyate atas tatra doṣa abhāvāt viparyaya darśana ākhya phala abhāva anumānam yuktam iti āha viparyayaḥ iti

original: tathā viparyayalakṣaṇāt phalāddhetoliṅgāt taddhetudoṣasaṃbhavānumānamapi yuktamityapi draṣṭavyam | ato'smākaṃ doṣābhāvabhāvābhyāṃ pramāṇatadābhāsavivekasiddhiḥ, na parasyeti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tathā viparyaya lakṣaṇāt phalāt hetu liṅgāt tad hetu doṣa saṃbhava anumānam api yuktam iti api draṣṭavyam atas smākam doṣa abhāva bhāvābhyām pramāṇa tad ābhāsa viveka siddhiḥ na parasya iti bhāvaḥ

original: anyathākhyātāvanālambanaṃ syāditi parokto doṣaḥ parasyāpyastītyāha—anālambaneti | yathā anyathākhyātau śukterākārādākārāntarasya P.146-10 rajatasya samarpaṇāt jñānasyānālambanatāpattiḥ, evamakhyātivādinastavāgrahaṇe'pi agre śuktisrarūpasya viśiṣṭasya 'idam' iti jñāne'narpaṇāt anālambanatāpattirbhavedityarthaḥ |
analyzed: anyathākhyātau anālambanam syāt iti para uktaḥ doṣaḥ parasya api asti iti āha anālambana iti yathā anyathākhyātau śukteḥ ākārāt ākāra antarasya rajatasya samarpaṇāt jñānasya anālambana tā āpattiḥ evam akhyāti vādinaḥ tava agrahaṇe api agre śukti srarūpasya viśiṣṭasya idam iti jñānena arpaṇāt anālambana tā āpattiḥ bhavet iti arthaḥ

original: atha tatra viśeṣānarpaṇe'pi 'idam' iti jñānena śuktamāsvaratvādisāmānyāṃśasya kasyacidarpaṇamasti ; sa ca śukteḥ svākāra iti tasmin gṛhyamāṇe śuktirevālambanamāpanneti 'viśeṣāṃśāgrahe'pi na nirālambanatāpattirityucyate, tadanyathākhyātāvapi tulyam, yatastatrāpīdamaṃśakhyātirastyevetyāha—kasyaciditi |
analyzed: atha tatra viśeṣa anarpaṇe api idam iti jñānena śuktam āsvara tva ādi sāmānya aṃśasya kasyacid arpaṇam asti sa ca śukteḥ sva ākāraḥ iti tasmin gṛhyamāṇe śuktiḥ eva ālambanam āpannā iti viśeṣa aṃśa agrahe api na nirālambana tā āpattiḥ iti ucyate tat anyathā khyātau api tulyam yatas tatra api idam aṃśa khyātiḥ asti eva iti āha kasyacid iti

original: tasmādagrahaṇaviparyayagrahaṇalakṣaṇe dve avidye abhyupetavye | te ca pūrvā kāraṇam, uttarā kāryamityeva vyavasthite | tathāca rajjutatvāgrahaṇāt sarpādiviparyayo dṛśyate | evaṃ sati ca pūrvā suṣupte, parā ca svapnajāgaritayorityevamavidyāvibhāgopapattiḥ | tathāca gauḍapādairdarśitam—“kāryakāraṇabaddhau” iti |

original: kāryaṃ vikṣepā tmikā prapañcāvidyā, kāraṇamagrahaṇātmikā avidyā; tābhyāṃ baddhāvubhau viśvataijasaśabdavācyau jāgaritasthānasvapnasthānāvātmānāviṣyete | prājñastu suṣuptasthāna ātmā kāraṇena taccāgrahaṇātmikayā avidyayā baddhaḥ |
analyzed: kāryam vikṣepa ā tmikā prapañca avidyā kāraṇam agrahaṇa ātmikā avidyā tābhyām baddhau ubhau viśva taijasa śabda vācyau jāgarita sthāna svapna sthānau ātmānau iṣyete prājñaḥ tu suṣupta sthāne ātmā kāraṇena tat ca agrahaṇa ātmikayā avidyayā baddhaḥ

original: ubhe tu te avidye turye pūrvoktasthānatrayāpekṣayā turye “caturaśchayatāvādyakṣaralopaśca” iti smaraṇāt caturthe muktisthāne na sidhyata ityarthaḥ | nanu anyathaivāyamagrahaṇāsamyagrahaṇabhedenāvidyābhedo bhaviṣyati, kiṃ viparyayeṇa ? tatrāgrahaṇaṃ suṣupte, jāgaritasvapnayostvasamyagrahaṇamiti vyavasthāsiddhiḥ |
analyzed: ubhe tu te avidye turye pūrva ukta sthāna traya apekṣayā turye iti smaraṇāt caturthe mukti sthāne na sidhyate iti arthaḥ nanu anyathā eva ayam agrahaṇa asamyak grahaṇa bhedena avidyā bhedaḥ bhaviṣyati kim viparyayeṇa tatra agrahaṇam suṣupte jāgarita svapnayoḥ tu asamyak grahaṇam iti vyavasthā siddhiḥ

original: nanvasamyagrahaṇāgrahaṇayoḥ kiṃ bhedo'sti ; bāṭam ; tathāhi—abhinnasyaikasya prapañcabhedaiḥ rahitasyātmavastuno'pradeśasya vibhogyagrahaṇamasamyagrahaṇam, tathābhūtasyābhinnasyāpradeśasya vā agrahaṇamagrahaṇam | tadevaṃ grahaṇāgrahaṇa rūpatvāttayoḥ pṛthaktvena pratītiḥ | ato'styanayorbhedaḥ | naitatsāram ; yato
analyzed: nanu asamyak rahaṇa agrahaṇayoḥ kim tathā hi abhinnasya ekasya prapañca bhedaiḥ rahitasya ātma vastunā upradeśasya vibhogya grahaṇam asamyak rahaṇam tathābhūtasya abhinnasya apradeśasya vā agrahaṇam agrahaṇam tat evam grahaṇa agrahaṇa rūpa tvāt tayoḥ pṛthaktvena pratītiḥ atas asti anayoḥ bhedaḥ na etat sāram yatas

original: yadi tāvadviparyajñānādanyadviparyayāṃśaśūnyagrahaṇamātramasamyagrahaṇamiṣyate, taḥ P. 160-7. tkimavyaktāvabhātitvam ? athavā kenacidrūpeṇārthasya grahaṇaṃ, na sarvātmanā ? tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣaḥ, tadā dūrasthe sūkṣme cārthe bhavatyavyaktāvabhāttakajñānam; na ca tadavidyā |
analyzed: yadi tāvat viparya jñānāt anyat viparyaya aṃśa śūnya grahaṇa mātram asamyak grahaṇam iṣyate tat kim avyakta avabhāti tvam athavā kenacid rūpeṇa arthasya grahaṇam na sarva ātmanā tatra yadi ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ tadā dūra sthe sūkṣme ca arthe bhavati na ca tad avidyā

original: tathā dvitīye pakṣe tatraiva dūrasthe sthāṇāvūrdhvatāsāmānyamātraṃ jñātaṃ viśeṣajñānānna sarvātmanā jñātamityavidyā syāt; na caivam | kiñcaivaṃ sati sarvameva jñānaṃ na sarvātmanārthasya grāhakamiti sarvajñānānāmasamyajñānatvānmithyātvamāpatet | tasmādasamyagrahaṇamavidyeti yaduktaṃ tattāvadyuktam |
analyzed: tathā dvitīye pakṣe tatra eva dūra sthe sthāṇau ūrdhvatā sāmānya mātram jñātam viśeṣa jñānāt na sarva ātmanā jñātam iti avidyā syāt na ca evam kiñca evam sati sarvam eva jñānam na sarva ātmanā arthasya grāhakam iti sarva jñānānām asamyak jñāna tvāt mithyātvam āpatet tasmāt asamyak grahaṇam avidyā iti yat uktam tat tāvat yuktam

original: yadapyabhinnasyātmano'pradeśasyābhedagrahaṇaṃ dvitīyāvidyoktā; tatrāpi yadyabhedāgrahaṇamātraṃ prapañcagrahaṇarahitamavidyā, tadā tatrāvidyāyā nivartanīyaṃ nāsti | na hi abhedāgrahaṇaṃ nivartyam, yato duḥkhatrayahetutayā yaḥ puruṣasyāparādhyati sa tena nivartyaḥ; na cāgrahaṇaṃ tathā | kiṃtu, prapañcabhedaḥ; sa hi dviviṣaduḥkhāyatanam |
analyzed: yat api abhinnasya ātmanaḥ pradeśasya abheda grahaṇam dvitīyā avidyā uktā tatra api yadi abheda agrahaṇa mātram prapañca grahaṇa rahitam avidyā tadā tatra avidyāyāḥ nivartanīyam na asti na hi abheda agrahaṇam nivartyam yatas duḥkha traya hetu tayā yaḥ puruṣasya aparādhyati sa tena nivartyaḥ na ca agrahaṇam tathā kiṃtu prapañca bhedaḥ sa hi dvi viṣa duḥkha āyatanam

original: tathācānyathākhyātirabhyupetā syāt | atha bhinne bhedena bhātīti na brūmaḥ, yenānyathākhyātiḥ syāt; kiṃtvabhinnamapyātmatattvaṃ prapañcabhedena bhinnamiva bhātīti, tatro'cyate—kimatra bhinnena sahābhinnasya sādṛśyam ? yadivaśabdasyārthaḥ syāt |
analyzed: tathā ca anyathā khyātiḥ abhyupetā syāt atha bhinne bhedena bhāti iti na brūmaḥ yena anyathā khyātiḥ syāt kiṃtu abhinnam api ātma tattvam prapañca bhedena bhinnam iva bhāti iti tatra ucyate kim atra bhinnena saha abhinnasya sādṛśyam yat iva śabdasya arthaḥ syāt

original: yadi yathā bhinnamaprakāśamānaikatvaṃ prakāśate, tathātmatattvamabhinnamapyaprakāśamānaikatvaṃ prakāśata itīdaṃ sādṛśyamivārthaḥ, tadaikatvarahitasyātmatattvasya grahaṇāt kenacidaṃśena grahaṇaṃ na sarvātmanetyekalakṣaṇamasamyagrahaṇamuktaṃ syāt; tatra ca na kiñciñcānaṃ sarvātmanārthasya grāhakamiti sarvajñānamithyātvāpāta ityuktam |
analyzed: yadi yathā bhinnam aprakāśamāna ekatvam prakāśate tathā ātma tattvam abhinnam api aprakāśamāna ekatvam prakāśate iti idam sādṛśyam iva arthaḥ tadā aikatva rahitasya ātma tattvasya grahaṇāt kenacid aṃśena grahaṇam na sarva ātmanā iti eka lakṣaṇam asamyak grahaṇam uktam syāt tatra ca na sarva ātmanā arthasya grāhakam iti sarvajñāna mithyātva āpātaḥ iti uktam

original: athābhinnamātmatattvaṃ bhinnaṃ prakāśata iva, na tu prakāśata eva; ato'nyathākhyātiprasaṅga ityucyate, tadāpi bhinnaprakāśena sahābhinnaprakāśasya kiṃ sādṛśyaṃ vācyam | yathā bhinnaprakāśāt bhedavyavahārapravṛttiḥ, tathātmatattvasyābhinnasya bhedavyavahārādidaṃ sādṛśyamiti cet;
analyzed: atha abhinnam ātma tattvam bhinnam prakāśate iva na tu prakāśate eva atas nyathā khyāti prasaṅgaḥ iti ucyate tadā api bhinna prakāśena saha abhinna prakāśasya kim sādṛśyam vācyam yathā bhinna prakāśāt bheda vyavahāra pravṛttiḥ tathā ātma tattvasya abhinnasya bheda vyavahārāt idam sādṛśyam iti ced

original: na, abhinne'pi cedātmani bhedavyavahāro bhavati, asti tarhi tatrāpyātmani bhedaprakāśanam | yato bhedaprakāśo bhedavyavahārasya kāraṇam | na cāsati kāraṇe kāryaṃ bhavati | tataścābhinne'pyātmani bhedajñānodayāt āpannā anyathākhyātiḥ | athābhinnasyātmatattvasyābhedāgrahe'bhimānamātramidam, na tu bhedagrahaḥ; etadeva vyavahārahetuḥ;
analyzed: na abhinne api ced ātmani bheda vyavahāraḥ bhavati asti tarhi tatra api ātmani bheda prakāśanam yatas bheda prakāśaḥ bheda vyavahārasya kāraṇam na ca asati kāraṇe kāryam bhavati tatas ca abhinne api ātmani bheda jñāna udayāt āpannā anyathā khyātiḥ atha abhinnasya ātma tattvasya abheda agraha abhimāna mātram idam na tu bheda grahaḥ etat eva vyavahāra hetuḥ

original: ato nānyathākhyātiprasaṅga iti ceducyate, tadasat; abhedāgraho hi grahaṇābhāvaḥ | na cāsāvabhāvamaprameyamabhyupagacchatāṃ svarūpeṇa pararūpeṇa vā grāhyaḥ | na cāgṛhīte tasmin bhedagrahābhimāno'vakalpate | na
analyzed: atas na anyathā khyāti prasaṅgaḥ iti ced ucyate tat asat abheda agrahaḥ hi grahaṇa abhāvaḥ na ca asau abhāvam aprameyam abhyupagacchatām sva rūpeṇa para rūpeṇa vā grāhyaḥ na ca agṛhīte tasmin bheda graha abhimānaḥ uvakalpate na

original: brahmahītāyāṃ śuktau rajatagrahābhimāno bhavati | kiñcābhinnasyātmanaḥ prapañcātmanā bhedaśrendra prakāśot, tataḥ kuto bhedagrahaḥ ? nanu na bhedagrahaḥ, kiṃtu tadabhibhāna ityuktam | satyamuktam; kiṃtu bhedagrahādanyo nābhimāno nāma nirūpyate | ato bhedagraha evāsau | sa ca bhedāprakāśane na yukta iti sūktam |
analyzed: brahma hītāyām śuktau rajata graha abhimānaḥ bhavati kiñca abhinnasya ātmanaḥ prapañca ātmanā tatas kutas bheda grahaḥ nanu na bheda grahaḥ kiṃtu tad abhibhāne iti uktam satyam uktam kiṃtu bheda grahāt anyaḥ na abhimānaḥ nāma nirūpyate atas bheda grahaḥ eva asau sa ca bheda aprakāśane na yuktaḥ iti su uktam

original: kiñca abhinna ātmatattve prapañcātmanā bhedābhimāno viparītajñānamavidyetyasmatpakṣaṃ parityajyābhinnasyātmatattvasyābhedāgrahe bhedagrahābhimānamaṅgī kurvatā viparītakhyātirevāṅgīkṛtā | ataḥ kiṃ tena parihatam ? tasmāt 'layavikṣepabhedaśra na syādagrahamātrake' iti sūktam | vedāntānāṃ jñānavidhiparatve apahatapāpmādirūpamātmano na sidhyati;
analyzed: kiñca abhinne ātma tattve prapañca ātmanā bheda abhimānaḥ viparīta jñānam avidyā iti asmad pakṣam parityajya abhinnasya ātma tattvasya abheda agrahe bheda graha abhimānam aṅgī kurvatā viparīta khyātiḥ eva aṅgīkṛtā atas kim tena parihatam tasmāt laya vikṣepa bhedaḥ śra na syāt agraha mātrake iti sūktam vedāntānām jñāna vidhi paratve apahata pāpma ādi rūpam ātmanaḥ na sidhyati

original: P.151-1. yato nātmasvarūpeṇāvabhāsakaṃ jñānamityuktam; tatra codayati—nanviti | arūpeṇānātmarūpeṇa apahatapāpmatvādinā ātmano'vabhāse dṛṣṭe prayojanābhāvādadṛṣṭakalpanā syāt | apahatapāpmāderātmarūpasyāvabhāse tatsiddhirnāma dṛṣṭaphalam | yato'nyatrāpi jñeyasvarūpasiddhireva jñānaphalam | na ca dṛṣṭaphale saṃbhavatyadṛṣṭakalpanocitā |
analyzed: yatas na ātma svarūpeṇa avabhāsakam jñānam iti uktam tatra codayati nanu iti arūpeṇa anātma rūpeṇa apahata pāpma tva ādinā ātmanaḥ uvabhāse dṛṣṭe prayojana abhāvāt adṛṣṭa kalpanā syāt apahata pāpma ādeḥ ātma rūpasya avabhāse tad siddhiḥ nāma dṛṣṭa phalam yatas nyatra api jñeya sva rūpa siddhiḥ eva jñāna phalam na ca dṛṣṭa phale saṃbhavati adṛṣṭa kalpanā ucitā

original: tasmāt jñānavidhiparatve'pi vedāntānāmātmano'pahatapāpmādirūpasiddhirityarthaḥ | atrottaramāha—na dṛṣṭamātrāditi | dṛṣṭamātrādhataḥ kutaścidapuruṣārthādapi dṛṣṭānna dṛṣṭārthaṃ jñānaṃ bhavati; kiṃtu puruṣārthena vinā vidheranairākāṅkṣyāt puruṣārthānugaṃ puruṣārthasaṃsparśitat dṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: tasmāt jñāna vidhi para tve pi vedāntānām ātmanā upahata pāpma ādi rūpa siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ atra uttaram āha na dṛṣṭa mātrāt iti dṛṣṭa mātrāt hataḥ kutaścid apuruṣa arthāt api dṛṣṭāt na dṛṣṭa artham jñānam bhavati kiṃtu puruṣa arthena vinā vidheḥ anairākāṅkṣyāt puruṣa artha anugam puruṣa artha saṃsparśi tat dṛṣṭam phalam bhavati

original: na cāpahatapāpmāderātmarūpasyānātmarūpasya vāvabhāse puruṣārthasya bhāvo bhidyate viśiṣyate; ubhayatrāpi puruṣārthaphalatvamaviśiṣṭamityarthaḥ | aviśeṣaṃ prapañcayati—yatheti |
analyzed: na ca apahata pāpma ādeḥ ātma rūpasya anātma rūpasya vā avabhāse puruṣa arthasya bhāvaḥ bhidyate viśiṣyate ubhayatra api puruṣa artha phalatvam aviśiṣṭam iti arthaḥ aviśeṣam prapañcayati yathā iti

original: yathā prapañcaśūnyatvapakṣe apahatapāpmādiviśuddhādvyātmatattve jñānena prakāśite śokādiduḥkhasya karmaṇāṃ rāgādeśca kleśasya hānaṃ tyāgaḥ, tathāpahatapāpmādāvatattve'pi jñānena prakāśite teṣāṃ hānaṃ bhavedityarthaḥ | taduktam— “tasmādbhūtamabhūtaṃ vā yadyadevātibhāvyate | bhāvanāphalaniṣpattau sphuṭakalpā ca dhīḥ phalam ||” iti |
analyzed: yathā prapañca śūnyatva pakṣe apahata pāpma ādi viśuddha dvi ātma tattve jñānena prakāśite śoka ādi duḥkhasya karmaṇām rāga ādeḥ ca kleśasya hānam tyāgaḥ tathā apahata pāpma ādau atattve api jñānena prakāśite teṣām hānam bhavet iti arthaḥ tat uktam tasmāt bhūtam abhūtam vā yat yat eva atibhāvyate bhāvanā phala niṣpattau sphuṭa kalpā ca dhīḥ phalam iti

original: yaśca vṛttau jīvanmuktaḥ sa manorapi saṃmataḥ | tathā cāha— “kapālaṃ vṛkṣamūlāni kucalamatsahāyatā | samatā caiva bhūteṣu etanmuktasya lakṣaṇam ||” iti |
analyzed: yaḥ ca vṛttau jīvanmuktaḥ sa manoḥ api saṃmataḥ tathā ca āha kapālam vṛkṣa mūlāni sama tā ca eva bhūteṣu etat muktasya lakṣaṇam iti

original: na cātra rāgādimukto mukto'bhimataḥ, viśeṣasyānupādānāt | tasmādagṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvāt sarvabandhamukto'tra mukta ukta iti gamyate | bandhasya hi mūlaṃ kāraṇamavidyā | tasyāṃ ca nirlepamapahatāyāṃ kāraṇanivṛttyaiva bandhasya nivṛtterupapannā viduṣo jīvata eva muktiḥ |
analyzed: na ca atra rāga ādi muktaḥ muktaḥ abhimataḥ viśeṣasya anupādānāt tasmāt agṛhyamāṇa viśeṣa tvāt sarva bandha muktaḥ utra muktaḥ uktaḥ iti gamyate bandhasya hi mūlam kāraṇam avidyā tasyām ca nirlepam apahatāyām kāraṇa nivṛttyā eva bandhasya nivṛtteḥ upapannā viduṣaḥ jīvataḥ eva muktiḥ

original: yā tu prapañcasya bādhitasyāpyābhāsamātreṇānuvṛttiḥ, tadupapattiḥ pūrvamukteti na punarucyate | atra cāvirbhūtādvayātmaprakāśo jīvanmukto'bhipretaḥ, na vākyārthamātraviditi viśuddhādvayādirūpamātmataccamevātmano jñānena prakāśyata iti | idamevātra yuktam | evaṃ hi dvayagrāhiṇāṃ pratyakṣādīnāṃ virodho na bhavati |
analyzed: yā tu prapañcasya bādhitasya api ābhāsa mātreṇa anuvṛttiḥ tad upapattiḥ pūrvam uktā iti na punar ucyate atra ca āvirbhūta advaya ātma prakāśaḥ jīvanmuktaḥ abhipretaḥ na vākya artha mātra vid iti viśuddha advaya ādi rūpam ātma taccam eva ātmanaḥ jñānena prakāśyate iti idam eva atra yuktam evam hi dvaya grāhiṇām pratyakṣa ādīnām virodhaḥ na bhavati

original: karmavidhānaṃ ca sādhyasādhanetikartavyatādibhedaviṣayaṃ satyārthaṃ bhavati | paramārthe hi prapañcaśūnyatve prapañcagrāhīṇi pratyakṣādīni bādhyeran | karmaviṣayaścābhūtaviṣayāḥ syuḥ | tasmāt “vācaṃ dhenumupāsīta” ityādivat abhūtātmādvaitaviṣayajñānavidhirayamiti yujyate | anaupacārikārthā iti; anaupacārikaḥ kalpito'rtho viṣayo yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: karma vidhānam ca sādhya sādhana itikartavya tā ādi bheda viṣayam satya artham bhavati paramārthe hi prapañca śūnya tve prapañca grāhīṇi pratyakṣa ādīni bādhyeran karma viṣayaḥ ca abhūta viṣayāḥ syuḥ tasmāt vācam dhenum upāsīta ityādi vat abhūta ātma advaita viṣaya jñāna vidhiḥ ayam iti yujyate anaupacārika arthāḥ iti anaupacārikaḥ kalpita ūrthaḥ viṣayaḥ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ

original: abhūtasya kalpanā, saivopādānaṃ yasya, sa cāsau vyavahārasiddhaśvāsāvarthaśca, tadvocarā iti vṛttau vigrahaḥ | nanu jānātistaccabodhaviṣayaḥ; ataḥ satyamevādvayādirūpamātmano jñānaviṣaya iti śaṅkayati—jānātiriti | tatrottaramāha—neti | jānātistaccabodhe na vartate |
analyzed: abhūtasya kalpanā sā eva upādānam yasya sa ca asau vyavahāra siddhaḥ śva asau arthaḥ ca tad vocarāḥ iti vṛttau vigrahaḥ nanu jānātiḥ tad ca bodha viṣayaḥ atas satyam eva advaya ādi rūpam ātmanaḥ jñāna viṣayaḥ iti śaṅkayati jānātiḥ iti tatra uttaram āha na iti jānātiḥ tad ca bodhe na vartate

original: kutaḥ ? mithyājñānaṃ samyagjñānaṃ saṃśayajñānamiti mithyādibhirjñānasya viśeṣaṇāt | anyathā samyagjñānamityatra viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇapadayoḥ paunaruktyaṃ syāt | mithyājñānaṃ saṃśayajñānamityatra virodhaḥ | nanu ‘ātmā jñātavyaḥ’ ityātmajñānaṃ vidhīyate | tatra yadyāropitenātmarūpeṇa viśuddhādvayādīnāṃ jñānaṃ syāt, tathā sati nātmā jñātaḥ syāt |
analyzed: kutas mithyājñānam samyak jñānam saṃśaya jñānam iti mithyā ādibhiḥ jñānasya viśeṣaṇāt anyathā samyak jñānam iti atra viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa padayoḥ paunaruktyam syāt mithyājñānam saṃśaya jñānam iti atra virodhaḥ nanu ātmā jñātavyaḥ iti ātma jñānam vidhīyate tatra yadi āropitena ātma rūpeṇa viśuddha advaya ādīnām jñānam syāt tathā sati na ātmā jñātaḥ syāt

original: ātmarūpeṇa hi pratīta ātmā jñāto bhavati, nānyathā | tataścādvayādirūpeṇātmajñānavidherātmanastadrūpasiddhirityāśaṅkayati—nātmeti | tatrottaramāha—na tadrūpeti | yadi ‘ātmā jñātavyaḥ’ ityetāvadidaṃ vākyaṃ syāt; tena cātmasvarūpajñānaṃ vidhīyate, tataḥ syādevam; na tvetadasti;
analyzed: ātma rūpeṇa hi pratītaḥ ātmā jñātaḥ bhavati na anyathā tatas ca advaya ādi rūpeṇa ātma jñāna vidheḥ ātmanaḥ tad rūpa siddhiḥ iti āśaṅkayati na ātmā iti tatra uttaram āha na tad rūpa iti yadi ātmā jñātavyaḥ iti etāvat idam vākyam syāt tena ca ātma svarūpa jñānam vidhīyate tatas syāḥ evam na tu etat asti

original: ātmanaḥ pramāṇāntarasiddhatve tasyānuvādatvāt, anirjātasvarūpasya jātumaśakyatvāt | ataścātmanaḥ pramāṇāntarasiddhatve, anyathā pramāṇāntarasiddhatve ca sutarāmātmasvarūpasyāvidhānam | yadi “apahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyuḥ” ityādiśabdatamapitena rūpeṇa tasyātmano jñānaṃ vidhīyate, tadā tenāpahata

analyzed: pāpma ādi rūpeṇa taccena api adhyāropitena api vācam dhenum upāsīta iti vadasya ātmanaḥ jñānam avakalpate tena jñāna vidheḥ apahata pāpma ādeḥ ātma svarūpasya tattva tva siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ kiṃca na tāvat advaya ātma prakāśa lakṣaṇam jñānam adṛṣṭa artham na hi tena kiñcid adṛṣṭam janyate tatra yadi dṛṣṭa artham tatra ucyate jñānam iti

original: tasyopāyo na jñātaḥ, tenopāyājñānāt dṛṣṭaphale'pi jñāne vidhimantareṇa puruṣo na pravartata iti jñānaṃ vidhīyata ityāśaṅkayati—taditi | atrottaramāha—tasyeti | atha dṛṣṭārthamapi jñānamavadhātādivat vidhāsyata ityāśaṅkayati—avadhāteti | tatrāpi taṇḍulagataniyamādṛṣṭamasti;
analyzed: tasya upāyaḥ na jñātaḥ tena upāya ajñānāt dṛṣṭa phale api jñāne vidhim antareṇa puruṣaḥ na pravartate iti jñānam vidhīyate iti āśaṅkayati tat iti atra uttaram āha tasya iti atha dṛṣṭa artham api jñānam avadhātā ādi vat vidhāsyate iti āśaṅkayati avadhātā iti tatra api taṇḍula gata niyama adṛṣṭam asti

original: avadhātādvilakṣaṇastuṣādivimokaḥ, tato vilakṣaṇastaṇḍulāḥ, tato vilakṣaṇaṃ piṣṭam, tato vilakṣaṇaṃ puroḍāśa ityevaṃ praṇāḍyā pradhānāpūrvasiddherevādṛṣṭaṃ tatrāstīti bhāvaḥ | athādvayātmajñānamadṛṣṭapūrvamalaukikam; ato'dṛṣṭārthamapi tadvidhīyata iti, tatrāha—alaukikamiti | kimarthaṃ tadvidhīyate ? na tāvadātmasvarūpasya siddhaye pratipattaye;
analyzed: avadhātāt vilakṣaṇaḥ tuṣa ādi vimokaḥ tatas vilakṣaṇaḥ taṇḍulāḥ tatas vilakṣaṇam piṣṭam tatas vilakṣaṇam puroḍāśaḥ iti evam praṇāḍyā pradhāna apūrva siddheḥ eva adṛṣṭam tatra asti iti bhāvaḥ atha advaya ātma jñānam adṛṣṭa pūrvam alaukikam atas dṛṣṭa artham api tat vidhīyate iti tatra āha alaukikam iti kimartham tat vidhīyate na tāvat ātma svarūpasya siddhaye pratipattaye

original: yato na pratipattimātraphalo vidhiḥ, apitu kartavyatā anuṣṭhānaṃ vidhito bhavati | sā ca dṛṣṭārthaṃ jñāne dṛṣṭādeva phalāt bhojanādivat prasidhyati;
analyzed: yatas na pratipatti mātra phalaḥ vidhiḥ apitu kartavya tā anuṣṭhānam vidhitaḥ bhavati sā ca dṛṣṭārtham jñāne dṛṣṭāt eva phalāt bhojana ādi vat prasidhyati

original: kiṃ vidhinā ? ato'laukike apahatapāpmādirūpe ātmatattve'rthaṃ śabdena prathamaṃ parokṣatayā pratipādite tasyāparokṣajñāne tamaparokṣīkartuṃ tasyāparokṣajñānasya jñeyabhūtātmopāyatvāt svayamevānmukhaḥ pumān | tathāhi—kasyacidvākyādāśrayeśrūtaṃ gandharvanagarādi śrutvā tadaparokṣīkaraṇe svayameva pumān unmukho bhavatīti | ataḥ kiṃ vidhineti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kim vidhinā atas laukike apahata pāpma ādi rūpe śabdena prathamam parokṣatayā pratipādite tasya aparokṣa jñāne tam aparokṣīkartum tasya aparokṣa jñānasya jñeya bhūtātma upāya tvāt svayam eva anmukhaḥ pumān tathā hi kasyacid vākyāt āśraye śrūtam gandharvanagara ādi śrutvā tad aparokṣīkaraṇe svayam eva pumān unmukhaḥ bhavati iti atas kim vidhinā iti bhāvaḥ

original: kva nāma vidhiryujyata ityāha—taditi | upasaṃharati—niyogeti | ato'pahatapāpmādivacasāṃ jñānaniyogānupraveśo bhūte siddharūpe'rthaṃ teṣāṃ pramāṇatāṃ vihanti, atatparatvāt | itihūtau | bhūtasya siddhasyāpahatapāpmāderarthasya gatimicchatā niyogānupraveśo nopāsyo na manasi kārya ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: kva nāma vidhiḥ yujyate iti āha tat iti upasaṃharati niyoga iti atas upahata pāpma ādi vacasām jñāna niyoga anupraveśaḥ bhūte siddha rūpa īrtham teṣām pramāṇatām vihanti atatpara tvāt iti hūtau bhūtasya siddhasya apahata pāpma ādeḥ arthasya gatim icchatā niyoga anupraveśaḥ na upāsyaḥ na manasi kāryaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tadeva prāyuktāsu tisrapu pratipattipu madhye prathamā śābdī pratipattiḥ, tṛtīyā cādvayātmaprakāśarūpā na vidhīyata ityuktam | adhunā upāsanākhyā thā dvitīyā pratipattiḥ, tasyāḥ pratipattervidhirnirasyate—ata pūrveti |
analyzed: tat eva prāyuktāsu tisrapu pratipattipu madhye prathamā śābdī pratipattiḥ tṛtīyā ca advaya ātma prakāśa rūpā na vidhīyate iti uktam adhunā upāsana ākhyā dvitīyā pratipattiḥ tasyāḥ pratipatteḥ vidhiḥ nirasyate atas pūrvā iti

original: bhūte'rthaṃ pramāṇābhāvaprasaṅgādityarthaḥ | ‘niṣṭhatā’ ityasyānantaraṃ siddhānāṃ vedāntānāmityadhyāhāryam | ata evetyupajīvitamarthaṃ darśayati—tatrāpīti | P 153-16 pūrvavaditi; yathā tṛtīyavidhiparatve atasparatvādvākyasya nātmasvarūpāvagatisiddhiḥ, tathetyarthaḥ | yadi tvapahatapāpmādivākyaṃ svarūpaniṣṭhameva na niyoganiṣṭham;
analyzed: bhūta īrtham pramāṇa abhāva prasaṅgāt iti arthaḥ niṣṭhatā iti asya anantaram siddhānām vedāntānām iti adhyāhāryam atas eva iti upajīvitam artham darśayati tatra api iti pūrvavat iti yathā tṛtīya vidhi para tve ataspara tvāt vākyasya na ātma svarūpa avagati siddhiḥ tathā iti arthaḥ yadi tu apahatapāpma ādi vākyam svarūpa niṣṭham eva na niyoga niṣṭham

original: tena tasmātpramitasyātmasvarūpasya “nididhyāsitavyaḥ” ityādervaco'ntarādupāsanavidhānamiṣyate, tat syādeva; na kaściddoṣaḥ | tathāca “vijñāya prajñāṃ kurvīta” ityatra ‘vijñāya’ iti klāpratyayenātmataccajñānasya vedāntajasya prajñākaraṇāt pūrvasiddhatāṃ darśayatītyāha—svarūpeti | tadapi copāsanavidhānaṃ dyathā, vidheraprāptārthatvāt;
analyzed: tena tasmāt pramitasya ātma svarūpasya nididhyāsitavyaḥ ityādeḥ vacaḥ ntarāt upāsana vidhānam iṣyate tat syāt eva na kaścid doṣaḥ tathā ca vijñāya prajñām kurvīta iti atra vijñāya iti klā pratyayena ātma tad ca jñānasya vedānta jasya prajñā karaṇāt pūrva siddha tām darśayati iti āha svarūpa iti tat api ca upāsana vidhānam dyathā vidheḥ aprāpta artha tvāt

original: asya ca dṛṣṭārthatayaiva bhojanādivat prāpterityāha—prāpteriti | dṛṣṭārthatvamāha—abhyāseneti | etaduktaṃ bhavati—yadi svargādivanmuktiradṛṣṭaphalaṃ syāt, tatastatphalānucintanamadṛṣṭārthatvādaprāptaṃ vidhīyeta; kiṃtu svarūpāvirbhāvamātraṃ muktiriti varṇitam | svarūpāvirbhāvaśca śabdātparokṣatayāvagatasyādvyātmanaḥ sākṣādbhāvaḥ |
analyzed: asya ca dṛṣṭārtha tayā eva bhojana ādi vat prāpteḥ iti āha prāpteḥ iti dṛṣṭārtha tvam āha abhyāsena iti etat uktam bhavati yadi svarga ādi vat muktiḥ adṛṣṭa phalam syāt tatas tad phala anucintanam adṛṣṭa artha tvāt aprāptam vidhīyeta kiṃtu svarūpa āvirbhāva mātram muktiḥ iti varṇitam svarūpa āvirbhāvaḥ ca śabdāt parokṣa tayā avagatasya ādvi ātmanaḥ sākṣāt bhāvaḥ

original: sa cānucintanasya bhojanasyeva tṛptirdṛṣṭaṃ phalam, jñānābhyāsena pratyayaprakarṣadarśanāt | tathāhi—abhūtamapi yadanubhāvyate tatra sākṣādanubhavamāpadyata ityuktam; kiṃ punarbhūtam | tadevaṃ dṛṣṭārthamanucintanam | na ca dṛṣṭārthaṃ dṛṣṭanirākāṅkṣatvādadṛṣṭaṃ phalamākāṅkṣate |
analyzed: sa ca anucintanasya bhojanasya iva tṛptiḥ dṛṣṭam phalam jñāna abhyāsena pratyaya prakarṣa darśanāt tathā hi abhūtam api yat anubhāvyate tatra sākṣāt anubhavam āpadyate iti uktam kim punar bhūtam tat evam dṛṣṭa artham anucintanam na ca dṛṣṭa artham dṛṣṭa nirākāṅkṣa tvāt adṛṣṭam phalam ākāṅkṣate

original: tasmādṛṣṭārthatayā prāptārthamanucintanamavidheyamityupasaṃharati—tasmāditi | vṛttau ‘yadapi’ ityādinā pūrvapakṣopanyāsaḥ | ‘taccamasi’ iti taccapadārthayorbrahmajīvayorabhedaṃ dhārayedityācāryaṇokte śiṣyābhiprāyeṇa ‘sadasmi’ ityuttamapuruṣanirdeśaḥ | dhārayediti dhāraṇamanucintanamucyate |
analyzed: tasmāt dṛṣṭārtha tayā prāpta artham anucintanam avidheyam iti upasaṃharati tasmāt iti vṛttau yat api ityādinā pūrvapakṣa upanyāsaḥ tat camasi iti tad ca padārthayoḥ brahma jīvayoḥ abhedam dhārayet iti ācāryaṇa ukte śiṣya abhiprāyeṇa sat asmi iti uttamapuruṣa nirdeśaḥ dhārayet iti dhāraṇam anucintanam ucyate

original: “taccamasi” - ityatrāśruto'pi vidhiḥ “pūṣā prapiṣṭhabhāgaḥ” ityatreva kalpyata iti paro manyate | śravaṇāditi; vedāntaśravaṇopalakṣitāt vedāntavākyārthajñānādanyadityarthaḥ | “sa kratuṃ kurvīta” ityādiśrutiṣu kratuprajñāśabdābhyāmanucintanamuktam |
analyzed: tat camasi iti atra aśrutaḥ api vidhiḥ pūṣā prapiṣṭha bhāgaḥ iti atra iva kalpyate iti paraḥ manyate śravaṇāt iti vedānta śravaṇa upalakṣitāt vedānta vākya artha jñānāt anyat iti arthaḥ sa kratum kurvīta ityādi śrutiṣu kratu prajñā śabdābhyām anucintanam uktam

original: dhyāyatinā tayorbhede tulyavannirdeśānupapattirmā bhūditi abhedadarśanārthamanucintanaṃ dhyānamiti paryāyanirdeśaḥ | pratyayapravāha iti ca dhyānavivaraṇam | karmavaditi; yathāgnihotrādi karma svargādiphalaṃ tathetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: dhyāyatinā tayoḥ bhede tulya vat nirdeśa anupapattiḥ mā bhūt iti abheda darśana artham anucintanam dhyānam iti paryāya nirdeśaḥ pratyaya pravāhaḥ iti ca dhyāna vivaraṇam karma vat iti yathā agnihotra ādi karma svarga ādi phalam tathā iti arthaḥ

original: P. 154-8. bāśropāsanāviṣāyakāḥ śrutaya uktāḥ, tāsu “sa kratuṃ kurvīta” ityeṣā tāvacchrutiḥ sakalaviśeṣanirmuktasya nirupādherātmatattvasyopāsanaṃ nirviśeṣabrahmībhāvaphalaṃ na vidhatte; kiṃtu “manomayaḥ prāṇaśarīro bhārūpaḥ” ityanuvṛttermanomayādiviśeṣopādhikasya sopādherātmano'nucintanamaiśvaryaphalam;

aiśvaryamanubhūya paścāt krameṇa vā svarūpāvirbhāvalakṣaṇaṃ muktiphalaṃ vidhatte, na tu sākṣānmuktiphalam | ato na tatra nirviśeṣātmavādinām “apahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyuḥ” ityādīnām “asthūlamanaṇu” ityādīnāṃ vākyānāmanvayo ghaṭate | nāmarūpe śabdārthāvupādhī yasya manomayādirūpasyātmanaḥ, tasyānudhyānamiti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: aiśvaryam anubhūya paścāt krameṇa vā svarūpa āvirbhāva lakṣaṇam mukti phalam vidhatte na tu sākṣāt mukti phalam atas na tatra nirviśeṣa ātma vādinām apahata pāpmā vijaraḥ vimṛtyuḥ ityādīnām asthūlam anaṇu ityādīnām vākyānām anvayaḥ ghaṭate nāma rūpe śabda arthau upādhī yasya manaḥ maya ādi rūpasya ātmanaḥ tasya anudhyānam iti vigrahaḥ

original: tathā “tameva dhīro vijñāya prajñāṃ kurvīta” ityatrāpi ‘raktaḥ paṭo bhavati’ itivat upapadasaṃkrānto vidhyarthaḥ | tena nāsyopāsanāvidhau tātparyam; apitu ‘tameva’ ityanyanivṛttau | tathāhi— tatrākāśāditattvānāṃ bhedaṃ pratipādyātmābhedaḥ pratipāditaḥ | tathāca “virajaḥ para ākāśāt” iti pūrvārthe ākāśātparatvamuktam |
analyzed: tathā tam eva dhīraḥ vijñāya prajñām kurvīta iti atra api raktaḥ paṭaḥ bhavati iti vat upapada saṃkrāntaḥ vidhi arthaḥ tena na asya upāsanā vidhau tātparyam apitu tam eva iti anya nivṛttau tathā hi tatra ākāśa ādi tattvānām bhedam pratipādya ātma abhedaḥ pratipāditaḥ tathā ca virajaḥ paraḥ ākāśāt iti pūrva arthe ākāśāt para tvam uktam

original: tatra tathaiva prajñākaraṇaṃ prāpte ‘tameva’ ityevakāreṇa ‘nākāśātparatvenātmani prajñā kartavyā, apitvākāśamantarbhāvyaiva kevalaḥ’ ityevakārārthatātparyam | yadi tu naiva vyākhyāyate, tadā evakāro'narthakaḥ syāt | na cāsya nivartyāntaramasti | tathāca kevala evātmā dhyeyo nākāśādīti |
analyzed: tatra tathā eva prajñā karaṇam prāpte tam eva iti evakāreṇa na ākāśāt paratvena ātmani prajñā kartavyā api tu ākāśam antarbhāvya eva kevalaḥ iti evakāra artha tātparyam yadi tu nā eva vyākhyāyate tadā evakāraḥ unarthakaḥ syāt na ca asya nivartya antaram asti tathā ca kevalaḥ eva ātmā dhyeyaḥ na ākāśa ādi iti

original: etadeva “nānudhyāyādbrahmabrahmabrahma vāco viglāpanaṃ hi tat” ityanena prajñākaraṇavākyatāpannena prapañcayate | na ca vācyam—śabdasyānudhyānaniṣedho'yam, nārthasyeti; yataḥ śabdamātrasyānudhyānamaprasaktatvānna niṣedhyam | ataḥ śabdapūrvakatvāt śabdārthānudhyānaniṣedha evāyamiti |
analyzed: etat eva na anudhyāyāt brahma brahma brahma vācaḥ viglāpanam hi tat iti anena prajñā karaṇa vākya tā āpannena prapañcayate na ca vācyam śabdasya anudhyāna niṣedhaḥ yam na arthasya iti yatas śabda mātrasya anudhyānam aprasakta tvāt na niṣedhyam atas śabda pūrvaka tvāt śabda artha anudhyāna niṣedhaḥ eva ayam iti

original: tathā “ātmetyevopāsīta” ityayamapyevakāraśravaṇādanyanivṛttiparo vidhiḥ, nopāsanāparaḥ | tathā “nididhyāsitavyaḥ” ityayamapi nopāsanāvidhiḥ; yasmāt “ātmanastu kāmāya” ityupakramāt “idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā” ityupasaṃhārācca ātmasvarūpaparamekamidaṃ vākyam |
